items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *On Saturday evening, at Little Vespers:*[^16]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," we set 4 verses, and we sing 3 Resurrectional stichera, repeating the sticheron of the first verse.*[^17]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *(The work of our venerable father John Damascene)*[^18]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Sticheron 1:* Accept our evening prayers, O holy Lord, and grant us remission of sins; for Thou alone art He Who hath manifested the Resurrection unto the world.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Sticheron 2:* Encompass Sion, ye peoples, and embrace her, and give glory within her unto Him Who is risen from the dead; for He is our God, Who hath delivered us from our iniquities.[^19]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Sticheron 3:* Come, ye peoples, let us sing and worship Christ, glorifying His Resurrection from the dead; for He is our God, Who hath delivered the world from the deceit of the enemy.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Theotokion Dogmatikon, in the same Tone:*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Theotokion Dogmatikon (continued):* Today is a festival of virginity, brethren! Let creation leap for joy, let mankind dance; for the holy Theotokos hath summoned us, the undefiled treasury of virginity, the spiritual paradise of the Second Adam, the storehouse of the union of the two natures, the festival of the saving reconciliation, the bridal chamber wherein the Word truly espoused the flesh, the light cloud that bore in the body Him Who is above the Cherubim. By her prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Then: "O Joyful Light." Prokimenon: "The Lord is King," with its verses [LXX Ps. 92:1];*[^20] *and after "Vouchsafe, O Lord," the priest says no litany, but we sing the Resurrectional sticheron at the Aposticha, in Tone 1:*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Aposticha Sticheron:* By Thy Passion, O Christ, we have been set free from passions, and by Thy Resurrection we have been delivered from corruption; O Lord, glory to Thee.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Most Holy Theotokos.*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Preeminently glorified art thou throughout generations of generations, O Virgin Maiden Mother, Theotokos Mary, protectress of the world, having in the flesh given birth to the Son of the unoriginate Father, truly co-eternal with the Spirit; entreat Him that we may be saved.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Held fast by unexpected afflictions, O pure one, having thee as our sole intercessor, O Virgin, we cry aloud in thanksgiving: Save us, O all-holy Bride of God; for thou art the refuge of the world, and the protection of our race.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* The world was renewed at thy childbirth, O maiden Theotokos, salvation of the faithful and unslumbering intercessor for those who piously pray to thee, O all-pure one! Cease not fervently praying for all who sing thy praise.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Theotokion Dogmatikon:* A cloud of the co-eternal Light did the Prophet call thee, O Virgin; for descending from thee like rain upon the fleece [LXX Ps. 71:6],[^24] the Father's Word, and having shone forth from thee, enlightened the world and destroyed deceit, Christ our God. Praying fervently unto Him, O most holy one, we pray: Cease not to intercede for us who confess thee to be the true Theotokos.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Then: "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart." Trisagion Prayers. After "Our Father:" The Resurrectional troparion (see fol. 5);*[^25] *Glory... Both now... its Theotokion. The litany: "Have mercy on us, O God," and the Dismissal.*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *On Saturday at Great Vespers:*[^26]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *After the Initial Psalm, the usual kathisma of the Psalter.*[^27]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," we set 10 verses, and we sing 3 Resurrectional stichera, 4 Eastern stichera, and 3 or 6 from the Menaion. If a celebrated saint occurs, Glory... from the Menaion; Both now... Theotokion 1 of the Tone.*[^28]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Stichera of the Octoechos, Tone 1:*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Sticheron 1:* Accept our evening prayers, O holy Lord, and grant us remission of sins, for Thou alone art He Who hath manifested the Resurrection unto the world.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Sticheron 2:* Encompass Sion, ye peoples, and embrace her, and give glory within her unto Him Who is risen from the dead; for He is our God, Who hath delivered us from our iniquities.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Sticheron 3:* Come, ye peoples, let us sing and worship Christ, glorifying His Resurrection from the dead; for He is our God, Who hath delivered the world from the deceit of the enemy.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Other Eastern Stichera, Tone 1:*[^29]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Eastern Sticheron 1:* Rejoice, ye heavens; trumpet forth, ye foundations of the earth; cry out in rejoicing, ye mountains [LXX Isa. 44:23, 49:13]![^30] For behold, Emmanuel hath nailed our sins to the Cross, and giving life, He hath slain death, having raised up Adam, as the Lover of mankind.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Eastern Sticheron 2:* Let us sing unto Him Who was willingly crucified in the flesh for our sake, Who suffered, and was buried, and rose from the dead, saying: Establish Thy Church in Orthodoxy, O Christ, and bring peace unto our life, as Thou art good and the Lover of mankind.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Eastern Sticheron 3:* Standing before Thy life-receiving tomb, we unworthy ones offer praise unto Thine ineffable lovingkindness, O Christ our God; for Thou, the Sinless One, didst accept the Cross and death, that Thou mightest grant resurrection unto the world, as the Lover of mankind.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Eastern Sticheron 4:* Let us praise the Word, co-unoriginate and co-eternal with the Father, Who came forth from the virginal

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Eastern Sticheron 4 (continued):* womb ineffably, and willingly accepted the Cross and death for our sake, and rose in glory, saying: O Giver of life, Lord, glory to Thee, Savior of our souls.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Glory... from the Menaion; Both now... Theotokion:*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Theotokion Dogmatikon:* Let us praise the Virgin Mary, the glory of all the world, who blossomed forth from men and gave birth to the Master, the heavenly gate, the hymn of the bodiless powers, and the beauty of the faithful; for she was revealed as heaven and the temple of the Godhead; she destroyed the barrier of enmity, brought in peace, and opened the kingdom. Having her, therefore, as the anchor of faith, we have as our champion the Lord Who was born of her. Be of good courage therefore, be of good courage, O people of God; for He shall defeat the enemies, as He is all-powerful.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *The Entrance. "O Joyful Light." After the Entrance, the daily Prokimenon:*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Tone 6: The Lord is King, He is robed in majesty [LXX Ps. 92:1].*[^31]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Verse 1: The Lord is robed in strength, and He hath girded Himself [LXX Ps. 92:1].*[^32]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Verse 2: For He hath established the world, so that it shall not be moved [LXX Ps. 92:1].*[^33]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Verse 3: Holiness becomes Thy house, O Lord, unto length of days [LXX Ps. 92:5].*[^34]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Then the usual litany. "Vouchsafe, O Lord." "Let us complete our evening prayer," and the rest.*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Sticheron:* By Thy Passion, O Christ, we have been set free from passions, and by Thy Resurrection we have been delivered from corruption. O Lord, glory to Thee.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Other Stichera in Alphabetical Order.*[^35] *Verse: The Lord is King, He is robed in majesty [LXX Ps. 92:1].*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Alphabetical Sticheron 1:* Let creation rejoice, let the heavens be glad, let the nations clap their hands with gladness; for Christ our Savior hath nailed our sins to the Cross, and having slain death, hath bestowed life upon us, having raised up all-father Adam, as the Lover of mankind.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Alphabetical Sticheron 2:* Being King of heaven and earth, O Incomprehensible One, Thou wast willingly crucified in Thy love for mankind. When Hades met Thee below, it was embittered, and receiving the souls of the righteous, they rejoiced; and Adam, seeing Thee, the Creator, in the nethermost regions, arose. O marvel! How did the Life of all taste death? But as He willed, He enlightened the world that cries aloud and saith: Risen from the dead, O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Alphabetical Sticheron 3:* Bearing myrrh, the myrrh-bearing women with haste and lamentation reached Thy tomb; and not finding Thy most pure body, yet learning from the Angel of the new and glorious miracle, they said unto the Apostles: The Lord is risen, granting great mercy unto the world.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Glory... from the Menaion, if there is one; but if not, Glory... Both now... Theotokion:*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Behold, the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled [Isa. 7:14];[^36] for as a Virgin thou didst give birth, and after childbirth thou didst remain even as before childbirth; for He Who was born was God, and therefore He re-fashioned the nature of things. But O Mother of God, despise not the supplications of thy servants, which are offered unto thee in thy temple; but as thou bearest the Compassionate One in thine arms, have pity upon thy servants, and pray that our souls may be saved.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Then: "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart." Trisagion Prayers. After "Our Father:"*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Troparion:* While the stone was sealed by the Jews and the soldiers were guarding Thy most pure body, Thou didst arise on the third day, O Savior, granting life unto the world; therefore the heavenly powers cried aloud unto Thee, O Giver of life: Glory to Thy Resurrection, O Christ; glory to Thy kingdom; glory to Thy dispensation, O Thou Who alone art the Lover of mankind!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* When Gabriel proclaimed unto thee, "Hail!" O Virgin, at his voice the Master of all became incarnate in thee, the holy Ark, even as righteous David said [LXX Ps. 131:8].[^37] Thou wast revealed as more spacious than the heavens, having borne Thy Creator. Glory to Him Who made His abode within thee; glory to Him Who came forth from thee; glory to Him Who hath set us free through thy childbirth!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *On Saturday at Compline:*[^38]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *And we:* Amen. *Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee. O Heavenly King...* Trisagion Prayers. And after *Our Father:* *Lord, have mercy (12 times).* *Glory... Both now...* *Come, let us worship (3 times).* Psalm 50: *Have mercy on me, O God [LXX Ps. 50];*[^39] Psalm 69: *O God, be attentive unto helping me [LXX Ps. 69];*[^40] Psalm 142: *Lord, hear my prayer [LXX Ps. 142].*[^41] *After this: Glory to God in the highest. Lord, Thou hast been our refuge. Vouchsafe, O Lord, this night. Then: I believe in one God [the Nicene-Constantinopolitan Creed].*[^42] *After this, we sing:*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos:*[^43]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Ode 1, Tone 1. Heirmos:* Israel, delivered from bitter bondage, crossed the impassable sea as dry land. Beholding the enemy drowned, it sang a hymn unto God as Benefactor, Who performs wonders with an outstretched arm; for He hath been glorified.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The angelic ranks were struck with awe in fear, O Sovereign Lady, praising thee; and every intellect sings of thee as Mother of the Creator because of goodness; for having given birth to Christ, thou didst surpass every rank of praise.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Tormented by grievous tribulations and harassed by foes, wretch that I am, I call out with tears: Stretch forth thy hand unto me from on high, O all-abundant one, delivering me, and vouchsafe that I may live without peril through thy prayers. Glory...

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Heal the secret transgressions of my soul with the medicine of mercy, and calm the surging of the flesh, O Theotokos! And turning back the spears and arrows of the enemies, pierce them firmly into their own hearts. Both now...

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* The virginal womb consumed the ancient, murderous pasture by giving birth to Christ; therefore all creation now rejoices, O all-pure one, as having been brought to life, and in unison sings praises unto thy Son and God.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Let not the mortal boast in his own wisdom and riches [LXX 1 Reg. 2:10; Jer. 9:23],[^44] but in the faith of the Lord, orthodoxly crying unto Christ God and singing ever: Establish me upon the rock of Thy commandments, O Master.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Sleeping once on his journey, great Jacob marveled as he beheld the angels descending from on high unto the earth upon a ladder, O Virgin [Gen. 28:12];[^45] and awakening, he clearly depicted thee as the gate of heaven.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Cast into tribulations by a temporary restraint, wretch that I am, and tormented by tempestuous perils, woe is me, I cry: O thou who didst give birth to God and hast exalted our horn, save me by thy prayers. Glory...

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Stretching forth a mighty hand from heaven, O Christ, King over all visible and intelligible things, my Jesus, put the heads of the enemies under the feet of those who faithfully proclaim the Theotokos to be Thy Mother. Both now...

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having of old been purified by the coal of the Spirit, Isaiah clearly cried out that the Son was to be born of thy womb, O all-abundant Virgin,

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 4 (continued):* to be born; Whom in the latter times, for my sake, without a husband thou didst bear.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Of old Habakkuk heard Thy marvelous report, O Christ, and cried aloud with fear: God shall come from Theman, and the Holy One from the dense overshadowed mountain, to save His anointed [LXX Hab. 3:2-3, 13].[^46] Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Forefiguring thee as the one who among women is fair and all-honorable, coming up as from the wilderness [Cant. 3:6, 8:5][^47] and bearing the Branch Christ on thine arm [Isa. 11:1],[^48] O Mother of God, the prince of myrrh cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Incline Thine ear unto me, O good one, and behold my affliction and the multiplication of perils; for having stretched the soul's eye toward thee, O Lady, and bowing my knees with tears, I now entreat thee, crying aloud: Put an end unto the turmoil of my tribulations. Glory...

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Knowing thee to be an invincible wall, drawn by supplication, I thy servant now flee unto thee; and I account the arrows of the foes as infantile and ineffective, O all-abundant one! Therefore, rejoicing, I cry aloud: Glory to thy childbirth, O Mother of God!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* The power of the Most High overshadowed thee, O Virgin, by the descent of the Divine Spirit [Luke 1:35];[^49] and then beyond nature, the Lord of all things, having given life to flesh and soul, united it unto Himself, remaining in the same nature.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Shine forth Thy never-setting light, O Christ, into the hearts of those who faithfully sing of Thee, granting us peace which surpasses all understanding [Phil. 4:7],[^50] that running from the night of ignorance unto the day by Thy light, we may give glory unto Thee, O Lover of mankind.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having of old foreseen thee as the unhewn mountain, O all-lauded one, Daniel cried aloud manifestly of the precious stone, Christ the Savior of the world, Who was cut from thee [Dan. 2:34, 45];[^51] and honoring Him now, we the faithful praise thee, O Virgin Bride of God.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Fallen, wretch that I am, into many tribulations, praying with anguish and weeping of heart, shamelessly I, thy servant, cry aloud: Deliver me, O Theotokos, from the troubles that encompass my lowliness, and fill me with gladness. Glory...

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Calm the fierce abyss of my passions with thy mighty prayer, O good one; for thou who didst give birth to Christ apart from passions,

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (continued):* that living the remainder of my life in tranquility of soul, I may sing thy praise in hymns.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* How bearest thou God upon thine arm? Tell us; and how givest thou suck unto Him Who holds all things in His hand? O all-blessed Virgin! "I remain pure" (she said) "even after childbirth, having given birth to Christ God, taking away the debt of Adam and of the ancestral mother."

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Wholly held fast by measureless passions, I have fallen down into the whale of evils; but lead me up from corruption, O God, even as Jonah [Jon. 2:1-7],[^52] and grant me passionlessness through faith, that with the voice of praise and the spirit of salvation I may sacrifice unto Thee.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Not departing from the bosom of the Father, the pre-eternal Son was seated in the motherly bosom; and in the last times, He Who from before the ages was with the Father, came forth from the womb of the Virgin: leading all up unto immortal life by ineffable goodness.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Bound with enemy chains because of affliction, woe is me, I have been cast down into the bars of Hades. But appear from heaven, O pure Maiden of God, raising me, thy servant, by thy prayers; and give a helping hand unto him who sings of thy divine childbirth. Glory...

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Wretch that I am, I have fallen into the pit of destruction, and many beasts surround me. But O Lady, by thy prayers turn away the stones and preserve thy servant unharmed; for thou didst bear in thy womb Christ, the chief Cornerstone [LXX Ps. 117:22; Eph. 2:20].[^53] Both now...

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Of old the choir of the divine prophets proclaimed prefigurations of thy childbirth, O Virgin: calling thee a radiant cloud, and a lampstand, and an urn [Exod. 25:31, 16:33; Heb. 9:4],[^54] and a table, and heavenly dew, the bread, the manna, and the gate, a throne, and a palace, a rod [Num. 17:8],[^55] and paradise, as having given birth to Christ.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Lord, have mercy (3 times). Glory... Both now...*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 1:*[^56]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn:* We all know thee to be the Mother of God, revealed truly as Virgin even after childbirth, fleeing with love unto thy goodness; for we sinners have thee as protectress, and in tribulations we have acquired thee as salvation, the only all-immaculate one.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Власность: 22/I 1926 Куплена за 30 золотих зі скарбонки за о. І. Кедринського пароха]
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The holy youths, having of old shown forth for piety, passed through the unbearable flame of the furnace as through a bridal chamber...[^57]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: ся ꙗ҆́вѣ, и҆ согла́снѡ воспѣва́юще, пѣ́снь поя́хꙋ: ѻ҆тє́цъ бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos (continued):* ...manifestly, and chanting in harmony, they sang the hymn: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^58]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Ше́ствꙋѧ превѣ́чный две́рьми непрохо́дными твои́ми всецари́це, чи́ста твоѧ̀ зна́меніѧ и҆ цѣ́ла сохранѝ, чи́ста и҆ по рж҃твѣ̀. Тѣ́мже вопіе́мъ: ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Passing through Thine impassable gates, O Queen of all, the Pre-eternal One preserved Thy tokens pure and intact, pure also after childbirth [LXX Ezek. 44:2].[^59] Therefore we cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Въ пе́щь вве́рженъ, седмочи́сленными пла́меньми ѡ҆паля́юся ѿ дꙋшеꙋбі́йственныхъ бѣ́дъ, но сама̀ ро́сꙋ мнѣ̀ ѡ҆дождѝ вл҃чце блага́ѧ, твои́ми молба́ми, да вопію̀: бл҃гослове́нъ бг҃ъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Cast into a furnace, I am burned by sevenfold flames of soul-destroying misfortunes; but do thou thyself, O good Lady, shower dew upon me by thy supplications, that I may cry aloud: Blessed is the God of our fathers![^60]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Страстьмѝ престарѣ́вся, и҆ неосла́бными напа́стьми и҆ скорбмѝ, и҆ доспѣ́въ къ за́падѡмъ житіѧ̀ моегѡ̀, добродѣ́телемъ неприча́стенъ, лѣ́ностію снѣде́нъ бы́въ, вопію̀ тебѣ̀ вл҃чце: ꙋ҆тѣше́ніе земны́мъ, поми́лꙋй мѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Grown old in passions and unslackening assaults and afflictions, and having arrived at the setting of my life, having no share in virtues, devoured by sloth, I cry aloud unto thee, O Lady: O consolation of earthly dwellers, have mercy on me!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Трⷪ҇цѣ въ є҆ди́нствѣ правосла́внѡ слꙋжа́ще, тѧ̀ ма́ти дв҃о чи́стаѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃а пло́тію ро́ждшꙋю проповѣ́дающе земні́и, боже́ственнѣ пое́мъ: ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Serving the Trinity in unity in Orthodox manner, we earthly dwellers, proclaiming thee as the pure Virgin Mother who didst bear God in the flesh, divinely sing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́да преесте́ственнагѡ показа̀ ѡ҆́бразъ, ѻ҆гнеро́снаѧ пе́щь дре́вле; ѻ҆́гнь бо не ѡ҆палѝ ю҆́ныѧ дѣ́ти, хрⷭ҇то́во ꙗ҆влѧ́ѧ безсѣ́менное ѿ дв҃ы бж҃е́ственное рождество̀. Тѣ́мъ воспѣва́юще воспои́мъ: да бл҃гослови́тъ тва́рь всѧ̀ гдⷭ҇а, и҆ превозно́ситъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The furnace dewy with fire showed forth of old an image of a transcendent marvel; for the fire burned not the young children, showing forth the seedless, divine childbirth of Christ from the Virgin [LXX Dan. 3:24–27].[^61] Therefore let us sing aloud in praise: Let all creation bless the Lord, and exalt Him supremely unto all ages [LXX Dan. 3:57]![^62]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Сло́во всеи́стинное сщ҃е́нника, вообразѝ рж҃тво̀ твоѐ дв҃о! вои́стиннꙋ бо родила̀ є҆сѝ сло́во бж҃їе, и҆ ложесна̀ не разве́рзе дв҃о, и҆́миже про́йде бг҃ъ; тѣ́мъ ра́дꙋющеся бцⷣꙋ тѧ̀ по до́лгꙋ, согла́снѡ воспѣва́емъ, и҆ превозно́симъ чи́стꙋю въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The all-true word of the priest prefigured thy childbirth, O Virgin! For in truth thou didst give birth to the Word of God, and the Virgin womb through which God passed was not opened; therefore, rejoicing, as is due, we chant in harmony unto thee as the Mother of God, and exalt the pure one supremely unto all ages.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Те́рніе возра́стшее въ дꙋшѝ мое́й недѣ́йственно, бж҃е́ственнымъ ѻ҆гне́мъ попалѝ пречи́стаѧ, и҆ твои́ми моли́твами на добродѣ́тели возста́ви мѧ̀, твори́ти плодоно́сїе хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀; и҆зъ тебе́ бо цвѣ́тъ при́снѡ живы́й прора́стши, тва́рь всю̀ ꙋ҆красѝ. Тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ бг҃ороди́тельницꙋ чи́стꙋю почита́емъ въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Burn up with divine fire the thorns that have grown up unfruitfully in my soul, O all-immaculate one, and by thy prayers raise me up unto virtues to bear fruit unto Christ [Matt. 13:7, 22];[^63] for the ever-living Flower, having budded forth from thee, hath adorned all creation. Therefore we honor thee, the pure God-parent, unto all ages.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Mother of God, grant me quickly, without hesitation, healing in fierce afflictions; for having fallen into tribulations and misfortunes, wretch that I am, I summon with weeping thy swift protection. Therefore, O all-pure one, hasten to deliver me, and save me from every torment; that

items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (continued):* blessing I may chant of thy childbirth.

items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Of old, Aaron's rod that budded prefigured thee, O Virgin [Num. 17:8];[^64] for thou alone didst bring forth an offshoot without a husband, having now received into thy womb the heavenly rain [LXX Ps. 71:6].[^65] Therefore, rejoicing, we all chant unto thee as the Mother of God, as is due, and exalt thee supremely unto all ages.

items.office: Front Matter

items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Ineffable is the mystery of the Virgin: for she was shown forth as heaven, and the Cherubic throne, and the light-bearing bridal chamber of Christ God, the Almighty [LXX Ezek. 1:26, 10:1].[^66] Her do we piously magnify as the Mother of God.

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Most glorious is the mystery of the Virgin: for Him Whom the supreme heavenly majesties could not contain, she contained in her womb [3 Kings 8:27].[^67] Therefore, having come together, we call her blessed, and faithfully rejoicing we magnify her.

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Seeing thee alone as higher than the heavens, the radiant dawn of God, O immaculate one, the Cherubic throne, and bridal chamber, and holy bed, we earthly dwellers praising thee magnify Christ our God, Whom thou didst bear from pure loins.

items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Many afflictions surround me, and evil tribulations now assault me, and diseases and grievous sins have cast me into the pit [LXX Ps. 87:5–7].[^68] Therefore I beseech thee in the bitterness of my soul, O most holy Mother of God: grant that I may find deliverance!

items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Give peace unto the world, O Christ, through the supplications of the pure Maiden of God, casting down the enemy's power under the feet of our faithful Emperor (name),[^69] and having established ineffable tranquility for him, preserve him unto ages.

items.english_text: *Then, "It is truly meet." Trisagion. And after "Our Father," the Hypakoe, Tone 1. "Lord, have mercy" (40 times). Prayer: "O Thou Who at all times." "Lord, have mercy" (3 times). Glory... Both now... "More honorable than the Cherubim." "In the name of the Lord, bless, father." Then the prayer: "O undefiled, unblemished,"[^70] and the rest as usual, and the dismissal, and mutual forgiveness.*

items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Thy victorious right hand hath been glorified in strength in a manner befitting God [LXX Exod. 15:6];[^74] for, O Immortal One, as almighty it shattered the adversaries, forging anew for the Israelites a path through the deep [LXX Exod. 14:21–22, 15:1–19].[^75]

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Seraphim unceasingly glorify the one tri-hypostatic Principle: unoriginate, ever-existing, Maker of all, incomprehensible [LXX Isa. 6:2–3],[^76] Whom also every tongue faithfully honors with hymns.

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* That Thou mightest show forth unto men Thy single, three-radiant Godhead, having created man of old, Thou didst fashion him according to Thine image: having given him mind, and word, and spirit, as the Lover of mankind [Gen. 1:26–27].[^77]

items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Showing forth from on high the single dominion in the three divine-originating Hypostases, O Father, Thou didst say unto Thy co-working Son and Spirit: Come, let Us go down, and confuse their tongues [Gen. 11:7]![^78]

items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Mind indeed is the unbegotten Father (as was figuratively foretold by the all-wise), and the Word is the co-unoriginate consubstantial Son, and the Holy Spirit, Who in the Virgin effected the incarnation of the Word [Luke 1:35].[^79]

items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou Who alone knowest the weakness of human nature, and didst compassionately take form therein: gird me with power from on high [LXX Ps. 17:33, Luke 24:49],[^80] that I may cry unto Thee: Holy is the living temple of Thine ineffable glory, O Lover of mankind!

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou Who of old didst manifestly appear unto Abraham as tri-hypostatic, yet single in the nature of Godhead [Gen. 18:1–3],[^81] didst prefigure the most true theology; and faithfully

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (continued):* we sing unto Thee, the God of single origin and three suns.

items.office: Front Matter

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Begotten of Thee in manner befitting God, incorruptibly, O Father, Light from Light shone forth, the immutable Son; and the divine Spirit, Light, proceeded [Nicene Creed];[^82] and we faithfully worship and glorify the tri-hypostatic radiance of the one Godhead.

items.office: Front Matter

items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The Trinity in Unity is praised supernaturally, ineffably beyond understanding, by the noetic beings, who cry out with thrice-holy voices unceasing praise [LXX Isa. 6:3];[^83] by whom also the tri-hypostatic Lord is sung in harmony with us.

items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* In time without seed, O Mother of God, He Who is beyond all years came forth from thee, the Invisible One having become like unto us, and having taught us the one nature and lordship of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Spirit; therefore do we glorify thee.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn:* Let us all worship the Father and the Son, and the upright and co-equal Spirit; glory to the uncreated Trinity and supreme divine Power, Whom the ranks of the bodiless praise: this day let us also, who are born of earth, faithfully praise Her with fear!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Guide us into the way of repentance, who ever turn aside unto the trackless ways of evils and anger the all-good Lord, O unwedded, blessed Mary, refuge of despairing men, dwelling-place of God!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Having with clairvoyant eyes perceived thee as the mountain overshadowed by the grace of God, Habakkuk proclaimed that from thee should come forth the Holy One of Israel, for our salvation and renewal [LXX Hab. 3:2–3].[^84]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Shine forth upon me, O three-sun divine Principle, with the rays of Thy divinizing illuminations, that in the eyes of my heart there may be envisioned the beauty, which is beyond mind, of Thy divine-originating brightness, and the light-bestowing and sweet communion!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In the beginning Thou didst establish the heavens, O Lord, and all their host by Thy all-effecting Word, and by the co-essential Spirit of Thy mouth [LXX Ps. 32:6];[^85]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* with Whom also Thou rulest over all things in the three-radiant monad of Godhead.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Since Thou didst create me according to Thine image and likeness [Gen. 1:26],[^86] O divine-originating and all-effecting Trinity, unconfused Unity, give me understanding and enlighten me, that I may do Thy holy, good, (in strength) and perfect will [Rom. 12:2]![^87]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Thou didst give birth unto One of the Trinity, O all-immaculate one, the supreme divine Son Who for our sake was incarnate of thee, illuminating earthly dwellers with the unwaning light and radiances of the three-sun Godhead.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Thou Who didst enlighten the ends of the world with the radiance of Thy coming, O Christ, and didst make them bright by Thy Cross: enlighten with the light of Thy divine knowledge the hearts of those who praise Thee in Orthodox faith!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Trinity of single origin, Who didst deign that the first angelic creation should be directly illuminated by the unapproachable rays of Thy beauty [Pseudo-Dionysius]:[^88] enlighten with Thy splendors those who in Orthodox faith sing unto Thee!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Now human nature, O single three-sun divine Principle, which Thou didst bring into being out of goodness, sings unto Thee, asking deliverance from transgressions, and assaults, and misfortunes, and afflictions.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* By faith we glorify Father, and Son, and Holy Spirit, one nature, dividing yet indivisible, the one God of invisible and visible creation.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* All the sayings of the prophets prefigured thy childbirth, O all-immaculate one, which is ineffable and hard to declare; which we have known as initiating into the mystery of the single and three-sun Godhead.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* The lowest abyss hath compassed us about [LXX Jonah 2:6];[^89] there is none to deliver; we were accounted as sheep for the slaughter [LXX Ps. 43:23, Rom. 8:36].[^90] Save Thy people, O our God; for Thou art the strength of the ailing and their restoration!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As possessing equal-standing power, O super-essential Trinity, in the sameness of will Thou art a simple and indivisible Unity; do Thou therefore preserve us by Thy power!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By Thy will, as good, Thou didst bring into being all ages out of non-being, O incomprehensible Trinity, and afterwards Thou didst create man; but even now deliver me from every distress!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou wast the house of the unsetting Sun [LXX Ps. 103:19, Mal. 4:2],[^91] Who almighty created and set in order the great luminaries [LXX Ps. 135:7–9],[^92] O all-pure Virgin Bride of God; but even now deliver me from the darkening of passions!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn:* Unto the Holy Trinity and indivisible Nature, divided without division in three Persons, and remaining undivided in the essence of Godhead, let us who are born of earth bow down with fear, and glorify Her as Creator and Master, the all-good God.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Direct my wretched soul, O pure one, and have compassion on her because of the multitude of transgressions, who hath slipped into the abyss of destruction, O all-blameless one! And in my fearful hour of death, do thou snatch me away from the accusing demons and every torment!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* We the faithful perceive thee as a noetic furnace, O Mother of God; for as the supremely exalted One saved the three youths [Dan. 3:23–27],[^93] so He, the praised and supremely glorified God of our fathers, being whole within thy womb, renewed the world!

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Word of God, co-essential radiance of God the Almighty, even as Thou didst promise [John 14:23],[^94] make Thine abode in me by divine operation, as Thou art tenderhearted, together with Thy Father and Spirit, and show me to be fearful unto demons and passions. (Twice)

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* That Thou mightest show unto us the abyss of Thy tenderheartedness, O Master, Thou didst send Thy Son unto our lowliness, and didst re-fashion us unto the first brightness; but even now give me understanding by the divine Spirit!

items.office: Front Matter

items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* He Who is borne upon the Cherubic throne, and the King of all, dwelt in thy virginal womb, O all-immaculate one, delivering all from corruption, as the Lover of mankind; but even now preserve me by thy prayers!

items.office: Front Matter

items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The furnace dewy with fire showed forth of old an image of a transcendent marvel; for the fire burned not the young children, showing forth the seedless, divine childbirth of Christ from the Virgin [LXX Dan. 3:24–27].[^95] Therefore let us sing aloud in praise: Let all creation bless the Lord, and exalt Him supremely unto all ages [LXX Dan. 3:57]![^96]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By Thy divine nod, O Lord of all, tri-hypostatic and Almighty, Thou didst stretch out the heavens as a curtain [LXX Ps. 103:2];[^97] and Thou didst suspend the depth of the earth by Thine almighty hand [Job 26:7];[^98] therefore strengthen Thy servants also by Thy love and faith, O Lover of mankind, that we may glorify Thee with longing unto ages!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With divine-originating light enlighten those who sing unto Thee, O Light with three suns in Persons, yet single again in essence, ever to look unto Thy light-bestowing rays, whereby I may be filled with Thy sweet, and light-giving, and most rich glory, and faithfully exalt Thee supremely unto ages!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Receive praise and honor from our incomprehending mind, O all-perfect Trinity, Who illuminest all things and enlightenest the mind by authority and power. The heavenly powers praise Thee; and we earthly dwellers unceasingly cry aloud, and exalt Thee supremely unto ages!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having inalterably assumed human nature, Thy Son, O all-pure Mother of God, through the exceeding abundance of goodness, having delivered it from ancient corruption, ascended into the heavens [Mark 16:19, Luke 24:51, Acts 1:9].[^99] Unto Him we chant in thanksgiving: Let all creation bless the Lord, and exalt Him supremely unto all ages!

items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* The burning bush unburnt showed forth an image of thy pure childbearing [LXX Exod. 3:2];[^100] and now we pray thee to quench the furnace of temptations raging against us, that we may unceasingly magnify thee, O Mother of God!

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Savior of visible and noetic creation, most holy consubstantial Trinity, save Thy servants from the enemy's assault and malice, and ever preserve Thy flock unharmed by snares!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* That Thou mightest show forth the unsearchable depth of Thine essential goodness, O three-sun and single-originating all-powerful God, Thou hast given saving promises unto Thy servants, which vouchsafe us to fulfill!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Look down upon our supplications, O Thou Who in three divine-originating Hypostases art the one God truly believed in; and grant consolation unto Thy servants, through the prayers of the all-pure and all-praised Mother of God.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* He could not endure to behold earthly nature fallen into corruption through the envy of the enemy, by the disobedience of the first-created [Wis. 2:24];[^101] but bowing the heavens He came down [LXX Ps. 17:10], not departing from the Godhead, and was incarnate in the Virgin without a father, that He might deify earthly dwellers [2 Pet. 1:4].[^102]

items.english_text: *After this, the refrains of Gregory of Sinai, which are said after the Trinity Canons on all Sundays: "It is truly meet to glorify Thee in a manner befitting God," which are written at the end of this book.[^103] And the rest of the Midnight Office, and the dismissal.*

items.english_text: *"God is the Lord," in Tone 1; after which, the Resurrectional Troparion (twice). Glory... To the Saint, if there be a troparion. Both now... Theotokion of the same tone. Then the usual chanting of the Psalter.*

items.english_text: *Resurrectional Sessional Hymns, Tone 1:*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* While the soldiers were guarding Thy tomb, O Savior, they became as dead by the lightning-flash of the angel who appeared, proclaiming the resurrection unto the women [Matt. 28:2–4].[^104] Thee do we glorify, the destroyer of corruption; unto Thee do we fall down, Who didst rise from the tomb, and unto our only God!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Nailed willingly to the Cross, O compassionate One, and placed in a tomb as dead, O Giver of life, Thou didst crush the dominion of death by Thy death, O Mighty One! For the gatekeepers of Hades trembled at Thee [Job 38:17];[^106] and Thou didst raise up with Thyself the dead from all ages, as the only Lover of mankind!

items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* We all know thee to be the Mother of God, revealed truly as Virgin even after childbirth, who with love flee unto thy goodness: for we sinners have thee as protectress; we have acquired thee as salvation in tribulations, the only all-immaculate one.

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* The women came early in the morning unto the tomb, and seeing the angelic vision they trembled [Mark 16:1–5, Luke 24:1–5].[^107] The tomb shone with

items.office: Front Matter

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1 (continued):* life; the marvel astonished them: therefore going, they proclaimed the resurrection unto the disciples [Matt. 28:7–8].[^108] Christ hath despoiled Hades, as the only strong and mighty One, and He hath raised up all who were corrupted, having destroyed the fear of condemnation by the Cross.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Thou wast nailed to the Cross, O Life of all, and wast numbered among the dead, O immortal Lord [LXX Ps. 87:5, Isa. 53:12];[^110] Thou didst rise on the third day, O Savior, raising Adam up from corruption. Therefore the heavenly powers cried aloud unto Thee, O Christ Giver of life: Glory to Thy resurrection! Glory to Thy condescension, O only Lover of mankind!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Mary, venerable receptacle of the Master, raise us up who have fallen into the chasm of grievous despair, and offenses, and afflictions; for thou art the salvation and help, and mighty protection of sinners, and thou savest thy servants!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Then: "Blessed are the undefiled in the way" [LXX Ps. 118:1].[^111] After this we sing: "Blessed art Thou, O Lord," and the Resurrectional Troparia: "The assembly of angels" (which are written at the end of this book).[^112] Then the little litany, and after it the Hypakoe.*

items.english_text: *Hypakoe, Tone 1:*[^113]

items.english_text: The repentance of the thief opened Paradise [Luke 23:42–43],[^114] and the weeping of the myrrh-bearing women announced joy [Matt. 28:8–9];[^115] for Thou art risen, O Christ God, granting great mercy unto the world.

items.english_text: *Hymns of Ascent.*[^116]

items.english_text: When I was afflicted, hear my pain, O Lord, unto Thee do I call [LXX Ps. 119:1].[^117]

items.english_text: Unto those who dwell in the wilderness there is unceasing divine longing, as they are outside the vain world.

items.english_text: Unto the Holy Spirit belongs honor and glory, even as it is due unto the Father, and likewise unto the Son; therefore let us chant of the single dominion of the Trinity.

items.english_text: Unto the mountains of Thy laws hast Thou lifted me up [LXX Ps. 120:1];[^118] enlighten me with virtues, O God, that I may sing unto Thee.

items.english_text: Taking hold of me with Thy right hand, O Word, keep me, preserve me, lest the fire of sin burn me [LXX Ps. 138:10].[^119]

items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit all creation is renewed, running again unto its first state; for He is of equal power with the Father and the Word.

items.english_text: Because of those who said unto me: Let us go into the courts of the Lord, my spirit was glad, my heart rejoices together [LXX Ps. 121:1].[^120]

items.english_text: In the house of David there is great fear; for there thrones being set, all the tribes of the earth and nations shall be judged [LXX Ps. 121:5].[^121]

items.english_text: Unto the Holy Spirit it is meet to bring honor, worship, glory, and dominion, even as it is worthy of the Father, and fitts the Son; for the Trinity is a Unity in nature, though not in Persons.

items.english_text: *Now will I arise, saith the Lord; I will set Myself in salvation, I will not hesitate concerning him [LXX Ps. 11:6].*[^122]

items.english_text: *Let every breath praise the Lord [LXX Ps. 150:6].*[^124]

items.english_text: *The Morning Gospel of the day. After which:*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ, let us worship the holy Lord Jesus, the only Sinless One. We venerate Thy Cross, O Christ, and we praise and glorify Thy holy Resurrection; for Thou art our God, and we know no other beside Thee; we call upon Thy name. Come, all ye faithful, let us worship Christ's holy Resurrection; for behold, through the Cross joy hath come into all the world. Ever blessing the Lord, we sing of His Resurrection; for having endured crucifixion, He hath destroyed death by death.

items.english_text: *Glory... Through the prayers of the Apostles, O Merciful One, blot out the multitude of our transgressions.*

items.english_text: *Both now... Through the prayers of the Mother of God, O Merciful One, blot out the multitude of our transgressions.*

items.english_text: *Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy, and according to the multitude of Thy compassions blot out my transgression [LXX Ps. 50:3].*[^125]

items.english_text: Jesus having risen from the tomb, as He foretold, hath given unto us eternal life and great mercy [Matt. 28:6].[^126]

items.english_text: *Save, O God, Thy people... And the Exclamation: Through the mercy and compassions and love for mankind...*

items.english_text: *Canons.*[^127]

items.english_text: *The Resurrectional Canon to 4; the Cross-Resurrectional to 3; and the Theotokion to 3; and the Menaion to 4. But if a Saint be celebrated, the Resurrectional to 6, the Cross-Resurrectional to 2, and the Theotokion to 2.*

items.english_text: *Canon of the Resurrection, Tone 1.*[^128]

items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Thy victorious right hand hath been glorified in strength in a manner befitting God [LXX Exod. 15:6]; for, O Immortal One, as almighty it shattered the adversaries, forging anew for the Israelites a path through the deep [LXX Exod. 14:21–22, 15:1–19].

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thy holy resurrection, O Lord.*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ніе въ лю́тыхъ, бг҃ороди́тельнице, неколѣ́зненно пода́ждь мнѣ̀ вско́рѣ; впа́дъ бо въ скѡ́рби и҆ бѣ́ды, твою̀ ско́рость въ застꙋпле́ніе ѡ҆каѧ́нный призыва́ю, рыда́ѧ. Тѣ́мже пречⷭ҇таѧ ꙋ҆скорѝ и҆зѧ́ти мѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки; ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* He Who in the beginning with all-pure hands divinely fashioned man from dust...[^129]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: зда́въ мѧ̀, рꙋ́цѣ распросте́рлъ є҆сѝ на Крⷭ҇тѣ̀, ѿ землѝ взыва́ѧ тлѣ́нное моѐ тѣ́ло, є҆́же ѿ Дѣ́вы прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (continued):* ...shaping me, Thou didst stretch out Thy hands upon the Cross, recalling from the earth my corruptible body, which Thou didst take from the Virgin.[^130]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нїе пода́лъ є҆сѝ менѐ ра́ди, и҆ дꙋ́шꙋ сме́рти пре́далъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же вдохнове́нїемъ бж҃е́ственнымъ дꙋ́шꙋ мнѣ̀ вложи́вый, и҆ ѿрѣши́въ вѣ́чныхъ ꙋ҆́зъ, и҆ совоскреси́въ, нетлѣ́нїемъ просла́вилъ є҆сѝ. Бг҃оро́дич:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst submit to slaying for my sake, and didst deliver Thy soul unto death, O Thou Who by divine inbreathing didst place a soul within me; and having loosed me from eternal bonds and raised me with Thyself, Thou didst glorify me with incorruption.[^131]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дꙋйсѧ, бл҃года́ти и҆сто́чниче, ра́дꙋйсѧ лѣ́ствице и҆ две́ре нб҃наѧ. Ра́дꙋйсѧ свѣ́щниче и҆ рꙋ́чко злата́ѧ, и҆ горо̀ несѣко́маѧ, ꙗ҆́же жизнода́вца Хрⷭ҇та̀ мі́рови ро́ждшаѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, fount of grace; rejoice, ladder and heavenly door! Rejoice, lampstand and golden urn, and unquarried mountain, who didst bear Christ the Life-giver unto the world![^132]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Припѣ́въ: Сла́ва Гдⷭ҇и крⷭ҇тꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀ и҆ воскресе́нїю.
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross and Resurrection.*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇то́съ ѡ҆божа́етъ мѧ̀ воплоща́ѧсѧ. Хрⷭ҇то́съ мѧ̀ возно́ситъ смирѧ́ѧсѧ. Хрⷭ҇то́съ безстра́стна мѧ̀ содѣ́ловаетъ, стражда̀ жизнода́вецъ є҆стество́мъ пло́ти. Тѣ́мже воспѣва́ю бл҃года́рственною пѣ́снь, ꙗ҆́ко просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* Christ is born...[^133]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇то́съ возно́ситъ мѧ̀ распина́емь, Хрⷭ҇то́съ совоскреша́етъ мѧ̀ ꙋ҆мерщвлѧ́емь. Хрⷭ҇то́съ жи́знь мнѣ̀ да́рꙋетъ. Тѣ́мже съ весе́лїемъ рꙋка́ма плеща́й пою̀ Спаси́телю побѣ́днꙋю пѣ́снь, ꙗ҆́ко просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thy Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃а Дв҃о зачала̀ є҆сѝ; Хрⷭ҇та̀ же въ дѣ́вствѣ родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆зъ тебѐ вопло́щшасѧ Пречи́стаѧ: є҆ди́наго ѵ҆поста́сїю є҆диноро́днаго, въ двои́хъ же сꙋщества́хъ познава́емаго Сн҃а; ꙗ҆́ко просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Christ deifies me by being incarnate; Christ exalts me by humbling Himself; Christ makes me impassible, as the Life-giver suffers in the nature of flesh. Therefore I sing the hymn of thanksgiving: For He hath been glorified![^134]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Припѣ́въ: Прест҃а́ѧ Гж҃ѐ Бцⷣе, спасѝ на́съ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Christ exalts me by being crucified; Christ raises me with Himself by being slain; Christ bestows life upon me. Therefore with gladness, clapping my hands, I sing unto the Savior the victory song: For He hath been glorified![^135]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Кꙋ́ю тебѣ̀ досто́йнꙋю пѣ́снь, на́ше принесе́тъ неможе́нїе? то́чїю ѡ҆бра́довательнꙋю, є҆́йже на́съ Гаврїи́лъ та́йнѡ наꙋчи́лъ є҆́сть: Ра́дꙋйсѧ Бцⷣе Дв҃о, Ма́ти неневѣ́стнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst conceive God, O Virgin, and didst bear Christ in virginity, incarnate from thee, O all-pure one: the only-begotten Son, single in hypostasis, yet recognized in two natures: For He hath been glorified![^136]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭ҇нодѣ́вѣ и҆ мт҃ри Цр҃ѧ̀ вы́шнихъ си́лъ, ѿ чистѣ́йша се́рдца вѣ́рнїи дх҃о́внѣ возопіе́мъ: Ра́дꙋйсѧ Бцⷣе Дв҃о, Мт҃и неневѣ́стнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Most Holy Mother of God.*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* Thy victorious right hand...[^137]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most holy Lady, Mother of God, save us.*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* What worthy song can our weakness offer unto thee, save the joyful greeting wherewith Gabriel mystically instructed us: Rejoice, O Virgin Mother of God, unwedded Mother![^138]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Unto the Ever-Virgin and Mother of the King of the celestial powers, let us the faithful spiritually cry aloud from a most pure heart: Rejoice, O Virgin Mother of God, unwedded Mother![^139]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The abyss of thy birthgiving is immeasurable and incomprehensible, O all-hymned one! With undoubting faith, therefore, we purely offer unto thee, saying:[^140]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (continued):* ...Rejoice, O Virgin Mother of God, unwedded Mother!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* I shall open my mouth...[^141]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou Who alone knowest the weakness of human nature, and didst compassionately take form therein: gird me with power from on high, that I may cry unto Thee: Holy is the living temple of Thine ineffable glory, O Lover of mankind![^142]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being my God, O Good One, Thou didst have compassion on me who was fallen, and deigning to come down unto me, Thou didst lift me up by Thy crucifixion, that I may cry unto Thee: Holy is the living temple of Thine ineffable glory, O Lover of mankind![^143]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Being the hypostatic Life, O Christ, and having clothed Thyself with me who was corrupted, as the merciful God, descending into the dust of death, O Master, Thou didst destroy the dominion of death, and having risen from the dead on the third day, Thou didst clothe me with incorruption.[^144]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having conceived God in thy womb through the Holy Spirit, O Virgin, thou didst remain unconsumed; since the bush burning yet unconsumed clearly prefigured thee unto the Lawgiver Moses, as one receiving the unendurable fire.[^145]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* Begotten of the Father before the ages...[^146]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Unto Christ God Who took upon His shoulder the strayed sheep, and by the Tree cast down its sin, let us cry aloud: O Thou Who hast exalted our horn, holy art Thou, O Lord![^147]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Unto Him Who brought up from hades the great Shepherd Christ, and by His sacred hierarchy wisely shepherded the nations through the Apostles, let us the faithful minister in truth and by the divine Spirit.[^148]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Unto the Son Who of His own will became incarnate without seed from the Virgin, and by divine power preserved pure after childbirth her who bare Him, unto God Who is over all, let us cry aloud: Holy art Thou, O Lord![^149]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* Thou Who alone knowest...

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A swift cloud do we truly name thee, O Virgin, following the prophetic utterances; for upon thee the Lord came, to cast down the handmade idols of Egyptian deception, and to enlighten those who served them.[^150]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The prophetic choir truly named thee the sealed fountain and closed door, clearly describing unto us the tokens of thy virginity, O all-hymned one,[^151]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...which thou didst preserve even after childbirth.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Gabriel, accounted worthy to behold the super-essential Mind as far as was possible, O all-immaculate Virgin, brought unto thee the joyful voice, clearly announcing the conception of the Word, and preaching His ineffable birth.[^152]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Perceiving thee with prophetic eyes as the mountain overshadowed by the grace of God, Habakkuk proclaimed that out of thee should go forth the Holy One of Israel, for our salvation and renewal.[^153]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
