items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Who is this Savior Who comes from Edom, wearing a crown of thorns, having His garment stained red, hanging upon the Tree? This is the Holy One of Israel, for our salvation and renewal![^154]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Behold, ye disobedient people, and be ashamed! For He Whom ye, with demented mind, begged Pilate to lift up on the Cross as an evildoer, having destroyed the power of death, hath risen from the tomb in a manner befitting God.[^155]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* We know thee, O Virgin, as the Tree of Life; for not a death-bearing fruit of eating did bud forth from thee for men, but the enjoyment of ever-existing life, unto the salvation of us who sing of thee.[^156]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection. Heirmos:* Rod from the root of Jesse...[^157]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Who is this comely One from Edom, and this redness of His garments from the vineyard of Bosor? Comely as God, yet as man wearing a garment reddened with the blood of flesh? Unto Him we the faithful sing: Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^158]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Christ, having appeared as High Priest of good things to come, hath abolished our sin; and having shown a marvelous path by His own blood, entered into the greater and more perfect tabernacle, as our Forerunner into the holy places.[^159]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst remit Eve's ancient debt, O all-hymned one, through the new Adam Who appeared for our sake; for having united unto Himself through a pure conception flesh endowed with mind and soul, Christ came forth from thee, one Lord in both.[^160]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Canon to the Mother of God. Heirmos:* Perceiving thee as the mountain...

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Hear marvels, O heaven, and give ear, O earth! For the daughter of dust-born Adam was called of God, and became the parent of her own Creator, unto our salvation and renewal.[^161]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* We sing of thy great and awesome mystery; for hidden from the supramundane ranks, He Who Is came down upon thee like rain upon the fleece, O all-hymned one, unto the salvation of us who sing of thee.[^162]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Holy of holies, all-hymned Mother of God, the Expectation of the nations and salvation of the faithful! From thee shone forth the Redeemer, the Life-giver, and Lord: pray Thou Him that Thy servants may be saved.[^163]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Christ, Who didst enlighten the ends of the world with the radiance of Thy coming, and didst illumine them by Thy Cross: enlighten with the light of Thy divine knowledge the hearts of those who sing of Thee in Orthodox manner.[^164]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Judeans put to death by the wood of the Cross the great Shepherd of the sheep and Lord; but He, like dead sheep buried in hades, delivered them from the dominion of death.[^165]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having preached peace through Thy Cross, and having proclaimed remission unto captives, O my Savior, Thou didst put to shame him that had the power of death, O Christ, showing him naked and impoverished by Thy divine resurrection.[^166]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Despise not the petitions of those who faithfully ask, O all-hymned one, but receive them, and convey them unto Thy Son, O all-pure one, the only Benefactor God; for we have acquired thee as mediatress.[^167]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* Being the God of peace...[^168]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O depth of the riches and wisdom of God! The Lord, catching the wise, hath delivered us from their craftiness; for having suffered willingly through the weakness of the flesh, yet quickening through His own strength, He raised the dead.[^169]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Being God, Christ is united to flesh for our sake, and is crucified, and dies; He is buried, and rises again, and ascends radiantly with His flesh unto the Father; wherewith He shall come again, and save those who piously serve Him.[^170]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Holy of holies, pure Virgin, thou didst give birth to the Holy of holies Who sanctifies all, Christ the Redeemer. Therefore we proclaim thee Queen and Lady of all, as Mother of the Creator of creation.[^171]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Canon to the Mother of God. Heirmos:* O Christ, Who didst enlighten...

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The heavenly Hosts make merry, beholding thee; the gatherings of men rejoice with them; for through thy childbirth they were joined together, O Virgin Mother of God, which we worthily glorify.[^172]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Let all human tongues and minds be moved unto praise of the true adornment of mankind! The Virgin manifestly stands forth, glorifying those who sing in faith of her marvels.[^173]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Glorified is the song and praise of the all-wise, offered unto the Virgin and Mother of God; for she was the temple of super-divine glory, whom we worthily glorify.[^174]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* The lowest abyss hath encompassed us, and there is none to deliver; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter; save Thy people, O our God, for Thou art the strength of the ailing, and their restoration![^175]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By the transgression of the first-created, O Lord, we were grievously wounded; but by Thy wound, wherewith Thou wast wounded for our sake, O Christ, we were healed; for Thou art the strength of the ailing, and their restoration![^176]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou hast brought us up out of hades, O Lord, having slain the all-devouring sea monster, O Almighty One, casting down his power by Thy dominion; for Thou art Life, and Light, and the Resurrection.[^177]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The forefathers of our race rejoice in thee, O all-pure Virgin, having received again through thee the Eden which they lost by transgression; for thou art pure both before childbirth and after childbirth.[^178]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* From the belly Jonah...[^179]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being an impassible and immaterial Mind, Christ God was joined to the human mind, the divine nature mediating with the grossness of the flesh; and without change He was wholly united unto the whole of me, that being crucified He might grant salvation unto the whole of me who had fallen.[^180]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Adam, having been deceived, falls, and being tripped up is crushed, having been seduced of old by the hope of deification; but he ariss, being deified by union with the Word, and through suffering receives impassibility, being glorified upon the throne as a son, sitting with the Father and the Spirit.[^181]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Not leaving the bosom of the unoriginate Begetter, He takes up His abode in the bosom of the pure Maiden; and He[^182]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Theotokion (continued):* ...Who was formerly without mother becomes incarnate without father, God Who reigns in righteousness; His fearsome lineage is without genealogy and ineffable.

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* The lowest abyss hath encompassed us...

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The celestial ranks stand in servitude before thy childbirth, marveling worthily at thy seedless birthgiving, O Ever-Virgin! For thou art pure both before childbirth and after childbirth.[^183]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The Word, Who previously was bodiless, became incarnate from thee, O all-pure one, creating all things by His will: He Who brought forth from non-being the hosts of incorporeal powers, as almighty.[^184]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The enemy was slain by thy life-bearing fruit, O Virgin full of God's grace! And hades was trampled underfoot manifestly, and we who were in bonds were set free. Therefore I cry aloud: Destroy the passions of my heart![^185]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: Thou didst rise as God from the tomb in glory, and didst raise the world with Thyself; and human nature sings of Thee as God, and death hath vanished; and Adam keeps festival, O Master, and Eve now delivered from bonds rejoices, crying aloud: Thou art He Who grants resurrection unto all, O Christ![^186]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Ikos:* Let us sing of Him Who rose on the third day as the almighty God, Who shattered the gates of hades, and raised from the tomb those who were there from the ages, Who appeared unto the Myrrh-bearing women as He was well pleased, saying first unto them: "Rejoice!"; and proclaims joy unto the Apostles, as the only Life-giver. Therefore in faith the women announce the tokens of victory unto the disciples, and hades groans, and death wails; the world makes merry, and all rejoice with it; for Thou, O Christ, hast granted resurrection unto all![^187]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* We the faithful perceive thee, O Mother of God, as a spiritual furnace; for as the Supremely Exalted One saved the three children, so the praised and supremely glorified God of our fathers wholly renewed the world in thy womb.[^188]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The earth was seized with fear, the sun was hidden and the light was darkened, the divine veil of the temple was rent, and the rocks were split; for the Righteous One hangs upon the Cross,[^189]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (continued):* ...the praised and supremely glorified God of our fathers!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou becamest as one helpless, and wounded among the dead willingly for our sake, O Supremely Exalted One; Thou didst liberate all, and by Thy mighty hand didst raise them with Thyself: the praised and supremely glorified God of our fathers.[^190]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, fount of ever-living water! Rejoice, delightful paradise! Rejoice, unwedded one! Rejoice, universal joy, through whom shone forth unto us the praised and supremely glorified God of our fathers![^191]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection. Heirmos:* The children brought up in piety...[^192]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Of old indeed was the earth cursed, having been stained red with Abel's blood by a fratricidal hand; but sprinkled with Thy God-flowing blood it was blessed, and leaping for joy it cries: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou![^193]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Let the Judean God-opposing people wail for the audacity of slaying Christ; but let the nations make merry, and clap their hands, and cry aloud: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou![^194]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Behold, shining upon the Myrrh-bearers, the Angel cried aloud: Come and see the tokens of Christ's resurrection, the Plashchanytsia and the tomb, and cry aloud: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou![^195]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Canon to the Mother of God. Heirmos:* We the faithful perceive thee...

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Jacob prophetically perceived thee as the ladder, O Mother of God; for through thee the Supremely Exalted One appeared upon earth, and dwelt with men as He was well pleased: the praised and supremely glorified God of our fathers.[^196]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Rejoice, pure one! From thee came forth the Shepherd, Who truly clothed Himself with Adam's skin, (the Supremely Exalted One) putting on the whole of me as man on account of His incomprehensible compassion: the praised and supremely glorified God of our fathers.[^197]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The pre-eternal God truly became the New Adam from thy pure blood. Him do thou now entreat, to renew him that calls aloud: O praised and supremely glorified God of our fathers![^198]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* In the furnace, as in a crucible, the children of Israel shone purer than gold with the beauty of piety, saying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages![^199]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Word of God, Who by Thy will dost make and transform all things, turning the shadow of death into eternal life by Thy Passion: Thee, the Lord, do all the works of the Lord unceasingly praise, and exalt supremely unto all ages.[^200]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having risen from the tomb on the third day, O Christ, Thou didst break down the ruin and misery in the gates and strongholds of hades. Thee do all works unceasingly sing as Lord, and exalt supremely unto all ages.[^201]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Let us sing of her who seedlessly and supernaturally, from the divine radiance, gave birth to Christ the pearl of great price, saying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages![^202]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection. Heirmos:* Showed forth of old an image of a transcendent marvel...[^203]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Come, ye people, let us worship the place where the all-pure feet stood, and where upon the Tree the divine life-creating hands of Christ were outstretched for the salvation of all men; and standing about the life-bearing tomb, let us sing: Let all creation bless the Lord, and exalt Him supremely unto all ages![^204]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The most iniquitous slander of the God-slaying Judeans was refuted; for He Whom they called a deceiver arose as the Mighty One, mocking the foolish seals. Therefore rejoicing let us sing: Let all creation bless the Lord, and exalt Him supremely unto all ages![^205]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Triadikon:* The all-pure Seraphim, theologizing the glory in three radiances and one Lordship, with fear in servitude glorify the tri-hypostatic Godhead. With them let us also piously sing: Let all creation bless the Lord, and exalt Him supremely unto all ages![^206]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Canon to the Mother of God. Heirmos:* In the furnace the children of Israel...

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Let us all sing of the light-bearing bridal chamber, from which Christ the Master of all came forth as a Bridegroom, crying aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages![^207]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Rejoice, glorious throne of God! Rejoice, wall of the faithful, through whom Christ the Light shone forth unto those in darkness, who call thee blessed,[^208]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...and cry aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages!

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having given birth unto the Lord Who is the Author of salvation for us, entreat Him earnestly for all who cry aloud, O all-hymned Virgin: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages![^209]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Then the Canticle of the Mother of God:*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *More honorable than the Cherubim...*[^210]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* The burning bush showed forth unconsumed an image of thy pure childbirth; and now we beseech thee to quench the furnace of temptations raging against us, that we may unceasingly magnify thee, O Mother of God![^211]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O how the lawless and disobedient people, taking evil counsel, justified the proud and impious one, but condemned upon the Tree the Righteous One, the Lord of glory! Whom we worthily magnify.[^212]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Savior, blameless Lamb, Who takest away the sins of the world, Thee do we glorify, Who didst rise on the third day with the Father and Thy divine Spirit, even the Lord of glory; Whom theologizing we magnify.[^213]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Save Thy people, O Lord, whom Thou didst purchase with Thy precious blood, granting unto our Emperor (name) strength against enemies, and bestowing peace upon Thy churches, O Lover of mankind, through the prayers of the Mother of God.[^214]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection. Heirmos:* A strange mystery...[^215]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thy Cross hath been glorified by Thine ineffable power, O Lord! For Thy weakness was shown forth unto all as stronger than strength; whereby the mighty indeed were cast down to the earth, and the poor are led up to heaven.[^216]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Our loathsome death was put to death by Thy resurrection from the dead; for appearing unto those in hades, O Christ, Thou didst bestow life. Therefore singing of Thee as Life and Resurrection, and hypostatic Light, we magnify Thee.[^217]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Triadikon:* The unoriginate and boundless nature is known in three unities, the divine-originating hypostases: one Godhead in Father, and Son, and Spirit; trusting in Whom our divinely-wise Emperor (name) is saved.[^218]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Canon to the Mother of God. Heirmos:* The burning bush showed forth unconsumed...[^219]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst sprout forth from the root of David, the prophet and forefather of God, O Virgin, but thou didst also truly glorify David, having given birth unto the prophesied Lord of glory; Whom we worthily magnify.[^220]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Every law of praise is overcome by the majesty of thy glory, O all-pure one. But, O Lady, from thine unworthy servants receive with fervor, from love offered unto thee, O Mother of God, this song of praise![^221]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O thy marvels beyond understanding! For thou alone brighter than the sun, O Virgin, didst grant unto all to understand the newest wonder of thine incomprehensible childbirth, O all-immaculate one; therefore do we all magnify thee.[^222]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *After the Katavasia, the Little Litany. Then:*

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Holy is the Lord our God (3 times).*[^223]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *The Morning Exapostilarion.*[^224]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *AT THE PRAISES*[^225]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: We sing of Thy saving Passion, O Christ, and we glorify Thy Resurrection.[^226]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: O Thou Who didst endure the Cross, and didst abolish death, and didst rise from the dead: bring peace unto our life, O Lord, as the only Almighty One.[^227]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: O Thou Who didst despoil hades, and didst raise man by Thy resurrection, O Christ: vouchsafe us with a pure heart to sing of Thee and to glorify Thee.[^228]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: Glorifying Thy divine condescension, we sing of Thee, O Christ: Thou wast born of the Virgin, yet wast not separated from the Father; Thou didst suffer as man, and willingly didst endure the Cross; Thou didst rise from the tomb, coming forth as from a bridal chamber, that Thou mightest save the world: Lord, glory to Thee![^229]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, Anatolian.*[^230]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: When Thou wast nailed upon the wood of the Cross, then was the enemy's dominion slain; creation was shaken with fear of Thee, and hades was despoiled by Thy dominion; the dead Thou didst raise from the tombs, and unto the thief Thou didst open paradise: Christ our God, glory to Thee![^231]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Безмѣ́рнаѧ бе́здна твоегѡ̀ непостижи́магѡ ржⷭ҇тва̀, Всепѣ́таѧ. Вѣ́рою несꙋмнѣ́нною ꙋ҆́бѡ чи́стѣ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще:
items.english_text: The venerable women, having reached Thy tomb with weeping and haste, and finding the tomb opened, and having learned from the Angel the new and most glorious marvel, announced unto the Apostles: That the Lord is risen, granting great mercy unto the world.[^232]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Воскрнѝ Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е мо́й, да вознесе́тся рука̀ твоя̀, не забꙋ́ди ᲂу҆бо́гихъ твои́хъ до конца̀.
items.english_text: *Anatolian Sticheron 3:* We venerate the divine wounds of Thy passions, O Christ God, and the sovereign hierurgy accomplished upon Sion, which was manifested by God at the end of the ages; for the Sun of righteousness hath enlightened those sleeping in darkness, guiding them unto the unwaning radiance: O Lord, glory to Thee![^234]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Стра́сте́й твои́хъ бж҃твеннымъ ꙗ҆́звамъ, поклана́емсѧ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, и҆ є҆́же въ сіѡ́нѣ влⷣчнемꙋ сщ҃еннодѣ́йствію, на коне́цъ вѣкѡ́въ бг҃оявле́ннѣ бы́вшемꙋ; ꙗ҆́ко въ тмѣ̀ спѧ́щїѧ, сл҃нце просвѣтѝ пра́вды, къ невече́рнемꙋ наставля́ѧ сїя́нїю: Гдⷭ҇и, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: *Anatolian Sticheron 4:* Give ear, O riotous Jewish race! Where are they who came unto Pilate? Let the guarding soldiers say: where are the seals of the tomb? Where was He laid Who was buried? Where was He sold Who was not sold? How was the treasure stolen? Why do ye slander the Savior's rising, O lawless Judeans? He is risen Who is free among the dead, and He grants great mercy unto the world.[^236]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: И҆сповѣ́мсѧ тебѣ̀ Гдⷭ҇и всѣ́мъ се́рдцемъ мои́мъ, повѣ́мъ всѧ̑ чꙋдеса̀ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Glory... Morning Evangelical Sticheron. Both now... Theotokion: Most blessed art thou [O Virgin Theotokos]: The Great Doxology. Resurrectional Troparion: Today is salvation come into the world: Litanies, and the Dismissal.*[^237]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Любомяте́жный ро́де є҆вре́йскїй внуши́те! гдѣ̀ сꙋ́ть, и҆̀же къ Пїла́тꙋ прише́дшїи? да рекꙋ́тъ стрегꙋ́щїи во́инзи, гдѣ̀ сꙋ́ть печа́ти грѡ́бныѧ? гдѣ̀ преложе́нъ бы́сть погребе́нный? гдѣ̀ про́данъ бы́сть непрода́нный? ка́кѡ ᲂу҆кра́дено бы́сть сокро́вище? что̀ ѡ҆клевета́ете сп҃сово воста́нїе, пребеззако́ннїи і҆ꙋде́и? Воскре́се и҆́же въ ме́ртвыхъ свобо́дь, и҆ да́рꙋетъ мі́рови ве́лїю млⷭ҇ть.
items.english_text: *AT THE LITURGY*[^238]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Стїхи́ра є҆ѵⷢлскаѧ ᲂу҆́треняѧ. И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Преблагослове́нна є҆сѝ: Славосло́вїе вели́кое. Тропа́рь воскре́сенъ: Дне́сь спасе́нїе мі́рꙋ: Є҆ктені́и. И҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Through eating of food, the enemy led Adam out of paradise; but through the Cross, Christ led the thief back into it, who cried: Remember me when Thou comest in Thy kingdom![^239]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Снѣ́дїю и҆зведѐ и҆зъ раѧ̀ вра́гъ А҆да́ма; Крⷭ҇то́мъ же разбо́йника введѐ Хрⷭ҇то́съ въ ѻ҆́нь, помянѝ мѧ зовꙋ́ща, є҆гда̀ прїи́деши въ црⷭ҇твїи твое́мъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I venerate Thy passions, I glorify Thy Resurrection; with Adam and the thief, with a radiant voice I cry unto Thee: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest in Thy kingdom![^240]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Покланя́юся страсте́мъ твои̑мъ, славосло́влю и҆ воскрⷭ҇ні́е; съ А҆да́момъ и҆ разбо́йникомъ, съ гла́сомъ свѣ́тлымъ вопїю̀ тебѣ̀: помянѝ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и, є҆гда̀ прїи́деши въ црⷭ҇твїи твое́мъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou wast crucified, O Sinless One, and wast laid in the tomb of Thine own will; but Thou didst rise as God, raising Adam up with Thyself: Remember me, who cry, when Thou comest in Thy kingdom![^241]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Распя́лся є҆сѝ Безгрѣ́шне, и҆ въ гро́бѣ положи́лся є҆сѝ во́лею; но воскре́слъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ, совоздви́гнувый себѣ̀ А҆да́ма; помянѝ мѧ зовꙋ́ща, є҆гда̀ прїи́деши въ црⷭ҇твїи твое́мъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having raised the temple of Thy body by Thy three-day burial, Thou didst raise up Adam and those descended from Adam, O Christ God: Remember us who cry, when Thou comest in Thy kingdom![^242]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Хра́мъ тво́й тѣле́сный, тридне́внымъ воскреси́вый погребе́нїемъ, съ А҆да́момъ и҆ и҆̀же ѿ А҆да́ма, воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е! помянѝ на́съ зовꙋ́щихъ, є҆гда̀ прїи́деши въ црⷭ҇твїи твое́мъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 5:* The Myrrh-bearers came weeping unto Thy tomb, O Christ God, very early in the morning; and they found an Angel sitting in white robes,[^243]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 5 (continued):* ...who cried: Why seek ye? Christ is risen; weep no more![^244]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 6:* Thine Apostles, O Lord, having come unto the mountain where Thou hadst commanded them, O Savior, and seeing Thee, worshipped; and Thou didst send them unto the nations, to teach and to baptize them.[^245]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Glory... Triadikon:* Let us worship the Father, let us glorify the Son, and together let us praise the All-holy Spirit, crying and saying: O All-holy Trinity, save us all![^246]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Thy people bring Thy Mother unto Thee in prayer, O Christ! By her supplications grant us Thy compassions, O Good One, that we may glorify Thee Who didst shine forth unto us from the tomb.[^247]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera of the Master:*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* O All-good Father! Thou didst send Thy Son, the All-good Lord, to take the prodigal son upon His shoulders, to bring back the straying sheep, and to lead him back whence he had fallen: into the fold of Thine Angels, the undeluded powers.[^249]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* O All-good Father! Moved by the abundant goodness of Thy tender-hearted compassions, as God Thou didst bring all things out of non-existence, and afterward didst create man with Thy hand according to Thine image; and when he had become corrupt through the transgression of the commandments, Thou didst rebuild him, as the Lover of mankind.[^250]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* O Lord, Lover of mankind, Who art the all-true Son of the Heavenly Begetter! Thou wast manifested for our sake, being the Son of Man, that taking me upon Thy shoulders as a sheep—man deceived by the deceit of the serpent—Thou mightest lead me up into the heavenly fold.[^251]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Bodiless Powers.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Ye bodiless Angels, who stand before the throne of God, illuminated with the radiances thence proceeding, and shedding streams of light,[^252]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1 to the Bodiless Powers (continued):* ...ever shining, and becoming secondary lights: pray ye unto Christ to grant peace and great mercy unto our souls![^253]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Ye immortal Angels, all-rich ones, having truly received imperishable life from the First Life! Ye have become partakers of ever-existing glory and holy beholders of eternal wisdom, filled with light, and transformed into lamps, fitly manifested.[^254]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Archangels, Angels, Principalities, Thrones, Dominions, six-winged Seraphim, and divine many-eyed Cherubim, instruments of wisdom, most divine Powers and Authorities: pray ye unto Christ to grant peace and great mercy unto our souls![^255]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Having become the pure dwelling-place of God, O pure Virgin! Pray with the bodiless hosts that I may purely accomplish the journey of this life, that the evening of death may not overtake me unprepared and dispatch me into the flame of fire to be tormented; but snatch me away from this![^256]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Then: "O Joyful Light." Then the Prokeimenon, Tone 1:*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Behold now, bless ye the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Then: "Vouchsafe, O Lord, to keep us this evening without sin," and the Litany.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera of Compunction, Tone 1:*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* As the abyss of my transgressions is vast, O Savior, and I am sorely overwhelmed by my sins: give me Thy hand, as unto Peter; save me, O God, and have mercy on me![^258]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Seeing that in evil thoughts and deeds I have condemned myself, O Savior: grant me the thought of repentance, O God, that I may cry unto Thee: Save me, O good Benefactor, and have mercy on me![^260]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Through the prayers of all the Saints and of the Theotokos, O Lord, grant us Thy peace, and have mercy on us, as Thou alone art compassionate.[^262]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion Automelon:*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: Joy of the heavenly ranks, mighty protection of men upon earth, O most pure Virgin! Save us who flee unto thee; for after God, O Mother of God, we have placed our hope in thee.[^263]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Then: "Lord, now lettest Thou Thy servant depart." Trisagion through "Our Father." Troparion of the Saint. Glory... Both now... Theotokion. Then the Litany, and the Dismissal.*[^264]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *On Sunday, at Compline:*[^265]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Supplicatory Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Tone 1. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Thy victorious right hand hath been glorified in strength in manner becoming God; for that hand, O Immortal One, being all-powerful, shattered the adversaries, fashioning anew for the Israelites a path through the deep.[^266]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^267]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Ineffably thou didst conceive God, and beyond nature didst give birth unto Him, O all-pure Sovereign Lady, Who redeemed earthly beings from transgressions; therefore I entreat thee: Deliver me from my many transgressions![^268]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I am overwhelmed by an abyss of sins, and countless tribulations and sorrows; but by thy mighty pilotage and by thy prayer, O All-immaculate One, direct me unto the divine stillness of repentance.[^269]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O protectress of my whole life, deliver me from many perils, that with a voice of thanksgiving I may hymn thee, O pure Mother of God; and snatch me away from future torments![^270]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Quell the assaults of tribulations and the storm of temptations, O all-immaculate Mother of the Redeemer, Creator, and our God, granting me the grace of salvation and purification.[^271]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Thou Who alone knowest the weakness of human nature, and hast mercifully taken form therein: gird me with power from on high, that I may cry aloud unto Thee: Holy is the living temple of Thine ineffable glory, O Lover of mankind![^272]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The vision of thy pure countenance is indeed sweet unto Angels, saving unto men, and dreadful unto the spirits of wickedness; honoring and kissing it with faith, O Mother of God, we enlighten our souls.[^273]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With virginal blood from thee, the Creator and Lord clothed His flesh; entreat Him, O All-immaculate One, to show compassion for Thine ineffable mercy's sake unto me, corrupted by unfitting deeds.[^274]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having gained thee as the guardian of my life and an impregnable rampart: vouchsafe me also after my departure to find thee as a shelter and an invincible champion, leading me unto God, and bestowing eternal life and glory, O All-immaculate One.[^275]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Seedless was thy conception, O Pure One, and incorrupt thy childbirth; for God clearly was He[^276]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4 (continued):* ...Who was born, calling human nature back from its fall. Therefore we praise thee as the true and real Mother of God.[^277]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Beholding thee with prophetic eyes as the mountain overshadowed by the grace of God, Habbakuk proclaimed that the Holy One of Israel should go forth from thee, unto our salvation and renewal.[^278]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* An unrestrained rush toward evil draws me on through the working of the enemy and evil habit; help me, O Sovereign Lady, lest the all-destroying one fall upon me utterly, hindering me by death from repentance.[^279]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I have spent the whole time of my life in wicked fornications and grievous wounds; and now the workers of these things drag my humble soul away: O Virgin, Mother of God, help me![^280]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Give ear unto my sorrowful voice, O All-immaculate One, which with groanings I offer from the depth of my soul, and grant me remission of the debts which I, wretched one, have incurred in thought and foolish disposition.[^281]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O Sovereign Lady of the world, Mother of God, help me! The most wicked enemy swallows me up greedily with grievous remembrances and imaginations that separate me from God; therefore leave me not, nor despise me.[^282]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Christ, Who hast enlightened the ends of the world with the radiance of Thy coming, and hast illumined them with Thy Cross: enlighten the hearts of those who praise Thee in orthodox fashion with the light of Thy divine knowledge.[^283]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Behold, I have gained a ready help unto salvation; therefore I fall down before thee, and cry with tears: O Mother of God, deliver me from the arrows of the stranger, and from the future reckoning.[^284]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou art my strength, thou art my praise and rejoicing, and thou art my guardian, protection, and refuge, and an invincible champion, O most holy Virgin Theotokos; therefore save thy servant.[^285]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Cleanse my wretched soul, defiled by passions, with the sprinkling of thy divine prayer, O all-pure Mother of God, granting the radiant garment of thy salvation.[^286]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4 (continued):* In my life thou art my steadfast pilot, delivering me from the tempest of many tribulations; and at my departure (I pray thee) stand by me, saving me, O Mother of Christ God![^287]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* The lowest abyss hath surrounded us, there is none that delivers; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter; save Thy people, O our God! For Thou art the strength of the infirm and their restoration.[^288]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O unwedded Mother of God, all-pure one! Stretch forth thy hand unto me, and snatch me out of the depth of evils which I, most wretched one, have brought upon my passionate soul by my folly.[^289]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Arise, O pure one, unto the aid of thy servant, who placs his hope, after God, in thine invincible protection, lest the enemy prevail, and seize and destroy me.[^290]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Healer of the sick, resurrection of the fallen, cleansing of sinners, O Mother of God: I entreat thee, falling down with tears, and I cry unto thee: As thou art powerful, save me who am perishing![^291]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Have mercy, O pure one, upon my humble soul; prevent and snatch it away, rescuing it from the evil one; for he strivs to cast it into the pit on account of the evils which great sloth hath wrought.[^292]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Then: "Lord, have mercy" (3 times). Glory... Both now... Sessional Hymn, Tone 1:*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: All of us have acquired thee as an intercessor before the Lord, O Pure One, and we run unto thy holy temple, asking help from thee, O Ever-virgin! Deliver us therefore from demonic malice and torment, and from the fearful condemnation, who call thee blessed.[^293]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* As a spiritual furnace, O Mother of God, do we the faithful perceive thee; for even as He Who is supremely exalted saved the three Children, so hath the praiseworthy and supremely glorified God of our fathers renewed the whole world within thy womb.[^294]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou wast the divine tabernacle of the Master, having conceived Him in thy womb and given birth unto Him in the flesh, O only Immaculate One. Therefore deliver us from passions and diseases, and sorrows and debts; for thou hast strength and great power.[^295]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Quell the intolerable sickness, O Pure One, of my most wretched[^296]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...soul, granting me true joy, O Sovereign Lady, dispelling the turbid wave of my many transgressions; for thou art my refuge and deliverance.[^297]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* All the hope of my salvation have I placed upon thee; for I have acquired thee as a help, an unconquerable pillar, and a confirmation, and an assurance of steadfastness; and through thee I hope to obtain the Kingdom, O Sovereign Lady.[^298]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Thou wast the Orient of the Sun of glory, O pure Sovereign Lady; for through thee He was manifested, and freed all from darkness, ignorance, and foul transgressions. Therefore I cry unto thee: Free me from outer darkness![^299]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* In the furnace the Children of Israel, as in a crucible, shone more purely than gold with the beauty of piety, saying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages![^300]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The turmoil of passions sorely grievs my soul, O Mother of God! But having given birth unto the Author and Giver of stillness and peace, O Pure One, preserving me in a peaceful frame, fill me with gentle joy and gladness.[^301]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou hast been shown forth as the Mediatress of salvation unto us, O Mother of God, having given birth unto the Savior and Master of all. Therefore I entreat thee: Vouchsafe salvation unto my humble soul, that I may faithfully hymn thee unto all ages.[^302]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O thou who didst ineffably conceive the Creator of all and God: save me from corruption and every temptation, and grant me ever to cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages![^303]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Thou didst give birth unto the Creator of all and God, O Virgin! Entreat Him to grant cleansing of transgressions, and deliverance from afflictions and trials, and release from eternal fire, unto those who unceasingly glorify thy glory.[^304]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* The bush burning with fire yet unconsumed showed forth an image of thy pure childbirth; and now we beseech thee to quench the furnace of temptations raging against us, that we may unceasingly magnify thee, O Mother of God![^305]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O all-immaculate Mother of God, open unto me thy merciful compassions, and deliver me from the mouth of the spiritual wolf that seeks to destroy and corrupt[^306]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (continued):* ...me. Have mercy, I pray thee; turn not away thy servant put to shame![^307]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Be thou the protectress of my whole life, and my firm defense; and deliver me, O All-pure One, from many trials and sorrows, and from the talkative slander of enemies; yea, and deliver me from eternal fire.[^308]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O sole visitation of the sick, sole restoration of the fallen, O Sovereign Lady! Sole guide unto God and entrance, sole Mediatress of eternal good things: have mercy upon me who alone have sinned more than all.[^309]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Receive now my tearful prayer, and grant me remission of transgressions and of the many evils which I have wrought, O all-hymned Sovereign Lady, Mother of God! For I am perishing utterly through boundless despair.[^310]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Then: "It is truly meet to bless thee," and the rest as usual, and the Dismissal.*[^311]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *On Monday at Matins:*[^312]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma of the Psalter, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 1:*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* In iniquities was I conceived, prodigal that I am; I dare not look up unto the height of heaven; yet daring upon Thy love for mankind, I cry: O God, cleanse me and save me![^313]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* If the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall I appear, a sinner, who have not borne the burden and heat of the day? But number me, O God, with the laborers of the eleventh hour, and save me![^315]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Beholding the wonder of wonders in thee, O full of grace, creation rejoices; for having conceived without seed, thou didst ineffably give birth unto Him Whom the ranks of Angels cannot gaze upon; entreat Him, O Mother of God, that our souls may be saved.[^316]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns:*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Make haste to open Fatherly embraces unto me; prodigally have I spent my life; looking upon the inexhaustible riches of Thy compassions, O Savior, despise not now my impoverished heart; for unto Thee, O Lord, in compunction do I cry: I have sinned against Thee, save me![^317]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Having foolishly withdrawn myself from Thee, O All-compassionate One! Prodigally have I spent my life, ever serving irrational passions. But receive me, through the prayers of Thine Angels, O tender-hearted Father, as the prodigal son, and save me, I pray Thee![^319]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Clothed by Thee, O Lord, in the praise of suffering and the dignity of crowns, the glorious Passion-bearers conquered through the endurance of wounds inflicted by the lawless, and by divine power received victory from heaven. Through their prayers deliver me also from the invisible enemy, O Savior, and save me.[^321]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* O steadfast protectress and helper of all! Unshakeable hope and defender of the world! Have mercy upon us as thou art good, and grant cleansing of transgressions and salvation of souls, and guide us onto the path of repentance; for unto thee do we flee in faith, and thee do we entreat warmly, and ask in love: Withdraw not thy mercy from us.[^322]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Other Sessional Hymns, when the 3rd Kathisma is chanted:*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Thy tribunal is fearful and Thy judgment is just, but my deeds are grievous; yet do Thou, O Merciful One, anticipate me and save me, and deliver me from torment; deliver me, O Master, from the portion of the goats, and vouchsafe me to stand on Thy right hand, O most righteous Judge![^323]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Surpassing the immaterial hosts, O Maiden, and alone transcending the heavenly Ranks, thou receivest worthy praise from them, O All-pure One! But entreat Thy Son with the Angels, that I, who alone am condemned, may be delivered from the tyranny of passions.[^324]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon,*[^325]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *whose acrostic is: "Wash away the filth of my transgressions, O Word!"*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Tone 1. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Thy victorious right hand hath been glorified in strength in manner becoming God; for that hand, O Immortal One, being all-powerful, shattered the adversaries, fashioning anew for the Israelites a path in the deep.[^326]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*[^327]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The multitude of my sins blot out, I pray Thee, O Christ, according to the multitude of Thy mercy, and grant me the thought of conversion, that I may glorify Thy goodness which surpasses understanding.[^328]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou wast manifested on earth through the loving-kindness of Thy compassions, taking flesh[^329]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...as man; therefore receive me, who have sinned more than any man, O Word of God, who now fall down in repentance before Thy compassions.[^330]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Martyrs, pray to God for us.*[^331]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Imitating the slaying and death of Christ Who suffered willingly, ye endured manifold sufferings and death, O ever-memorable ones; therefore, O Martyrs, ye attained immortal life.[^332]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Bearing the fire of divine love most gloriously within, O Martyrs, ye feared not the material fire; but by the fervent endeavors of your sufferings ye consumed every substance of polytheism.[^333]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The ranks of the bodiless hosts sing of thee with us, O all-hymned Virgin! For thou didst give birth in the flesh unto the Uncontainable One within thy womb, remaining a virgin, even as before childbirth, O Bride of God.[^334]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Second Canon, to the Bodiless Powers,*[^335]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *whose acrostic is: "Theophan's first song to the Angels."*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Archangels and Angels, pray to God for us.*[^336]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
