items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (twice):* Standing radiantly before the Master's throne, all-holy Angels: entreat the Son co-unoriginate with the Father, even the Angel of Great Counsel, to inspire speech in me who hymn you.[^337]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Being mirrors of the God-originating light, receiving within themselves the radiance of the thrice-sunny lamp so far as is fathomable: the Divine Intellect, having first conceived the Angelic Ranks, brought them into being.[^338]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who as God adorned the commanders of the hosts on high, took up His dwelling within thy womb that knew not wedlock, which is higher than the Seraphim, O Mother of God, and unchangeably became flesh.[^339]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Thou Who alone knowest the weakness of human nature, and hast mercifully taken form therein: gird me with power from on high, that I may cry aloud unto Thee: Holy is the living temple of Thine ineffable glory, O Lover of mankind![^340]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Arise, come, O my soul, and cry aloud unto thy Creator Who knows all thy secret things, and bring forth fruits of repentance, that the compassionate Lord may have mercy upon thee and deliver thee from eternal fire.[^341]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵроно́сицы прїидо́ша пла́чꙋще, на гро́бъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, зѣлѡ̀ ра́нѡ; и҆ въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́гг҃ла сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Cleanse me, O only Good One, cleanse and save me, as the publican who[^342]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: стра́хомъ зовꙋ̀ тебѣ̀: мно́жествомъ грѣхѡ́въ влекі́йся, и҆ преклоня́емъ є҆́смь тягото́ю прегрѣше́нїй, и҆ стꙋда̀ безмѣ́рнагѡ и҆сполня́йся.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...with fear I cry unto Thee: dragged down by a multitude of sins, and bowed down by the weight of transgressions, and filled with boundless shame.[^343]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́дростїю и҆ ра́зꙋмомъ и҆́стиннымъ Мч҃ници и҆сполня́еми, є҆́ллинскꙋю мꙋ́дрость ѡ҆бꙋи́ша, мꙋ́дростнꙋю же ѕло́бꙋ погꙋби́ша, и҆ крѣ́пкѡ пострада́вше, досто́йнѣ воспрїя́ша побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ ра́дꙋющеся.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Filled with true wisdom and understanding, the Martyrs made foolish the wisdom of the Greeks, and destroyed their crafty malice; and having suffered valiantly, they worthily received the crowns of victory, rejoicing.[^344]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆ди́ницꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ є҆стество́мъ, Трⷪ҇цꙋ же ли́цы и҆сповѣ́дающе страда́лци, пре́лесть многобо́жную, бж҃е́ственною вѣ́рою потреби́сте, и҆ свѣти́лници ꙗ҆ви́стеся, всѣ́хъ ѡ҆заря́юще сердца̀, лꙋча́ми бл҃года́тными.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Confessing a Monad indeed in essence, but a Trinity in Persons, O passion-bearers, ye destroyed the error of polytheism through divine faith, and were shown forth as luminaries, enlightening the hearts of all with beams of grace.[^345]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃а́я Бг҃оневѣ́сто чⷭ҇таѧ, Ст҃а́гѡ породила̀ є҆сѝ, въ ст҃ы́хъ почива́ющаго, Сн҃а и҆ Сло́ва Ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ собезна́чальнаго, ѡ҆сщ҃а́ющаго ѡ҆ ст҃ѣ́мъ Дс҃ѣ, и҆̀же того̀ бл҃гоче́стнѡ ѡ҆сщ҃а́ющїя.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O holy and pure Bride of God, thou didst give birth unto the Holy One Who rests among the saints, the Son and Word co-unoriginate with the Father, Who sanctifies in the Holy Spirit those who piously worship Him.[^346]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тꙋ бг҃одѣ́тельномꙋ, Серафі́ми несре́дственнѡ приближа́ющеся, и҆ многогꙋ́бѡ и҆̀мъ насыща́еми, первода́тными ꙗ҆́вѣ сїя́ньми, перводѣ́лнѡ свѣ́тат-
items.english_text: *Canon to the Bodiless Powers. Heirmos the same:*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: ся, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣ́ти вторі́и быва́ютъ бж҃ество́мъ ѡ҆божа́еми. В҃.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Directly drawing near unto the God-working Light, the Seraphim, being abundantly filled by Him with primary effulgences, shine forth in primary fashion, and become secondary lights, deified by the Godhead. *(Twice)*[^347]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: А҆́гг҃лскїя свѣ́тлѡсти пѣ́ти, ᲂу҆се́рднѣ жела́ющїе, ꙗ҆̀же тѣ́ми ѿ Бг҃а по́мощь подае́мꙋю вѣ́рнїи про́симъ, ᲂу҆ма̀ чистото́ю, и҆ пречи́стыми ᲂу҆стны̀: и҆ да полꙋ́чимъ си́хъ сїя́нїе. Бг҃оро́диченъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Desiring with fervor to praise the angelic splendors, we faithful ask the help granted by God through them, with purity of mind and most pure lips, that we may receive their illumination.[^348]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пресꙋ́щественнаго, ви́дѣти сподобля́емь ꙗ҆́кѡ лѣ́пѡ, Гаврїи́лъ Дв҃о всенепоро́чная, ра́дованенъ гла́съ принесѐ тебѣ̀, Сло́ва зача́тїе ꙗ҆́вѣ возвѣща́ѧ тебѣ̀, и҆ неизрече́нное ржⷭ҇тво̀ твоѐ проповѣ́даѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Deemed worthy, as was meet, to behold the Supersubstantial Mind, Gabriel brought unto thee the joyful salutation, O all-immaculate Virgin, manifestly announcing unto thee the conception of the Word and proclaiming thine ineffable childbearing.[^349]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Го́рꙋ тя̀ бл҃года́тїю Бж҃їею присѣне́ннꙋю, прозорли́выма А҆ввако́мъ ᲂу҆смотри́въ ѻ҆чи́ма, и҆зъ тебѐ и҆зы́ти І҆и҃левꙋ провозглаша́ше Ст҃о́мꙋ, въ сп҃се́нїе на́ше и҆ ѡ҆бновле́нїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Habakkuk, beholding with foresighted eyes the mountain overshadowed by the grace of God, foretold that the Holy One of Israel should come forth from thee, unto our salvation and renewal.[^350]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Комꙋ̀ тя̀ дꙋшѐ моя̀ ѻ҆каѧ́нная ᲂу҆подо́блю, дѣ́лающꙋю лю̑таѧ, и҆ нетворя́щꙋю до́брыхъ? Ѡ҆брати́ся, возопі́й, тебѐ ра́ди ѡ҆бнища́вшемꙋ во́лею: сердцевѣ́дче ᲂу҆ще́дри, и҆ сп҃сѝ мя.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unto whom shall I liken thee, O my wretched soul, who workest evil and doest not good? Turn back, cry aloud unto Him Who willingly became poor for thy sake: O Knower of hearts, have compassion and save me![^351]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast ordained repentance, O Savior, for those who turn back; grant this unto me, O Good One, before the end of life, giving me compunction and sighing, as formerly unto the harlot...[^352]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...who kissed Thy feet, O Master.[^353]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having been filled with spiritual waters, O Martyrs, ye were shown forth as rivers of living water by the divine beckoning, and through the Spirit ye dried up the turbid streams of deceit, O Christ, and gave drink to the minds of the faithful.[^354]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having mightily struggled, the divine Martyrs endured the torment of fire and sword and all cruel things. By their entreaties, O Word of God, deliver from the greatest eternal torments those who praise Thee in faith.[^355]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Born of the Father without generation, the Son took upon Himself a temporal birth, being incarnate of thee, desiring as the Compassionate One to take away the ancient warfare of earthborn men, being Himself above days and years.[^356]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Thrones, first filling the beauty, and the Cherubim and Seraphim, shine directly with divine rays, receiving the God-working sacred hierarchies, singing in hymnody: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.[^357]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The Seraphim praise the threefold Unity of the Godhead with Triadic radiances, revealing with unceasing voices the most pure mystery of theology, and instructing in the orthodox faith.[^358]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Reverently receiving the outpouring of wisdom and the richness of understanding of the solitary and simple self-subsistent Wisdom, the Cherubim grant them in a God-imitating manner unto the rest, emitting illumination unto them.[^359]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who is understood to be higher than every creature, working miracles in truth upon earth through His life-originating creation beyond understanding, by His efficacious brightnesses dwelt within thy pure womb, O All-pure One.[^360]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Christ, Who didst enlighten with the radiance of Thy coming, and didst illumine the ends of the world by Thy Cross: enlighten with the light of Thy divine knowledge the hearts of those who praise Thee in orthodox fashion.[^361]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have fallen into the corruption of passions, and I fear Thy righteous judgment seat, O righteous Lord. Therefore I pray unto Thee: strengthen me to do good works which justify me.[^362]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The unknown and secret things of my heart Thou knowest, O my God, and Creator, and Lord! Condemn not...[^363]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...me then in the hour of judgment, when Thou comest to judge all things.[^364]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having partaken of fire, the holy ones showed the kindling of their divine love. Therefore, bedewed with the expectation of future good things, the God-bearing ones rejoiced.[^365]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Strengthened by the hope of good things, the Martyrs endured the tearing of their limbs most patiently, and with the sinews of their unslackened endurance they strangled the multi-wiled one.[^366]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Eloquent lips cannot tell the ineffable mystery of thy childbearing, O Bride of God! For thou givest birth unto the Incomprehensible One, and carriest in thine arms Him Who holds all things in His hand.[^367]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Kindled with divine love, the Dominions, Authorities, and Powers, the secondary ranks, with unceasing lips sing praise unto the God-originating one Essence and Power. *(Twice)*[^368]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The Archangelic ranks, and those of the Angels and Principalities, with countless hosts, are governed by the Spirit; and they are brightly taught to revere the one Tri-hypostatic illuminating Essence.[^369]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast adorned above all angelic beauty, having conceived the Creator and Lord of Angels, Who became incarnate, O most pure Mother of God, all-immaculate.[^370]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* The lowest abyss hath surrounded us, and there is none to deliver; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter; save Thy people, O our God! For Thou art the strength of the ailing, and their setting-aright.[^371]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Being the Physician, O Christ, heal the passions of my heart, and wash me from every defilement with the streams of my compunction, O my Jesus, that I may sing and magnify Thy tender compassion.[^372]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As I stray upon the paths of perdition, and fall into the pit of sins, turn me back, O Christ, and lead me unto the unerring paths of Thy precious ordinances, that I may glorify Thee.[^373]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Being pelted with stones, the truly precious stones did not deny the Living Stone, nor unto graven stones did they...[^374]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs (continued):* ...sacrifice, the glorious and crown-bearing martyrs of the Lord.[^375]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having renewed their souls with the plow of faith, the Martyrs, through the divine Spirit, brought forth a hundredfold ear of suffering, and were deemed worthy of blessed sustenance.[^376]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast shown forth, O All-immaculate One, having given birth unto the Fire of the fiery ministers; and in primary fashion excelling all creation, O most pure Virgin, blessed among women, rejoicing in God.[^377]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The ranks of the bodiless ones, O Lord, standing before the throne of Thy glory, O Lover of mankind, honor Thee with unceasing angelic voices; for Thou art their strength, O Christ, and their song. *(Twice)*[^378]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Beholding Thy face, O Angels—the unsearchable beauty, the super-divine loveliness of Thy divine brightness—they are enlightened; for Thou art both their Light and their rejoicing.[^379]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who before was the bodiless Word became incarnate of thee, O Most Pure One! He Who makes all things by His will, and Who brought the hosts of the bodiless from non-existence, as the Almighty.[^380]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* We the faithful discern thee, O Theotokos, to be a spiritual furnace; for even as the Supremely Exalted One saved the three children, so wholly within thy womb He renewed the world: the praised and supremely glorified God of the fathers.[^381]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In ancient times Daniel tamed lions, having virtue as his companion. Emulate him, O soul; and by ever looking unto God, make inactive the one who ever roars as a lion and desires to seize thee.[^382]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Through the great excess of prodigality, O Lord, I have grievously defiled my soul. Possessing surpassing goodness, O Christ, receive me as the prodigal, and have compassion on me who sing: O praised and supremely glorified God of the fathers![^383]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Powerfully strengthened by the law of Christ, the invincible Martyrs destroyed the counsels of the lawless, and having lawfully finished their course, they sang: Blessed art Thou, O praised God of our fathers![^384]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* O God-illumined Martyrs of the Lord, kindled with the light of the Trinity, ye manifestly destroyed the darkness of torments and the mist of error, singing: O praised and supremely glorified God of our fathers![^385]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The laws of nature are renewed in thee; for beyond the laws of the flesh thou givest birth unto Christ the Lawgiver, O All-immaculate One, Who statuts deliverance for all who sing: O praised and supremely glorified God of the fathers![^386]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou art the Unoriginate Light, O Master, Who didst shine forth from the Father of lights; Thou didst establish the hosts of Angels as lights, mirrors receiving Thine unsetting radiance: O praised and supremely glorified God of the fathers![^387]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As the Lord of all, Thou manifestly savest the human race through angelic appointments; for these Thou hast appointed over all who believe and who in orthodox fashion sing unto Thee, the praised and supremely glorified God of our fathers.[^388]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Tongue and mind cannot utter Thy wonders, O Master, and the splendor of Thy works; for Thou hast enlightened every embellishment of the heavenly powers: O praised and supremely glorified God of the fathers![^389]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Of thee, O Pure One, the Son became incarnate, Who before was without mother from the Father, and without father in that which pertains unto us, having become man for our sake; Whom the ranks of the bodiless now serve as the praised and supremely glorified God of our fathers.[^390]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* In the furnace, the children of Israel, as in a crucible, shone more brightly than gold with the beauty of piety, saying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^391]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Christ, my tender-hearted Redeemer! Deliver me from the sinful darkness and from all temptations that now hold me fast, as I cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^392]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When Thou shalt come in glory, O Christ, to judge the world, number me also among the standing of Thine elect, as I cry aloud and say: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^393]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Ye passed over unto the land of Christ, O holy Martyrs; for having mightily struggled upon earth, ye received the heavenly life, singing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^394]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having stripped off the corruptible body, into the garment of immortality as...[^395]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs (continued):* ...victorious Martyrs, ye were clothed in Christ, crying from on high: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^396]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Sacred voices from afar foretold, O Most Pure One, that thou shouldest be the Mother of God Who made all things; unto Whom we sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^397]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Emulating the angelic hosts enlightened and brought near to light by the beams of three-sun beauty, let us faithful sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^398]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As the fountain of all good things, the supremely God-originating divine Power brings forth the secondary lights, who receive the First Light and cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^399]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The Primary Mind and Creator supersubstantially established for Himself the transcendent angelic minds, who manifestly draw near and cry: Sing unto the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^400]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Him Who was begotten of the Father before the ages beyond speech, thou didst ineffably bear incarnate for us, O all-immaculate Virgin! Unto Whom we cry: Sing unto the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^401]

items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* The burning bush showed forth unburnt an image of thy pure childbearing; and we pray thee now to quench the raging furnace of temptations that assaults us, that we may unceasingly magnify thee, O Theotokos.[^402]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Even as the Canaanite woman I cry unto Thee: Have mercy on me, O Word! For I have a soul suffering distress through the assaults of demons, and senselessly working lawless deeds, and having no feeling of Thy divine fear, O Long-suffering One.[^403]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Set the feet of my soul, O Lord, upon the rock of Thy commandments; and trip up the serpent that shamelessly desires to trip me up, and deliver me from his evil-doing, for Thou art good and of great mercy.[^404]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having already crossed over the surging water of temptations and the storm of cruel wounds, O Martyrs, ye have manifestly reached the haven of the heavenly kingdom, enjoying divine tranquillity.[^405]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having become luminous, O Martyrs, ye were deemed worthy of the unwaning Light; and ye dwell in the church of the firstborn, and rejoice with the angelic choirs; with them pray unto the Giver of life on our behalf.[^406]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou carriest Him Who bears all things, and thou sucklest Him Who gives food unto all. Great and dreadful beyond understanding is thy mystery, O ark of precious holiness, Virgin Theotokos! Therefore in faith we call thee blessed.[^407]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst establish the bodiless minds, O Savior, as partakers of Thine ineffable glory; and now through them preserve Thy people who flee unto Thee in faith and love, that we may unceasingly magnify Thee, O Master.[^408]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Almighty Ruler, Thou sendest an angel of peace to preserve Thy flock; for Thou art the Author of peace and love; one who guards the God-wise faith, and through Thy power destroys all heresies.[^409]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Thou Who art praised as altogether sweetness, plant in Thy churches, O Master, heavenly sweet radiance, and grant well-ordered stability, that we may unceasingly magnify Thee, the Savior.[^410]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The angelic ranks, O Most Pure One, now unceasingly honor thy childbearing; for standing in their order and beholding it, they are filled with His gladness, and unceasingly magnify thee as the Theotokos.[^411]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *The little litany, and the Exapostilarion.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Another world awaits thee, O soul, and the Judge is about to expose thy secret and grievous deeds. Abide not therefore in the things here below, but anticipate the end, crying unto the Judge: O God, cleanse me and save me![^412]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad. In all our days let us be glad for the days wherein Thou didst humble us, for the years wherein we saw evils. And look upon Thy servants and upon Thy works, and guide their sons.* [^413]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Despise me not, O my Savior, who am held fast by sinful slothfulness; raise up my thoughts unto repentance, and show me forth an approved laborer of Thy vineyard...[^414]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 (continued):* ...grant unto me the reward of the eleventh hour, and great mercy.[^415]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Come, all ye peoples, let us honor with spiritual hymns and songs the passion-bearers of Christ, the luminaries of the world and preachers of the faith, the ever-flowing fountain from which healings pour forth unto the faithful. By their supplications, O Christ our God, grant peace unto Thy world, and unto our souls great mercy.[^417]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the celestial ranks" (Нб҃ныхъ чинѡ́въ):*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: Holier than all the holy powers, more honorable than all creation, O Theotokos, Lady of the world: save us who have given birth unto the Savior, from myriad transgressions and afflictions, as thou art good, by thy prayers.[^418]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Then: It is good to give praise: Trisagion. After the Our Father: troparion to the Saint, and litany and dismissal. First Hour, and the final dismissal.*[^419]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Refrain:* By food the enemy led Adam out of Paradise, but by the Cross Christ led the thief into it: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy kingdom.[^420]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Grant me a fountain of compunction, O Christ God, through Thy tender-hearted compassion, cleansing me from every defilement of boundless evils, and make me a partaker of Thy kingdom, O Benefactor.[^421]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* We bring before Thee the ranks of Thine Angels in supplication, O Christ! Save and have compassion on us through them, as Thou art supremely good, overlooking all our transgressions both in knowledge and in ignorance.[^422]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* By the streams of your blood, O holy ones, ye manifestly drowned the spiritual Pharaoh; and now ye pour forth streams of wonders, drying up the deep of infirmities; therefore ye are called blessed.[^423]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Glory... Triadikon:* Let us worship the Father, let us glorify the Son, and together let all we faithful sing praise unto the All-holy Spirit, crying out and saying: O All-holy Trinity, save us all![^424]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^248]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Having given birth unto the timeless Light, guide unto the light my soul, ever darkened by the assaults of demons, O All-immaculate One, and deliver me from the coming fire by thine intercessions.[^425]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera. Tone 1:*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* All my life have I shamefully squandered, O Lord, wretched among harlots; like the prodigal I cry in compunction: O Heavenly Father, I have sinned, cleanse and save me, and cast me not away, who have estranged myself from Thee and am now become destitute on account of unfruitful works.[^427]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Having become poor, though Thou art rich, O Christ, Thou hast enriched men with immortality and brightness; therefore enrich me with virtues, who have become impoverished through worldly pleasures, and appoint me with poor Lazarus, delivering me from the torment of the rich man and from the Gehenna that lies before me.[^428]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* With wickedness was I grievously enriched, and I loved delicacies, and received good things in life, O Lord, and was condemned unto Gehenna; my hungry mind, like Lazarus cast down before the gates of Thy divine deeds, have I neglected; have compassion on me, O Lord![^429]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* O marvelous Prophet, Baptist and Forerunner of Christ! By thy prayers, I beseech thee, cause my heart, which hath dried up through unseemliness, to pour forth rivers of ever-flowing tears, that being saved through thee, though full of grief, I may magnify Him Who hath magnified thee.[^430]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* O blessed Prophet, who didst baptize Christ Jesus Who takes away the abyss of the world's transgressions: upon thee do I place all my hope and the life of my expectation. Entreat Him, O John, I pray thee, to cleanse my heart and save me.[^431]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* O wise preacher of grace, who didst foretell repentance unto all nations: grant unto my all-wretched and blinded soul, O divine Forerunner, to abide in repentance and ever to do the will of the Lord, that in faith and love I may glorify thee.[^432]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: Pray with the Lamb, O Virgin, Who takes away the sins of the whole world, Whom the most great Forerunner preached unto all, that in the hour of judgment He may show me a stranger to the portion of the goats, and unite me, the unworthy one, unto His right-hand sheep.[^433]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *The Lord will hear me. Verse: When I call upon Him.*[^434]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *And the litany. Thereafter: Vouchsafe, O Lord, in this evening:*[^435]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* As a great abyss are my transgressions, O Savior, and I am grievously sinking through my sins; stretch forth Thy hand unto me as unto Peter, and save me.[^436]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Because in wicked thoughts and in deeds I have been condemned, O Savior, grant me the thought of turning back, O God, that I may cry unto Thee: Save me, O good Benefactor, and have mercy on me.[^438]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Your confession before the judgment seat, O holy ones, spat upon the power of the demons, and delivered men from delusion; therefore also, as your heads were being severed, ye cried: Let the sacrifice of our souls, O Lord, be acceptable before Thee, for having loved Thee, we took no account of temporal life, O Lover of mankind![^440]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: O all-lauded Virgin! In thee Moses with prophetic eyes beheld the mystery—the bush burning and unconsumed; for the fire of the Godhead did not burn thy womb, O Pure One. Therefore we pray thee, as the Mother of our God, to ask peace for the world, and great mercy.[^441]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Then: Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion. After the Our Father: troparion, and dismissal.*[^442]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Tone 1. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Let us all sing a triumphant song unto God, Who hath wrought marvelous wonders with His high arm, and saved Israel, for He hath been glorified.[^443]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^444]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Rejoice, O all-pure sanctuary, Virgin, embellishment of Angels, and receptacle of the Spirit, undefiled bride of the unoriginate Father, and Mother of the Word of God![^445]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou art Queen, as the King's daughter having blossomed forth, O Theotokos and Lady, and having given birth in the flesh unto the King and God, and thou reignest with Him.[^446]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆предѣ́лилъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе Сп҃се ѡ҆браща́ющымсѧ, є҆́же мнѣ̀ пода́ждь Бл҃же, пре́жде конца̀ житїя̀, да́я мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆миле́нїе и҆ воздыха́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́цѣ пе́р-

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́тъ ржⷭ҇тво̀ твоѐ Дв҃дъ пѣве́цъ, превоспѣва́етъ же И҆са́їа оу҆тро́бꙋ твою пречи́стꙋю, Мр҃і́е всечи́стаѧ! хрїстїа́нстїи же лю́дїе сла́вѧтъ рождество̀ твоѐ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* David the chanter sings of thy childbearing, and Isaiah extols thy most pure womb, O all-pure Mary! And Christian people glorify thy childbearing.[^448]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Проповѣ́дꙋетъ цр҃ковь рождество̀ твоѐ Дв҃о Бг҃оневѣ́сто, правосла́вными оу҆че́нїи, и҆ вещемѝ бж҃е́ственными; ѡ҆бразѡ́мъ бо воплоще́нїѧ Сн҃а твоегѡ̀ покланѧ́етсѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* The Church proclaims thy childbearing, O Virgin Bride of God, with orthodox teachings and divine realities; for it venerates the image of the incarnation of thy Son.[^449]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Ка́мень, є҆гѡ́же не брего́ша зи́ждꙋщїи, се́й бы́сть въ главꙋ̀ оу҆́гла. То́й є҆́сть ка́мень, на не́мже оу҆твердѝ цр҃ковь Хрⷭ҇то́съ, ю҆́же ѿ ꙗ҆̀зыкъ и҆скꙋпѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner. This is the stone upon which Christ established the Church, which He redeemed from the nations.[^450]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́вꙋ дѣ́вства и҆мꙋ́щи, ѡ҆блекла́сѧ є҆сѝ бл҃года́тїю Дх҃а ст҃а́гѡ, пречи́стаѧ Мр҃і́е, ꙗ҆́вльшисѧ Бц҃а; но́вое та́инство и҆ сокрове́нное: ка́кѡ бо Бг҃а пло́тїю ро́ждши дѣ́вствꙋеши?
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Possessing the glory of virginity, thou wast clothed with the grace of the Holy Spirit, O most pure Mary, shown forth as the Theotokos; a new and hidden mystery: for how, having given birth unto God in the flesh, dost thou remain a virgin?[^451]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Дѣ́ло, є҆́же содѣ́лалъ є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и, кто̀ ска́жетъ? ю҆́же бо проклѧ́тъ въ печа́лѣхъ роди́ти ча́да, Сн҃ъ показа́лсѧ є҆сѝ сеѧ̀; и҆ ра́дꙋетсѧ же́нское па́дшее є҆стество̀ ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ Бз҃ѣ, Бц҃ы ра́ди.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Who shall recount the work which Thou hast wrought, O Lord? For of her who was cursed to bring forth children in sorrows, Thou hast shown Thyself to be the Son; and fallen womanly nature rejoices in Thee, O God, for the sake of the Theotokos.[^452]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Бꙋ́рѧ прегрѣше́нїй рѣши́тсѧ мі́рꙋ, тобо́ю пречи́стаѧ Мр҃і́е Бц҃е є҆ди́на. Тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ приста́нище спасе́нїа и҆мꙋ́ще, восхвалѧ́емъ вѣ́рнїи, пою́ще вели́чїа твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The tempest of transgressions is loosed for the world through thee, O most pure Mary, sole Theotokos. Therefore having thee as a haven of salvation, we the faithful praise thee, singing thy great deeds.[^453]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Воспѣ́тъ дѣ́вствꙋ Прⷪ҇ро́ки дре́вле, роди́ти тѧ̀ безлѣ́тнаго въ лѣ́та, и҆ па́че сло́ва Сло́во, є҆ди́наго ѿ Трⷪ҇цы Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего; є҆гѡ́же цр҃ковь, мт҃и чи́стаѧ, почита́етъ ѻ҆́бразы.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* It was sung of old by the Prophets that thy virginity should bring forth in time the Timeless One, and the Word beyond word, One of the Trinity, Christ our God; Whose images the Church venerates, O pure Mother.[^454]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Дх҃омъ прови́дѧ проро́че А҆ввако́ме, Словесѐ воплоще́нїе, проповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ вопїѧ̀: внегда̀ прибли́житисѧ лѣ́тѡмъ, позна́ешисѧ; внегда̀ прїитѝ вре́мени, пока́жешисѧ. Сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Foreseeing in the Spirit the incarnation of the Word, O Prophet Habakkuk, thou didst proclaim, crying aloud: When the years draw near, Thou shalt be known; when the time is come, Thou shalt be shown forth. Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^455]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Седмосвѣ́тлое зерца́ло бж҃твенныхъ Проро́къ, многоѻбра́знѡ пое́тъ ѡ҆бразова́нїа твоѧ̑; мы́ же дѣ́ломъ зна́менїа и҆схо́да твоегѡ̀ воспрїе́мше, Бц҃ꙋ тѧ̀ вои́стинꙋ, вещемѝ ви́дѧще, вѣ́рꙋемъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The seven-light mirror of the divine Prophets in manifold ways sings of thy foreshadowings; and we, having in deed received the signs of thine outcome, seeing by realities that thou art truly the Theotokos, believe.[^456]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃їю тѧ̀ досто́йнѡ Мт҃рь, вои́стинꙋ Дв҃о чи́стаѧ чтꙋ́ще, сла́вимъ мы̀, сво́йственный приносѧ́ще гла́съ тебѣ̀, въ зако́нѣ и҆ проро́цѣхъ проповѣ́даннѣй: ра́дꙋйсѧ ѡ҆бра́дованнаѧ, Гдⷭ҇ь съ тобо́ю.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Worthily honoring thee in truth as the Mother of God, O pure Virgin, we glorify thee, bringing unto thee our proper voice, who was proclaimed in the Law and the Prophets: Rejoice, thou that art full of grace, the Lord is with thee![^457]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Behold the divine mountain which Habakkuk beheld, covered with the virtues...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (continued):* ...manifestly overshadowing, the Theotokos hath shone forth in the world; through whom we who of old had fallen away through transgression were immediately brought near unto God.[^458]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Blessed is the tongue, O all-lauded and Pure One, which hath been deemed worthy to honor thy childbearing faithfully with orthodoxy, teaching, and works, truly manifesting all the images of the incarnation of thy Son.[^459]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Rising early from the night, we hymn Thee, O Christ God, Who becamest poor for our sake, and didst endure the Cross and death in the flesh.[^460]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Mystically in secret did Moses show thee forth as the unburned bush, O Lady Theotokos! For thy material womb was not consumed by the Godhead.[^461]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Hymning thee as the Mother of the Word of God, O pure Theotokos, we offer unto thee a blossoming spiritual gift, wherein we believe that we rejoice.[^462]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Turn not away praise from defiled lips, O most pure Theotokos! For there is no one on earth who dares to sing of thee worthily.[^463]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* He Who was born of the Virgin is One in two essences: as invisible God, and as man Who willingly for our sake became like unto men.[^464]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Imitating the Prophet Jonah, I cry aloud: Deliver my life from corruption, O Good One, and save me, O Savior of the world, who cry: Glory to Thee![^465]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Prophet beholds thee as the spiritual seven-branched lampstand, O Virgin, manifestly showing forth the operations of the Spirit shining within thee.[^466]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou hast been shown forth as a tree, O Virgin, truly life-bearing, which by thy Fruit put to death the deceitful serpent, and brought forth life unto men, Christ God.[^467]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Uncomely praise is offered unto thee from defiled lips, O pure Mother of our God! Yet look upon the desire of my soul, and accept this.[^468]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* The lawless rage in the tumult of bitter unbelief, whenever they merely see the assemblies of the Orthodox kissing thine image, O Virgin.[^469]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Lord, have mercy (40 times). Glory... Both now...*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: Pilot my wretched life, O Pure One, and have compassion, O All-immaculate One, upon my soul that hath slipped...[^470]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn (continued):* ...through many transgressions into the abyss of perdition; and in the hour of death deliver me from the slandering demons and from the dreadful reckoning.[^471]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The fire touched not nor troubled Thy youths in the furnace, O Savior; then the three, as with one mouth, sang and blessed, saying: Blessed is the God of our fathers![^472]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou wast shown forth exceedingly adorned with virtues, O Bride of God, with the glory and honor of virginity; most comely indeed is thy beauty in its majesty; truly the Lord, as Lover, took thee unto Himself as His divine Mother.[^473]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Manifestly thou wast the rod of uprightness, O Pure One, the most honorable rod of the kingdom; therefore thou didst bud forth the Fruit of the Word of God, which marvel the rod of Aaron clearly prefigured from afar.[^474]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having defiled body, word, and soul with many bodily passions, how shall I sing of the beauty of thy virtues, O Pure One? I am at a loss and am terrified; but do thou thyself become my help through thy prayers.[^475]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* I honor the union of Thine incarnation, O Christ, and in a manner becoming God I venerate the image thereof; for being the eternal God, Thou becamest unchangeable man from the Virgin, Himself perfect in both.[^476]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Him before Whom the Angels and all the hosts tremble as Creator and Lord: praise, ye priests; glorify, ye youths; bless, ye people; and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^477]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Let the divine hierurgy of God be praised, whereby the world was delivered from corruption; arise, all ye who of old were fallen; for Mary hath given birth unto Christ the Salvation.[^478]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* We hymn thee, O Most Pure One and Mother of God! And who does not glorify thee who art truly good, being the hope of our souls? Therefore, O Most Holy One, accept my supplication.[^479]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Be radiant today with hymns, ye faithful; glorify, ye Angels and men together; for the devil falls, and despair; for Mary hath given birth unto our hope of salvation.[^480]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Circumscribe not the Godhead, lie not, ye blind! For It is simply invisible and unseeable; but depicting the image of the flesh, I venerate it, and in faith I glorify the Virgin who gave birth unto the Lord.[^481]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* The luminous cloud, into which the Master of all descended as rain from heaven upon the fleece, and was incarnate for our sake, the Unoriginate becoming man: her do we all magnify as the pure Mother of our God.[^482]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Rejoice, O Mary, great wonder of all creation! Rejoice, daughter indeed of David, yet Mother of the Lord! Rejoice, song of Gabriel! Rejoice, refuge and confirmation, and help unto all sinners upon earth, O Most Holy One![^483]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In the divine Spirit, marvelous Joachim and divine Anna sing and raise a thanksgiving hymn, as seeing upon earth the Mother of the Creator, the daughter Mary whom they brought forth; by whose prayers do Thou save us all as God.[^484]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O most holy Virgin, Mother of God the Most High! Thy childbearing upon earth hath appeared as salvation unto sinners and the lowly; for through thee were we saved having believed. But do thou save me both now, and unto all the ages of my life.[^485]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* I know the Word to be incarnate, yet unchangeable; therefore I hymn Him faithfully, in two essences indeed, but in one Hypostasis. Truly proclaiming Him as God and man, I complete my song.[^486]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet: Trisagion, and the rest as usual, and the dismissal.*[^487]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *After the first stichology, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 1:*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Conceived in iniquities, I, the prodigal, dare not look up unto the height of heaven; but relying on Thy love for mankind, I cry aloud: O God, cleanse me, a sinner, and save me![^488]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* If the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall I appear, a sinner, who have not borne the burden and heat of the day? But number me with the laborers of the eleventh hour, O God, and save me![^489]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: Having acquired the Theotokos Mary as an unbreakable wall, come, ye faithful, let us fall down before her; for she hath boldness toward Him Who was born of her, to pray and deliver our souls from wrath and death.[^490]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *After the second stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1:*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: Hasten to open Fatherly embraces unto me; prodigally have I squandered my life, looking upon the inexhaustible wealth of Thy compassions, O Savior. Now despise not my impoverished heart, for in compunction I cry unto Thee, O Lord: Father, I have sinned against heaven and before Thee; save me![^491]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Beholding the wealth of Job's virtues, the enemy of the righteous plotted to dig through and steal, and he pulled down the bodily pillar, yet he stole not the spiritual treasure; for he found the soul of the blameless one armed; but me he stripped and took captive. Forestall him therefore before the end, deliver me from the deceitful one, O Savior, and save me![^492]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* As good soldiers, believing with one mind, ye feared not the threats of the tyrants, O holy ones. Ye came zealously unto Christ, taking up the precious Cross, and having finished your course, ye received victory from heaven. Glory to Him Who strengthened you! Glory to Him Who crowned you! Glory to Him Who works healings for all through you![^493]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: Thou didst forestall the despair of the Ninevites, averting the foretold rebuke, and Thy mercy overcame wrath, O Lord. Have compassion now upon Thy people and Thy flock; cast down our enemies with Thy mighty hand, through the prayers of the Theotokos granting us Thy mercy.[^494]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *After the third stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 1:*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* I have fallen among thieves through my thoughts, and have been robbed in mind; and they have wounded my soul with sins, and I lie unhealed, O most merciful Jesus. But pour out Thy mercy through the prayers of the Forerunner, and heal the grievous wounds of my soul.[^495]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* O John, who of old didst baptize with the streams of Jordan the Cleansing of the whole world: pull me back as I am submerged by many transgressions, and wash me from every defilement, ever entreating the Lover of mankind as an acceptable mediator.[^496]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: Leaping in his mother's womb, O Pure One, John recognized by divine grace God carried within thy womb, and faithfully worshipped. I beseech thee therefore, O Virgin: with the Forerunner entreat the Word Whom thou didst incarnate, to save thy servants.[^497]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Whose acrostic is: Receive, O Christ, the supplication of my words. A composition of Joseph.*[^498]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Tone 1. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Let us all sing a triumphant song unto God, Who hath wrought marvelous wonders with His high arm, and saved Israel; for He hath been glorified.[^499]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being enslaved by the passions of sin, I fall down before Thee, O Lord, that Thou mayest show me free from them, diligently glorifying Thy goodness.[^500]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I, wretched, have been wounded with the spear of sin and have died, and the enemy rejoices seeing me lying fallen. O Thou Who raisest up the dead, give me life and save me![^501]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs. Refrain: Holy Martyrs, pray to God for us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The choirs of the sufferers were glorified, having glorified with their honorable members Christ Who bore the flesh, and Who through His passions destroyed corruption.[^502]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* The glorious Martyrs, being pillars and ramparts of piety, remained unshaken by the assaults of the enemy. By their prayers, O God, have compassion on us all.[^503]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As a fiery throne, O Virgin, thou bearest the Creator; as an animate bridal chamber and beautiful palace, thou containest the King, Who became that which we are, without change or confusion.[^504]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Holy Great Prophet, Forerunner, and Baptist John.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Whose acrostic is: Hear the voice of those who cry unto thee, O Blessed One.*[^505]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Forerunner and Baptist of the Savior, John, pray to God for us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou wast the voice of the Word, O Blessed One! Therefore accept our voices which we raise unto thee, O Forerunner, delivering us from evils by thy mediation.[^506]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having shone forth like the dawn, like the sun, thou enlightenest the ends of the earth, and dost darken the deceitful spirits; therefore drive away the darkness from our souls.[^507]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou didst preach unto the dead that our Life was coming, O Forerunner! Therefore put to death the passions that slay me, and show me forth, O Blessed One, as a partaker of divine brightness.[^508]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having alone given birth in time unto the Timeless Son being incarnate, O most pure Lady...[^509]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Theotokion (continued):* ...heal the chronic passions of my all-wretched soul.

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner. This is the stone upon which Christ established the Church, which He redeemed from the nations.[^510]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Behold my weakness, O Thou Who didst clothe Thyself therewith! Behold the grievous deformity of my soul, and give ear unto my voice, O most merciful Christ, and transform this unseemliness into goodly beauty, O Savior![^511]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Save the prodigal, O Jesus! Save me who alone have transgressed Thy saving laws, and unreasonably committed every sin, and have been led away by thoughts that alienate me from Thee, O Good One![^512]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The ranks of the bodiless, O holy ones, truly marveled at your courage: how suffering gloriously at the judgment seat, though falling in body, ye cast down all bodiless foes by divine power![^513]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Still crimson with the blood of wounds, still bathed in drops of gore, O passion-bearers, ye stood rejoicing before the Lord, the immortal King, being crowned as victors![^514]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou givest birth unto Him Whom the Father begat before all ages; thou nourishest the Nourisher, knowing not the trial of man. Most glorious wonder, new mystery, O Full of Grace! Therefore every soul of the faithful glorifies thee.[^515]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], the Heirmos the same.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
