items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Sacredly budding forth from a barren and unbearing woman, O Forerunner, thou wast shown to be fruitful in divine deeds; therefore make my heart, which is utterly barren, fruitful in good things, that in faith I may ever glorify thee.[^516]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Strengthen my heart with the heavenly Bread, O Blessed One, which is weakened by wicked thoughts, and grant me zealously to fulfill the desires of the all-compassionate God, so that with steadfast faith I may ever praise thee.[^517]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou didst proclaim the Lamb Who takes away the sins of the world, O blessed Prophet! Lighten, I pray thee, the heavy burden of my sins, granting me compunction that cleanses the defilements of the passions.[^518]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:*[^519] The Word, coming forth from thee fully clothed in flesh, O Theotokos, clothed Himself with whole Adam. Him therefore entreat, O Theotokos, to deliver us from all manner of tribulations and from the everlasting fire.[^520]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Foreseeing in the Spirit the incarnation of the Word, O Prophet Habakkuk, thou didst proclaim, crying aloud: When the years draw near, Thou shalt be known; when the time is come, Thou shalt be shown forth. Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^521]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The wealth which Thou gavest me, O Christ, I squandered evilly, committing unseemly deeds, and I became naked, clothed in works of dishonor; therefore I cry unto Thee: Adorn me with the first robe, making me tender with divine grace.[^522]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I was brought low through folly, and fell grievously, and I lie upon the earth incurably ailing; raise me up, O Resurrection of the fallen, and establish my heart, O Christ, upon the rock of saving repentance.[^523]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Emulating Christ Who was lifted up upon the Cross, receiving wounds, the passion-bearers rejoiced together, and with the showers of their blood they stilled the rain-clouds of polytheism, pouring forth streams of healings.[^524]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having sailed dryshod through the vehemence of torments and the bitter surging, the divine sufferers, by the piloting of saving hope, hastened unto the supreme haven, filled with all joy.[^525]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The angelic hosts marveled beholding thee: how He Who is invisible of aspect became visible after our likeness from thee, O Virgin Parent of God! Him entreat to grant salvation unto all who in faith glorify thee.[^526]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], the Heirmos the same.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having woven for thyself a robe of salvation in bodily nakedness, O Baptist of the Lord: clothe me, I pray thee, who am stripped of every good deed, with the garment of righteousness and gladness.[^527]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Rain down upon me a drop of salvation, O Forerunner, who am wasting away through the scorching heat of lusts, thou who didst immerse in the streams of the Jordan Jesus the Giver of life, the Torrent of delight, that I may glorify thee as is meet.[^528]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Neither an Angel nor a mediator saved us, but the Lord Himself Who came upon earth, for Whom thou didst make straight the paths, O Blessed One! Entreat Him now to show me the pathway leading unto the kingdom.[^529]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou hast been shown forth as a sanctified temple of God, Who beyond understanding dwelt within thee, O Virgin; entreat Him to cleanse us from sinful defilements, that we may be shown forth as a temple and dwelling-place of the Divine Spirit.[^530]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Grant us Thy peace, O Son of God! For we know no other God beside Thee; we name Thy name, for Thou art the God of the living and of the dead.[^531]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I am filled with many and grievous fallings into sin, O Master compassionate and longsuffering! Have compassion on me, the condemned, and cast me not away from Thy presence.[^532]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst justify the publican who sighed, O Christ; imitating him, therefore, I beat upon my breast and cry unto Thee: Cleanse me, O Thou Who alone art tender-hearted and compassionate![^533]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thy saints, O Lord, were shown forth as unerring luminaries, driving away the deep night of deception, and enlightening the whole inhabited world with the brightness of wonders.[^534]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* As most precious stones, loving Thee, the living Stone, O Master, the Martyrs, rolled about by torments, cast down every structure of deception.[^535]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* In two wills, O All-immaculate One, thou didst bring forth One of the Most Holy Trinity, bearing one Hypostasis; Him diligently entreat, that we all may be saved.[^536]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], the Heirmos the same.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst settle in the wilderness, O Forerunner of Christ, even as Elijah of old; therefore establish my heart, which hath been desolated by transgressions, through divine diligence, O All-blessed One.[^537]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having become an immovable pillar and rampart of the faithful, O great Forerunner of Christ: show my thought, which is shaken by the wiles of the deceiver, to be immovable.[^538]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Unto the dead was the Light proclaimed, Which shone forth from Light upon earth, by thy voice, O Blessed One, and we who sit in darkness were enlightened...[^539]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (continued):* ...therefore enlighten me who am grievously darkened.

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* David proclaims thee as Queen, a Virgin pure, O Most Pure One; therefore I pray thee: Make me an heir of the heavenly kingdom, that I may call thee blessed.[^540]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Imitating the Prophet Jonah, I cry aloud: Deliver my life from corruption, O Good One, and save me, O Savior of the world, who cry: Glory to Thee![^541]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The bones of my wretched soul have been crushed, and I have become weakened by the weight of many pleasures; but help me, O Christ, sole Help of all![^542]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I have fallen into the deep of grievous things and the tempest of passions; I cry unto Thee, O all-powerful Christ: Lead me up with Thy mighty hand, and save me![^543]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The multitude of chosen ones by myriads, of holy passion-bearers, trampled underfoot myriads of noetic foes, and were united unto the myriads of heavenly minds.[^544]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having dried up the deep of godlessness, O sufferers, ye inherited the torrent of delight; therefore dry up the flood of my sin![^545]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Manifested as the tabernacle of consecration, O Mary: sanctify my wretched soul alone defiled by pleasures, and make me a partaker of divine glory.[^546]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], the Heirmos the same.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Baptist, who didst preach repentance upon earth: show me the paths of repentance guiding me unto the light, and deliver me from the abysses of deception.[^547]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Immersing the Abyss in river streams, dry up the abyss of my passions, granting me a fountain of tears, O Forerunner, preacher of Christ![^548]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* From spiritual infirmities, and bodily passions, life's adversities, and all manner of temptations and sorrows: save me, O Forerunner of the Lord![^549]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As the Mother of God and goodly among women, I pray thee diligently: Despise me not, O Pure One, but have compassion, and preserve me whole from all harm.[^550]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ бж҃е́ственнаѧ гора̀, ю҆́же ви́дѣ А҆ввако́мъ, добродѣ́телей...
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The fire touched not nor troubled Thy youths in the furnace, O Savior; then the three, as with one mouth, sang and blessed, saying: Blessed is the God of our fathers![^551]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: сы́й слове́сенъ. Сло́ве Бж҃їй, и҆́же
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Job was accustomed unto patience, and remained unmoved by all the assaults of the deceitful one, even as a valiant pillar. Emulate him always, O my soul, and despond not at all in calamities.[^552]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: и҆зво́листе и҆злїѧ́ти своѧ̂ кро́ви;
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I was vanquished by bodily pleasures, and became irrational, being endowed with reason. O Word of God, Who by a word didst save the harlot: save me, the wretched one, that I may sing, blessing Thy goodness.[^553]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: дрїи, въ не́йже ра́достнѡ Хрⷭ҇то́съ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Redeemed by the Blood of Him Who suffered in the flesh for our sake, O wise Martyrs, for Whose sake ye willingly resolved to pour out your blood: therefore ye reign with Him unceasingly.[^554]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: почи́лъ є҆́сть, є҆ди́нъ Цр҃ь и҆ Гдⷭ҇ь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* By the building up of sacred sufferings, ye were shown forth as a palace, O wise ones, wherein Christ hath joyfully made His rest, the one King and Lord, Who hath brought you unto heavenly mansions.[^555]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Out of all generations Christ chose thee alone for Himself, O All-praised One, as an honorable and pure dwelling place; and having shone forth from thee like the sun, He enlightened all the earth.[^556]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], the Heirmos the same.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having become the most eminent and glorious mediator between the Old and the New, O Baptist: intercede to renew me who am wholly grown old through sins, entreating Jesus, the Renewer of all things.[^557]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou wast shown forth upon earth legislating repentance, O Forerunner of Christ and Baptist! Strengthen all to accomplish it by thy prayers, that we may be delivered from immeasurable evils whereby we continually sin.[^558]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou hast trodden the narrow path, passing through all self-control, O wise servant, and by the breadth of radiant divine visions thou wast wholly illuminated; grant that we also may enjoy them, entreating Christ.[^559]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Triadikon:* As faithful, we glorify the Trinity in one nature: the unoriginate Father, and the Son, and the Spirit likewise; one reigning essence, one Lordship, one Principle, and the Life that quickens us.[^560]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Offer supplication unto God, O Most Pure One, that He may overlook our transgressions and countless sins, and deliver us from the tormenting eternal fire.[^561]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Him before Whom the Angels and all the hosts tremble as Creator and Lord: praise, ye priests; glorify, ye children; bless, ye people; and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^562]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The deceitful serpent by evil counsel hath made me naked of all virtues; clothe me now with the garment of virtues, O my Savior, Who didst lay bare the enemy's malice.[^563]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Coming to judge the human race in the dreadful hour, O Judge: send not me, who am condemned, into the fire of Gehenna, but have compassion and save me.[^564]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Neither tribulation, nor distress, nor sword, nor fire was able to separate you at all from the love of Christ, O all-lauded sufferers of the Lord, Who loved you on account of His tender-heartedness.[^565]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Wrestling in the flesh with the bodiless foe, ye cast him down, O valiant sufferers; and now ye join in choral dance with the bodiless hosts, healing the passions of souls and bodies.[^566]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Finding thee as a flower in the valleys of life, the Planter of all took up His dwelling within thee; with the fragrances of virtues and purity make us now sweet-smelling, O Mother of God.[^567]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos:* Him Who preserved the hymn-singing children in the furnace, and transformed the thundering flame of the furnace into dew: praise Christ God, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^568]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I alone have sinned more than all born on earth; I alone have become a transgressor of Thy laws, O Lord! Therefore for the sake of the Forerunner, have compassion and save me.[^569]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In character thou wast shown forth as an angel, O Baptist John, preaching the Angel of Great Counsel unto the ends of the earth; therefore we glorify thee with hymns unto all ages.[^570]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou wast unrighteously beheaded, O Blessed One, who didst immerse the head of Christ in the waters. Strengthen all of us by thy prayers to trample upon the truly ruinous head of the deceiver.[^571]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Deliver me from improper sins, and from burning torment, and from tormenting darkness, gnashing of teeth, and the worm, O Virgin, sole protectress of the human race.[^572]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* The luminous cloud, wherein the Master of all descended as rain from heaven upon the fleece, and was incarnate for our sake, the Unoriginate becoming man: her do we all magnify as the pure Mother of our God.[^573]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Behold, the time of repentance and pure labor; behold the day: do bright works; flee the darkness of passions; drive away the sleep of evil despondency, O my soul, that thou mayest be a partaker of divine light.[^574]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Like the publican I sigh, like the harlot I shed tears, and like the thief I cry unto Thee: Remember me, O Compassionate One! And like the prodigal son I call out: I have sinned! I fall down before Thee like the Canaanite woman: despise me not, O merciful Christ.[^575]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Unto bodily passions and spiritual afflictions ye were shown forth as truly physicians, having patiently given over your bodies unto wounds and unto violent death, O all-lauded sufferers of the Lord! Therefore ye are ever called blessed.[^576]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* More than the radiance of the sun did the patience of the all-wise passion-bearers of Christ shine forth; therefore by grace it visibly destroyed the prince of darkness, and dispersed the night of godlessness, and enlightened the hearts of the faithful.[^577]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* By the illuminating rays of the Word Who shone forth from thy holy womb, O Virgin Theotokos, and enlightened the ends of the earth: enlighten my soul, darkened by the blackness of pleasures and by the slothfulness of passions, that with faith I may sing of thee.[^578]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], the Heirmos the same.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Behold the lamp shining upon those who are in the darkness of life! Behold the sweetly speaking swallow, announcing spring unto all, Christ's great Forerunner, mediator between the Old and the New; by whose prayers may we be preserved evermore.[^579]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having a multitude of sins, I present thee now as an intercessor, as the friend of the Bridegroom, and cry unto thee, O Baptist: Grant me forgiveness of debts, O All-blessed One, and rekindle the lamp of my soul, utterly extinguished by slothfulness.[^580]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* With the bodiless Angels, with the sacred passion-bearers, and with the Prophets, O Forerunner: ever entreat the all-good God that we may obtain eternal good things, having been continually enriched with thee as a good defender...[^581]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O fair swallow, honorable nightingale, all-good dove, wilderness-loving turtledove, Baptist of the Lord, offshoot of the wilderness! Show my soul, desolated by unfruitfulness, to be fruitful in good things.[^582]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou bearest Him Who bears all things, even as the Cherubic Throne, and thou nourishest Him Who nourishes us; Him unceasingly entreat, O pure and joy-bestowed Lady, that thy flock may ever be delivered from earthquake, pestilence, captivity, and every distress.[^583]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet: and a bow. Small litany. Exapostilarion, and the usual psalms.*[^584]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 1:*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Another age awaits thee, O my soul, and the Judge is about to expose thy secret and grievous deeds. Abide not therefore in them, but forestall Him, crying unto the Judge: O God, cleanse me and save me![^585]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad; in all our days we were glad. For the days wherein Thou hast humbled us, for the years wherein we have seen evils. And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, and guide their sons [LXX Ps. 89:14-16].* [^586]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Despise me not, O my Savior, who am held fast by sinful slothfulness, but raise up my thought unto repentance, and show me to be an experienced laborer in Thy vineyard. Grant me the reward of the eleventh hour, and great mercy.[^587]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and prosper Thou the works of our hands upon us, yea, prosper Thou the work of our hands [LXX Ps. 89:17].* [^588]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* These soldiers of the great King opposed the commands of the tyrants; valiantly they were unconcerned about torments, and having trampled upon all delusion, they were worthily crowned, and they ask of the Savior peace for our souls, and great mercy.[^589]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: Thou alone, O Pure One, wast the dwelling place of the Light Who shone forth from the Father; therefore I cry unto thee: Enlighten with the light of virtues my soul, darkened by passions, and settle me in the mansions of thy brightness in the day of judgment, O Most Pure One.[^590]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Then: It is good to give thanks unto the Lord: Troparion, Litany, and Dismissal. Then the First Hour, and the usual psalms and the rest, and the final Dismissal.*[^591]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Stanza 1:* Through eating, the enemy led Adam out of Paradise; but through the Cross, Christ led the thief into it, who cried: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy kingdom![^592]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Stanza 2:* Sinning every day and transgressing Thy commandments, convert me, O God, and snatch me from torment, that I may glorify Thine ineffable compassion, O Lover of mankind.[^593]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Stanza 3:* Thou wast shown forth as a lamp, O Forerunner of God, going before the unwaning Light Who ineffably shone forth unto us from a radiant cloud; Him therefore entreat continually, to have compassion and save our souls.[^594]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Stanza 4:* Having endured intricate torments, O all-lauded Martyrs, ye were deemed worthy of the heavenly supernal good things; therefore ye are ever called blessed by all men.[^595]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Triadikon:* In three Persons we all know one Godhead, which is indivisible: the Son and the living Spirit together with the Father, unoriginate and unconfused, abiding for ever unto all ages.[^596]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^426]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: After giving birth, O Ever-Virgin, even as before childbirth, thou wast preserved pure, having given birth unto God in the flesh; Him entreat, O Most Pure One, to deliver us from carnal and spiritual passions, we pray thee.[^597]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 1:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Nailed unto the Cross, O Christ God, as a man, Thou didst deify human nature, and didst put to death the author of evil, the serpent; Thou didst deliver us from the curse of the tree, as Thou art tender-hearted, having become a curse and granting unto the world blessing and great mercy.[^599]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Being higher than all honor, O Master, Thou wast pleased to be dishonored, enduring reproachful death upon the tree, O Compassionate One, by reason whereof the human race hath found immortality and received its former life, when Thou didst die in the flesh, O Almighty One.[^600]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* O all-honorable Cross, cleansing of all the faithful, strength of kings: sanctify all who bow down before thee and glorify Christ, Who stretched forth His most pure hands upon thee by reason of His ineffable tender-heartedness, and gathered all the ends of the earth into one.[^601]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Theotokos, Tone 1:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Standing by the Cross of thy Son and God, and beholding His longsuffering, the pure Mother wept and said: Woe is me, my sweetest Child! Why dost Thou suffer these things unjustly, O Word of God, that Thou mayest save mankind?[^602]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Standing by the Cross, O unwedded Bride, and receiving wounds from sorrows, she cried aloud: Show me not to be childless, O my Child, who gave birth unto Thee, O Word of God! Leave me not alone, O Only-begotten, co-eternal with the Father![^603]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* When I gave birth unto Thee, I had no sorrows at all, and how do I now endure sorrows, when Thou art unjustly crucified, O Word? the weeping Virgin cried bitterly: Woe is me! I cannot bear to see Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Lover of mankind![^604]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: When of old thou didst behold thy Son and Master stretching forth His hands upon the Cross, and His ribs pierced with a spear, O pure Mother, sobbing thou didst cry aloud: Woe is me! How dost Thou suffer, Who takest away the sufferings of men, O Lover of mankind![^605]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Then: O Gladsome Light: After this, the Prokeimenon of the day. Vouchsafe, O Lord, to keep us this evening: And the Litany.*[^606]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 1:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* The Cross was planted on Calvary, and immortality blossomed forth for us from the ever-flowing fountain, the side of the Savior.[^607]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* An unbroken wall unto us is the precious Cross of the Savior; for placing our hope thereon, we all are saved.[^609]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O fair merchandise was yours, O holy ones! For ye gave your blood and inherited the heavens; and having been tried for a season, ye rejoice eternally. Truly fair was your merchandise! For having left corruptible things, ye received incorruptible things, and joining in choral dance with the Angels, ye unceasingly sing unto the consubstantial Trinity.[^611]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: When she beheld the Lamb lifted up upon the Cross, the blameless Virgin wept and cried aloud: My sweet Child! What is this new and most glorious vision? How art Thou, Who holdest all things in Thy fist, nailed in the flesh upon the tree?[^612]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Then: Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparion of the Saint, and the Dismissal.*[^613]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 1:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Thy victorious right hand hath in a manner becoming God been glorified in strength; for it, O Immortal One, being all-powerful, shattered the adversaries, fashioning a new path through the deep for the Israelites.[^614]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^615]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* He Who is incomprehensible unto the heavenly hosts, O all-blameless Maiden, took flesh from thy flesh, and renewed that which was corrupted by the first transgression.[^616]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With hymns let us, the faithful, call blessed the Mother of the Word of God beyond word; for she, the all-immaculate one, was shown forth as an adornment unto earthly beings, and hath become an advocate for all who sin.[^617]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou wast shown forth more spacious than the heavens, having contained the Creator of all things, O Mother Ever-Virgin; therefore I cry unto thee: Deliver me from every death-bearing straitness, O Lady full of divine joy.[^618]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: Grant us help, O Pure One, who are tempest-tossed by the tumult of afflictions; cast down the deceitful exaltations of our enemies, and grant salvation unto all who piously glorify thee.[^619]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou Who alone knowest the weakness of human nature, and didst mercifully take form therein: gird me with power from on high, that I may cry unto Thee: Holy is the living temple of Thine ineffable glory, O Lover of mankind![^620]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Full empties Himself for our sake, and the Unoriginate receives a beginning from thee, O all-blameless Virgin, and the Invisible is seen; and He Who nourishes all things is nourished with milk, providing for the renewal of men.[^621]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Heal our affliction, O unwedded Virgin, who gavest birth unto the Healer and Lord, Who by grace hath shown us the entrance unto life; Him unceasingly entreat to have compassion and save thy servants.[^622]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O thou who didst deify human nature beyond nature, O All-immaculate One: pray unto Him Who was born of thee, to grant forgiveness of our sins and eternal joy, O most holy and all-praised Virgin.[^623]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: Having spent my life in slothfulness, I fall down before thee, O Most Pure One: by thy continual prayers unto God, raise up my mind, and wholly enlighten me who am blackened, with the brightness of repentance, that with faith and love I may glorify thee.[^624]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Beholding thee with farsighted eyes as the mountain overshadowed by the grace of God, Habakkuk proclaimed that out of thee should come forth the Holy One of Israel, for our salvation and renewal.[^625]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* We know thee as the divine palace of the Word, wherein taking up His dwelling in the flesh, He renewed us who were corrupted by passions; therefore, O Pure One, we honor thee as the Mother of God, and we glorify Him Who was born of thee.[^626]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The incarnate Word took up His dwelling within thy womb, O Virgin, and drove away the curse which had formerly entered into human nature, and by His divine union deified it in a manner becoming God; therefore do we sing of thee.[^627]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Adam brought forth mortality, O All-immaculate One, from the time he tasted of the corruptible fruit; but now through thy childbearing he is made alive, and dwells in the mansions of Paradise; therefore as is our duty do we sing of thee.[^628]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: Thou didst stem the torrent of death, having given birth unto Christ God, the Fountain of immortality, O Pure One; Him therefore entreat, O woman full of divine grace, to heal the death-bearing passions of my soul, and to save me.[^629]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Thou Who by the radiance of Thy coming didst enlighten, O Christ, and by Thy Cross didst illumine the ends of the world: enlighten with the light of the knowledge of Thee the hearts of those who orthodoxly sing of Thee.[^630]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* From thy womb shone forth the unwaning Sun, O All-immaculate One, and utterly destroyed the darkness, and made the earth radiant with divine understandings; therefore with faith do we sing of thee.[^631]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Rejoice! we cry unto thee with the angelic voice, O Most Pure One! For thou gavest birth unto the Angel of Great Counsel, co-unoriginate with the Father, Who became flesh, O Virgin, in order to save man.[^632]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The Lord, taking up His dwelling within thy womb, O Pure One, hath delivered from the dominion of the enemy those who piously believe in Him; therefore with a loud voice do we all sing of thee, O Most Pure One.[^633]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: Having clothed Himself in me, the Master came forth from thee, O All-immaculate One, and deified corrupted nature; Him entreat, O Mother of God, to make me stripped of every sin.[^634]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* The lowest abyss hath encompassed us; there is none to deliver; we were accounted as sheep for the slaughter; save Thy people, O our God! for Thou art the strength of the weak and the restoration.[^635]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Without seed didst thou conceive God within thy womb, and after strange childbirth thou didst remain a Virgin, O All-immaculate One! Therefore with praises do we glorify thee, who through thee, O Most Pure One, were delivered from the curse.[^636]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The ladder which Jacob saw; the overshadowed mountain; the all-radiant cloud of divine light; the gate through which God alone passed: O blessed among women, thou art she, O All-immaculate One.[^637]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Apart from the laws of nature didst thou bring forth, O unwedded Virgin, the hypostatic Word of God Who heals our affliction; Him diligently entreat to save all of us.[^638]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: Bringing my soul which is sick with transgressions, I cry unto thee, O all-holy, most glorious, and pure one: heal and save me by thine intercession, that I may sing of and magnify thy protection.[^639]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Lord, have mercy (40 times). Glory... Both now...*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: Possessing thy protection, O Most Pure One, and by thy prayers being delivered from calamities, guarded everywhere by the Cross of thy Son...[^640]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn (continued):* ...as is our duty we all piously magnify thee.[^641]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* We the faithful perceive thee, O Theotokos, as a spiritual furnace; for even as the Supremely Exalted One saved the three children, He renewed the world wholly within thy womb, the praised and supremely glorified God of our fathers.[^642]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The shadows of the Law and the foreshadowings of the divinely speaking Prophets clearly preannounced thy seedless childbearing, O Most Pure and All-immaculate One! Singing whereof, we praise the hymned and supremely glorified God of our fathers.[^643]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou gavest birth unto the Dayspring of the sun, O pure woman full of divine grace, Who enlightens the fulness of all the faithful and hath brought to naught the night of impiety; therefore we honor the hymned and supremely glorified God of our fathers.[^644]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The unburned bush of old, O All-immaculate One, prefigured thy womb; for the fire of the Godhead consumed thee not at all. Therefore I pray thee: Deliver me from the unquenchable fire, that unceasingly, O Pure One, I may sing of thy marvelous deeds.[^645]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: O Mother of God, help of the faithful, cleansing of sinners, dispenser of all good things: receive me in thy merciful tender-heartedness, as I fall down and come unto thee with weeping, asking forgiveness of my sins.[^646]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* In the furnace the children of Israel, as in a crucible, shone purer than gold with the beauty of piety, saying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^647]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The types of the Law and the foreshadowings of old clearly predicted thee, O Virgin, as the pure Mother of the Lord; and we, now seeing the fulfillment of realities, sing of thee in harmony, and glorify thee unto all ages.[^648]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Adorned with divine beauties, having given birth without separation in beauty unto the Word of God, O All-immaculate One, Who with divine splendors illuminates the hearts of all who in faith sing of Him unto all ages.[^649]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* With sacred voices from afar the Prophets told that thou shouldest be the Mother, O All-immaculate One, unto the Master God; unto Whom we all cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^650]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а а҆́бїе, є҆ди́но црⷭ҇твꙋю-
items.english_text: How fair, how all-good art thou, O Virgin, having given birth unto Him Who is fair in beauty...[^651]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: па́че вины̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇та̀, є҆мꙋ́же всѝ зове́мъ: бл҃гослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇а, по́йте и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: ...beyond cause didst give birth unto Christ, unto Whom we all cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^652]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆́бразъ чи́стагѡ рождества̀ твоегѡ̀, ѻ҆гнепали́маѧ кꙋпина̀ показа̀ непа́лнаѧ; и҆ ны́нѣ на на́съ напа́стей свирѣ́пѣющꙋю ꙋ҆гаси́ти, мо́лимсѧ, пе́щь, да тѧ̀ Бцⷣе непреста́ннѡ велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* The burning bush showed forth unburned a figure of thy pure childbearing; and now we pray thee to quench the furnace of temptations raging against us, that unceasingly, O Theotokos, we may magnify thee.[^653]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆стество̀ є҆́же пре́жде ѻ҆сꙋжде́нное земны́хъ Дв҃о, преесте́ственнымъ твои́мъ бж҃ественнымъ ржⷭ҇тво́мъ безсме́ртіе ꙋ҆лꙋчѝ, и҆ добро́тꙋ пре́жнюю воспріѧ́тъ, пою́щее тѧ̀ согла́снѡ, ра́достными пѣ́сньми.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The nature of earthly beings, which formerly was condemned, O Virgin, through thy supernatural and divine childbirth hath obtained immortality, and received its former beauty, singing unto thee in harmony with joyous songs.[^654]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Но́сиши всѧ̑ носѧ́щаго, и҆ млеко́мъ пита́еши, всѣ̑мъ пи́щꙋ даю́щаго. Ве́ліе и҆ стра́шно, є҆́же па́че ꙋ҆ма̀ твоѐ та́инство, ковче́же честна́гѡ сщ҃е́нства Дв҃о Бцⷣе! тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѝ ꙋ҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou bearest Him Who bears all things, and with milk dost nourish Him Who gives food unto all. Great and dread is thy mystery which is beyond understanding, O ark of venerable consecration, O Virgin Theotokos! Therefore do we all call thee blessed.[^655]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тъ мнѣ̀ лежа́щꙋ, Пречи́стаѧ, въ лѣ́ности тьмы̀, ны́нѣ возсіѧ́й ѻ҆слѣплѧ́ющїа мнѣ̀ по́мыслы страсте́й рѣша́щи, и҆ ми́ръ глꙋбо́къ Всенепоро́чнаѧ, при́снѡ содѣва́ющи въ дꙋшы̀ мое́й, сла́вити тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Unto me who lie in the darkness of slothfulness, O Most Pure One, cause light now to dawn, untying the thoughts of passions that blind me, and continually working deep peace within my soul, O All-immaculate One, that I may glorify thee.[^656]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Страшꙋ́сѧ сꙋди́ща неꙋмы́тнагѡ, и҆ сꙋдїѝ незабве́ннагѡ, Всенепоро́чнаѧ; и҆́мамъ бо мно́жество согрѣше́нїй безчи́сленное, въ лѣ́ности жи́въ всестра́стный; тѣ́мже мѧ̀ Бцⷣе, ꙋ҆ще́дривши поми́лꙋй.
items.english_text: I am afraid of the unbribable judgment-seat and the unforgetting Judge, O All-immaculate One; for I have an unnumbered multitude of transgressions, having lived in slothfulness, all-passionate as I am; therefore, O Theotokos, take pity on me and have mercy.[^657]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Та́же: Досто́йно є҆́сть: и҆ покло́нъ. Трⷭ҇то́е, и҆ по Ѻ҆́тче на́шъ: Тропарѝ, и҆ про́чее ѻ҆бы́чное, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ.
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet: and a prostration. Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparia, and the rest as usual, and the Dismissal.*[^658]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Распе́ншꙋсѧ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, поги́бе мꙋчи́тельство, и҆ попра́на бы́сть си́ла вра́жїа; ниже́ бо А҆́гг҃лъ, ни человѣ́къ, но ты̀ са́мъ Гдⷭ҇и спа́слъ є҆сѝ на́съ; сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 1:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Возноси́те Гдⷭ҇а Бг҃а на́шего, и҆ покланѧ́йтесѧ подно́жїю нѡ́гъ є҆гѡ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ свѧ́то є҆́сть.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* When Thou wast crucified, O Christ, the tyranny perished, and the power of the enemy was trampled underfoot; for neither an Angel nor a man, but Thou Thyself, O Lord, hast saved us: glory to Thee![^659]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* We worship the wood of Thy Cross, O Lover of mankind, for upon it Thou wast nailed, O Life of all; and Thou didst open Paradise, O Savior, unto the thief who came unto Thee in faith, and didst make him worthy of delights who confessed Thee: Remember me, O Lord! Receive even as that one...[^661]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: ...also us who cry: We all have sinned; in Thy tender-heartedness despise us not![^662]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: Beholding the Lamb upon the Cross crucified between two thieves, O longsuffering Word, and pierced in the ribs with a spear, the Ewe-lamb exclaimed, crying aloud with maternal love: What is this strange and terrible mystery, O my Jesus, ineffably accomplished? How art Thou covered by a tomb, O uncircumscribable God? Leave me not who gave birth unto Thee, O my sweetest Son![^663]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 1:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Save, O Lord, Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance, granting victories unto our right-believing Emperor over adversaries, and preserving Thy commonwealth by Thy Cross.[^664]

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* The weapon of the Cross in battles appeared of old unto the pious King Constantine as an invincible victory over enemies by reason of faith; before this the adversary powers tremble; this hath become salvation unto the faithful, and the boast of Paul.[^666]

items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* By the sufferings of the Saints, which they endured for Thy sake, be Thou implored, O Lord, and heal all our sicknesses, O Lover of mankind, we pray Thee.[^668]

items.english_text: O marvelous new wonder! O dread mystery! exclaimed the Ewe-lamb and undefiled Maiden, when she beheld the Lord stretched out upon the tree: How is He Who holds all things in His fist condemned as one condemned?[^669]

items.english_text: *After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 1:*

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* When the sun beheld Thee, O Word, hung upon the tree of the Cross in the flesh voluntarily for the tender-heartedness of Thy mercy, not enduring the audacity, it was darkened. Therefore illumine my darkened soul with Thine unapproachable light, and save me, I pray.[^670]

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Having stretched forth Thy palms upon the Cross, O Compassionate One, Thou didst gather the nations that were far from Thee to glorify Thy great goodness; but look down upon Thine inheritance, and cast down those who make war against us, by Thy precious Cross.[^671]

items.english_text: Beholding the Lamb and Shepherd hung dead upon the tree, the undefiled Ewe-lamb weeping uttered with maternal love...[^672]

items.english_text: ...exclaiming: How shall I endure Thine ineffable condescension, O my Son, and Thy voluntary sufferings, O all-good God?[^673]

items.english_text: *Canon to the Precious and Life-Giving Cross, whereof the Acrostic is: By the Cross I am saved, of the Master Who suffered. (A composition of Joseph).*[^674]

items.english_text: *Tone 1. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Delivered from bitter slavery, Israel traversed the impassable deep as dry land; and beholding the enemy drowned, it sang a song unto God as Benefactor, Who works wonders with an high arm, for He hath been glorified.[^675]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Lifted up upon the Cross, O Christ, Thou didst raise up fallen man with Thyself, and didst cast down all the power of the enemy, O Word. Therefore do I hymn Thy sufferings, of Thee Who didst suffer and deliver me from passions.[^677]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Being the Lord of glory, Who didst crown man with glory, Thou wast crowned with thorns, that Thou mightest make our thorn-bearing nature fruitful, O Planter of divine deeds.[^678]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]

items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The all-holy assembly of the Saints, having suffered lawfully, hath sanctified all creation with the streams of holy blood, and in God the Father hath destroyed the foul sacrifices offered unto demons.[^679]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* The clouds of torments hid not your patient struggles, O all-holy Martyrs; therefore, more than the rays of the sun did ye appear glorious, clearly flashing forth the beams of salvation.[^680]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]

items.english_text: The Most Pure One was consumed by the sword of the passions of her Son, when she beheld Him pierced with a spear, cutting off the weapon that barred the way into Paradise and permitted not the divine entrance unto the faithful.[^681]

items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Most Holy Theotokos.*

items.english_text: *Tone 1. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Thy victorious right hand hath in a manner becoming God been glorified in strength; for it, O Immortal One, being all-powerful, shattered the adversaries, fashioning a new path through the deep for the Israelites.[^682]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]

items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^683]

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Grant me a stream of tears from the soul, O All-immaculate One, who didst give birth unto the Fountain of forgiveness, washing away the filth of sin, and conducting my life in humility.[^684]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Higher than creation didst thou become, O Pure Virgin, having incarnated God; therefore I pray thee: From the corruption of passions raise up...[^685]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: ...my soul, and lead me up unto the divine height of dispassion.[^686]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Show thyself merciful unto me, O Pure One, on the Day of Judgment, I pray thee, delivering me from all dread standing and cruel torment, who flee under thy protection, O most pure Lady.[^687]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Held fast by the darkness of sin and fallen, O Most Pure One, raise me up, granting me a shower of tears wherewith I may wash away my foul deeds; for thee alone do we have as protectress, O Theotokos.[^688]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Let not the mortal man boast in his wisdom and riches, but in the faith of the Lord, orthodoxly crying unto Christ God, and singing continually: Upon the rock of Thy commandments establish me, O Master.[^689]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The lawless dug into Thy hands and feet, O my Jesus, Who with Thine ineffable palm didst first fashion man, O Christ God, and by Thy Passion didst deliver all from passions and corruption.[^691]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Let the moon and the sun stand still, cried Joshua, prefiguring the darkening of the luminaries when the Master suffered in the flesh upon the Cross, whereby the evil principalities of darkness were put to shame.[^692]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The glorious Martyrs zealously endured wounds, and being wounded, they mightily wounded the serpent Belial. Therefore do they continually heal the wounds of our souls by divine command.[^693]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Ye tore down the demonic shrines and temples, O Martyrs; and by sufferings and courage ye most gloriously erected yourselves through grace as temples capable of containing the Father.[^694]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: At the hour of the passions, beholding Him Who is fair in beauty having neither form nor comeliness, O Virgin, bitterly didst thou weep, O Pure One, exclaiming: Woe is me! How dost Thou suffer, O Son, Who desirest to deliver all from passions?[^695]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* Thou Who alone knowest the weakness of human nature, and didst mercifully take form therein: gird me with power from on high, that I may cry unto Thee: Holy is the living temple of Thine ineffable glory, O Lover of mankind![^696]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou wast a temple, O Most Pure One, of Him Who reigns over all: me who have become a den of soul-corrupting robbers, snatch from their...[^697]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: ...maltreatment, and show me forth as a pure dwelling of the Holy Spirit. (Twice)[^698]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Send me a shower of tears, drying up the streams of my evil deeds, I pray thee, who didst give birth unto the most tranquil abyss of tender compassion, Christ our God, O all-hymned Virgin Theotokos.[^699]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Be Thou our strength and an unshakable pillar, O woman full of divine grace, and a shield and invincible weapon, driving far from us the hosts of noetic enemies, O most pure Theotokos, who honor thee with faith and love.[^700]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Of old the Prophet Habakkuk heard Thy marvelous report, O Christ, and with fear he cried: God shall come from Theman, and the Holy One from the mountain overshadowed, to save Thine anointed. Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^701]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Wounds and stripes didst Thou endure, O Christ, healing the wounds of my heart; tasting bitter gall, Thou didst take away the harm of the sweet, corrupting taste; and nailed upon the tree, Thou didst destroy the ancient curse.[^702]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross, Thou didst draw nigh the nations that were cast far from Thee; and Thou didst reconcile us unto the Father, O Longsuffering One, placing Thyself in the midst as Mediator; and in the midst of the earth Thou didst endure reproachful suffering.[^703]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* In the sea of your blood, O divinely blessed ones, the noetic Pharaoh falling with all his hosts was mystically drowned. Therefore with joy, having been saved, ye came unto the promised land, and became citizens of heaven.[^704]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Strengthened by the Passion of Christ, the blessed ones had power to receive diverse sufferings in their venerable flesh; therefore they appease the passions of both souls and bodies of those who praise them and ever call them blessed.[^705]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: Beholding Thine unjust slaying, she who gave birth unto Thee, O Christ, sobbing cried aloud unto Thee: O righteous Judge and Son! How art Thou unjustly condemned, desiring to justify those condemned of old by transgression, who slid into corruption?[^706]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* Perceiving thee with farsighted eyes as the mountain overshadowed by the grace of God, Habakkuk proclaimed that out of thee should come forth the Holy One of Israel, for our salvation and renewal.[^707]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Me who am grievously drawn away from the commandments of God by demonic deceptions...[^708]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: ...despise not, O Good One! But have compassion, I pray thee, and show me to be higher than his deception, who flee, O Most Pure One, unto thy mercy. (Twice)[^709]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Thou Who alone art merciful, Christ God: by the prayers of her who gave birth unto Thee, have mercy on those who hope in Thee, and take pity, and guide us unto the light of Thy commandments, and make us worthy of eternal life.[^710]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Asleep unto death, and lying in the tomb of despair, O Most Pure One, bound with the irons of my transgressions: by thy vigilant prayer raise me up, and direct me unto repentance, I pray thee.[^711]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Make Thine unwaning light to dawn, O Christ, in the hearts of those who faithfully hymn Thee, granting us peace which surpasses understanding; that running from the night of ignorance unto the day by Thy light, we may give glory unto Thee, O Lover of mankind.[^712]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The sun, O Savior, was stripped of light, beholding Thee naked hanging upon the tree, Who didst suspend the earth upon the waters; and when the rocks perceived Thee lifted up, rock split upon rock through fear, and the foundations were shaken.[^713]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
