items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Lifted up upon the tree and fastened with nails, Thou didst stain Thy fingers with blood, O Longsuffering One! And pierced in the ribs with a spear, Thou didst heal the wound of Adam, which he received by listening to a rib and disobeying Him Who made him.[^714]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The multitude of the Martyrs appeared as Paradise, having in its midst the Tree of Life, Christ; for Whose sake having endured reproachful death with a valiant mind, by divine power they put to death the serpent that by eating had slain the first-created parents.[^715]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* With drops of blood, O sufferers of Christ, ye dried up the abyss of godlessness; and by divine outpourings of sacred wonders ye dam up the streams of passions of both souls and bodies; therefore as is meet are ye called blessed.[^716]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: The Undefiled One marveled, beholding Christ voluntarily lifted up upon the tree, and weeping she cried aloud: O my Son and God! having escaped pains in Thy birthgiving, now do I suffer pains, when Thou art unjustly crucified by the lawless.[^717]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* Thou Who didst enlighten with the radiance of Thy coming, O Christ, and didst illumine with Thy Cross...[^718]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: ...the ends of the world: enlighten with the light of the knowledge of Thee the hearts of those who orthodoxly sing of Thee.[^719]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Torrents of many transgressions rushed upon me and cast down the temple of my soul, O Most Pure One! But as thou art the restoration of the forefathers, O Theotokos, raise me up, thy servant. (Twice)[^720]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Sunk wretched into the mire of passions and drowned by the tempest of many transgressions: stretch forth thy hand, O Lady, and lead me up, and guide me unto the haven of repentance.[^721]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Grant me cleansing of the filth of the soul, and heal me of bodily sicknesses, I pray thee, and change me from the cruel despondency that grips me, by thine intercessions.[^722]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Wholly held fast by measureless passions, I have fallen down into the whale of evils; but lead me up out of corruption, O God, even as of old Thou didst Jonah, and by faith grant me dispassion, that with the voice of praise and the spirit of salvation I may sacrifice unto Thee.[^723]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Lifting up his hands on high, Moses prefigured Thy Passion, Who didst stretch forth Thy palms upon the tree and destroy the destructive dominion of the evil one; therefore knowing Thee as Deliverer and Savior, we sing unto Thee, O Lover of mankind.[^724]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst endure death when lifted up upon the tree, and didst put to death our slayer, and didst make alive the creation of Thy hands, O Christ; and pierced in the ribs with a spear, Thou didst pour forth two rivers of forgiveness, Who art praised in two wills.[^725]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Precious in the sight of the Lord is your death now become, O Saints, who honored all by your honorable sufferings, and put to shame the dishonorable Belial, who plotted by all assaults of torments to cast you all down.[^726]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having with all your soul turned away unto diverse torments, O all-wise ones, ye found all-availing help from Him Who clothed Himself in all humanity; therefore, when cut limb from limb and brought nigh unto the fire, ye rejoiced.[^727]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: Beholding Thy Crucifixion, the Most Pure One cried aloud: O Son, what is this strange vision that is seen? Thou Who healest the sufferings of the sick, how dost Thou endure new suffering, O Christ? What have Thine enemies rendered unto Thee...[^728]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: ...O Benefactor, in return for the benefits they received?[^729]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* The lowest abyss hath encompassed us; there is none to deliver; we were accounted as sheep for the slaughter. Save Thy people, O our God! for Thou art the strength of the weak and the restoration.[^730]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Tear up the handwriting of my transgressions, O Most Pure One, with the spear of Him Who was born from thy seedless womb, and deem me worthy to be written in the book of the elect, who flee unto thy divine protection. (Twice)[^731]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Cleanse Thy servants, O Christ, by the prayers of her who gave birth unto Thee, and send down forgiveness of transgressions, as Thou alone art good; for Thou art the Savior and Deliverer of all who hope in Thee.[^732]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Me who am slain by passions, O most pure Virgin, who didst give birth unto the Giver of life, make me alive now by thy prayers, and show me to be victor over the evil enemy; for thee alone do we have as our helper before God.[^733]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* They traversed as a bridal chamber the unbearable furnace-flame, the holy children who of old clearly appeared for piety's sake, and singing in harmony they sang the hymn: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^734]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being Master, Thou didst receive a blow from a servant, O my Jesus, desiring to deliver me who was enslaved to the enemy; and nailed upon the Cross, Thou savest me who sing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^735]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* All creation was shaken when Thou wast crucified, O tender-hearted Lord! When Thou wast pierced with a spear, the enemy received a mortal wound in all his body, and wounded Adam was healed, crying: Blessed is the God of our fathers![^736]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Shielded by the Cross, the glorious army of passion-bearers destroyed the hostile regiments by grace, and received crowns of victory, crying: Blessed is the God of our fathers![^737]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having acquired a resolve stronger than fire, O sufferers, ye were not burned when brought into the fire; but ye burned up the evil substance of impiety, crying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^738]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: Thy childbearing, O Virgin, most gloriously brought forth the Creator of the ages; and lifted up upon the Cross, He raised up the fallen with Himself, and showed them forth as heavenly citizens, who...[^739]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: ...cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^740]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* We the faithful perceive thee, O Theotokos, as a spiritual furnace; for even as the Supremely Exalted One saved the three children, He wholly renewed the world within thy womb, the praised and supremely glorified God of our fathers.[^741]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having given birth unto the Fountain of life, O Most Pure One, raise up my dead soul with thy life-bearing right hand, and vouchsafe me to cry in contrition of my heart: O praised God of our fathers, blessed art Thou! (Twice)[^742]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* He Who is God before the ages was pleased to become the New Adam from thy pure blood. Him now entreat to renew me who am grown old, as I cry: O praised God of our fathers, blessed art Thou![^743]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: Coming by way of wrath, the enemy mercilessly desires to snatch away my humble soul. Destroy his counsels, O Most Pure One, and take pity on me who sing: O praised God of our fathers, blessed art Thou![^744]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The dew-bearing furnace showed forth of old a figure of supernatural wonder; for the fire burned not the young children, manifesting Christ's seedless and divine childbirth from the Virgin. Therefore, hymning let us sing: Let all creation bless the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^745]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou wast crucified upon the Cross voluntarily, Who by Thy nod didst stretch out the heaven; and Thou wast fastened with nails, desiring to bring to naught the passionate lapse of Adam, the first-created. Therefore, hymning we sing: Let every creature bless the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^746]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When the stony-hearted assembly lifted Thee up upon the rock, the mountains were shaken and the earth trembled, O Word of God, and wavering souls were established unto divine life, ever crying: Let every creature bless the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^747]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The holy passion-bearers clearly wove for themselves a saving garment, patiently suffering in bodily nakedness and receiving the rubbing of salt into their wounds. Therefore, hymning they sing: Let every creature bless the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^748]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Scraped unmercifully with claws, the passion-bearers, and mercilessly...[^749]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: ...cut limb from limb, and partaking of all manner of wounds, sacrificed not unto carved idols; but they appeared as pillars of courage unto the faithful, crying: Bless Christ, all ye works, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^750]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: When the foolish council that embittered Thee thought to take Thee away from the earth, she who knew not man cried aloud of old, beholding Thee lifted up upon the Cross: I am become childless and am troubled, and in heart I suffer pain with maternal love! Together with her creation glorifies Thee, the Deliverer of all, O Jesus, unto all ages.[^751]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* In the furnace the children of Israel, as in a crucible, shone purer than gold with the beauty of piety, saying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^752]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Enlighten the eyes of my heart, O Pure One, who art the door of light, dispersing the cloud of passions and the deep darkness, that I may sing: Praise the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages! (Twice)[^753]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Cease not to pray for all, O pure Lady, who call upon thee as the Mother of God, O all-immaculate Virgin, and who cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^754]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having ineffably given birth unto Christ, the Cause of salvation: entreat Him on behalf of all who earnestly cry, O all-hymned Virgin: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^755]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Then we sing the Canticle of the Theotokos: My soul doth magnify the Lord [Luke 1:46-55]: And prostrations.*[^756]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Ineffable is the Virgin's mystery: for she hath been shown forth as heaven, the Cherubic Throne, and the light-bearing bridal chamber of Christ God the Almighty. Her do we piously magnify as Theotokos.[^757]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* When of old the wise thief beheld Thee, O Savior, hung upon the tree, Who didst suspend the earth upon the measureless waters, he faithfully cried unto Thee: Remember me! With whom we piously glorify Thy sufferings.[^758]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When crucified Thou didst shake the foundations of the earth; and when pierced with a spear Thou dost pour forth immortal drops, blood and water: wherewith Thou hast cleansed humanity from passions, O Jesus! Therefore hymning Thee do we magnify.[^759]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ дре́вꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ Человѣколю́бче, ꙗ҆́кѡ на не́мъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ животѐ всѣ́хъ, и҆ ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, вѣ́рою прише́дшемꙋ къ тебѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆ пи́щи сподо́билъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́дающаго тѧ̀: помани́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и. Прїимѝ ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́наго...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The Saints rejoiced in their torments, inciting themselves...[^760]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: на сла́дость до́блїи: ста́нѣмъ (вопїю́ще), сѐ ѿве́рзесѧ по́прище, Хрⷭ҇то́съ вѣнцы̀ ны́нѣ подае́тъ тѣ̑мъ, и҆́хже возлюбѝ.
items.english_text: ...unto sweetness, the noble ones, exclaiming: Let us stand, lo, the race-course is opened, Christ now bestows crowns upon those whom He hath loved![^761]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣща́етсѧ всѧ́ко вѣ́рныхъ є҆ди́нственное торжество̀, страда̑нїа почита́ющее всѣ́хъ непобѣди́мыхъ мꙋ́ченикъ, и҆ тмы̑ болѣ́зней; и҆́хъ же ра́ди неболѣ́зненныѧ сподо́бишасѧ сла́дости и҆ жи́зни, и҆ присносꙋ́щнагѡ наслажде́нїа.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Every singular triumph of the faithful is enlightened, honoring the sufferings of all the invincible Martyrs and the multitude of afflictions; for the sake whereof they were vouchsafed painless sweetness and life, and everlasting enjoyment.[^762]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣколю́бца Сло́ва неизрече́ннѡ поро́ждшаѧ, зрѧ́щи ѻ҆трокови́ца ѿ человѣ̑къ во́лею стра́ждꙋща, что̀ сїѐ? вопїа́ше: Бг҃ъ безстра́стенъ стра́сть прїе́млетъ, ꙗ҆́ко да ѿ страсте́й и҆зба́витъ вѣ́рою покланѧ́ющихсѧ є҆мꙋ̀.
items.english_text: Beholding Him Who is beyond cause, the Lover of mankind, the Word, willingly suffering from men, the Maiden exclaimed: What is this? God Who is impassible accepts passion, that He may deliver from passions those who worship Him in faith.[^763]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆́бразъ чи́стагѡ рождества̀ твоегѡ̀, ѻ҆гнепали́маѧ кꙋпина̀ показа̀ непа́лнаѧ; и҆ ны́нѣ на на́съ напа́стей свирѣ́пѣющꙋю ꙋ҆гаси́ти, мо́лимсѧ, пе́щь, да тѧ̀ Бцⷣе непреста́ннѡ велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* The burning bush showed forth unburned a figure of thy pure childbearing; and now we pray thee to quench the furnace of temptations raging against us, that unceasingly, O Theotokos, we may magnify thee.[^764]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Возмѝ та́жкое бре́мѧ мои́хъ согрѣше́нїй, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ, и҆ легча́йшее и҆́го Сн҃а и҆ Бг҃а твоегѡ̀ сподо́би мѧ̀ носи́ти, и҆ по стезѝ ше́ствовати къ го́рнемꙋ соверше́нїю возводѧ́щей. Два́жды.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Take away the heavy burden of my transgressions, O All-praised Theotokos, and vouchsafe me to bear the most light yoke of Thy Son and God, and to journey along the path leading up unto heavenly perfection. (Twice)[^765]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Трепе́щꙋ помышлѧ́ѧ, Всенепоро́чнаѧ, стра́шный де́нь прише́ствїа Хрⷭ҇то́ва; всѧ́ бо жи́знь моѧ̀ въ грѣсѣ́хъ сконча́сѧ, и҆ страсте́й дꙋша̀ моѧ̀ и҆спо́лнисѧ; но ꙋ҆ще́дри мѧ̀, и҆ всѧ́кагѡ и҆зба́ви тогда̀ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїа.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I tremble when considering, O All-immaculate One, the dread Day of Christ's coming; for all my life hath been spent in sins, and my soul is filled with passions; but take pity on me, and deliver me then from all condemnation.[^766]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Прїимѝ пречи́стаѧ Влⷣчце, непотре́бнагѡ раба̀ твоегѡ̀ моле́нїа, и҆ дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ и҆ тѣ́ла смꙋще́нїе въ глꙋбо́кꙋю тишинꙋ̀ преложѝ, ꙗ҆́ко да тѧ̀ велича́ю спаса́емь.
items.english_text: Receive, O Most Pure Lady, the supplication of thine unprofitable servant, and turn the turmoil of my soul and body into deep tranquility, that saved I may magnify thee.[^767]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Та́же: Досто́йно є҆́сть: и҆ покло́нъ, є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, и҆ свѣти́ленъ. Та́же ѱалмѝ ѻ҆бы́чнїи.
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet: and a prostration, the Small Litany, and the Exapostilarion. Then the customary Psalms.*[^768]`

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ на дре́вѣ пригво́ждшагосѧ пло́тїю, и҆ живо́тъ на́мъ пода́вшаго, ꙗ҆́кѡ Сп҃са и҆ Влⷣкꙋ пое́мъ непреста́ннѡ.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 1:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Твои́мъ крⷭ҇то́мъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, є҆ди́но ста́до бы́сть А҆́гг҃лѡвъ и҆ чл҃вѣ́кѡвъ, и҆ въ є҆ди́номъ собо́рѣ нб҃о и҆ землѧ̀ весели́тсѧ, вопїѧ̀: Гдⷭ҇и, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Unto Thee Who wast nailed upon the tree in the flesh, and didst grant us life, as Savior and Master do we sing unceasingly.[^769]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* By Thy Cross, O Christ, there became one flock of Angels and men, and in one assembly heaven and earth rejoice, crying: Lord, glory to Thee![^770]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Neither affliction, nor distress, nor famine, nor persecution, nor wounds, nor the fury...[^771]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: ...of beasts, nor sword, nor fire threatening to sever you from God could prevail against you, O all-praised Martyrs; but rather through love toward Him, striving as in alien bodies, ye forgot nature, despising death; therefore worthily of your afflictions ye received the reward, and became heirs of the Heavenly Kingdom. Pray unceasingly for our souls.[^772]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: Standing beside Thy Cross, O Word of God, the Ewe-lamb and Thine undefiled Mother, lamenting cried aloud: How art Thou dying upon the Cross, O my Son? Woe is me, my sweet Light! Whither hath the vision of Thy beauty now set, Who art fairer than all the sons of men?[^773]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Then: It is good to give praise: and the Trisagion, and after Our Father: the Troparion, the Litany, and the Dismissal. Then the First Hour, and the customary Psalms, and the final Dismissal.*[^774]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Through food the enemy led Adam out of Paradise, but by the Cross Christ led the thief back into it, who cried: Remember me, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom![^775]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst endure an ignominious Passion, O Christ, and didst take away all our reproach, O Good One, and didst make us partakers of the Kingdom on high, who worship Thy descent.[^776]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Covering the nakedness of Adam, O Christ, Thou wast stripped in the flesh; and lifted up upon the Cross, Thou didst lift us up out of the depth of evils. Therefore, O Word, we glorify Thy holy descent.[^777]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having wounded the multitude of demons by your holy wounds, O all-praised Martyrs, by grace ye always truly heal all human sores and wounds.[^778]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Triadikon:* The Trinity enlightens all who purely honor It and know It as possessing indestructible dominion; unto Whom let us cry: Save those who sing unto Thee with love, O Trinity![^779]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^598]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Standing beside the Cross and beholding Christ nailed in the flesh, the All-immaculate One exclaimed, crying aloud: Whither hath Thy truly ineffable beauty now set, O Compassionate One?[^780]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Apostles, Tone 1:*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Glorious Apostles, God-called disciples of Christ, teachers of the universe! Having found the Lord, Who is the Mediator between God and men, unto Him ye were joined in a manner becoming God; and Him as God and as all-perfect Man ye plainly proclaimed in the world.[^782]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* All-wise Apostles, God-called disciples of Christ, teachers of the universe! By your prayers strengthen me to attend unto divine teachings, and help me ever to walk along the narrow path, that I may attain unto the most spacious dwelling of Paradise.[^783]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* I hymn Peter the first-enthroned, Paul, James, Andrew, and Philip, Simon, Bartholomew, and Thomas, Matthew and John, Mark and Luke, who wrote the Good News: the God-chosen choir, with the other seventy, as eyewitnesses of the Word and His preachers.[^784]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Hierarch Nicholas, Tone 1:*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Flitting over the flowers of the Church like a fledgling of the celestial angelic nest, O thrice-blessed Nicholas, thou ever criest unto God for all people who are in dire misfortunes and temptations, and deliverest them by thy prayers.[^785]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Passing through celestial beauties, thou didst perceive that dread glory, the Holy of Holies. Therefore, O most sacred Father, thou ever revealest unto us heavenly words, visions of those living beings.[^786]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* By active virtues thou didst make the adornment of the sacred vestments most radiant, O God-bearing Father. Therefore, for Christ's sake thou also dost sacredly work for us marvelous and glorious wonders, delivering us from fierce evils.[^787]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: Tempest-tossed by the deep of transgressions, having fled unto the calm haven of thy pure prayer, O Theotokos, I cry unto thee: Save me, stretching forth thy strong right hand unto thy servant, O All-immaculate One![^788]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Then: O Gladsome Light: Prokeimenon of the day. Vouchsafe, O Lord:*[^789]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Apostles, Tone 1:*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* The all-harmonious apostolic lute, moved by the Holy Spirit, brought to naught the abominable sacrifices of the demons; and having proclaimed the one Lord, it delivered the nations from the deception of idols, and taught them to worship the consubstantial Trinity.[^790]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Let us praise Peter and Paul in unison, Luke, Matthew, Mark, John, Andrew, Simon the Canaanite, James, and Philip, and let us worthily praise the whole choir of disciples.[^791]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The earth hid you not, O all-praised Martyrs, but heaven received you, and the gates of Paradise were opened unto you, and being within, ye enjoy the Tree of Life. Pray unto Christ to grant our souls peace and great mercy.[^792]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: O Virgin Theotokos unwedded, who in the latter times didst give birth unto God, and after childbirth wast truly shown forth again as a pure Virgin: the throne, and gate, and mystical table, and radiant lampstand.[^793]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparion and Dismissal.*[^794]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 1.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Let us all sing a triumphant song unto God, Who hath wrought marvelous wonders with an high arm, and saved Israel; for He hath been glorified.[^795]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The burning bush prefigured thee, O Theotokos; for thou didst truly bear the unendurable Fire, remaining unconsumed. Therefore with faithful voices do we ever hymn thee.[^796]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having clothed Himself in man, God the Word was incarnate of thee beyond understanding, O Most Pure One. Therefore every breath glorifies thee, and worships thee, and duly honors thee.[^797]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou didst conceive, O Most Pure One, the ineffable Word Who contains all the ends of the earth, and didst give birth unto Him; Whom earnestly entreat to have mercy on us.[^798]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having given birth in time unto the incarnate, timeless God, Who alone is...[^799]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: ...O Most Pure Lady, heal the lifelong passions of my passionate soul.[^800]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Let my heart be established in Thy will, O Christ God, Who didst establish the second heaven above the waters, and didst found the earth upon the waters, O All-powerful One.[^801]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* That God might deify humanity, He became man from thee, O Pure Virgin, beyond word and understanding. Therefore in unison do we, the faithful, call thee blessed.[^802]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* He Who by nature is uncircumscribed, having become incarnate of thee, was circumscribed, O Maiden full of the grace of God! Pray unceasingly unto Him to take pity on and enlighten the souls of those who call thee blessed.[^803]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Drive away all the barrenness of my barren thought, and show forth my soul fruitful in virtues, O Most Holy Theotokos, helper of the faithful.[^804]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Deliver me, O All-immaculate One, from all misfortune, and from the many snares of the serpent, and from eternal fire and darkness, O thou who didst give birth unto the never-setting Light for us.[^805]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Foreseeing in the Spirit the incarnation of the Word, O Prophet Habakkuk, thou didst proclaim, crying: When the years draw near, Thou shalt be known; when the time is come, Thou shalt be shown forth! Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^806]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Christ took up His abode within thy most pure womb, O All-holy Lady, and deified us, having assumed an animate flesh. Therefore as pure Mother do we orthodoxly hymn thee, O Lady, helper of the world.[^807]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Holy Theotokos, sanctify us, who didst give birth in the flesh unto the Most Holy One, Who desired to be likened unto men; and by thy prayers, O Most Pure One, show all to be partakers of the Heavenly Kingdom.[^808]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Virgin Theotokos, undefiled tabernacle, cleanse me now who am defiled with transgressions, by the pure beams of thy mercies; and grant me a helping hand, that I may cry: Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^809]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast shown forth as a consecrated Church unto God, Who took up His abode within thee beyond understanding, O Virgin; entreat Him to cleanse the filth of our sins, that we may be shown forth as temples and dwellings of the Spirit.[^810]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Grant us Thy peace, O Son of God! For we know no other God beside Thee; we call upon Thy name, for Thou art the God of the living and of the dead.[^811]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The deceitful tasting in Eden made me dead of old; but having given birth unto Life, O Pure One, thou didst quicken him who of old was slain by the tree, that I may hymn thee with songs of praise.[^812]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Save me, O All-pure One, from fierce misfortunes, raise me up from festering passions, and deliver me from the captivity and malice of deceitful demons, who honor thee with love.[^813]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* We know thee as cloud and paradise, and door of light, table and fleece, and jar carrying the manna within, the sweetness of the world, O pure Virgin Mother.[^814]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having given birth, O All-immaculate One, unto God Emmanuel, Who plainly became man for tender mercy's sake: entreat Him, as Lover of mankind, O Pure One, to take pity on people who have sinned.[^815]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* As the Prophet Jonah, lead up my life from corruption, O Christ God, I cry unto Thee, O Lover of mankind; for with Thee is life, and incorruption, and power.[^816]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Defiled as I am with many sins, I pray thee, who art the good and undefiled tabernacle: Wash away all defilement by thy mediation.[^817]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Be thou pilot unto me, O Pure One, who am tossed on the fierce deep of worldly temptations, and guide me unto the saving haven, and save me.[^818]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Surges of thoughts, and assaults of passions, and the depth of sins tempest-toss my wretched soul. Help me, O holy Lady![^819]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Mary, who wast forenamed the tabernacle of sanctification, sanctify my wretched soul defiled by pleasures, and make me a partaker of divine glory.[^820]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Sessional Hymn, Tone 1:*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: O Virgin and nourisher of One of the Trinity, beautiful paradise, salvation of earthly beings: by thy protection save those who piously hymn thee; for thou didst give birth unto Him Who spoke through the Prophets, thou didst bear Him Who contains all things, as Mother of Christ God.[^821]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The fire touched not nor troubled Thy children in the furnace, O Savior; then the three, as with one mouth...[^822]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: ...sang and blessed, saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^823]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Son of the Unoriginate Father took up His abode within thy womb, taking a beginning, that as God He might deliver us from the deceitful rulers of darkness, O pure Theotokos, who worship Him.[^824]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Embroidered with divine virtues, O pure Virgin, thou didst give birth unto the Word co-unoriginate with the Father, Who truly covered the heavens with virtues; Whom unceasingly entreat to take pity on us.[^825]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Sanctify our thoughts, establish the souls of all, O Mother of God, that they may rightly perform the ordinances of the Word of the Unoriginate Father, Who was incarnate of thee for the sake of ineffable tender mercy, O Virgin.[^826]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Slain by many passions, O All-immaculate One, quicken my mind, and strengthen me to do what is well-pleasing unto God, that I may magnify thee as the constant protectress and hope of Christians.[^827]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Him at Whom the Angels and all the hosts are terrified as Creator and Lord: praise, ye priests; glorify, ye children; bless, ye peoples; and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^828]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* We are delivered from all manner of temptations, O All-immaculate One, by thy watchful prayers unto God, who know thee as the Theotokos, blessed and full of joy.[^829]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The Bodiless One is incarnate of thee in a manner becoming God; Whom entreat, O Most Pure One, to put to death the passions of my flesh, and to quicken my soul which hath been slain by sins.[^830]`

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having given birth unto the Savior and God, Who healed the crushing of earthly Adam, O Most Pure One: entreat Him to heal the incurably aching wounds of my soul.[^831]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Raise me up who lie in the depth of evils, and conquer the enemies who now war against me, consuming my soul with unlawful pleasures; despise me not, O Pure One, but take pity, and save me.[^832]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* The light-bearing cloud, whereinto the Master of all descended like rain from heaven upon the fleece, and was incarnate for our sake, becoming man, the Unoriginate One: all we magnify as the pure Mother of our God.[^833]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O All-immaculate One, who didst give birth unto the divine Light Which shone forth from the Father: take pity on my soul darkened by the deceits of life and become a laughing-stock...[^834]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: ...unto enemies, and vouchsafe me the light of saving repentance, O Pure One.[^835]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Isaiah beheld thee as a radiant cloud, O All-immaculate One, from whom the Sun of Righteousness, having shone forth upon us, mystically enlightened creation; therefore in faith do we hymn thee, who art fair among women.[^836]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Being sin-loving, I live in slothfulness, and tremble at the unbribable judgment-seat, O Pure One; whereat preserve me uncondemned by thy holy prayers, O Virgin Bride of God, that as protectress I may call thee blessed unceasingly.[^837]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* I tremble at the judgment-seat, O Virgin, and the unforgetting eye of Thy Son, having committed many sins upon earth; and therefore do I cry unto thee: All-merciful Lady, help me, and deliver me then uncondemned from distress, O Pure One.[^838]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet: Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparia and the rest as usual, and the Dismissal.*[^839]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Apostles, Tone 1:*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* All-wise fishers of the universe, who from God have received the gift of prayer! Pray even now for us who cry: O Lord, save Thy people and Thy city, and deliver our souls from the evils that beset us, for the sake of the Apostles.[^840]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* In hymns let us the faithful honor the sweet-voiced trumpets of Christ, the all-wise Apostles, the horses who troubled the sea of godlessness, and drew men as from the depth unto the divine haven of salvation, by the grace of the Spirit.[^842]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: Having conceived unburned the Fire of the Godhead, and without seed given birth unto the Lord, the Fountain of life, O joyful Theotokos: save those who magnify thee![^843]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 1:*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Having with the rod of the Cross cast down the rhetorical webs with a rational net, the fishermen enlightened the nations to glorify Thee piously as the true God. Therefore do we cry a hymn unto Thee Who didst strengthen them: Glory to the Father and to the Son, glory to the Con-...[^844]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: ...substantial Spirit; glory to Him Who through them hath enlightened the world![^845]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* The Light Which shone timelessly from Light, in time appeared in the flesh upon earth, and through you enlightened the world, O all-blessed ones. Therefore, all we being enlightened by your divine teachings, honor your sacred memory, O Apostles.[^847]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* All we pray unto the Martyrs of Christ, having come unto them with love and faith; for they ask for our salvation, they pour forth the grace of healings, they drive away the legions of demons, as guardians of the faith.[^849]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: The divine Disciples and Apostles, O Maiden, by divine teachings proclaimed unto all thy ineffable childbearing, O most pure Theotokos, worthily teaching us to worship thee. But we pray thee: With them entreat that those who honor thee in faith may be saved.[^850]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 1:*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Radiant luminaries, light-bearing Disciples of the Savior, like fire ye illuminated the fullness of all the earth by divine teachings. Therefore I pray: Enlighten my soul which is in darkness, with your light-bearing rays, O all-blessed ones.[^851]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Dwelling sensibly in Myra, O Hierarch, thou wast shown forth spiritually anointed as with myrrh by the Spirit, O Father Nicholas, and with the myrrh of thy wonders thou didst make all fragrant, pouring forth ever-flowing myrrh, by thy fragrant songs and by thy memory.[^852]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: The Prophets clearly foreannounced thee, O Maiden, as Mother of God, and the divine Apostles proclaimed it in the world, and we have believed. Therefore, all we honoring thee with pious mind do hymn thee, and truly name thee Theotokos unceasingly.[^853]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy Apostles, a composition of Theophanes, Tone 1.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Thy victorious right hand hath in a manner becoming God been glorified in strength; for it, O Immortal One, being all-powerful, shattered the adversaries, fashioning a new path through the deep for the Israelites.[^854]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Apostles, pray to God for us.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Enlightened by the divine beams of the Tri-sun radiance, O glorious ones, by adoption ye were truly called gods, O light-bearing Apostles! Therefore we worthily honor you in faith. (Twice)[^855]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having through faith become acceptable servants and fulfillers of all the commandments of the Word Who appeared on earth for tender mercy's sake in the grossness of the flesh...[^856]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: ...ye are unceasingly honored.[^857]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* With radiant rays of the Most Holy Spirit, O ever-blessed ones, enlighten me entirely, who am covered with the darkness of sins, and plainly guide me unto the path of repentance.[^858]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: O joy of the Apostles, O Theotokos, All-immaculate Lady, who didst become the Mother of Him Who spoke in them in a manner becoming God: with them pray that I may be delivered from the fire of Gehenna.[^859]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to our Father among the Saints Nicholas the Wonderworker, whereof the Acrostic is: Unto thee, Nicholas, I offer the first singing, I, Joseph. Tone 1.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Let us all sing a triumphant song unto God, Who hath wrought marvelous wonders with an high arm, and saved Israel; for He hath been glorified.[^860]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Adorned with righteous crowns, and standing before the throne of grace, O Nicholas: ever save by thy prayers those who now crown thee in faith with songs.[^861]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having received the grace of healings, O all-blessed Nicholas, heal the wounds of my soul by thy prayers, and deliver me from the temptations that assail me, I pray.[^862]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* By the power of thy prayer, O Nicholas, set aright my soul utterly paralyzed by transgressions, and deliver me from the bitter evils of life, I pray.[^863]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: Dispel the darkening of my mind, O All-immaculate One, with thy light; and deliver me from eternal darkness, that I may ever sing of thy great deeds.[^864]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Ode 3 [to the Apostles]. Heirmos:* Thou Who alone knowest the weakness of human nature, and in Thy mercy didst take form therein: gird me with power from on high, that I may cry unto Thee: Holy is the animate temple of Thine ineffable glory, O Lover of mankind![^865]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* He Who alone is the invisible God, becoming visible in incarnation, chose you as disciples throughout all the world, who proclaim His name and surpassing glory, O most blessed and divine Apostles! (Twice)[^866]`

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ, всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченици, ни ско́рбь, ни тѣснота̀, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́нїе, нижѐ ра̑ны, ни ꙗ҆́рость...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Against Thee alone have I sinned, O Christ, against Thee alone have I transgressed, and have defiled my soul with evils; cleanse and save me by Thy mercy, having praying unto Thee...[^867]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́не бл҃гопремѣни́телю І҆и҃се, премꙋ́дрыѧ А҆пⷭ҇лы твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: ...O Jesus Who alone art easily reconciled, Thy most wise Apostles.[^868]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Го́рести страсте́й и҆ помыслѡ́въ, и҆ всѧ́кагѡ грѣха̀ и҆зба́вите мѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ ми́лостивїи А҆пⷭ҇ли! и҆ покаѧ́нїемъ ѡ҆слади́те мою̀ мы́сль, ꙗ҆́кѡ бж҃е́ственною носѧ́ще сла́дость въ срⷣцы, всехва́льнїи.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Deliver me from the bitterness of passions and thoughts, and from every sin, as merciful Apostles! And sweeten my mind with repentance, as bearing divine sweetness in your hearts, O all-praised ones.[^869]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Съ невеще́ственными слꙋжи́тели, Дв҃о неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ, съ всѣ́ми вы́шними Си́лами, съ Мч҃еники и҆ А҆пⷭ҇лы, Хрⷭ҇та̀, є҆го́же воплоти́ла є҆сѝ ѿ чи́стыхъ крове́й твои́хъ, оу҆молѝ спасти́сѧ рабѡ́мъ твои̑мъ.
items.english_text: With the bodiless ministers, O Virgin unwedded, with all the Hosts on high, with the Martyrs and Apostles, entreat Christ Whom thou didst incarnate of thy pure blood, that His servants may be saved.[^870]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Да оу҆тверди́тсѧ срⷣце моѐ въ во́ли твое́й, Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, и҆́же надъ вода́ми не́бо оу҆тверди́вый второ́е, и҆ ѡ҆снова́вый на вода́хъ зе́млю, Всеси́льне.
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* Let my heart be established in Thy will, O Christ God, Who didst establish the second heaven above the waters, and didst found the earth upon the waters, O Almighty One.[^871]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Первосщ҃е́нникѡвъ оу҆добре́нїе, бл҃гоꙋха́нїе бж҃е́ственнагѡ Дх҃а, мѵрото́чными твои́ми моли́твами, ѕлосмра̑дныѧ стра̑сти ѿженѝ се́рдца моегѡ̀, Нїко́лае мꙋ́дре, любо́вїю молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Adornment of High Priests, fragrance of the Divine Spirit, by thy myrrh-streaming prayers drive away the foul-smelling passions of my heart, O wise Nicholas, I pray thee with love.[^872]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Въ лѣ́ности скончава́ю мою̀ жи́знь ѻ҆каѧ́нный, и҆ бою́сѧ стра́шнагѡ твоегѡ̀ сꙋди́ща Хрⷭ҇тѐ; на не́мже не посрамѝ менѐ, Нїкола́а хода́тайствы сщ҃е́нными оу҆моле́нъ быва́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In slothfulness do I end my life, wretch that I am, and I fear Thy dread judgment-seat, O Christ; whereat put me not to shame, being entreated through the sacred intercessions of Nicholas.[^873]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Преиспещре́нъ бж҃е́ственною бл҃года́тїю, ст҃и́телю Нїко́лае ѻ҆́ч҃е, ѿ разли́чныхъ и҆скꙋше́нїй, и҆ бѣ́дъ спасѝ прибѣга́ющыѧ въ кро́въ тво́й чⷭ҇нїй при́снѡ, всебл҃же́нне.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Pre-eminently adorned with divine grace, O Hierarch Father Nicholas, from manifold temptations and tribulations save those who ever flee unto thy honorable shelter, O all-blessed one.[^874]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви мѧ̀ ѿ всѣ́хъ напа́стей, и҆ ѿ мно́гихъ собла́знъ ѕмїе́выхъ, и҆ вѣ́чнꙋющагѡ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ и҆ тмы̀, Всенепоро́чнаѧ, ꙗ҆́же Свѣ́тъ ро́ждшаѧ на́мъ невече́рнїй.
items.english_text: Deliver me from all assaults, and from the many snares of the serpent, and from everlasting fire and darkness, O All-immaculate One, who didst give birth for us unto the Unwaning Light.[^875]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^781]
items.slavonic_text: Го́рꙋ тѧ̀ бл҃года́тїю Бж҃їею присѣне́ннꙋю, прозорли́выма А҆ввакꙋ́мъ оу҆смотри́въ ѻ҆чи́ма, и҆зъ тебѐ и҆зы́ти І҆и҃левꙋ провозглаша́ше, Ст҃о́мꙋ, въ спасе́нїе на́ше и҆ ѡ҆бновле́нїе.
