items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Tone 1. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Let us all sing a victorious song unto God Who wrought marvelous wonders with an high arm, and saved Israel; for He hath been glorified.[^1028]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou who alone didst bear the timeless God incarnate in time, O all-holy, Most Pure One, heal the lifelong passions of my most wretched soul.[^1029]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The wounds of my soul, and the perplexity of my heart, the darkening of my thoughts, and the defeat of my mind consume, O Most Pure One, as thou art merciful, by thy prayers.[^1030]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O thou who didst bear the Light, my Deliverer, deliver me, O Most Pure One, from darkness and everlasting torments, that, being saved, I may hymn thy tender-heartedness.[^1031]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Drowning in the abyss of evils and in the tumult of passions, I call upon thy calm, O Most Pure One: save me; for thou art the haven of the faithful.[^1032]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Canon to the Cross, Ode 3. Heirmos:* Let my heart be established in Thy will, O Christ God, Who hast established the second heaven above the waters, and founded the earth upon the waters, O Almighty One.[^1033]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having spread out Thy palms upon the Cross, Thou didst stain Thy divine fingers with blood, delivering the work of Thy hands, Adam, O Master, from the murderous hand, as Thou alone art good and the Lover of mankind.[^1034]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou wast pierced in the side with a spear, O Master, rectifying the slipping of the rib; Thou didst ascend upon the tree, bringing him who received misfortune of old through the fruit of the tree into paradise with the wise thief.[^1035]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* As the pillars of the Church, the foremost bulwarks of piety, the destroyers of enemies, let us in songs bless the Lord's martyrs with pure intent.[^1036]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Being divine branches of the noetic vine, the martyrs plainly brought forth for us clusters of grapes, pouring forth the wine of endurance, gladdening the hearts of all the faithful.[^1037]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: Blessed is the fruit of thy womb, O all-lauded Virgin, Who, for the sake of His Cross, by divine grace hath made partakers of incorruption those corrupted by the fruit of the tree.[^1038]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Consume all the barrenness of my unfruitful mind, and show forth my soul fruitful in virtues, O most pure Theotokos, help of the faithful.[^1039]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Deliver me, O All-immaculate One, from every tribulation, from the many snares of the serpent, and from everlasting fire and darkness, O thou who didst give birth to the pre-eternal Light.[^1040]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* By the dread judgment-seat, O Pure One, and by that unquenchable fire and the terrible sentence am I wholly condemned; make haste to save me, thy servant, O all-pure Sovereign Lady.[^1041]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* That He might deify humanity, God became man from thee, O pure Virgin, beyond speech and comprehension; therefore with one accord do all we the faithful call thee blessed.[^1042]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Canon to the Cross, Ode 4. Heirmos:* I heard Thy report, O Lord, and was afraid; I considered Thy works (the prophet said), and glorified Thy power.[^1043]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being a righteous Lawgiver, Thou wast reckoned among the lawless; Thou didst ascend upon the tree, O Benefactor and Lord, desiring to justify all.[^1044]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* All the angelic powers marvelled, beholding Thee, the Sun, lifted up upon the Cross, and conquering the principalities of darkness.[^1045]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having drawn the grace of healings from spiritual gifts, the martyrs wash away from all men soul-corrupting passions by the grace of God.[^1046]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having cast away the slumber of negligence, the passion-bearers by the vigilance of divine faith put to sleep the raging assaults of wild beasts, and suffered rejoicing.[^1047]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: Woe is me, O Child! How do I behold Thee lifted up upon the tree, and unjustly slain, Who givest life? the Virgin said weeping.[^1048]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos, Ode 4. Heirmos:* Foreseeing in the Spirit the incarnation of the Word, O prophet Habakkuk, thou didst proclaim, crying aloud: When the years draw near, Thou shalt be known; when the time is come, Thou shalt be shown forth. Glory to Thy power, O Lord.[^1049]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Virgin Theotokos, undefiled tabernacle, cleanse me who am defiled with transgressions, by the purest sprinklings of thy mercies. Give me a hand of help, that I may cry: Glory to thee, O pure Bride of God.[^1050]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 [to the Theotokos]:* Thou hast been shown forth as a sanctified temple unto God, Who dwelt within thee beyond comprehension. Pray Him to cleanse us from sinful defilements, that we may be known as a temple and a spiritual dwelling-place.[^1051]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Have mercy upon me, O Theotokos, who alone didst give birth to the fountain of mercies, and loosen the grievous sickness and the heartache of my soul; grant me a stream of tears and compunction before the end, and deliverance from evils.[^1052]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O holy Theotokos, sanctify us, who didst give birth in the flesh to the All-Holy One, Who willed to become like unto men; and by thy prayers, O Most Pure One, show all to be partakers of the Heavenly Kingdom.[^1053]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Canon to the Cross, Ode 5. Heirmos:* Shine forth upon us Thy bright and ever-existing light, who early from the morning seek the judgments of Thy commandments, O Master, Lover of mankind, Christ our God.[^1054]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being lifted up in the flesh upon the Cross, Thou didst call the nations who knew Thee not unto the knowledge of Thee, O Judge of all, Who alone art merciful, Christ our God.[^1055]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When Thou didst stand before the unjust judgment-seat, O righteous Lord, Adam, who had formerly been condemned, was justified, and cries: Glory to Thy crucifixion, O longsuffering Lord![^1056]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* As a paradise planted by God were ye shown forth, O martyrs, having your precious sufferings as fragrant flowers, whereby every soul of the faithful is filled with fragrance.[^1057]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* As fair-flowering and fruitful trees that have blossomed forth the fruit of faith and immortality and uprooted the roots of malice, let us sing of the Lord's martyrs.[^1058]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: The Virgin, the precious rod that budded forth the unfading flower, when she beheld Him lifted up upon the tree, cried aloud: O Master, make me not childless.[^1059]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos, Ode 5. Heirmos:* Grant us Thy peace, O Son of God! for beside Thee we know no other God, we name Thy Name, for Thou art the God of the living and of the dead.[^1060]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The evil tasting in Eden made me dead of old; but O Most Pure One, who didst give birth to Life, make me alive now who died of old by the tree, and grant peace.[^1061]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Save me, O Most Pure One, from grievous troubles, and raise me up from the corruption of passions; and deliver me, thy unprofitable servant, from captivity and the malice of wicked demons.[^1062]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Enlighten the pupils of my soul, O Pure One, that I may ever behold the divine radiance and thy glory, O All-immaculate One, that I may obtain mercy and everlasting glory.[^1063]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* We know thee as a cloud, and paradise, and the gate of light, the table and the fleece, the jar bearing the manna within, the sweetness of the world, O pure Virgin Mother.[^1064]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Canon to the Cross, Ode 6. Heirmos:* Thou didst save the prophet from the whale, O Lover of mankind! And raise me up from the depth of transgressions, I pray Thee.[^1065]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou Who art higher than all honor didst endure dishonor, O Christ, lifted up upon the Cross, desiring to honor men.[^1066]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou dost sign a pardon for me who was enslaved by the deceiver, being struck with a reed, O Christ our all-good God.[^1067]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Through the pains of sufferings, O saints, ye passed over unto a painless end, being accounted worthy of ineffable joy.[^1068]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Ye were kindled with the coals of Christ's love, O most wise ones! Therefore, cast into the fire, ye remained unconsumed.[^1069]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: After giving birth, O All-immaculate One, thou didst remain even as thou wast before birth; for thou didst bear God, Who by the tree hath saved mankind.[^1070]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos, Ode 6. Heirmos:* Imitating the prophet Jonah, I cry aloud: Deliver my life from corruption, O Good One, and save me, O Savior of the world, who cry: Glory to Thee.[^1071]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Defiled as I am by many sins, I pray thee, who alone art the good and undefiled tabernacle: wash me clean from every defilement through thine intercession.[^1072]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Be thou a pilot unto me, O Pure One, tossed about by worldly necessities in the deep of evils; and guide me unto a calm harbor, and save me.[^1073]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The surging tempest of thoughts, the assaults of passions, and the depth of sin toss like waves my wretched soul; help me, O holy Sovereign Lady.[^1074]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ Сн҃а, зрѧ́щи Всенепоро́чнаѧ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нна, восклица́ше ма́терски, и҆ рыда́ющи гла́ше: что̀ є҆́же на тебѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й ви́жꙋ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ недовѣ́домое чꙋ́до?
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O Mary, shown forth as the sacred tabernacle, sanctify my wretched soul which is defiled by pleasures.[^1075]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Пе́щь Спа́се ѡ҆роша́шесѧ, ѻ҆́троци же ликꙋ́юще поѧ́хꙋ: ѻ҆тє́цъ Бж҃е, благослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Cross, Ode 7. Heirmos:* The furnace was bedewed, O Savior, and the children, dancing, sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^1076]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Распина́емь, тва́рь поколеба́лъ є҆сѝ; оу҆мерщвлѧ́емь, ѕмїа̀ оу҆мертви́лъ є҆сѝ. Благослове́нъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е ѻ҆́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being crucified, Thou didst shake creation; being put to death, Thou didst slay the serpent. Blessed art Thou, O Christ, the God of our fathers.[^1077]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Напоѧ́етсѧ же́лчїю Долготерпѣли́вый, и҆сточа́ѧ мнѣ̀ сла́дость спаси́тельнꙋю, сла́достною снѣ́дїю лише́номꙋ ра́йскїа пи́щи.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The Long-suffering One is given gall to drink, welling forth saving sweetness unto me, who through sweet food was deprived of the sustenance of Paradise.[^1078]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици ногтьмѝ стро́жеми, ме́ртвости дебе́лство ѿложи́вше, красотꙋ̀ бж҃твеннꙋю ѿ Бг҃а прїѧ́ша.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Scraped with claws, the martyrs, having laid aside the coarseness of mortality, received divine beauty from God.[^1079]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Страстьмѝ стра́сти Хрⷭ҇то́вѣ пречи́стѣй подо́бѧщесѧ, до́блїи Мꙋ́ченици, ра̑ны вра́жїа оу҆до́бь претерпѣ́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Likening yourselves by your sufferings unto the most pure Passion of Christ, O valiant martyrs, ye readily endured the wounds inflicted by the enemy.[^1080]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Распина́ема зрѧ́щи Гдⷭ҇а, непоро́чнаѧ Бцⷣа гла́ше: оу҆вы́ мнѣ̀ Сн҃е мо́й! ка́кѡ оу҆мира́еши, животѐ и҆ наде́ждо вѣ́рныхъ?
items.english_text: Beholding the Lord crucified, the spotless Theotokos said: Woe is me, O my Son! How art Thou dying, O Life and Hope of the faithful?[^1081]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Сꙋ́щымъ въ пещѝ ѻ҆трокѡ́мъ твои̑мъ Спа́се, не прикосну́сѧ нижѐ стꙋжѝ ѻ҆́гнь. Тогда̀ трїѐ ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нѣми оу҆сты̑ поѧ́хꙋ, и҆ бл҃гословлѧ́хꙋ глаго́люще: бл҃гослове́нъ Бг҃ъ ѻ҆́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos, Ode 7. Other Heirmos:* The fire touched not nor troubled Thy children in the furnace, O Savior. Then the three, as with one mouth, sang and blessed, saying: Blessed is the God of our fathers.[^1082]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скве́рншꙋюсѧ страстьмѝ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ ѡ҆стѝ пречи́стаѧ Бг҃оневѣ́сто: и҆ оу҆ма̀ моегѡ̀ лю́тое плѣне́нїе, и҆ се́рдца недоꙋмѣ́нїе, и҆ бѣсо́вскаѧ оу҆стремле́нїа вско́рѣ потребѝ, Чи́стаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Sanctify my soul defiled by passions, O most pure Bride of God; and quickly destroy the grievous captivity of my mind, the perplexity of my heart, and the assaults of demons, O Pure One.[^1083]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нный страстьмѝ плотски́ми Всенепоро́чнаѧ, ѡ҆живѝ оу҆́мъ мо́й, и҆ Бг҃ꙋ оу҆гѡ́днаѧ соверша́ти оу҆крѣпи́ мѧ, да велича́ю тѧ̀, и҆ сла́влю при́снѡ благоꙋтро́бїе твоѐ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Slain by carnal passions, O All-immaculate One, quicken my mind and strengthen me to perform things well-pleasing unto God, that I may magnify thee and ever glorify thy tender compassion.[^1084]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Дѣ́во Ма́ти, ꙗ҆́же є҆ди́на Бг҃а ро́ждшаѧ, оу҆мертвѝ плотскі́ѧ моѧ̑ сла́сти, и҆ дꙋше́внꙋю мою̀ скве́рнꙋ ѡ҆мы́й вско́рѣ; и҆ и҆стѧза́нїа бѣсѡ́въ лꙋка́выхъ и҆зба́ви, и҆ спаси́ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Virgin Mother, who alone didst bear God, put to death my carnal pleasures, and quickly wash away the defilement of my soul; and deliver me from the torment of wicked demons, and save me.[^1085]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Преиспрещре́на бж҃твенными добродѣ́тельми, родила̀ є҆сѝ Сло́во собезна́чальное Ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀, чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, добродѣ́тельми небеса̀ вои́стинꙋ покры́вшаго; є҆го́же молѝ при́снѡ, оу҆ще́дрити на́съ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Adorned with divine virtues, O pure Virgin, thou didst bear the Word co-unoriginate with the Father, Who truly covered the heavens with virtues; Whom do thou ever implore to have compassion on us.[^1086]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣснослѡ́вцы, въ пещѝ спа́сшаго дѣ́ти, и҆ громопла́меннꙋю прело́жшаго на ро́сꙋ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а по́йте, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Cross, Ode 8. Heirmos:* Hymn Christ God, O singers, Who saved the children in the furnace, and changed the thunderous flame into dew; and highly exalt Him unto all ages.[^1087]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* When Thou wast nailed to the Cross, O Savior, creation was shaken...[^1088]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: ...the sun withheld its rays, the rocks were split, and Hades was swiftly laid bare, not enduring Thy dominion.[^1089]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* For the condemnation of the outcast, Thou didst suffer condemnation; for him that received nakedness, Thou didst hang naked upon the tree, O Compassionate One! Great is Thy dominion and longsuffering.[^1090]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Companions of the bodiless hosts, soldiers of Christ, armed with the Cross as with breastplates, deployed against the adversary, trampling him underfoot with beautiful feet.[^1091]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* In the midst of the tribunal the valiant ones stood with bonds, being torn limb from limb, tearing down the edifice of delusion and smashing the shrines of demons.[^1092]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: She that is higher than the heavens, beholding the only Exalted One lifted up upon the tree, and casting down the arrogance of the enemy, sang aloud unto Christ.[^1093]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos, Ode 8. Other Heirmos:* Him of Whom angels and all hosts are in dread as Creator and Lord, sing, ye priests; glorify, ye children; bless, ye peoples; and highly exalt Him unto all ages.[^1094]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Bodiless One is divinely incarnate from thee; pray Him, O Most Pure One, to put to death my carnal passions, and to quicken my soul which hath been slain by sins.[^1095]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst bear the Savior and God, O Most Pure One, Who heals the brokenness of earthly Adam; beseech Him to heal the wounds of my soul, which suffer incurably.[^1096]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Raise me up who lie in the depth of evils, and overcome him who now fights against me, O Pure One; and despise not my soul wounded by improper pleasures, O Most Pure One, but have compassion and save me.[^1097]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* We are delivered from all manner of temptations, O Most Pure One, through thy vigilant prayers unto God, knowing thee to be the blessed and full of grace Theotokos.[^1098]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Then: My soul doth magnify the Lord: and prostrations.*[^1099]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Cross, Ode 9. Heirmos:* Thee, whom Moses saw as the unconsumed bush, and the animate ladder which Jacob saw, and the heavenly gate through which Christ our God passed, with hymns, O pure Mother, do we magnify.[^1100]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O how did the disobedient people deliver Thee to the Cross, the only Long-...[^1101]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: ...suffering One! Who willingly becamest poor, and didst accept the Passion, and becamest the Mediator of impassibility unto all who had slipped from Adam.[^1102]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* An ignominious crucifixion didst Thou accept in the flesh, O Christ, desiring to honor man dishonored by irrational passions, who had lost his ancient beauty. Glory beyond mind to Thy tender mercy![^1103]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Christ, unsetting Sun, those that rose early toward Thee and traversed the darkness of sufferings by Thy beckoning, hast Thou guided to the light of Thine ineffable glory and brightness; therefore enlighten us by their prayers.[^1104]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* The regiment of holy martyrs overcame the hosts of noetic enemies, and was joined to the ten thousands of holy powers; and by an all-efficacious sign it ever heals the darkness of passions of our souls.[^1105]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: With the light of the Light that shone forth from thee in the flesh, O Virgin, illumine my mind and enlighten my heart, driving away the darkness of sin, and dispersing all the mist of my despondency.[^1106]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos, Ode 9. Other Heirmos:* The light-bearing cloud, into which the Master of all, as rain from heaven upon a fleece, came down, and was incarnate for our sake, becoming man, the Unoriginate One, all we magnify as the pure Mother of our God.[^1107]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Loving sin, I abide in laziness, and I tremble before the inexorable tribunal, O Pure One; whereat do thou preserve me uncondemned through thy holy prayers, O Bride of God, that as my protectress I may call thee blessed, O Most Pure One.[^1108]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I am in dread of the tribunal, O Virgin, and of the unforgetting eye of thy Son, having committed many sins upon the earth; and therefore I cry unto thee: O all-compassionate Sovereign Lady, help me, and deliver me from the trouble of that time, and save me, O Pure One.[^1109]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* How dread is the day of examination, O Maiden! How terrible the answer! How bitter the calamity! Who will stand henceforth? O most pure Sovereign Lady, have mercy on my passionate soul, and grant me remission before the end, O Most Pure One.[^1110]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O thou who didst bear the divine Light that shone forth from the Father, my soul darkened by the deceits...[^1111]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: ...of this life, and which hath become a mockery unto enemies, do thou pity, O All-immaculate One, and account worthy of the light of saving repentance, O Pure One.[^1112]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Tone 1, Podoben: "The sky with stars" (Не́бо ѕвѣзда́ми):*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: O Cross of my Christ, scepter and victory of rulers, boast of the Orthodox, preserve those who bow down before thee, that the multitudes of blasphemous men may be vanquished.[^1113]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 1:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: Thee Who wast nailed upon the tree in the flesh, and Who hast granted us life, as Savior and Master do we sing unceasingly.[^1114]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad: - - - And look upon Thy servants, and upon the works of Thy hands, and guide their sons.* [^1115]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Christ, there hath become one flock of angels and of men, and in one assembly heaven and earth rejoice. O Lord, glory to Thee.

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us: - - And direct Thou the works of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands do Thou direct.* [^1116]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: Come, all ye peoples, let us honor with chants and spiritual songs the passion-bearers of Christ: the luminaries of the world and preachers of the faith, the ever-flowing fountains from which healings pour forth unto the faithful. By their prayers, O Christ our God, grant peace to Thy world, and to our souls great mercy.

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: When the Ewe-lamb, the Ewe-lamb and all-immaculate Sovereign Lady, beheld upon the Cross Him Who had neither form nor beauty, woe is me! weeping she said: Whither hath Thy beauty set, O sweetest One? Whither Thy majesty? Whither the radiant splendor of Thine image, O my most beloved Son?[^1117]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: By food the enemy led Adam out of Paradise, but by the Cross Christ brought the thief into it, who cried: Remember me when Thou comest into Thy kingdom.[^1118]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: Being crucified, O Sinless One, Thou didst take upon Thyself the sins of all, O Christ, and being pierced in the side, Thou didst pour forth the streams of salvation: water...[^1119]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: ...and blood, building up those crushed by corruption.[^1120]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: Being nailed to the tree of Thine own will, O Jesus God, Thou didst take away, O Compassionate One, all the passionate understanding of Adam; and by Thy precious wounds Thou didst wound the demonic host.[^1121]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: Likening yourselves unto the sufferings of Him Who willingly suffered in the flesh, O glorious martyrs, ye ever heal incurable passions, and drive away diseases from men by spiritual power.[^1122]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Triadikon:* As equal in power and equally honored Trinity do we glorify Thee: the unoriginate God the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, one tri-hypostatic Godhead, magnifying in faith.[^1123]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^955]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* When she that bare Thee in the flesh beheld Thee nailed upon the Cross, O Christ God, weeping she said: What hath the ungrateful Jewish assembly rendered unto Thee, O my Son?[^1124]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerables:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* The martyrs in unified festivity, by the streams of their blood drowned the multitude of demons, and brought to an end all shameful sacrifices; they destroyed idolatrous delusion, having patiently suffered, and now they pray unto Christ to grant our souls peace and great mercy.[^1126]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* The all-sacred shepherds, with wise words and teachings, taught all to glorify the Trinity in the unity of the Godhead, divinely avoiding the confusion and division of the Persons; and now they pray that there may be granted to our souls peace and great mercy.[^1127]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* The company of the venerable put to sleep carnal desires, and bridled their impulses, showing forth an angelic life. Therefore in the heavenly mansions do they now make merry, praying...[^1128]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: ...unto Christ to grant our souls peace and great mercy.[^1129]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Martyrs, Same Tone:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* By the prayers of all the saints and of the Theotokos, grant us Thy peace, O Lord, and have mercy on us, as Thou alone art compassionate.[^1130]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Your confession before the tribunal, O saints, spat upon the power of demons and freed men from delusion. Therefore also, as your heads were being cut off, ye cried: Let the sacrifice of our souls be acceptable before Thee, O Lord, for, having loved Thee, we took no thought for temporal life, O Lover of mankind.[^1131]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* O goodly traffic of yours, O saints! For ye gave blood and inherited the heavens, and being tried for a time, ye rejoice eternally. Truly goodly is your traffic; for leaving corruptible things, ye received incorruptible, and keeping festival with the angels, ye sing unceasingly unto the consubstantial Trinity.[^1132]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Dogmatikon Theotokion:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: Let us sing of Mary the Virgin, the boast of the whole world, who blossomed forth from mankind and bare the Master, the heavenly gate, the song of the bodiless hosts, and the adornment of the faithful. For she appeared as heaven and temple of the Godhead; she, having broken down the barrier of enmity, brought in peace and opened the Kingdom. Having her, therefore, as the confirmation of our faith, we have as champion the Lord Who was born of her. Be of good courage therefore, be of good courage, O people of God, for He will conquer the enemies, for He is all-powerful.[^1133]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: O all-lauded martyrs, the earth did not hide you, but heaven received you, and the gates of Paradise were opened unto you; and being within, ye enjoy the Tree of Life. Pray unto Christ to grant our souls peace and great mercy.[^1134]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: What earthly sweetness remains unpartaker of sorrow? What glory stands immutable upon earth? All things are more feeble than shadows, all things more deceitful than dreams; in a single hour death takes all these things away. But in the light of Thy countenance, O Christ, and in the enjoyment of Thy beauty, give rest unto them whom Thou hast chosen, as Thou art the Lover of mankind.

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: No one is without sin, none among men hath been such, save Thou alone, O Immortal One. Therefore, as compassionate God, establish Thy servants in light with Thy choirs of angels, in Thy tender...[^1137]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: ...compassion, overlooking transgressions, and granting them forgiveness.[^1138]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: Truly beyond mind are the marvelous majesties of thy childbearing, O Bride of God, which all the prophets proclaimed, all most glorious: the conception and the birth, O All-hymned One, incomprehensible and ineffable, whereby He hath saved the world, as He is merciful.[^1139]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Tone 1. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Let us all sing a victorious song unto God Who wrought marvelous wonders with an high arm, and saved Israel; for He hath been glorified.[^1140]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A saving harbor and protection art thou unto those who call upon thee, O most pure Theotokos! Therefore I also from my soul call upon thee fervently: O Sovereign Lady, save me.[^1141]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O pure Mary, Mother of the Creator, heal my humble soul decayed by passions and transgressions, as thou art good and propitious.[^1142]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O unwedded Sovereign Lady, cease not to pray ever unto my Creator and God, on behalf of him that ever flees unto thy protection, that I may obtain mercy.[^1143]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Animate palace of the King, and fiery throne, with the holy martyrs and the Apostles ever pray Christ to deliver us from tribulations.[^1144]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner. This is the stone upon which Christ hath established the Church, which He redeemed from the nations.[^1145]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The darkness of transgressions holds fast my heart, O Sovereign Lady, and I dare not look up unto heaven with my eyes. Therefore I cry: Enlighten my mind and my heart with the commandments of Christ.[^1146]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I gaze upon thy divine icon, and I honor the Most Pure Mother as the prototype; and this I kiss, venerate, and praise, knowing the honor of thee and of Him to be one.[^1147]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Restrain the fierce bodily impulses, and quench the flame of passions, O Virgin, wherewith the manifold woven chain of sins...[^1148]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: ...the fierce serpent weavs for me, desiring to snatch me away unto destruction.[^1149]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Wholly clothed in Adam from thee, O Theotokos, the Word came forth, taking on the whole body. Pray Him, therefore, to deliver us from passions, and from various temptations, and from everlasting fire.[^1150]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Foreseeing in spirit the incarnation of the Word, O prophet Habakkuk, thou didst proclaim, crying: When the years draw near, Thou shalt be known; when the time is come, Thou shalt be shown forth. Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^1151]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having given birth to the Creator and Maker of all, thou hast ineffable power and invincible might, O Virgin, and thou savest those who come unto thee in faith; therefore I cry unto thee: O Sovereign Lady of the world, help me.[^1152]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Cast down the warfare of invisible, noetic enemies, O Sovereign Lady, who ever assault my wretched heart, granting divine tranquility and peace, that I may joyfully hymn thee.[^1153]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Hope of the hopeless, helper of the poor, consolation of those who mourn, cleansing of those who sin, guide of the wandering, physician of the sick, and restoration of the falling.[^1154]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O pure and blessed Virgin Mary, who alone didst change the curse of all! With the Apostles, martyrs, and prophets, pray Him Who came forth from thy womb, to save the souls of those who hymn thee.[^1155]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Grant us Thy peace, O Son of God; for we know no other God save Thee, we name Thy Name, for Thou art the God of the living and of the dead.[^1156]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Save me, O Sovereign Lady, from the depth of temptations, tribulations, sorrows, and bodily passions, and preserve my soul in divine tranquility.[^1157]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou art my fervent protection and firm defense in all my life, O All-immaculate One! Therefore I pray thee: Extend unto me thy rich tender compassion after death also.[^1158]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O thou who didst give birth to the Creator and Redeemer of all: Deliver me from bodily passions which burn my heart and draw me unto unfitting deeds.[^1159]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having appeared as the place of noetic sanctification, sanctify me wholly...[^1160]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: ...O Sovereign Lady, and with the holy and wise Apostles pray, O Virgin, that I may be saved.[^1161]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Imitating the prophet Jonah, I cry aloud: Deliver my life from corruption, O Good One, and save me, O Savior of the world, who cry: Glory to Thee![^1162]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou dost preserve me alive, delivering me from temptations; do thou also translate me when departing from the earth unto everlasting life, O Virgin Mother, by thy tender compassion.[^1163]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou art an unbreakable wall, thou art a firm protection, O good Theotokos, thou art a strong protectress unto thy servant; and therefore do I ever call upon thee.[^1164]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having acquired powerful intercession with God, O good Theotokos, despise me not who fervently flee unto thy protection, and cry aloud: Have mercy on me, O Mother of the God of all.[^1165]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Cast me not away, O Christ; abhor me not, O Savior; the Ewe-lamb that bare Thee in the flesh prays Thee, with Thine Apostles, prophets, and passion-bearers.[^1166]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Then: Lord, have mercy, thrice. Glory... Both now...*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: A cloud of the co-eternal divine Light, O Virgin, and an ark, and a lampstand, and an urn, and an unhewn mountain, did the prophets foretell thee to be, O most pure Maiden! For from thee seedlessly in the latter times came forth Christ our God, even as the Father was well pleased.[^1167]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The fire touched not nor troubled Thy children in the furnace, O Savior. Then the three, as with one mouth, sang and blessed, saying: Blessed is the God of our fathers.[^1168]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* When I am in despair, O Pure One, through transgressions and carnal pleasures, and am driven into the depth of perdition, come quickly and deliver me, O most pure Sovereign Lady, by thy tender compassion.[^1169]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* A mighty refuge, and protection, and deliverance unto all the faithful art thou, O Theotokos; be thou a guide unto me toward the Creator, granting me deliverance from transgressions by thy tender-heartedness.[^1170]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou didst destroy the curse, O Pure One, who didst bear Christ our Joy; do thou also loose by thy power the curse that hath come upon me from sin, O All-immaculate One, and grant me joy.[^1171]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* We thy servants pray thee, O Most Holy Pure One, ever by day and by night, praying with contrite mind: Grant deliverance from our transgressions through thy prayers.[^1172]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Him of Whom angels and all hosts are in dread as Creator and Lord, sing, ye priests; glorify, ye children; bless, ye peoples; and highly exalt Him unto all ages.[^1173]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Arise, anticipate, war against the enemies who ever trouble and afflict us, manifesting thy power, O holy Virgin, helper of the world.[^1174]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou hast saved the world from death and corruption by thy divine childbearing, O good Virgin; and now by thy prayers snatch us away from passions and save us who praise thee.[^1175]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Great and ineffable is thy might, O Virgin, manifold and invincible are thy divine mercies and tender compassion. Therefore save us who truly call upon thee.[^1176]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As an animate vine, O Virgin, thou didst put forth for us the ripe Cluster that welled forth the wine of forgiveness, and dried up the drunkenness of sin.[^1177]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* The light-bearing cloud, into which the Master of all, as rain from heaven upon a fleece, came down, and was incarnate for our sake, becoming man, the Unoriginate One, all we magnify as the pure Mother of our God.[^1178]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Buffeted by carnal pleasures in the sea of life, I fall down before thee and cry aloud: Have mercy on me who flee unto thee, O Sovereign Lady, and stretch forth to me a hand of salvation, delivering me from the deep of perdition.[^1179]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Unto thee do I confess my sins, O Virgin! Unto thy face do I present my shame, and I cry aloud from my soul: Have mercy and show compassion, O Most Pure One, for after God I have placed my firm hope in thee.[^1180]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thee who seedlessly didst bear the Creator and Master, I call upon from my soul, and I pray diligently: Save me from the corruption of many transgressions, and deliver me from unquenchable fire, O most holy, good Theotokos.[^1181]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ на крестѣ̀ Сп҃се пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ, колеба́шесѧ тва́рь,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O impassable gate, portal of Paradise, way of those who are saved, path of salvation, with the martyrs and...[^1182]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Проро́ки, съ Пра́ведными же и҆ Преподо́бными, и҆ съ бж҃твенными А҆пⷭ҇толы, моли́сѧ Чи́стаѧ, спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: ...the Prophets, with the Righteous and the Venerable, and with the divine Apostles, pray, O Pure One, that our souls may be saved.[^1183]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Та́же, Досто́йно є҆́сть: Трїст҃о́е и҆ прѡ́чаѧ.
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet: Trisagion and the rest.*[^1184]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Страда́нїѧ похвало́ю, и҆ вѣ́чною по́честїю, сла́внїи страстоте́рпцы, ѡ҆дѣ́ѧвшесѧ тобо́ю Гдⷭ҇и, терпѣ́нїемъ оу҆́бѡ ра́нъ, беззако́нныхъ побѣди́ша, и҆ си́лою бж҃твенною ѿ небе́съ побѣ́дꙋ прїѧ́ша. Тѣ́хъ моли́твами и҆ на́съ свободѝ ѿ неви́димагѡ врага̀ Сп҃се, и҆ спасѝ на́съ.
items.english_text: *After the 1st Stichologia, Sessional Hymns, to the Martyrs, Tone 1:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: With the boast of suffering and eternal honor, O glorious passion-bearers, having clothed yourselves with Thee, O Lord, by the endurance of wounds they conquered the lawless, and received victory from heaven by divine power. By their prayers deliver us also from the invisible enemy, O Savior, and save us.[^1185]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́брїи во́инни є҆диномо́дреннѡ вѣ́ровавше, преще́нїа мꙋчи́телей не оу҆боѧ́стесѧ Ст҃і́и; прїидо́сте оу҆се́рднѡ къ Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀, взе́мше честны́й крⷭ҇тъ; и҆ сконча́вше тече́нїе, съ нб҃сѐ побѣ́дꙋ прїѧ́сте. Сла́ва оу҆крѣ́пльшемꙋ вы̀, сла́ва вѣнча́вшемꙋ вы̀, сла́ва дѣ́йствꙋющемꙋ ва́ми всѣ́мъ и҆сцѣле́нїа.
items.english_text: As good soldiers of one mind in faith, ye feared not the threats of the torturers, O holy ones; ye came fervently unto Christ, having taken up the precious Cross, and having finished your course, ye received victory from heaven. Glory to Him Who hath strengthened you, glory to Him Who hath crowned you, glory to Him Who through you works healings for all.[^1187]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Дꙋ́ши и҆́хъ во благи́хъ водворѧ́тсѧ.
items.english_text: In a place of light, in the choir of the righteous, give rest, O Savior, unto those who have passed over unto Thee; for they have placed their hope in Thee, O Lover of mankind. Accept our supplication for the fathers and children whose memory we celebrate, and justify them, as Thou art abundant in mercy.[^1189]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Въ мѣ́стѣ свѣ́тлѣ, въ ли́цѣ пра́ведныхъ, оу҆поко́й Сп҃се, къ тебѣ̀ преста́вльшихсѧ; на тѧ́ бо оу҆пова́нїе Человѣколю́бче возложи́ша. Прїимѝ моле́нїе ѡ҆ ѻ҆тцѣ́хъ и҆ ча́дѣхъ, и҆́мже соверша́емъ па́мѧть, и҆ ѡ҆правдѝ тѣ́хъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ многоми́лостивъ.
items.english_text: When Gabriel said unto thee: Rejoice! O Virgin, with that voice the Master of all was incarnate in thee, the holy Ark, as the righteous David said; thou didst appear more spacious than the heavens, having borne Thy Creator. Glory to Him Who dwelt in thee, glory to Him Who came forth from thee, glory to Him Who hath set us free through thy childbearing.[^1190]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Гаврїи́лꙋ вѣща́вшꙋ тебѣ̀ Дв҃о: ра́дꙋйсѧ! со гла́сомъ воплоща́шесѧ всѣ́хъ Влⷢ҇ка, въ тебѣ̀ ст҃ѣ́мъ Кївѡ́тѣ, ꙗ҆́кѡже речѐ пра́ведный Даві́дъ; ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ простра́ннѣйши небе́съ, поноси́вши Зижди́телѧ твоего̀. Сла́ва все́льшемꙋсѧ въ тѧ̀, сла́ва проше́дшемꙋ и҆зъ тебѐ, сла́ва свободи́вшемꙋ на́съ рождество́мъ твои́мъ.
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Stichologia, Sessional Hymns, Tone 1:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Ра́нами Ст҃ы́хъ, и҆́же по тебѣ̀ пострада́ша, оу҆моле́нъ бꙋ́ди Гдⷭ҇и! и҆ всѧ̑ на̑ша болѣ́зни и҆ стра̑сти и҆сцѣлѝ, Человѣколю́бче, мо́лимсѧ.
items.english_text: By the wounds of the saints who suffered for Thy sake, be Thou entreated, O Lord, and heal all our sicknesses and passions, O Lover of mankind, we pray Thee.[^1191]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: Let us all beseech the martyrs of Christ, and let us come unto them in love with faith; for they intercede for our salvation, and they all pour forth the grace of healings; they drive away the regiments of demons, as guardians of the faith.[^1193]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: Having abolished the dominion of death, O Christ, Thou didst well forth incorruption unto those on earth; and they that believe in Thee die not, but live ever in Thee. Give rest therefore, O Lord, unto the souls of Thy servants, and appoint them with Thy saints, by the prayers of the Theotokos, granting them Thy mercy.[^1195]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: O only firm and fervent protectress of the human race, O Virgin Theotokos, cease not to pray, with the prophets, and martyrs, with the hierarchs, and fasters, and venerable ones, unto God the Word, Whom thou didst bear beyond nature, to save all creation.[^1196]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy Martyrs, and Hierarchs, the Venerable, and the Departed, whose acrostic is: Unto those who have loved God, I sing a divine song. (A work of Joseph).*[^1197]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Tone 1. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Guiding Israel with a pillar of fire and cloud, as God He parted the sea, and covered Pharaoh's chariots with the deep. Let us sing a song of victory, for He alone hath been glorified.[^1198]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Martyrs, pray to God for us.*[^1199]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Protected by the shield of piety, the divine sufferers rushed unto the contest; and they destroyed all the power of the enemy, singing a song of victory unto Christ Who strengthened them.[^1200]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy ones of Christ, pray to God for us.*[^1201]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Ye shepherded the flock of God upon mystical pasture, O divine pastors, driving away the wolves with the staff of sacred words; and rejoicing, ye took up your abode in the heavenly fold, where the Great Shepherd is.[^1202]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: All ye Saints, pray to God for us.*[^1203]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having put to death the passions of the flesh by fasting and sufferings, by the divine nod ye live after death, O Venerable ones; ever pray Christ, Who for our sake became dead, to have compassion upon us.[^1204]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Give rest, O Lord, to the souls of Thy departed servants.*[^1205]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having become dead, Thou didst grant unto the dead Thy divine life and immortal existence; those who have passed over in faith from this cor-...[^1206]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: ...ruptible life, make partakers of Thy kingdom, as Thou art full of tender compassion, and alone abundant in mercy.[^1207]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: The martyrs wounded by the love of Christ, and the women crowned by God, and all the venerable ones honor thee, the all-immaculate and fair among women, faithfully rejoicing, as the all-honorable Queen.[^1208]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *We sing it in order, where there is no Menaion, or at the office for the departed, over the kolyvo.*[^1209]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: Unto those asleep in the faith, I bring the first song).*[^1210]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Tone 1. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Thy victorious right hand hath been glorified in power in a manner befitting God; for it, O Immortal One, as all-powerful, shattered the adversaries, fashioning a new path through the deep for the Israelites.[^1211]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Marvelous is God in His saints.*[^1212]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The gates of death and its bars hast Thou shattered by Thy death, O Immortal One! Open, O Master, the gates of immortality beyond mind unto the departed, by the prayers of Thy passion-bearers.[^1213]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Give rest, O Lord, to the souls of the departed.*[^1214]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* That we might be accounted worthy of divine life, Thou didst descend unto death, and having overturned its treasuries, Thou didst draw us forth from thence; and now, O Giver of life, give rest unto the departed.[^1215]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having assumed my corruptible and mortal nature, Thou hast clothed it in incorruption, and hast lifted it up unto unending and blessed life; where, as Thou art compassionate, give rest unto them whom Thou hast received.[^1216]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: Let us the faithful sing of her who bare the divine Word from God; for that all-pure one became the way of life unto the dead, whom as the Receiver of God and Theotokos we glorify.[^1217]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Let my heart be established in Thy will, O Christ God, Who didst establish the second heaven above the waters, and didst found the earth upon the waters, O Almighty One.[^1218]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Martyrs, pray to God for us.*[^1219]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Ст҃ы̑мъ, и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ Гдⷭ҇ь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа и҆́хъ.
