items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Let the nations and peoples praise Christ our God, Who for our sake willingly endured the Cross, and spent three days in hades; and let them worship His Resurrection from the dead, whereby the ends of the whole world have been enlightened.

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *On Sunday at Matins, Tone 2.*[^1476]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Thou wast crucified and buried, O Christ, as Thou didst will; Thou didst overthrow death and rose in glory, as God and Master, granting unto the world eternal life and great mercy.

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* In truth, O ye lawless ones who sealed the stone, ye have made us worthy of greater marvels! The watchmen have understanding: "Today He came forth from the tomb," they said; "say ye: While we were asleep, His disciples came and stole Him." And who steals a dead body, especially even naked? He Himself rose by His own power as God, having left His burial wrappings in the tomb. Come, see, O ye Jews, how He broke not the seals—He that trampled down death, and grants unending life unto mankind, and great mercy!

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Glory: Evangelical Sticheron. Both now: Theotokion:* "Most blessed art Thou, O Theotokos." *Great Doxology. Troparion:* "Having risen from the tomb."[^1478]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *AT THE LITURGY, Beatitudes, Tone 2.*[^1479]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The voice of the thief do we bring unto Thee, and we pray: Remember us, O Savior, in Thy kingdom.

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thy Cross do we bring unto Thee for the remission of transgressions, which Thou didst accept for our sake, O Lover of mankind.

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* We worship Thy burial and Thy rising, O Master, whereby Thou didst deliver the world from corruption, O Lover of mankind.

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* By Thy death, O Lord, death has been swallowed up; and by Thy Resurrection, O Savior, Thou hast saved the world.

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 5:* Thou didst meet the Myrrhbearers, having risen from the tomb, and didst command [them] to tell Thy disciples of Thy rising.[^1480]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 6:* They that slept in darkness, having seen Thee, the Light, in the nethermost depths of hades, O Christ, arose.

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Let us glorify the Father, let us all worship the Son, and let us faithfully hymn the Holy Spirit.

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* Rejoice, fiery throne! Rejoice, unwedded Bride! Rejoice, O Virgin who didst bear God unto men!

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^1125]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *On Sunday Evening, Tone 2.*[^1481]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 2.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Possessing a fountain of tender compassion, and pouring forth abysses of mercies and streams of bounties, O All-good Father, and Son, the Father's Word, and Holy Spirit, uncreated Nature! Receive our supplication and prayer, granting unto all who are in transgressions forgiveness, as a God compassionate and Lover of mankind.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Thou hast by nature, as God, a womb of bounties, and mercies, and goodness; therefore we pray Thee, O Christ our Savior, and falling down we call, ever crying unto Thee: Grant unto Thy servants the loosening of many transgressions, and the forgiveness of all wherein we all have sinned, as a God compassionate and Lover of mankind.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Desiring, O Savior, to save all as God, for whose sake having become incarnate, Thou didst appear as man, save us who worship Thy commandments; for Thou camest not, O Lover of mankind, to save the righteous, but to loose by the grace of divine baptism us who are bound in transgressions by many sins, as a God compassionate and Lover of mankind.[^1483]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Then the Stichera of the Menaion; but if there be no Menaion, we sing:*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Bodiless Powers.*[^1484]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Thrones, Cherubim, and Seraphim, Dominions, and Powers, and venerable Authorities, Angels, Archangels, and Principalities with them, unto Him Who composed their imperishable nature, sing an unceasing hymn with one accord, teaching all to honor the one Essence in Trinity, co-originate, equal in honor, and co-enthroned.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* The first ranks of the immaterial choirs, receiving the radiances of the Godhead through immediate stations, according to their order impart the divine splendors unto the others; and through the law of love they also bring them with diligence unto us, according to the worthiness of each one's purity of heart.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Lifting up on high the soul, on high the eye of the heart and the intellectual aspirations, having divine love in our souls, let us ever stretch forward; that, being illuminated by the rays thence proceeding, we may flee the darkness of passions, hoping to stand with the Angels before the awesome throne of the Creator, and to be transformed from light to light.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *On Sunday Evening, Tone 2.*[^1485]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* The multitude of Angels, O Most Pure One, hymn Thy Son with thrice-holy voices, seeing Thee as His fiery throne and living palace, a divine bridge leading [mortals] ever from earth unto Him, crying unto Thee with one accord with the Archangel Gabriel: "Rejoice, Thou full of grace," for Thou gavest birth to the Fountain of joy.[^1486]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Then:* "O Gladsome Light." *Prokeimenon:* "Behold now..."[^1487]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *AT THE APOSTICHA, Penitential Stichera, Tone 2.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* I have sinned against Thee, O Christ Savior, like the prodigal son; receive me, O Father, repenting, and have mercy on me, O God.[^1488]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Refrain [Verse]:* "Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes... even so our eyes look unto the Lord our God, until He have compassion upon us."[^1489]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* I cry unto Thee, O Christ Savior, with the voice of the publican: Cleanse me as him, and have mercy on me, O God.[^1490]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Refrain [Verse]:* "Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us... For our soul hath been exceedingly filled with the reproach of them that are at ease, and the contempt of the proud."[^1491]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3 [Martyrikon]:* Having not loved earthly sweets, the passion-bearers were accounted worthy of heavenly good things, and became fellow-citizens with the Angels. O Lord, by their prayers have mercy and save us.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Rejoice, O Mary Theotokos, indestructible temple, and rather holy, as the Prophet cries: "Holy is Thy temple, wonderful in righteousness!"[^1492]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Then:* "Now lettest Thou depart;" *Trisagion; after* "Our Father:" *Troparion to the Saint; Glory... Both now... Theotokion according to the Tone of the troparion. Ektenia and Dismissal.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *AT COMPLINE, Canon of praise to the Most Holy Theotokos.*[^1493]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 1, Tone 2. Heirmos:* In the deep of old, the overwhelming power laid low the Pharaoh-like host; and the incarnate Word destroyed all-wicked sin, the supremely glorified Lord; for gloriously has He been glorified.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Refrain:* Most holy Lady Theotokos, save us.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Taking form from Thee like unto us, the never-setting Sun clearly showed Thee forth as a spiritual and most radiant heaven. Therefore deliver me from the stench of passions, that with love I may hymn Thee, the only Virgin Mother.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The tongs that bare the noetic Coal, and human nature...[^1494]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *On Sunday at Compline, Tone 2.*[^1495]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...that cleansed [it]; I pray Thee, O Lady: wash away the filth of my many transgressions, and deliver me by Thy prayers from defiling passions.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Having given birth unto Christ, the Fountain of mercy, O Most Pure One, and opened Eden unto men: open unto me the doors of Thy mercy, O Theotokos, and grant forgiveness of transgressions, O Lady of the world.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Burst asunder the bonds of my transgressions, O Lady, praying unto Thy Son and God; and cast down the sin that torments me, O Ever-virgin, that, being saved, I may ever hymn Thee, O All-immaculate One.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:*[^1496] Having established me upon the rock of faith, Thou hast enlarged my mouth against mine enemies; for my spirit has rejoiced when singing: There is none holy as our God, and none righteous besides Thee, O Lord.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Dispel the gloom and darkness of my passions by the radiances of Thy prayers, and enlighten me, O most pure Lady, who gavest birth to Christ Who shone forth before the morning star, the never-setting Sun from the Sun.[^1497]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By Thy birthgiving, O Most Pure One, Thou didst raise up the fallen and crushed tabernacle of David Thy forefather; therefore raise up also me, Thy servant, O Theotokos, crushed by passions and transgressions.[^1498]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Be Thou a weapon putting to flight the sins and passions of my soul, O Virgin! And show me forth like another paradise, unharmed and guarded by Thee, and bearing the flowers of the Spirit.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Stretching forth the hand of Thy tender compassion, receive me, O Parent of God, and snatch from all condemnation him that flees unto Thee, and falls down before Thee, and calls upon Thy help.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:*[^1499] I sing to Thee; for by report, O Lord, I heard and was afraid; for Thou comest unto me, seeking me who had strayed. Therefore I glorify Thy great condescension toward me, O Plenteous in mercy.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The undefiled and holy leaven of human nature, taking dough from which the Creator fashioned it; wash away from me also the filth of passions, and cleanse the mire of my transgressions.[^1500]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Е҆стество́мъ чл҃вѣ́ческимъ стра́стенъ же и҆ сме́ртенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же безстра́стный невеще́ственнымъ бж҃тво́мъ, ѡ҆безтли́вый ᲂу҆мерщвле́ныѧ Хрⷭтѐ, ѿ преиспо́днихъ а҆́довыхъ воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By the healing medicine of Thy prayers, O Lady, and with plaster and oil, heal Thou now, O Pure One, the scabs and sinful wounds of my soul,

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Въ Недѣ́лю на Повече́ріи, Гла́съ в҃. р҃нѳ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...as having given birth unto the God-originate remedy of our nature.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: я́кѡ ро́ждшая бг҃онача́льнyю цѣльбy є҆стества̀. Сла́ва:
items.english_text: *Glory:* Loose the cords of my passions, O Lady, and sunder the chains of my sins with the weapon of thy prayers, as thou gavest birth unto Christ, Who grants deliverance unto those bound in hades.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Плени́цy страсте́й мои́хъ разрѣшѝ Влдко, и҆ вері́ги грѣхѡ́въ мои́хъ расто́ргни, ѻ҆рýжіемъ моли́твъ твои́хъ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ ро́ждшая, подаю́щаго и҆збавлені́е свѧ́заннымъ въ а҆́дѣ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Heal the passions of my soul which have darkened me most wretchedly; and enlighten my mind, driving far away, O Pure One, the hordes of demons that afflict me and spread nets for me all the days.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стра̑сти дyшѝ моеѧ̀ и҆сцѣлѝ, ѻ҆мрачи́вшіѧ мѧ̀ преѻкаѧ́ннѣ; и҆ по́мыслъ просвѣтѝ, дале́че ѿгона́ющи Чи́стаѧ тмы̑ бѣсѡ́въ ѻ҆скорблѧ́ющихъ мѧ̀, и҆ по всѧ̑ дни̑ сѣ̑ти простира́ющихъ мнѣ̀.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Enlightenment of those lying in darkness, Salvation of the despairing, O Christ my Savior, unto Thee do I rise early, O King of peace! Enlighten me with Thy radiance; for besides Thee I know no other God.[^1501]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣще́ніе въ тмѣ̀ лежа́щихъ, спасе́ніе ѿча́ѧнныхъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Спа́се мо́й, къ тебѣ̀ оу҆́треннюю Царю̀ ми́ра! просвѣти́ мѧ сіѧ́ніемъ твои́мъ; и҆но́гѡ бо ра́звѣ тебѐ Бг҃а не зна́ю.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As thou hast delivered the world from the ancient curse, O Lady, having given birth unto the Blessing of the world, Christ: deliver me from improper thoughts and all sorrow; for thou alone art the rejoicing of the faithful.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Ѿ клѧ́твы дре́вніѧ, мі́ръ я́кѡ и҆зба́вила є҆сѝ Влдко, мі́рy благослове́ніе Хрⷭ҇та̀ ро́ждшая, помышле́ній безмѣ́стныхъ и҆зба́ви мѧ̀, и҆ всѧ́кіѧ печа́ли; є҆ди́на бо є҆сѝ вѣ́рныхъ ра́дованіе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The demonic host surrounds the city of my soul, and strives exceedingly to plunder it. O most glorious Lady, City of the King of all, surround me with towering walls by thy prayers, and save me.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆крyжа́етъ дyшѝ моеѧ̀ гра́дъ, бѣсо́вскій по́лкъ, и҆ разплѣни́ти ѕѣлѡ̀ покyша́етсѧ. Пресла́внаѧ Влдко, гра́де всѣ́хъ Царѧ̀, ѻ҆гради́ мѧ сто́лпными стѣна́ми, твои́ми моли́твами, и҆ спасѝ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* A fierce tempest of perversions of the spirits of wickedness troubles my thoughts; come quickly beforehand and calm it, O thou who gavest birth unto the only Helmsman of all creation, Christ the Almighty.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Бýрѧ люта̀ развраще́ній, дyхѡ́въ лyка́вствіѧ, мою̀ мы́сль смyща́етъ; предварѝ ско́рѡ, и҆ оу҆ти́ши сію̀, Ро́ждшая всѧ́кіѧ тва́ри є҆ди́наго ко́рмчіа, Хрⷭ҇та̀ всеси́льнаго.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Cause the light of repentance to shine forth upon me, O Mother of God, who am shut up in destructive darkness; stretch forth a hand of help unto me who lie prostrate, and by thy prayers raise me up, O Pure One, to do the statutes of God.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Возсіѧ́й мнѣ̀ свѣ́тъ покаѧ́ніѧ Бг҃ороди́тельнице, въ тмѣ̀ поги́бельнѣй затворе́нномy; да́рyй рýкy по́мощи лежа́щемy, и҆ твои́ми моли́твами воздви́гни мѧ Чи́стаѧ, твори́ти Бж҃іѧ ѻ҆правда́ніѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Wallowing in the abyss of sin, I call upon the unfathomable abyss of Thy tender compassion: lead me up from corruption, O God![^1502]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днyю милосе́рдіѧ твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднy: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As thou gavest birth unto eternal Life, O Most Pure One, put death to death by thy prayers when my soul departs from the body.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Я́кѡ жи́знь вѣ́чнyю ро́ждшая Пречⷭ҇таѧ, ѿ тѣ́ла дyшѝ мое́й и҆сходя́щей, сме́рть твои́ми моли́твами оу҆мертвѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The man-hating serpent hunts tempting me; bring him to nought, O Lady, as thou gavest birth unto Him Who crushed the heads of dragons.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Лови́тъ и҆скyша́ѧ мѧ̀ ѕмі́й человѣ́конави́стный; сегѡ̀ оу҆празднѝ Влдко, я́кѡ ро́ждшая главы̑ сокрýшшаго ѕмі́евъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Guide unto the straight path me who have walked in perverse paths, O thou who didst bring forth the Way of life, Christ our God.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Heal the passions of my soul, and overcome the perplexity of grief, O Most Pure One, who didst give birth unto God for the salvation of men.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Then:* "Lord, have mercy," *thrice.* "Glory... Both now..."

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: Being the wellspring of loving-kindness, account us worthy of mercy, O Theotokos! Look upon a people who have sinned; show forth as always thy power; for hoping in thee, we cry aloud unto thee: "Rejoice!" even as once did Gabriel, Chief Commander of the Bodiless Powers.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Unto the golden image the all-wise youths served not, and went of themselves into the flame, and mocked their gods; amid the flame they cried aloud, and the Angel bedewed them: The prayer of your mouth has already been heard.[^1504]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A wave of passions troubles my mind and shakes my soul; but O Virgin, who didst bring forth Him Who by divine command bridles the surging sea: turn me unto the tranquility of dispassion, and still the carnal disturbance.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Knowing thee to be the door of the spiritual East, manifested from heaven, I, thy servant, pray to enter into heaven through thee, O Virgin. Therefore receive me, O Lady, and guide me by the light.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Christ Thy Son, willingly crucified upon the Cross, put to shame the principalities of darkness, and by death destroyed the corruptive power; by Him, O most pure Lady, mortify my passionate carnal mind.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Cease not, O Pure One, to pray unto God, Who was born of thee, for those who flee with faith unto thee and ask deliverance, O only Protectress of the world, Hope and Protection of the despairing, and ever-present Help of those tempest-tossed in bitter misfortunes.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Disregarding the golden image, the thrice-blessed youths, seeing the immutable and living image of God, sang in the midst of the fire: Let all existing creation praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^1505]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being the God-fashioned Tabernacle of the Holy of Holies, holding within the great High Priest Who showed forth the figure of the ancient tabernacle: show forth my heart, O Virgin, as a holy tabernacle of the Most High and King of all, Christ.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having borne the divine ark and the tablets of the covenant, the uncircumscribed...

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...Christ, O Virgin, the all-pure Word of God, cause Him to be written as upon the tablet of my soul by the finger of God through thy prayers.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Glory:* From thy womb was hewn out, O all-immaculate Lady, as from a mountain, the precious Stone, and as the only almighty Ruler He shattered the pillars of all delusion; through Him now destroy the forms of the passions of my soul, having crushed the jaws of spiritual enemies.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Both now:* With living waters, do thou water my heart dried up by the flame of sin, O Virgin Theotokos, ever preserving me in compunction, as with fear I sing: Let all creation praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Thee who didst ineffably give flesh from virginal loins unto God, the Luminary Who shone forth before the sun and came bodily unto us: O blessed and all-pure one, thee, O Theotokos, do we magnify.[^1506]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst cause Christ, the Sun of righteousness, to shine forth, O Pure One, and wast shown forth as a most radiant heaven; through Him dispel the night of my passions by thy prayers, and enlighten my soul, and illumine and make clear my heart.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Judge, O Theotokos, and overcome my fierce adversary, and deliver me from his affliction; for thou gavest birth unto the good and righteous Judge Who in the bosom of the Godhead condemned death.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Glory:* He Who as God composed the essences of the bodiless hosts was incarnate of thee, O Virgin Maiden; therefore deliver me, thy servant, by thy prayers from the carnal assault of passions and from carnal mindedness.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Thou didst destroy the grief of Eve, having given birth unto the new Adam, Who created the nature of Adam of old. Therefore tear up also the handwriting of my transgressions, freeing me from temptations, afflictions, and passions.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Then:* "It is truly meet;" *Trisagion; and after* "Our Father:" *troparia and the rest as usual, and Dismissal.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *ON MONDAY AT MATINS.*[^1507]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *After the first stichology, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 2.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* As the waves of the sea, mine iniquities have risen up against me; and like a ship in the deep, I alone...

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1 (continued):* ...am submerged by many transgressions; but guide me into the calm haven of repentance, O Lord, and save me.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* I am an unfruitful tree, O Lord, bearing no fruit of repentance at all; and I fear being cut down, and dread that unquenchable fire. Therefore I pray Thee: before that calamity come, convert and save me.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Being the wellspring of loving-kindness, account us worthy of mercy, O Theotokos! Look upon a people who have sinned; show forth as always thy power; for hoping in thee, we cry aloud unto thee: "Rejoice!" even as once did Gabriel, Chief Commander of the Bodiless Powers.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *After the second stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 2.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* "Have mercy on me," said David; and I cry unto Thee: I have sinned, O Savior! Cleanse my sins through repentance, and have mercy on me.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* "Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me," wept David over two sins; but I cry unto Thee over myriads of transgressions; he bedewed his bed with tears, but I have not acquired even a single drop. I am in despair, and I pray: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy.[^1510]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Having Thee as their vesture, Who dost deck the heaven with clouds, the holy ones endured torments in the world from the lawless, and abolished the idol delusion. By their prayers deliver us also from the invisible enemy, O Savior, and save us.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Thee do we magnify, O Theotokos, crying: Rejoice, O shut gate, through which ancient paradise was opened unto men!

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *After the third stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 2.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Sinning in ignorance and knowledge, by night and by day, angering Thee, O Christ, I alone upon earth by mine iniquities; O only Good and Sinless One, convert and save me by the supplications of Thine Angels, Thou Who camest in tender compassion to call sinners unto repentance.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* O most holy choirs of the Bodiless Powers, pray unto the good God and Master: to spare us...

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2 (continued):* ...in the hour of judgment, from demonic malice and the darkening of passions and from every threatening, who flee with love unto your protection.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* What mother was ever heard of as a virgin? Or what virgin was known as a mother? All things concerning thee are most glorious, O Theotokos! Therefore with faith do we magnify thee.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Canon of compunction, unto our Lord Jesus Christ, and unto His holy Martyrs.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Whose acrostic is: "Grant me a cloud of tears, O Word of God." (A composition of Joseph).*[^1513]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Ode 1, Tone 2. Heirmos:* Come, ye people, let us sing a song unto Christ God, Who divided the people whom He led forth from the bondage of Egypt; for He is glorified.[^1514]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having become incarnate, O Word, and having come not to call the righteous, as Thou didst say, but sinners unto repentance: receive me who have sinned greatly, and save me.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I alone am enslaved by sin; I alone have opened the doors unto the passions. O only Clement One, having converted me, save me by Thy tender compassion.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Before Thy judgment-seat, O Lord, the passion-bearers stand wearing crowns, having overcome the insolence of the evil one and been enriched with immortality.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Pouring forth streams of healings for us, the passion-bearers ever dry up the flows of the passions of our flesh by the power of the Holy Spirit.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O thou who didst give birth unto the Wellspring of dispassion, heal me who am wounded by passions, O Maiden, and snatch me from eternal fire, O only God-favored one.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Other Canon, unto the holy heavenly bodiless Angels.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Whose acrostic is: "I sing praise unto the Angelic choir." (A composition of Theophanes).*[^1515]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Ode 1, Tone 2. Heirmos:* Traversing an untrodden, unusual path through the sea without wetness, chosen Israel cried aloud: Let us sing unto the Lord, for gloriously has He been glorified![^1516]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As God-bearing embers, kindled by the brilliance of Thine essence, Thou hast shown forth the bodiless choirs, O Christ, who glorify Thee as Almighty.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having acquired the power of incorruption and the bestowed glory of immortality, O Christ, the Angels are enlightened by their drawing near unto Thee.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The light-bearing Angels have appeared, showing forth by forms that which is immaterial and according to nature, O Christ, sensibly depicting purity...

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The angelic ranks serve thy childbearing which is beyond nature, rejoicing, O Pure One! For thou gavest birth unto their God and Lord.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Establish us in Thee, O Lord, Who by the Tree didst slay sin, and plant Thy fear in the hearts of us who sing to Thee.[^1517]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou Who didst enter the incorrupt womb, O Christ: renew by repentance my soul which has been corrupted by passions, and show it forth filled with everlasting light.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I gave ear to the enemy who angers Thee, and committed every sin, and foolishly angered Thee, O Lover of mankind, the only Long-suffering One.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Warded about by the Cross, the invincible warriors and martyrs of the Savior, like walls, bravely in God tore down the strongholds of deceit.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Having strengthened your weakness by divine power, O valiant passion-bearers, ye consigned the might of the wrestler unto utter destruction.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Mary, golden censer, drive away the stench of my passions, and establish me who am shaken by the assaults of the deceitful wrestler.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* The bow of the mighty has been broken by Thy dominion, O Christ, and the weak have girded themselves with strength.[^1518]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* He Who by nature is immortal God, wisely working by grace, reveals the immortal hosts. *(Twice)*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Now standing before Christ with utmost longing, pray, ye Angels, that we all may be saved.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Truly the Maker of the ages received a temporal beginning from thee, O Mother Ever-virgin.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* I sing to Thee; for by report, O Lord, I heard and was afraid; for Thou comest unto me, seeking me who had strayed. Therefore I glorify Thy great condescension toward me, O Plenteous in mercy.[^1519]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I fell into the mire of sin and lost the heavenly fair comeliness, O Lord, and I fear torment. Therefore by the beauty of repentance enlighten my humble soul.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By deceitful words the deceitful one stole me away from Thee, and made me...

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...food for himself; O God of all, snatch me from his malice, and call me back by ways of repentance.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Being given over to be food for wild beasts, and burned with fire, O martyrs, and flayed, and torn limb from limb: having Christ as your Helper, ye denied Him not. Pray Him earnestly for me, the wretched one.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Honoring the Unity in essence, and Trinity in Persons, the uncreated Godhead, and by no means honoring creation, ye are recognized as Christ's martyrs; therefore ye endured all manner of torments.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Lord was willingly incarnate of thy pure blood and united with men, O Most Pure One! And He receives the repentant who of old were submerged in sins, ever inclined by thy supplications, O Pure One.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* I heard, O Lord, Thy glorious dispensation, and I glorified Thine incomprehensible power, O Lover of mankind.[^1520]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Bodiless Hosts do I bring unto Thee as intercessors; receiving them, O Bountiful One, as Thou art compassionate, deliver me from sins.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Drawing near unto the All-causing Mind, the divine minds, being purified, are enlightened with transcendent understandings.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The divine adornments of the heavenly hierarchy, being adorned by the Holy Spirit, are preserved immutably.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Perceiving thee from afar, O Virgin, as bearing God incarnate upon thine arms, Isaiah foretold.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Giver of light and Creator of the ages, O Lord, guide us in the light of Thy commandments; for besides Thee we know no other God.[^1521]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou Who didst enlighten the eyes of the blind man: enlighten my blinded soul, and strengthen it to watch unto good deeds, and to hate slothful sleep unto the end.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Heal, O only Savior, my soul truly wounded by the grievous wound of sin, Thou Who of old didst heal the wounds of him who fell among thieves.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* The assembly of honorable sufferers put to shame the assembly of lawless persecutors, having endured manifold pains, and now with the sacred Angelic assemblies ever rejoices...

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* As stars of many lights, the martyrs, having appeared most radiant, emit rays of endurance and enlighten the souls of the faithful by the Holy Spirit.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Anew, as a child, thou hast borne for us the pre-eternal Son, existing twofold in two wills and operations, as man and at the same time God, O All-hymned One.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* The Coal foreshadowed unto Isaiah, the Sun, shone forth from the Virginal womb, bestowing the enlightenment of divine knowledge upon those that had strayed in darkness.[^1522]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Shining near unto the divine Godhead with brightness, the Cherubim and Seraphim, together with the exalted Thrones, in godlike manner enlighten the rest. *(Twice)*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As Giver of all effusion of light, O Word of God, Thou hast brought forth mirrors of radiant form, which receive Thy beam with gladness and unwavering understanding.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The sacred Archangel Gabriel, flying down from heaven, announced joy unto thee, loosening the mourning of the forefathers, O pure Bride of God.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Wallowing in the abyss of sin, I call upon the unfathomable abyss of Thy tender compassion: lead me up from corruption, O God![^1523]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I have fallen down by the malice of the serpent, and lie upon the bed of despair; O Christ, Who didst raise up paralytics by a word, raise me up also.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Blown about by serpentine winds and ever engulfed by the waves of sin: save me, as Thou didst Peter, O Lord, Lover of mankind.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Transcending the bounds of nature, ye endured torments beyond nature; therefore ye were accounted worthy of good things beyond understanding, O martyrs.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* As good, as beautiful, as honorable, ye were united unto the Good-doing and Beautiful One, ever praying for us, O most glorious martyrs.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* From all generations the Creator chose thee, O All-immaculate One, the beauty of Jacob which He loved, and shining forth from thee He appeared.[^1524]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* Having heard the voice of suppliant words from an afflicted soul, O Master, deliver me from grievous evils; for Thou alone art the Cause of our salvation.[^1525]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The divine places of Thy glory, O Master Christ, kindled by radiant flashes of light of the Primal Light, abide eternally in radiant form by its beam. *(Twice)*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Strengthened by divine power, the Seraphim, crying aloud with unceasing voices the thrice-holy hymn, lead us to venerate the three-hypostatic Nature.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As the Lord swore in truth of old unto David, He fulfilled, coming forth from thy womb; for thou didst bear, O Maiden, Him Who reigns over heaven and earth.[^1526]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Unto the golden image served in the plain of Dura, Thy three youths paid no heed to the godless decree; but cast into the midst of the fire, bedewed they sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^1527]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By perversion of mind and demonic assaults having been filled with every shame, I went far from Thy commandments like the prodigal; but now turning back I cry: I have sinned like him; abhor me not, O Jesus, Who wast incarnate for my sake.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O God of all, Who of old didst save the Ninevites when they repented of the threat that brings forth death: likewise, O only Lover of mankind, deliver from bitter torments my heart, defiled with exceeding fornication, which now turns back unto Thee.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Grievously wounded was the evildoer who desired to wound you, O divinely blessed and godly martyrs, and he remained unhealed; while your wounds have been shown forth as healing for all the faithful who have been wounded by the assaults of the ancient supplanter.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Ye feared neither fierce beasts, nor the threatening of torturers, nor the cleaving sword, nor fiery vessels; but as though in alien bodies ye endured all things, O great martyrs! Therefore have ye been crowned.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thy womb became the dwelling-place of the immaterial Light, O all-pure Bride of God, Maiden, Who by the brightness of divine understanding drove away godlessness; singing unto Whom we cry: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* Orators were the most wise youths shown to be of old; for theologizing from a God-receiving soul, with lips they sang: O supremely transcendent God of our fathers and our God, blessed art Thou.[^1528]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Around the throne of Thine ineffable glory, the heavenly minds, ever keeping festival, chant with unceasing lips: O supremely transcendent God of our fathers and our God, blessed art Thou. *(Twice)*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When the Angelic ranks beheld Thee ascending into the heavens with flesh, they opened the heavenly gates unto Thee, singing: O supremely transcendent God of our fathers and our God, blessed art Thou.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Revealing thee as the fulfillment of the Law and the Prophets, O Maiden, Gabriel cried aloud: Behold, thou alone, O All-hymned One, dost give birth unto the supremely transcendent and blessed God of our fathers and our God.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Him Who descended into the fiery furnace unto the Hebrew youths, and changed the flame into dew, praise God as the Lord, ye works, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^1529]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I have fallen under the evil one, and have been enslaved by his wiles, and seeing me in great negligence, the deceitful one boasts; snatch me from him, O Bountiful One, Who art the Return of the strayed.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Loose me who am held fast by indissoluble bodily bonds of passions, Thou Who didst loose the indissoluble from eternal bonds, and guide me thither unto saving paths, O Christ, Savior of the world.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* The authors of passions truly built all malice upon humble me; but O blessed martyrs, who are truly imitators of Christ's Passions, deliver me from His harm.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Not bowing the knee unto idols, ye were cast of old into the furnace of wounds even as the youths, and by divine dew appearing ye remained unburned, O all-praised martyrs, singing unto Christ unto the ages.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Стропѡ́тныѧ стєзѝ ше́ствовавшаго, къ пра́вѣй стезѝ наста́ви, я҆́же пýть жи́зни ро́ждшаѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Theotokos, Virgin, by thy healing supplications make whole my wretched soul, weakened by many assaults of the evil one, that I may glorify thee unto all ages.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ подо́бїи зла́тѣ небре́гше требл҃же́ннїи ю҆́нѡши, неизмѣ́нный и҆ живы́й Бж҃їй ѻ҆́бразъ ви́дѣвше, средѝ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ воспѣва́хꙋ: ѻ҆сꙋществова́ннаѧ да пое́тъ Гдⷭ҇а всѧ̀ тва́рь, и҆ превозно́ситъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *On Monday at Matins, Tone 2.*[^1530]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Подо́бїа твоеѧ̀ бл҃гости соста́вилъ є҆сѝ А҆́гг҃лы, за́пѡвѣди твоѧ̑ крѣ́постїю соверша́ющїѧ Сло́ве, и҆ споспѣ́шествꙋющїѧ всѣ̑мъ вѣ̑рнымъ зва́ти: ѻ҆сꙋществова́ннаѧ да пое́тъ Гдⷭ҇а всѧ̀ тва́рь, и҆ превозно́ситъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* Disregarding the golden image, the thrice-blessed youths, beholding the immutable and living image of God, sang in the midst of the fire: Let all creation, brought into being, praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^1531]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃е́ственными добродѣ́тельми небе́сное ꙋ҆краси́лъ є҆сѝ житїѐ, ст҃ы́хъ А҆́гг҃лъ свѧщеннонача́лїе, просвѣща́ѧ си́хъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ вопію́щихъ: ѻ҆сꙋществова́ннаѧ да пое́тъ Гдⷭ҇а всѧ̀ тва́рь, и҆ превозно́ситъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As likenesses of Thy goodness hast Thou composed the Angels, O Word, who perform Thy commandments with might, and help all the faithful to cry: Let all creation, brought into being, praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дꙋющесѧ свѣ́тлѡ, воспои́мъ бж҃е́ственное пѣ́нїе безпло́тныхъ неоскꙋ́днѣ, и҆ Влⷣкꙋ бг҃осло́вѧще, пѣ́снь съ ни́ми возопіи́мъ: ѻ҆сꙋществова́ннаѧ да пое́тъ Гдⷭ҇а всѧ̀ тва́рь, и҆ превозно́ситъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With divine virtues hast Thou adorned the heavenly life, the hierarchy of the holy Angels, illuminating them as they cry unto Thee, O Christ: Let all creation, brought into being, praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Пра́вость ꙗ҆́же мꙋ́дрѣ всѧ̑ пра́вѧщаѧ, возлюбѝ досто́йнѡ тѧ̀ пренепоро́чнꙋю и҆ пречи́стꙋю Дѣ́вꙋ, несказа́ннѡ прест҃а́ѧ Бцⷣе, въ тѧ̀ все́льшаѧсѧ; ю҆́же славосло́вимъ: да пое́тъ Гдⷭ҇а всѧ̀ тва́рь, и҆ превозно́ситъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Rejoicing brightly, let us sing the divine hymn of the incorporeal ones unceasingly, and theologizing the Master, let us cry aloud the song with them: Let all creation, brought into being, praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆́тъ Бг҃а Бг҃а Сло́ва, неизрече́нною мꙋ́дростїю, прише́дшаго ѡ҆бнови́ти А҆да́ма, ꙗ҆́дїю въ тлѣ́нїе па́дшаго лю́тѣ, ѿ ст҃ы́ѧ Дѣ́вы неизрече́ннѡ воплоти́вшагосѧ на́съ ра́ди, вѣ́рнїи є҆диномꙋ́дреннѡ пѣ́сньми велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Uprightness, which wisely directs all things, worthily loved thee, the all-spotless and all-pure Virgin, having ineffably taken up abode in thee, O most holy Theotokos; Whom we hymn in glory: Let all creation, brought into being, praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ вре́мѧ дѣ́ланїѧ; что̀ спи́ши, без̾ ꙋ҆ма̀ дꙋшѐ, въ ꙋ҆ны́нїи глꙋбо́цѣ? Воста́ни, слеза́ми просвѣтѝ свѣщꙋ̀ твою́. Потщи́сѧ, приближа́етсѧ жени́хъ дꙋша́мъ. Не ꙋ҆коснѝ, да не ѡ҆ста́нешисѧ бж҃е́ственныхъ двере́й внѣкꙋ́дꙋ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* God the Word of God, Who by ineffable wisdom came to renew Adam, who through eating had grievously fallen into corruption, and Who for our sake was ineffably incarnate of the Holy Virgin, with one mind we the faithful magnify in songs.[^1532]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́ль стра́шное твоѐ сꙋди́ще, ꙗ҆влѧ́ющее всѧ́ко дѣѧ́нїе на́го, предъ А҆́гг҃лы и҆ человѣ́ки! Ѡ҆ ко́ль лю́тое и҆зрече́нїе, є҆́же согрѣ́шшымъ хо́щеши да́ти! ѿ негѡ́же и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, пре́жде конца̀ пода́ѧ мнѣ̀ ѡ҆браще́нїа сле́зы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Behold, the time for labor! Why sleepest thou without mind, O my soul, in deep despondency? Arise, brighten thy lamp with tears! Make haste, the Bridegroom draws nigh unto souls; linger not, lest thou be left outside the divine doors![^1533]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Зна́менавшесѧ бж҃е́ственною А҆́гнца и҆ Па́стырѧ кро́вїю, сла́внїи бж҃е́ственнїи страда́лцы, закала́еми ра́довахꙋсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡже неѕло́бивїи а҆́гнци; и҆ ны́нѣ всю̀ перворо́дныхъ це́рковь ст҃ꙋ́ю, вои́стинꙋ на небесѣ́хъ просвѣща́ютъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O how fearful is Thy judgment-seat, revealing every deed bare before Angels and men! O how severe the sentence which Thou shalt deliver unto sinners! Deliver me therefrom, O Christ, granting me tears of conversion before the end!

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Зна́менавшесѧ бж҃е́ственною А҆́гнца и҆ Па́стырѧ кро́вїю, сла́внїи бж҃е́ственнїи страда́лцы, закала́еми ра́довахꙋсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡже неѕло́бивїи а҆́гнци; и҆ ны́нѣ всю̀ перворо́дныхъ це́рковь ст҃ꙋ́ю, вои́стинꙋ на небесѣ́хъ просвѣща́ютъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Marked with the divine blood of the Lamb and Shepherd, the glorious, divine sufferers rejoiced when being slaughtered like innocent lambs; and now they truly illuminate in the heavens the whole holy Church of the firstborn.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Зна́менавшесѧ бж҃е́ственною А҆́гнца и҆ Па́стырѧ кро́вїю, сла́внїи бж҃е́ственнїи страда́лцы, закала́еми ра́довахꙋсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡже неѕло́бивїи а҆́гнци; и҆ ны́нѣ всю̀ перворо́дныхъ це́рковь ст҃ꙋ́ю, вои́стинꙋ на небесѣ́хъ просвѣща́ютъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon (continued):* Appearing like luminaries of solar radiances, with the rays of your sufferings ye enlighten every soul and drive away all darkness of deception, O noble sufferers; therefore ye are worthily called blessed in faith.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Зна́менавшесѧ бж҃е́ственною А҆́гнца и҆ Па́стырѧ кро́вїю, сла́внїи бж҃е́ственнїи страда́лцы, закала́еми ра́довахꙋсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡже неѕло́бивїи а҆́гнци; и҆ ны́нѣ всю̀ перворо́дныхъ це́рковь ст҃ꙋ́ю, вои́стинꙋ на небесѣ́хъ просвѣща́ютъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Spare me, O Lord, spare me, when Thou art about to judge me, and condemn me not into fire, nor rebuke me in Thy wrath: the Virgin who gave birth unto Thee, O Christ, entreats Thee, with the multitude of Angels, and the assembly of martyrs.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Зна́менавшесѧ бж҃е́ственною А҆́гнца и҆ Па́стырѧ кро́вїю, сла́внїи бж҃е́ственнїи страда́лцы, закала́еми ра́довахꙋсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡже неѕло́бивїи а҆́гнци; и҆ ны́нѣ всю̀ перворо́дныхъ це́рковь ст҃ꙋ́ю, вои́стинꙋ на небесѣ́хъ просвѣща́ютъ.
items.english_text: *Other Heirmos:* Wholly desire, wholly sweetness art Thou, O Word of God, Son of the Virgin, God of gods, O Lord, most holy of the saints! Therefore with her who gave Thee birth we all magnify Thee.[^1534]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers
items.slavonic_text: Зна́менавшесѧ бж҃е́ственною А҆́гнца и҆ Па́стырѧ кро́вїю, сла́внїи бж҃е́ственнїи страда́лцы, закала́еми ра́довахꙋсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡже неѕло́бивїи а҆́гнци; и҆ ны́нѣ всю̀ перворо́дныхъ це́рковь ст҃ꙋ́ю, вои́стинꙋ на небесѣ́хъ просвѣща́ютъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Appearing in white forms, light-like, the Angels declared unto Thy divine disciples Thy second coming, O Christ; with whom we all, theologizing Thee, magnify Thee. *(Twice)*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As the Benefactor of all rational nature, Thou makest a second brightness for Thy first ray, by reason of Thine extreme goodness; therefore we all, giving thanks, magnify Thee.

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Understanding thy light-formed virginity, O All-pure One, and marveling, the divine Archistrategos brought joy unto thee; therefore we all magnify thee as Theotokos.

items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet: Litany, Exapostilarion, and the rest as usual.*

items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Meditating upon the improper things, the evils wrought by me, I flee unto Thy compassions, imitating the publican, and the weeping harlot, and the prodigal son. Therefore also I fall down before Thee, O Merciful One: before Thou judgest me, spare me, O God, and have mercy on me.

items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Disregard my transgressions, O Lord born of the Virgin, and cleanse my heart, making it a temple for Thy Holy Spirit. Cast me not away from Thy presence, Thou Who hast measureless, great mercy.

items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and establish Thou the works of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish Thou.* [^1536]

items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Having suffered for Christ even unto death, O passion-bearers,

items.english_text: *Martyrikon (continued):* O martyrs! Ye have your souls in the heavens in the hands of God, and throughout all the world your relics are venerated. Priests and kings bow down, and all we people, rejoicing, customarily cry: Precious before the Lord is the death of His venerable ones!
