items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* The Son of the Unoriginate Begetter, God and Lord, incarnate of the Virgin, hath appeared unto us, to enlighten them that are in darkness and to gather the scattered; therefore do we magnify the all-hymned Theotokos.[^1852]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Return me, O Lord, who am condemned, who am uncorrected, who have disregarded Thy commandments, and have followed demonic delusion unto the harm of my mind, through the prayers of Thine Apostles. *(Twice)*[^1853]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O glorious Apostles, blessed Apostles, and Disciples of the Savior, all-wise preachers: deliver me from all harm, from all wrath, from all sin, from all adversity, and from diverse perils.[^1854]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* I bring an uncorrected soul, and a conscience buried together with things of transgression, and a defiled...[^1855]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (continued):* ...heart, and a polluted thought, and I cry unto Thee, O Lover of mankind: for the sake of the Apostles, have compassion on me by Thy mercy.[^1856]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Apostles proclaimed thy Son throughout all the world, O Most Pure One, as God and man; therefore with them entreat Him that in the dread day of judgment they who magnify thee in faith may be delivered from torments.[^1857]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], Ode 9. Heirmos:* God the Word of God, who by ineffable wisdom came to renew Adam who by eating had grievously fallen into corruption, and who was ineffably incarnate for our sake of the holy Virgin: Him do we the faithful with one mind magnify in songs.[^1858]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A rule of priesthood and a pattern of meekness do I know thee to be, O wise Nicholas! The tempest of passions and perils that rises up against me every day: calm by thy prayers, and preserve me unharmed, O most sacred father.[^1859]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As a most sacred vessel receptive of the divine myrrh mercifully poured forth upon earth: perfume the hearts of us all, O wise one, having been primate of the people of Myra, driving away the stench of temptation by thy prayers.[^1860]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Do thou comfort my soul, O Father, which is invisibly and grievously afflicted by a multitude of evils; do thou calm my measureless temptations which the deceitful one stirs up against me by day and by night, appearing as my good intercessor, O Nicholas.[^1861]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* The dread Day of the Master draws nigh at the doors: what wilt thou do, O my soul, having a multitude of sins? Hasten therefore before the end, and cry aloud diligently unto the Lord: Through the prayers of Nicholas Thy hierarch, save me![^1862]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Spare me, O Lord, spare me when Thou shalt come to judge, and condemn me not unto the fire, neither rebuke me in Thine anger: the Virgin who bare Thee entreats Thee, O Christ, together with the multitude of the Apostles, and glorious Nicholas.[^1863]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet; and a prostration. Little Litany, Photogogic, and the usual Psalms.*[^1864]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Apostles, Tone 2.*[^1865]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Въ чре́во твоѐ всели́вся, є҆го́же и҆зъ чре́ва превѣ́чный О҆ц҃ъ родѝ Сы́на, соверше́нъ бы́сть человѣ́къ; и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благода́тей тѧ̀ Богома́ти показа̀ на́мъ, вѣ́рнѡ кла́няющимсѧ несказа́нномꙋ твоемꙋ̀ Рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Thou didst magnify in the universe the names of the supreme Apostles, O Savior; for they learned of heavenly things, and bestowed ineffable healings upon earthly men; and their very shadows cured diseases, working wonders though they were from fishermen, and though from...[^1866]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: іуде́й богосло́вахꙋ благода́ти оу҆че́нїа; и҆́хже ра́ди Благоꙋтро́бне, да́ждь на́мъ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: ...Jews, they theologized the doctrines of grace; for their sake, O Compassionate One, grant unto us great mercy.[^1867]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: И҆спо́лнихомсѧ заꙋ́тра ми́лости твоеѧ̀ Гдⷭі, и҆ возра́довахомсѧ: - - - И҆ при́зри на рабы̑ твоѧ̑, и҆ на дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, и҆ наста́ви сы́ны и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* We who are ever assailed by unrighteous deeds and who flee unto Thee, the truly existing God, bring unto Thee the voice of Thy disciples, saying: Master, save us, we perish! Show now also unto our enemies, we beseech Thee, that Thou dost shelter Thy people and deliver them from perils, overlooking our sins through the prayers of the Apostles, according to Thy great goodness: O Lord, glory to Thee![^1869]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ѿ непра́ведныхъ дѣѧ́нїй всегда̀ бори́ми, и҆ къ тебѣ̀ прибѣга́ющїи вои́стинꙋ сꙋ́щемꙋ Бг҃ꙋ, гла́съ твои́хъ оу҆чени́къ прино́симъ тебѣ̀ глаго́люще: спаси́ ны наста́вниче, погиба́емъ. Покажѝ и҆ ны́нѣ врагѡ́мъ на́шымъ, мо́лимсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ покрыва́еши лю́ди, и҆ спаса́еши ѿ бѣ́дъ, моли́твами А҆по́столъ презира́ѧ грѣхѝ, за мно́гꙋю благосты́ню. Гдⷭі сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* The multitude of Thy saints entreat Thee, O Christ: have mercy and save us, for Thou art the Lover of mankind.[^1871]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: И҆ бꙋ́ди свѣ́тлость Гдⷭа Бг҃а на́шегѡ на на́съ, и҆ дѣла̀ рꙋ́къ на́шихъ и҆спра́ви на на́съ; и҆ дѣ́ло рꙋ́къ на́шихъ и҆спра́ви.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* All my hope do I place upon thee, O Mother of God: preserve me under thy shelter.[^1872]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧты́хъ твои́хъ мно́жество, мо́литъ тѧ̀ Хрⷭтѐ; поми́лꙋй и҆ спасѝ на́съ, ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣколю́бецъ.
items.english_text: *Then: It is good to give praise; Trisagion Prayers; and after Our Father: the troparia, and litany.*[^1873]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Всѐ оу҆пова́нїе моѐ на тѧ̀ возлага́ю, Мт҃и Бж҃їа, сохрани́ мѧ подъ кро́вомъ твои́мъ.
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 2.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Та́же: Бла́го є҆́сть: Трисвѧто́е, и҆ по Оу҆́тче на́шъ: тропарѝ и҆ є҆ктентїа̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* We bring unto Thee the voice of the thief, and cry aloud unto Thee: Remember us, O Savior, in Thy kingdom.[^1874]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ тебѣ̀ прино́симъ разбо́йничкь, и҆ вопїе́мъ ти: поманѝ на́съ Спа́се въ ца́рствїи твое́мъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having traversed the fullness of the world, O Apostles, ye delivered mankind from the darkness of the delusion of impiety, O all-wise ones.[^1875]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Мірска̑ѧ и҆сполне́нїа проше́дше А҆пⷭли, ѿ тмы̀ пре́лести ѕлоче́стїа, человѣ́ки и҆зба́вили є҆стѐ, премꙋ́дрїи.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* By the net of grace, O disciples of the Savior, ye wisely drew up all men from the depth of vanity.[^1876]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Мре́жею благода́ти, и҆зъ глꙋбины̀ сꙋ́етства, всѣ́хъ человѣ́къ, оу҆ченицы̀ Спа́сѡви, мꙋ́дрѣ возвелѝ є҆стѐ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having finished the course and kept the faith, let us the faithful with one accord hymn the passion-bearers of the Lord.[^1877]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же тече́нїе сконча́вшїа, и҆ вѣ́рꙋ соблю́дшїа, страстоте́рпцы Гдⷭни, согла́снѡ вѣ́рнїи воспои́мъ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Triadikon:* Having preached the Son co-equal in operation with the Father together with the Spirit, let us hymn the uncreated Trinity.[^1878]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^1720]
items.slavonic_text: Равнодѣ́телна Роди́телю Сы́на съ Дх҃омъ, проповѣ́давше, воспои́мъ Трⷪ́цꙋ несозда́ннꙋю.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* The boast of the Apostles, the ornament of the sufferers art thou, O Most Pure Virgin, and the salvation of the world.[^1879]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 2.*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* When Thou, O Savior, wast nailed unto the Cross, the sun seeing it was darkened at fear of Thee, and the veil of the temple was rent in twain, the earth was shaken, and the rocks likewise were split with trembling, unable to endure beholding their Creator and God suffering unjustly on the Tree of Thine own will, and reviled by lawless men.[^1881]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Utterly cast down unto the earth, utterly wounded, the all-evil serpent lies by a marvelous fall, when Thou, O Lover of mankind, wast lifted up upon the Tree; and Adam who was formerly condemned is loosed from the curse and saved. Therefore we also pray: Save all of us, O Bountiful One, and count us worthy of Thy kingdom.[^1882]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* When the lawless people nailed Thee, the Life of all, unto the Cross, O Savior, then all creation trembled with fear; the kingdoms of hades and the whole dominion of death were cast down by Thy divine power; then also Adam the forefather rejoicing cried out unto Thee: Glory to Thy condescension, O Lover of mankind![^1883]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Then the Stichera of the Menaion for the Saint. But if there is no Menaion, we chant these Cross-Theotokia [Stavrotheotokia]:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion 1:* Beholding Thee lifted up upon the Tree of the Cross, O Jesus, the Unwedded Maiden wept and said: O sweet Child, why hast Thou left me alone who bare Thee? O Inaccessible Light of the Pre-eternal Father! Hasten and be glorified, that they who glorify Thy divine passions may receive divine glory.[^1885]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion 2:* When the Virgin beheld Life dying upon the Tree, and His side painfully pierced with a spear, weeping she cried aloud: O my Son and my God, what hath the ungrateful assembly repaid Thee? Woe is me! Unable to endure the pangs, I am consumed in my womb, seeing Thee suffering these things, O Master.[^1886]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion 3:* When the Unwedded Maiden saw her Son taken down from the Tree and laid outstretched upon the earth lifeless as a man, embracing Him in her bosom and kissing His lips and eyes, she cried aloud marvelously unto Him: How do I now see Thee, who givest life to all, speechless and motionless? Truly a great wonder![^1887]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: When the undefiled Ewe-lamb saw her Lamb led voluntarily unto slaughter as a man, weeping she said: Dost Thou now hasten to make me childless, O Christ, who bare Thee? What is this that Thou hast done, O Redeemer of all? Yet do I hymn and glorify Thine extreme goodness surpassing mind and word, O Lover of mankind.[^1888]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Then: O Gladsome Light; Prokeimenon of the day; Vouchsafe, O Lord.*[^1889]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 2.*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Save me, O Christ the Savior, by the power of the Cross, Thou Who didst save Peter in the sea, and have mercy on me, O God.[^1890]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Let Him be crucified! cried out they who continually enjoyed Thy gifts; and the murderers of the righteous asked to receive a malefactor instead of the Benefactor. But Thou wast silent, O Christ, enduring their cruelty, desiring to suffer and to save us, for Thou art the Lover of mankind.[^1892]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us... Our soul is exceedingly filled: an object of reproach unto the prosperous, and of contempt unto the proud.* [^1893]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* The passion-bearers, having not loved earthly pleasures, were accounted worthy of heavenly good things, and became fellow-citizens with the angels. O Lord, by their prayers, have mercy and save us.[^1894]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: When the lawless people lifted Thee up upon the Tree, O Savior, the Life of all, then Thy pure and all-spotless Mother standing by and sobbing cried aloud: O my sweet Child! Light of mine eyes! Woe is me! How hast Thou endured to be nailed unto the Cross in the midst of two malefactors, Thou Who didst suspend the earth upon the waters?[^1895]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Then: Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart; Trisagion Prayers; after Our Father: troparion, and the Dismissal.*[^1896]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Supplicatory Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Tone 2. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Of old the transcendent power laid low the entire host of Pharaoh in the deep; and the Word incarnate hath abolished all-wicked sin, the most glorious Lord: for He is gloriously glorified.[^1897]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As beautiful, as all-comely, as spotless among wo-...[^1898]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (continued):* ...-men, God chose thee and took up His abode in thy spotless womb. Entreat Him, O All-Spotless One, to deliver from the stain of sins all them that hymn thee.[^1899]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In the manner of the psalm, O Pure One, as queen thou didst stand at the right hand of the King Who shone forth from thy womb; entreat Him, O All-Spotless One, that He may show me forth standing at His right hand in the day of creation.[^1900]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having given birth unto the Heavenly Rain, thou didst renew the nature of mankind utterly dried up by improper deeds. Therefore I pray thee: Show the parched furrow of my soul fruitful, O Bride of God.[^1901]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Slain by the plant of knowledge, by the Tree of Life, O Pure One, we were called unto eternal life through Christ God, Who blossomed forth beyond understanding from thee, O Theotokos. Entreat Him with boldness that our souls may be saved.[^1902]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* The desert hath blossomed as a lily, O Lord, the barren Church of the nations by Thy coming, wherein my heart is established.[^1903]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having come forth from thy womb, O Most Pure One, the Creator clothed Himself in me, a man, granting a garment of incorruption unto him that was stripped naked by many evil deeds.[^1904]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst bear the priceless God the Word, O Sovereign Lady! Entreat Him diligently to have compassion on my humble soul which mourns because of shameful pleasures.[^1905]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Heal the wounds of my soul, O Most Pure One, and with thine effective medicine cure my humble heart embittered by the venom of the serpent.[^1906]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* As the Mother having boldness toward thy Son, O Sovereign Lady, ask help for the afflicted people, and cast down the haughtiness of the lawless.[^1907]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Thou didst come from the Virgin, not an ambassador, nor an angel, but Thyself, O Lord, incarnate, and didst save me, the whole man; therefore I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^1908]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Rain down upon me a drop of compunction, O Sovereign Lady, taking away all the burning heat of my heart, and my sorrow, and driving away harmful assaults.[^1909]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Wounded by the weapon of pleasure and lying in sores, despise me not, O Most Pure One, but heal me...[^1910]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...by the spear and blood of Thy crucified Son and our God.[^1911]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Enriched with every creation of the Master, account me, who am grievously impoverished, worthy of divine grace, that I may magnify thee as my good protectress, O All-Spotless One.[^1912]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Christ, the Father's Radiance, shone forth from thy womb, O Unwedded Maiden, and being crucified enlightened the universe, and destroyed the demonic darkness.[^1913]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Thou wast a Mediator between God and men, O Christ God; for through Thee, O Master, we have access from the night of ignorance unto Thy Father, the Source of Light.[^1914]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having given birth unto the Way of life, O Most Pure One, direct me now into the right path, who have been foolishly cast down into pathlessness and onto the shore of grievous falls.[^1915]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having senselessly alienated myself from the knowledge of God, I lived prodigally, wandering in the far country of passions; but turn me back, O Pure Virgin, and save me by thy consolation.[^1916]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* With thy living waters give drink unto thy servant, who am inflamed with the fire of sin and scorched by demonic assaults, O Virgin Mother most pure.[^1917]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Behold, in thy womb, O Most Pure Theotokos, thou didst hold Christ God beyond word, even as Isaiah proclaimed, and beyond nature didst bear Him, O Parent of God.[^1918]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Wallowing in the abyss of sin, I invoke the unfathomable abyss of Thy compassion: from corruption, O God, bring me up.[^1919]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Show me not forth as a joy unto demons at the future judgment seat, O Sovereign Lady! But looking favorably upon me, entreat the Judge and thy Son.[^1920]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having provoked Thee to anger by thoughts, O Lord, and by my deceitful and unclean deeds, I bring Thy Mother in prayer unto Thee: show compassion and save me.[^1921]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Deliver me from condemnation, O Sovereign Lady, who am self-condemned by transgressions, since thou didst give birth unto the Judge and God of all, O All-Hymned One.[^1922]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Entreat Jesus the Savior, Whom thou didst supernaturally bear in the flesh, O Virgin Mother most pure, that thy servants may be delivered from tribulations.[^1923]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Then: Lord, have mercy (Thrice). Glory... both now...*[^1924]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: The Virgin and Thy Mother, O Christ, beholding Thee stretched out dead upon the Tree, weeping bitterly, said: O my Son, what is this strange mystery? Thou Who bestowest eternal life upon all, how of Thine own will dost Thou die upon the Cross an ignominious death?[^1925]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The godless decree of the lawless tyrant raised a high flame; but Christ spread out spiritual dew upon the pious children, He Who is blessed and supremely glorified.[^1926]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being my strength, and song, and salvation, and firm protection, and an unconquerable wall, O Sovereign Lady: conquer the demons that war against me, who ever seek to put me to death.[^1927]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having incarnated God by thy virginal blood, O Virgin, thou didst deify humanity. Therefore I pray thee: by thine intercessions deliver me who am defiled by passions and corrupted by the wiles of the enemy.[^1928]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The furnace prefigured thy childbearing, O All-Spotless One! For it burned not the children, even as the unapproachable fire burned not thy womb. Therefore we pray thee: Deliver thy servants from eternal fire.[^1929]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* A most pure conception and incorrupt childbearing thou alone didst manifest, remaining a Virgin; for thou didst conceive Christ, O Pure One, God over all, become man for the salvation and deliverance of the faithful.[^1930]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The fiery furnace of old in Babylon divided its operation at the command of God, consuming the Chaldeans, but bedewing the faithful as they sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord![^1931]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Emulate the good, having departed from evil through care for divine deeds, O my soul, having the Parent of God praying for thee, and possessing her who is an unashamed protectress of all, as merciful and loving of goodness.[^1932]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst loose the human bond of the ancient condemnation. Therefore I pray thee, O Parent of God: loose every evil bond of my heart...[^1933]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...binding me, O Most Pure One, with the divine love of the Creator.[^1934]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having given birth unto the Radiance of the Father's glory, O Theotokos, illuminate my heart mourning in the dishonor of transgressions, and show me forth a partaker of everlasting glory, that with faith I may glorify thee.[^1935]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* From thee, O Parent of God, the true Sun of Righteousness hath appeared unto us, enlightening all things with the beams of the Godhead: the Most High incarnate, Whom we hymn in song.[^1936]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* The Son of the Unoriginate Begetter, God and Lord, incarnate of the Virgin hath appeared unto us, to enlighten them that are in darkness, and to gather the scattered; therefore do we magnify the all-hymned Theotokos.[^1937]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having tasted from the tree the food mingled with death, Adam found bitterness; but Thy Son, O Most Pure One, nailed upon the Tree, poured forth the sweetness of immortality: therefore do we praise thee.[^1938]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Queen art thou, who beyond word didst bear Christ the King and Lord, Who demolished the kingdoms of hades. Diligently entreat Him, O Maiden, to count all them that honor thee worthy of the heavenly kingdom.[^1939]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Comfort my humble heart, O Sovereign Lady, afflicted by the enclosures of pleasure, as the Parent of the Good One, and being wholly good; and lead me into the good doors of repentance.[^1940]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Thou wast dead, lifted up upon the Cross; thereby Thou didst slay the serpent. Therefore I cry unto Thee: Have mercy on my soul slain by deceitful deeds, O Word, and quicken it through the prayers of her that bare Thee.[^1941]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet; Trisagion Prayers, and the rest.*[^1942]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *On Friday at Matins.*[^1943]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *After the First Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 2.*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Thou hast wrought salvation in the midst of the earth, O Christ God, stretching out Thy most pure hands upon the Cross, gathering all the nations who cry: O Lord, glory to Thee![^1944]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* In the very manner whereby the enemy made captive Adam through the tree of eating, in like manner, O Lord, hast Thou Thyself taken captive the enemy through the Tree of the Cross and through Thy Passion...[^1946]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2 (continued):* ...for unto this art Thou come, the Second Adam, to seek him that was lost and to quicken him that was dead: O God, glory to Thee![^1947]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Stavrotheotokion:* The Virgin and Thy Mother, O Christ, beholding Thee stretched out dead upon the Tree, weeping bitterly, said: O my Son, what is this strange mystery? Thou Who bestowest eternal life upon all, how of Thine own will dost Thou die upon the Cross an ignominious death?[^1948]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *After the Second Stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 2.*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* The Life-Giving Cross of Thy goodness, which Thou hast bestowed upon us the unworthy, O Lord, do we bring in supplication unto Thee: save the Emperor *(Name)*, and Thy city, granting peace, for the sake of the Theotokos, O sole Lover of mankind.[^1949]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* We worship Thine immaculate Icon, O Good One, asking forgiveness of our transgressions, O Christ God; for of Thine own will Thou wast pleased to ascend the Cross in the flesh, that Thou mightest deliver them whom Thou hadst created from the bondage of the enemy. Therefore thankfully do we cry unto Thee: Thou hast filled all things with joy, O our Savior, Who art come to save the world.[^1951]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having Thee, Who clothest the heaven with clouds, as their raiment in the world, the Saints endured torments from the lawless, and abolished the delusion of idols. By their prayers set us also free from the invisible enemy, O Savior, and save us.[^1953]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Standing by Thy Cross, she that bare Thee without seed, O Christ, unable to endure seeing Thee suffering unjustly, sobbed with weeping and cried out unto Thee: How dost Thou suffer, Who art impassible by nature, O sweetest Son? I hymn Thine extreme goodness.[^1954]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *After the Third Stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 2.*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Like the thief do I make confession, and cry aloud unto Thee, O Good One: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy kingdom, and number me with him, Thou Who of Thine own will didst endure the passions for our sake.[^1955]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Having enlightened earthly things by Thy Cross, and called sinners unto repentance: separate me not from Thy flock, O Good Shepherd! But seek me out who have gone astray, O Master, and number me with Thy hundredfold flock, for Thou art the sole Good One and Lover of mankind.[^1956]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Preserved by the Precious Cross of thy Son, O Sovereign Lady, pure Theotokos, we all easily conquer every assault of the adversary; therefore as is meet do we call thee blessed, as the Mother of God, and the sole hope of our souls.[^1957]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Precious and Life-Giving Cross.*[^1958]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: When the Cross was planted, demonic delusion fell.)*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Tone 2. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Having traversed an untrodden, unaccustomed, unwetted sea path, the chosen Israel cried aloud: Let us sing unto the Lord, for He is gloriously glorified![^1959]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst accept crucifixion, and wast ignominiously nailed with nails, O Word, desiring to bestow honor upon all men who glorify Thy voluntary sufferings.[^1960]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst stretch out Thy palms upon the Cross, O Savior, Who didst stretch out heaven like a curtain, wherewith Thou didst embrace the nations and peoples who glorify Thy voluntary passions.[^1961]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Taking the cross upon their shoulders, the passion-bearers fervently followed Christ Who was crucified, conforming themselves unto His divine passions.[^1962]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* The angelic hosts sang praises, beholding your sufferings; but the multitude of demons wailed, O victorious martyrs most contemplative of God.[^1963]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Theotokion [Stavrotheotokion]:* The word of the honorable Prophet is fulfilled: for a sword pierced thy heart, O Sovereign Lady, when thou didst behold thy Son nailed upon the Cross.[^1964]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Most Holy Theotokos.*[^1965]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Tone 2. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Come, ye peoples, let us sing a song unto Christ God, Who divided the sea and guided the people whom He led forth from the bondage of Egypt: for He is gloriously glorified.[^1966]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having given birth unto the Fountain of dispassion, O Maiden, heal me who am wounded by passions, and snatch me from eternal fire, O sole Rejoiced of God.[^1967]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Deliver me from bodily sicknesses, and heal the improper passions of my soul, and snatch me from eternal fire, O sole Divine-Grace-bestowed One.[^1968]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Under thy goodness do I now flee, O Virgin Mother most pure: deliver thy servant from sicknesses of soul, and passions...[^1969]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (continued):* ...corruptive of the soul, and from eternal fire.[^1970]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Thou art my fervent mercy-seat, O Sovereign Lady; unto thee do I run and am saved, and I obtain spiritual salvation: for thou canst save all, as being the Mother of God.[^1971]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Having established me upon the rock of faith, Thou hast enlarged my mouth against mine enemies; for my spirit rejoiced to sing: There is none holy as our God, and none righteous save Thee, O Lord![^1972]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The incorrupt Cluster hanging upon the Tree dripped divine sweetness gladdening the hearts of men, destroying the drunkenness of malice: Jesus, the Redeemer of our souls.[^1973]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Of Thine own will Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree, O Jesus, and didst cast down all the evildoing of the devil; and men who had fallen into perdition through a corrupted mind hast Thou lifted up, O Many-Merciful One.[^1974]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Inflamed with the fire of divine love, the noble ones feared not the fire, neither were they terrified of death, hoping to receive the immortal gifts: unending joy and unwaning light.[^1975]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* The passion-bearers dyed a most radiant purple robe in their own blood, and with it were clothed; and bearing in their right hand the divine Cross as a scepter, they reign ever with the Lord.[^1976]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Theotokion [Stavrotheotokion]:* The ranks of the bodiless honor thee; for thou didst bear the Master of all in the flesh, Who through the Tree loosed all them that were bound, O Maiden, Bride of God, and bound the faithful unto His love.[^1977]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], the Heirmos the same.*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst bear the Unoriginate King, Who received flesh from thee, O Virgin Mother: Him therefore entreat as the Lover of mankind, to save thy servant from every affliction and from future condemnation.[^1978]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Dispel the perplexity of my heart, heal my wounds, and drive away festering sores by thy divine power; and grant unto me a stream of compunction, O thou that didst bear the Ever-Living Fountain.[^1979]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: А҆по́столѡвъ похвала̀, страда́лцевъ оу҆добре́нїе, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, и҆ мі́ра спасе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Heal my soul that is sick with demonic assaults and despondency, O Parent of God; and tears...[^1980]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: ...покаѧ́нїа да́ждь се́рдцꙋ моемꙋ̀, и҆ Влады́ки моегѡ̀ стра́хъ всадѝ въ не́мъ Пречи́стаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (continued):* ...of repentance grant unto my heart, and plant within it the fear of my Master, O Most Pure Lady.[^1981]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Лѣ́ностїю жи́знь мою̀ и҆жди́въ, и҆ страстьмѝ се́рдце моѐ ѡ҆скверни́въ, прихождꙋ̀ къ тебѣ̀ Влады́чице оу҆миле́нїемъ дꙋшѝ, и҆ молю́сѧ: оу҆ще́дри и҆ спаси́ мѧ, покаѧ́нїа мѧ̀ ѻ҆́бразы оу҆твержда́ющи.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having spent my life in slothfulness, and having defiled my heart with passions, I come unto thee, O Sovereign Lady, with compunction of soul, and I pray: Have compassion and save me, establishing me in the ways of repentance.[^1982]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Прише́лъ є҆сѝ ѿ Дѣ́вы, не хода́тай ни А҆́гг҃лъ, но са́мъ Гдⷭи вопло́щсѧ, и҆ спа́слъ є҆сѝ всего́ мѧ человѣ́ка. Тѣ́мъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ̀: сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й Гдⷭи.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Thou hast come from the Virgin, not an intercessor, nor an angel, but Thou Thyself, O Lord, incarnate, and hast saved me, the whole man. Therefore do I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^1983]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Повѣ́шенъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ на дре́вѣ, повѣ́сивый зе́млю на вода́хъ Всеси́льне! копіе́мъ же въ ре́бра пробода́емь, кро́вь съ водо́ю и҆ска́палъ є҆сѝ на и҆збавле́нїе всѣ́хъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou wast suspended upon the Tree, O Almighty One, Who didst suspend the earth upon the waters; and pierced in the side with a spear, Thou didst pour forth blood with water unto the redemption of all.[^1984]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Прободе́нꙋ ти ребрꙋ̀ и҆сцѣлѣ̀ болѣ́знь моѧ̀; рꙋко́ю по лани́тѣ бїе́нꙋ тебѣ̀, свобо́дꙋ оу҆лꙋчи́хъ, же́лчи же вкꙋше́нїемъ, сластна́гѡ и҆зба́вихомсѧ Хрⷭтѐ бра́шна.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When Thy side was pierced, my sickness was healed; when Thou wast struck on the cheek with a hand, I obtained freedom; and by the tasting of gall, O Christ, we were delivered from pleasurable food.[^1985]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Стрꙋ́пми ѡ҆стрꙋ́пльше ѕмі́а льсти́ваго, и҆сцѣля́ете стрꙋ́пы се́рдцъ на́шихъ всегда̀, благода́ть и҆сточа́юще ѿ и҆сто́чникъ Спа́совыхъ, бж҃е́ственнїи Мꙋ́ченици.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having wounded the deceitful serpent with your wounds, ye heal the wounds of our hearts at all times, pouring forth grace from the springs of the Savior, O divine martyrs.[^1986]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Всетѣле́снꙋю ꙗ҆́звꙋ врагꙋ̀ нанеслѝ є҆стѐ Всечестні́и, ꙗ҆́звами ѡ҆кровавля́еми, на крестѣ́ же протаза́еми, и҆ ѡ҆дира́еми, бг҃озра́чнїи страстоте́рпци.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Ye inflicted a wound unto the whole body of the enemy, O all-honored ones, being bloodied with wounds, stretched out upon the cross, and flayed, O passion-bearers of divine countenance.[^1987]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Воплоти́сѧ и҆зъ пречи́стыхъ крове́й твои́хъ Вы́шнїй; є҆го́же ви́дѧщи на дре́вѣ Пречи́стаѧ, безъ пра́вды воздвиза́ема, стена́ше слезѧ́щи, и҆ тогѡ̀ благоꙋтро́бїе велича́ла є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion [Stavrotheotokion]:* The Most High took flesh from thy most pure blood; and beholding Him unjustly lifted up upon the Tree, O Most Pure Lady, thou didst groan in tears and magnify His loving-kindness.[^1988]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Пою́ тѧ; слꙋ́хомъ бо Гдⷭи оу҆слы́шахъ и҆ оу҆жасо́хсѧ; до менѐ бо и҆́деши, менѐ и҆щѧ̀ заблꙋ́ждшаго. Тѣ́мъ мно́гое твоѐ снизхожде́нїе є҆́же на мѧ̀, прославлѧ́ю, Многоми́лостиве.
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], Heirmos:* I sing to Thee; for by hearing, O Lord, have I heard and was afraid; for Thou comest unto me, seeking me who am lost. Therefore do I glorify Thy great condescension toward me, O Many-Merciful One.[^1989]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Пою́ тѧ вои́стинꙋ Всепѣ́таѧ, препѣ́таго Бг҃а Сло́во па́че є҆стества̀ ро́ждшꙋю, и҆ молю́сѧ: смире́нныѧ дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ бѡлѣ́зни и҆сцѣлѝ, и҆ ѿ лю́тагѡ мѧ и҆зба́ви ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїа.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Truly do I praise thee, O All-Lauded Lady, who beyond nature didst give birth unto the All-Praised God the Word; and I pray: Heal the sicknesses of my humble soul, and deliver me from grievous condemnation.[^1990]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆бы́чнѡ на ны̀ бога̑тыѧ твоѧ̑ ми́лости Дѣ́во ѡ҆роша́еши, недꙋ́ги оу҆ставлѧ́ющи, и҆ стра̑сти разрꙋша́ющи разли́чныѧ дꙋшѝ. Тѣ́мже разрѣшѝ се́рдца моегѡ̀ плени́цы грѣхѡ́вныѧ, и҆ болѣ́зней мно́гихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Habitually dost thou bedew us with thy rich mercies, O Virgin, soothing infirmities and breaking the diverse passions of the soul. Therefore loose the sinful bonds and many afflictions of my heart.[^1991]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* I have defiled my soul with passions; do thou, who wast...[^1992]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (continued):* ...a most pure habitation unto the Most Pure One, cleanse me, O Parent of God, guiding me unto the light of repentance and snatching me from the fire to come.[^1993]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Enlighten my mind, O most pure Sovereign Lady, I pray thee; calm the waves of my passion-tossed heart, destroying carnal desires, and bringing me unto the divine haven.[^1994]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* The Coal revealed unto Isaiah, the Sun, shone forth from the virginal womb, granting the enlightenment of the knowledge of God unto them that were lost in darkness.[^1995]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* For the sake of mercy Thou didst partake of the Cross, O Master, and from the depth of evils Thou didst pluck me, and didst honor me by seating me together with the Father, having willingly undergone dishonor.[^1996]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Crowned with thorns, O Thou Who crownest all the earth with flowers, Thou cuttest down the thorns of my passions by the root, O Word, and plantest within me Thy understanding.[^1997]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Willingly clothing yourselves in strength through your infirmity, O holy martyrs, and being fortified, ye utterly destroyed the power of the demons.[^1998]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having contended greatly upon earth, O holy ones, ye found great glory in the heavens, and ye deliver us from great afflictions who honor you.[^1999]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Theotokion [Stavrotheotokion]:* He Who in a manner befitting God is borne upon the shoulders of the cherubim in the heavens, truly seated upon thy hands, O Most Pure Lady, was crucified and delivered all from corruption.[^2000]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], Heirmos:* O Enlightenment of them that lie in darkness, Salvation of the despairing, O Christ my Savior, unto Thee I rise early, O King of peace; enlighten me with Thy brightness, for I know no other God save Thee.[^2001]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Quicken me who have been slain by the snares and traps of the deceitful one, O all-immaculate Sovereign Lady Theotokos, who didst bear the hypostatic Life of all, that in godliness I may sing to thee, the all-lauded one.[^2002]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Virgin Mother, who didst show forth the Lamb and Shepherd, shepherd me who wander in my ways, and vouchsafe me on the Day of Judgment to be numbered among the sheep on the right hand, that I may sing of thy saving grace.[^2003]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* From the darkening of passions, from stumbling-blocks abounding through the assaults of the stranger, and from the future eternal torments of them that sin, deliver me, O Maiden, by thy supplications, I pray.[^2004]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O Bride of God, into whom the one Divine Word entered, enlightening all the inhabited earth, make the dawn of true repentance to shine upon me; illuminate me with saving rays, dispersing the darkness of my passions by thy supplications, I pray.[^2005]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Having heard the voice of suppliant words from an afflicted soul, O Master, deliver me from grievous things; for Thou alone art the Cause of our salvation.[^2006]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having given Thy back to stripes, and Thy cheeks to blows, and Thy face, O Savior, to spitting, Thou didst save me who have sinned greatly against Thee, in knowledge and in ignorance.[^2007]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Even as a Lamb wast Thou led to slaughter, O Christ my God, bringing back again unto life them that were slain by the venomous biting of the noetic wolf: Glory to Thy crucifixion![^2008]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Keeping the laws of the Master, O martyrs, ye completely turned away from the lawless counsel of the transgressors, and having died, ye received the life to come.[^2009]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Joyfully arraying yourselves against the adversary powers, O holy ones, ye conquered them with divine weapons, and received crowns of victory from God.[^2010]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Theotokion [Stavrotheotokion]:* That He might deify man, God is born of thee, O Virgin, and is crucified, and tastes death, slaying by the Cross him that of old had slain me.[^2011]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], Heirmos:* Rolling in the abyss of sin, I call upon the unfathomable abyss of Thy mercy: From corruption, O God, bring me up.[^2012]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Now do I flee unto thee, O All-Lauded Lady, save me by thy prayers and preserve me; for whatsoever thou desirest, thou canst do, as the Mother of Him Who strengthens all things.[^2013]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Tossed by the tempest of sorrows, and overwhelmed by the onsets of churning waves, save me, thy servant, O Virgin Theotokos.[^2014]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Vouchsafe me thy mercy, who am held fast by mercilessness and malice; and from the torments lying before me, and from the eternal fire, snatch me away.[^2015]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having conceived the most pure Lamb Who takes away the sins of the world, thou didst bear Him, O All-Immaculate Lady; cease not to pray unto Him to grant me the forgiveness of sins.[^2016]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The God-opposing command of the lawless tyrant lifted up a high flame, but Christ spread spiritual dew over the godly youths, He Who is blessed and supremely praised.[^2017]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having been lifted up upon the Cross, O Word, Who art the Resurrection and Co-elevation of all, Thou didst raise me up who was fallen through transgression, and didst cast down the adversary who cast us down, showing him to be utterly impotent and dead: Glory to Thy dominion![^2018]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With nails Thou didst nail the sins of the forefather, O Christ, and struck with a reed, Thou didst write freedom for all men: Glory to Thy suffering, whereby we were delivered from the darkness of passions![^2019]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Cleaved upon your bodies by abominable murderous hands, O fair-victorious great martyrs of Christ, ye remained in spirit inseparable from God, cutting down with the sword of courage and slaying the deceitful enemy.[^2020]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having the invincible strength of Christ Who was crucified, the undefeated army utterly destroyed the destructive host; and having suffered, it received as a crown of victory the blessed and imperishable life.[^2021]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Theotokion [Stavrotheotokion]:* Thou hast shown thyself to be the animate palace of the King, O Virgin, and His fiery-formed throne, sitting upon which He raised up all men from their first fall, and honored them by seating them together with the Father.[^2022]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], the Heirmos the same.*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O thou that didst give birth unto the hypostatic Life for us, Who by death visibly abolished death, put to death the passions of my heart, and grant me a fountain of tears, O Pure Lady, that I may ever glorify thee.[^2023]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O hope that puts not to shame, sure expectation and unassailable rampart, be thou a protection and helper unto me, O All-Immaculate One, who hope in thee; and guide me, O Pure Lady, unto the light of repentance and compunction.[^2024]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Entreat Thy Son that Thy servant may be delivered from every demonic malice, and sorrow, and condemnation, and eternal fire, that in faith I may ever glorify thee.[^2025]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* A most pure conception and an incorrupt birthgiving hast thou alone shown forth, having remained a Virgin; for thou didst conceive Christ, O Pure One, God over all, Who became man...[^2026]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4 (continued):* ...unto the salvation and redemption of the faithful.[^2027]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Disregarding the golden image, the thrice-blessed youths, beholding the immutable and living image of God, sang in the midst of the fire: Let all creation that has been brought into being praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^2028]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A disobedient people, performing all lawless deeds without fear, lifted Thee up and crucified Thee upon the Tree between two lawless ones, O Compassionate One, Who justifiest the lawless; yet all creation glorifies Thee as Lord and Master, singing of Thy longsuffering.[^2029]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst bloody Thy fingers, O Christ, when nailed unto the Tree, and didst cause to cease the blood offered of old unto demons unto the destruction of them that offered it; therefore all creation glorifies Thee, singing of Thy love for mankind, O God of all.[^2030]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Being filled with living waters, the martyrs dried up the deceitful torrents by the divine streams of their blood, crying with unwavering faith: Let all creation that has been brought into being praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^2031]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* The countless multitude of your blood, O holy ones, extinguished the fire of impiety and destroyed the polytheistic delusion of the Hellenes; and it enlightened all the faithful who sing: Let all creation praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages![^2032]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Theotokion [Stavrotheotokion]:* The Spotless Ewe-Lamb, the adornment of the prophets and martyrs, beholding Thee, the Lamb, lifted up upon the Tree, O Unoriginate Word, wept bitterly and said: Let all creation that has been brought into being praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages![^2033]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], Heirmos:* Unto God Who descended into the fiery furnace unto the Hebrew youths, and changed the flame into dew, sing, ye works, as unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^2034]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O refuge and helper of Christians, despise me not who am held in grievous things, O most pure Virgin, compassed about ever by tribulations, and by many assaults of the wicked demons.[^2035]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Forget not the voice of thy suppliants, O awesome Protectress, but from every affliction and from every threatening snatch us away by thy supplications; for...[^2036]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...thy maternal prayer inclines God to mercy.[^2037]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Quench now the fierce storm of my passions, O pure and blessed Lady, and conquer, O Maiden, all the bodiless foes who mercilessly assault my poverty, that in faith I may sing to thee.[^2038]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* From the furnace of temptations, from the flame of sins, and from the fire of passions and Gehenna, and from demonic assault at the hour of my end, snatch me away, O sole Parent of God, Protectress of the faithful.[^2039]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Every tongue is at a loss to praise thee as is meet, and an intellect even of the transcendent world is dazed to sing to thee, O Theotokos; yet since thou art good, accept our faith, for thou knowest our divine love; for thou art the Protectress of Christians: thee do we magnify.[^2040]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* That Isaac might prefigure of old Thy Passion, he was bound, O Word! But the bound ram in the same figure in the bush of Sabek was untied for remission, and an involuntary sacrifice was truly dismissed; for when Thou wast willingly sacrificed, we were loosed from evils.[^2041]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Being comely in beauty beyond the sons of men, O Christ, yet having neither beauty nor form in Thy Passion, suspended upon the Tree of the Cross, Thou didst adorn the ugliness of all the human race: Glory to Thy loving-kindness, O only merciful Lord![^2042]
