items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Ye were revealed as divine citizens of Zion on high, and martyrs equal in honor with the angels as fellow-citizens; and ye radiantly enlighten the Church of the firstborn, O holy ones, shining with divine light and adorned with crowns of martyrdom.[^2043]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* O beloved friends of Him Who gloriously loved you, deliver me from deceitful friendship with the flesh, O holy martyrs of the Lord! And ask sanctification, enlightenment, and remission of grievous transgressions for all them that celebrate your memory.[^2044]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Theotokion [Stavrotheotokion]:* The beauty of the luminaries gave way from its customary course when they beheld Thee, the Sun of Righteousness, willingly lifted up upon the Cross; and the Virgin with the Virgin Disciple cried out with weeping: Woe is me! exclaiming: What is this strange sight?[^2045]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], Heirmos:* The Son of the Unoriginate Parent, God and Lord, incarnate of the Virgin, hath appeared unto us...[^2046]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Heirmos (continued):* ...to enlighten them that were darkened, and to gather together them that were scattered: Therefore the all-lauded Theotokos do we magnify.[^2047]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Beyond mind and word didst thou give birth unto the Lover of mankind, the only many-merciful Lord; Him entreat, O Virgin, at the dread hour of judgment, to deliver thy servant from the eternal fire.[^2048]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Unto us who sing to thee, and glorify thee in faith, and ever flee unto thy divine protection, grant from heaven deliverance from grievous and tormenting passions, O Bride of God, and deliver us from torment and judgment.[^2049]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Fair to behold, but in tasting most bitter, was the fruit of sin that slew me, wherewith I was filled unto satiety, and I anticipate the dreadful judgment: snatch me away from it, O most holy Virgin Mother.[^2050]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Sweeten my humble heart, O Most Pure Lady, embittered by pleasurable bondages, as the Parent of the Good One, being wholly good; and lead me unto the good gates of repentance.[^2051]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Then, "It is truly meet:" Litany, Exapostilarion, and the customary Psalms.*[^2052]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 2:*[^2053]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* The Tree of Thy Cross, O Christ God, hast Thou shown forth as a tree of life unto us who believe in Thee, and thereby having brought to nought the power of him that had the dominion of death, Thou didst quicken us who were slain by sin. Therefore do we cry unto Thee: O Benefactor of all, Lord, glory to Thee![^2054]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord: [and we rejoiced and were glad. And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works,] and guide their sons.* [^2055]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Willingly didst Thou become poor, on account of Adam's poverty, O Christ God; Thou camest upon the earth, incarnate of the Virgin, and didst receive crucifixion, that Thou mightest free us from the slavery of the enemy: Lord, glory to Thee![^2056]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having suffered for Christ even unto death, O passion-bearing martyrs, ye have your souls in the heavens in the hand of God, and throughout the whole world your relics are venerated; priests and kings bow down, and all people rejoicing cry out in harmony: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones![^2058]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: O Thy goodness! O loving-kindness surpassing intellect! O Thy abundant bounty and longsuffering, O pre-unoriginate Word! the Virgin cried out, weeping: How hast Thou, Who art immortal, loved to die? A great mystery do I behold; yet I worship Thy Passion, which Thou didst willingly endure.[^2060]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *It is good to give thanks unto the Lord: Trisagion. After "Our Father:" troparion and litanies. Then the First Hour.*[^2061]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 2:*[^2062]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: The voice of the thief do we bring unto Thee, and we pray: Remember us, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom.[^2063]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst uproot the wicked thorn, O Master, having willingly worn a crown of thorns, O longsuffering One.[^2064]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Being crucified upon the Place of the Skull, O Sinless One, Thou didst crush the head of the evil one, and didst save all men.[^2065]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Crushed, O martyrs, ye crushed all the power of the enemy, and received crowns of victory.[^2066]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Triadikon:* Enlightened by the sprinkling of the divine blood, we the faithful honor one Godhead in three Persons.[^2067]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^1880]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Christ as a Lamb suspended upon the Tree, the All-Immaculate Lady, sobbing with tears, magnified Him.[^2068]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerables:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Delivering your flesh to wounds, and enduring most bitter torments and violent death, O all-lauded martyrs, ye put the tormentors to shame, and truly abolished idolatrous honors, proclaiming Christ as the one God and Master, before Whom, with the angelic choirs, ye glorious crown-bearers stand. *(Twice.)*[^2071]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Ye were revealed as divine preachers of the Word Who appeared upon earth, and ye taught all godliness, setting forth the Orthodox exposition of divine doctrines, whereby ye drove heresy far away from the Church of Christ. Therefore, as sacred ministers of the Trinity, bring all into the ever-living mansions, O blessed ones.[^2072]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, for the Martyrs, Same Tone:*[^2073]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Having not loved earthly delights, the passion-bearers were accounted worthy of heavenly good things, and became fellow-citizens of the angels: O Lord, by their prayers have mercy on us and save us.[^2074]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* While the holy martyrs pray for us and sing to Christ, all delusion has ceased, and the human race is saved by faith.[^2075]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* The choirs of the martyrs resisted the tormentors, saying: We are soldiers of the King of hosts; though ye deliver us to fire and torments, we deny not the power of the Trinity.[^2076]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion [Dogmatikon]:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: The shadow of the law passed away when grace arrived; for even as the bush burned not being consumed, so as a Virgin didst thou give birth, and a Virgin didst thou remain; instead of a pillar of fire, the Sun of Righteousness shone forth; instead of Moses, Christ, the Salvation of our souls.[^2077]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Then, "O Joyful Light:" Prokeimenon of the day. "Vouchsafe, O Lord:"*[^2078]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 2:*[^2079]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Great is the glory which ye acquired by faith, O holy ones; for not only in sufferings did ye conquer the enemy, but even after death ye drive away spirits and heal the sick, physicians of souls and bodies: Pray unto the Lord that our souls may be saved.[^2080]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Departed:* Like a flower man withers, and like a shadow he passes away; each man is dissolved. But again, when the trumpet sounds, the dead, as in an earthquake, shall all arise to meet Thee, O Christ God! Then, O Master, settle the spirits of Thy servants whom Thou hast translated from us in the tabernacles of Thy saints.[^2082]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Departed:* Woe is me! what an agony has the soul when being separated from the body; woe is me! how greatly it weeps then, and there is none...[^2084]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *For the Departed (continued):* ...who shows mercy unto it; lifting up its eyes unto the angels, it prays in vain; stretching out its hands unto men, it has none to help. Therefore, my beloved brethren, having understood our brief life, let us ask rest from Christ for the departed, and for our souls great mercy.[^2085]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: Save Thy servants from perils, O Virgin Theotokos; for next to God we all flee unto thee, as unto an unbreakable rampart and protection.[^2086]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion; after "Our Father:" Troparion and dismissal.*[^2087]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Supplicatory Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.*[^2088]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Tone 2. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Come, O ye peoples, let us sing a song unto Christ God, Who divided the sea, and guided the people whom He brought out of the bondage of Egypt; for He is glorified.[^2089]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Refrain:* Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.[^2090]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou art the fountain of life, O pure Virgin Mother, having given birth unto the Prince and Lord, the Life of all, bedewing them that in faith glorify thee.[^2091]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Being enriched, we possess thee as a foundation and protectress, who confess thee to be the Theotokos, O Most Pure One, and from the surge of life's billows are we saved, O all-immaculate Virgin.[^2092]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O thou that didst bear the Fountain of immortality, heal me who am wounded with passions, O Maiden, and snatch me from eternal fire, O sole Divine-Grace-bestowed One.[^2093]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O refuge of the faithful, Ever-Virgin, and mighty help of them that flee unto thee, save us from every necessity and harm of the adversary.[^2094]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Establish us in Thee, O Lord, Who by the Tree didst put sin to death, and plant Thy fear in the hearts of us who sing to Thee.[^2095]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Truly as the golden censer, and the jar of manna, and the divine mountain, and the exceedingly fair palace of God, do we name thee, O Virgin.[^2096]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ; чистѣ́йшее ты̀ бы́вши...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Being the temple and sacred dwelling of the Word, O Theotokos, be thou ever the cleansing of my transgressions, O most holy Virgin.[^2097]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ Пѧто́къ на Повече́рїи, Гла́съ в҃.           с҃лѳ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Neither an earthly tongue nor an intellect of the bodiless powers is able to tell of thy childbearing; for beyond nature and understanding, O Theotokos, didst thou give birth unto the Creator.[^2098]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ни ꙗ҆зы́къ зе́мленъ, ни оу҆́мъ безпло́тныхъ, возмо́жетъ рождество̀ твоѐ сказа́ти; па́че є҆стества́ бо и҆ смы́сла Бцⷣе, Зижди́телѧ родила̀ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Be thou a confirmation, refuge, and protection, O Virgin Birthgiver of God, unto them that in faith flee unto thee and confess thee to be the Mother of God.[^2099]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆твержде́нїе бꙋ́ди и҆ прибѣ́жище и҆ покро́въ, Дѣ́во Богороди́телнице, вѣ́рою къ тебѣ̀ прибѣга́ющимъ, и҆ Бж҃їю тѧ̀ Ма́терь и҆сповѣ́дающимъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* I heard, O Lord, Thy glorious dispensation, and I glorified Thy unsearchable power, O Lover of mankind.[^2100]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ Гдⷭи, сла́вное твоѐ смотре́нїе, и҆ просла́вихъ Человѣколю́бче, непостижи́мꙋю твою̀ си́лꙋ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* We Christians have gained thee, O Theotokos, as a great help: snatch us away from grievous perils.[^2101]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тѧ̀ Бцⷣе стѧжа́хомъ хрⷭтїа́не по́мощь ве́лїю, ѿ лю́тыхъ бѣ́дъ на́съ и҆схи́ти.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O unwedded Lady, who didst conceive God in Thy womb: deliver us all from tribulations and sorrows.[^2102]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ Влⷣчце, ꙗ҆́же Бг҃а въ оу҆тро́бѣ заче́нши, напа́стей и҆ печа́лей всѣ́хъ на́съ и҆зба́ви.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* We the faithful have gained thee, O Pure One, as an invincible rampart and a mighty hope in tribulations, O Theotokos.[^2103]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Непобѣди́мꙋю стѣ́нꙋ тебѐ, и҆ держа́внꙋю наде́ждꙋ Бцⷣе, вѣ́рнїи стѧжа́хомъ въ напа́стехъ, Чи́стаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having gained thy prayer, O Lady, as a firm foundation, we are delivered from diverse afflictions.[^2104]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Моли́твꙋ твою̀ Влⷣчце, ꙗ҆́кѡ тве́рдъ степе́нь стѧжа́вше, разли́чныхъ скорбе́й и҆збавлѧ́емсѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Giver of light and Creator of the ages, O Lord, guide us in the light of Thy commandments; for besides Thee we know no other God.[^2105]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́та Пода́телю, и҆ вѣкѡ́въ тво́рче Гдⷭи, въ свѣ́тѣ твои́хъ повелѣ́нїй наста́ви на́съ; ра́звѣ бо тебѐ и҆но́гѡ Бг҃а не зна́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Incarnate of thee, O Birthgiver of God, have we the faithful known the Son born without seed, true God and man by nature; therefore do we glorify thee.[^2106]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Воплоще́нна и҆зъ тебѐ Богороди́телнице, вѣ́рнїи позна́хомъ безъ сѣ́мене Сы́на рожде́на, Бг҃а и҆́стинна, и҆ человѣ́ка є҆стество́мъ; тѣ́мже тѧ̀ сла́вимъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Under thy shelter and protection, O Most Pure One, we the faithful, ever fleeing in faith, are delivered through thee, O Theotokos, from every grievous assault.[^2107]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Подъ кро́въ тво́й и҆ застꙋпле́нїе, Пречи́стаѧ, вѣ́рнїи всегда̀ прибѣга́юще вѣ́рою, и҆збавлѧ́емсѧ тобо́ю Бцⷣе, всѧ́кагѡ та́жкагѡ наше́ствїа.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Deliver us from perils and from the storm of thoughts, O Most Pure One, from all wrath, from every sin, from famine and pestilence, and from eternal torment, O Virgin.[^2108]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви на́съ ѿ напа́стей, и҆ бꙋ́ри помышле́нїй Пречи́стаѧ, всѧ́кагѡ гнѣ́ва, всѧ́кагѡ грѣха̀, гла́да же и҆ гꙋби́тельства, и҆ вѣ́чнагѡ Дѣ́во мꙋче́нїа.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Being our Protectress, salvation, and hope, O Lady of Christians: save them that ever faithfully sing to thee with love, O all-hymned Virgin.[^2109]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Застꙋ́пница на́ша и҆ спасе́нїе, и҆ наде́жда Влⷣчце, Хрⷭтїа́нъ сꙋ́щи, спасѝ любо́вїю тѧ̀ при́снѡ вѣ́рнѡ воспѣва́ющихъ, Дѣ́во всепѣ́таѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Wallowing in the abyss of sin, I call upon the unfathomable abyss of Thy mercy: from corruption, O God, raise me up![^2110]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* He Who by His will works all things, having by His will dwelt within the womb of the Unwedded One, hath enriched with incorruption them that were sick with corruption, as He is merciful.[^2111]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Higher than the heavenly powers and more holy art thou, O All-Immaculate One, having contained in thy womb beyond nature the uncontainable Word.[^2112]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Lead me who have strayed upon the path of life, and who through lawlessness often fall into sins, O Lady, unto the paths of repentance.[^2113]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Despise not, O Pure One, our entreaties, the servants who have placed our hope in thee; for thou art a refuge, O Lady, and the cleansing of souls.[^2114]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Then: Lord, have mercy (thrice). Glory... Both now...*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: Thou didst conceive the Word without seed, and didst give birth unto the only Son, Christ; for thou didst bear as a new child Thine own Creator. Therefore do we magnify thee, O Theotokos.[^2115]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Unto the golden image worshipped in the plain of Dura, Thy three youths paid no heed, disregarding the godless command; but cast into the midst of the fire, being bedewed, they sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^2116]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The noetic Son, consubstantial with the Father, hast thou incarnated by the power of the All-Holy Spirit, O Lady graced of God; Him, therefore, pray unceasingly to show compassion unto them that sing: Blessed art thou who didst give birth unto God in the flesh![^2117]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O pure, unwedded, holy, and blessed Virgin, the restoration of the falling, the deliverance of them that sin! save me, a prodigal, save me, crying unto thy Son: Blessed art thou who didst give birth unto God in the flesh![^2118]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* A firm haven, an awesome protectress, and an impregnable rampart unto them that are in distress through necessities and tossed by the tempest in sorrow: by thy prayers unto thy Son, being the Theotokos, save thy servants from manifold temptations.[^2119]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O thou sole hope and help of the faithful, Birthgiver of God, make haste to help thy servants who are submerged by sorrows, at a loss on every side, who are in afflictions, and who flee unto thee with love of soul.[^2120]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Unto God Who descended into the fiery furnace unto the Hebrew youths, and changed the flame into dew: sing, ye works, as unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^2121]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being a living fountain, having given birth unto the Water of life, bedew my soul that is melted by the flame of sin, O Virgin Theotokos, that I may glorify thee unto all ages.[^2122]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Them that were put to death and brought down unto mortal and corruptible dust didst thou alone raise up, having given birth unto the Prince of life, Christ our God, O Lady, Virgin pure and blessed.[^2123]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Deliver me, O pure Lady, from eternal fire and condemnation, and snatch me away from evil-doing men and them that seek to entrap me, that I may ever call thee blessed, whom all creation divinely blesses.[^2124]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* In the likeness of flesh was the Pre-divine One seen from thee, O pure Virgin! Him pray unceasingly to show mercy unto us who live in malice and tremble at the eternal torment.[^2125]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* God the Word from God, Who by ineffable wisdom came to renew Adam who had grievously fallen into corruption through eating, and Who was ineffably incarnate of the Holy Virgin for our sake: with one mind in hymns do we the faithful magnify Him.[^2126]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Vouchsafe me divine love for mankind, O Maiden, who alone didst ineffably give birth unto God, the Lover of mankind, Who borrowed flesh from thee; and deliver me from future flame and from every torment, who glorify thee in love.[^2127]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having gained thee as a mighty protectress, as hope and rampart, and foundation and firm protection, and invincible confirmation and calm haven, and sovereign refuge: we all are saved, O All-Hymned One.[^2128]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Virgin, Birthgiver of Light, drive away the clouds of my soul, and grant me purely to behold the saving beauty, O Lady, which shone forth ineffably from thy most holy womb as a light unto the nations, O All-Hymned One.[^2129]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O thou who didst bear the Divine Light, enlighten my heart that is darkened by the onslaught of many passions and alienating thoughts, O Maiden, giving me a drop...[^2130]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4 (continued):* ...ever granting tears, O Virgin, which cleanse the defilement of sin.[^2131]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet; Trisagion; and after "Our Father:" the remainder as usual, and dismissal.*[^2132]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *After the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Martyrs, Tone 2.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: Having Thee as a garment in the world, Who clothest heaven with clouds, the saints endured tortures from lawless ones, and abolished the deception of idols. By their prayers free us also, O Savior, from the invisible enemy, and save us.[^2133]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: Apostles, Martyrs, and Prophets, Hierarchs, Venerables, and Righteous ones, who have fought the good fight and kept the faith, having boldness before the Savior: pray Him as good, we beseech you, on our behalf, that our souls may be saved.[^2135]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: As God ruling over both the dead and the living, possessing authority over all, O Giver of life, receive the supplication of Thy servants; show Thy mercy, O Lover of mankind, and grant remission unto the souls which in hope in Thee Thou hast translated, for the sake of Thy tender-heartedness, as Thou art good.[^2137]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: All beyond understanding, all most glorious are thy mysteries, O Theotokos! Though sealed in purity and preserved in virginity, thou wast known to be an unfeigned Mother, having given birth unto the true God: Him pray, that our souls may be saved.[^2138]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *After the second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 2.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: O Thou Who hast enlightened Thy saints more than gold, and hast glorified Thy venerable ones as Thou art good: being entreated by them, O Christ God, bring peace unto our life as Lover of mankind, and direct our prayer as incense, O Thou Who alone restest in the saints.[^2139]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: O passion-bearers of the Lord! Blessed is the earth that was drenched with your blood, and holy are the shrines that received your bodies; for at the tribunal ye convicted the enemy, and with boldness preached Christ: Pray Him as good, we beseech you, that our souls may be saved.[^2140]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: Remember Thy servants, O Lord, as Thou art good, and forgive whatever sins they have committed in this life; for no one is sinless, save Thee alone, Who art able to give rest also unto the departed.[^2142]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: O Theotokos, Virgin Mary, who didst give birth unto Christ the Redeemer and Savior: pray His goodness together with the Apostles and Martyrs and Prophets, with the Venerables and Hieromartyrs, to grant us remission of sins and great mercy.[^2143]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Then we chant the Canon in the Menaion unto the Saint. After this we chant the Canon unto the Saint whose temple it is. But if it be a temple of Christ or of the Theotokos, the temple canon takes precedence. This order is observed on all Saturdays of the Tones, outside of a feast.*[^2144]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, Venerables, and for the Departed.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: Unto God's close servants do I bring praise. Joseph.)*[^2145]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Tone 2. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Having taken up the Mosaic song, cry out, O my soul: He was unto me a helper and a protector unto salvation; this is my God, and I will glorify Him![^2146]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy martyrs, pray unto God for us.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having patiently endured grievous banishments and sore wounds, O sufferers, by divine power ye drove away all deception from the ends of the earth.[^2147]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Hierarchs of Christ, pray unto God for us.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Hierarchs:* Ministers and Hierarchs of God, shining manifestly with noetic light, guided the fullness of all the pious unto the light of piety.[^2148]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: All ye saints, pray unto God for us.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Venerables:* Having humbled your proud mind, O Venerable ones, ye came unto the good land; and being exalted by divine forms, ye ever help all the humble.[^2149]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Give rest, O Lord, to the souls of Thy departed servants.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Departed:* As God, show forth as partakers of the most radiant light and eternal gladness Thy faithful servants whom Thou hast translated from temporal things, O our most good God.[^2150]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having valiantly and patiently contested by fasting, the venerable women cast down the enemy, and with thee, O Birthgiver of God, they stand rejoicing.[^2151]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Second Canon for the Departed, chanted in order where there is no Menaion.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: For the dead a second hymn do I weave.) A work of Theophanes.*[^2152]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Tone 2. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Unto Him Who by His divine command dried up the impassable billowing sea, and guided the Israelite people to go on foot through it, let us sing unto the Lord; for He is gloriously glorified.[^2153]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Marvelous is God in His saints, the God of Israel.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Trampling down death by Thy death, Thou didst pour forth the ever-existing flow of divine life; grant this, O Good One, unto the souls of the departed, bestowing remission of transgressions through the entreaties of Thy martyrs.[^2154]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Give rest, O Lord, to the souls of Thy departed servants.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Thou Who ever pourest forth rich mercy unto them that ever piously receive Thee in Thy house, O Christ, in Thy marvelous tabernacle: grant a place of refreshment, O Master, unto Thy servants, as Thou art tender-hearted.[^2155]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou wast mightier than death, O Christ; therefore, having bound it, Thou didst deliver us; and now deliver the departed from this corruption, as Thou art good, and grant them communion in Thy radiance.[^2156]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having established my wavering mind, O Mother of God, strengthen me by the divine commandments of Him Who was born of thy consecrated womb, and Who abolished, O Lady, the gloomy kingdom of Hades.[^2157]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Canon 1. Ode 3. Heirmos:* My barren mind show Thou fruitful, O God, Husbandman of noble things and Planter of good things, by Thy tender-heartedness.[^2158]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy martyrs, pray unto God for us.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having been ignited with the fire of Christ's love, O passion-bearers, ye quenched the burning of tortures by the dewing of the All-Working Spirit.[^2159]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Hierarchs of Christ, pray unto God for us.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Hierarchs:* O most holy Hierarchs of Christ, and venerable assemblies of the monastics: entreat God, the Lover of mankind, on behalf of us all.[^2160]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: All ye saints, pray unto God for us.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Prophets and Holy Women:* The most sacred choir of the divine prophets was magnified, and the multitude of women who valiantly suffered attained glory.[^2161]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Give rest, O Lord, to the souls of Thy departed servants.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Departed:* Being put to death upon the Cross, O Christ, Thou didst bestow im-...[^2162]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Departed (continued):* ...-mortality unto the dead; which grant them to obtain, who in faith have departed unto Thee.[^2163]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: Together with all the Prophets and the consecrated women, now earnestly entreat God Who was born of thee, O Virgin, to show compassion unto us.[^2164]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Canon 2. Ode 3. Heirmos:* Having established me upon the rock of faith, Thou hast enlarged my mouth over mine enemies; for my spirit hath rejoiced when singing: There is none holy as our God, and none righteous besides Thee, O Lord![^2165]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Vouchsafe them that in faith have fallen asleep to be illuminated with the radiance of Thy beauty together with Thy martyrs, O Thou Who art rich in mercy; for Thou art our God, and none is righteous besides Thee, O Lord.[^2166]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In the place of refreshment, in the bosom of Thine elect Abraham, grant Thy servants to dwell, as Thou art compassionate, who cry unto Thee: Thou art our God, and none is righteous besides Thee, O Lord.[^2167]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Receive Thy servants bearing lamps to dwell in the heavenly bridal chambers, having entered together with the wise virgins, O Master, whom by Thy will Thou hast translated from temporal things, O only Lover of mankind.[^2168]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Me who was deadened and returned unto the earth hast thou raised up, having given birth unto the Giver of life; and thou hast brought me up from the lowest Hades, who in faith glorify thee as Theotokos and venerate thee, O most pure and all-hymned Lady.[^2169]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Canon 1. Ode 4. Heirmos:* Foreseeing Thy birth of the Virgin, the Prophet proclaimed, crying: I heard Thy report, and was afraid; for from the south, from the holy and shaded mountain, art Thou come, O Christ![^2170]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being well likened unto Christ's sufferings, the glorious passion-bearers, stretched out under many tortures, rejoiced looking unto the eternal rewards; which having received, they are ever called blessed.[^2171]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Keeping the laws of the Spirit, O high priests, ye most wisely shepherded the people, as excellent pilots, in the divine harbor; and having transferred from worldly turmoils, ye passed over unto the quietude of life.[^2172]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Strangers were ye revealed upon the earth, O fathers, having transferred your life unto the heavens, as it is written, devout-...[^2173]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Venerables (continued):* ...-ly wise, and having curbed the carnal passions through the pains of self-restraint by the power of Christ.[^2174]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Departed:* Whomsoever Thou hast translated, O Master, from temporal life—a numerous multitude that served Thee in the Orthodox faith, O Word—uniting them with the multitude of all the saved, vouchsafe them eternal life.[^2175]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Holy Women:* Desiring divine mortification which truly mediates endless life, by reason of tortures and afflictions and acts of abstinence the honorable women attained unto it, praying Christ and God on our behalf.[^2176]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Prophet Habakkuk, O Theotokos, sees thee as a mountain overshadowed with virtues, from which God ineffably appeared, covering the heavens with His virtue and saving the human race from corruption.[^2177]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Canon 2. Ode 4. Heirmos:* I sing to Thee, for I heard Thy report, O Lord, and was afraid; for unto me dost Thou come, seeking me who had strayed. Therefore Thy great condescension toward me do I glorify, O Plenteous in mercy![^2178]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Them that have lived in hope and love and with an Orthodox mind vouchsafe Thy glory which surpasses the mind, O Christ, through Thy manifold love for mankind and through the entreaties of the chosen martyrs.[^2179]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As Thou possessest an ever-flowing torrent of sweetness, Thou ever givest drink unto the elect, O Lord! With them also now feed those translated unto Thee, O Christ, by Thine ineffable mercy beside the waters of forgiveness.[^2180]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou art Lord over the living, O Master, and rulest over the dead; Thou by Thy power shalt resurrect the dust that is in the earth. Therefore settle those who have come unto Thee in Thy courts, O Savior.[^2181]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou hast healed Eve's crushing and ancient misery; for thou didst give birth unto the Creator Who is able to restore us who were cast down by transgressions, O Birthgiver of God, sole Virgin Mother.[^2182]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Canon 1. Ode 5. Heirmos:* Having dispersed the gloom of my soul, O my Savior, enlighten me with the light of Thy commandments, as the only King of peace.[^2183]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having loved Thee, O Compassionate One, the noble passion-bearers hated all worldly things, mingling with tortures through renunciation of the flesh.[^2184]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Hierarchs & Monastics:* Hierarchs, Prophets, venerable God-bearers, with spiritual rays ye enlighten the world, dispelling the darkness of passions.[^2185]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For All Saints:* Venerable Fathers, Prophets, High Priests, and ever-memorable women, earnestly entreat Thee, the Master of all, on our behalf.[^2186]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Departed:* We pray Thee, O Word: having numbered with the choir of Thine elect those whom Thou hast taken from us, show them forth as partakers of the better life.[^2187]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O most pure Virgin Mother, the praise of Martyrs, Venerables, and Righteous ones: snatch us away from every torment of the evil one.[^2188]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Canon 2. Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Giver of light and Creator of the ages, O Lord, guide us in the light of Thy commandments; for besides Thee we know no other God.[^2189]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Us who were deadened and laid in corruption hast Thou brought up from the dark treasuries of Hades, and hast snatched away, O Good One, uniting us unto the armies of the holy angels.[^2190]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Since Thou camest, O Christ, that Thou mightest save us: receive now those who have piously been translated unto Thee, as Thou art alone good, and settle them in the bosom of Abraham with Lazarus.[^2191]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou hast dissolved, O Master, my ancient and long-standing warfare, when Thou previously becamest a Mediator and Intercessor of reconciliation; and now having shown compassion unto Thy servants, give them rest.[^2192]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Under thy shelter, O Mother of God, they that hope in thee are saved; for thou didst give birth for us unto the Giver of life, Who quickens all things by His will.[^2193]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Canon 1. Ode 6. Heirmos:* In the abyss of sin am I held, O my Savior, and in the deep of life am I tossed by the tempest. But as Jonah from the monster, lead me up also from the passions, and save me![^2194]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By strength of heart the sufferers, having set themselves in array against the enemy, cast him down, and received from God crowns of victory; and now they earnestly pray for all earthborn mortals.[^2195]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Let us faithfully honor the hierarchs of God, and call His venerable ones bles-...[^2196]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Hierarchs & Monastics (continued):* ...-sed, being saved by their entreaties from all wrath and affliction and assault of the enemy.[^2197]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *For the Holy Women:* The divine choir of women suffered, and in fasting was well-pleasing unto God, and obtained the Kingdom of heaven; by their prayers show compassion, O God, unto Thy world.[^2198]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: O Christ, Giver of life, Who didst fashion man from the earth: give rest unto those whom Thou hast translated from us, granting them remission of evil deeds, as Thou art merciful and Lover of mankind.[^2199]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: O Holy Theotokos, sanctify our thoughts and strengthen our mind, and save us unwounded from the darts of the evil one, who glorify thy majesties, O All-Hymned One.[^2200]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Canon 2. Ode 6. Heirmos:* Wallowing in the abyss of sin, I call upon the unfathomable abyss of Thy mercy: from corruption, O God, raise me up![^2201]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Twice):* Vouchsafe those whom Thou hast translated from the earth by Thy all-working will, O Lover of mankind, unto the ineffable and divine brightness where the ranks of martyrs abide.[^2202]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Vouchsafe those who have left this life to be illuminated by the beauty of Thy glory, and give rest unto them that have passed over unto Thine ineffable light, O Master.[^2203]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Earnestly appear delivering them that call upon thee, O most pure Lady, who didst give birth unto God Who hath dominion over life and death.[^2204]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Canon 1. Ode 7. Heirmos:* Imitating the Cherubim, the youths in the furnace danced, crying: Blessed art Thou, O God, for in truth and judgment hast Thou brought all these things upon us for our sins, O supremely praised and supremely glorified unto all ages![^2205]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By patient endurance the saints cast down Beliar, enduring every temptation of bitter torments, for truly they loved God Who suffered for our sins. By their prayers save us all, O Word, from perils and afflictions, who glorify Thee.[^2206]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Radiant Hierarchs, and Venerables, and Prophets, and the glorious multitude of Hieromartyrs, and the consecrated assembly of holy women who shone forth valiantly in suffering and in fasting: ever make supplication unto God on our behalf, that He may have mercy upon us.[^2207]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю милосе́рдїа твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The multitude of martyrs entreats Thee, O Christ Benefactor: from all...[^2208]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: печа́лей, и҆ скорбе́й, и҆ лю́тыхъ напа́стей, и҆ всѣ́хъ прегрѣше́нїй, и҆ ѿ вре́да спасѝ мѧ̀, Сло́ве, поги́бшаго.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs (continued):* ...of sorrows, and afflictions, and cruel temptations, and all transgressions, and from harm save me, O Word, who am perishing.[^2209]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿню́дꙋже болѣ́знь ѿбѣжѐ, и҆ воздыха́нїе и҆ печа́ль, и҆дѣ́же свѣ́тъ сїѧ́етъ твоегѡ̀ лица̀ Хрⷭтѐ, и҆ и҆дѣ́же Ст҃ы́хъ собо́ри ны́нѣ ликꙋ́ютъ, оу҆чинѝ всѣ́хъ преста́вльшихсѧ вѣ́рою дꙋ́ши, прегрѣше́нїа и҆́хъ всѧ̑ презрѣ́въ, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ ми́лостивъ.
items.english_text: *For the Departed:* Where pain and sighing and sorrow have fled away, where the light of Thy countenance shines, O Christ, and where the choirs of the Saints now dance: establish the souls of all who have passed away in faith, having overlooked all their transgressions, as Thou alone art merciful.[^2210]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Съ Мꙋ́ченики Пречи́стаѧ, и҆ съ преподо́бными Ѻ҆тцы̀, и҆ Проро́ки всѣ́ми, съ ст҃ы́ми жена́ми, въ Ст҃ы́хъ є҆ди́наго почива́ющаго оу҆молѝ, всѣ́хъ ѡ҆свѧти́ти на́съ, ст҃ы́ми гла́сы тѧ̀ славосло́вѧщихъ, Чи́стаѧ, во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With the Martyrs, O Most Pure One, and with the venerable Fathers, and all the Prophets, with the holy women, implore Him Who alone rests among the Saints, to sanctify us all who praise thee with holy voices, O Pure Lady, unto all ages.[^2211]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Богопроти́вное велѣ́нїе беззако́ннꙋющагѡ мꙋчи́телѧ высо́къ пла́мень вознесло̀ є҆́сть; Хрⷭто́съ же прострѐ благочести̑вымъ ѻ҆трокѡ́мъ ро́сꙋ дх҃о́внꙋю, сы́й благослове́нъ, и҆ препросла́вленъ.
items.english_text: *Canon 2. Ode 7. Heirmos:* The God-opposing decree of the lawless tyrant raised a high flame; but Christ spread out spiritual dew upon the pious youths, He Who is blessed and supremely glorified.[^2212]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же вездѣ̀ сы́й, низше́лъ є҆сѝ, є҆́же спастѝ дре́вле прельща́емый человѣ́ческїй ро́дъ, Гдⷭи. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ мꙋ́ченици мо́лѧтъ: си́хъ ꙗ҆̀же преста́вилъ є҆сѝ ѿ землѝ кро́ткихъ, Спа́се оу҆поко́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou Who art everywhere present didst descend, O Lord, to save the human race that was deceived of old. Therefore the martyrs pray Thee: give rest, O Savior, to those whom Thou hast translated from the earth into the land of the meek.[^2213]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ме́ртвости оу҆мерщвле́нїе ѿтрѧ́слъ є҆сѝ, въ ме́ртвыхъ свобо́дь бы́въ, са́мъ є҆ди́нъ Хрⷭтѐ! и҆ ны́нѣ оу҆мерщвле́нїа грѣхо́внагѡ, Влⷣко и҆зба́ви рабы̑ твоѧ̑, ꙗ҆влѧ́ѧ и҆̀хъ наслѣ́дники црⷭтвїа твоегѡ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou hast shaken off the deadness of mortality, being free among the dead, Thou alone, O Christ! And now, O Master, deliver Thy servants from the deadness of sin, showing them forth as heirs of Thy Kingdom.[^2214]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Мно́гимъ твои́мъ и҆ неизрече́ннымъ милосе́рдїемъ, и҆ неизмѣ́рною бе́здною человѣколю́бїа твоегѡ̀ Хрⷭтѐ, прегрѣше́нїй оу҆́бѡ ѡ҆ставле́нїе преста́вленымъ да́ждь, и҆ благода́тїю твое́ю ѡ҆чище́ныхъ си́хъ ꙗ҆вѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* By Thy manifold and ineffable tender mercy, and by the boundless abyss of Thy love for mankind, O Christ, grant remission of sins unto the departed, and show them cleansed by Thy grace.[^2215]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́лникъ была̀ є҆сѝ, бж҃е́ственныѧ сла́вы сїѧ́нїе носѧ́щи Дѣ́во, пло́тїю на́мъ ꙗ҆́вльшагосѧ, и҆ а҆́довꙋ мглу̀ свѣ́тлостїю Бж҃ества̀ своегѡ̀ потреби́вша, Богора́дованнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A lamp-stand wast thou, bearing the brightness of divine glory, O Virgin: Him Who appeared unto us in the flesh and destroyed the gloom of Hades by the splendor of His Divinity, O thou full of divine joy![^2216]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ кꙋпинѣ̀ Мѡѷсе́ю Дѣ́вы чꙋ́до, на Сїна́йстѣй горѣ̀ Проѡбрази́вшаго и҆ногда̀, по́йте, благослови́те, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Canon 1. Ode 8. Heirmos:* Him Who of old prefigured the miracle of the Virgin unto Moses in the bush on Mount Sinai: praise, bless, and supremely exalt unto all ages![^2217]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* The stream of your blood, O passion-bearers of the Lord, hath sanctified all creation, and visibly dried up the outpouring of deception, and richly watered the souls of the faithful.[^2218]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *For the Saints:* The fasting choir, the assembly of hierarchs, of holy women, and of glorious prophets was shown equal in honor unto the angels, having lived angelically on earth in the spirit.[^2219]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *For All Saints:* Deliver us all, O passion-bearers of the Lord, high priests, and prophets, and multitude of venerable ones, and holy women, from the darts of the enemy, who praise you.[^2220]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Those whom Thou hast received from us, O Savior, establish in the bosom of Abraham, and give them rest with all the elect, granting remission of all their sins, as Thou art all-bountiful.[^2221]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: O pure Mother of God, with all the holy prophets, and martyrs, and venerable ones, and holy women, and hieromartyrs: pray the Savior to show compassion unto us.[^2222]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Canon 2. Ode 8. Heirmos:* The fiery furnace of old in Babylon divided its operation by the command of God, scorching the Chaldeans, but bedewing the faithful who sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord![^2223]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By Thy descent Thou hast shown us the death of our enemies, as Thou art immortal; and by Thy divine power Thou hast revealed the entrances of life, O Immortal One, which Thy martyrs have now worthily obtained.[^2224]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Vouchsafe the departed to delight in Thy noetic beauty, cleansing the shame of hideous sin, as Thou art the Lover of mankind; for Thou alone, O Master, wast shown to be a stranger to sin.[^2225]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou hast raised us up, O Christ, who had fallen into mortal dust, by Thy death granting life, and endless delight, and everlasting joy: whereof vouchsafe now the departed, as Thou art merciful.[^2226]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Great and awesome is the mystery of thy childbearing, O Mother of God: for thou didst give birth unto God, Whom death could not retain, and Whom the tomb could not corrupt. Therefore, O Most Pure Lady, all nations glorify thee.[^2227]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Canon 1. Ode 9. Heirmos:* Her who supernaturally conceived in her womb in the flesh the Word Who before all ages shone forth from the Father, let us the faithful magnify with unceasing hymns.[^2228]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Shown to be steadfast against passions, mighty against the enemies, the passion-bearers...[^2229]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs (continued):* ...took the victory, having suffered lawfully, and were crowned by God.[^2230]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *For the Hierarchs:* As sacred ministers of God, and imitators of the Good Shepherd, ye piously tended His sheep, O right-glorious high priests.[^2231]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *For the Ascetics & Holy Women:* With the venerable fasters, and sacred prophets, let us honor the multitude of women who suffered, and through fasting cast down the enemy.[^2232]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: The all-glorious multitude of Thy saints, O Christ, unceasingly prays Thee: show those whom Thou hast translated in faith, O Lord, to be partakers of eternal life.[^2233]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: O thou who didst bear in the flesh the God of tender compassions, with the saints ever pray Him to save us from tribulations, O pure Mother and Virgin.[^2234]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Canon 2. Ode 9. Heirmos:* Her who ineffably incarnated from virgin loins God Who shone forth as a luminary before the sun and came to us in the flesh: O blessed and all-pure Theotokos, thee do we magnify.[^2235]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having authority over both the living and the dead, O Author of life, grant unto those who have come from the earth unto Thee the heavenly inheritance, O Master, and the brightness of Thy saints and all-glorious passion-bearers.[^2236]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Being the all-originating Word, Who of old gavest me being, and again bestowest well-being: in the longing-desired bosom of Abraham our forefather, settle Thy departed servants, as Thou art merciful.[^2237]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
