items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou art wholly light-bearing sweetness, O my Savior, Thou art wholly insatiable desire: with the torrents of Thy delight and the water of remission water the departed who unceasingly glorify Thee.[^2238]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee, O Theotokos, do we the faithful worthily bless, following thine inspired words; for thou alone among earthborn mortals didst bear God, Who destroyed the power of death, O Virgin Mother.[^2239]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs. (If Alleluia is appointed.) Tone 2:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Having suffered for Christ even unto death, O passion-bearing martyrs, your souls are in the heavens in the hand of God, and throughout the whole world...[^2240]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs (continued):* ...your relics are venerated: hierarchs and tsars bow down, and all people rejoicing cry aloud with one accord: Precious before the Lord is the death of His saints.[^2241]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Every city and country honors your relics, O passion-bearing martyrs! For having suffered lawfully, ye received heavenly crowns; and for this cause ye are the boast of hierarchs, victory for tsars, and the beauty of churches.[^2242]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Having taken up the Cross of Christ as an invincible weapon, the holy martyrs abolished all the power of the devil and received heavenly crowns; they have become a wall for us, ever making intercession on our behalf.[^2243]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Woe is me! What a struggle hath the soul when parting from the body! Woe is me! How many tears she then sheds, and there is none that pities her! Lifting up her eyes to the angels, she prays in vain; stretching out her hands to men, she hath none to help. Therefore, my beloved brethren, understanding the shortness of our life, let us ask of Christ rest for the departed, and for our souls great mercy.[^2244]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Come, let us all glorify with unceasing hymns the Mother of Light; for she gave birth unto our salvation. And let us bring unto her 'Rejoice!', as unto her who alone gave birth unto the primordial God before all ages. Rejoice, O thou who didst fashion anew Eve our foremother! Rejoice, O all-pure Virgin unwedded![^2245]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, if Alleluia is not chanted, we sing Stichera for the Departed, Tone 2.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: The assault of death and corruption hast Thou cast down by Thy life-bearing death, O Master! Unto all hast Thou poured forth eternal life, and unto the dead of the earth Thou hast granted resurrection. Therefore we pray Thee, O Savior: give rest unto those who in faith have passed over unto Thee, and vouchsafe them Thy incorruptible glory, O Lover of mankind.[^2246]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: That Thou mightest make men partakers of Thy divine Kingdom, O Christ, Thou didst endure crucifixion, and accepted voluntary death. For this cause we pray: by Thy tender mercy show forth those who in faith have passed over unto Thee as partakers of...[^2248]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed (continued):* ...Thy Kingdom, and vouchsafe them Thy sweet beauty, O Lover of mankind.[^2249]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Desiring to save Thine own creation, Thou didst with joy accomplish the truly awesome mystery of dispensation, as Thou art supremely good; and at a price Thou didst redeem the whole world by Thy precious Blood. Therefore we pray: vouchsafe deliverance with all the saints unto those who in faith have passed over unto Thee.[^2251]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Standing before Thine awesome, dreadful, and fearful throne, O Christ, they that have died from the beginning of the world await Thy righteous sentence and receive Thy divine justice. At that time give rest, O Savior, unto Thy servants who in faith have passed over unto Thee, where the choirs of the saints abide, and where joy is ineffable.[^2253]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: When my soul is about to be separated from life and the bodily bond, then stand by me, O Lady, and destroy the counsels of the incorporeal enemies, and crush the jaws of those who seek to devour me mercilessly; that unhindered I may pass by the princes of darkness standing in the air, O Bride of God![^2254]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Then: It is good to give praise to the Lord (Psalm 91:2), and the rest. After this, the First Hour, and the Dismissal.*[^2255]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 2:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: We bring unto Thee the cry of the thief, and we pray: Remember us, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom.[^2256]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Having been conformed unto the sufferings of Christ, O martyrs, ye ever heal the diverse passions of men.[^2257]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: With the Prophets the Apostles, and with the Venerables the Teachers, well pleased the Creator of all.[^2258]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: With all Thy saints, O Lord Who lovest mankind, establish all Thy servants who have passed away in faith, we pray Thee.[^2259]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: O consubstantial Trinity, have compassion upon those who honor Thee, ever delivering all from the enemy's delusion and snares.[^2260]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Despise not the supplications of thy servants, O All-Blameless Lady, saving us from all tribulations and sorrows.[^2261]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *End of Tone 2.*[^2262]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *[Engraving: The Crucifixion of Christ with the Mother of God and St. John the Theologian, flanked by floral baroque foliage.]*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *On Saturday Evening, at Little Vespers.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *At "Lord, I have cried," resurrectional stichera, 3, repeating the first.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Christ Savior, the dominion of death was dissolved, and the delusion of the devil was brought to naught; and the human race, being saved by faith, ever offers a hymn unto Thee.[^2263]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: All things were enlightened by Thy Resurrection, O Lord, and Paradise was opened once again; and all creation praising Thee, ever offers a hymn unto Thee.[^2264]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: I glorify the power of the Father and of the Son, and I praise the authority of the Holy Spirit: the undivided, uncreated Godhead, the consubstantial Trinity, reigning unto ages of ages.[^2265]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Dogmatic Theotokion, Tone 3:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: A most great miracle! The Virgin hath given birth, and the One born is God before the ages: a manifestation of birth, and accomplished beyond nature! O awesome mystery! which even when contemplated remains ineffable, and when beheld cannot be comprehended! Blessed art thou, O all-pure Maiden, daughter of earthly Adam, and Mother of God Most High Who appeared: Him do thou entreat, that our souls may be saved.[^2266]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Then: O Gladsome Light. After this, the Prokeimenon: "The Lord is King" (three times). Verse: "The Lord is clothed with strength, and hath girded Himself" (Psalm 92:1). Then: "Vouchsafe, O Lord, to keep us this evening." But the priest says no litany; rather we sing:*[^2267]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Resurrectional Sticheron, Tone 3:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: By Thy Passion, O Christ, Thou didst darken the sun, and by the light of Thy Resurrection Thou didst enlighten all things: accept our evening hymn, O Lover of mankind.[^2268]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Then Theotokia Stichera, in the same Tone:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: O Church of God prepared for the Godhead of the All-Holy Trinity, O Maiden full of divine joy, river of every goodness proceeding out of paradise beyond understanding: do thou joyfully grant unstinting gifts unto all thy servants, O Pure Lady, that we all may faithfully give thanks unto thee, for thou art the sole mediatress of human nature, O Most Pure One.[^2270]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: O Heaven of the King of all! O tabernacle that contained God, unhewn mountain, golden urn containing Christ the God-flowing Manna, noetic ark of the New Covenant, O Theotokos, all-blameless and pure! Deliver us from every affliction, and vouchsafe us the inheritance of the righteous.[^2272]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Thou knowest, O Christ, my many sins, and do Thou grant me remission; and for the remainder of my life, strengthen me in Thee to live with godly compunction of heart and inward repentance; and at the dreadful hour may I obtain mercy: standing on the right hand and receiving that which Thou hast prepared for them that have worthily served Thee, O Savior.[^2274]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion, Tone 3:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: A recreation and a second life have we through thee, O most pure Mary, who didst bear the Creator of creation united with human nature in thy womb, Who raised us up from Hades and death, and gave us eternal life, so that we ever cry unto thee, O Virgin: Rejoice, thou who hast united earthly things with the heavenly! Rejoice, hope of all the ends of the earth, and mediatress and protection! Rejoice, thou who by the Resurrection of thy Son hast enlightened all things, and grantest great mercy unto the world![^2275]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Then: Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart (Luke 2:29). Trisagion, and after Our Father: Resurrectional Troparion. Glory... both now... its Theotokion. Litany: "Have mercy on us, O God," and the Dismissal.*[^2276]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *At "Lord, I have cried," we set 10 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Christ Savior, the dominion of death was dissolved, and the delusion of the devil was brought to naught; and the human race, being saved by faith, ever offers a hymn unto Thee.[^2277]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: All things were enlightened by Thy Resurrection, O Lord, and Paradise was opened once again; and all creation praising Thee, ever offers a hymn unto Thee.[^2278]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: I glorify the power of the Father and of the Son, and I praise the authority of the Holy Spirit: the undivided, uncreated Godhead, the consubstantial Trinity, reigning unto ages of ages.[^2279]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: We bow down before Thy precious Cross, O Christ, and we praise and glorify Thy Resurrection; for by Thy wound were we all healed.[^2280]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: We praise the Savior incarnate of the Virgin; for for our sake was He crucified, and on the third day He arose, granting us great mercy.[^2281]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Having descended unto them that were in Hades, Christ proclaimed good tidings, saying: Take courage, now have I conquered! I am the Resurrection, I will lead you forth, having destroyed the gates of death![^2282]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Standing unworthily in Thine all-pure house, we send up our evening hymn, crying out of the depths: O Christ God, Who didst enlighten the world by Thy three-day Resurrection, deliver Thy people from the hand of Thine enemies, O Lover of mankind![^2283]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Dogmatic Theotokion, Tone 3:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: How shall we not marvel at thy God-manbearing childbearing, O Most Honored...[^2284]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Dogmatic Theotokion (continued):* ...Lady? For having received no trial of man, O All-Blameless One, thou gavest birth without a father unto a Son in the flesh, Who was begotten before the ages of the Father without a mother, Who in no wise underwent change, or confusion, or division, but preserved intact the property of both essences. Therefore, O Mother and Virgin Lady, entreat Him that the souls of them that in orthodox manner confess thee to be the Theotokos may be saved.[^2285]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Entrance with the censer. O Gladsome Light. Prokeimenon and Litanies.*[^2286]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 3:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: By Thy Passion, O Christ, Thou didst darken the sun, and by the light of Thy Resurrection Thou didst enlighten all things: accept our evening hymn, O Lover of mankind.[^2287]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Thy life-receiving Resurrection, O Lord, enlightened the whole inhabited world, and called back Thine own corrupted creation. Therefore, having been set free from Adam's curse, we cry aloud: O Almighty Lord, glory to Thee![^2289]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Being unchangeable God, suffering in the flesh Thou wast changed; and creation, unable to bear the sight, bowed down in fear, and groaning praised Thy long-suffering; and having descended into Hades, on the third day Thou didst arise, granting life unto the world and great mercy.[^2291]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: That Thou mightest deliver our race from death, O Christ, Thou didst endure death; and having arisen on the third day from the dead, Thou didst raise with Thyself those who acknowledged Thee as God, and didst enlighten the world: O Lord, glory to Thee![^2293]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Without seed from the Holy Spirit, and by the will of the Father, thou didst conceive the Son of God, Who before the ages was of the Father without a mother; and for our sake, having come from thee without a father, thou didst bear Him in the flesh, and nursed the Infant with milk. Therefore cease not to entreat Him, that our souls may be delivered from tribulations.[^2294]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Then: Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart (Luke 2:29). Trisagion, and after Our Father:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Let the heavens be glad, let the earth rejoice; for the Lord hath wrought...[^2295]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Troparion (continued):* ...might with His arm; He hath trampled down death by death; He became the firstborn of the dead; He hath delivered us from the belly of Hades, and hath granted great mercy unto the world.[^2296]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Thee who didst mediate the salvation of our race, do we hymn, O Virgin Theotokos! For in the flesh assumed from thee, Thy Son and our God, having through the Cross accepted the Passion, delivered us from corruption, as the Lover of mankind.[^2297]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: He Who of old by divine nod gathered the waters into one gathering, and divided the sea for the people of Israel: this is our God, He is supremely glorified; unto Him alone let us sing, for He hath been glorified.[^2298]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: As the Mother of God, shown forth by the divine Spirit and by the good pleasure of the Father, do we the faithful crown thee with pure hymns, O all-pure Bride of God, and with the Archangel we kiss thee with songs, unto our salvation.[^2299]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: From the ribs of Adam, indeed, was Eve fashioned by the ancient creation of God; but from the womb of the Theotokos Christ appeared, being our God: having become man without change, the Pre-Eternal One became subject to time.[^2300]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: He Who condemned Eve's womb to bring forth children in sorrows and in pain, dwelt in thy womb, O pure Virgin, being our God: He appeared in the flesh beyond understanding, and cancelled the debt of the first mother.[^2301]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Having fallen into the depth of despair by heavy burdens, earnestly do we call unto thee, O Mother of God: Help, O Lady, us who are being drowned by the deeds of deceitful transgressions; for thee alone have we as our hope after God.[^2302]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Thou Who didst bring all things out of nothingness, which are fashioned by the Word and accomplished by the Spirit: O Almighty Master, establish me in Thy love.[^2303]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: The rod of Aaron prefigured thee, which budded without watering, O all-pure Theotokos, who without seed gavest birth unto God incarnate without change.[^2304]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ве ва́шеѧ, страстоте́рпци Гдⷭни, ѡ҆свѧтѝ всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ и҆зсꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆злїѧ́нїе пре́лести, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́ши напоѝ бога́тнѡ.
items.english_text: Bearing the divine Fire, as a lamp-stand, O Most Pure Lady...[^2305]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ Сꙋббѡ́тꙋ на Повече́ріи, Гла́съ г҃.
items.english_text: *Troparion (continued):* ...the Prophet in the Spirit foresaw thee bearing sweet fragrance unto those in the world, and life eternal.[^2306]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: прови́дѣ Проро́къ дх҃омъ, благоꙋха́нїе нося́щꙋ сꙋ́щымъ въ мі́рѣ, и҆ жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Let us approach the Archangel Gabriel, crying aloud unto the Virgin with hymns: Rejoice! for through thee the ancestral curse of condemnation is dissolved.[^2307]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Къ А҆рха́гг҃лꙋ пристꙋ́пимъ Гаврїи́лꙋ: ра́дꙋйсѧ, вѣща́юще Дѣ́вѣ пѣ́сньми; тобо́ю бо разрѣши́тсѧ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїа пра́дѣднаѧ кла́тва.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Having thee, O most holy Theotokos, as a wall of salvation, we sinners are saved; despise not, O Lady, and put not to shame our supplications.[^2308]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Тѧ̀ прест҃а́ѧ Бцⷣе, ꙗ҆́кѡ стѣ́нꙋ спасенїа и҆мꙋ́ще грѣ́шнїи спаса́емсѧ; не пре́зри Влⷣчце, и҆ не посрамѝ на̑ша моле́нїа.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Thou hast established steadfast love toward us, O Lord; for Thou didst give Thine Only-begotten Son unto death for us. Therefore we cry unto Thee, giving thanks: Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^2309]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Положи́лъ є҆сѝ къ на́мъ тве́рдꙋю любо́вь Гдⷭи; є҆диноро́днаго бо твоего̀ Сы́на за ны̀ на сме́рть да́лъ є҆сѝ. Тѣ́мже тебѣ̀ зове́мъ благодарѧ́ще: сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й Гдⷭи.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The noetic mountain, the shadow of virtues, did Habakkuk of old, seeing thee in godly manner in the Spirit, proclaim, O Most Pure One, as the Word Who came from the south, having received flesh from thee.[^2310]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Го́рꙋ мы́сленнꙋю, добродѣ́телей сѣ́нь, Дх҃омъ дре́вле А҆вваку́мъ бг҃ови́днѡ тѧ̀ ви́дѣвъ, проповѣ́даше Пречи́стаѧ, ꙗ҆́ко ѿ ю҆́га прише́дша, ѿ тебѐ Сло́во пло́ть прїе́мша.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* A great, uncut mountain did Daniel see thee in the Spirit, manifesting the incorrupt purity of thy virginity, O Lady, from which the Stone was cut, Christ the Word, casting down the deceit of idols.[^2311]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Го́рꙋ тѧ̀ ве́лїю несѣко́мꙋю Данїи́лъ Дх҃омъ ви́дѣ, нерастлѣ́ннꙋ ꙗ҆влѧ́ѧ чистотꙋ̀ дѣ́вства твоегѡ̀, Влады́чице, ѿ нея́же ка́мень ѹ҆сѣче́ся, Хрїсто́съ Сло́во, ле́сти низлага́ѧ і҆́дѡлскїѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* A marvelous and fertile mountain did David foretell thee; for the Only-begotten Son of the Father was well pleased, O Pure One, to dwell in thee, being incarnate; therefore in the spirit we cry unto thee: Rejoice![^2312]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Го́рꙋ тѧ̀ Дави́дъ чꙋ́днꙋ и҆ тꙋ́чнꙋ проречѐ; є҆диноро́дный бо ѿ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ Сы́нъ, въ тѧ̀ благоволѝ Чи́стаѧ всели́тисѧ воплоща́емь; тѣ́мъ тебѣ̀, ра́дꙋйсѧ, дꙋ́хомъ зове́мъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Being all-good and a fervent protectress unto sinners and the humble, O all-pure Lady Mother of God, from tribulations, and afflictions, and sins, save thy servants.[^2313]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Всѧ̀ блага́ѧ и҆ те́плаѧ застꙋ́пница сꙋ́щи грѣ́шникѡмъ и҆ смире́ннымъ, Богороди́телнице пречи́стаѧ Влады́чице, ѿ бѣ́дъ и҆ скорбе́й и҆ грѣхѡ́въ, спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* As Isaiah figuratively saw God exalted upon a throne, borne aloft by the Angels of glory, he cried: Woe is me, wretched one! for I have foreseen God incarnate, the Unwaning Light, and ruling over the world in peace.[^2314]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́ко ви́дѣ И҆са́їа ѡ҆́бразнѡ на престо́лѣ превознесе́на Бг҃а, ѿ А҆́гг҃лъ сла́вы дорѷноси́ма, ѽ ѻ҆каѧ́нный, вопїѧ́ше, а҆́зъ! прови́дѣхъ бо воплоща́ема Бг҃а, свѣ́та невече́рна, и҆ ми́ромъ влады́чествꙋюща.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The rod of Jesse hath budded forth an unfading flower, the Virgin Mary, conceiving without seed the unoriginate God from the Divine Spirit and the Father, Who took dominion over the mighty kingdoms of the Gentiles, in Whom the nations have hoped.[^2315]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зрастѝ же́злъ І҆ессе́евъ цвѣ́тъ невѧда́емый, Дѣ́ва Марíа, Бг҃а безнача́льнаго, безъ сѣ́мене, ѿ Дх҃а бж҃е́ственнагѡ и҆ Ѻ҆тца̀, и҆́же црⷭтва держа́внаѧ ꙗ҆зы́ческаѧ ѡ҆блада́вшаго, на него́же ꙗ҆зы́цы оу҆пова́ша.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The Prince of Peace hath come, reigning upon the throne of David, God being incarnate from thee, O Theotokos; O wonder! and having put an end to war, He...[^2316]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...honored the princes of Moab,[^2317] and showed thee forth as Queen who gavest Him birth.

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Manifesting thy spotless beauty, from which Christ clothed Himself in flesh without seed, O Virgin, Isaiah cries aloud, calling: The Lord of glory comes upon a light cloud, and casting away the darkness of delusion, He will enlighten us.[^2318]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Having conceived from the Holy Spirit the Word consubstantial with the Father, O Virgin, thou didst give birth unto Him existing in two natures, perfect God and perfect man, Whose bodily manifestation we honor in faith.[^2319]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* The lowest abyss of sins hath compassed me, and my spirit fails; but stretch out Thine exalted arm, O Master, and save me, O Helmsman, as Thou didst Peter.[^2320]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* In songs the most wise one prefigures thee as a bed, O All-Praised One, whereon God rested, being incarnate in hypostasis from thee, and He glorified thee, being born without confusion.[^2321]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou wast a chosen garment for the Word, O all-praised Virgin; for having received flesh from thee as a divine purple robe, He reigned, having clothed Himself in godly manner.[^2322]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou wast the receptacle of the divine union, O Bride of God, brighter than gold; for through thee God became as man, and God conversed with men as man.[^2323]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Put to death the heresy of wickedness of those who act impiously against thee, O all-praised Virgin, for they melt away with envy, beholding the most glorious likeness of thine image.[^2324]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Lord, have mercy (three times). Glory... both now...*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 3:* From the warmth of faith I cry unto thee, O Theotokos, with unworthy lips and a defiled heart: Save me, who am submerged in sins; show compassion unto me, who am slain by despair, that saved I may cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Virgin, the help of Christians![^2325]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The three Children of old bowed not down before the golden image, the Persian object of worship, singing in the midst of the furnace: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou![^2326]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The burning bush and the flame joined together in conformity, and both appearing unconsumed, clearly manifest thee, O Virgin...[^2327]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (continued):* ...manifest thee; for thou didst give birth unto God, and remainest a virgin.[^2328]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The fleece and dew figuratively shown unto Gideon prefigure thy childbearing; for thou alone dost carry the Divine Word in thy womb like rain, O Virgin Mother.[^2329]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The fire of my sin creates a flame for me worse than Gehenna; quench this, O Pure One, by thy mercy, directing me unto the light through repentance.[^2330]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Venerating the manifestation of thy form, O all-pure Theotokos, we all have thee as the archetype, an unceasing protectress, and a well-pleasing protection unto God.[^2331]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The Babylonian furnace burned not the Children, neither did the fire of the Godhead consume the Virgin; therefore with the Children let us, the faithful, cry aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord![^2332]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having found thee as a most radiant lily in the midst of thorns, shining with the brightness of beauty, the Father was pleased that thou be the unwedded Bride, through the Divine Spirit, as a dwelling for the Son.[^2333]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The most holy Virgin, holier than the hosts on high, all-immaculate, do I manifestly praise without doubting; for thou didst bear in thy womb the Creator of these, Who received flesh from thee in unconfused union.[^2334]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having preserved unstolen virginity, O Virgin, thou wast truly shown forth as the Mother of the Son of God, having by the Father's good pleasure become a bride, and an incorruptible receptacle of the glory of the Spirit.[^2335]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* He Who is by nature immaterial and invisible God, simply and ineffably beyond nature is born man from the holy Virgin, seen as twofold in one hypostasis, wherein He is visible in depictions.[^2336]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* A new and godlike marvel! For the Lord manifestly passes through the shut door of virginity: naked in His entrance, and at His departure God appeared bearing flesh, and the door remains shut. Her do we ineffably magnify as the Mother of God.[^2337]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A holy fruit of a holy root: for the Theotokos, the maiden, budded forth unfading life, bringing to perfection the parents who were barren and sanctified by the Law of God; and Anna rejoices, having received an infant in her old age, the Mother of God, whom we glorify.[^2338]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* New and godlike is the birthgiving of thy holy and God-bearing womb...[^2339]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (continued):* ...O Pure One; for in it the form into man was written by the Father's finger, the Son was incarnate with the Holy Spirit; Whom unconfusedly, as God and man, we magnify.[^2340]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Every judgment cries out against me; for the deeds of sinful actions create a heap, threatening me, and the soul knows all wherewith it shall be condemned, and trembles at the flame of Gehenna; from which before the end, deliver me by thy prayers, O Lady.[^2341]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* After giving birth thou wast shown forth incorrupt, O Pure One; for unchangeably, O Theotokos, thou didst bear in the flesh as man the Creator of all, beyond nature by the Divine Spirit, not having departed from the Father's essence, and again thou didst remain a Virgin. Therefore glorifying thee, we complete the hymn.[^2342]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet: Trisagion. Resurrectional Hypakoe, and the rest.*[^2343]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *On Sunday Morning, at the Midnight Office.*[^2344]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Trinity. (Its acrostic: I praise Thee, O Trinity, the one Sovereignty of God). By Metrophanes.*[^2345]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Tone 3. Ode 1. Heirmos:* He Who of old by divine nod gathered the waters into one gathering, and divided the sea for the people of Israel: this is our God, He is supremely glorified; unto Him alone let us sing, for He hath been glorified.[^2346]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Trinity, our God, glory to Thee.*[^2347]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Incomprehensible one Sovereignty of the Lord, and one Trinitarian Godhead! Vouchsafe me Thy tri-radiant light, that I may sing of Thee, Who art unceasingly hymned with thrice-holy songs by angelic lips.[^2348]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Sacredly all the immaterial ranks sing of Thee, as the creative cause, unique, tri-radiant, manifestly supreme; Whom we, the multitudes of men, also sing with one accord, and faithfully glorify with earthen lips.[^2349]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Mind, and Word, and Spirit do theologians fittingly and significantly call Thee: designating the passionless begetting of the Son from the unbegotten Father, O God, sole Principle of all, together with the procession of the Divine Spirit.[^2350]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* As Thou art the Lover of mankind by nature, having assumed human essence, O Word of God, Thou hast shone forth as Trinitarian, the supreme single-principled...[^2351]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Tone 3.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Theotokion (continued):* ...Light of the one Godhead, having shown forth unto all as supremely glorified the all-pure Virgin who bore Thee.[^2352]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou Who didst bring all things out of nothingness, which are fashioned by the Word and accomplished by the Spirit: O Almighty Master, establish me in Thy love.[^2353]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Elijah of old, having commanded to pour water thrice upon the pieces of wood, figuratively revealed the Trinitarian hypostasis of the unique Sovereignty of God.[^2354]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The corruptible nature of earthborn mortals hymns Thee, the one and tri-radiant immutable Creator, and cries unto Thee: O Master, deliver me from all-diverse change, and save me.[^2355]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Evenly uttering words of the Prophets, and of the glorious Apostles and preachers of the faith, we the faithful glorify Thee, the equally operating Trinity, O God of all.[^2356]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* From the high throne Christ descended, exalting man as the Lover of mankind, through thee, O Most Pure One, and the tri-solar light shone forth upon all.[^2357]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* I am wholly changed by my lack of self-control, and in my senselessness by my lack of fear, feeling nothing, wretch that I am; I tremble not at the day at which all things visible and invisible tremble. O Lady, help me, and dispel the perplexity of my heart; for thou thyself art the hope and protectress of thy servants.[^2359]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Thou hast established steadfast love toward us, O Lord; for Thou didst give Thine Only-begotten Son unto death for us. Therefore we cry unto Thee, giving thanks: Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^2360]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As a twofold branch from the Father, as from a root, sprouted the Son and the Upright Spirit, consubstantial sproutings, God-planted, and...[^2361]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Tone 3.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (continued):* ...co-unoriginate flowers: so that there are three lights of the Godhead. *(Twice)*[^2362]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The multitudes of noetic beings unceasingly hymn Thee, the incomprehensible God; with whom we also glorify Thee, saying: O super-essential Trinity, save Thy servants, as the Lover of mankind.[^2363]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Thou hast inflamed us with Thy love, O most merciful Word of God, Who for our sake wast incarnate without change, and mystically didst teach the one tri-radiant Godhead; therefore we glorify Thee.[^2364]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* As Isaiah figuratively saw God exalted upon a throne, borne aloft by the Angels of glory, he cried: Woe is me, wretched one! for I have foreseen God incarnate, the Unwaning Light, and ruling over the world in peace.[^2365]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As Isaiah figuratively saw the one Sovereign Lord, God, glorified in three Persons with pure voices, a seraph was sent forthwith to proclaim the tri-radiant Essence and the tri-solar Monad. *(Twice)*[^2366]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O tri-solar Monad, who of old didst bring into being out of nothingness the nature of all things visible and invisible: having delivered from all temptations those who faithfully hymn Thee as the one God, vouchsafe them Thy glory.[^2367]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Having become the radiant and pure bridal chamber of God, O Virgin, we hymn thee in love and call thee blessed; for from thee was born Christ in twofold essences and wills, Who is One of the Trinity and the Lord of glory.[^2368]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* The lowest abyss of sins hath compassed me, and my spirit fails; but stretch out Thine exalted arm, O Master, and save me, O Helmsman, as Thou didst Peter.[^2369]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being a sojourner, Abraham was vouchsafed figuratively to receive the unique Lord in three hypostases, super-essential, yet in human forms. *(Twice)*[^2370]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Direct the hearts of Thy servants unto the unapproachable light, O tri-solar Lord! and grant the radiance of Thy glory unto our souls, that they may be shone upon by Thine ineffable beauty...[^2371]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Tone 3.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Open unto me the doors of light, of Him Who was born of thy womb, O Most Pure One, that I may behold the tri-radiant ray of the Godhead, and glorify thee, the all-radiant Lady.[^2372]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* Grant me sighing, O Virgin, even as unto the publican, and tears as unto the harlot, that offering these unto thee, I may cry: Have mercy upon me, O all-merciful one, and destroy my perplexity by thy grace, bestowing upon me a cloud of compunction; for unto thee have I fled, O Most Pure One.[^2374]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* As of old Thou didst bedew the three pious Children in the Chaldean flame with the radiant fire of the Godhead: so also enlighten us who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^2375]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Show me forth as a temple of Thy tri-radiant Godhead, O Master, wholly bright, above the cruel darkening of sin and passions, by Thy light-bestowing radiances, crying: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou![^2376]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* We proclaim one appearance of the Godhead in three hypostatic and distinct properties: Father, Son, and Spirit, crying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^2377]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* God in three Hypostases appeared unto Abraham of old at the oak of Mamre, rewarding his hospitality with the mercy of Isaac; Whom even now we glorify as the God of our fathers.[^2378]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* The Creator of all appeared upon earth, having become man in godly manner from thy virginal and most pure womb, and deified us, O blessed, all-pure, and most clean Theotokos.[^2379]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* United with the unbearable fire, the youth champions of piety, being unharmed by the flame, sang the divine hymn: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^2380]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Tone 3.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* From the unoriginate Father as from a root, the Word and the Spirit, being co-unoriginate, as shoots of the super-essential Godhead, have shown forth the one glory and power of the Trinity: which all we faithful hymn unto the ages. *(Twice)*[^2381]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By Thy brightnesses Thou dost guide the heavenly ranks, that they may unceasingly hymn with divine thrice-holy songs, O Father, conformed Word, and Spirit, the tri-radiant and equally powerful dominion. Therefore we hymn Thee unto all ages.[^2382]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* The prophetic predictions, seeing thy birthgiving from afar, O Theotokos, praised Him Who was born without seed and beyond nature, O Lady! And we also sing of Him with one accord as the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^2383]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* A new and godlike marvel! For the Lord manifestly passes through the shut door of virginity: naked in His entrance, and at His departure God appeared bearing flesh, and the door remains shut. Her do we ineffably magnify as the Mother of God.[^2384]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* To behold the tri-radiant glory, the godlike ranks of the incorporeal hosts manifestly desire to ascend on wings on high; yet they stand in deep awe of the unapproachable light, and unceasingly cry out hymns. With them, with one accord, O unique Trinity, we glorify Thee. *(Twice)*[^2385]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With unswerving love, we also upon earth, having received from Thee a noetic and rational soul, hymn Thee, O Master, God of all, the unique essence in truth, and Trinitarian in Persons, from the whole heart. Therefore, O Compassionate One, as Thou art abundantly merciful, show compassion unto us.[^2386]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Show me forth as a radiant temple of Thy single-principled and tri-radiant Godhead, purely to serve Thee, the Creator of all, and noetically to behold Thine ineffable glory, through the prayers of the only Theotokos, whom we worthily magnify as most glorious.[^2387]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Then, the Trinitarian Hymns of Gregory of Sinai: It is truly meet in godly manner. Then: More honorable than the Cherubim. Trisagion. After Our Father, the troparia: Have mercy on us, O Lord. Then, the litany, and the Dismissal.*[^2388]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *On Sunday at Matins,*[^2389]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *After the Six Psalms, we sing: "God is the Lord, and hath appeared unto us" in Tone 3.*[^2390]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Troparion: "Let the heavens be glad..." Glory... both now... Theotokion: "Thee who didst mediate the salvation..."*[^2391]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Then, the usual Kathismata of the Psalter.*[^2392]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Resurrectional Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: Christ is risen from the dead, the firstfruits of them that slept, the Firstborn of creation, and Maker of all things that have come to be; He hath renewed in Himself the corrupted nature of our race. No longer, O death, dost thou hold dominion; for the Master of all hath destroyed thy power.[^2393]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: Terrified at Thine unchangeable Godhead and Thy voluntary passion, O Lord, Hades lamented within itself: I tremble at the bodily hypostasis of incorruption; I behold the Invisible One, secretly waging war against me; therefore they also whom I hold captive cry out: Glory, O Christ, to Thy Resurrection![^2395]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: Heavenly beings rejoiced in love, and earthly beings trembled in awe, when the all-pure voice came upon thee, O Theotokos; for one solemnity shone forth for both, when the incorporeal one brought joy unto thee. Therefore with the Angel we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Pure One, dwelling-place of God![^2396]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Resurrectional Sessional Hymns, Tone 3.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: Having tasted death in the flesh, O Lord, Thou hast cut off the bitterness of death by Thy rising, and hast strengthened man against it, revoking the prevailing power of the ancestral curse. O Defender of our life, Lord, glory to Thee![^2397]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: The incomprehensible mystery of Thy Crucifixion and the ineffable wonder of Thy Rising do we the faithful proclaim, an unspoken mystery; for today death and Hades have been despoiled, and the human race is clothed in incorruption. Therefore giving thanks we cry unto Thee: Glory, O Christ, to Thy Rising![^2399]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: The incomprehensible and uncircumscribable One, consubstantial with the Father and the Spirit, didst thou mystically contain in thy womb, O Theotokos; one and unconfused Godhead of the Trinity have we known, to glorify thy childbearing in the world. Therefore thankfully we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O full of grace![^2400]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *After the Amomos, the Hypakoe, Tone 3:*[^2401]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: Astonishing by his appearance and bedewing by his words, the radiant Angel said unto the myrrh-bearing women: Why seek ye the Living One in the tomb? He is risen, Who emptied the graves! Understand the Incorruptible Changer of corruption. Say unto God: How awesome are Thy works! for Thou hast saved the human race.[^2402]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: *Songs of Ascents, Tone 3:*[^2403]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: Thou hast led captive Zion out of Babylon; draw me also, O Word, away from passions unto life.[^2404]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: They that sow in the south with divine tears shall reap the sheaves of everlasting life in joy.[^2405]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: Unto the Holy Spirit is all thanksgiving, even as He co-radiates with the Father and the Son, in Whom all things live and move. *Both now... the same.*[^2406]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: Except the Lord build the house of virtues, in vain do we labor; and while He protects the soul, no one shall destroy our city.[^2407]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: By the Spirit the saints are ever unto Thee, O Christ, even as unto the Father, the fruit of the womb adopted as sons.[^2408]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: Through the Holy Spirit is every holiness and wisdom foreseen; for He gives essence unto every creature. Unto Him let us minister; for He is God, even as unto the Father and the Word. *Both now... the same.*[^2409]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: Blessed are they that fear the Lord, walking in the ways of His commandments; for they shall eat the life-bearing fruit of all virtues.[^2410]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: Around Thy table, O Chief Shepherd, be glad, beholding Thine offspring bearing branches of well-doing.[^2411]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: Through the Holy Spirit is all wealth of glory, from Whom is grace and life unto every creature; for He is hymned with the Father and with the Word. *Both now... the same.*[^2412]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: Say among the heathen that the Lord is King; for He hath established the world, which shall not be moved.[^2413]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Кня́зь ми́рный прїи́де на престо́лъ Дави́довъ ца́рствꙋѧ, и҆зъ тебѐ Бцⷣе Бг҃ъ воплоща́емь; ѽ чꙋ́до! и҆ бра́нь разрѣши́въ, почтѐ
items.english_text: Let every breath praise the Lord.[^2415]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Въ Недѣ́лю на Оу҆́тренни, Гла́съ г҃.
items.english_text: *The Resurrection Gospel, and the rest in order.*[^2417]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ѵⷢліе воскре́сно, и҆ про́чее по рѧ́дꙋ.
items.english_text: *Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ... Psalm 50.*[^2418]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^2069]
