items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O mystical Vine, who didst bud forth for us the divine cluster, from which we are watered with the water of incorruption: pour forth into my soul compunction and the wine of purification, by thy supplications.[^2593]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: O pure and holy bridal chamber, wherein God betrothed the nature of men unto Himself, I pray thee: unite me unto thy Son, and make me His own by divine life, through thy supplications.[^2594]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: Having given birth unto Christ, the Fountain of incorruption, O Virgin, thou hast transformed the pasture of corruption of human nature; put to death therefore for me the burning and tumultuous surging of passions, by thy supplications.[^2595]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Then: "It is truly meet." Trisagion, and after "Our Father": the rest as usual, and the Dismissal.*[^2596]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *ON MONDAY AT MATINS.*[^2597]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *After the 1st Stichologia, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*[^2598]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Sojourning upon earth, O my soul, repent! For dust in the tomb praises not, nor delivers from transgressions. Cry out unto Christ God: O Knower of hearts, I have sinned against Thee! Before Thou judgest me, spare me, O God, and have mercy on me.[^2599]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* How long, O my soul, abidest thou in transgressions? How long dost thou accept the postponing of repentance? Bring to mind the coming judgment; cry out unto Christ God: O Knower of hearts, I have sinned! O sinless Lord, have mercy on me.[^2601]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: O Theotokos, our refuge and strength, mighty helper of the world! By thy

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: prayer save thy servants from every distress, O only Blessed One.[^2602]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Stichologia, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*[^2603]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* At the dread tribunal am I reproached without accusers, and condemned without witnesses; for the books of conscience are unrolled, and hidden deeds are uncovered. Therefore before Thou art to examine in that public spectacle what hath been done by me: O God, cleanse me and save me.[^2604]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* The depth of my transgressions Thou knowest, O Lord! Stretch forth unto me a hand of help, as unto Peter, and save me.[^2606]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* The good courage of your endurance hath conquered the crafts of the author of evil, O all-lauded passion-bearers! Therefore have ye been deemed worthy of eternal blessedness. But pray ye unto the Lord to save the flock of Christ-loving people, being witnesses of truth.[^2608]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: Rejoice, O Mary, Virgin Mother, holy mountain, paradise of Eden, from whom was born Christ God, the unseeded Word, through Whom life blossomed forth for the world.[^2609]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Stichologia, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* When we stand before Thine unbribable tribunal and divine judgment, and the heavenly powers shall stand before Thee with trembling: how shall I appear before Thee then, O most righteous Judge, having deeds worthy of condemnation and fire! But by the prayers of Thine Angels, spare me then, and save me.[^2611]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Another Sessional Hymn, to the Bodiless Powers:*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: Heavenly and earthly things hast Thou brought into being by Thy word, as almighty; and the angelic choirs, standing before Thee with trembling, offer unceasing praise unto Thee, O Master, illuminating all the ends of the earth with Thy light. With them we also cry unto Thee: Save us by Thy tender compassion.[^2612]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: As an uncultivated vine, O Virgin, thou hast budded forth the fairest Cluster, which pours forth for us the wine of salvation, making glad the souls and bodies of all. Therefore, ever blessing thee as the cause of good things, with the Angel we cry unto thee: Rejoice, thou who art full of grace.[^2613]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to His holy Martyrs.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *(The work of kyr Joseph.) Tone 3.*[^2614]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Having covered the chariots of Pharaoh with the deep, O Lord, Thou didst divide the sea, and didst save the people of Israel who praised Thee with songs.*[^2615]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*[^2616]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 1, Troparion 1:* Deliver me from the darkness of transgressions, O Sinless One, which without understanding I have committed, granting me tears of compunction, as once unto the harlot.[^2617]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Show me, who have become a den of robbers through improper deeds, to be Thy temple through virtues, O Lover of mankind, Who willingly wast born in a cave.[^2618]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Guided by the divine Spirit, ye traversed the storm of tortures, O divinely inspired martyrs, and reached the divine haven.[^2619]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Having been enlightened by the grace of the Spirit, O martyrs, ye fled from the deepest darkness of the frenzy of idols, rejoicing, O all-lauded ones.[^2620]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: O all-holy and all-pure One, helper of sinners, restoration of the falling: grant me compunctionate repentance, who have sinned much.[^2621]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Holy Bodiless Angels.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: I make a third song to the Bodiless.)*[^2622]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *(The work of Theophanes.) Tone 3.*[^2623]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Let us sing a new song, O ye peoples, unto Him that was born of the Virgin for our salvation, and made earthly things one with heavenly things; for He hath been glorified.*[^2624]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Archangels and Angels, pray to God for us.*[^2625]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 1, Troparion 1:* Being the unoriginate Light and the Giver of all manifestation of light, O Christ God: enlighten my thought by the intercession of Thy powers.[^2626]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Rejoicing in a manner befitting angels, through all-rich communion the angelic choirs are mystically illuminated by Thy fair radiances, O Savior.[^2627]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* As good and life-creating, the almighty Spirit of the Father hath beneficially established the heavenly powers in the unfailing divine radiances.[^2628]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: O Gabriel, leader of the ranks of God, of the immaterial choirs, and now most rich one: cry out a joyous voice unto her that is favored with grace: Rejoice, O All-immaculate One.[^2629]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Establish me, O Lord, Who alone art rich in mercy, and stretch forth unto me a hand as unto Peter, and save me.*[^2630]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 3, Troparion 1:* As Thou didst save Peter when he was sinking, O Lover of mankind, so also lead me up from the depth of my transgressions.[^2631]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The deceitful one hath slain me, killing me with passions; but do Thou, O Giver of life, quicken me by forms of repentance.[^2632]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Being unjustly burned with material fire, O martyrs, ye were immaterially inflamed with desire for the Immaterial One.[^2633]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Being torn asunder, the martyrs destroyed the tearing asunder and the snare of the deceitful one, and were deemed worthy of crowns.[^2634]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: O Mary, called after the Lord, free me who am held in sway by many soul-corrupting passions, by thy prayers.[^2635]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Thou hast broken the bow of the enemy, and crushed the shields by Thy might, O Master Christ, our confirmation: Holy art Thou, O Lord.*[^2636]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 3, Troparion 1:* Flowing streams and rivers of goodness hast Thou revealed, O Good One: the angelic choirs, shining with the ray of Thy hidden mystery.[^2637]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* That Thou mightest manifestly show the treasures of Thy wealth and might, O Master Christ, Thou hast brought forth the intellectual powers as partakers of Thy glory.[^2638]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Standing before Thee in trembling as servants, the angelic splendors ever sing of Thy power, O Christ, of immeasurable might.[^2639]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: He took whole man from thee immutably, and the same Master of all, O Mother of God, hath revealed thee as a fountain of grace.[^2640]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Wast Thou angry with the rivers, O Lord? Was Thine anger against the rivers, or Thine indignation against the sea?*[^2641]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 4, Troparion 1:* Loose the bonds of my passions, O Lord, binding me with repentance, and reveal me as a partaker of Thy good things.[^2642]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Cause radiant forms of repentance to dawn upon me, O Christ Who art the Sun, driving away the deep night of mine evils.[^2643]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Ye appeared, O wise sufferers, like coals burning up the matter of godlessness, and enlightening those that are in darkness.[^2644]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 4, Martyrikon 2:* Ye were assimilated unto the death of Christ, O martyrs, having mingled yourselves with various pains; therefore have ye inherited divine life.[^2645]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: Grant me true repentance, O Pure One, and still the tumult of my passions, O protectress of those who sin.[^2646]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *I heard the strange and ineffable mystery of Thy dispensation, and was afraid; and rejoicing I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind.*[^2647]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 4, Troparion 1:* Clouds receiving the three-sun illumination, ye were borne along by divine will, O threefold adornments, piloted by the power of the Spirit.[^2648]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Into the world are the Angels sent unto those that are about to believe in Thee, as guardians of the salvation of the pious, keeping Thy servants, O Savior.[^2649]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The Angels partake of the immaterial mystery, being illuminated by the approach of Thy Godhead, O Christ, crying: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind.[^2650]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: As a servant supplicant do I now come under thy roof, O All-immaculate One! Deliver me, O Mother of God, from the confusion of passions, who didst bear the Cause of dispassion.[^2651]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *With Thy never-setting light, O Christ God, illuminate my humble soul, and guide it unto Thy fear; for a light are Thy commandments.*[^2652]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 5, Troparion 1:* Set me not naked of good deeds at Thy tribunal, O Lover of mankind! But clothe me in the garment of divine deeds through repentance.[^2653]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I have been wounded with the weapon of passions, and have fallen into the pit of despair; despise me not, O Master, but heal me with the herb of conversion.[^2654]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Both being fiercely scraped with nails, and slain with the sword, O sufferers, and exhausted with wounds, ye bowed not the knee unto idols.[^2655]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* The world ever gloris in your sufferings, holy martyrs, for ye have found a transcendent dwelling with the Angels.[^2656]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнюю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ съ кади́ломъ, и҆
items.english_text: O thou who alone on earth didst give birth in the flesh unto the Word by a word, and didst remain a virgin: [deliver] me from irrational [passions]...[^2657]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: изба́ви дѣѧ́нїй, ꙗ҆́кѡ да словескѝ честны́ми воспѣва́ю тѧ̀.
items.english_text: ...deliver me from [irrational] deeds, that in rational words of honor I may praise thee.[^2658]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: На землѝ неви́димый ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ, и҆ человѣ́кѡмъ во́лею пожи́лъ є҆сѝ Непостижи́мый; и҆ къ тебѣ̀ оу҆́тренюющє, воспѣва́емъ тѧ̀ Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Upon earth, O Invisible One, Thou wast seen, and with men Thou didst willingly dwell, O Incomprehensible One; and rising early at dawn unto Thee, we praise Thee, O Lover of mankind.*[^2659]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆тца̀, Сы́на и҆ Дх҃а, трисїѧ́ннымъ свѣ́томъ просвѣща́ющесѧ вѣ́рнїи, воспои́мъ є҆ди́но Бж҃тво̀, съ А҆́гг҃лскими во́инствы.
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 5, Troparion 1:* Being enlightened with the three-sun light of the Father, the Son, and the Spirit, O faithful, let us praise the one Godhead with the angelic hosts.[^2660]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́щы собира́ющїѧсѧ, незаходи́мое сїѧ́нїе Бж҃ества̀ пребж҃твеннагѡ, проѧвле́ннѣ ѡ҆бога́щшесѧ, А҆́гг҃лстїи чи́ни проповѣ́даютъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The angelic ranks, gathering like lamps, manifestly enriched by the never-setting radiance of the pre-divine Godhead, proclaim Thee.[^2661]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆ди́но нача́ло пребезначáльное, честѝ Серафі́ми оу҆ча́тъ, вопїю́ще гла́съ трист҃ы́й ꙗ҆́вѣ, Дх҃омъ просвѣща́еми А҆́гг҃ли.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The Seraphim teach us to honor the one pre-unoriginate Principle, crying aloud manifestly the thrice-holy hymn, Angels enlightened by the Spirit.[^2662]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Безъ сѣ́мене Ѻ҆трокови́це тебѣ̀, А҆рха́гг҃лъ Гаврїи́лъ, роди́ти Животода́вца благовѣстѝ, Бц҃е всечи́стаѧ, съ небесѐ соше́дъ.
items.english_text: Having descended from heaven, O all-pure Theotokos, the Archangel Gabriel announced unto thee the good tidings of giving birth without seed unto the Giver of life, O Maiden.[^2663]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ концы̀ вѣкѡ́въ доше́дша Человѣколю́бче, и҆ треволне́ньми напа́стей поги́бнути бѣ́дствующа, вопїю́щїа не пре́зри: спасѝ Спа́се, ꙗ҆́коже спа́слъ є҆сѝ ѿ ѕвѣ́ра Проро́ка.
items.english_text: *O Lover of mankind, despise not him who hath come unto the end of the ages and is in peril of perishing through the surges of afflictions, crying out: Save me, O Savior, as Thou didst save the Prophet from the sea-monster.*[^2664]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Превознесо́хсѧ мы́слїю, ꙗ҆́кѡже дре́внїй фарісе́й; прегрѣше́нїемъ низпадо́хсѧ лю́тѣ, зрѧ́ мѧ льсти́вый, весели́тсѧ. Хр҃тѐ, и҆́же смири́вый сегѡ̀ крⷭ҇то́мъ, смири́вшагосѧ ны́нѣ оу҆ще́дри мѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 6, Troparion 1:* I was exalted in mind like the ancient Pharisee; through transgression I fell down fiercely, and seeing me the deceiver rejoices. O Christ, Who didst humble him by the Cross: have compassion on me who now have humbled myself.[^2665]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣхолюби́въ въ житїѝ бывъ, ꙗ҆́кѡже и҆́нъ никто́же Влⷣко, и҆жди́хъ твоѐ долготерпѣ́нїе ѻ҆ка́ѧнный, и҆ є҆щѐ є҆́смь нечу́вственъ; но ѡ҆брати́ мѧ твои́мъ благоутро́бїемъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having been a lover of sin in life as none other, O Master, I, wretched one, have exhausted Thy long-suffering, and yet I am unfeeling; but convert me by Thy tender compassion.[^2666]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́ростнымъ произволе́нїемъ, законопрестꙋ́пницы бг҃омꙋ́дренныхъ ѡ҆сꙋжда́юще, ѻ҆гне́мъ и҆ созже́нїемъ и҆ прокоде́ньми, зла́та свѣтлѣ́йша тїа̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ вои́стинꙋ показа́ша, и҆ Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ сонаслѣ́дники.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* With wrathful purpose the transgressors of the law condemned the divinely wise, and by fire, burning, and piercings they showed them to be truly brighter than gold and co-heirs with Christ.[^2667]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Сꙋди́ще и҆спо́лнено боре́нїй, и҆ по́двигѡвъ превели́кихъ, и҆ па́че є҆стества̀ ра́ны преше́дше, побѣди́сте кнѧ́за тмы̀, и҆ ѿ Бг҃а прїѧ́сте страда́лцы вѣнцы̀.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Having passed through a tribunal full of struggles and exceedingly great ascetic feats, and wounds surpassing nature, ye conquered the prince of darkness, O sufferers, and received crowns from God.[^2668]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Ковче́гъ завѣ́та, ст҃ꙋ́ю вои́стинꙋ трапе́зꙋ, ѻ҆чисти́лище на́ше, це́рковь Бж҃їю ѻ҆дꙋшевлéннꙋю, всезлаты́й свѣ́щникъ, и҆́стиннꙋю Ма́терь Зижди́телѧ воспѣва́емъ.
items.english_text: The ark of the covenant, the truly holy table, our mercy-seat, the ensouled church of God, the all-golden lampstand, the true Mother of the Creator do we praise in song.[^2669]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Jonah, being a natural image of the dwelling in the lowest Hades, cried out: Lead up my life from corruption, O Lover of mankind.*[^2670]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 6, Troparion 1:* The prime and all-effective radiance of the Godhead the Archangels and Angels powerfully sing, calling upon the Lord with unceasing voices together with Principalities, and Authorities, and Powers. *(Twice)*[^2671]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Thou Who didst invisibly adorn the noetic world in good order with all-diverse rank, vouchsafe that the honorable Church may be conformed unto this good order.[^2672]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: The Word that took up His abode in thee showed thee to be an ever-flowing fountain of healings; heal therefore the wounds of my soul, O Virgin Theotokos.[^2673]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *The three youths in the furnace, prefiguring the Trinity, trampled the fiery threatening, and singing cried aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.*[^2674]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 7, Troparion 1:* My time is ending, O my soul! The departure is at the doors; show forth therefore the fruits of repentance. Before the doors are shut, cry out unto Christ: O Lord, save me.[^2675]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Let us renew our hearts with the plow of true knowledge, sowing the wheat of repentance, that we may reap the ear of righteousness, O tillers of our souls in Christ.[^2676]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Luminaries of piety, adversaries of impiety, enrichers of the poor, O martyrs of the Lord! Enrich with virtues my most wretched soul that is destitute.[^2677]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* O Thou Who didst save the publican that sighed from the depths, receive also my small sighing, and save me for the sake of the passion-bearers who glorified Thee with their members, O Christ.[^2678]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: O fountain pouring forth the water of remission, dry up the torrents of my transgressions, granting me a cloud of tears, that I may ever praise thee as the Theotokos.[^2679]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *The proud tormentor became a plaything of children; for having trampled the sevenfold flame as dust, they sang: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.*[^2680]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 7, Troparion 1:* Beholding with steadfast mind and valiant eye, through communion in the primal splendor ye become secondary lights, O angelic choirs, crying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers. *(Twice)*[^2681]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Guided by unwavering desire and unflagging love,

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: ...and by the beauties of the Creator, ye became secondary luminaries by position, O angelic choirs, crying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^2682]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Incarnate didst thou bear the unoriginate Word, O Theotokos, Who is from the Father without mother before all ages, by a divine birth. Blessed, O Lady, is the Fruit of thy womb.[^2683]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Unto the Lord Who by divine power descended into the flame unto the Hebrew youths, and appeared: O ye priests, bless Him, and exalt Him above all unto all ages.*[^2684]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 8, Troparion 1:* Through mocking, Ham became a servant by his father's sentence; what wilt thou do, O my soul, having enslaved thyself to passions, and laughing disorderly, and having no shame before the Heavenly Father?[^2685]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having conceived enmity foolishly, Cain became a fratricide; unto him hast thou been shown like, O my soul, not having slain another, but thyself, through pleasure-loving and the deceits of life.[^2686]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* The chosen pearls of the Lord, honorable vessels shining with the radiance of lamps of divine grace, the passion-bearers of Christ, having assembled in faith, let us honor worthily.[^2687]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* O Word Who didst receive the blood of the wise passion-bearers more than incense, by their supplications save those who fall down before Thee in repentance, as the only Merciful One.[^2688]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: By the excess of a prodigal life, I have now drawn near unto Hades; having exceeding great tender compassion, O Maiden, as having ineffably given birth unto the compassionate God, have compassion and save me.[^2689]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *With immaterial flame the God-beholding youths withered the flame of material fire, and sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord.*[^2690]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 8, Troparion 1:* As Creator of all, Thou didst conceive the Angels in mind, and they stood before Thee with fear, crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and exalt Him above all unto the ages.[^2691]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By communion with the divine fire, having become like a flame, the heavenly minds cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and exalt Him above all unto the ages.[^2692]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou didst constitute the immaterial and noetic Angels before

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: ...all visible things, who unceasingly cry unto Thee: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and exalt Him above all unto the ages.[^2693]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 8, Troparion 4:* Thou didst constitute the immaterial and noetic Angels before all visible things, who unceasingly cry unto Thee: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and exalt Him above all unto the ages.[^2694]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: The Word of the Father, incarnate beyond word, hast thou born, O Virgin Mother of God, Whom all works praise as Lord and exalt above all unto all ages.[^2695]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Then: "My soul doth magnify the Lord."*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Upon Mount Sinai Moses beheld thee in the bush, who didst unburnt conceive the Fire of the Godhead in thy womb; and Daniel beheld thee as the unhewn mountain; and Isaiah cried: A rod that sprouted from the root of David.*[^2696]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 9, Troparion 1:* Jacob received the birthright of old through temperance; but Esau gave away his primogeniture, having not restrained his belly. How evil is intemperance, and how great is temperance! Flee from what is unfitting; love, O my soul, the increase of good things.[^2697]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As having endured many things, blameless Job was crowned; for the torrents of temptations that flowed together did not shake the pillar of his heart. Emulate him, O my soul, ever remaining unchangeable against the crafts of the deceitful one.[^2698]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Sharpened by the fire of the divine Spirit, ye appeared manifestly as swords, cutting down the opposing legions, O passion-bearers of Christ; and being glorified by great victories, ye were crowned by the all-powerful hand of the King of all.[^2699]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* O blameless multitude of martyrs! Pray the Master and God, Who received your ineffable labors and united you with the hosts of the bodiless, to cleanse the multitude of my measureless evils.[^2700]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: O radiant chamber of the Master, show me to be a house of light; O impassable gate, open unto me the paths of repentance; O holy earth, guide me unto the land of the meek, O Lady, and show me free from every dominion of passions.[^2701]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Wounded, O Pure One, by the sweet dart of thy most pure childbirth, marveling at thy much-desired beauty, with angelic songs we worthily magnify thee as Mother of God.*[^2702]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 9, Troparion 1:* O choirs that now stand before the great and prime Light, become most mighty intercessors for all of us who magnify you as much as is possible, O most divine Angels of God. *(Twice)*[^2703]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having been deemed worthy to clearly glorify the equal-in-power Trinity, being primarily illumined by Its radiance: make us, who piously magnify you, worthy to be illumined with secondary radiance.[^2704]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: We all know thee to be the foundation of our salvation; for thy most pure childbearing, by divine-working blood, hath saved those who sing of thee, O Theotokos, and faithfully glorify thee.[^2705]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Then: "It is truly meet." Litany, Exapostilarion, and the usual Psalms.*[^2706]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 3:*[^2707]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Gather my scattered mind, O Lord, and cleanse my frozen heart, giving me repentance as unto Peter, sighing as unto the publican, and tears as unto the harlot, that with a great voice I may cry unto Thee: O God, save me, as the only compassionate One and Lover of mankind.[^2708]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Many a time while performing the singing, I was found fulfilling sin; uttering the song with my tongue, but thinking unfitting things in my soul. But amend both, O Christ God, through repentance, and save me.[^2710]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* The memory of the holy passion-bearers, come, all ye people, let us honor; for having become a spectacle unto Angels and men, they received crowns of victory from Christ; and they pray for our souls.[^2712]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: O holy, prime-pure boast of the heavenly ranks, song of the Apostles and fulfillment of the Prophets, O Lady, receive our prayers.[^2713]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Then: "It is good to give praise." Trisagion; after "Our Father": troparion, and Litany. After this, the First Hour.*[^2714]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, The Beatitudes, Tone 3:*[^2715]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Adam our forefather, who rejected Thy commandment, O Christ,

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: ...Thou didst cast out of paradise; but the thief, O Compassionate One, who confessed Thee on the Cross, Thou didst settle therein, crying: Remember me, O Savior, in Thy kingdom.[^2716]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having overlooked the multitude of mine evils according to the multitude of Thy mercy, O Christ, save me; and in the day of judgment deliver me, O Savior, from condemnation and eternal torment, that I may hymn Thy goodness.[^2717]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 [to the Bodiless Powers]:* Cherubim and Seraphim, Thrones, Archangels, Powers, and Principalities, and Dominions, Angels and all Authorities: pray the Creator to overlook then my transgressions, when He shall come to judge the earth, as the Lover of mankind.[^2718]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Having dipped a purple robe in their sacred blood, the passion-bearers of Christ were truly deemed worthy to reign with the King of hosts in a manner befitting God; and they ask remission of transgressions for us who ever worthily honor them.[^2719]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Piously singing of the one tri-hypostatic Godhead, O faithful: the Father, and the Word, and the Holy Comforter Spirit, let us cry out with unceasing voices in the manner of angels: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God; save our souls.[^2720]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^2533]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Both now:* O thou who didst bear the Light of Light, radiant cloud! Having guided me, who am darkened by passions and the pleasures of life, unto the light, direct me, O Pure One, and pray that I may attain the glory which those who lived well have now obtained.[^2721]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 3.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Beholding in me slothfulness toward profitable works, and an inclination toward evil and worse things, the manifold serpent transforms himself, displaying the sweetness of sin, but his own bitter working, contrary to the divine commandments; therefore

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: ...he urges me on by deceitful custom to accept evils as good things, O Christ.[^2724]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Having eagerly walked every path of lawlessness and sin, and having abandoned the upright path unto the end, I have now drawn near unto the gates of death; being straitened I cry: O Way of our life, my all-good Jesus! Convert me unto the breadth of true repentance and save me; grant me amendment, and vouchsafe me divine forgiveness before death.[^2725]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Having been slain by various sins, and by multitudes of transgressions, and by great impropriety, I lie dead, helpless indeed; but my one hope lives, which is toward Thy tender compassion, O Christ, Who givest breath and life together unto the dead, and puttest to death the passions that have slain us. Therefore anticipate me, and snatch me from eternal death.[^2726]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Holy Forerunner John:*[^2727]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1 to the Forerunner:* O Forerunner, Who didst loose thy mother's barrenness and thy father's speechlessness at thy nativity: loose the childlessness of my heart and the irrationality of my soul by thy acceptable prayers unto the compassionate Son of the Father, the Master of all and God, Whom the Mind begot dispassionately as the Word; and strengthen me both to speak and to do the things pleasing unto Him.[^2728]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 to the Forerunner:* O thou who didst prepare the paths for Christ and make straight His ways, before Whose face thou wast sent: show my heart also to be a good pathway for Him by thy prayers and helpful manifestations; O thou who wast shown worthy of His honorable feet, make me worthy to walk upon the heavenly earth, where the feet of the meek tread, that with love I may honor thee as an intercessor.[^2729]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3 to the Forerunner:* Thou didst emulate the life of Angels upon earth, O completion of the Prophets, and first martyr of the New Testament, who wast the first preacher unto those under the earth of the descent of the divine Word thither, attested by Christ, friend of the Lamb and Deliverer! From all snares of the enemy, and from his entwined temptations, deliver thy servant, O John the Baptist, by thy prayers.[^2730]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: O cloud of the never-setting Light, Maiden favored with divine joy, blessed Mary! Cause the light of repentance to shine upon me who am foolishly held fast in the darkness of sin; and by thy supplications deliver me from the fire of Gehenna and the lightless darkness, and show me, who flee beneath thy protection, O All-pure One, to be a partaker of the never-ending day, O Virgin.[^2731]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Then: "O Gladsome Radiance." The Prokeimenon of the day.*[^2732]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 3:*[^2733]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* An evening song do we offer unto Thee, O Christ, with incense and spiritual songs: have mercy and save our souls.[^2734]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Save me, O Lord my God, for Thou art salvation unto all! The tempest of passions troubles me, and the burden of mine iniquities drowns me; stretch forth unto me a hand of help, and lead me up unto the light of repentance, as the only compassionate One and Lover of mankind.[^2736]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Great is the power of Thy martyrs, O Christ! For lying in the tombs, they drive away spirits, and they abolished the enemy's power, having contended for piety by faith in the Trinity.[^2738]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: O holy Theotokos among women, unwedded Mother! Pray Him Whom thou didst bear, the King and God, that He may save us, as the Lover of mankind.[^2739]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Then: "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart," and the rest.*[^2740]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.*[^2741]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *He Who of old by His divine bidding gathered the waters into one gathering, and divided the sea for the people of Israel: this is our God, most glorified; unto Him alone let us sing, for He hath been glorified.*[^2742]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^2743]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having spent my life in slothfulness, I have drawn near unto the end of my life; but do thou thyself, O Pure One, at least in the last time, grant me compunction, I pray, that I may weep bitterly over my measureless transgressions.[^2744]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having foolishly defiled the beauty of the image by the passions of my flesh, O Virgin, I was terrified of the indignation of God, and of the dread fiery threatening; but do thou thyself have mercy on me who flee unto thee.[^2745]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Having bowed my knees, wretched one, I ask thy help, O all-holy Virgin! Hear thou my suffering soul, and dispel the pressing cloud of my sorrow by the radiance of thy prayers.[^2746]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Grant that the furrows of my passionate

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: ...soul may be richly watered with tears, and vouchsafe me, O Lady, to bring forth fruit a hundredfold, and fill my heart with all gladness, that I may glorify thee.[^2747]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *O Almighty Master, Who didst bring all things into being from non-existence, created by the Word, perfected by the Spirit: establish me in Thy love.*[^2748]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Grant me a cloud of tears, O good Theotokos, and with them quench the furnace of my passions, and wash away every defilement of my soul.[^2749]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In lawlessness have I defiled the nobility of my soul, O Pure One, and I tremble at the inquiry, when the Word shall examine my worthiness of the image.[^2750]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Glory:* The storm of transgressions having encompassed me now, hath brought me down into the depth of despair; but stretch forth unto me a hand, O Pure One, and guide me unto repentance.[^2751]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Deliver thy servant, O all-immaculate One, from Gehenna and from every other threatening at the hour of judgment, and make me a partaker of the kingdom of thy Son and God.[^2752]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Thou hast set toward us a steadfast love, O Lord; for Thou didst give Thine only-begotten Son unto death for our sake. Therefore we cry unto Thee in thanksgiving: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.*[^2753]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The waters of unfitting deeds, O Pure One, have come in unto my wretched soul; therefore held fast by thoughts of mire, I cry out with pain: Despise me not, O Lady, thy servant.[^2754]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Noetic beasts have now unmercifully compassed me, striving unsparingly to snatch away my humble soul, O all-immaculate One; but crush their soul-captivating jaws, O Pure One.[^2755]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Be merciful unto thy servant, O Lady, I pray, and snatch thy people from the expected threatening, O All-pure One, that we may cry unto thee in thanksgiving: Glory to thee, the Queen of all.[^2756]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Both now:* When in the night the Bridegroom shall come to judge the earth, then vouchsafe me, O Pure One, to go forth unto His meeting with a radiant lamp, and to bow down before His coming.[^2757]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Upon earth, O Invisible One, Thou wast seen, and with men Thou didst willingly dwell, O Incomprehensible One; and rising early at dawn unto Thee, we praise Thee, O Lover of mankind.*[^2758]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Many dogs have truly encompassed me; a congregation of evil spirits hath surrounded me; but dispel their counsels now, O Pure One.[^2759]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having dug a pit for me now, the evil one attempts to cast me therein; but by thy right hand, O Lady, let him fall into the ditch which he hath made.[^2760]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Glory:* May I not be reproved by the wrath of thy Son at the time of His coming, nor chastened by His anger, O All-praised One! But save me by thy supplications.[^2761]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Behold, O Pure One, the infirmity, behold the humiliation of my wretched soul, and the rising up of bodiless enemies, and deliver me from their harm.[^2762]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *The uttermost abyss of sins hath compassed me, and my spirit fails; but stretch forth Thy high arm, O Master, and save me, O Helmsman, as Thou didst Peter.*[^2763]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By the bidding of the Creator of all, when my soul shall be parted from the flesh, O all-immaculate One: free me from the hand of those who hate me, O all-praised Theotokos.[^2764]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Dry up the turbid rivers of mine evil deeds, O Mother of God, with streams of compunction, and direct me unto the water of relief in the day of judgment.[^2765]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Thou knowest my psychic infirmity, and the weakness of my mind, O Pure One, and the frailty of my flesh; therefore save thy servant, for I have acquired thee as an unconquerable protectress.[^2766]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Grant me streams of spiritual tears, O Maiden, wherewith I may wash away the mire of my transgressions, and the tumult of passions, O all-immaculate One, and bodily defilements.[^2767]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Then: Lord, have mercy (three times). Glory... Both now...*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: O thou who didst bear the Merciful One in thy womb! Have compassion upon him who flees beneath thy protection, and asks from his soul for thy divine help, O Lady, and make him worthy of mercy; and when we stand before the Master of creation, deliver me, O Pure One, from eternal fire and every condemnation.[^2769]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Of old, the three youths bowed not down to the golden image, the Persian object of worship, singing in the midst of the furnace: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.*[^2770]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Селе́нїа І҆ѡ́на, є҆́же въ преиспо́днѣмъ а҆́дѣ, є҆сте́ственный ѻ҆́бразъ бы́въ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The waters of transgressions, O Pure One, have poured forth unto my soul...[^2771]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Въ Понедѣ́лникъ на Повече́ріи, Гла́съ г҃.  с҃чѳ
items.english_text: ...and the uttermost abyss hath compassed me; but deliver me from this tempest.[^2772]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: бе́здна же ѡ҆бы́де мѧ̀ послѣ́днаѧ; но сегѡ̀ и҆змѝ треволне́нїѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Sprinkle me, O Pure One, with the blood from the ribs of thy Offspring, according to the multitude of thy mercy; and wash me with streams of tears, and cleanse me from every defilement.[^2773]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆кропи́ мѧ Чи́стаѧ, кро́вїю и҆зъ ре́бръ Рождества̀ твоегѡ̀ мно́жествомъ ми́лости твоеѧ̀; ѡ҆мы́й же мѧ̀ сле́зными струѧ́ми, и҆ ѡ҆чи́сти мѧ̀ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ скве́рны.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Grant contrition to my soul, and humility to my heart, O All-pure One, that I may be delivered from every craftiness of those who ever mercilessly hunt me.[^2774]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Сокруше́нїе мое́й душѝ, смире́нїе же се́рдцу да́ждь Всечи́стаѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ да всѧ́кагѡ и҆зба́влюсѧ кова́рства, при́снѡ мѧ̀ неща́днѡ ловѧ́щихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* As the merciful Mother of God, vouchsafe mercy unto thy servants, O Lady, who with faith cry aloud unto thy Son: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^2775]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ми́лостива Ма́ти Бж҃їа, рабы̀ твоѧ̑, Влады́чице, ми́лости сподо́би, и҆̀же вѣ́рою Сы́ну твоемꙋ̀ вопїю́щыѧ: ѻ҆тце́въ Бж҃е, благослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *United with unendurable fire, the youths, champions of piety, remained unharmed by the flame and sang the divine hymn: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all for ever.*[^2776]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Нестерпи́момꙋ ѻ҆гню̀ соедини́вшесѧ, благоче́стїѧ предста́тели ю́нѡши, пла́менемъ же неврежде́ни, бж҃твенную пѣ́снь поѧ́хꙋ: благослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇на Гдⷭ҇а, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Стрѣ́лы стрѣльца̀ сокрушѝ Чи́стаѧ, держа́вою Сы́на твоегѡ̀, и҆ сегѡ̀ непра́вда ны́нѣ да сни́детъ на ве́рхъ є҆гѡ̀, да воспою̀: всѧ̑ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇на, Гдⷭ҇а по́йте, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Break the arrows of the archer, O Pure One, by the dominion of thy Son, and let his unrighteousness now descend upon his head, that I may sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all for ever.[^2777]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́томъ твои́мъ ѡ҆зарѝ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ѡ҆мраче́нное моѐ се́рдце, и҆ ѻ҆рꙋ́жїемъ свѣ́та, къ свѣ́ту две́ри ѿве́рзи мнѣ̀ зовꙋ́щꙋ: благослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇на Гдⷭ҇а, по́йте и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Illumine my darkened heart with thy light, O Maiden, and with the armor of light open unto me the doors of light as I cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all for ever.[^2778]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆сну́въ въ сме́рти, лежꙋ̀ въ гро́бѣ ѿча́ѧнїѧ; но сама́ мѧ возста́ви Дѣ́во, и҆ бо́дреннѡ пѣ́ти сподо́би: благослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇на Гдⷭ҇а, по́йте и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Having fallen asleep in death, I lie in the tomb of despair; but do thou thyself raise me up, O Virgin, and make me worthy to sing vigilantly: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all for ever.[^2779]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Не преста́й Чи́стаѧ молѧ́щи ѡ҆ чтꙋ́щихъ тѧ̀ въ ᲂу҆миле́нїи, и҆зба́витисѧ сѣ́тей діа́волскихъ, Сы́ну твоемꙋ̀ вопїю́щимъ: благослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇на Гдⷭ҇а, по́йте и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Cease not, O Pure One, to pray for those who honor thee in compunction, that they may be delivered from the snares of the devil, crying unto thy Son: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all for ever.[^2780]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Въ зако́нѣ сѣ́ни и҆ писа́нїй, ѻ҆́бразъ ви́димъ вѣ́рнїи: всѧ́къ мꙋ́жескїй по́лъ ложесна̀ разверза́ѧ, свѧ́тъ Бг҃у. Тѣ́мъ перворожде́нное Сло́во, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ безнача́лнагѡ Сы́на, перворожда́ющасѧ Ма́терїю неискꙋсомꙋ́жнѡ, велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *In the shadow and the letter of the Law, we the faithful see a figure: Every male that opens the womb is holy to God. Therefore the firstborn Word of the unoriginate Father, the Son Who is the firstborn of an unwedded Mother, do we magnify.*[^2781]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆бурева́етъ страсте́й волне́нїе, и҆ смꙋще́нїе скве́рныхъ помышле́нїй дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀, и҆ лꙋка́выхъ человѣ́къ бꙋ́рѧ при́снѡ мѧ̀ смꙋща́етъ; но ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣколюби́ва Дѣ́во, ѡ҆держа́щїѧ нꙋ́жды вско́рѣ мѧ̀ и҆зба́ви.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The surging of passions and the confusion of defiled thoughts overwhelm my soul, and the tempest of evil men ever troubles me; but as a lover of mankind, O Virgin, quickly deliver me from the distress that holds me fast.[^2782]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O humble soul, depart from thine evil deeds, and cease...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: ...cease from malice and from angering God; and diligently receive His commandments, for thou hast the Theotokos directing thy paths.[^2783]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Glory:* As she that bare the Lord of all, free me from passions and grievous sins, and enrich my whole self with good works for thy great mercy's sake, that rejoicing I may magnify thee with love, O All-immaculate One.[^2784]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Both now:* The end draws nigh, O my soul, the judgment seat is at the doors; depart from shameful deeds, and take hold of a good life; for thou hast the Theotokos as a helper, delivering thee from every affliction.[^2785]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet... Trisagion. After the Our Father: the troparion and the rest as usual, and the dismissal.*[^2786]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *On Tuesday at Matins, Tone 3.*[^2787]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymns of Compunction, Tone 3:*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: Abiding upon the earth, O my soul, repent; for the dust in the grave sings not, nor delivers from transgressions; cry aloud unto Christ God: O Knower of hearts, I have sinned against Thee; before Thou judgest me, spare me, O God, and have mercy on me.[^2788]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: How long, O my soul, dost thou remain in transgressions? How long dost thou accept the postponement of repentance? Bring to mind the coming judgment, and cry aloud unto Christ God: O Knower of hearts, I have sinned; O Sinless Lord, have mercy on me.[^2790]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: Marveling at the beauty of thy virginity and the exceedingly bright splendor of thy purity, Gabriel cried aloud unto thee, O Theotokos: What worthy praise shall I bring unto thee? Or what shall I name thee? I am in perplexity and I am amazed. Therefore, as I was commanded, I cry aloud unto thee: Rejoice, thou who art full of grace![^2791]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: At the dread judgment seat I am convicted without accusers, and without witnesses am I condemned; for the books of conscience are opened, and secret deeds are disclosed. Before, therefore, Thou shalt examine upon that public spectacle the deeds done by me, O God, cleanse me and save me.[^2792]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: Thou knowest the depth of my transgressions, O Lord; give me a hand of help, as unto Peter, and save me.[^2794]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
