items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Ye shine through faith as exceedingly radiant luminaries, O holy ones, physicians of the infirm, all-praised passion-bearers! For ye feared not the torments of the torturers, and cast down the impiety of idols, possessing an invincible victory: the true Cross.[^2796]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: Receive him that flees with faith beneath thy protection, O Lady, and despise me not, nor overlook me, O Good One, who pray in repentance. Receive the prayer from my unworthy lips, and by thine intercession deliver me from snares, that with boldness I may cry unto thee: Rejoice, thou who art full of grace![^2797]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3.*[^2798]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: Having fled beneath thy protection, with faith we call from the depth of our soul: O divinely-blessed Prophet and Forerunner! Still the confusion of assaults and tribulations, and the tempest of diseases; and make ineffectual the crafty counsels of the enemies, asking for us great mercy.[^2800]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: Shake off thy despondency through repentance, O wretched soul, before thy departure; turn back with weeping, crying unto the guileless Jesus, the Lover of mankind: I have sinned against Thee, O Master! But as Thou art compassionate, save me through the prayers of the holy Forerunner, Who alone art sinless.[^2801]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: Incomprehensible and unsearchable, O Lady full of divine grace, is the dread mystery of God accomplished concerning thee; for having conceived the Uncontainable One, thou gavest birth unto Him, clothed in flesh from thy most pure blood; Whom do thou ever entreat, O Pure One, together with the Forerunner, that our souls may be saved.[^2802]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to His Holy Martyrs.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: Attend unto my groanings, O Word of God.)*[^2803]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *(The work of Joseph.) Tone 3.*[^2804]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Marvelous in glory, doing wonders art Thou, O God, Who didst turn the deep into dry land, and didst drown the chariots, and savedst the people that sing unto Thee as our King and God.*[^2805]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Let us ourselves weep from our whole soul before the end, O faithful! The Bridegroom draws nigh; let us kindle our deeds as radiant lamps, that together we may attain the divine bridal chamber...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: ...that together we may attain the divine bridal chamber.[^2806]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having repented of old from his whole soul, Manasseh was saved; for, bound fast in the midst of fetters, he cried aloud unto the only Master. Emulate him, O soul, and thou shalt easily be saved.[^2807]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Blindness of eyes, severance of hands, cutting out of tongue, and amputation of feet, breaking of thighs and arms did the divine sufferers endure, giving thanks unto Jesus Christ.[^2808]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* A place of healing hath the shrine of your relics appeared unto us all, the faithful, O holy martyrs; from whence we draw healings of souls and bodies, who ever worthily honor you.[^2809]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Carrying Christ, the Manna of immortality, O spiritual urn: deliver me from the bitterness of soul-destroying passions, O All-hymned Virgin, that with faith I may piously give glory to thee.[^2810]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Forerunner John.*[^2811]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *He Who of old by divine beck gathered the waters into one gathering, and divided the sea for the people of Israel, this is our God, and He is exceedingly glorified; unto Him alone do we sing, for He hath been glorified.*[^2812]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Forerunner and Baptist of the Savior John, pray to God for us.*[^2813]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 1, Troparion 1:* Divine offspring of a barren womb: pray to God that I may bring forth fruits of virtues, loosing the barrenness of my sin, and driving away the gloom from my mind, O Forerunner of the Lord.[^2814]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 1, Troparion 2:* As a great forerunner star of the Sun of glory, Who enlightens all the earth, hast thou appeared on earth through faith. Do thou therefore pray to Him, O Forerunner, to enlighten my soul darkened by evil thoughts.[^2815]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 1, Troparion 3:* O Prophet who by the divine Spirit didst proclaim life drawing nigh unto those in Hades: quicken my slain soul by thy supplications, and raise me up, I pray, as from the tomb of transgressions, O glorious Forerunner.[^2816]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Together with Archangels and Angels, O Virgin, and with all the Saints, entreat the Lord Who through thee appeared unto us, we pray, that those who confess thee as true Theotokos...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: ...may be delivered from tribulations.[^2817]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *O barren and childless soul, acquire glorious fruit, and crying out in bearing good children: I am established through Thee, O God! There is none holy, there is none righteous above Thee, O Lord.*[^2818]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 3, Troparion 1:* Senselessly have I rejected the Law of God, and I am to be condemned, and what I shall do, I know not. O most righteous Judge, have compassion on me and save me in Thy loving-kindness.[^2819]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 3, Troparion 2:* Being the Orient of orients, O Lover of mankind: shine forth upon me, I pray, the light of righteousness, delivering me from the darkening of passions and the darkness of torment, O Plenteous in mercy.[^2820]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 3, Martyrikon 1:* Dwellers of the noetic land, fruitful trees of paradise, holy martyrs, fountains possessing divine water, cups pouring forth holy drink have ye appeared.[^2821]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 3, Martyrikon 2:* Bearing a single character in many bodies, O passion-bearing martyrs, ye vanquished the ruler of the world of darkness, proclaiming the indivisible Trinity.[^2822]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 3, Theotokion:* O Virgin Mother most pure, unto us who repent and flee unto Christ, and desire to receive remission of transgressions, make Him merciful unto all, O Lady of all.[^2823]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *O Almighty Master, Who didst bring all things out of nothingness, which are created by the Word and perfected by the Spirit: establish me in Thy love.*[^2824]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Forerunner and Baptist of the Savior John, pray to God for us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 3, Troparion 1:* Having been the voice of the Word, O Baptist: direct now unto Him the voices of those who honor thee, and grant us remission of transgressions by thine intercession.[^2825]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 3, Troparion 2:* I have sinned against Thee and committed iniquity, and grievously, O Savior, have I transgressed and defiled my soul. Therefore do I pray Thee: for Thy Baptist's sake, have compassion upon me.[^2826]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 3, Troparion 3:* O thou who wast nurtured in the wilderness and art the instructor of the new people: I pray thee, O Forerunner, guide me who have wandered in the wilderness through pleasures into the way of repentance.[^2827]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 3, Theotokion:* Together with the Apostles and the divine Prophets, with the Martyrs, O All-pure One, and with the heavenly Powers: pray to thy Son to have compassion on us who sing of thee.[^2828]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *The shadowed mountain did Habakkuk foresee, even thy most pure womb, O Pure One...*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: ...therefore did he cry: God shall come from Theman, and the Holy One from a mountain shadowed with dense woods.[^2829]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 4, Troparion 1:* O Christ Who of old didst bring forth water from the rock for an intractable and contradictory people: from my dry soul, O God, bring forth a drop of compunction to wash me clean.[^2830]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 4, Troparion 2:* O Physician of the sick: heal the passions of my heart by Thy compassionate nod, applying thereto, O Savior, as Good One, the plaster of repentance, of divine healing, that in faith I may glorify Thee.[^2831]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 4, Martyrikon 1:* Having compassionately unyoked the thought of friendship toward the body, O passion-bearers, ye surrendered yourselves to those who wished to torment you. Therefore did ye become close friends unto the Creator.[^2832]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 4, Martyrikon 2:* Grievous wounds from manifold tortures did ye endure, O sufferers of Christ, and ye received grace from spiritual gifts, driving away the long-enduring sicknesses of our passions.[^2833]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 4, Theotokion:* Rejoice, O Maiden of many names, from whom God the Word was born, loosing us from irrational and unfitting deeds! Rejoice, radiant cloud that drivest away the clouds of our despondency![^2834]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Thou hast set a firm love toward us, O Lord; for Thou didst give Thine only-begotten Son unto death for us. Therefore unto Thee do we cry, giving thanks: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.*[^2835]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Forerunner and Baptist of the Savior John, pray to God for us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 4, Troparion 1:* Thee, who art the voice of the Word manifested in the flesh, do I entreat, O Forerunner of the Lord: deliver me from irrational deeds, who rationally honor thee and dutifully bless thee in faith.[^2836]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 4, Troparion 2:* Sigh, O soul, and cry aloud unto God thy Creator: I have sinned, cleanse me, O Christ, and deliver me from dread torment, and from perils and afflictions, through the supplications of the divine Forerunner.[^2837]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 4, Troparion 3:* Plunged by many waves of grievous passions, and cruelly held fast by tempest, and ever drowning: snatch me away, O Baptist, and guide me unto the haven of repentance.[^2838]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 4, Theotokion:* Mother of God, chariot higher than the Cherubim: together with the immaterial ministers, and with all the Saints...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: ...entreat Christ, Whom thou didst bear, O All-immaculate One, to save me who am in despair.[^2839]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Rising early at dawn, we hymn Thee, O Word, only-begotten Son of God! Grant us Thy peace, and have mercy upon us who praise Thee and faithfully worship Thee.*[^2840]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 5, Troparion 1:* Having sprinkled me with the hyssop of repentance, cleanse me from the defilements of passions, that I may appear pure before Thee, when Thou shalt judge all things, O Jesus, by Thy righteous judgment.[^2841]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 5, Troparion 2:* The wounds of my most wretched soul are become corrupt, O Savior; O Physician of the sick, and Giver of good things, heal and save me, for Thy great mercy's sake.[^2842]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 5, Martyrikon 1:* The earthen vessels of the passion-bearers were broken upon the earth, but the strength of their soul was strengthened yet more, and shone forth by the power of Christ.[^2843]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 5, Martyrikon 2:* The shed blood of the Saints sanctified the whole earth, and gave drink to the souls of the faithful, and manifestly dried up the turbid streams of deception.[^2844]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 5, Theotokion:* By thy birthgiving, O Maiden, thou didst make barren the ancestral curse, and didst pour forth unto us rivers of blessing, who bless thee and glorify thee in faith.[^2845]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Invisible upon earth hast Thou appeared, and willingly hast Thou dwelt with men, O Incomprehensible One! And rising early at dawn unto Thee, we sing of Thee, O Lover of mankind.*[^2846]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Forerunner and Baptist of the Savior John, pray to God for us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 5, Troparion 1:* As an Angel upon earth, O blessed one, didst thou live in the flesh; therefore do I pray thee: free my soul from carnal mindedness.[^2847]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 5, Troparion 2:* Having fallen into the depth of sin, and defiled my soul with pleasures, and being in peril: O Forerunner of the Lord, save me who flee unto thee.[^2848]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 5, Troparion 3:* Higher than the Prophets hast thou appeared, for thou thyself, O Prophet, didst behold the One Foretold; Whom do thou unceasingly entreat to enlighten our souls.[^2849]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 5, Theotokion:* Revealed as more spacious than the heavens through the indwelling of the Word within thee, O thou full of divine grace: free me from the sins that oppress me.[^2850]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *The deep of passions hath risen up against me, and the tempest of contrary winds; but make haste and save me, O Savior, and deliver me from corruption, as Thou didst save the Prophet from the sea monster.*[^2851]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 6, Troparion 1:* I am darkened by the gloom of sin, and lie entirely inactive; O Christ God, Who wast once wounded with a spear for my sake, have compassion upon me in Thy mercy.[^2852]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 6, Troparion 2:* I groan and abide in evils; I shed tears, yet tremble not at the judgment, ailing with insensibility. O Word of God, have compassion upon me, and save me by Thy good judgments.[^2853]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 6, Martyrikon 1:* As lambs crying not out at all, emitting neither word nor sound, O all-glorious sufferers, ye were led to slaughter and to wounds, singing unto Christ.[^2854]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 6, Martyrikon 2:* Ye were given over unto wild beasts for food, and partook of the depths of the sea with a joyful soul. Therefore did Christ adorn you with incorruptible crowns, O sufferers.[^2855]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 6, Theotokion:* Door of those who are faithfully saved, Gate through which He alone passed Who was incarnate for our sake: open the gates of righteousness unto us who sing of thee in faith.[^2856]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *The uttermost abyss of sins hath compassed me, and my spirit fails; but stretch forth Thy high arm, O Master, and save me, O Helmsman, as Thou didst Peter.*[^2857]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Forerunner and Baptist of the Savior John, pray to God for us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 6, Troparion 1:* With the waters, thou didst baptize Him that bowed beneath thy hand, the torrent of pleasure; entreat Him, O wise one, to send down water of compunction upon me who have sinned much.[^2858]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 6, Troparion 2:* In the river, O Forerunner, thou didst wash the abyss of mercy, Jesus the Lover of mankind, Who covers the highest heights of heaven with waters; entreat Him to pour forth forgiveness unto me.[^2859]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 6, Troparion 3:* The kingdom of heaven is at hand: repent! didst thou cry, O Forerunner! Make those who love and honor thee, and flee beneath thy precious protection, worthy to obtain it.[^2860]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 6, Theotokion:* O All-pure One, who gavest thy flesh in loan unto the Creator: together with the heavenly Powers, and with all the Prophets, Apostles, and Martyrs, entreat Him to have compassion and save me.[^2861]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Thou Who didst bedew the furnace flame, and savedst the youths unconsumed: Blessed art Thou for ever, O Lord, the God of our fathers.*[^2862]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 7, Troparion 1:* I am stripped of the garments of incorruption, and have clothed myself in deeds of dishonor; therefore do I cry unto Thee: O compassionate God, illumine me with the garments of virtues.[^2863]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 7, Troparion 2:* With prodigal eyes have I wallowed in the mire, and by the touch of intemperance have I been defiled, and I am become abominable before Thee, O Jesus; receive me as the prodigal.[^2864]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 7, Martyrikon 1:* Having loved the life on high, ye endured many afflictions, O armorbearers of Christ, divine luminaries! Therefore are ye faithfully blessed.[^2865]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 7, Martyrikon 2:* Having been enlightened by the radiance of martyrdom, ye shine forth brighter than the sun, and have driven away all darkness of godlessness, O holy martyrs.[^2866]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 7, Theotokion:* As thou didst give birth unto the Upholder of all: deliver me from the darkness of ignorance and sin which holds me fast, O pure Theotokos, ever-Virgin.[^2867]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *The three youths in the furnace, prefiguring the Trinity, trod underfoot the fiery threatening, and singing they cried aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord, God of our fathers.*[^2868]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Forerunner and Baptist of the Savior John, pray to God for us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 7, Troparion 1:* Luminary of the Sun: illumine my soul which is darkened and blinded by slothfulness, directing me unto the path of repentance, O Baptist and Forerunner of Christ.[^2869]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 7, Troparion 2:* Contemplating the hour of judgment, I am entirely terrified, lying in a multitude of unfitting deeds; O Baptist of the Lord, stand by and deliver me from the fire that lies before me.[^2870]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 7, Troparion 3:* Protector of my life, my defender, O Forerunner: preserve and shelter me from enemies visible and invisible, and make me a partaker of the heavenly kingdom.[^2871]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 7, Theotokion:* O Virgin Theotokos: entreat thy Son, together with the Prophets, Apostles, and Martyrs, to deliver us, who ever honor thee, from future distress.[^2872]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Unto God Who is unceasingly glorified by Angels in the highest, the heavens of heavens, the earth, and the mountains, and the hills, and the deep, and the whole human race: with hymns bless Him as Creator and Redeemer, and exalt Him above all for ever.*[^2873]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 8, Troparion 1:* Because I have not had Thy fear dwelling in my heart, I, devoid of conscience, have fulfilled all carnal pleasure, and I tremble at Thy judgment, O King of all! Abhor me not who now repent.[^2874]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 8, Troparion 2:* Vouchsafe me, O Plenteous in mercy, to pass over into the holy land wherein the meek dwell, washing me by repentance from earthly sin, O Thou Who wast born sinlessly upon earth of the Virgin.[^2875]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 8, Martyrikon 1:* In your own blood were your feet dyed crimson, tripping up the enemy, and righteously accomplishing your journey to the heavens, O all-glorious passion-bearers of Christ, the God of all.[^2876]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 8, Martyrikon 2:* Having stripped yourselves for sufferings and great struggles with eagerness, ye exposed the enemy and clothed him in shame. Therefore, wearing crowns in the heavens, ye dance for joy, O glorious passion-bearers.[^2877]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 8, Theotokion:* Having loved thee as the beauty of Jacob, the Lord Who is fair in beauty, entering into thy womb, O All-immaculate One, illumined human nature with beautifying gifts surpassing understanding.[^2878]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *United with unendurable fire, the youths, champions of piety, remained unharmed by the flame and sang the divine hymn: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all for ever.*[^2879]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Forerunner and Baptist of the Savior John, pray to God for us.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 8, Troparion 1:* Thou didst proclaim the Lamb of God Who takes away the sins of men, O divine Forerunner John! Pray unto Him to loose the burden of my sins, and make me worthy of the portion of the saved.[^2880]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 8, Troparion 2:* Deliver me from the flame of the burning furnace, and from outer unillumined darkness, who am wholly held fast in the darkness of evil deeds, I pray Thee, O Word of God, supremely unoriginate, for the sake of Thy glorious and divine Baptist.[^2881]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 8, Troparion 3:* O divine Prophet of the Lord, who didst preach fruitful repentance unto empty and barren souls: cleanse my thorn-bearing soul from all pleasures, that I may bring forth ears of good deeds.[^2882]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 8, Theotokion:* As Mother of God, pray together with the holy Angels and Prophets, the Apostles, and the Martyrs, that those who ever confess thee as Theotokos may be delivered from perils and afflictions, and all future torments.[^2883]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Blessed is the Lord God of Israel, Who has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David, through the tender mercy of His loving-kindness, whereby the Dayspring from on high has visited us, and has guided us into the way of peace.*[^2884]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѐ смире́ннаѧ, ѿстꙋпѝ лꙋка́выхъ твои́хъ дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ преста́ни
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 9, Troparion 1:* Behold, now is the acceptable time, and the day of purification! Desire at last to turn back, O soul, and produce fruits of repentance, lest the dread axe of death find thee barren, and, cutting thee down like the barren fig tree of old, send thee unto the fire yonder.[^2885]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡже и҆ногда̀ бога́тый, весели́хсѧ въ сла́достехъ, немилосе́рдїе мно́гое и҆мы́й къ бли́жнемꙋ, и҆ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ не оу҆страша́юсѧ неꙋгаси́магѡ. Тѣ́мже Влады́ко, оу҆мягчѝ мнѣ̀ ѡ҆камене́нїе дꙋшѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ да понѐ на коне́цъ милосе́рдїемъ просвѣти́всѧ ѡ҆мраче́нный.
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 9, Troparion 2:* Even as the rich man once rejoiced in delights, having much mercilessness toward his neighbor, and feared not the unquenchable fire: therefore, O Master, soften for me the petrification of my soul, that at last, having been illumined by mercy, I who am darkened may be saved.[^2886]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Зна́менавшеся Мч҃ницы бж҃е́ственною кро́вїю Хрⷭ҇то́вою, и҆ зна́менми вѣ́рою стра́ждꙋще крѣ́пкѡ, невѣ́рныя врагѝ низложи́сте, и҆ ѿ пре́лести скве́рныя мнѡ́гїя лю́ди и҆схи́тисте, премѣне́нїи бж҃е́ственными просвѣти́вше свѣ́томъ бг҃оразꙋ́мїя.
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 9, Martyrikon 1:* Marked, O holy Martyrs, with the divine blood of Christ, and suffering firmly with faith by miracles, ye cast down the faithless enemies, and from foul delusion snatched away many people, having illumined them with the light of divine knowledge through divine transformations.[^2887]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зощре́ни ꙗ҆ви́стеся мечѝ, сѣкꙋ́ще вра́жїя ѡ҆полче́нїя бж҃е́ственнїи Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви Мч҃ницы, и҆ сосꙋ́ди вмѣсти́вшїи зарю̀ ст҃ы́я Трⷪ҇цы, и҆ свѣ́щницы свѣтѧ́щїи вѣ̑рнымъ свѣ́тъ благоче́стїя, и҆ Сїѡ́на мы́сленнагѡ и҆́стиннїи ѻ҆рꙋ́жницы.
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 9, Martyrikon 2:* Ye appeared as sharpened swords, cutting down the enemy's regiments, O divine Martyrs of Christ, and vessels containing the radiant dawn of the Holy Trinity, and lamps shining the light of piety upon the faithful, and true soldiers of spiritual Sion.[^2888]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Свѣтови́дна тѧ̀ ѻ҆́блака Проро́къ предзри́тъ, и҆зъ негѡ́же вели́кое со́лнце ꙗ҆ви́ся на́мъ Хрⷭ҇то́съ Бг҃ъ, и҆ просвѣтѝ ꙗ҆̀же пе́рвѣе ѡ҆мраче́нныя. Того̀ оу҆молѝ Блага́я, страсте́й мои́хъ ѻ҆́блаки ѿгна́ти, и҆ свѣ́томъ бж҃твеннымъ просвѣти́ти.
items.english_text: *Canon 1, Ode 9, Theotokion:* The Prophet foresaw thee as a light-bearing cloud, from which the great Sun, Christ God, appeared unto us, and illumined those who were formerly darkened. Him do thou entreat, O Gracious Lady, to drive away the clouds of my passions, and to illumine me with divine light.[^2889]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Въ зако́нѣ сѣ́ни и҆ писа́нїй ѡ҆́бразъ ви́димъ вѣ́рнїи, всѧ́къ мꙋ́жескїй по́лъ ложесна̀ разверза́ѧ, ст҃ъ Бг҃ꙋ. Тѣ́мъ перворожде́нное Сло́во Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ безнача́льна, Сн҃а первородѧ́щася Мт҃ерїю неискꙋсомꙋ́жнѡ, велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *In the shadow and the letter of the Law, we the faithful see a figure: Every male that opens the womb is holy to God. Therefore the firstborn Word of the unoriginate Father, the Son Who is the firstborn of an unwedded Mother, do we magnify.*[^2890]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Въ зако́ннꙋю сѣ́нь прини́къ, зарю̀ бж҃е́ственныя благода́ти бога́тство оу҆зрѣ́въ, земны́я концы̀ Мꙋ́дре просвѣща́еши, и҆ тмꙋ̀ прогоня́еши неразꙋ́мїя, Проро́че, сегѡ̀ ра́ди тѧ̀ чти́мъ.
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 9, Troparion 1:* Stooping down into the legal shadow and seeing the wealth of the radiant dawn of divine grace, thou dost illumine the ends of the earth, O Wise One, and dost drive away the darkness of foolishness, O Prophet; therefore do we honor thee.[^2891]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ мч҃никъ Хрⷭ҇то́въ, ꙗ҆́кѡ бж҃твенный Крести́тель, ꙗ҆́кѡ покаѧ́нїя свѣти́льникъ, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ оу҆́тро благоче́стїя, ве́тхомꙋ хода́тай и҆ но́вомꙋ, ѡ҆бветша́вшꙋю ѕло́бою смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ, разꙋмѣ́нїемъ бж҃е́ственнымъ ѡ҆бнови́въ, просвѣтѝ.
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 9, Troparion 2:* As a Martyr of Christ, as the divine Baptist, as the lamp of repentance, and as the morning of piety, mediator between the Old and the New: having renewed with divine understanding my humble soul, grown old in malice, do thou illumine it.[^2892]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Въ ча́съ оу҆жа́сный, въ ча́съ стра́шный, въ ча́съ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїя ѡ҆сꙋжда́ема мѧ̀ и҆зба́ви Мꙋ́дре, преще́нїя ждꙋ́щагѡ мѧ̀ та́мѡ, послꙋ́шающаго и҆мѣ́я твоѧ̀ мольбы̀, ꙗ҆́кѡже дрꙋ́гъ жениха̀ Спаси́телѧ дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 9, Troparion 3:* In the fearful hour, in the dread hour, in the hour of judgment, deliver me, O Wise One, who am condemned, from the threat that awaits me there, having Him Who hears thy supplications, as the Friend of the Bridegroom, the Savior of our souls.[^2893]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Canon 2, Ode 9, Theotokion:* As the Mother of God, as the Mother of the Word of God born of thee according to the flesh, O Pure One...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: ...with the Bodiless Powers, the Apostles and the Prophets, with the Hierarchs and the Martyrs, Him do thou ever entreat to give peace unto the world, O Most Pure Virgin Mother.[^2894]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet... Litany, and Exapostilarion, and the usual Psalms.*[^2895]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of Compunction, Tone 3:*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: Gather my scattered mind, O Lord, and cleanse my frozen heart, giving me repentance as unto Peter, sighing as unto the publican, and tears as unto the harlot, that with a loud voice I may cry unto Thee: O God, save me, as Thou alone art compassionate and the Lover of mankind.[^2896]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: Often singing hymns, I am found committing sins; with my tongue indeed uttering songs, but in my soul conceiving unseemly thoughts; but correct both, O Christ God, through repentance, and have mercy on me.[^2898]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* The warriors of Christ cast away the fear of kings and torturers, and with good boldness and courageously confessed Him, the Lord of all, God and our King, and they pray for our souls.[^2900]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Without seed thou didst conceive by the Holy Spirit, and glorifying we sing unto thee: Rejoice, O Most Holy Virgin.[^2901]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise... Trisagion. After Our Father: troparion and litany. The First Hour and dismissal.*[^2902]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 3:*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: Thou didst cast out of Paradise, O Christ, our forefather Adam who set aside Thy commandment; but the thief, O Compassionate One, who confessed Thee upon the Cross, Thou didst settle therein, as he cried: Remember me, O Savior, in Thy kingdom.[^2903]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: Defiled by the pleasures of life have I acquired my soul; unto Thy compassions do I come, being wholly desperate, and diligently do I cry unto Thee, O Christ, Who alone knowest secrets: Cleanse me by Thy mercy, O Lord.[^2904]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having been mediator between the Old and the New, O divine Baptist...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: ...having renewed me who am grown old through transgressions, grant me by thy supplications, O All-praised One, to walk without stumbling along the paths of repentance, leading well into the kingdom of Christ.[^2905]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Having fought the good fight, O noble sufferers, ye endured countless multitudes of afflictions, and therefore do ye ever alleviate the sicknesses of all, and drive away the harms of the spirits; therefore with faith do we glorify you, O holy ones.[^2906]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Light, and Life, and Creator of all, is the three-hypostatic Unity as It truly is, Which we glorify; for the Father, and the Son, and the Spirit, the Unity holding all things, Sovereign Master and Lord, one God in three Persons is known.[^2907]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^2722]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Continually sinning and provoking the good God, O Virgin Mother, have compassion on me, and as thou art good, establish me now in the ways of repentance, that having escaped the torments to come, I may diligently sing of thy mercy, O Maiden.[^2908]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 3.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Creation was sanctified, O Thou Who alone art longsuffering, by the precious blood that dripped from Thy ribs; and the rivers of polytheism were dried up, and Adam was delivered from condemnation by Thy crucifixion, O Word.[^2911]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* He Who is the Creator of all and the Lord, and the God of all, becomes impoverished willingly; He endures suffering for mankind, being lifted up upon the Cross under the curse of the Law.[^2912]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* By Thine own will art Thou crucified, O Benefactor; and having been pierced in Thy ribs with a spear, O Giver of life, Thou didst pour forth two fountains of immortality. Therefore unceasingly do we all faithfully glorify Thy sufferings, O Compassionate One.[^2913]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Most Holy Theotokos, the same Tone:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Beholding Him Who was born of thee hanging upon the Tree, O All-immaculate One, thou didst cry aloud, weeping: O my most beloved child...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: ...child! Whither has Thy light-bearing beauty departed, which adorned human nature?[^2914]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Wounded by the weapon of the serpent, the beginner of evil, and lying half-dead upon the bed of despair, O Maiden, quickly heal me by the medicine of thy prayer; and save me, O my hope and protection.[^2915]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Lay aside, O my humble soul, the intolerable burdens of malice, and draw near weeping and crying aloud: Make me worthy, O Pure Virgin, to bear the light yoke of thy Son and God.[^2916]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* A sword pierced thy heart, O Most Pure One, when thou didst behold thy Son upon the Cross, and thou didst cry aloud: Show me not childless, O my Son and my God, Who didst preserve me a Virgin after childbirth.[^2917]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 3:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: I worship Thy precious Cross, O Christ, the guardian of the world, the salvation of us sinners, the great mercy seat, the victory of kings, the boast of the whole universe.[^2918]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: Moses, prefiguring the Cross upon the mountain, lifting up his hands on high, conquered Amalek; but Thou, O Savior, having stretched forth Thy palms upon the precious Cross, embracing me didst save me from the enemy's bondage, and hast given me the life-giving sign, to flee from the bow of them that oppose me. Therefore, O Word, do I worship Thy precious Cross.[^2920]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* The Prophets, and Apostles of Christ, and Martyrs taught us to sing of the consubstantial Trinity, and they illumined the erring nations, and made the sons of men partakers with the Angels.[^2922]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* When thou didst behold Him Who shone forth from thy womb setting upon the Cross, the never-setting Sun, and darkening the rays of the sun, thou didst cry aloud, weighed down in thy soul by a darkness of sorrows: O Thou Who didst set willingly, shine forth again, unto mine illumination and that of the whole world.[^2923]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Then: Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart... Trisagion. After Our Father: troparia, litany, and dismissal.*[^2924]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 3.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *He Who of old gathered the waters into one gathering by His divine nod, and divided the sea for the people of Israel: this is our God, and He is exceedingly glorified; to Him alone let us sing, for He has been glorified.*[^2925]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Knowing thee, the Mother of God, as the fountain of compassion and mercy, I approach and pray to thy goodness, to grant me compunction, that I may mourn and weep for my transgressions, O All-pure Lady.[^2926]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Grant me a drop of tears of the soul, washing away all the defilement of my deeds and evil thoughts, and cleansing the impurity of my soul, and making me a temple of the Holy Spirit of God.[^2927]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Tempest-tossed by tumult and the surging of my transgressions, and ever grievously overwhelmed by the works of the adversary, and now cast down into the depth of perdition, I cry unto thee, O All-immaculate One: Save me.[^2928]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Both now:* For the sake of the mercy of thy loving-kindness, O Sovereign Lady of all, have mercy on my wretched soul, and deliver me from the everlasting fire and demonic assault, who now flee under thy protection, O Theotokos.[^2929]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Thou Who didst bring all things out of nothingness, creating them by the Word and perfecting them by the Spirit: O Almighty Master, establish me in Thy love.*[^2930]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* With divine light, O All-praised One, illumine my mind darkened by evil thoughts; for thou gavest birth to the Light, the co-eternal One Who shone forth from the Father.[^2931]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Tripping up the steps of my soul, the enemy of the righteous dashed me to the ground; but by thy right hand, O Pure Lady, raise me up.[^2932]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory:* With the voices of the publican, wretched that I am, I cry unto thee: Cleanse me, O Lady, and by thy prayer grant remission of transgressions unto thy servant.[^2933]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Heal the wounds of my soul, and quiet the tempestuous surge of thoughts, O Lady, and grant me a peaceful disposition.[^2934]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Thou hast shown firm love toward us, O Lord; for Thou gavest Thine Only-begotten Son unto death for us. Therefore we cry unto Thee with thanksgiving: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.*[^2935]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I have defiled my flesh with pleasures and sensuality, and with foul thoughts have I stained the purity of my soul, and I have darkened my mind; despise me not, therefore, O Lady, thy servant.[^2936]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Be thou my deliverance, and refuge, and might, and horn of salvation, O Pure One, and protectress, ever delivering me from every affliction, and putting to shame all mine enemies.[^2937]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Held fast now by many misfortunes, wretch that I am, and ever plunged into demonic deceits, I flee unto thee now: by thy fervent prayer save me, thy servant.[^2938]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Both now:* A dark night of passions holds me fast, wretched that I am; but with thy light, O Gracious Lady, scatter the clouds of my soul, and guide me unto the light of God's commandments, O All-immaculate One.[^2939]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *As Isaiah in a figure beheld God lifted up upon a throne, borne aloft by the Angels of glory, "O wretched am I," cried he; "for I have foreseen God incarnate, the never-setting Light, and Him Who rules over the world."*[^2940]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The time of my life has vanished like smoke, and I have drawn nigh unto the gates of death, and I am terrified of demonic assault; for their deeds have I ever done. O All-immaculate One, have compassion and save me.[^2941]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Drying up the abyss of my evils, O Virgin, grant me rivers of tears, and extinguish the whole flame of my passions, O Maiden, and vouchsafe me to be delivered from the fire and other torments in the day of judgment.[^2942]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Heal my soul that is sick with sins, O Most Pure One, by thy tender mercy, and vouchsafe me ever to perform the commandments of thy Son in humility, that I may receive His goodness.[^2943]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Both now: Stavrotheotokion:* Bereaved, O my Son, of bridal raiment is Thy divine Church, clothed with the holy blood from Thy ribs; but I bear mournful pains, beholding Thy sufferings upon the Cross, the Mother of the Word weeping cried aloud.[^2944]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *The uttermost abyss of sins has compassed me, and my spirit fails; but stretch...*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: ...stretch forth Thy high arm, O Master, and as Peter, O Helmsman, save me.*[^2945]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Son of God showed thee to be a great refuge unto sinners, being incarnate of thy pure blood, O Bride of God; therefore be merciful unto thy servants.[^2946]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Illumine with thy radiant dawn, O Gracious Lady, the darkened eyes of my heart with improper thoughts, and make me a child of the light, and settle me in a place of light.[^2947]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory:* The waves of passionate thoughts ever trouble me, O Most Pure One, and the tempest of deceitful spirits overwhelms me; but establish me upon the rock of dispassion.[^2948]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Both now:* I have fallen asleep unto the death of the soul, and I lie in the grave of despair; but give me a hand, and raise me up, I pray thee, guiding me unto the life of repentance.[^2949]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Lord, have mercy (three times). Glory... Both now...*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: Having acquired the Cross of thy Son as a rod of strength, O Theotokos, thereby do we cast down the insolence of the enemies, unceasingly magnifying thee with love.[^2950]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Of old, the three youths bowed not down to the golden image, the Persian idol, singing in the midst of the furnace: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.*[^2951]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Gird my soul that is enfeebled by sins with strength, O Pure One, and save me who cry aloud unto thy Son: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^2952]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Fearing the hour of death, on account of immortal and eternal torment, I fall down before thee: Save me, O Maiden, from the snare of the hunters, O Birthgiver of God.[^2953]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory:* O thou who didst contain the uncontainable God in thy womb: my mind is constrained by many transgressions, O Theotokos; deliver it from their condemnation.[^2954]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Both now:* The human race prays to thee, O Theotokos and Lady: have mercy on thy servants who with faith cry aloud unto thy Son: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^2955]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *United with unendurable fire, the youths, champions of piety, remained unharmed by the flame and sang the divine hymn: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all for ever.*[^2956]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having truly envied the prodigal, and having consumed my whole life in sins, now I cry: I have sinned against thee, make me, O Maiden, as one of the hired servants of thy Son and Creator, that I may glorify thee unto all ages.[^2957]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* My soul is filled with evils, and I am numbered with all them that go down into the pit; but do thou, O Virgin Theotokos, lead me up out of the pit of passions and from the mire of the clay of my evils.[^2958]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Pray unto Christ, whom thou didst bear from thy holy loins, O Theotokos, to grant me forgiveness of my many transgressions, that I may sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all for ever.[^2959]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Both now:* When by the commandment of God my soul is about to depart from this life, snatch me away from the snare of the hunters, O Most Pure One, who cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all for ever.[^2960]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *In the shadow and the letter of the Law, we the faithful see a figure: Every male that opens the womb is holy to God. Therefore the firstborn Word of the unoriginate Father, the Son Who is the firstborn of an unwedded Mother, do we magnify.*[^2961]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The human race, O All-immaculate One, enriched now by thine invincible prayer, cries aloud day and night: Cease not ever to pray to the Creator and thy Son, to have compassion on those who sing of thee.[^2962]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The arrows of improper passions have wounded my soul through demonic assaults, and with hostile arrows of thoughts they ever trouble my mind; therefore heal, O Maiden, mine incurable wounds.[^2963]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Take away quickly from me, O Pure Bride of God, the wounds of the warring enemies, for their uprising and great malice and arrogance I, wretch that I am, can no longer endure; but hasten to deliver me.[^2964]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Thou knowest the weakness of my humble body, the wounds of my soul, the groaning of my heart, and the wandering and deception of my mind; therefore by thy mercy grant healing unto both.[^2965]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *After the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: The Cross was set up on earth, and touched heaven; not that the wood...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: ...reached unto the height, but because Thou upon it dost fill all things; O Lord, glory to Thee.[^2966]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: Upon the cypress, and the pine, and the cedar, wast Thou lifted up, O Lamb of God, that Thou mightest save them that with faith worship Thy voluntary crucifixion; O Christ God, glory to Thee.[^2968]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Having acquired the Cross of thy Son as a rod of strength, O Theotokos, thereby do we cast down the insolence of the enemies, unceasingly magnifying thee with love.[^2969]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: Having willed to suffer the Cross and death, in the midst of creation didst Thou set it up; when Thou wast well-pleased, O Savior, to have Thy body nailed: then also the sun hid its rays; then also the thief, beholding these things, singing of Thee upon the cross, cried reverently: Remember me, O Lord! and believing, received Paradise.[^2970]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: At Thine unsearchable power and voluntary crucifixion, the angelic hosts were amazed, beholding how the Invisible One was wounded in the flesh, willing to deliver mankind from corruption; therefore, as unto the Giver of life, we cry unto Thee: Glory, O Christ, to Thy tender compassions.[^2973]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Armed with the whole armor of Christ, and clad in the weapon of faith, ye cast down the hostile regiments through your sufferings; for eagerly, with the hope of life, ye endured all the threats and wounds of the torturers; therefore also ye received crowns, O patient-minded Martyrs of Christ.[^2975]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* A reproachful death and crucifixion didst Thou willingly endure, O Compassionate One; beholding which, She that bare Thee was wounded. By Her supplications, for the tender compassion of Thy mercy, O Thou Who alone art supremely good and the Lover of mankind, O Lord, have compassion and save the world, Thou Who takest away the sins of the world.[^2976]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 3:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: Having accepted crucifixion and death, Thou didst pour forth immortal life for us, O Christ Savior, and didst deliver the world from corruption; therefore do we glorify Thy saving passions, O Giver of life, Lover...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: ...Lover of mankind, whereby we are all saved, having the invincible weapon of peace, Thy precious Cross.[^2978]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Thou didst endure the Cross dishonorably, O Master, Who art higher than all creation, that Thou mightest honor me who was formerly grievously dishonored; and in Thy ribs wast Thou pierced with a spear, O Longsuffering One, willing to deliver me, Thy creation, from corruption. I sing of Thy great tender compassion and goodness, O Lover of mankind.[^2979]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* The Unwedded, Pure One and Thy Mother, O Christ, beholding Thee hanging dead upon the Cross, wept maternally and said: What has the lawless and ungrateful Jewish assembly rendered unto Thee, which enjoyed Thy many and great gifts, O my Son? I sing of Thy divine condescension.[^2980]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Canon of the Precious and Life-Giving Cross.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: Sicknesses hast Thou stilled for men by Thy sicknesses, O Word.)*[^2981]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *A Work of Joseph.*[^2982]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *He Who of old gathered the waters into one gathering by His divine nod, and divided the sea for the people of Israel: this is our God, and He is exceedingly glorified; to Him alone let us sing, for He has been glorified.*[^2983]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Crucifixion.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Many-painful passions hast Thou stilled, O Word, by the passions of Thy precious flesh, and hast saved men whom the adversary wounded of old, who piously worship Thine inscrutable dispensation.[^2984]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* He who bound man in Paradise through deceit, by the transgression of the commandment, is bound with indissoluble bonds, O Lord, wherewith incarnate Thou wast bound willingly, loosing our transgressions, O Lover of mankind.[^2985]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Beholding creation endangered by drowning through the delusions of demons, the passion-bearers appeared as peaceful harbors unto the faithful, having drowned all the power of the proud one in streams of blood, O renowned ones.[^2986]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* The choir of martyrs, brightly united with the heavenly company, is ever illumined with the splendors of the uncreated Godhead, and illumines those on earth who glorify their miracles with faith.[^2987]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и Бж҃їя, ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и и҆зъ тебѐ пло́тїю ро́ждша-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Higher than the heavenly ranks didst thou appear, having given birth on earth to God the Word, O Most Pure One, Who by His passions has raised us unto heavenly things...[^2988]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: и҆ Кресто́мъ честны́мъ возве́дшаго бла́гости ра́ди.
items.english_text: ...and by the Precious Cross, for the sake of His goodness.

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Напая́тисѧ бога́тнѡ слеза́ми пода́ждь, бразда́мъ дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ Дѣ́во, и҆ пло́дъ приноси́ти стори́чный, Влчⷣце, сподо́би мѧ̀, и҆ се́рдце моѐ весе́лїѧ и҆спо́лни, да сла́влю тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.*
