items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Милосе́рдїѧ ра́ди ми́лости Влчⷣце всѣ́хъ, поми́лꙋй ѡ҆кая́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋшꙋ̀; и҆ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ вѣ́чнꙋющагѡ, и҆ бѣсо́вскагѡ напа́данїѧ, под̾ кро́въ тво́й Бцⷣе нн҃ѣ прибѣга́ющаго.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Grant the furrows of my soul to be richly watered with tears, O Virgin, and make me worthy to bring forth fruit an hundredfold, O Lady, and fill my heart with gladness, that I may glorify thee.[^2989]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ нескве́рный хра́мъ царе́въ, страстьмѝ ѡ҆скве́рншеесѧ безмѣ́стными се́рдце моѐ, молю́сѧ Пречи́стаѧ, ѡ҆чи́сти моли́твами твои́ми, и҆ чи́стагѡ житїѧ̀ дѣ́лы ѡ҆богатѝ, Бг҃ора́дованнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* For the sake of the tender compassion of thy mercy, O Lady of all, have mercy on my wretched soul, and deliver me from the everlasting fire and from demonic assault, who flee now beneath thy protection, O Theotokos.[^2990]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Что̀ лѣ́ностїю житїѐ, дꙋшѐ стра́стнаѧ прехо́диши? и҆ не бои́шисѧ днѐ стра́шнагѡ сꙋда̀. Но воста́ни про́чее ѿ согрѣше́нїѧ оу҆ны́нїй, оу҆се́рднѡ и҆ те́плѣ нн҃ѣ возопі́й: спаси́ мѧ Влчⷣце чи́стаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* As the undefiled temple of the King, my heart which is defiled by improper passions, I pray thee, O Most Pure One, cleanse by thy supplications, and enrich with the deeds of a pure life, O thou who art full of divine grace.[^2991]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ѿ не сꙋ́щихъ всѧ̑ приведы́й, Сло́вомъ созида́емаѧ, соверша́емаѧ Дх҃омъ, Вседержи́телю Влдко, въ любвѝ твое́й оу҆тверди́ менѐ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Why passest thou thy life in slothfulness, O passionate soul, and fearest not the day of the dread judgment? But arise henceforth from the despondency of sins, and cry aloud now fervently and warmly: Save me, O pure Lady.[^2992]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ є҆стество́мъ Бж҃ества̀ безстра́стна, стра́стна бы́вша пло́тїю бла́гости ра́ди, дре́вомъ оу҆мертви́лъ є҆́сть є҆вре́йскїй собо́ръ, на́съ ѡ҆безсме́ртвлѧюща.
items.english_text: *Canon of the Precious and Life-Giving Cross.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: На вода́хъ повѣ́сивый Сло́ве зе́млю, на дре́вѣ во́лею бы́лъ є҆сѝ повѣ́шенъ, возводѧ́ мѧ къ небе́снымъ, въ ѕло́бы ро́въ па́дшаго.
items.english_text: *O Thou Who from nothingness broughtest all things into being, which are created by the Word and perfected by the Spirit: O Almighty Master, establish me in Thy love.*[^2993]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Преиспещре́ни ра́нами, Хрⷭ҇товы всехва́льнїи мч҃еницы, Гдⷭ҇еви предстоитѐ, ѿ негѡ̀ прїе́млюще богатнѣ́йшею рꙋко́ю воздаѧ́нїѧ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Crucifixion.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Ра́достною дꙋше́ю къ ра́намъ тща́хꙋсѧ мч҃еницы, послѣ́днею ѕмі́еви печа́ль твора́ще, и҆ а҆́гг҃льскїѧ ли́ки ра́дости и҆сполнѧ́юще.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thee Who in the nature of Thy Godhead art passionless, yet becamest passionate in the flesh for the sake of goodness, did the Hebrew assembly put to death upon the Tree, Thee Who dost make us immortal.[^2994]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: Воздви́жена зрѧ́щи на крестѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀ Неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ, пла́чꙋщи глаго́лаше: заше́лъ є҆сѝ сла́вы со́лнце ѿ ѻ҆́чїю мое́ю, просвѣща́ѧй въ тмѣ̀ сꙋ́щыѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Word, Who hangedst the earth upon the waters, Thou wast willingly hanged upon the Tree, raising me up unto the heavens, who had fallen into the pit of malice.[^2995]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Adorned with wounds, O all-praised martyrs of Christ, ye stand before the Lord, receiving recompense from Him with a most rich hand.[^2997]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* With a joyful soul did the martyrs hasten unto wounds, working utter grief for the serpent, and filling the angelic choirs with joy.[^2998]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Christ lifted up upon the Cross, the Unwedded One, weeping, said: Thou hast set from mine eyes, O Sun of glory, Thou Who dost enlighten those in darkness.[^2999]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Deliver from Gehenna and all other torments in the hour of judgment thy servant...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: ...O All-immaculate One, and make him a partaker of the kingdom of thy Son and God.[^3000]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Heal the wounds of my soul, and still the tempestuous turmoil of my thoughts, O Lady, and grant me a peaceful disposition.[^3001]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Being now grievously inflamed by passions, there is no healing for my soul, O All-immaculate One; yet leave me not utterly, thy servant, O Virgin.[^3002]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Dead in soul through the multitude of the malice of passions, make me alive, O Lady, who didst ineffably give birth to Christ the Giver of life.[^3003]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Canon of the Precious and Life-Giving Cross.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Thou hast shown steadfast love toward us, O Lord; for Thou gavest Thine Only-begotten Son unto death for us. Therefore with thanksgiving we cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.*[^3004]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Crucifixion.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Contempt indeed didst Thou endure, O Christ Master, Who art higher than all honor, being struck upon the head with a reed, that Thou mightest honor me who was dishonored by transgression, O Lover of mankind.[^3005]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou wast willingly crowned with a crown of thorns, O Longsuffering One, as the true King, and the thorn-bearing ancestral sin Thou didst eradicate from the root. I sing praises unto Thy sufferings, O Savior.[^3006]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Unbroken by the torments of wounds did ye remain, O Martyrs, crushing the enemy's delusion, and trampling under your feet him who boasted immeasurably and was utterly withered by folly.[^3008]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* With corruptible bodies ye acquired divine incorruption, through passions steadfastly imitating the precious Passion of the Passionless One, O all-praised Martyrs, numbered with all the bodiless hosts.[^3009]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* The Prophet of old beheld thee as a scroll, O Maiden, in which by the Father's finger the incarnate Word was written, Who with a spear tore up the ancestral handwriting of debt, O Most Pure One.[^3010]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* When in the night the Bridegroom shall come to judge the earth, then with a bright can-...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: ...-dle, vouchsafe me to go forth to meet Him, O Most Pure One, and to worship His coming.[^3011]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The unilluminated night of passions holds fast thy servant; but by thy light, O Good One, disperse the cloud of my soul, and guide me unto the light of the divine commandments, O All-immaculate One.[^3012]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* By a tempest of temptations and by the surge of evil thoughts am I wholly overwhelmed, and ever dragged down into the abyss of despair. Save thy servant, O Lady, I cry unto thee.[^3013]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* When my soul is about to be separated from the flesh, then stand by me mercifully, and snatch me away from the assault of demons who unceasingly seek my destruction, O Maiden.[^3014]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Canon of the Precious and Life-Giving Cross.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Upon earth Thou, the Invisible One, didst appear, and willingly didst dwell among men, O Incomprehensible One; and rising early unto Thee, we hymn Thee, O Lover of mankind.*[^3015]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Crucifixion.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As a lamb wast Thou lifted up upon the Tree, and offered Thyself as a sacrifice to the Father for us, O Good One, and didst abolish idolatrous sacrifices, O Almighty One.[^3016]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Pierced in the side with a spear, O Giver of life, Thou didst pour forth two fountains of salvation unto those who proclaim Thee as One of the Trinity, bearing two energies.[^3017]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Finding Thee by faith as a strong foundation and an immovable rock, O Jesus, the valiant passion-bearers built themselves up as precious stones.[^3019]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Strengthened by the power of God through faith, ye brought into subjection all the cruel power of the deceiver, O passion-bearing martyrs, and were radiantly crowned.[^3020]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Having incorruptibly given birth to Christ, thou didst recreate our nature which was previously corrupted through transgression, O Most Holy Lady, protectress of our souls.[^3021]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Behold, O Pure One, the affliction of my humble and passionate soul; behold also the assaults of bodiless foes, and deliver me from their harm.[^3022]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When my mind through demonic temptations is ever drawn away into improper thoughts, leave me not, O Lady, but establish me immovably.[^3023]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Eating with sinners did thy Son appear, for the sake of His great mercy; having been likened unto them, O Pure One, have mercy now on me who have sinned more than all.[^3024]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Let me not be rebuked by the fury of thy Son at the time of His coming, nor let me be chastised by His wrath, O All-hymned One, but save me by thy supplications.[^3025]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Canon of the Precious and Life-Giving Cross.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *The lowest abyss of sins has surrounded me, and my spirit fails; but stretching forth Thy lofty arm, O Master, save me, O Helmsman, even as Peter.*[^3026]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Crucifixion.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The serpent led me out of Eden, that deceiver who deceived me by deceptive food; but Christ, being willingly lifted up upon the Tree, grants me again mine ancient entrance.[^3027]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* He who wounded us was wounded and remained incurably hurt by Thy wounded side, O Benefactor and Lord; but we the faithful have been healed by Thy wounds, wherewith Thou wast willingly wounded.[^3028]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Ye appeared in the midst of the fire, O all-wise soldiers of Christ, roasted as lambs and brought unto the banquet of God the King of all, inheriting ineffable gladness.[^3030]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Ye dispense rivers of healings, drawing from inexhaustible treasures, and ye dry up the streams of passions, O passion-bearers, watering the assemblies of the faithful.[^3031]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding the death of the Word Who was incarnate from thy blood, O All-immaculate One, maternally didst thou cry aloud and magnify Him Who is the Cause of life, O Mother, Virgin, Lady.[^3032]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By the waves of this life to my soul's hurt am I, wretched one, ever overwhelmed, and by the winds of the enemy am I ever tossed; now cry I unto thee: O Theotokos, help me.[^3033]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Grant me streams of spiritual tears, O most immaculate Maiden, that I may wash away the mire of my transgressions, the tumult of passions, and bodily defilements.[^3034]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* I have fallen asleep in the death of the soul, and lie in the grave of despair; but stretch forth a hand unto me, and raise me up, I pray thee, guiding me unto the repentance of life.[^3035]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Dry up the turbid rivers of mine evil deeds, O Mother of God, with streams of compunction, and direct me unto the waters of relief on the day of judgment.[^3036]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Canon of the Precious and Life-Giving Cross.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Unto the golden image of old, the Persian worship, the three youths bowed not down, singing in the midst of the furnace: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.*[^3037]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Crucifixion.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By Thy sufferings Thou didst abolish our sicknesses, O Lover of mankind, and now hast brought unto painless life those who piously worship Thy precious Passion, O God of all.[^3038]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When creation beheld Thee crucified, O Christ, it was altered and trembled; the earth shook, the rocks were rent, and the course of the sun hid its light.[^3039]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Submitting unto the law of Christ, the martyrs turned away from the blandishments of the lawless; and lawfully contending in the midst of the tribunal, they were gloriously crowned.[^3041]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Ye were not burned by fire, having acquired a purpose warmer than fire, O crown-bearing passion-bearers of the Lord, crying: Blessed art Thou, O God.[^3042]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Thou didst stand beholding Christ lifted up upon the Cross, Whom thou didst bear, O Most Pure One, and didst cry: Leave me not childless, Whom Thou didst preserve pure even after childbirth.[^3043]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As merciful Mother of God, vouchsafe thy mercy unto thy servants, O Lady, who with faith cry unto thy Son: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.[^3044]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Consume the pasture of my sins and vile deeds, O Pure One, that with faith I may cry unto thy Son: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.[^3045]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The human race entreats thee, O Theotokos and Lady: Have mercy on thy servants, who with faith cry unto thy Son: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.[^3046]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* At the dread tribunal of Christ, when I am to be judged as guilty, O Most Pure One, appear unto me, delivering me from every torment by thy warm intercession.[^3047]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Canon of the Precious and Life-Giving Cross.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *The Babylonian furnace burned not the youths, nor did the fire of the Godhead consume the Virgin; therefore...*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *...with the youths let us the faithful cry aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord.*[^3048]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Crucifixion.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* When Thou wast crucified, Paradise was opened again, and the sword that turned against us turned its back, put to shame by the spear that pierced Thy holy side, O most merciful Christ.[^3049]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By Thy spear was the adversary wounded and cast down; and fallen Adam returns unto life, crying unto Thee Who wast willingly slain, O Christ: Blessing Thee, I glorify Thee, O my most merciful God.[^3050]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* The world is enlightened by your roots and excellences, O sufferers, and by your innumerable miracles, and is delivered from the darkness of afflictions, crying in faith: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord.[^3052]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* An object of mockery is seen lying beneath your feet, O Saints, he who before boasted to destroy the earth and sea; but Christ adorns you with His life-bearing right hand with unfading crowns, O ever-renowned ones.[^3053]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* In time didst thou bring forth Him Who is above times, Who loosens temporal bonds by His own bonds, O Most Pure One, even Adam the first-formed, and binds him with the bonds of His sweet love.[^3054]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Joined unto the unbearable fire, the youths, champions of piety, remained unhurt by the flame and sang the divine hymn: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all for ever.*[^3055]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Cease not, O Pure One, to pray that those who honor thee in compunction and cry unto thy Son may be delivered from the snares of the devil: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all for ever.[^3056]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When by the commandment of God my soul is about to depart from this life, snatch me away from the snares of those who hunt for me, O Theotokos, who sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all for ever.[^3057]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* An unilluminated night holds me fast, for I have enslaved myself to dark deeds; but do thou, who art the gates of light, illumine me with thy light, who sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all for ever.[^3058]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Grant thy mercy, O Lady of the world, unto thy servant, I pray thee...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: ...and from the expected condemnation snatch away thy people, O All-immaculate One, that with thanksgiving we may cry unto thee: Glory to thee, O Queen of all.[^3059]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Canon of the Precious and Life-Giving Cross.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Her who was prefigured in Sinai unto the lawgiver Moses by the bush and the fire, and who in her womb unburnt conceived the divine fire, the all-radiant and inextinguishable lamp, the true Theotokos, honoring her in hymns do we magnify.*[^3060]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Crucifixion.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* That Thou mightest find the drachma which was lost, O Christ, Thou didst kindle Thy flesh upon the Cross, O Good One, and makest Thy heavenly hosts partakers of joy, O Giver of life. Singing with them unto Thee as our Benefactor, in hymns do we magnify Thee.[^3061]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When Thou didst lift up Thy hands upon the Cross, O Christ, Thou didst strengthen by Thy power my hands that were previously weakened by many passions, and didst establish the knees that were truly feeble for running the divine race. Therefore do we magnify Thee.[^3062]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Burning in the flame and beneath immeasurable wounds, Thy steadfast and marvelous sufferers found Thee, O Christ, as the dew of refreshment. Therefore rejoicing they walked the path in their desire for honors, unceasingly magnifying Thee in hymns.[^3064]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* The multitude of sufferers, the choir of saints, entreats Thee, O Christ, for the congregation of people who have provoked Thee much; by the multitude of Thy mercy, O Compassionate One, cleanse the multitude of our iniquities, as the Lover of mankind.[^3065]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Bearing the likeness of earthly beings, thou didst give birth to the Brightness of the Father, O Virgin. Beholding Him lifted up upon the Cross, the sun could not bear to look upon Him and was darkened, and the darkness of idolatry was diminished; therefore with Him do we magnify thee.[^3066]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *In the shadow and the letter of the Law, we the faithful see a figure: Every male that opens the womb is holy to God. Therefore the firstborn Word of the unoriginate Father, the Son Who is the firstborn of an unwedded Mother, do we magnify.*[^3067]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The end draws near, O my soul, judgment is at the doors; turn away from shameful deeds, and lay hold on the good life; for thou hast a helper, the Theotokos, who delivers thee from every affliction.[^3068]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Among noetic thieves have I fallen, wretch that I am, and through their wiles have I been stripped of my garment of virtues to my soul's hurt; and filled with soul-corrupting passions...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: ...I cry unto thee: O All-immaculate Lady, despise me not.[^3069]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* All my life, O Most Pure One, is spent in despondency, and by despair have I drawn near unto hades now. But grant me amendment, O Pure One, and leave me not to be afflicted therein, who flee unto thy protection.[^3070]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou knowest the weakness of my humble body, the wounds of my soul, the groaning of my heart, and the wandering and delusion of my mind. Therefore by thy tender compassion grant healing unto both.[^3071]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet: Litany and the rest.*[^3072]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* The tree of disobedience put forth death for the world; but the Tree of the Cross put forth life and incorruption. Therefore we pray Thee, the crucified Lord, that the light of Thy countenance may be signed upon us.[^3073]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad: [and look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works,] and guide Thou their sons.* [^3074]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Through envy of sweet pleasure was I cast out, having fallen with a grievous fall; yet Thou didst not despise me, O Master, but having accepted for my sake the crucifixion which belonged to me, Thou savest me and leadest me into glory; O my Redeemer, glory to Thee.[^3075]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* The powers of the holy Angels were astonished at the suffering of the martyrs, how, though clad in flesh, they disregarded torments, having become imitators of the passions of Christ the Savior; and they pray for our souls.[^3077]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* When the all-hymned Ewe-lamb, the Virgin Thy Mother, beheld Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O my Christ, sobbing with weeping she cried aloud: O my Son and my God, leave me not childless, whom Thou didst preserve pure even after childbirth.[^3078]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Adam the forefather, having cast aside Thy commandment, O Christ, Thou didst expel from Paradise; but the thief who confessed Thee upon the Cross, O Compassionate One, Thou didst settle therein, as he cried: Remember me, O Savior, in Thy kingdom.[^3079]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou wast inflamed for my sake, and pierced with a spear in Thy ribs, O my Jesus, Thou didst pour forth two saving fountains for me. Therefore, being saved by Thy passion, O Christ, I hymn and glorify Thy tender-heartedness, crying: Remember me in Thy kingdom.[^3080]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Numbered with two lawless men, Thou tookest away the iniquities of us all, O Jesus, and crowned with thorns as King of all, Thou didst cut down from the root the thorns of the forefather's sin, O Christ; therefore with faith do we now glorify Thy Passion.[^3081]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Ye who imitated the sufferings of Christ, O valiant sufferers, all-glorious martyrs, and cast down the enemy's delusion by divine power, have obtained heavenly glory: Pray for us all, O Holy Ones.[^3082]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Glory:* O Tri-hypostatic Unity and indivisible, all-effecting Trinity, one Essence and Power! Cover Thy singers from every harm of the enemy, and make them worthy of Thy kingdom, which they that lived well have obtained.[^3083]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^2909]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding upon the Cross Him Whom thou didst enflesh from pure blood, weeping didst thou cry aloud, O Mother of God, Maiden: What is this, O Child, that the evil assembly has rendered unto Thee, putting Thee to death, Who art the Life and Resurrection of all the faithful?[^3084]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Holy Apostles, Tone 3.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* By the prayers of Thy precious and divine Apostles, O generous Lover of mankind, Who alone art merciful, grant Thy peace unto Thy servants, and save from distresses those who hymn Thee and worship with faith.[^3086]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* When ye shall sit upon twelve thrones with the Judge of all to judge every creature: show me uncondemned, and deliver me from darkness and every torment, O my benefactors, divine Apostles.[^3087]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Deliver me from the arrows of the ungodly one, as eyewitnesses of God, quenching his wiles; and bedew me with spiritual dew, I pray you, O my wise benefactors, divine Apostles.[^3088]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Then in the Menaion, Stichera to the Saint.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *If there be no Menaion, we sing Stichera to the holy Wonderworker Nicholas.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Wounded am I, wretched one, by the biting of the serpent, and I lie cast down, dead and breathless; by thy vigilant supplication raise me up speedily, O all-blessed Hierarch, that I may glorify thy grace which is swift to hear.[^3090]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Foreseeing that my mind is darkened by evil thoughts and lies prostrate, the crafty one in no wise ceases hunting after me. But as God, show compassion and save me, by the prayers of Nicholas.[^3091]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* A great salvation hast thou appeared unto all of us, O all-blessed Nicholas; for thou dost deliver thy servants from all tribulations and distresses, and from temptations, sicknesses, adversities, and invisible enemies.[^3092]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Great is the power of thy wonders, O Pure One; for thou deliverest from tribulations, and savest from death, and snatchest away from unexpected calamities, and loosest sorrows, and takest away the transgressions of men.[^3093]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light: The Prokeimenon of the day.*[^3094]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Apostles, Tone 3:*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Into all the earth went out your sound, O holy Apostles; ye destroyed the delusion of idols, proclaiming the knowledge of God. O good is your contest, O Blessed Ones! Therefore we sing and glorify your memory.[^3095]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Being branches of the life-bearing Vine, O glorious Apostles, ye offered yourselves unto God as fruit of piety. Therefore, having boldness before Him, entreat that He grant peace and great mercy unto our souls.[^3097]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us: [for we are utterly filled with abasement;] our soul is exceedingly filled with the reproach of the prosperous, and with the contempt of the proud.* [^3098]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́нны, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Thy Martyrs, O Lord, established by faith and strengthened by hope, spiritually united by the love of Thy Cross, destroyed the enemy's tyranny; and having obtained crowns, with the Bodiless Powers they pray for our souls.[^3099]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Вельмѝ согрѣша́юща мѧ̀ О҆трокови́це, и҆схитѝ вели́кою твое́ю моли́твою пла́мене нꙋ́жднагѡ; и҆ и҆спра́ви Чи́стаѧ твои́ми мольба́ми, къ спаси́тєльнымъ стєза́мъ наставля́ющи мѧ̀, Ма́терними твои́ми моли́твами.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Snatch me away, who sin exceedingly, O Maiden, by thy great supplication from the inescapable flame; and direct me, O Pure One, by thy prayers, guiding me unto saving paths by thy maternal intercessions.[^3100]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ моле́бный къ прест҃ѣ́й Бц҃ѣ.
items.english_text: *On Wednesday at Small Compline, Canon of Supplication to the Most Holy Theotokos.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же во́ды дре́вле ма́нїемъ бж҃е́ственнымъ въ є҆ди́но со́нмище совокꙋпи́вый, и҆ раздѣли́вый мо́ре їи҃лтескимъ лю́демъ, се́й Бг҃ъ на́шъ препросла́вленъ є҆́сть; томꙋ̀ є҆ди́номꙋ пое́мъ, ꙗ҆́ко просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: *He Who of old by His divine nodding gathered the waters together into one gathering, and divided the sea for the people of Israel: this is our God, and He is exceedingly glorified; to Him alone do we sing, for He has been glorified.*[^3101]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Припѣ́въ: Прест҃а́ѧ Гп҃же́ Бц҃е, спасѝ на́съ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Стена́нїе мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆́бѡ пода́ждь Бц҃е, сокрꙋше́нїе, и҆ сле́зꙋ дꙋше́внꙋю, ꙗ҆́ко да мои́хъ мно́гихъ прегрѣше́нїй пла́чꙋсѧ, и҆ со́вѣсти неисправле́нїа О҆трокови́це, и҆ молю̀ милосе́рдїе твоѐ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Grant me sighing, O Theotokos, contrition and tears of the soul, that I may weep for my many transgressions and for the uncorrected state of my conscience, O Maiden, and I pray for thy tender compassion.[^3102]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: По́мыслы пополза́ѧсѧ, впа́даю въ бе́зднꙋ поги́бели. Твоѐ Дѣ́во ны́нѣ молю̀ застꙋпле́нїе: ᲂу҆твердѝ непоколеби́мо неможе́нїе ᲂу҆ма̀ моегѡ̀, на ка́мени тве́рдѣмъ Бж҃їихъ за́повѣдей.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Slipping in my thoughts, I fall into the abyss of perdition. I pray now for thy protection, O Virgin: establish immovably the feebleness of my mind upon the firm rock of God's commandments.[^3103]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Смоко́вницꙋ ношꙋ̀ безпло́дїа, и҆ бою́сѧ посѣче́нїа и҆ прѝ, да не въ ѻ҆́гнь по́слетъ мѧ̀ зижди́тель мо́й Бг҃ъ; Влч҃це предвари́вши, покаѧ́нїа мѧ̀ дѣ́лы плодоно́сна сотворѝ, да сла́влю тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Glory:* I bear the fig tree of fruitlessness, and I fear the cutting down and the burning, lest my Creator God send me into the fire. O Lady, anticipating this, make me fruitful with the works of repentance, that I may glorify thee.[^3104]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ непоро́ченъ хра́мъ царе́въ, страстьмѝ безмѣ́стными ѻ҆скве́рншееся се́рдце моѐ, молю́сѧ, ѻ҆чи́сти Пречи́стаѧ; цѣломꙋ́дрїемъ же и҆ чи́стымъ житїе́мъ, и҆ дѣ́лы ѻ҆богатѝ Богоблагода́тнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* As the undefiled temple of the King, my heart which is defiled by improper passions, I pray thee, cleanse, O Most Pure One; and enrich it with chastity and a pure life and with good deeds, O thou who art full of divine grace.[^3105]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ѿ не сꙋ́щихъ всѧ̑ приведы́й, Сло́вомъ созида́ємаѧ, соверша́ємаѧ Дх҃омъ, Вседержи́телю Влады́ко, въ любвѝ твое́й ᲂу҆твердѝ менѐ.
items.english_text: *O Thou Who from nothingness broughtest all things into being, which are created by the Word and perfected by the Spirit: O Almighty Master, establish me in Thy love.*[^3106]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Борю́щїи и҆ ѻ҆скорблѧ́ющїи мѧ̀ мно́зи сꙋ́ть, и҆ нѣ́сть ѻ҆сла́бы ѡ҆брѣстѝ и҆ и҆збавле́нїа ѿ ѻ҆быше́дшихъ мѧ̀; но не пре́зри Чи́стаѧ, моле́нїа моегѡ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Many are they that wage war against me and afflict me, and there is no respite to find nor deliverance from those that have surrounded me; yet despise not my supplication, O Pure One.[^3107]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆тѧгче́нъ мно́жествомъ ѕлы́хъ и҆ мно́гими прегрѣше́нїи мои́ми, къ высотѣ̀ нб҃нѣй воззрѣ́ти не могꙋ̀; но ты̀ ѻ҆ставле́нїе мнѣ̀ пода́ждь, Пречи́стаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Weighed down by the multitude of evils and by my many transgressions, I cannot look up to the heavenly height; but do thou grant me forgiveness, O Most Pure One.[^3108]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Glory:* To tear apart my humble soul the crafty serpent daily...

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *On Wednesday at Small Compline, Tone 3.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: ...attempts to do; but shatter, O Theotokos, his soul-destroying teeth.[^3109]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Both now:* Deliver me, O Theotokos, thy servant, from every besetting distress and storm of sin, and direct me unto the saving haven by thy prayers.[^3110]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Thou hast shown steadfast love toward us, O Lord; for Thou gavest Thine Only-begotten Son unto death for us. Therefore with thanksgiving we cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.*[^3111]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I tremble when I consider the gulf of my sins and the fierce and great tempest of contrary thoughts; but do thou pilot me, and direct me unto tranquility, O Most Pure One.[^3112]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Grievous perplexity has now overtaken my soul, senselessness and forgetfulness of the evils which I have committed in life; yet do thou, O Most Pure One, lead me unto repentance for the things wrought by me.[^3113]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Glory:* Quench the fire of passions with streams of tears, and with the fire of the Spirit burn up the worldly turmoil and thorns that choke my mind, O Parent of God; for thou art my protection and praise.[^3114]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Both now:* By the tumult of tribulations and tempests am I wholly overwhelmed through evil thoughts, and ever dragged down into the abyss of despair, I cry unto thee: O Lady, save me, thy servant.[^3115]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *As Isaiah typically beheld God lifted up upon a throne, borne aloft by angels of glory: O wretched one that I am, he cried, for I have seen beforehand God incarnate, the Unwaning Light, Who rules with peace.*[^3116]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou knowest the sickness of my soul and the feebleness of my flesh, O Lady, and the corruption and instability of my mind. Therefore vouchsafe me thy mercy and grace, that being saved by thy protection, I may glorify thee.[^3117]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Shut not against me the tender compassion of thy compassions, O all-immaculate Lady, but grant thy mercies unto him that comes to thee in compunction, and relief and forgiveness of grievous things, that with thanksgiving I may sing thy marvelous deeds.[^3118]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Glory:* Multiplied, O Virgin, are they that hate me without a cause and afflict me now, more than the hairs of my head, O Pure One, seeking to tear me apart and make food of me; therefore fill them with shame and turn them back.[^3119]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *On Wednesday at Small Compline, Tone 3.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Both now:* O thou who gavest peace to the world and salvation unto all, having given birth to the Divine Peace, O Virgin: through the fear and love of Christ the Savior, calm the warfare of the passions of my soul and body, O Pure One.[^3120]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *The lowest abyss of sins has surrounded me, and my spirit fails; but stretching forth Thy lofty arm, O Master, save me, O Helmsman, even as Peter.*[^3121]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* In word and deed and action there is none that has lived wickedly upon earth as I; therefore do I ask for thy love of mankind, O Lady, that I may obtain mercy.[^3122]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The deeds of evil transgressions give birth to sorrows for all; therefore by bitter afflictions are we now beset. Help us, O thou who alone art the salvation of Christians.[^3123]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Glory:* Thou both givest birth and hast appeared pure after childbirth, O Virgin Theotokos! Therefore ever pray to Him Who was born of thee, that we thy servants may be delivered from every harm of the enemy.[^3124]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Both now:* By the prayers of Thy most pure Mother, and of all the Prophets and Martyrs, and of the holy Disciples, O Word of God, grant us peace and cleansing of transgressions.[^3125]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Then: Lord, have mercy (thrice). Glory... Both now...*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: All my life have I passed in great slothfulness, O Most Pure One; and now have I drawn near unto the departure of my time, and am terrified of my foes, lest they tear my soul apart, O All-immaculate One, and cast me into the pit of perdition; but show compassion unto thy servant, O Virgin, and deliver me from their malice.[^3126]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *As of old Thou didst bedew the three pious youths in the Chaldean flame with the bright fire of the Godhead, so also illumine us who cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.*[^3127]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Defiled in body and soul, and wretched with unclean deeds, I pray thee, O pure and undefiled Mother of God, O Lady, trusting in thy mercy: show compassion on me, O Most Pure One.[^3128]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The multitude of my transgressions and the trial of evils exceedingly confound me with perplexity, and drag me down into the abyss of despair; but do thou, O most pure Lady...

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *On Wednesday at Small Compline, Tone 3.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: ...save me who am perishing and grievously drowning.[^3129]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Glory:* By the multitude of the compassions of Thy goodness, overlook the multitude of our sins, O Good One, and be easily reconciled unto those who unceasingly cry: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.[^3130]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Both now:* From the mire of passions, and the depth of afflictions, and worldly tribulations, draw us unto dispassion, O Pure One, and unto joyful gladness, O Blessed One, who cry: Thou alone art full of divine grace.[^3131]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *The flame of material fire did the God-beholding youths subdue with the immaterial fire, and sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord.*[^3132]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The bitterness of pleasures having passed through all my bodily senses, foully defiles my soul and drags it into death; O Lady of the world, be my salvation.[^3133]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Upon thee have I placed soul and heart and body; for I have no other hope save thee, O Lady, through whom I may obtain mercy; therefore grant me thy rich mercy and grace.[^3134]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Glory:* The serpent, having crept near, has grievously slain my wretched soul with the poison of carnal pleasure; but make it alive with contrary remedies, O Pure One, through thy prayers.[^3135]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Both now:* O thou who gavest birth to God and the Savior, pray Him, the Prince of Peace, to send peace swiftly to the world, that in peace we may glorify Him.[^3136]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Thee, the unburnt bush, and holy Virgin, Mother of the Light, and Theotokos, the hope of us all, do we magnify.*[^3137]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Cleanse the defilement of the passionate thoughts of my mind, O Pure One, clothing me in the bright garment of dispassion.[^3138]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Open unto me, O Virgin, the divine entrances of repentance, blocking the entrances of my passions and pleasures and forbidding them by thy power.[^3139]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Glory:* Hear the voice of my groaning, and the voice of my weeping, and grant cleansing and salvation unto my wretched soul, O all-immaculate Virgin.[^3140]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Both now:* Daniel the Prophet beheld thy birthgiving, O Virgin; he truly beheld...

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *On Wednesday at Small Compline, Tone 3.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: ...truly on the throne, Whom he proclaimed as the Ancient of Days.[^3141]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparion and the rest as usual, and the Dismissal.*[^3142]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *After the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Come, all ye people, let us praise the Apostles as helmsmen; for they abolished the delusion of idols, and led us unto the light of life, and taught us to believe in the Trinity. Therefore today, celebrating their memory with honor, we the faithful glorify Christ our God.[^3143]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* The memory of Thine Apostles hast Thou made illustrious, O Lord, as Almighty, in that Thou didst strengthen them to be conformed unto Thy passions; for manfully did they conquer the enemy's power, therefore also they received the grace of healings. By their prayers, O Lover of mankind, grant peace unto Thy people.[^3145]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Taking into mind the immeasurable wealth of thy tender compassion and the invincible power of thy might, I have fled unto thy protection; held fast by sorrow, and grievously perplexed, I cry aloud, and from the depth of my heart with tears, O Virgin Theotokos, I cry unto thee: Save me, save me, unworthy one.[^3146]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *After the second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* The Apostles watered all the earth with streams of the Word of God, and the ear of faith grew up, and filled the ends of the universe; for they cut down all tares, and brought all men unto Christ God, baptizing them into the uncreated Trinity.[^3147]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *And again we say the same Sessional Hymn.*[^3149]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* O holy Passion-bearers, entreat the merciful God, that He may grant remission of transgressions unto our souls.[^3151]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* The Prophets proclaimed, the Apostles taught, the Martyrs confessed, and we have believed thee to be truly the Theotokos; therefore...

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: ...and we magnify thy Childbirth, O Most Pure One.[^3152]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *After the third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Thine Apostles, O Christ, hast Thou sent forth unto the ends of the earth as the Merciful One, as sharp, mighty arrows, slaying all ungodliness and evil counsel, and planting saving teachings. By their supplications, O Compassionate One, grant peace unto our souls.[^3153]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Praising thee as a preacher of truth and an all-radiant luminary of the world, we sing to thee, O Nicholas, and cry in faith, praying: As thou didst snatch away the innocent from death, so also, O Holy One, deliver us from troubles and afflictions and every grievous oppression.[^3154]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Make alive my soul which has been slain by many transgressions, O all-immaculate Lady, as one having maternal boldness before thy Son; for thou alone didst bear beyond mind and comprehension the Word Who is co-unoriginate with the Father and the Spirit, Who ever grants life and incorruption to the world, and great mercy.[^3155]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy, Glorious, and All-Praised Apostles.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *He Who of old by His divine nodding gathered the waters together into one gathering, and divided the sea for the people of Israel: this is our God, and He is exceedingly glorified; to Him alone do we sing, for He has been glorified.*[^3156]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Pillars of the Church, foundations of the faith, pious confirmations that strengthen all the faithful: come, let us call the holy Apostles blessed, that by their supplications we may be saved. (Twice)[^3157]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O immovable pillars of piety! Tripped up by the deceit of the enemy, and lying upon the earth in affliction, set me upright, that I may find remission for the things in which I have sinned.[^3158]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Prodigal that I am, before the judgment I fear and condemn myself; for countless evil deeds have I acquired. Therefore I pray Thee, O righteous Judge: save me who am in despair, by the divine supplications of Thine Apostles.[^3159]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With the holy Prophets, with the Apostles, and the Martyrs, earnestly entreat the Lord Who was incarnate from thee, O Pure One, that He may put to death all our carnal passions, and grant us eternal life.[^3160]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Holy and Great Wonderworker Nicholas.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Let us sing unto the Lord, Who wrought marvelous wonders in the Red Sea; for He covered the adversaries with a flood, and saved Israel. To Him alone let us sing, for He has been glorified.*[^3161]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The all-radiant, inextinguishable luminary, the pillar that is upon earth, who calls unto the divine harbor those who are ever drowned by the waves of this life: let us all honor Nicholas, and in love let us call him blessed.[^3162]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Strengthened by the power of God, O All-blessed One, thou didst acquire zeal for piety according to knowledge; therefore thou didst deliver those who were about to die unjustly. For this cause we entreat thee: deliver us from all unjust affliction, O Nicholas.[^3163]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Offer supplications unto the Lord unceasingly, O father, that He may deliver us from sins and from the flame of eternal torment, and from tribulations and afflictions, as the One Good.[^3164]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The divine ark that contained the Lawgiver, Who takes away all our iniquities for the sake of the ineffable abyss of His divine mercy: Mary the most pure, let us sing with one accord.[^3165]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *O Thou Who from nothingness broughtest all things into being, which are created by the Word and perfected by the Spirit: O Almighty Master, establish me in Thy love.*[^3166]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Ye who have filled the ends of the world with divine teaching, fill my soul with virtuous deeds and good thoughts, O eyewitnesses of Christ. (Twice)[^3167]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* From the many stumbling blocks of the crafty one, and from every sorrow, and from every straitness, from every besetting distress, O Disciples, deliver me.[^3168]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Woe is me, O my wretched and humble soul! Often sinning and provoking God to anger, how wilt thou ask forgiveness of the evils which thou ceasest not to commit?[^3169]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O divine ladder which Jacob beheld, upon which God came down, lifting us up: earnestly pray with the Apostles that He have compassion on us.[^3170]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *O barren and childless soul, acquire glorious and well-favored...*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: ...fruit, and rejoicing cry aloud: I have been established by Thee, O God! There is none holy, there is none righteous beside Thee, O Lord.[^3171]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A sharp spiritual sword didst thou appear, O Wise One, cutting down the evil tares of the heretics, and smoothing out the saving paths of virtues for the faithful, O father Nicholas.[^3172]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Unto thee, the fountain that pours forth streams of healings, do we pray, O Holy One: wash away the defilement of the passions of us all by thy prayers, delivering us from troubles and afflictions.[^3173]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Casting down the enemy by thy mighty prayers, now again strengthen our thoughts that are weakened by passionate assaults, through the invocation of thy holy prayers, O father Nicholas.[^3174]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The mind cannot comprehend the birthgiving beyond mind of thy marvelous Childbirth, O all-immaculate Parent of God! Therefore I pray thee: endow my mind with grace, that I may ever glorify thee.[^3175]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Thou hast shown steadfast love toward us, O Lord; for Thou gavest Thine Only-begotten Son unto death for us. Therefore with thanksgiving we cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.*[^3176]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As lightning and as rays of the unwaning Sun, spreading forth Thine Apostles unto the ends of the world, O Word, having enlightened all, Thou didst drive away the darkness of godlessness. (Twice)[^3177]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The sea of grievous sin roars against me, O Word, and the billows of countless thoughts trouble my humble soul; O Helmsman Lord, by the supplications of Thy Disciples save me.[^3178]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* I am terrified when I consider Thy dread coming, O Master; for before the judgment I have my conscience within condemning me, and before the torment my insensibility torments me.[^3179]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^3085]
items.slavonic_text: Расто́ргнꙋти смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѕмі́й лꙋка́вый по всѧ̑ днѝ...
