items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ є҆ди́на въ всѣ́хъ родѣ́хъ Дѣ́во пречи́стаѧ, Мт҃и ꙗ҆ви́ласа є҆сѝ Бж҃їѧ; ты̀ Бж҃ества̀ была̀ є҆сѝ жили́ще Всенепоро́чнаѧ, неопа́льшасѧ ѻ҆гне́мъ непристу́пнагѡ свѣ́та; тѣ́мже всѝ тѧ̀ благослови́мъ, Марї́е Бг҃оневѣ́сто.
items.english_text: *The birthgiving of the Theotokos saved the pious youths in the furnace: then prefigured, but now actualized, it raises up the whole inhabited earth to sing unto Thee: Hymn the Lord, ye works, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.*[^3872]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆́троки благочести́выѧ въ пещѝ рождество̀ Бг҃оро́дично спасло̀ є҆́сть; тогда̀ оу҆́бѡ ѡ҆бразꙋ́емое, ны́нѣ же дѣ́йствꙋемое, вселе́ннꙋю всю̀ воздвиза́етъ пѣ́ти тебѣ̀: Гд҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Seeing Thy unjust slaughter, creation was darkened and wept; as the earth was shaken, the sun was clothed in darkness as in a black garment; but we unceasingly hymn Thee, and supremely exalt Thee, O Christ, unto all ages.[^3873]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Непра́ведное ви́дѧщи заколе́нїе твоѐ тва́рь, ѡ҆мрача́ѧсѧ рыда́ше; землѝ ко смꙋща́ющейсѧ, въ мра́къ ꙗ҆́кѡ въ ри́зꙋ че́рнꙋю со́лнце ѡ҆блече́сѧ; мы́ же тѧ̀ непреста́ннѡ пое́мъ, и҆ превозно́симъ Хрртѐ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having descended unto me even unto hades, and having opened the way of resurrection unto all, Thou didst ascend again, taking me upon Thy shoulders, and didst lead me unto the Father. Therefore I cry unto Thee: Hymn the Lord, ye works, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^3874]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Сше́дый ко мнѣ̀ да́же до а҆́да, и҆ всѣ̑мъ пꙋтесотвори́вый воскресе́нїе, па́ки возше́лъ є҆сѝ взе́мь мѧ̀ на ра́мꙋ твое́ю, и҆ Ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ приве́лъ є҆сѝ. Тѣ́мже зовꙋ̀ тебѣ̀: Гд҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Triadikon:* The first Mind and Cause of all, the Father, the only Uncaused One...[^3875]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: ...we glorify, as also the Word co-unoriginate, and the Spirit the Comforter, the one God of all, worshipping the connatural Trinity, and supremely exalting It unto all ages.[^3876]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *O all-powerful Deliverer of all, having descended into the midst of the flame, Thou didst dew those who lived piously, and didst teach them to sing: Bless, all ye works, hymn the Lord.*[^3877]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* He Who created thee from Adam's rib was incarnate from thy virginity, He Who is Lord of all; Whom singing, we cry aloud: Bless, all ye works, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^3878]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In the tent Abraham beheld the mystery which is in thee, O Theotokos; for he received Thy bodiless Son, singing: Bless, all ye works, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^3879]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The prefiguration of thy virginity saved the youths equal in number to the Trinity; for in virginal bodies they trampled the flame, O Maiden, crying aloud: Bless, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^3880]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *A cornerstone was cut out without hands from an uncut mountain, which is thee, O Virgin: Christ, Who joined together divided natures. Therefore, rejoicing, we magnify thee, O Theotokos.*[^3881]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst receive me whole, all of me, in unconfused union, granting salvation unto all of me, O my God, through Thy passion, which Thou didst endure bodily upon the Cross by reason of Thy great tender compassion.[^3882]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Beholding Thy tomb opened, and the God-bearing winding-sheets emptied by Thy Resurrection, Thy disciples said with the Angel: Truly the Lord is risen![^3883]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Triadikon:* Worshipping the Unity indeed of the Divine Essence, but the Trinity in Hypostases, all we faithful now piously magnify the Trinity in unconfused Hypostases, equal in power and equal in honor.[^3884]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Let every earthborn mortal leap for joy, enlightened by the Spirit; and let the nature of the bodiless minds celebrate, honoring the sacred festival of the Mother of God, and let them cry aloud: Rejoice, O all-blessed Theotokos, pure Ever-Virgin!*[^3885]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Deceitfully creeping, the serpent led me captive out of Eden; but upon the solid stone of the Place of the Skull the Almighty Lord dashed this one in pieces as an infant, and through the Tree of the Cross opened again the entrance unto delight.[^3886]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou hast now laid waste the strong fortresses of the enemy, and with Thy most powerful hand hast plundered his wealth, O Christ Who didst raise me up together with Thyself from the depths of hades; and him who of old boasted boundlessly Thou didst show forth as an object of mockery and derision.[^3887]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Come, visiting the affliction of Thy poor people, and by Thy merciful and mighty hand strengthen our cross-bearing Emperor [Name] against blaspheming enemies, to deliver Thine elect inheritance, O Christ, as the Lover of mankind.[^3888]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *The hidden and ineffable divine mystery is clearly accomplished in thee, O most pure Virgin! For God was incarnate of thee out of mercy; therefore we magnify thee as the Theotokos.*[^3889]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* We behold thee as a lily adorned with a robe dyed purple by the Divine Spirit, O Most Pure One, shining in the midst of thorns, and filling with sweet fragrance those who sincerely magnify thee.[^3890]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having received corruptible human nature from thy womb, O All-immaculate One, the Incorruptible One showed it forth in Himself as incorruptible, through His tender compassion; therefore we magnify thee as the Theotokos.[^3891]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O thou who rulest over all creatures, grant unto thy people victorious triumph, making the enemy reconciled unto the Church, that we may magnify thee as the Theotokos.[^3892]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *After the Katavasia, the Litany and "Holy is the Lord our God." Then the Exapostilarion. Glory... Both now... Theotokion.*[^3893]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Thou Who didst endure the Cross and death, and didst rise from the dead, O all-powerful Lord, we glorify Thy Resurrection.[^3894]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* By Thy Cross, O Christ, Thou didst deliver us from the ancient curse, and by Thy death Thou didst abolish the devil who tormented our nature, and by Thy rising Thou didst fill all things with joy. Therefore we cry aloud unto Thee: O Thou Who didst rise from the dead, Lord, glory to Thee![^3895]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* By Thy Cross, O Christ our Savior, guide us unto Thy truth, and deliver us from the snares of the enemy; O Thou Who didst rise from the dead, raise up us who are fallen through sin, stretching forth Thy hand, O Lover of mankind...[^3896]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: ...O Lord, through the prayers of Thy saints.[^3897]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* Without parting from the Father's bosom, O only-begotten Word of God, Thou camest down upon earth for the sake of Thy love for mankind, having become man without change; and in the flesh Thou didst endure the Cross and death, being impassible in Thy Godhead; and rising from the dead, Thou didst grant immortality unto the race of mankind, as the only All-powerful One.[^3898]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, Anatolian:*[^3899]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5 [Anatolian 1]:* In the flesh Thou didst accept death, mediating immortality for us, O Savior; and Thou didst dwell in the tomb that Thou mightest free us from hades, having raised us up together with Thyself: having suffered indeed as man, but risen as God. Therefore we cry aloud: Glory to Thee, O Life-giving Lord, only Lover of mankind![^3900]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 6 [Anatolian 2]:* The rocks were rent, O Savior, when Thy Cross was planted upon the Place of the Skull; the gatekeepers of hades were terrified when Thou wast laid in the tomb as dead; for having abolished the power of death, Thou didst grant incorruption unto all the dead by Thy Resurrection, O Savior: O Life-giving Lord, glory to Thee![^3901]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 7 [Anatolian 3]:* The women desired to see Thy Resurrection, O Christ God; Mary Magdalene came beforehand, and found the stone rolled away from the tomb, and an Angel sitting and saying: Why seek ye the living with the dead? He is risen as God, that He may save all things.[^3903]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 8 [Anatolian 4]:* Where is Jesus, Whom ye thought to guard, say, ye Jews? Where is He Whom ye laid in the tomb, sealing the stone? Give up the dead Man, ye who have rejected Life; give up the Buried One, or believe in Him Who is risen! Even if ye keep silence concerning the Lord's rising, the stones will cry out, especially the one rolled away from the tomb. Great is Thy mercy! Great is the mystery of Thy dispensation! O our Savior, glory to Thee![^3905]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Glory: Evangelical Morning Sticheron. Both now: Theotokion. Great Doxology; Troparion: "Having risen from the tomb"; Litanies, and the Dismissal. Thereafter the First Hour, and the rest of the customary order, and the final Dismissal.*[^3906]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *The Beatitudes, Tone 4:*[^3907]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Through the tree Adam was banished from paradise, but through the tree of the Cross the thief took up dwelling in paradise: for the one, having tasted, rejected the commandment of Him that made him, while the other, crucified together, confessed the hidden God, crying: Remember me in Thy kingdom![^3908]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having all the Cross of Christ in our thoughts, let us hasten to mortify the pleasures of this life, making the church of our souls for the Holy Spirit, and sending up the cry of the well-disposed thief unto Him, we faithful: Remember us in Thy kingdom![^3909]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Let us faithful pray unto Him Who is risen from the dead, and plundered the dominion of hades, and was seen by the Myrrh-bearing women, saying: "Rejoice!", to deliver our souls from corruption, ever crying unto Him with the voice of the wise thief: Remember us also in Thy kingdom![^3910]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* The Myrrh-bearing women came unto Thy tomb, O Christ, to anoint Thee, and finding not Thy life-bearing and most pure Body, O Good One, they were perplexed, and weeping with tears they sought Thee; but seeing Thee, their beloved Master, they cried unto Thee: Remember us in Thy kingdom![^3911]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 5:* Truly Christ is risen, and the tomb testifies unto you, ye transgressors of the Law; for leaving behind His burial wrappings, He rose on the third day. The stone was sealed, and the guards stood before the tomb, hades was despoiled, death was put to death. Christ was not stolen away; believe with us in His Resurrection![^3912]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 6:* Having come unto the disciples and granting them peace, and convincing unbelieving Thomas by the showing of Thy wounds, Thou didst raise up all the ends of the earth, O Lord, to glorify Thee. And now, being entreated, save those who cry, O Master: Remember us in Thy kingdom![^3913]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Glory... Triadikon:* Let all we faithful pray to praise worthily with one mind the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, the Unity of the Godhead existing in three Hypostases, abiding unconfused, simple, undivided, and unapproachable, whereby we are delivered from the torment of fire.[^3914]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^3442]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Thy Mother, O Christ, who in the flesh gave birth unto Thee without seed, and truly remained a Virgin incorrupt even after childbirth, her do we bring unto Thee in prayer: O abundantly merciful Master, grant forgiveness of transgressions unto those who ever cry unto Thee: Remember us also in Thy kingdom![^3915]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 4.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* I have sinned against Thee, O Lover of mankind, not according to nature as a man, that I might ask forgiveness, but beyond man, and above the laws of nature, and beyond the comprehension of thought; having become man, O my Savior, and possessing a love for mankind that surpasses the mind, have mercy on me who turn unto Thee.[^3918]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Thou hast appointed repentance for sinners, O Christ, and not for the righteous: having indeed the examples of the thief and the prodigal, of Manasseh and the harlot, of the persecutor, the publican, and the denier, I do not easily despair; for knowing Thy love for mankind and exceeding goodness, O my Savior, I turn and weep, and have good hope that Thou wilt receive me.[^3919]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Grant me compunction, and estrangement from evil deeds, and perfect amendment, unto me who am now sunken in bodily passions and distanced from Thee, O God, King of all; and having no hope at all, save me, the prodigal, for the sake of Thy great goodness, O all-powerful Jesus, Savior of our souls.[^3920]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Then the Stichera in the Menaion to the Saint, if there be any; but if there be no Menaion, these Stichera to the Holy Bodiless Angels:*[^3921]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1 [to the Bodiless Powers]:* Receptive dwellings of the divine splendor, and all-honorable receptacles, Thou didst establish the angelic armies, O Immortal One; and by divine constitution Thou didst appoint them beholders and ministers of Thy glory, in strength to accomplish Thy word, and to fulfill Thy all-effecting and transcendent will.[^3923]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 [to the Bodiless Powers]:* Desiring to manifest an abyss of goodness, being good, O Unoriginate One, Thou didst first create by Thine almighty nod and divine command the angelic choirs and the ranks of the Powers; for truly it was fitting that good should pour forth and go forward, that Thy gifts might be unto many, O Master.[^3924]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3 [to the Bodiless Powers]:* The six-winged Seraphim, the many-eyed Cherubim, with the most exalted Thrones stand round about Thee, directly partaking of Thine all-effecting radiance; Dominions, Principalities, Authorities, Archangels, Angels, and divine Powers, praising Thy glory, O Almighty, pray unto Thee for us.[^3925]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* When sailing upon the sea, when walking upon the way, when sitting in the sheepfold by night, when keeping vigil, bestow grace upon me and my mind, O all-immaculate one, and vouchsafe me to do the will of the Lord, that I may find in the day of judgment remission of the things committed by me in life, fleeing beneath thy shelter.[^3926]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *"O Gladsome Light." Prokeimenon of the day. "Vouchsafe, O Lord."*[^3927]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* I desired to wash away the handwriting of my transgressions with tears, O Lord, and for the remainder of my life to be well-pleasing unto Thee through repentance; but the enemy deceives me and wars against my soul. O Lord, before I perish utterly, save me![^3928]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Verse: Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes, unto Thee that dwellest in heaven... So look our eyes unto the Lord our God, until He take pity on us.* [LXX Ps. 122:1-2]* [^3929]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Who, being tempest-tossed and fleeing unto Thy haven, O Lord, is not saved? Or who, being sick and falling down before Thy healing medicine, is not healed? O Creator of all things and Physician of the ailing! O Lord, before I perish utterly, save me![^3930]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us, for we are exceedingly filled with contempt. Our soul is exceedingly filled with the reproach of the prosperous, and with the contempt of the proud.* [LXX Ps. 122:3-4]* [^3931]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* O Christ God, Who art glorified in the memories of Thy saints, and being entreated by them: send down upon us Thy great mercy.[^3932]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Rejoice, cloud of light! Rejoice, radiant lampstand! Rejoice, jar wherein was the manna! Rejoice, rod of Aaron! Rejoice, unburnt bush! Rejoice, bridal chamber! Rejoice, throne! Rejoice, holy mountain! Rejoice, refuge! Rejoice, divine table! Rejoice...[^3933]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: ...mystical door! Rejoice, joy of all![^3934]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *"Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart." Trisagion. After "Our Father": Troparion, Litany, and the Dismissal.*[^3935]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Having traversed the Red Sea's deep with unwetted feet, ancient Israel of old conquered the power of Amalek in the wilderness by the crosswise-stretched hands of Moses.*[^3936]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^3937]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Receive my supplication from the soul, O most pure Sovereign Lady, who gavest birth to God in the flesh; for unto thee have I fled for mighty help, that I may not fail of my hope.[^3938]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In servile manner I fall down before thee, O most pure Mother of God, as thou hast great boldness: deliver me from all afflictions by thy prayers, interceding with thy Son.[^3939]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Drowned by the waves of the sea of life, and held fast by cruel temptations, I have hastened unto the storm-free haven of thy protection; therefore deliver me, O Theotokos, from grievous ills.[^3940]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Look with thy compassionate and gentle eye upon thy servant, and hasten to hear me, O Good One, fulfilling the supplication of thy servant, O Most Pure One, and destroying the counsels of the wicked.[^3941]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Thy Church rejoices in Thee, O Christ, crying: Thou art my strength, O Lord, and my refuge and confirmation!*[^3942]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou art a helper against enemies, and a champion in battles for the faithful, O Sovereign Lady, and a refuge for those who are in sorrows.[^3943]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Pray unto Him Whom thou didst bear in the flesh, the God of all, as unto thy Son, to grant me release from my evils from worldly troubles.[^3944]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Look mercifully upon our lowliness, O Sovereign Lady, that thy servants may be delivered from the impending wrath.[^3945]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Saved ever from all sorrows beneath thy shelter, O good Sovereign Lady, we offer praise unto thy Son.[^3946]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *I heard report of Thee and was afraid; I considered Thy works and was in dread, O Lord.*[^3947]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As thou hast boldness toward thy Son, O pure Mother of God, deliver me from the present temptation, shattering the frequent counsels of the enemies who ever war against me.[^3948]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Ye choirs of the higher Ranks, Martyrs, and Just Ones, with the Apostles, the assembly of divine Prophets, and the Righteous, with the Theotokos pray unto Christ for us.[^3949]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Receive Thy most glorious Mother praying for peace, O Christ, crying mercifully unto Thee: O My Son, receive My prayer, and assuage the wrath hanging over the earth.[^3950]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Both now:* I fall down before thee, O Theotokos, and pray from the depth of my heart: turn away the present temptation from me, that having been delivered from grievous ills, I may offer a hymn unto thy brightness.[^3951]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *The ungodly shall not behold Thy glory, O Christ, but waking early out of the night, we hymn Thee, O Only-begotten One, Radiance of the Father's glory of the Godhead, O Lover of mankind.*[^3952]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O hope and protection of earthly dwellers, O Pure One, have compassion on our lowliness, we pray, and free us from the impending wrath.[^3953]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Holding thy prayer as an invincible wall, O Pure One, we cry aloud unto thee: Have compassion, O Sovereign Lady, and drive away visible enemies.[^3954]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Boasting ever in hope toward thee, O Most Pure One, let us not be put to shame, we pray with tears, and we worship thy goodness.[^3955]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Both now:* By thy most pure hand, O All-hymned One, disperse the enemies rising up against us, that the wretched ones may know that we have placed our hope in thee.[^3956]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Prefiguring the three-day burial, the Prophet Jonah cried aloud, praying in the sea monster: Deliver me from corruption, O Jesus, King of powers!*[^3957]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Cleanse our sins, O Lover of mankind, we pray, through the supplications of her that gave birth to Thee without seed; for for our sake, O Word, Thou didst pour forth Thy precious blood.[^3958]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* An evil assembly is gathered against us of those who unjustly war against us, O Bride of God! But cast them down, as Simon the sorcerer of old.[^3959]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Hear our supplication, O Sovereign Lady, we pray, and calm the storm-waves of diverse afflictions wherewith the enemies have gathered against us.[^3960]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Turn my sorrow into joy, as Thou art compassionate, and change my weeping into gladness, and have mercy for the sake of the Theotokos, O Christ Who didst turn water into wine in Cana of Galilee.[^3961]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Lord, have mercy (three times). Glory... Both now...*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: Having darkened my prodigal mind with many transgressions, I cry unto thy strong protection, O Theotokos: Enlighten the pupils of my soul, and cause the radiant dawn of repentance to shine forth upon me, and clothe me in the armor of light, O pure Mother of God.[^3962]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Deliver us not up utterly for Thy name's sake, and break not Thy covenant, and take not Thy mercy away from us, O Lord God of our fathers, all-hymned unto the ages.*[^3963]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being in diverse temptations and sorrows, I have now fled unto thee, O Pure One, for my salvation, crying: Let me not turn back put to shame from my expectation, but hear and deliver me from the snares of those who hunt for me.[^3964]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In servile manner I bend the neck, wretched one, and cry from my heart; stretching forth my hands, I bow the knees, and pray unto thee, O most pure Virgin, to be delivered from the sorrows that ever come upon me from the alien assault.[^3965]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Glory:* O most glorious, pure Mary, boast of earthly mortals, we pray: grant thy help unto us who pray and piously bow down before thy Childbirth; for we have acquired no other hope and protectress besides thee.[^3966]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Both now:* O Mary unwedded, who beyond comprehension and beyond all nature gavest birth to God, O protectress of the faithful: deliver those who honor thee pure and unharmed from sudden temptations, and from all enemies visible and invisible.[^3967]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Daniel, stretching forth his hands, stopped the gaping mouths of lions in the pit; and girded with virtue, the youths, lovers of piety, quenched the power of fire, crying aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord.*[^3968]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ́хъ, Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́наго безвино́в-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I dare not lift up my hands unto thy Son, O Pure One! For I am wholly...[^3969]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Въ Недѣ́лю на Повече́ріи, Гла́съ д҃.
items.english_text: ...defiled; therefore I dare to flee unto thee, O Sovereign Lady:[^3970] intercede with the compassionate and easily-reconciled God,[^3971] that we may be delivered from the adversary enemies who afflict us.[^3972]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: ...оскверне́нъ; тѣ́мже дерза́ю къ тебѣ́ Влчце прибѣ́гнути: хода́тайствуй къ ще́дрому Бг҃у и бл҃гопремѣ́нному, изба́витися на́мъ сопроти́вныхъ вра̑гъ, оскорбля́ющихъ на́съ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I have placed mine eyes, my heart, and my soul upon thee, O Most Pure One; therefore take pity, O pure Sovereign Lady, falling down before the Compassionate One on behalf of me, the wretched and impatient, that He may save me from every distress, plague, and sorrow.[^3973]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: О́чи и се́рдце и ду́шу на тя̀ Пречи́стая возложи́хъ; тѣ́мже оу҆милосе́рдися Влчце чи́стая, ще́дромꙋ припа́дающи, ѡ҆ мнѣ̀ хꙋде́мъ и нетерпѣли́вѣмъ, да спасе́тъ мя̀ ѿ вся́кія ну́жды, и҆ ꙗ҆́зи, и҆ печа́ли.
items.english_text: *Glory:* With Thine armor, as Thou art mighty, trample down those warring against us, O Lord, and grant victory, O Master, unto those who hope with faith in Thee; the Theotokos beseeches Thee, with John the Forerunner, and the choir of Thine Apostles and Martyrs.[^3974]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Ѻру́жіемъ твои́мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ си́ленъ, борю́щія на́съ поперѝ Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ побѣ́ду да́руй Вл҃ко, вѣ́рою надѣ́ющимся на тя̀; Бцⷣа мо́литъ тя̀ съ Предте́чею І҆ѡа́нномъ, и҆ А҆пⷭ҇толскій ли́къ и҆ Мч҃никъ твои́хъ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Gabriel of old brought unto thee the joy of good tidings, O pure Virgin, and the ancient mother's mourning was loosed by thy childbirth; therefore having thyself cleansed the despondency of my soul, show me forth unashamed by thy prayers.[^3975]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дость бл҃говѣ́щенія и҆ногда̀ Гавріи́лъ тебѣ̀ чи́стая Дв҃о принесѐ, и҆ прама́терне сѣ́тованіе разрꙋши́ся ржⷭ҇тво́мъ твои́мъ; тѣ́мже сама̀ и҆ моея̀ душѝ оу҆ны́ніе ѡ҆чи́стивши, покажи́ мя моли́твами твои́ми непосра́млена.
items.english_text: *A stone uncut by hands was cut from an unhewn mountain, from thee, O Virgin, the cornerstone, Christ, Who joined together the severed natures. Therefore rejoicing, we magnify thee, O Theotokos.*[^3976]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Ка́мень нерꙋкосѣ́чный ѿ несѣко́мыя горы̀ тебѐ Дв҃о, краеꙋго́лный ѿсѣче́ся, Хрⷭ҇то́съ совокупи́вый разстоя́щаяся є҆стества̀. Тѣ́мъ веселя́щеся тя̀ Бцⷣе велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Manifest thy help speedily, O Virgin Theotokos; incline thine ear earnestly, and give ear unto those who cry out fervently, and change our bitter afflictions, delivering us by thy prayers.[^3977]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆вѝ Бцⷣе Дв҃о твою̀ по́мощь вско́рѣ, приклони́ же оу҆се́рднѡ оу҆́хо твоѐ, и҆ вопію́щихъ те́плѣ оу҆слы́ши, и҆ лю́тыхъ и҆змѣнѝ, и҆збавля́ющи на́съ моли́твами твои́ми.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I am wholly held fast by slothfulness, and am in the despair of the depths of my transgressions. Therefore stretch forth a hand unto me, O Virgin Mother, as Christ did unto Peter, and deliver me from the depths of transgressions.[^3978]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Ве́сь лѣ́ностію ѡ҆держи́мъ, и҆ въ ѿча́яніи є҆́смь глубины̀ мои́хъ прегрѣше́ній. Тѣ́мже мнѣ̀ Дв҃о Мн҃ти ру́ку прострѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Петроу̀ Хрⷭ҇то́съ, и҆ и҆зъ глубины̀ прегрѣше́ній и҆зба́ви мя.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Subdue, O Virgin, an unbridled and boastful tongue, sharpened like an arrow, which desires to shoot and to kill me; pour it out like wax, and make its counsel vain.[^3979]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆зы́къ необузда́нъ и҆ велерѣ́чивъ оу҆кротѝ Дв҃о, и҆зощре́нный ꙗ҆́кѡ стрѣла̀, оу҆стрѣли́ти хотя́щь и҆ оу҆мори́ти мя̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ во́скъ разли́й, и҆ совѣ́тъ є҆гѡ̀ су́етенъ сотворѝ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Destroy all the counsels of those armed against us, O Mother of God Most High! And fill with joy those who trust in thee, that we all may earnestly proclaim thy protection.[^3980]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Разрушѝ совѣ́ты вся̑ ꙗ҆̀же на ны̀ вооруже́ныхъ, Мн҃ти Бг҃а вы́шнягѡ! ра́дости же и҆спо́лни оу҆пова́ющихъ на тя̀, да оу҆се́рднѡ всѝ твоѐ проповѣ́мы заступле́ніе.
items.english_text: *On Monday at Matins.*[^3981]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: По а҃-мъ стіхосло́віи сѣда́льны пока́янны, Гла́съ д҃.
items.english_text: *After the first stichology, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 4:*[^3982]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: Visit my humble soul, O Lord, which has spent its whole liv-

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: ...ing in sins; like the harlot receive me, and save me.[^3983]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: Crossing the deep sea of this present life, I ponder the abyss of my many evils; and having no steersman of my thoughts, I utter Peter's cry unto Thee: Save me, O Christ, save me, O God, as the Lover of mankind.[^3985]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: Thou art an unconquerable wall unto us Christians, O Virgin Theotokos; for fleeing unto thee we remain unharmed, and having sinned again, we have thee as an intercessor. Therefore gratefully we cry unto thee: Rejoice, thou who art full of grace, the Lord is with thee.[^3986]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *After the second stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4:*[^3987]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: Speedily let us enter into the bridal chamber of Christ, that we all may hear the divine voice of Christ our God: Come, ye who love heavenly glory, and receive it together with the wise virgins, having enlightened your lamps with faith.[^3988]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: Condemned by the multitude of my transgressions, and troubled by the fear of torment, O Christ our God! I offer Thee tears of repentance from the heart, unto Thee Who hast dominion of life and death, and I cry unto Thee in compunction: I have sinned, O Lord, save me.[^3990]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: Today the angelic hosts have arrived for the memory of the passion-bearers, to enlighten the minds of the faithful and to illumine the universe with grace; being implored by them, O God, grant us great mercy.[^3992]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: Having received the Word from the Angel in thy womb, O Virgin, and given birth to Christ God Emmanuel incarnate, O Theotokos, pray for our souls.[^3993]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *After the third stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4:*[^3994]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: With immaterial lips, O supersubstantial Trinity, the choirs of the Bodiless Powers unceasingly hymn Thee, and stand with fear, crying: Holy, O tri-hypostatic Nature! Have mercy on the creation of Thy hands through their supplications, O only Lover of mankind.[^3996]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: The angelic ranks stand before Thy throne with fear, O Master, and being enlightened from thence with radiant-

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: ...beams ever illuminated, unceasingly chant a hymn of victory unto Thee, O Lord; through their sacred prayers, grant peace unto the world, and remission of our transgressions.[^3997]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: O all-immaculate Virgin, who gavest birth to the transcendent God, with the Bodiless Powers unceasingly pray Him: to grant us remission of transgressions and amendment of life before the end, unto us who hymn thee with faith and love as is meet, O only All-hymned One.[^3998]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to His holy Martyrs.*[^3999]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: Save me, O Savior, as the prodigal of old). A creation of Joseph.*[^4000]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Thou Who wast born of the Virgin, drown, I pray Thee, the tripartite part of my soul in the depth of dispassion, as of old the mighty trireme commanders, that in the mortification of the body, as upon a timbrel, I may sing a triumphal song unto Thee.*[^4001]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*[^4002]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O my Savior Jesus, Who didst save the prodigal, and Who didst accept the weeping of the harlot, Who didst justify the sighing publican by Thy nod: receive also me, who have sinned without number and am returning, and save me.[^4003]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Like material fuel a wicked fire devours my soul, and kindles a spark for the flame that is to come, O Lover of mankind! Quench it with the bedewing of Thy mercies, O Long-suffering One, granting me tears of repentance.[^4004]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Filled with much understanding, the choir of holy sufferers prudently turned away from the unwise counsel and contrary musing of all the lawless, and received divine honors.[^4005]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* Having despised the fair things of the world, through faith ye inherited the life above the world, O wise, all-lauded passion-bearers! Therefore deliver me, who sincerely bless you, from every worldly confusion.[^4006]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O most radiant candle of the Sun of glory, kindle the fire of my soul extinguished by despondency, O Most Pure One, ever watering it with the oil of divine deeds, that with faith and love I may glorify thee.[^4007]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Holy Bodiless Angels.*[^4008]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Tone 4. The Heirmos the same:*[^4009]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Twice):* As pure minds, O Angels, standing before the great and first Mind, and being filled with divine radiance, illuminate me with your beam, as ye hymn the all-causing Word, O all-glorious-

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Wholly inclined toward God in love, and manifestly figured with divine beauties, O glorious Archangels, ye stand around with diligent station, crying a triumphal hymn unto the Creator.[^4011]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having alone received in thy womb the Word, Whom the angelic hosts glorify unceasingly, illuminate my soul, loosing sinful, dark evil-thinking, O All-immaculate One, and enlightening me with the understanding of the Spirit.[^4012]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *From the height Thou didst voluntarily descend upon the earth, O Thou Who art above every principality, and didst raise up from the nethermost hades humble human nature; for there is none holy besides Thee, O Lover of mankind.*[^4013]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* In the night of life, the darkness of passions hath encompassed me; O Christ God, Who art the unsetting Light, illuminating me with the rays of repentance, save me as the Lover of mankind, that I may glorify Thee.[^4014]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Show me forth, O Christ, as an inheritor of the portion of the elect, having separated me from the adversary portion, O Savior, cleansed by tears and almsgiving, that in praise I may ever glorify Thee.

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Truly your feet were empurpled with blood, and ran swifter toward heaven, having left the earth with sin, O Martyrs, companions of the divine powers.[^4015]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* Your body, afflicted with wounds, was dissolved, O sufferers of Christ, but the power of your soul was strengthened, bound by love unto the desire of Him Who created all things.[^4016]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Mary, being the Sovereign Lady, as having given birth to the Lord of all: make me free and enlighten me, who am dominated by the passions of my mind and blackened with malice.[^4017]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], The Heirmos the same:*[^4018]`

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Twice):* O Christ, Who art hymned by choirs above the world, through their order grant the assemblies of the faithful to hymn Thee with godly wisdom, O Word! For there is none holy besides Thee, O Lover of mankind.* (Twice)[^4019]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With warm love, with affectionate attachment, partaking of the first Fountain, ye stand ministeringly, unceasingly hymning the one Essence of the unoriginate Godhead, O divine Archangels.[^4020]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having given birth to Christ, Who crowns all with blessings, O pure Mother, thou didst most radiantly dissolve Eve's ancient curse; for there is no helper besides thee, O Most Pure One.[^4021]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *He Who sits in glory upon the throne of the Godhead, Jesus the transcendent God, came on a light cloud, by an incorrupt hand, and saved those who cry: Glory to Thy power, O Christ!*[^4022]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As before the most righteous Judge, I now fall down before Thee, O Lord: have pity on me, condemned and despairing, and deliver me from Thy righteous sentence, and vouchsafe unto me the standing of the elect.[^4023]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having fallen among untamed robbers, O Lover of mankind, and been wounded, heal me, O Christ, pouring out upon me the wine and oil of repentance, and clothing me with the garment of my salvation.[^4024]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Ye were clothed from on high with the robe of salvation in the stripping of the flesh, O all-lauded Martyrs, and having stripped him who stripped our forefather of old, ye laid him bare, making him a breathless corpse.[^4025]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* Speaking with eloquence before the lawless, O Martyrs, adorned with the understanding of the piety of God the Word, ye put to shame all the ungodly sages and orators, and put the enemy to death.[^4026]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Upon thee, as rain, Jesus the abyss of wisdom came down, having found thee alone pure, O Virgin Mother of God, and by divine grace He stopped the grievous torrents of ungodliness.[^4027]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], The Heirmos the same:*[^4028]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By Thine incomprehensible power Thou didst bring the heavenly minds from non-existence, O transcendent Word of God, and didst adorn them with Thine ineffable glory, as they cry: Glory to Thy power, O Christ![^4029]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Governed by the Spirit and His bridles, and radiant with divine beams, the higher powers inherited ranks that fall not away, honoring the one Beginning and Godhead of all.[^4030]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: Thy ministering Brightnesses were vouchsafed to behold the fair beauty of Thy face, and receiving understanding from thence-

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: ...forth, they cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Christ![^4031]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Queen Virgin, adorned with a golden vesture, now stands before the Son the King, she who is incomparably higher than the Angels, who cry: Glory to Thy power, O Christ![^4032]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Now will I arise, prophetically said God; now will I be glorified, now will I be exalted, having received from the Virgin him that fell, and raising him to the noetic light of My Godhead.*[^4033]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O how shall I, condemned, appear before Thee, the Judge and God of all, and be reproved concerning all the evil things that I have foolishly and willfully committed, and have made myself wholly unprofitable![^4034]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Save me, O Lord, for I am filled with many evils; and I pray Thee, heal my wounds and grievous sores; and suffer not me alone to perish, O my Jesus, who have sinned greatly against Thee.[^4035]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Having manifestly found a blessed end, the sufferers attained glory, glorifying Christ the Arbiter of the contest with their members, having manfully resolved to partake of bruises and wounds.[^4036]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* Heavenly riches, all-gloriously, O divine Sufferers, an unfading crown, and unsetting light, and a non-decaying habitation not made with hands have ye inherited, O blessed Martyrs of Christ.[^4037]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Prophetic voices foretold thy wonders, calling thee a mountain, O Most Pure One, and a gate, and a radiant lampstand, from which in truth a marvelous light enlightens the whole world, O Pure One.[^4038]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], The Heirmos the same:*[^4039]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Twice):* With trembling the Cherubim and Seraphim with the Thrones, and the divine Archangels, and Dominions, and Powers, and Principalities, and Authorities with the Angels glorify the honorable one and threefold Godhead.* (Twice)[^4040]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The Angels appeared shining in light-bearing form, O Christ, proclaiming Thy resurrection in the world unto the venerable women, and striking terror into the mind of Thine enemies by the lightnings of Thy Godhead.[^4041]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: Now preserve Thy Church with Archangelic hosts, as it glorifies Thee with orthodox voices, O Thou Who wast ineffably born of the Virgin-

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: ...delivering mankind from corruption.[^4042]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *I have come into the depths of the sea, and a storm of many sins hath overwhelmed me; but as God, lead my life up from the abyss, O Plenteous in mercy.*[^4043]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being dead I understand not, feeling nothing, wretched that I am, and ever bearing a defiled conscience; O God my Creator, destroy me not utterly to the end.[^4044]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* My deeds, like enemies, desire to slander me at Thy judgment-seat, O Compassionate One! From them speedily deliver me, O Christ, guiding me unto repentance.[^4045]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* The assembly of the lawless crushed the bones of the passion-bearers, but crushed not their faith; for the sake whereof they were shown forth as heirs unto God, and unto the Savior of our souls.[^4046]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* As precious stones, upon the immovable rock of hope the passion-bearers were built with godly wisdom, and as temples of the Holy Spirit, they took up their abode in the temple of God.[^4047]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* My heart, darkened by the murky assaults of sin, illuminate with the light that is in thee, O unwedded Bride of God, who gavest birth to Christ the Sun.[^4048]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], The Heirmos the same:*[^4049]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Twice):* Ye angelic hosts that stand around the Sovereign Lady, and purely enjoy the radiance of the radiant Beginning: enlighten those who hymn you with faith.* (Twice)[^4050]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having by Thy wisdom made the angelic choirs, Dominions and Powers and Seraphim, Thou hast shown them forth as a Master, as they honor Thee with praises.[^4051]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As Thou Who restest upon exalted thrones, O Christ, and preservest all things by divine providence, Thou didst rest, O Master, upon the virginal arm.[^4052]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *The three youths in Babylon, turning the tyrant's command into folly, cried out in the midst of the flame: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!*[^4053]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* To whom shall I liken thee, O my wretched soul? Woe is me! loving unfitting things, and not seeking the good? Therefore before the end hasten to show forth good examples.[^4054]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: Grant me a shower of tears, O Christ, that from my grievous-

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: ...sins I may wash myself; and suffer me not now to perish, O Savior, who have sinned against Thee far more than all men.[^4055]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Bearing in your body the dying of the mortified Word, ye put deception to death; and having died, ye live, O glorious sufferers, and heal those who are mortified by passions.[^4056]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* What place now has you not, O Martyrs, enlighteners and bulwark? What region is not sanctified by your sufferings, O glorious ones, and by the outpourings of healings?[^4057]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou alone remainest a virgin after childbirth, O Sovereign Lady, shining with virginal beauty; thou alone didst escape maternal pangs; for thou alone gavest birth to God, the Deliverer of our souls.[^4058]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], The Heirmos the same:*[^4059]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Twice):* Having noetic witnesses of the things committed, even the Angels, let us choose a pure life, O my soul, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!* (Twice)[^4060]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Cleansed by a live coal, the divine Isaiah, beholding the Seraphim standing before Thy throne, cried aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers![^4061]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou manifestly transcendest the ranks of all the Bodiless Powers, O Virgin, as having given birth to the Creator and Lord. Blessed, O Most Pure One, is the fruit of thy womb.[^4062]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *O almighty Deliverer of all, coming down in the midst of the flame Thou didst bedew those who acted piously, and didst teach them to sing: All ye works, bless, praise the Lord!*[^4063]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I have appeared like unto beasts, having bowed myself down unto irrational passions; O Word of God, transcendent and unoriginate, turn me and save me as I cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord![^4064]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The wild boar has grazed upon me, the solitary beast has consumed me, O Savior, like a vineyard cultivated by the Spirit; deliver me from him, O Word, and show forth my soul fruitful in virtues straightway unto Thee.[^4065]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* The sprinklings of blood dyed for you a divinely-woven purple robe, wherewith ye were adorned, O Martyrs, and wearing crowns of victory, ye stand before the eternal King on high.[^4066]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* The sacred assembly of Martyrs destroyed the unholy accord that commanded them to act lawlessly; and having suffered lawfully, they were lawfully crowned by the Master of all.[^4067]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* All creation blesses thy childbirth, which hath crowned us with blessings and delivered us from the curse, O only All-blessed and Most Glorious One, who hast bestowed grace upon our race.[^4068]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], The Heirmos the same:*[^4069]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Twice):* As Thou art immortal life, Thou didst creatively make the Angels to partake of immortal life, and didst teach them to sing: Bless the Lord, praise Him.* (Twice)[^4070]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Noetically standing around Thee, the Archangels hymn Thee with unceasing voices, honoring Thee in godly manner as the Master of all: Bless the Lord, praise Him.[^4071]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The legal types foreshadowed thee, O All-blessed One, who gavest birth to God Who is united to material flesh, Who before was immaterial by divine nature. Let us bless thy childbirth, O Virgin.[^4072]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Eve through the disease of disobedience introduced the curse; but thou, O Virgin Theotokos, through the blossoming of pregnancy didst bud forth blessing unto the world. Therefore we all magnify thee.*[^4073]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Behold the time of repentance! Why are we slothful? Why are we sunk in sleep? Let us depart from despondency; let us adorn our lamps, as it is written, with the oil of well-doing, that we may not remain weeping outside the doors.[^4074]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* While there is time to repent, turn from thine evils, O my soul, which thou hast committed in knowledge and in ignorance, and cry aloud unto Him Who knows all things: I have sinned against Thee, forgive, O Master, and despise me not, unworthy though I be.[^4075]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Christ gathered the holy sufferers most manifestly from every land and city into glorious places, into honorable resting places; and now rejoicing they enlighten the church of the firstborn.[^4076]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: The all-honorable shrine of Thy venerable Martyrs, O Lord, illuminated by the rays of the Holy Spirit, most gloriously sends forth the brightness of healings, and destroys the diseases of ail-

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: ...ments, O only Plenteous in mercy.[^4077]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With the beams from the light that is in thee, O Bride of God, enlighten my soul, and raise it up lying in the pit of destruction, crushing the enemies that ever afflict my heart and urge me on to passions.[^4078]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], The Heirmos:*[^4079]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *The hidden ineffable mystery of God is accomplished manifestly in thee, O most pure Virgin! For God was incarnate of thee because of mercy; therefore as the Theotokos we magnify thee.*[^4080]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Hymning the Father of the Mind, and the Son and the Spirit proceeding, O Angels! earnestly strive now to send down upon us the gifts of divine grace.[^4081]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Beautifully adorned with the gift and grace of incorruption, O divine Archangels, as they hymn Thee the Fountain, O Christ, the co-eternal Incorruption, they magnify Thee as Benefactor.[^4082]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As the bridal chamber of the ineffable incarnation, and an animate palace, and the ark of the law of grace, we the faithful know thee, O Mother of God; therefore unceasingly we magnify thee.[^4083]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera. Tone 4:*[^4084]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: Wash me with my tears, O Savior, for I am defiled with many sins; therefore I also fall down before Thee: I have sinned, O God, have mercy on me.[^4085]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad... And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, and guide their sons.* [^4086]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: I am a sheep of Thy rational flock, and I flee unto Thee, the good Shepherd: seek me who have gone astray, O God, and have mercy on me.[^4087]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу посѣтѝ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ всѐ жи-
items.english_text: Who is not struck with awe, beholding, O holy Martyrs, your good fight, wherewith ye fought? How, being in the flesh, ye conquered the bodiless enemy, confessing Christ, and having armed yourselves with the Cross? Therefore worthily were ye shown forth as expellers of demons, and against barbarians...[^4089]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: воборцы̀, непреста́ннѡ молѧ́щесѧ, спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: ...adversaries, praying unceasingly that our souls may be saved.[^4090]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Бц҃е, всѣ́хъ Цари́це, правосла́вныхъ похвало̀! є҆рети́чествꙋющихъ шата̑нїа разорѝ, и҆ ли́ца и҆́хъ посрамѝ, не кла́нѧющихсѧ, нижѐ чтꙋ́щихъ Пречи́стаѧ честны́й тво́й ѡ҆́бразъ.
items.english_text: O Theotokos, Queen of all, boast of the Orthodox! Destroy the arrogance of the heretics, and put to shame the faces of those who neither bow down before nor venerate thine honorable icon, O Most-pure One.[^4091]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Дре́вомъ А҆да́мъ раѧ̀ бы́сть и҆зселе́нъ, дре́вомъ же кре́стнымъ разбо́йникъ въ ра́й всели́сѧ: ѻ҆́въ оу҆́бѡ вку́шъ, за́повѣдь ѿве́рже Сотво́ршагѡ, ѻ҆́въ же сраспина́емь, Бг҃а и҆сповѣ́да та́ѧщагосѧ, помѧни́ мѧ, вопїѧ̀, въ ца́рствїи твое́мъ.
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy:*[^4092]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
items.slavonic_text: Па́че всѣ́хъ человѣ́къ на землѝ а҆́зъ согрѣши́хъ, и҆ бою́сѧ та́мѡ нелицемѣ́рнагѡ сꙋди́ща, на не́мже неосꙋжде́на мѧ̀ соблюдѝ тогда̀, Преблагі́й, и҆ ѿ мꙋ́ки и҆зба́ви, подаѧ̀ мнѣ̀ покаѧ́нїе ѡ҆мыва́ющее всѧ́кїѧ скве́рны, ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣколю́бецъ.
items.english_text: *The Beatitudes, Tone 4:*[^4093]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^3916]
