items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* Having clearly been made radiant as gold in a furnace, tested by torments, O sufferers, and shown to be honorable seals of the sufferings of Christ, ye are now hidden in the heavenly treasuries in great security.[^4249]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: Having borne in the flesh the Savior and God, the Redeemer and Master, O most-pure Lady! pray Him unceasingly, O Most-pure One, that having received release from cruel sins and forgiveness of many transgressions, we may glorify His compassions which transcend the mind.[^4250]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *The children of Abraham once in Babylon trampled upon the furnace flame, crying in hymns: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.*[^4251]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou wast shown to be the greatest of all born of women, O Prophet of God; deliver me who sin greatly, by thy most great prayer, from the great flame and from eternal darkness, that I may bless thee.[^4252]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I have appeared as a barren fig tree, and I fear the cutting down; establish me by thy mediation, O Forerunner of the Savior, and make me fruitful, that I may bless thee.[^4253]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Lull to sleep every storm stirred up by the enemy against those who run unto thee in faith, by thy vigilant prayers unto the Redeemer of all, O Forerunner John.[^4254]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: From the assault and portion of the evil one, O Virgin, and from demonic bondage, preserve thy servants, who ever glorify thee with soul and tongue.[^4255]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *In flaming fire Cherubim and Seraphim stand before Thee, O Lord, and all creation sings unto Thee a fair song: Hymn, bless, and exalt above all, ye people, Christ, the only Creator, unto all ages.*[^4256]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I have not abided in Thy fear, I have not obeyed Thy commandments, and Thy will have I never done; what shall I, wretched one, become? As Thou art the Lover of mankind, have compassion on me freely, O Savior, and cast me not away.[^4257]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Unto Thee, the Cultivator of good things, do I cry: With the sickle of Thy fear reap out by the root all the thorny thoughts of my wretched soul, and grant me, O Christ, through the seed of repentance, to sprout forth a saving ear of grain.[^4258]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Being straitened in many torments, the passion-bearers were enlarged by grace, and they narrowed for the enemy the paths that are full of chasms; and now they guide us unto the ways of God in faith and love.[^4259]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* The deceiver suffered calamity, falling into the depth of your endurance and suffering, O martyrs, and the foolish one lies mocked by all; but ye are adorned with crowns of victory.[^4260]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: Thy womb, O All-immaculate One, was shown to be a heap of wheat upon the honorable threshing-floor, bearing for the world the Wheat of life that nourishes all things; therefore, as the cause of all good things, we the faithful duly bless thee.[^4261]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *O Almighty Redeemer of all, having descended into the midst of the flame, Thou didst bedew the godly ones, and didst teach them to sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works, hymn the Lord.*[^4262]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Upon me who am held fast by the sleep of despondency and darkened by the gloom of malice, set me upright by thy radiant prayer, O Forerunner, and grant me to walk becomingly as in the day of virtues.[^4263]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* A storm of temptations holds me fast, and a surge of passions troubles me; stretch out a hand unto me, O Forerunner, guiding the ship of my soul unto the haven of repentance by thy prayers.[^4264]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O thou who didst baptize in the river waters Him Who takes away the sins of the world, dry up the abyss of my evils with the streams of thy prayers, O blessed John the Forerunner.[^4265]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having seen the Holy Spirit, thou didst hear the Father's voice bearing witness, O Forerunner, unto Jesus Who was ineffably baptized by thee; pray Him to save us.[^4266]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: As thou art the wellspring of our renewal, renew me wholly who am crushed by the assaults of the serpent, that with faith and love I may bless thee, O Theotokos, all-immaculate Virgin.[^4267]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Then: My soul magnifies the Lord:*[^4268]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *He hath shown strength with His arm; for the God of Israel hath put down the mighty from their thrones, and exalted them of low degree; wherewith the Dayspring from on high hath visited us, and hath guided us into the way of peace.*[^4269]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Lo, the mystical bridal chamber is opened, and the wise, having adorned their lamps with the oil of virtues, enter in bright; cast off the sleep of despondency, O my soul, that thou mayest enter in with Christ, bearing a lamp.[^4270]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Even as the harlot I mentally hold fast Thy feet, and wash them with tears, O Word! Wash me, O Savior, from the mire of passions; cry out now unto me also: Thy faith hath saved thee, that I may sing of Thine innumerable tender mercy.[^4271]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* With a glad heart and joyful soul the martyrs dwell on high, ever having the wounds of Christ as the beauty of majesty; and they entreat peace for us, and deliverance from afflictions, and remission of transgressions.[^4272]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* Every place that possesses your relics, O divine sufferers, hath been sanctified, like another ark in Israel delivering from afflictions; the heavenly realms rejoice with the honorable angels, having acquired your souls, O blessed ones.[^4273]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: O goodness-loving Maiden, who didst bear the goodness-loving God, I cry unto thee: Make blessed my wretched soul, grievously afflicted by passions and the assaults of cunning demons, that with faith I may hymn thee, the hope of all.[^4274]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Eve indeed, through the disease of disobedience, brought in the curse; but thou, O Virgin Theotokos, through the blossoming of childbearing, didst bud forth blessing unto the world; therefore we all magnify thee.*[^4275]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* My strength and my song is Christ the Lord; pray Him, O blessed Forerunner, to strengthen me against passions and against all demonic assaults; and grant me to do His divine will, that with love I may ever bless thee.[^4276]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou wast shown to be a beautiful turtledove and sweet-speaking swallow, O divine Forerunner, proclaiming the divine Spring, Christ; pray Him to deliver me from soul-corrupting winter and the storm of sin, I pray thee.[^4277]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Leaping in thy mother's womb, thou didst proclaim Him Who shone forth from the Virgin; pray Him to put to death my fleshly motions that bring death unto me, and to fill my heart with joy, that I may hymn thee, O divine Forerunner.[^4278]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* The judgment is without mercy, O my soul, unto those that show no mercy; look and give ear: receive oil that enlightens thy lamp, and keep it unquenched; the Bridegroom draws near: watch, that thou mayest keep thy resolve unquenched.[^4279]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: Having borne the goodness-loving God, O goodness-loving Theotokos, pray Him to deliver me from all malice, and to make my heart yearn after Him, and to hate fleshly voluptuousness, that in hymns I may magnify thee.[^4280]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 4:*[^4281]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: I am a sheep of Thy rational flock, and unto Thee do I flee, O Good Shepherd: seek me who have gone astray, O God, and have mercy on me.[^4282]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad in all our days... And look upon Thy servants and upon the work of Thy hands, and guide their children.* [^4283]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: The storm of my transgressions holds me fast, O Savior, and unable to endure the surging, I fall down before Thee, the only Helmsman: stretch out unto me the hand of Thy love for mankind as unto Peter, and save me.[^4284]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and direct Thou the works of our hands over us; yea, the work of our hands do Thou direct.* [^4285]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: Ye became partakers with the angels, O holy martyrs, having courageously proclaimed Christ at the judgment-seat; for ye left behind all the fair things in the world as though they were not, and held fast the faith...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: ...as a firm hope. Therefore, having driven away delusion, ye pour forth the gifts of healings unto the faithful, praying unceasingly that our souls may be saved.[^4286]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: Preserve thy servants from all perils, O blessed Theotokos, that we may glorify thee, the hope of our souls.[^4287]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise to the Lord... Trisagion, and the rest.*[^4288]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy:*[^4289]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *The Beatitudes, Tone 4:*[^4290]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: By a tree was Adam exiled from Paradise, but by the tree of the Cross was the thief settled in Paradise; for the one, by tasting, rejected the commandment of Him Who made him; while the other, being crucified with Him, confessed the hidden God, crying out: Remember me in Thy kingdom.[^4291]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: O Word Who didst accept Peter's weeping and the harlot's tears, and Who didst show compassion unto the publican who only sighed, O Christ, as Thou art tender-hearted: have mercy on me also who fall down before Thee and ask forgiveness of transgressions, O all-good Lord, and deliver me from eternal torment.[^4292]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: O great Forerunner who didst loose the bonds of barrenness, loose the barrenness of my humble heart, and make it to bring forth virtuous deeds by thy mediation, whereby I may receive inexhaustible nourishment, crying unto Christ: Remember me, O Savior, when Thou comest in Thy kingdom.[^4293]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: Crushed by torments, given over as food to wild beasts, O wise ones, cruelly cut down, cast into the deep of the sea, burned with fire, and scraped with sharp instruments, O all-glorious martyrs, ye denied not God; ask of Him for us, O holy ones, peace and enlightenment, and great mercy.[^4294]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: The Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, all we the faithful like-mindedly pray to glorify worthily: the unity of the Godhead, existing in three Hypostases, abiding unconfused, simple, indivisible, and unapproachable; whereby we are delivered from fiery torment.[^4295]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: Him Who is co-unoriginate with the Father, and co-enthroned with the Holy Spirit, thou didst receive in thy womb, and didst bear Him beyond mind and word become man for the benefaction of mankind, O Mary, Bride of God, spacious dwelling-place of our God; fervently pray Him...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^4100]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: ...that thy servants may be saved.[^4296]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *On Tuesday Evening:*[^4298]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 4.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: Lifted up upon the Cross, pierced with a spear, and dipping Thy fingers in blood, O Master, Thou didst sign freedom for us, O All-good One! And tearing up the handwriting of Adam the forefather, Thou didst set free human nature. Therefore we hymn Thy goodness which transcends the mind, O Compassionate One.[^4300]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: We hymn Thy sufferings, O Master Jesus: the Cross, the spear and the reed, the sponge and the nails, the scourgings, the purple robe, and the crown of thorns, the spittings and mockings, which Thou didst endure willingly. I magnify Thy long-suffering, O guileless only Life-giver, and with faith I glorify Thee, O Lover of mankind.[^4301]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: I bow down before Thy precious Cross, O All-good One, kissing it with love, and I glorify Thy descent which transcends the mind, Thy immeasurable mercy, Thine ineffable compassions, and Thy rich goodness, for the sake whereof Thou didst save human nature which was held fast in the darkness of transgressions. Glory, O Christ, to Thy crucifixion.[^4302]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Most-holy Theotokos, Tone 4.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: When the Ewe-lamb and Thy Mother beheld Thee nailed upon the Cross, O Lord, she was amazed, crying aloud: What is this sight, O beloved Son? Doth the disobedient, lawless congregation repay Thee these things, having enjoyed Thy many miracles? But glory to Thine ineffable condescension, O Master.[^4304]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: When the Ewe-lamb who bore Thee saw Thee, the Lamb and Shepherd, upon the Tree, she wept and cried out unto Thee as a mother: O most-beloved Son, how art Thou lifted up upon the tree of the Cross, O Long-suffering One? How were Thy hands and feet nailed by the lawless, O Word, and Thou didst pour out Thy blood, O Master?[^4305]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: Seeing Thee hanging upon the Cross, O Lord, the Virgin and Thy Mother was amazed, and looking upon Thee, said: What have they repaid Thee, who enjoyed Thy many gifts, O Master? But I pray Thee: leave me not alone in the world, but hasten to rise again...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: ...raising the forefather together with Thyself.[^4306]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: Beholding Christ, the Lover of mankind, crucified, and His side pierced with a spear, the Most-pure One wept and cried aloud: What is this, O my Son? What have the ungrateful people repaid Thee for the good things which Thou didst do unto them? And Thou makest haste to leave me childless, O most beloved One! I marvel, O Tender-hearted One, at Thy voluntary crucifixion.[^4308]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 4:*[^4309]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: An invincible weapon hast Thou given us, O Christ: Thy Cross, and thereby we conquer the assaults of the adversary.[^4310]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: Ever having Thy Cross as help, O Christ, we easily trample down the snares of the enemy.[^4312]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us, for we are utterly filled with contempt; our soul is exceedingly filled with the reproach of the prosperous, and with the contempt of the proud.* [^4313]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: Having boldness toward the Savior, O holy ones, pray unceasingly for us sinners, asking remission of transgressions and great mercy for our souls.[^4314]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: Weep not for Me, O Mother, beholding hanging upon the Tree Thy Son and God, Who hung the earth unconstrained upon the waters, and created all creation; for I shall arise and be glorified, and shall crush the realms of Hades with might, and shall destroy his power, and deliver the bound from his malice, as I am tender-hearted, and bring them unto My Father, as I am the Lover of mankind.[^4316]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *On Tuesday at Compline:*[^4317]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most-holy Theotokos, Tone 4.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *I shall open my mouth, and it will be filled with the Spirit, and I will utter a word unto the Queen Mother, and I shall appear brightly keeping festival, and I shall sing rejoicing in her wonders.*[^4318]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most-holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^4319]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пꙋсты́ню всели́выйсѧ непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ, ѡ҆пꙋстѣ́вшїй всѧ́кими престꙋпле́ньми оу҆́мъ мо́й, бж҃е́ственными моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆бновѝ Предте́че.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having borne the immeasurable Wisdom and Power of God, O All-immaculate One...[^4320]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Въ Вто́рникъ на Повече́ріи, Гла́съ д҃.
items.english_text: ...Christ in the flesh without seed, thou hast acquired dominion of strength and divine majesty through thy childbearing, O Theotokos.[^4321]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇та̀ безъ сѣ́мене пло́тїю, держа́вꙋ крѣ́пости, и҆ бж҃твенное вели́чїе стѧжа́ла є҆сѝ, рождество́мъ твои́мъ Бг҃ороди́тельнице.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O childbearing of thine, beyond all understanding, O Most-pure One, whereby the multitude of earthborn men was enriched with incorruption, and now duly blesses thee, the Mediatress of renewal.[^4322]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Ѽ па́че ᲂу҆ма̀ ржⷭ҇тва̀ твоегѡ̀, Пречи́стаѧ! и҆́мже ѡ҆богати́сѧ земны́хъ мно́жество нетлѣ́нїемъ, и҆ тѧ̀ ны́нѣ блажи́тъ досто́йнѡ, хода́таицꙋ ѡ҆бновле́нїѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Heal thy servant who is sick in soul and body, O Virgin, by thine overshadowing; for I know thee as the protectress of all that are in sorrow, as thou didst bear our salvation.[^4323]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Болѧ́щаго и҆сцѣлѝ дꙋше́ю и҆ тѣ́ломъ Дѣ́во, раба̀ твоего̀, ѡ҆сѣне́нїемъ твои́мъ; тѧ́ бо предста́тельницꙋ всѣ̑мъ сꙋ́щымъ въ печа́ли позна́хъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ро́ждшꙋю спасе́нїе на́ше.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Cruelly engulfed in the deep of sorrows and by the tempest of immeasurable tribulations, stretch forth to me the hand of salvation, and lead me forth from the depth of evils, O Lady.[^4324]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Лю́тѣ погрꙋжа́емꙋ въ пꙋчи́нѣ скорбе́й, и҆ бꙋ́рею безмѣ́рныхъ ѡ҆бстоѧ́нїй, спасе́нїа просте́рши мнѣ̀ рꙋ́кꙋ, и҆зведѝ Влⷣчце и҆зъ глꙋбины̀ ѕѡ́лъ.
items.english_text: *O Theotokos, thou living and plentiful fountain: spiritually establish those united as a choir who sing thy praises; and in thy divine glory, vouchsafe unto them crowns of glory.*[^4325]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Твоѧ̑ пѣсносло́вцы Бцⷣе, живы́й и҆ незави́стный и҆сто́чниче, ли́къ себѣ̀ совокꙋ́пльшїѧ дꙋхо́внѡ, ᲂу҆твердѝ, въ боже́ственнѣй твое́й сла́вѣ, вѣнце́въ сла́вы сподо́би.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou sprinklest streams of healings everywhere upon the sick, O Virgin; for the Lord of mercy, Who was born of thee beyond all understanding, showed thee forth, O Lady, as a fountain of tender-heartedness.[^4326]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Кропи́ши и҆сцѣле́нїй стрꙋѝ болѧ́щымъ Дѣ́во всю́дꙋ; тѧ́ бо и҆сто́чника показа̀ милосе́рдїѧ Влⷣчце, и҆́же ми́лости Гдⷭ҇ь, и҆зъ тебѐ рожде́йсѧ па́че ᲂу҆ма̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* A fair bridal-chamber for the divine Word, and a divine bridal room beyond nature didst thou become, O Virgin Mother; therefore open unto me the mercies of thy compassions, leading me up unto salvation.[^4327]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Красе́нъ черто́гъ бж҃твенномꙋ Сло́вꙋ, и҆ бж҃твенный невѣ́стникъ вы́ше є҆стества̀, Дѣ́во Ма́ти была̀ є҆сѝ; тѣ́мже ми́лѡсти твои́хъ щедро́тъ ѿве́рзи мнѣ̀, къ спасе́нїю возводѧ́щи.
items.english_text: *Glory:* All my strength is slain by the multitude of immeasurable evils; by many sorrows indeed have I despaired. Help me, O Lady, who didst bear Life, and Who art consolation to them that weep.[^4328]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́сѧ всѧ̀ крѣ́пость моѧ̀, ѿ мно́жества безмѣ́рныхъ ѕѡ́лъ; мно́гими ᲂу҆́бѡ скорбмѝ ѿча́ѧхсѧ. Помозѝ мнѣ̀ Гп҃же́, ꙗ҆́же жи́знь ро́ждшаѧ, и҆ пла́чꙋщымъ ᲂу҆тѣше́нїе.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Have mercy, O only Mother of God, have mercy, and have compassion on my wretched soul which is drowned by crafty demons and passions; and before the time of my death, have compassion to cleanse it.[^4329]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Поми́лꙋй є҆ди́на Бг҃ома́ти, поми́лꙋй, и҆ ᲂу҆ще́дри дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ ѻ҆каѧ́ннꙋю, потоплѧ́емꙋ бѣ́сы лꙋка́выми и҆ страстьмѝ; и҆ пре́жде вре́мене сме́рти моеѧ̀, сїю̀ ѡ҆чи́стити ᲂу҆милосе́рдисѧ.
items.english_text: *Perceiving the unsearchable divine counsel of Thine incarnation from a Virgin, O Thou Most High, the Prophet Habakkuk cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!*[^4330]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Неизслѣ́дный Бж҃їй совѣ́тъ, є҆́же ѿ Дѣ́вы воплоще́нїа тебѐ Вы́шнѧгѡ, проро́къ А҆ввакꙋ́мъ ᲂу҆смотрѧ́ѧ, зова́ше: Сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Desiring thee as one who was of royal root and loins, the King of all made thee higher than the Cherubim and Seraphim, having wholly taken up His abode within thee, O Theotokos.[^4331]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Ко́рене и҆ чре́слъ тѧ̀ ца́рскихъ, всѣ́хъ Ца́рь, ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́щꙋ, вожделѣ́въ, вы́шшꙋ Херꙋвї̑мъ и҆ Серафї̑мъ содѣ́ла, ве́сь Бцⷣе все́лсѧ въ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* For the sake of the human generation, the Creator, becoming incarnate, was born of thee, and showed thee forth as the unerring protectress...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: ...of Christians. Therefore unto thy protection do I flee, O Pure One.[^4332]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Be thou protection, and defense, and refuge unto me thy servant, O Virgin, and heal me from immeasurable evils, that I may sing, O Most-pure One: Glory to thine ineffable childbearing![^4333]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Both now:* I am perplexed, and I weep, and I groan because of my impassioned thoughts, and I pray thee: as thou art the fountain of mercy, deliver me from my sicknesses, leading me unto divine compunction.[^4334]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *All things were amazed at thy divine glory; for thou, O Virgin who knewest not wedlock, didst hold in thy womb the God over all, and didst give birth to the timeless Son, Who grants peace unto all that hymn thee.*[^4335]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou pourest forth waters of healings ever, O Virgin, unto all that are sick, as thou art an animate cloud of Christ the King. Therefore I fervently pray thee: send down the dew of healing unto me who am sick.[^4336]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Cease not to pray Him Whom thou didst bear, O Bride of God, Virgin, as Savior and Master, to grant me release from sorrows and sicknesses; and lead me up unto incorruptible joy, forgiving me my transgressions.[^4337]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Thou art my hope, O Most-pure One, and the boast of salvation. Therefore I flee unto thy protection: abhor me not, who am now swallowed up by many sins and sorrowful sicknesses, but anticipate and save me.[^4338]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Both now:* O ripe cluster of grapes, how dost Thou hang upon the Tree? O Sun of glory, how hast Thou been lifted up, Who didst darken the sun's light in Thy Passion, O Savior? The Ewe-lamb who bore Thee cried of old unto Thee, weeping aloud as a mother.[^4339]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *I have entered into the depths of the sea, and the tempest of many sins hath overwhelmed me; but as God, lead up my life from the abyss, O Many-merciful One.*[^4340]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The King of all and our God took upon Himself the form of a servant from thee, O Virgin, and showed thee forth as the Theotokos higher than the Cherubim and the dread Seraphim.[^4341]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O thou who alone didst bear the divine Life and Him Who gives salvation unto all: vouchsafe salvation unto me who am in despair, and cut down the insurrection of my passions.[^4342]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Grant thy help, and deliver me from perils and sorrows, freeing me from misfortunes and my transgressions, O thou who didst bear the Redemption of all.[^4343]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Both now:* In thee, O Virgin, do we boast, and through thee are we delivered from grievous things; hoping in thee, we who sing to thee fear not the assaults of wicked barbarians.[^4344]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Then, Lord, have mercy, thrice. Glory... Both now...*[^4345]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: O Virgin all-immaculate, Mother of Christ God, a sword passed through thy most-holy soul when thou beheldest Thy Son and God crucified of His own will. Cease not to pray Him, O Most-blessed One, to grant us the remission of transgressions.[^4346]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *The godly-minded children worshipped not creation rather than the Creator, but having manly trampled upon the threat of fire, they rejoiced, singing: Blessed art Thou, O all-hymned Lord and God of our fathers!*[^4347]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* All my strength is dried up like a potsherd through the passions, and lo, I have drawn near unto Hades and its all-destructive bonds; anticipate me, O Mother of God, and snatch me from the sorrows that encompass me by the hand of thy mercy.[^4348]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* While my inner heart is torn asunder by manifold evils, and my living is rent apart by the multitude of my transgressions and sicknesses, yet deliver me from both, O Most-pure One, who didst bear Life unto us.[^4349]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Vouchsafe, as thou art good, O most-pure Virgin, to open unto me the gates of the kingdom of Christ the all-merciful King; and deliver me from soul-corrupting sicknesses and assaults, by thy prayers, O blessed one.[^4350]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Both now:* The aggravated sicknesses of my wounds from my boundless transgressions lead unto soul and bodily death; but snatch me away, O Lady, as thou art mighty, from all sorrows and diseases.[^4351]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *The childbearing of the Theotokos saved the pious youths in the furnace: then prefigured, but now in act, it rouses all the world to sing unto Thee: Hymn the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him above all unto all ages.*[^4352]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having acquired a furnace of thorn-bearing passions, I am pierced by their stings; therefore have I despaired, being choked by bonds and...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: ...misfortunes, O most-pure Mother of Christ God! Delivering me from them, grant me the forgiveness of all transgressions, by thy prayers.[^4353]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Being the lampstand of the thrice-radiant Light, take away the darkness of my transgressions by the beam of thy tender-heartedness, O Theotokos, granting deliverance from distressing sicknesses unto me who hymn in faith and exalt above all thy most-pure childbearing.[^4354]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Wholly dwelling in thy womb, the transcendent God was ineffably incarnate, O Ever-virgin, having made thee the protector and universal help of the world; therefore I pray thee to deliver me from my cruel passions and the bonds of transgressions.[^4355]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Both now:* In the hour of my end, O Virgin, snatch me away from demonic hands, and condemnation, and reckoning, and the dread examination, and the bitter toll-houses, and the cruel prince, and the eternal fire, O Mother of God.[^4356]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Let every earthborn mortal leap for joy in spirit, being enlightened, and let the nature of the bodiless minds celebrate, honoring the sacred festival of the Mother of God, and let it cry aloud: Rejoice, O all-blessed Theotokos, pure Ever-virgin!*[^4357]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The earthly race was exalted by thy childbearing, having received adoption as sons through the divine union; and the heavenly multitude rejoices together with earthly men, duly hymning thee, O Pure One, as being the Mother of our God, and the refuge of all the world.[^4358]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having become wholly bound by my sins from immeasurable wounds and sicknesses, I call upon thy help and defense, O Lady; grant it, delivering me from all cruel perils and sorrows.[^4359]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Singing with a song and weaving praises from a suffering soul do I now offer with love unto thee who naturally didst give birth to Christ God; having found Him propitious, and having fulfilled all my petitions, O Theotokos, preserve me by thy prayers.[^4360]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Enlighten the eyes of my soul, O pure Theotokos, lest grievous sinful darkness overtake me, nor the abyss of despair cover me; but do thou thyself save me, and pilot me, O unashamed protectress of the faithful.[^4361]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *It is truly meet... and a prostration. Trisagion. And after Our Father... the troparia, and the rest as usual, and the Dismissal.*[^4362]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *After the first stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 4:*[^4363]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: Thou hast redeemed us from the curse of the law by Thy precious Blood; being nailed to the Cross and pierced with a spear, Thou didst pour forth immortality unto mankind; O our Savior, glory to Thee.[^4364]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: The Jews nailed Thee to the Cross, O Savior, whereby Thou didst call us from among the nations, O Christ our God; Thou didst stretch out Thy palms upon it of Thine own will, and didst accept to be pierced in Thy ribs with a spear through the multitude of Thy compassions, O only Lover of mankind.[^4366]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: Thy unwedded Mother, O Christ, when she beheld Thee lifted up upon the Cross, weeping as a mother, spoke such words: What is this new and strange wonder, O my Son? How does the lawless assembly nail Thee to the Cross, the Life-giver of all, O my sweetest Light?[^4367]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *After the second stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4:*[^4368]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: Speedily anticipate, before we be enslaved to the enemies that blaspheme Thee and threaten us, O Christ our God! Destroy by Thy Cross those who war against us, that they may understand how powerful is the faith of the Orthodox, through the prayers of the Theotokos, O only Lover of mankind.[^4369]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: Nailed to the Cross upon Golgotha of Thine own will, Thou didst heal my ancient sinful wound, O Master, for the sake of Thy great goodness; for Thou didst lay down Thyself willingly, O our Savior Lover of mankind, for the human race, and didst drop blood and water from Thy ribs for them that hymn Thee with faith.[^4371]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* Having contended well by the power of the Cross, ye cast down the adversary enemy with might by your...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: ...endurance, O holy passion-bearers! Therefore, faithfully keeping your venerable memory, we are sanctified by the operation and grace of the all-holy Spirit; by your prayers, O sacred warriors of Christ, pray unto the Savior for the world.[^4373]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: Beholding upon the Cross the Lamb born of her without seed, and pierced with a spear, the Virgin and Ewe-lamb, wounded with the arrows of grief, cried aloud, painfully exclaiming: What is this new mystery? How dost Thou die, Who art the only Lord of life? Therefore arise, raising up the fallen forefather together with Thyself.[^4374]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *After the third stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4:*[^4375]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: When I fell grievously in Paradise by the bitter counsel of the murderer of man, Thou didst raise me up again upon the Place of the Skull, O Christ, healing by the Tree the curse from the tree, having slain the serpent that by deceit had put me to death, and Thou didst grant me divine life. Glory to Thy divine crucifixion, O Lord![^4376]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: Perceiving Thee, the Sun of righteousness, hanging upon the Tree, O Christ, the sun darkened its light, and creation was shaken, and the dead speedily arose from the graves as if from sleep, O Word, singing the praises of the divine dominion of Thy glory.[^4377]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: O Virgin all-immaculate, Mother of Christ God, a sword passed through thy most-holy soul when thou beheldest Thy Son and God crucified of His own will. Cease not to pray Him, O Most-blessed One, to grant us the remission of transgressions.[^4378]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Canon to the Precious and Life-Giving Cross, and to the Holy Martyrs.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: The Cross is a weapon unto salvation.) A composition of Joseph.*[^4379]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Traversing with dry feet the deep of the Red Sea, ancient Israel conquered the power of Amalek in the wilderness through Moses' hands held in the form of a cross.*[^4380]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and crucifixion.*[^4381]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having stretched out the heaven, Thou didst spread out Thy palms, O Jesus, calling brightly unto Thyself the nations that were far from Thee, as Thou art good and tender-hearted.[^4382]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Surround me with Thy Cross, O Christ my Word, that I may not become a prey unto the wolf that seeks my perdition and daily prepares snares and traps for me.[^4383]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* By your sufferings, O martyrs, ye cast down the author of all sufferings, and ye have now inherited a life without suffering, and all...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: ...manner of sickness do ye ever lighten from our souls and bodies, O blessed ones.[^4384]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* With indissoluble bonds, O holy ones, ye bound the one of many wiles, being bound for the sake of Christ, O wise ones, Who was bound of His own will and destroyed all delusion; therefore are ye worthily blessed.[^4385]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A Virgin didst thou remain after childbirth, for thou didst give birth unto God, O Most-pure One, Who was lifted up upon the Cross and raised up the earthborn together with Himself. Therefore do all we the faithful magnify thee with loud voice.[^4386]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Most-holy Theotokos.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: Unto the Virgin Theotokos I offer supplication.)*[^4387]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Tone 4, Ode 1. The Heirmos is the same.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As thou art purer than all creation, O Most-pure One, cleanse by thy pure prayer my heart which is grievously defiled with impure passions, O Theotokos. (Twice)[^4388]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Deliver me from the tears and groanings that lie before me at the dread future judgment, O most-pure Virgin Mother, by thy God-acceptable prayers unto the Creator and our God.[^4389]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O thou who alone didst free the human race from the curse beyond all understanding by thy childbearing, free me who am enslaved to the fleshly passions by thy supplications, O Most-pure One.[^4390]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Thy Church rejoices in Thee, O Christ, crying aloud: Thou art my strength, O Lord, and refuge, and confirmation.*[^4391]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being lifted up upon the Cross, Thou didst raise up those cast down into corruption, O Christ our God, and didst cast down the enemy, O Master.[^4392]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The enemy's swords became blunt when Thou wast pierced in the ribs, O hypostatic Word of the Father, and Eden was opened.[^4393]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* By rivers of fire the martyrs tamed the rivers of delusion, and quenched the flame of polytheism.[^4394]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* Crucified and scraped with claws, O martyrs of Christ, ye slaughtered the enemies and the serpent with the sword of endurance.[^4395]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beholding Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Master, the immaculate Ewe-lamb, sorrowfully weeping, sang the praises of Thy dominion.[^4396]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *We boast not in wisdom, nor in power, nor in riches, but in Thee, the hypostatic Wisdom of the Father, O Christ; for there is none holy save Thee, O Lover of mankind.*[^4397]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Lady higher than the Cherubim, I pray thee: show my mind, which hath fallen down through the assaults of the serpent, higher than the bodily passions. (Twice)[^4398]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In the dread trial, when the Lord shall judge me who have sinned greatly, may I find thee, O All-immaculate One, delivering me from condemnation.[^4399]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* By Thy compassions change my unmerciful ways, and by Thy mercy, O Christ, save me who am unmerciful, through the supplications of her that bore Thee.[^4400]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Beholding Thee, the Sun of righteousness, lifted up upon the Cross, the Church stood in her station, duly crying aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!*[^4401]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Seeing Thee, the Sun of glory, lifted up upon the Tree of Thine own will, the sun clothed itself in darkness, and the rocks were split, and the veil of the temple was rent in twain.[^4402]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When Thou wast crucified, O Savior, and pierced with a spear, the flaming sword gave back by Thy command, O Lord, unto the wise thief who sang the praise of Thy dominion.[^4403]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Fenced about with the weapon of Thy Cross, Thy passion-bearers, O Lord, were shown unwounded by the arrow of malice, and threw down the unstable walls of idol-madness.[^4404]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* As whole, blameless consecrations, sacrifices, and whole-burnt offerings, O martyrs, were ye brought unto the Lord Who became poor for mercy's sake, receiving recompense for your sufferings.[^4405]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* She who in time gave birth to the Timeless One, and who alone kept her virginity undefiled, when she beheld the Lord lifted up upon the Tree, rent her soul with sorrows.[^4406]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], The Heirmos is the same:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being the divine house of sanctification of Him Who emptied Himself for the benefaction of His creation, O Most-pure One, sanctify my soul and enlighten my thoughts. (Twice)[^4407]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* My mind is tossed about by the wind of malice, and by slothfulness...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: ...is wholly submerged; establish it by thy prayers, O Lady, and snatch it from assaults.[^4408]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O animate heavenly palace of the King, now do I pray thee, O Virgin: by thy prayers show me forth as a house of the Holy Trinity, who have become a den of robbers.[^4409]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Thou, O Lord, art my light, a holy light which is come into the world, turning those who hymn Thee in faith away from the darkness of ignorance.*[^4410]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By Thy pierced ribs, Thou pourest forth divine streams of incorruption unto me, O Master, who through the transgression of the rib slipped into captivity.[^4411]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thy precious Cross is victory over enemies, which Thou hast given unto us, O Word, for the salvation of the souls of them that hymn Thee with faith.[^4412]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Mortals are now joined together with fiery ministers, having passed through the material fire of great torments, as most-radiant martyrs.[^4413]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* Though the flesh was broken down by many sufferings, the unbroken soul's love of the martyrs toward the Creator was firmly established.[^4414]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who alone is good, having entered into thy incorruptible womb, O Most-pure One, was manifested becoming incarnate and was crucified, that He might deliver us from corruption.[^4415]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *The ungodly shall not see Thy glory, O Christ, but we, rising early from the night, hymn Thee, O Only-begotten One, the radiance of the Father's glory of the Godhead, O Lover of mankind.*[^4416]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Ewe-lamb who didst bear the Lamb of God, seek out my soul that was seduced by the assault of the serpent and wanders, O Lady, upon the mountains of transgression.[^4417]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By thy fervent prayer, piously arouse my soul that is frozen with bitter frost unto the warmth of the Creator's divine love, O Theotokos Ever-virgin.[^4418]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O thou who art fair and blameless among women, O Pure One, now free my wretched soul from passionate blemish, and order my steps that I may live purely by thy prayers.[^4419]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Preserve my soul as the apple of an eye under the shelter of thy wings, O good and Most-pure One! And deliver me from the spirits of malice, oppression, and torment.[^4420]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *I will sacrifice unto Thee with the voice of praise, O Lord, the Church cries out unto Thee, having been cleansed from the blood of demons by the Blood which flowed for mercy's sake from Thy ribs.*[^4421]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being above all honor, Thou didst endure to be dishonored, that Thou mightest honor me who was evilly dishonored, and save me by the Cross, O Lover of mankind.[^4422]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When lifted up upon the Tree, Thou wast indeed dead, O Lord, but Thou didst render the slayer of my soul dead and filled with all manner of shame; and now, O my Creator, I sing of Thy power.[^4423]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* The all-wicked one who wounded you was himself wounded with incurable torments, and by your feet, O martyrs, was he cast down, and is seen mocked by all.[^4424]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* The dust of the martyrs' relics lying in the tomb pours forth healings, and crushes demons like dust, and heals diverse sicknesses of men.[^4425]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The gathering of the transgressors nailed Thee with nails upon the Cross, and with the sword of sorrow I now rend my heart, O my Son! the Virgin cried, weeping.[^4426]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], The Heirmos is the same:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thy childbearing became the destroyer of death, O Virgin, and life and redemption unto the dying. For the sake of this I pray thee: raise up my slain soul.[^4427]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Stretch forth unto me a hand of help, O Lover of mankind, who am storm-tossed in the surge of life, through the supplications of Thy Mother and of the innumerable powers on high.[^4428]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O field that brought forth the divine ear of grain, despise not my weakened soul that faints with hunger for divine deeds, but nourish it with the divine grace of thy Son.[^4429]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4297]
items.slavonic_text: Человѣ́ческагѡ ра́ди порожде́нїа Содѣ́тель воплоща́емь, и҆зъ тебѐ роди́сѧ, и҆ предста́тельни-
