items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *On Friday at Matins, Tone 4.*[^4724]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 4:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: Thou hast redeemed us from the curse of the law by Thy precious Blood; nailed to the Cross and pierced with a spear, Thou hast poured forth immortality unto men: O our Savior, glory to Thee![^4725]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: The Judeans nailed Thee to the Cross, O Savior, through which Thou didst formerly call us from the gentiles, O Christ our God; Thou didst stretch forth Thy palms upon it of Thine own will, and in the multitude of Thy compassions wast pleased to be pierced with a spear in Thy ribs, O Lover of mankind.[^4727]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: O all-immaculate Virgin, Mother of Christ God, a sword passed through thy most-holy soul when thou beheldest Thy Son and God crucified of His own will; cease not to pray Him, O Blessed One, to grant us the forgiveness of transgressions.[^4728]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: Speedily anticipate, before we are enslaved unto the enemies that blaspheme Thee and threaten us, O Christ our God. Destroy by Thy Cross those that war against us, that they may understand how mighty is the faith of the Orthodox, through the prayers of the Theotokos, O only Lover of mankind.[^4729]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: When Thy divine side was pierced with a spear, O Master, the weapons of the invisible enemy failed utterly, and all the violence of his malice ceased. Therefore do we venerate Thy saving Passions, glorifying Thy divine dispensation.[^4731]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* Today the angelic hosts came unto the memorial of the passion-bearers, to enlighten the minds of the faithful...[^4733]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: ...and to make clear the universe by grace. Being entreated for their sake, O God, grant us great mercy.[^4734]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: When Thy most-pure Mother beheld Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Word of God, weeping maternally she said: What is this new and strange wonder, O my Son? How dost Thou, the Life of all, taste of death, desiring to make alive those that are dead, as Thou art tender-hearted?[^4735]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: Thou didst willingly endure the Cross and death for us, O Good One, in Thine immeasurable mercy, and an unjust judgment, that Thou mightest free all from condemnation and the ancient curse who through delusion had fallen into corruption. Therefore do we also venerate Thy crucifixion, O Word.[^4736]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: Beholding Thee, Christ the Sun of righteousness, hanging upon the Tree, the sun darkened its light, and creation was convulsed, and the dead quickly arose from the tombs as from sleep, O Word, singing of Thy divine dominion.[^4737]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: Thy spotless Mother, O Christ, when she beheld Thee lifted up upon the Cross, weeping maternally, spoke in this wise: What is this new and strange wonder, O my Son? How doth the lawless assembly nail Thee to the Cross, O Life of all, my sweetest Light?[^4738]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Precious Cross, whose acrostic is: Nailed to the Cross, Christ destroys delusion. The creation of Joseph, Tone 4.*[^4739]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *I will open my mouth, and it will be filled with the Spirit, and I will utter a word unto the Queen Mother, and I will appear radiantly celebrating, and rejoicing I will sing of her wonders.*[^4740]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Crucifixion.*[^4741]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst spread out Thy divine palms upon the Cross, O Long-suffering One, and didst call the perishing world unto the knowledge of Thy dominion, O Compassionate One! Therefore do we magnify Thy tender mercy.[^4742]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Moses lifted up the serpent, prefiguring Thy divine crucifixion, O pre-eternal Word, whereby the venomous serpent fell, who had been the mediator of Adam's fall.[^4743]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Ye were vouchsafed to live now in the brightness of the saints, O Martyrs, having manifestly received an unshakable kingdom, as Paul said, and ye became partakers of Christ's glory.[^4744]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* By the surging waves of your intolerable torments, the ship was kept from sinking, O Martyrs! For by the piloting of the King...[^4745]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: ...of all, ye reached the haven of rest.[^4746]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* A sword passed through thy heart, as Simeon said, when thou beheldest Christ crucified, O Virgin Lady, and Him pierced with a spear; therefore weeping didst thou endure pangs.[^4747]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Most-holy Theotokos, Tone 4.*[^4748]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou alone art protection, and refuge, and guardian unto thy servants, O pure Mother of God; therefore falling down we cry unto thee: Save us, O Lady, by thy tender mercy.[^4749]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Sanctify my defiled heart, O Lady, who didst bear the most-holy Word, and art more holy than all the celestial powers, O all-immaculate Maiden.[^4750]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou art the restoration of the fallen and the confirmation of them that stand, O All-immaculate One! Therefore I pray thee: set upright my mind fallen through sin, O Lady, that I may glorify thee.[^4751]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* As I lie dead and inactive through sorrows, stretch forth the hand of thy help, raise me up, and show me forth full of divine gladness, O Mother of God.[^4752]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *O Theotokos, living and plentiful fountain: spiritually establish those united as a choir who sing thy praises; and in thy divine glory, vouchsafe unto them crowns of glory.*[^4753]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As a sheep to the slaughter, the most lawless people led Thee, O Christ, Who art the Lamb of God, and wast willing to deliver from the fierce wolf the sheep whom Thou didst love in Thy love for mankind.[^4754]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst stand before the judge, judged unjustly, Who judgest all the earth righteously, and didst endure a blow on the cheek, desiring to free me, O Lord, who was enslaved unto the evil ruler of the world.[^4755]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Having suffered lawfully, O Holy Ones, ye put to shame the lawless enemies; and willingly put to death for the resurrection of all, ye subjugated the serpent who was the mediator of death.[^4756]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* Having been lifted up from earthly things, and having passed over unto blessed glory through suffering, O holy Martyrs, being material ye were united unto the immaterial ranks, being filled with ineffable joy.[^4757]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* From thee, O Virgin, the renewal of Eve truly appeared: God born in the flesh, and lifted up upon the Cross, casting down demons, O Lady full of divine grace.[^4758]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Have mercy, O most-pure Virgin, upon me who am sorely drowned in the abyss of life, and direct me unto the calm haven of salvation; for thee alone have I acquired as hope.[^4759]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Dispel the darkness of my mind, O Theotokos, with the light that is in thee, as thou art good, I pray thee, and establish me in images of repentance, as thou art compassionate and many-merciful, that being saved I may call thee blessed.[^4760]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* By the sprinkling of thy mercy, O Virgin full of divine grace, quench the coals of my passions; and rekindle the extinguished lamp of my heart, O golden candlestick, all-immaculate one.[^4761]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Visit my wretched soul, grievously sick with passions, O Mother of God, as thou art merciful, and save me by thy prayers, that having obtained a better life, I may magnify thee.[^4762]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Perceiving the unsearchable divine counsel of Thine incarnation from a Virgin, O Thou Most High, the Prophet Habakkuk cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!*[^4763]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* That Thou mightest release me from the bonds of sin, O Lover of mankind, Thou wast bound of Thine own will, and didst die upon the Cross like a malefactor. Glory to Thine abundant compassion![^4764]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst endure wounds, O Word of God, and an ignominious death, making immortal the nature of earthly beings mortified by passions. Glory to Thine abundant compassion![^4765]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Desiring to inherit the joy of God in the All-holy Spirit, with joyful soul the Martyrs endured wounds and violent death, and wounded the evil one.[^4766]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* Having your hands cut off, and heads, and your theological tongues severed, and eyes deprived of light, and being hewn into limbs, O Martyrs, ye remained unsevered from God.[^4767]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими коле́блемаго прило́ги, и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели гони́маго, ꙋ҆ще́дри Влдко, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́ мя на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, и҆ вражде́бныя совѣ́ты разрꙋши́вши, сподо́би мя̀ твори́ти повелѣ̑нїя Сы́на твоегѡ̀ и҆ Бг҃а на́шегѡ,
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* The handwriting of Adam is rent asunder when Thou wast pierced with a spear, O Master, the Theotokos cried aloud, standing by the Cross, O Lord, and sorrowfully exclaiming.[^4768]\n

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Всенепоро́чная Ма́ти Бж҃іа, возсіѧ́й мнѣ̀ покаѧ́ніѧ зарю̀, разрѣшѝ мра́къ ѻ҆каѧ́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ, и҆ лꙋка́ваѧ помышле́ніѧ се́рдца моегѡ̀ ѿженѝ, Дв҃о.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O all-immaculate Mother of God, shine forth upon me the dawn of repentance, dispel the darkness of my wretched soul, and drive away the wicked thoughts of my heart, O Virgin.[^4769]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же благопремѣ́ннаго и҆ благоꙋвѣ́тливаго, пречи́стаѧ Влады́кꙋ ро́ждшаѧ, Дѣвома́ти, ꙗ҆́кѡ блага́ѧ, ѡ҆ на́съ того̀ молѝ всегда̀, ѿ чꙋжда́гѡ и҆зба́вити на́съ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having given birth unto the Master Who is easily reconciled and compassionate, O all-pure Virgin Mother, as thou art good, pray Him always for us, to deliver us from the stranger.[^4770]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Тѧ̀ ѡ҆чисти́лище всѣ́хъ человѣ́кѡвъ, вѣ́рою молю̀ и҆ прошꙋ̀, Благослове́ннаѧ! ми́лостива мнѣ̀ сꙋді́ю Сы́на твоего̀ сотворѝ, ꙗ҆́ко да въ хвале́ніи сла́влю тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* As the propitiation of all men, with faith I beseech and entreat thee, O Blessed One: make Thy Son a merciful Judge unto me, that in praise I may glorify thee.[^4771]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: И҆мѣ́ѧ тѧ̀, Пречи́стаѧ, помо́щницꙋ всегда̀, никогѡ̀ оу҆бою́сѧ, нижѐ оу҆страшꙋ́сѧ. Кто́ же ли хотѧ̀ скѡ́рбнаѧ принестѝ рабꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀, и҆ не оу҆страши́тсѧ?
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having thee, O All-Pure One, as helper always, I will fear no one, nor will I be afraid. For who, desiring to bring afflictions upon thy servant, will not be afraid?[^4772]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆жасо́шасѧ всѧ́ческаѧ ѡ҆ боже́ственнѣй сла́вѣ твое́й; ты́ бо неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ Дв҃о, и҆мѣ́ла є҆сѝ въ оу҆тро́бѣ надъ всѣ́ми Бг҃а, и҆ родила́ є҆сѝ безлѣ́тнаго Сы́на, всѣ́мъ воспѣва́ющимъ тѧ̀, ми́ръ подава́юща.
items.english_text: *All things were amazed at thy divine glory; for thou, O Virgin who knewest not wedlock, didst hold in thy womb the God Who is over all, and didst bear the timeless Son, granting peace unto all who praise thee.*[^4773]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Ви́дѣвши тѧ̀ Со́лнца на крестѣ̀ простира́ема, со́лнце скры̀ лꙋчѝ, сіѧ́ти немогꙋ́щее, тебѣ̀ Спа́се заше́дшꙋ, и҆ просвѣща́ющꙋ и҆̀же въ нощѝ пре́лести спѧ́щыѧ, покланѧ́ющыѧсѧ держа́вѣ твое́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Beholding Thee, the Sun, stretched out upon the Cross, the sun hid its rays, unable to shine when Thou, O Savior, didst set, and didst enlighten those sleeping in the night of delusion, who worship Thy dominion.[^4774]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Распина́емь за милосе́рдіе Гдⷭ҇и, спаса́еши мѧ̀, ѻ҆́цта и҆ же́лчи пріе́млеши вкꙋше́ніе, сла́стнагѡ и҆збавлѧ́ѧ на́съ вкꙋше́ніѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ бла́гъ, и҆́мже прельсти́хомсѧ, и҆ тлѝ подпадо́хомъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Being crucified in Thy tender mercy, O Lord, Thou savest me, and acceptest the tasting of vinegar and gall, delivering us, as Thou art good, from the tasting of pleasure, whereby we were deceived and fell under corruption.[^4775]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Пре́лести разори́сте зи́мꙋ, бж҃е́ственніи Мч҃еници, Дх҃а ст҃а́гѡ теплото́ю, и҆ къ веснѣ̀ поко́ѧ ра́дꙋющесѧ дондо́сте кꙋ́пнѡ, всѣ̑мъ помога́юще сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ.
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Ye destroyed the winter of delusion, O divine Martyrs, by the warmth of the Holy Spirit, and rejoicing ye came together unto the spring of rest, helping all who are in afflictions.[^4776]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Тꙋ́чами бж҃е́ственныѧ кро́ве, зе́млю всю̀ напои́сте, и҆зсꙋша́юще пото́ки безбо́жіѧ, ст҃і́и Мч҃еници! тѣ́мже къ водѣ̀ живо́тнѣй ны́нѣ всели́стесѧ, ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ молѧ́щесѧ.
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* With showers of divine blood ye watered all the earth, drying up the torrents of godlessness, O holy Martyrs! Therefore are ye now settled by the water of life, praying for all.[^4777]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Пло́тію є҆го́же родила̀ Сы́на Бгора́дованнаѧ, ꙗ҆́ко ви́дѣ на дре́вѣ возвы́шена, пла́чемъ и҆спо́лнися, и҆ долготерпѣ́нію є҆гѡ̀ дивлѧ́шеся вои́стинꙋ; тѣ́мже велича́ше є҆гѡ̀ снизхожде́ніе.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* When She who was graced of God beheld Her Son, Whom She had borne in the flesh, lifted up upon the Tree, She was filled with weeping, and truly marveled at His longsuffering; therefore She magnified His condescension.[^4778]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Mortified by passions and defilements, O All-Immaculate One,...[^4779]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: ...unto thy compassions I flee, and unto thy fervent protection and help I run, O Lady; having alone given birth unto Life, make alive my heart.[^4780]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Enlighten my darkened heart, O All-Pure One, who didst bear the Giver of light, God and man together: as a Mother, entreat Him, O Lady, to grant me deliverance before the fearful day.[^4781]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Heal the crushing of my mind, O All-Immaculate One! Heal the passions of my soul, and drive away the darkness of despondency, that in praise I may ever hymn thee as blessed, O all-hymned Mother of God.[^4782]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Cast down, O Lady, the insolence of mine enemies; for thee alone have I as protectress, and hope, and mighty help. Preserve me, O Pure One, delivering me from every assault of theirs.[^4783]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Celebrating this divine and all-honorable feast of the Mother of God, come, ye divinely-wise, let us clap our hands, and glorify God Who was born of Her.*[^4784]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By the sufferings which Thou didst endure being crucified, Thou didst make to cease the sufferings of mankind, and leadest all unto a sorrowless life, O tender-hearted Lord.[^4785]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The rays of the sun were hid, and the brightness of the temple was rent, and the earth quaked, and the rocks were rent with fear, unable to look upon the Creator on the Cross.[^4786]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Dead became the serpent, beholding the divine martyrs being put to death by tortures, and truly inheriting eternal life by divine grace.[^4787]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* Ye endured many tortures, and obtained many crowns, O numerous hosts of ever-living martyrs; therefore drive away the multitude of my sins.[^4788]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Be a haven unto me, O All-Immaculate One, who sail in the deep of cruel things, who by thy childbirth, O Birthgiver of God, didst save all distressed creation.[^4789]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *The Prophet Jonah cried aloud, prefiguring the three-day burial, praying in the belly of the whale: Deliver me from corruption, O Jesus, King of powers!*[^4790]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Shine forth upon me the dawn of repentance, O Lady, and dispel the clouds of my wicked thoughts, O cloud...[^4791]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: ...of the Sun of righteousness, O Ever-Virgin.[^4792]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Still the fierce wave of my passions, and calm the tempest of wicked thoughts, O great haven of the tempest-tossed, Ever-Virgin.[^4793]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Give me to drink of the drink of compunction, O Lady, granting me now rivers of tears, wherewith I may quench the eternal flame, O only all-hymned one.[^4794]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Drying up the fierce deep of my sins, O thou who truly didst bear the deep of goodness, guide me unto the haven of the divine will.[^4795]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *The godly-minded worshiped not the creature rather than the Creator, but manfully trampling upon the threat of fire, they rejoiced, singing: Blessed art Thou, O all-hymned Lord and God of our fathers!*[^4796]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The adversary was conquered and fell with a marvelous fall, when Christ was lifted up upon the Tree; and he who was formerly condemned was saved, crying unto Him: Blessed art Thou, O Lord and God of our fathers![^4797]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having died upon the Tree, O Christ, Thou didst make alive me who was dead through the tree, and by Thy divine wounds didst heal the sores of my heart: Blessed art Thou, O all-hymned Lord and God of our fathers![^4798]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Having received the gift of healings, to heal infirmities and drive away demons from men by spiritual power, heal the passions of my heart by your prayers, O unconquerable Martyrs.[^4799]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* Enduring drowning, the tormentor perished with his hosts by your blood; while ye, O all-praised Martyrs, rejoicing cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord and God of our fathers![^4800]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* O spotless Bride, palace of the Creator, untilled earth, fiery-visaged throne, Thou wast revealed, O All-Pure One! Therefore we cry unto thee: Rejoice, all-pure Lady, who hast deified men by thy divine childbirth.[^4801]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Thou Who didst save Thy children of Abraham in the fire, and didst slay the Chaldeans whom justice justly ensnared: Blessed art Thou, O all-hymned Lord, God of our fathers!*[^4802]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* With much love I flee beneath thy holy protection: turn me not away into darkness, but grant...[^4803]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: ...unto me, O All-Pure One, the remission of transgressions, and save me, that mine enemies, seeing it, may be put to shame.[^4804]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I will fear no evil, for thou art with me, O Virgin! Drive away the enemies who mercilessly persecute me, and being strengthened by thy power I will conquer them, O Mary, Birthgiver of God.[^4805]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou hast power always, as having given birth unto the Master of all; free me from the dominion of pleasure and passions, that rejoicing I may sing: Rejoice, throne of the Most High, O blessed one![^4806]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Thee alone do I, thy servant, have as protectress on earth, and as a help truly saving and firm, O All-Pure One, glorified of God! And unto thee do I flee: save me from the snares of hunters, O Birthgiver of God.[^4807]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *The Offspring of the Theotokos saved the pious youths in the furnace; then prefigured, but now in act, He gathers the whole universe to sing to Thee: Sing unto the Lord, all ye works, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.*[^4808]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou releasest me from the bonds of time, having come into time though timeless; and being bound willingly, O Master, Thou didst deliver the proud one unto indissoluble bonds, and savest me by Thy Cross and Passion. Therefore do I bless Thee, O Christ, unto the ages.[^4809]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Lifted up upon the Tree of Thine own will, Thou didst raise all creation with Thyself, O all-hymned, unoriginate, and invisible Word; and by Thy Passion, O Christ, Thou didst expose the principalities and powers of darkness; therefore do we hymn Thee unto all ages.[^4810]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Ye mounted upon your blood as upon a chariot, O all-comely Martyrs, and were taken up unto the supermundane dwellings, receiving worthy honors from Christ, and crying aloud: Sing unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages![^4811]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* Lifted up upon trees, cast into the pit, delivered unto beasts, divided into fire and water, the passion-bearing Martyrs rejoicing sang: Sing unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages![^4812]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Christ fallen asleep upon the Tree, Who grants unto all divine and saving wakefulness, the all-immaculate Mother with weeping cried aloud and exclaimed: What is this newest marvel? Doth He Who gives life unto all willingly die?[^4813]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having lived my life prodigally, and having committed every uncleanness, I tremble before the judgment-seat, I tremble at the interrogation, I tremble at the answer of my condemnation, O Pure One! O thou who didst bear the Judge, stand before me then, and deliver me from distress.[^4814]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Upon thee have I placed all the hope of my salvation, O Mother of God who knewest not wedlock, and thee do I ever call upon for help: save me from the griefs and assaults of the enemy, and loose the bonds of my sins, and snatch me from eternal darkness.[^4815]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* In the hour of my end, O Virgin, snatch me from the hands of demons, and from judgment, and accusation, and the fearful examination, and the bitter toll-houses, and the cruel prince, O Mother of God, and from eternal condemnation.[^4816]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Preserve thy servant, O Virgin, from every assault of the stranger; for thee do I have, O Lady, as protection and intercession, refuge and confirmation; and for thy sake I hope to be delivered from the snares of the enemy, O only Protectress of the human race.[^4817]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *My soul doth magnify the Lord: with prostrations.*[^4818]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Let every earthborn mortal leap for joy, enlightened by the Spirit, and let the nature of the bodiless minds keep festival, honoring the sacred festival of the Mother of God, and let them cry aloud: Rejoice, all-blessed Mother of God, pure Ever-Virgin!*[^4819]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst stand to be judged, O Lover of mankind, Who art to judge all; and with a crown of thorns Thou wast voluntarily bound, O Savior, of Thine own will, tearing up by the root, O Christ, the thorns of disobedience, and planting in all the knowledge of Thy tender mercy.[^4820]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O how the lawless people, being darkened by envy, deliver Thee, the righteous and blameless Giver of light, unto the Cross! Beholding Whose Passion, the sun was darkened, and the brightness of the temple was rent, and the foundations of the earth quaked.[^4821]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Martyricon 1:* Ye were made conformed unto the Passions of Christ, O holy Martyrs, and heirs of the kingdom and of brightness; therefore enlighten your singers, O most wise ones, delivering them from sinful gloom and diverse tribulations.[^4822]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Martyricon 2:* Having already settled into the very heavenly realms, O most wise ones,...[^4823]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: ...and having received ever-existing glory, and being deified by sacred communion, remember all of us who by faith honor your all-sacred and honorable memory, O ever-glorious ones.[^4824]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Enlighten, O Pure One, those who with love praise and magnify thee; dispel the darkness of our passions, O Maiden; calm the storm, and drive away from our midst the temptations of the wicked one; and subdue the children of Hagar, O Maiden, unto our pious Emperor (*Name*)[^4825], by thy prayers.[^4826]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Rejoice, O All-Pure One, who truly didst bear joy unto those upon earth! Rejoice, saving haven and protection of those fleeing unto thee! Rejoice, pure ladder who didst raise the fallen! Rejoice, all-blessed Mother of God, the hope of our souls![^4827]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Destroy the pasture of sin of my defiled soul and body, O Lady graced of God, all-pure one, by thy mighty prayer, O All-Immaculate One, granting saving healing, the divine fear of the Master.[^4828]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou art my illumination, thou art my deliverance and rejoicing, thou art my helper, thou art my glory and boast, and the expectation of my salvation, O All-Immaculate One! And unto thee do I faithfully bow down, and cry unto thee: Save me, thy wretched servant, and snatch me from the gates of hades.[^4829]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Save me, O Pure One, who didst bear the all-compassionate Savior; show mercy unto me, thy servant, and guide me unto the way of repentance; drive away from our midst the temptations of the wicked one, and deliver me from his snaring, and snatch me from eternal fire, O All-Undefiled One.[^4830]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Litany, Exapostilarion, and the usual Psalms.*[^4831]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 4:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Be a wall unto us, Thy Cross, O Jesus our Savior! For no other hope do we the faithful possess save Thee, Who wast nailed thereon in the flesh, and grantest us great mercy.[^4832]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad... And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, and guide their sons [LXX Ps. 89:14, 16].* [^4833]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Thou hast given a sign unto them that fear Thee, O Lord: Thy precious Cross,...[^4834]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: ...wherewith Thou didst put to shame the principalities and powers of darkness, and didst bring us back unto the first blessedness; therefore we glorify Thy dispensation, Lover of mankind, O almighty Jesus, Savior of our souls.[^4835]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and direct the works of our hands upon us; yea, direct Thou the work of our hands [LXX Ps. 89:17].* [^4836]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* Who doth not marvel, beholding, O holy Martyrs, the good fight which ye fought? How, being in the flesh, ye overcame the incorporeal enemy, confessing Christ, and being armed with the Cross? Therefore were ye worthily shown forth as expellers of demons and conquerors of barbarians, unceasingly praying that our souls be saved.[^4837]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: When the Ewe-lamb and Thy Mother beheld Thee nailed upon the Cross, O Lord, She marveled, and cried aloud: What is this vision, O beloved Son? Hath the unfaithful and lawless synagogue rendered these things unto Thee, which enjoyed Thy many wonders? But glory to Thine ineffable condescension, O Master![^4839]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise: Trisagion. After Our Father: troparion, litany, and the First Hour, and the rest as usual, and the dismissal.*[^4840]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Through a tree Adam became an exile from Paradise, but through the tree of the Cross the thief entered to dwell in Paradise: for the one, having tasted, cast away the commandment of Him that made him, while the other, being crucified with Thee, confessed the hidden God, crying aloud: Remember me in Thy kingdom![^4841]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Beholding Thee stretched out upon the Cross, O Thou Who alone art longsuffering, the heavenly powers, being at a loss, marveled with trembling; and the earth quaked, and the beauty of the luminaries was quenched; when Thou, O Lover of mankind, wast unrighteously condemned, Adam who was condemned was justified: I glorify Thy tender mercy.[^4842]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Lifted up upon Golgotha, Thou didst crush the head of the enemy; and having died upon the Tree, O Master, Thou didst make alive those who died through the ancient fruit, and didst reveal them as dwellers of Paradise, unceasingly glorifying Thy goodness and crying aloud: Remember us in Thy kingdom![^4843]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* Having taken up the Cross as a weapon, O holy Martyrs, with valiant purpose ye went forth unto the battle array of the enemies; and having destroyed them, with an incorruptible crown...[^4844]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: ...ye were crowned, and obtained highest glory, rejoicing, O richly-blessed ones; therefore with faith we call you blessed.[^4845]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Glory...:* That Thou mightest manifestly show forth, O Savior, Thy tender mercy toward us, Thou wast nailed upon the Cross, Who art united unto the Father and the Spirit; Thou didst endure the sponge and reed, mockings and wounds, desiring to deliver from eternal fire those who cry: Remember us, O Savior, in Thy kingdom![^4846]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^4657]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Both now...:* He Who cannot be contained anywhere, unconfined by space, took up His abode within thy holy womb, O Birthgiver of God, all-pure Lady! And suspended upon the Tree, He manifestly poured forth life unto the world. Entreat Him, as Lover of mankind, to mortify the carnal mind of our flesh, and to save us all.[^4847]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerables, Tone 4:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Zealous for the Passions of Christ, the Lover of mankind, O passion-bearers, ye surrendered your bodies unto wounds, and bitter torments, and myriads of pains, as ever foreseeing the divine delight of Paradise, the inexhaustible food, and the eternal good glory; which having obtained, pray ye for those who praise you.[^4850]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *At the second verse, say the same sticheron again.*[^4851]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* All-sacred shepherds, glorious imitators of Christ the Chief Shepherd, King of all, ye zealously laid down your lives for the sheep, and endured cruel tribulations, as assaulted by grievous wolves, O richly-blessed ones; and ye preserve unharmed the God-chosen flock.[^4852]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Living sacrifices, rational whole-burnt offerings, Martyrs of the Lord, perfect slaughters unto God, sheep knowing God and known of God, whose fold is inaccessible to wolves: pray for us, that we also may be pastured with you by the water of rest.[^4853]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* Precious is the death of Thy saints, O Lord; for by the sword and fire, and with a contrite soul,...[^4854]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: ...they shed their blood, having hope in Thee, to receive the reward of their labors; and having endured, they received from Thee, O Savior, great mercy.[^4855]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5:* Having boldness toward the Savior, O holy ones, pray unceasingly for us sinners, asking remission of transgressions and great mercy for our souls.[^4856]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Dogmatic Theotokion:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: David, the forefather of God, through thee, O Prophet, musically proclaimed concerning thee unto Him Who hath done great things for thee: The queen stood at Thy right hand. For God, Who was well-pleased without a father to become man of thee, revealed thee as Mother and mediatress of life, that He might renew His own image, corrupted through passions; and having found the sheep that went astray upon the mountains, taking it upon His shoulder, He will bring it unto the Father, and according to His own will will unite it unto the heavenly Powers, and Christ, Who hath great and rich mercy, will save the world, O Mother of God.[^4857]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light: Prokeimenon of the day, Vouchsafe, O Lord: And the litany.*[^4858]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Martyrs, Tone 4:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* O Christ God, Who art glorified in the memorials of Thy saints, and being entreated by them, send down upon us great mercy.[^4859]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* O Lover of mankind, Who didst accept the endurance of the holy martyrs, accept also from us our singing, and grant us through their prayers great mercy.[^4861]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us, for we are utterly filled with contempt. Our soul is exceedingly filled with the reproach of the prosperous, and with the contempt of the proud [LXX Ps. 122:3-4].* [^4862]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* With the spirits of the righteous who have been perfected, give rest unto the souls of Thy servants, O Savior, preserving them in the blessed life which is with Thee, O Lover of mankind.[^4863]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* O unquenchable lamp, righteous throne, all-pure Lady, pray that our souls be saved.[^4864]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion. After Our Father: troparion, and dismissal.*[^4865]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *O Thou Who wast born of a Virgin, drown, I pray Thee, the tripartite power of my soul in the depth of dispassion, as of old Thou didst drown the mighty captains, that in the mortification of the body, as upon a timbrel, I may sing unto Thee a song of victory.*[^4866]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most holy Lady Mother of God, save us.*[^4867]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* From the mire of passions, from the tempest of thoughts, from the darts of the wicked one, and from every assault of the adversary, save my wretched soul, O all-pure Birthgiver of God, and snatch me from eternal fire.[^4868]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Lead me up, O Pure One, from the depth of transgressions, and guide me unto the light of the divine commandments of the Savior Christ and God; shine forth upon me the saving dawn of repentance, and grant me life eternal.[^4869]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Glory...:* Having fallen into the evil mire of my sins, I am sorely choked by evil deeds, and have no stability: O Lady Virgin Mother, by thy power lead me up, and deliver me from fire and torment.[^4870]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Both now...:* Death and corruption hast thou abolished, O all-hymned Mother of God, having given birth unto Christ the fountain of incorruption, Who adorned human nature with immortality and grace, O All-Undefiled One.[^4871]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Not in wisdom, and power, and riches do we boast, but in Thee, the hypostatic Wisdom of the Father, O Christ; for there is none holy save Thee, O Lover of mankind.*[^4872]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having appeared, O pure Virgin, take away the darkness of my soul, and rend asunder the bonds of sin, and save me, I pray thee, by thine intercession.[^4873]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* My heart, shaken by passionate assaults, establish in the most pure fear of God, O all-undefiled Virgin, by thy tender mercy.[^4874]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Glory...:* Despairing of all help, unto thee, O All-Undefiled One, as mighty guardian and protection, have I run: cast me not away, therefore, from thy divine protection.[^4875]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Both now...:* Arrayed in fringes of gold as a queen, at the right hand of the King and God thou standest now, O Lady, praying for thy servants.[^4876]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Sitting in glory upon the throne of the Godhead, Jesus the most divine came upon a light cloud, and with His incorrupt hand He saved those who cry: Glory to Thy power, O Christ!*[^4877]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ страстьмѝ и҆ скве́рнами, Всенепоро́чная, къ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Deliver me who am held fast by despondency, completely darkened by the gloom of passions, and enslaved to sin, O divinely-blessed Maiden, and unite me unto Thy Son and our God.[^4878]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́на мѧ̀ ѕло́бою льсти́вагѡ, Пренепоро́чнаѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ жи́знь ро́ждшаѧ, ѡ҆живѝ, къ тебѣ́ бо прибѣго́хъ; и҆ погрꙋже́нна въ глꙋбинѣ̀ паде́жей возведѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ми́лостива Всенепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Mortified by the malice of the deceiver, O All-Undefiled One, as having given birth unto Life, make me alive, for unto thee have I fled; and lead me up who am plunged into the depth of downfalls, as thou art merciful, O All-Blameless One.[^4879]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Въ гро́бѣ безмѣ́рныхъ сласте́й мои́хъ низлежꙋ̀, и҆ оу҆ны́ніемъ и҆ лѣ́ностїю ѡ҆держи́мъ є҆́смь; но ро́ждшаѧ всѣ́хъ возставле́ніе, ѡ҆живи́ мѧ Блага́ѧ, и҆ спасѝ.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* In the grave of mine immeasurable pleasures I lie low, and am held fast by despondency and sloth; but O thou who gavest birth unto the Resurrection of all, make me alive, O Good One, and save me.[^4880]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Свяще́нную тѧ̀ дре́вле проро́къ го́рꙋ бж҃твенную наречѐ, Дѣ́во чи́стаѧ, добродѣ́телми всю̀ ѡ҆сѣне́ну, и҆зъ нея́же спаси́тельное Сло́во ꙗ҆ви́ся, въ созда́ніе и҆ просвѣще́ніе дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now...:* The prophet of old called thee a sacred and divine mountain, O pure Virgin, overshadowed all round by virtues, from which the saving Word appeared, for the renewal and illumination of our souls.[^4881]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Нечести́вїи не оу҆́зрятъ сла́вы твоеѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, но мы́ тѧ є҆диноро́дне, Ѻ҆́ч҃ескїѧ сла́вы сїя́ніе Бж҃ества̀, ѿ но́щи оу҆́тренююще воспѣва́емъ, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *The ungodly shall not see Thy glory, O Christ, but we, rising early from the night, hymn Thee, the Only-begotten, the Radiance of the Father's glory of the Godhead, O Lover of mankind.*[^4882]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Да возвесели́тся Влⷣчце дꙋша̀ моя̀ смире́ннаѧ, боя́тися твоегѡ̀ Сы́на, и҆ твори́ти повелѣ́нїя є҆гѡ̀ ѿ се́рдца, всенепоро́чнаѧ Пречи́стаѧ, моли́твами твои́ми наста́ви.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* That my humble soul may rejoice, O Lady, to fear Thy Son, and to do His commandments from the heart, guide me, O all-undefiled and Most Pure One, by thy prayers.[^4883]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́мъ се́рдцемъ мои́мъ Влⷣчце блага́ѧ, и҆сповѣ́датися И҆зба́вителю, сподо́би дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ стра́стную, ѿгоня́щи невѣ́дѣніе се́рдца моегѡ̀, Всенепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With all my heart, O good Lady, vouchsafe my passionate soul to confess unto the Redeemer, driving away the ignorance of my heart, O All-Undefiled One.[^4884]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ сохранѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ зѣ́ницꙋ ѻ҆́ка, подъ кро́вомъ крилꙋ̑ твое́ю блага́я Пречи́стаѧ, и҆ ѿ дꙋхѡ́въ лꙋка́выхъ томле́нїя и҆ мꙋче́нїя и҆зба́ви.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* Preserve my soul as the apple of the eye under the shelter of thy wings, O good and Most Pure One, and deliver me from the torment and torture of evil spirits.[^4885]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: И҆збавля́ющи ꙗ҆ви́ся Пречи́стаѧ, ѿ страсте́й наведе́нїя, и҆ бѣсѡ́въ лꙋка́выхъ твоего̀ раба̀, стяжа́вшаго тѧ̀ держа́вное застꙋпле́ніе, и҆ предста́тельницꙋ непосты́дную.
items.english_text: *Both now...:* Reveal thyself delivering thy servant from the assault of passions and from evil demons, O Most Pure One, who hast gained thee as a mighty protection and an unashamed advocate.[^4886]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Возопѝ, прообразу́я погребе́ніе тридне́вное проро́къ І҆ѡ́на, въ ки́тѣ моля́ся: ѿ тлѝ и҆зба́ви мѧ, І҆и҃се Царю̀ си́лъ.
items.english_text: *The prophet Jonah, praying in the whale, cried aloud, prefiguring the three-day burial: Deliver me from corruption, O Jesus, King of powers!*[^4887]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Низложѝ и҆̀же при́снѡ борю́щїя мѧ̀ Влⷣчце, и҆ ѻ҆́блакъ лꙋка́выхъ помышле́ній разорѝ: со́лнца пра́веднагѡ сꙋ́щи две́рь, Бгома́ти.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Cast down those who ever wage war against me, O Lady, and disperse the cloud of evil thoughts, for thou art the gate of the Sun of righteousness, O Mother of God.[^4888]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Возсїя́й мнѣ̀ покаѧ́нїя зарю̀ Влⷣчце, и҆ ѻ҆́блаки ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній мои́хъ разрꙋшѝ, лю́тыми прельще́ніи привлеко́ма же и҆ растлѣва́ема.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Cause the dawn of repentance to shine upon me, O Lady, and dispel the clouds of my wicked thoughts, drawn away and corrupted as I am by cruel enticements.[^4889]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* Still the raging wave of my passions, and destroy the tempest of wicked thoughts, O steadfast protectress and shelter of all, O All-Undefiled One.[^4890]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...:* The transgressions of my soul are multiplied above the sand of the sea, and as a heavy burden they weigh me down; but do thou, O Virgin, having compassion on me before the end, save me.[^4891]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Lord, have mercy (3). Glory... Both now...*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: As a fervent protection in tribulations, and our helper, and reconciliation unto God, through whom we were delivered from corruption, we, the faithful, call the Mother of God blessed.[^4892]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *The Abrahamic youths of old in Babylon trampled down the flame of the furnace, crying aloud in hymns: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!*[^4893]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thee, O pure Mother of God, do I faithfully invoke: preserve my humble heart, and deliver me from the flame of torment and eternal darkness.[^4894]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Rend asunder, O pure Virgin, with the spear of Thy Son the handwriting of my transgressions, and deliver me, I pray thee, from all possession at the hour of my departure.[^4895]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* Quench, O pure Virgin, with the streams of my tears and the rain of thy compassions, the furnace which the multitude of my wicked deeds hath prepared for me by demonic working.[^4896]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...:* Deliver us from the assaults of temptations, O only Mother of the Word and Ever-Virgin, and from every torment, who truly and understandingly hymn thee unto all ages.[^4897]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *O all-powerful Redeemer of all, having descended into the midst of the flame, Thou didst bedew the godly youths and teach them to sing: All ye works, bless and praise the Lord!*[^4898]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Heal my ailing soul, and enlighten my darkened mind, and snatch me from fire and eternal, ineffable torments, O Mother of God, Virgin Bride of God.[^4899]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Bowed down by irrational passions, I have descended into the depth of perdition, and have made myself burning fuel for the flame; from which deliver me, O Virgin Mother of God, thy servant.[^4900]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* Dry up the deep of my wicked deeds, O thou who gavest birth unto the Abyss of compassion, the Redeemer and Lord; and loose the chains of my wicked deeds before the end, O thou who gavest birth unto the Savior of all.[^4901]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...:* The Lord Who rules over creation, having become incarnate from thy womb, revealed thee, O Virgin, as Sovereign Lady over all things both visible and invisible,...[^4902]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: ...glorifying thee as His undefiled Mother.[^4903]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Eve through the disease of disobedience brought in the curse, but thou, O Virgin Mother of God, through the bud of thy childbearing didst blossom forth blessing unto the world: therefore do we all magnify thee.*[^4904]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* My heart, which hath been barren of divine virtues, do thou, O most pure Virgin Mother of God, show forth to be fruitful, O thou who wast born of a barren woman by the will and beck of Him Who transforms all things, that I may hymn thee, the All-Praised.[^4905]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With thy light enlighten me, O All-Undefiled One, who gavest birth unto the unapproachable Light; drive away the clouds of my passions, and snatch me from murky darkness, and vouchsafe me divine light, that I may hymn thee, O Virgin Mother.[^4906]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* By the sprinkling of thy compassions, O Pure One, wash away the ulcers of my heart, and grant me ever to pour forth streams of tears, subduing the torrents of passions, and delivering me from torment.[^4907]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...:* O gracious Mother of God, who gavest birth unto God Who loves what is good, quickly deliver me now from evil carnal love, O Lady, and enslave me unto the divine will, who am perishing through sloth.[^4908]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆толѝ страсте́й мои́хъ свирѣ́пꙋю во́лну, и҆ бꙋ́рю ѕлы́хъ помышле́ній потребѝ, тве́рдая всѣ́хъ предста́тельнице и҆ покро́ве, Пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: and a prostration. Trisagion. After Our Father: troparia and the rest as usual.*[^4909]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^4848]
