items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* O Word, who didst strengthen the all-wise passion-bearers to endure many-woven torments, by their prayers have compassion upon all.[^5479]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Blessed art Thou, O God, who having dwelt in a virginal womb didst save man, praised and exalted above all unto the ages.[^5480]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Canon to the Bodiless Powers. Ode 7. Heirmos:* The exalted Lord of the fathers quenched the flame and bedewed the youths, who sang in unison: O God, blessed art Thou.[^5481]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Twice):* Manifesting His immeasurably mighty power, Christ appointed you Archistrategoi and taught you to sing: O God, blessed art Thou.[^5482]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Thou who adornest the innumerable multitude of the incorporeal ranks with goodness, vouchsafe the assemblies of the faithful to sing unto Thee: O God, blessed art Thou.[^5483]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Virgin, who didst pour forth passionlessness unto all the faithful, now establish me who am shaken by passions, as I sing in faith: O God, blessed art Thou.[^5484]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The Creator of creation, at Whom the Angels tremble, hymn, O ye people, and exalt Him above all unto all ages.[^5485]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having become dead through transgressions, make me alive, O Lord, that I may glorify Thee unto all ages.[^5486]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having enlightened me by repentance, deliver me from the darkness of sin, O Lord, that I may glorify Thee unto all ages.[^5487]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Passion-bearers, Martyrs, ye trampled upon the flame of deception, having most gloriously received dew from heaven.[^5488]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Like fertile soil, O holy ones, ye truly bore fruit a hundredfold unto Christ the Arbiter of the contest.[^5489]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* From thee did God shine forth, O all-hymned Virgin, and by divine knowledge He enlightened the darkened.[^5490]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Canon to the Bodiless Powers. Ode 8. Heirmos:* Unto Thee, Creator of all, the youths in the furnace, having woven a universal choir, sang: All ye works, hymn the Lord and exalt Him above all unto all ages.[^5491]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Twice):* The angelic assemblies now draw me to sing with hymns and heartfelt desire, with whom I sing: All ye works, hymn the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto the ages.[^5492]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Ye ministers of the most holy and thrice-solar ray, pray that they may be saved who sing in faith: Hymn the works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto the ages.[^5493]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Gate of light, Virgin Mother Maiden, illuminate with thy light those who sing in faith: Hymn the works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto the ages.[^5494]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Thee, who art blessed among women and blessed by God, the human race magnifies in hymns.[^5495]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Be merciful unto me, O Lord, who have sinned foolishly beyond number, and vouchsafe me Thy Kingdom, O Word.[^5496]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Even as Thou didst save the Ninevites of old when they repented, O only Savior, so also save us who hymn Thee, by Thy mercy.[^5497]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Having surrendered your flesh unto all manner of wounds, ye preserved your soul unvanquished, O Passion-bearers of the Lord, partakers of divine glory.[^5498]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Day-shining stars, illuminating the souls of all upon earth, did ye appear, O passion-bearers of the Lord of all.[^5499]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Like a fiery throne thou bearest Him who upholds all things by His nod, and with thy breasts thou nourishest, O Virgin, Him who nourishes all.[^5500]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Canon to the Bodiless Powers. Ode 9. Heirmos:* Rejoice, O Isaiah, the Virgin held in womb and bore a Son, Emmanuel, God and man, Dayspring is His name; Whom magnifying, we call the Virgin blessed.[^5501]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Twice):* Having been leaders of the angelic orders, O most radiant Michael, and thou, Gabriel, who wast the all-true preacher of the divine Incarnation: preserve all who sing of you, O glorious ones.[^5502]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Thou who out of rich giftings overflowest Thy treasures, Thou hast brought forth the angelic ranks; coming with them as Judge and King of all, save me, O Master, who flee unto Thy mercy.[^5503]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Intelligences, Archangels, Authorities, Thrones, Cherubim, Powers, and Seraphim, radiant Angels, Principalities, and Dominions, with trembling serve Thy Son, O all-immaculate, pure, all-blessed Theotokos.[^5504]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 5:*[^5505]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Overlook the multitudes of my transgressions, O Lord born of the Virgin, and cleanse all my sins, granting me thoughts of conversion, as the only Lover of mankind, I pray, and have mercy on me.[^5506]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad. In all our days let us be glad for the days wherein Thou didst humble us, for the years wherein we saw evils. And look upon Thy servants and upon Thy works, and guide their sons.* [^5507]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Woe is me! Unto whom have I been likened? Unto the barren fig tree; and I fear the curse together with the cutting down. But O heavenly Husbandman, Christ God, show my dried-up soul to be fruitful, and receive me as the prodigal son, and have mercy on me.[^5508]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and prosper Thou the works of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands do Thou prosper.* [^5509]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Blessed is the host of the heavenly King: for although the passion-bearers were earth-born, yet they hastened to attain unto the angelic dignity; they took no heed of their bodies, and through sufferings were vouchsafed the honor of the Incorporeal Ones: therefore, by their prayers, O Lord, send down upon us great mercy.[^5510]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* O Joy-endowed one, intercede by thy prayers, and entreat...[^5511]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: ...for our souls a multitude of compassions, and cleansing of many transgressions, we pray.[^5512]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise: Trisagion, and after Our Father: Troparion of the Saint, if there be one; if not, we say the Troparion of the day. Then the Ectenia and the First Hour, and the rest as usual, and the Dismissal.*[^5513]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *On Monday, The Beatitudes, Tone 5:*[^5514]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The thief on the cross having believed Thee to be God, O Christ, confessed Thee purely from the heart, crying: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom.[^5515]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Soul-corrupting robbers, having met me on the path of this life, have wounded me; but unto Thy compassion do I now flee: heal me, O Christ, and save me, I pray.[^5516]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The heavenly choirs hymn Thee, the God of all; by their holy intercessions, O Master, overlook my many evils and save me, I pray.[^5517]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Numbered among the angelic choirs, O sufferers of Christ, and filled with unwaning illumination, consume the foul-smelling passions of my heart.[^5518]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Like Angels, let us who are earth-born sing a thrice-holy hymn unto God who is hymned in the highest: Holy art Thou, O unoriginate Father, Son, with the Spirit.[^5519]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^5322]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Having received in thy womb the joy of the Angels, O Pure One, fill my soul that mourns over wicked deeds with joy, guiding me unto the light.[^5520]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *On Monday Evening:*[^5521]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 5:*[^5522]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Woe is me, who have angered Thee, my merciful God and Lord! How often did I promise to repent, O Christ, and was found a senseless liar: for I defiled the first garment of baptism, and I abandoned my covenant which was unto Thee; and this second testament again, which I confessed unto Thee before Angels and...[^5524]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: ...men, being clothed in mournful form, which I have laid aside. Furthermore, O Savior, leave me not to perish utterly.[^5525]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* What manner of answer, O wretched soul, wilt thou make in the Day of Judgment? Or who shall deliver thee from the condemnation of eternal fire and other torments? No one, unless thou thyself make the Compassionate One propitious, leaving behind thy wicked deeds and acquiring a life pleasing unto God, weeping at every hour wherein thou sinnest by deed, and word, and thought: praying unto Christ that He grant unto thy soul complete forgiveness thereof.[^5526]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Let not sinful habit that drags me down hold me, O Savior, neither let the demon possess me, constantly warring and bringing me down unto his will: but snatch me from his dominion by Thy strong hand, O Almighty One! And reign within me, Thou Lover of mankind! Vouchsafe me to belong wholly unto Thee, and to live according to Thy will, O Word, and to have rest in Thee, and that I may find cleansing, and salvation, and great mercy.[^5527]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Forerunner.*[^5528]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Heal me who am wholly bowed down unto the earth and incurably crushed, O Forerunner and Martyr of Christ, who flee in faith unto thy divine protection, O Blessed One! Therefore also snatch me from the dreadful day wherein I must stand before the judgment seat and be given over unto torments; deliver me then from standing there, I pray thee, as having unashamed boldness, O Wise One, entreating Him who grants great mercy unto the world.[^5530]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Being the lamp of the Sun, O wise one, most radiant Forerunner of Christ: shine upon me the ray of light, when the darkness of immeasurable evils has fallen upon me, I pray thee, and raise me up from the pit of sin, guiding me by thy sweet voice; thou who of old didst loose the voice of thy father by thy birth, now set right my voice, I pray thee, that in faith and love I may give glory unto God and the Savior, the Lover of mankind, who grants great mercy unto the world.[^5531]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* A divine temple wast thou of God the Giver of life unto all, O blessed Prophet, Forerunner, and Preacher, having Him living in thy heart. Pray Him unceasingly: that those who flee unto thy holy temple and honor thee, O most rich John, may be temples of the Spirit, we pray, and draw near unto God, that we may honor in hymns thy protection and fervent prayer, from Whom thou wast witnessed to be greater than all men, O Most-honored One.[^5532]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Wholly from infancy was I seen doing sins without ceasing; grievously was I wounded in mind, and having continued in them with love through much habit. And now I...[^5533]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: ...mourn, lamenting my cruel perdition. O Lady, despise me not who perish evilly; but having had compassion, deliver me from every assault and passion by thy protection, that at least in old age I may repent unto God.[^5534]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light: Prokeimenon and the rest:*[^5535]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 5:*[^5536]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* O Lord, I cease not from sinning; though vouchsafed Thy love for mankind, I understand it not: overcome my perplexity, O only Good One, and have mercy on me.[^5537]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* O Lord, I both fear Thy dread and cease not from doing evil. Who at the judgment-seat fears not the judge? Or who, desiring to be healed, provokes the physician to wrath as do I? O long-suffering Lord, have compassion on my weakness, and have mercy on me.[^5539]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Having armed themselves with the shield of faith, and having strengthened themselves with the sign of the Cross, Thy holy ones, O Lord, bravely gave themselves over unto torments, and cast down the pride and deceit of the devil. By their supplications, as the almighty God, send down peace upon the world, and great mercy unto our souls.[^5541]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Assuage the pains of my much-sighing soul, thou who didst wipe away every tear from the face of the earth; for thou drivest away the diseases of men and dispersest the sorrows of sinners: for thee have we all acquired as hope and confirmation, O most holy Virgin Mother.[^5542]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion; after Our Father: Troparion of the Saint; Glory... Both now... Theotokion in the Tone of the Troparion; ectenia and dismissal.*[^5543]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *On Monday at Small Compline:*[^5544]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.*[^5545]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Horse and rider in the Red Sea, He who crushes wars with a high arm, Christ did shake off; and Israel He saved, as they sang a song of victory.[^5546]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Refrain:* Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.[^5547]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Grant me a contrite spirit, O Good One, humility of heart, purity of mind, correction of life, and remission of transgressions, and...[^5548]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: ...fountains of tears, O All-immaculate One.[^5549]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Behold my distress and humiliation, and heal the bruises of ancient transgressions, and grant me time for repentance and confession of sins.[^5550]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Glory:* I weep for myself before my departure, considering the abyss of mine evils, O All-immaculate One. Therefore I pray thee: Entreat thy Son to deliver me from torment.[^5551]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Having time for repentance, depart from every malice, O my soul, and cry with tears unto thy Creator: O my God, save me by the supplications of her who gave birth unto Thee.[^5552]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* He who established the earth upon nothing by Thy command, and suspended it without restraint, though weighed down: upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments, O Christ, establish Thy Church, O only Good and Lover of mankind.[^5553]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The authors of my passions have encompassed me, O Most-pure One, and have filled me with shame, who was created according to the image and likeness of God; but deliver me from their harm, who in compunction sing unto thee.[^5554]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Deceitfully the enemy strives to ensnare me, desiring to show me as fuel for the eternal flame, O Most-pure One! But destroy his craftiness and counsels, that rejoicing I may glorify thee.[^5555]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Into the lowest pit have the enemies of the righteous deceitfully cast me because of my many transgressions; and as one who is now helpless and wholly wounded, I call upon thy prayer: O all-immaculate Lady, save me.[^5556]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Both now:* In slothfulness have I spent my life, wretch that I am, and now have I drawn near unto the gates of death, and trembling at the assaults of the enemy, I cry unto thee: Deliver me from these temptations, that being saved I may glorify thee.[^5557]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Understanding Thy divine emptying, Habakkuk foresightedly, O Christ, with trembling cried unto Thee: For the salvation of Thy people, to save Thine anointed ones art Thou come.[^5558]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I have been wounded with the arrows of sin, and I now bear about the bruise of my whole body; therefore I cry unto thee, O Most-pure One: By the swiftness of thy prayers, heal the wounds of my soul.[^5559]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Have mercy, O Pure One, upon thy servants; for thee have we acquired as intercessor with God, and we pray that we may be delivered from every necessity and eternal torment.[^5560]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Hope, and shield, and confirmation art thou unto me, O Good One, and deliverance from grievous things, and enlightenment of my soul, and praise, and wall, and dominion.[^5561]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Profligately have I squandered the wealth of good works which Christ as good granted unto me; despise me not therefore, O all-pure Maiden, who perish of hunger.[^5562]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Covering Thyself with light as with a garment, I awake early unto Thee and cry to Thee: Enlighten my darkened soul, O Christ, as the only Compassionate One.[^5563]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Behold, O Lady, the weakness of my humble soul, and the infirmity of my flesh, and the captivity of my mind, and save me who have no hope.[^5564]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Pray God, Whom thou didst bear, ever to save all of us who confess thee as Theotokos and glorify thy childbearing, O Most-pure One.[^5565]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Who blesses thee not, O All-immaculate One? For thou didst ineffably give birth unto the Creator of the whole world, the Savior Christ and only Master.[^5566]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Send down upon me streams of tears, O Most-pure One, wherewith having washed away the defilements and wounds of my sins, I may sing the multitude of thy goodness.[^5567]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Raging with a soul-corrupting tempest, O Master Christ, tame the sea of passions, and bring me up from corruption, as Thou art compassionate.[^5568]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I have cast myself into the depth of transgressions and iniquities; but stretch forth thy hand, O All-immaculate One, and bring me up from the hell of despair.[^5569]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou knowest the multitude of my transgressions and the thoughts that trouble me; make haste therefore, and deliver me from them, O Most-pure One.[^5570]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Spare me Thy servant, O Master Christ, by the prayers of her who purely gave birth unto Thee, when Thou art about to judge the world which Thou hast created.[^5571]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Into the depth of transgressions hath my pure soul been dragged down, O Lady, having become food for demons; therefore, beyond all hope, save me.[^5572]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Lord, have mercy (20 times). Glory... Both now:*[^5573]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 5:*[^5574]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn:* Quickly heal the much-painful passions of my soul, and the infirmities of my flesh; stay the wanderings of my mind, O All-immaculate One, and vouchsafe me, O Theotokos, in quietness of thought to offer pure prayers unto the King of all, and to entreat remission of transgressions.[^5576]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The exalted Lord of the fathers quenched the flame and bedewed the youths, who sang in unison: O God, blessed art Thou.[^5577]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* When I take into my mind the multitude of mine unseemly deeds and transgressions, O All-immaculate One, I fear and am in dread; from which free me by thy prayers, O Virgin.[^5578]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The sleepless worm and unquenchable fire consume me continually and eat away my soul; let me not experience them, O most holy Theotokos.[^5579]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Glory:* From the outer darkness and dreadful torment deliver me Thy servant, O all-immaculate Virgin, who cry unto Thy Son: O God, blessed art Thou.[^5580]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Both now:* My flesh indeed have I defiled with shameful passions, and my mind have I darkened with foul thoughts; but have compassion, O Pure One, and save me thine unprofitable servant.[^5581]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Unto Thee, Creator of all, the youths in the furnace, having woven a universal choir, sang: All ye works, hymn the Lord and exalt Him above all unto all ages.[^5582]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Unto thee, O Theotokos, do I offer the infirmity of my humble soul, and the weakness of my heart, and the deception of my mind do I make known, asking thy help, O Virgin.[^5583]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Be merciful unto Thy servants, O Word, through the prayers of her who gave birth unto Thee, and save those who sing: All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto the ages.[^5584]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Glory:* O thou who didst bear the Lover of mercy, have mercy upon all who sing in faith: All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto the ages.[^5585]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нно краша́еми А҆́гглстіи собо́ри и҆збра́нніи, свѣтода́тельны-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Deliver me from the outer darkness and the unsleeping worm, O good Virgin! For thou didst bear the Creator of the world, who does all things whatsoever He pleases, by thy prayers.[^5586]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Въ Понедѣ́льникъ на Повече́ріи, Гла́съ є҃. фм҃ѳ
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Rejoice, O Isaiah, a Virgin had in womb and bare a Son, Emmanuel, both God and man, Orient is His name; whom magnifying, we call the Virgin blessed.[^5587]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: И҆са́їе ликꙋ́й, Дѣ́ва и҆́мѣ въ чре́вѣ, и҆ родѝ Сы́на Є҆мманꙋ́ила, Бг҃а же и҆ человѣ́ка, Восто́къ и҆́мѧ є҆мꙋ̀; є҆го́же велича́юще, Дѣ́вꙋ оу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* God, whom thou didst ineffably bear, O pure Sovereign Lady, beseech diligently to deliver us from necessities and afflictions, and from the fearful judgment that is to come, and vouchsafe unto us the radiance of His Saints.[^5588]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃а, є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ неизрече́ннѡ Влⷣце чи́стаѧ, молѝ прилѣ́жнѡ, и҆зба́вити на́съ ѿ бѣ́дъ и҆ скорбе́й, и҆ бꙋ́дꙋщагѡ сꙋда̀ стра́шнагѡ, и҆ свѣ́тлости Ст҃ы́хъ є҆гѡ̀ сподо́би.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* More than all have I sinned, having disobeyed Thy life-giving commandments, O Christ, and I have become like unto irrational beasts; but by the prayers of Thy Mother, O Word, pluck me not from life unrepentant.[^5589]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Па́че всѣ́хъ согрѣши́хъ, преслꙋ́шавъ твоѧ̑ за́повѣди Хрⷭ҇тѐ животво́рныѧ, и҆ оу҆подо́бихсѧ безслове́снымъ скотѡ́мъ; но твоеѧ̀ ма́тере Сло́ве моли́твами, непока́ѧнна ѿ житїа̀ не и҆сто́ргни менѐ.
items.english_text: *Glory...* As having borne the Abyss of mercy, the Word of God, have mercy, O Good One, on the souls of all who flee beneath thy protection; for thee have we all acquired as an unashamed advocate before God.[^5590]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ми́лости бе́зднꙋ ро́ждшаѧ Сло́во Бж҃їе, поми́лꙋй Блага́ѧ всѣ́хъ дꙋ́ши подъ кро́въ тво́й прибѣга́ющихъ; та́ бо къ Бг҃ꙋ всѝ стѧжа́хомъ предста́тельницꙋ непосты́днꙋ.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Ask for us cleansing and forgiveness of transgressions, and transformation of all grievous things, and now an upright and light-bearing way of life, that we may glorify thy great mercy, O Mother of God.[^5591]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆чище́нїе и҆ ѡ҆ставле́нїе прегрѣше́нїй и҆спросѝ на́мъ, и҆ всѣ́хъ нꙋ́ждныхъ премѣне́нїе, и҆ житїа̀ и҆справле́нїе ны́нѣ чи́сто и҆ свѣтови́дно; да прослаблѧ́емъ Бгома́ти мно́гꙋю твою̀ ми́лость.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparion and the rest as usual.*[^5592]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Трисвѧто́е. По О҆́тче на́шъ: тропа́рь и҆ про́чее ѻ҆бы́чно.
items.english_text: *On Tuesday at Matins:*[^5593]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: По а҃-мъ стїхосло́вїи, сѣда́лны покаѧ́нны, Гла́съ є҃.
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 5:*[^5594]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сꙋдїѝ сѣда́щꙋ, и҆ А҆́гг҃лѡмъ предстоѧ́щымъ, трꙋбѣ̀ гласа́ющей, и҆ пла́меню горѧ́щꙋ, что̀ сотвори́ши дꙋшѐ моѧ̀, ведо́ма на сꙋ́дъ? Тогда́ бо лю̑таѧ твоѧ̑ предста́нꙋтъ, и҆ та̑йнаѧ твоѧ̑ ѡ҆блича́тсѧ согрѣше́нїа; тѣ́мже пре́жде конца̀ возопі́й сꙋдїѝ: Бж҃е, ѡ҆чи́сти мѧ̀ и҆ спаси́ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* When the Judge sits and the Angels stand by, the trumpet sounds and the flame burns, what wilt thou do, O my soul, being led unto judgment? For then thy grievous deeds shall stand before thee, and thy secret transgressions shall be exposed; therefore before the end cry aloud unto the Judge: O God, cleanse me and save me.[^5595]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Стíхъ: Гдⷭ҇и, да не ꙗ҆́ростїю твое́ю ѡ҆бличи́ши менѐ, нижѐ гнѣ́вомъ твои́мъ нака́жеши менѐ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Let us all watch and meet Christ with abundance of oil and radiant lamps, that we may be accounted worthy of entering the bridal chamber; for he that is caught outside the doors shall cry in vain unto God: Have mercy on me.[^5597]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Всѝ побди́мъ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ оу҆сря́щимъ съ мно́жествомъ є҆ле́а, и҆ свѣща́ми свѣ́тлыми, ꙗ҆́ко да черто́га внꙋ́трь сподо́бимсѧ; и҆́же бо внѣ̀ двере́й пости́гнꙋтый, недѣ́йственнѡ Бг҃ꙋ воззове́тъ: поми́лꙋй мѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* A strange mystery of the Virgin! For from her without seed was born and in the flesh appeared the Lord, salvation unto the world. O Joy of all, Lord, glory to Thee![^5598]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Стра́нное Дѣ́вы та́инство, и҆зъ неѧ́ бо роди́сѧ безъ сѣ́мене, и҆ пло́тїю ꙗ҆ви́сѧ Гдⷭ҇ь, мі́рови спасе́нїе. Всѣ́хъ ра́досте, Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 5:*[^5599]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: По в҃-мъ стїхосло́вїи, сѣда́лны, Гла́съ є҃.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* When thy deeds shall be uncovered, O my soul, and ten thousands of Angels...[^5600]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: ...stand by: what ashamed answer wilt thou find before the Judge, unless before the end thou cry aloud weeping: I have sinned, O good Lord, have mercy on me.[^5601]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* I lie upon a bed of many transgressions, robbed of the hope of my salvation; for the sleep of my slothfulness procures torment for my soul. But do Thou, O God born of the Virgin, raise me up unto Thy singing, that I may glorify Thee.[^5603]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* The miracles of Thy holy martyrs hast Thou granted us as an indestructible wall, O Christ God; by their entreaties destroy the counsels of the nations, and strengthen the scepters of the kingdom, as the only good One and Lover of mankind.[^5605]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Show forth thy speedy protection, and help, and mercy upon thy servant, and calm the waves of vain thoughts, O Pure One, and raise up my fallen soul, O Theotokos; for I know, I know, O Virgin, that thou canst do all things whatsoever thou desirest.[^5606]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 5:*[^5607]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* The tempest of despair overwhelms me, who have slipped into the deep of sin; but anticipate me, O Christ, as all-powerful, Helmsman of all, and direct me unto the quiet haven of dispassion by the prayers of Thy Forerunner, in Thy tenderheartedness, O Savior, and save me.[^5608]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Elizabeth was freed from barrenness, and the Virgin remained again a virgin when she conceived in her womb at Gabriel's voice; but the Forerunner John leaps in the womb, foreseeing God and the Master being incarnate in the virginal womb for our salvation.[^5609]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* O divine Flower that sprouted from the root of Jesse, ark and lampstand, all-golden urn, holy table bearing the Bread of Life: as His Mother, entreat Thy Son and God together with the holy Forerunner, to have compassion and to save those who confess thee as Theotokos.[^5610]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon.*[^5611]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: Grant us cleansing of transgressions, O Christ.)*[^5612]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *A composition of Joseph.*[^5613]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Earth upon which the sun never shone nor looked; the deep which the wide expanse of heaven never saw naked: Israel traversed dryshod, O Lord; and Thou leddest him into the mountain of Thy sanctuary, as he praised and sang a song of victory.[^5614]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*[^5615]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Grant me cleansing of the things committed by me, O Savior, and give me relief before I depart hence. Cleanse my many sores, O Lord, who cleansed the lepers; and vouchsafe me to stand blameless before Thee, when Thou comest to judge the living and the dead.[^5616]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The corruption that lies upon the eyes of my soul, preventing me from beholding Thy rays, which Thou didst spread out having appeared on earth, O unwaning Sun: cleanse this, O Savior, and grant me, O tenderhearted Lord, to contemplate the light of Thy graces.[^5617]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Having been watchful guardians of Christ's commandments, ye lulled to sleep all the malice of the enemy, O blessed sufferers. Therefore, I pray, raise me up unto divine watchfulness of repentance, who am weighed down with the sleep of sin.[^5618]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Entangled in the flesh with the taunting enemy, O Martyrs, ye overcame him by the weapon of the Cross, and drowned him in the flow of your blood, and received crowns of victory from God, chanting and singing a song of victory.[^5619]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Deliver me from evil habit, O pure Virgin! Establish me upon the rock of the commandments, shaken as I am by the wiles of the ancient supplanter, O Sovereign Lady; and vouchsafe me to be well-pleasing unto Christ, chanting and singing a song of victory.[^5620]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Second Canon, to John the Forerunner.*[^5621]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: O Baptist, accept this supplication.)*[^5622]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *A composition of Joseph.*[^5623]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Horse and rider into the Red Sea, He who crushes wars with a high arm, Christ did shake off; and Israel He saved, as they sang a song of victory.[^5624]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A cleansed manner of life and an immaterial life didst thou show forth, O Forerunner, in a material body. Therefore we pray thee: make those who bless thee in faith imitators of thyself.[^5625]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou who didst plunge the Abyss of tenderheartedness, Christ, into the streams of the river: beseech Him, O Forerunner, I pray, to dry up the abyss of my evils, and to enlighten my understanding.[^5626]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Forerunner of the Savior, interceding on my behalf for causes of repentance, ask that compunction be given me, washing away the mire of foul...[^5627]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: ...sin, praying the Lover of mankind, I beseech thee.[^5628]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Ineffably without pain didst thou bear Him whom the Father begat incorruptibly before the ages, O all-hymned Sovereign Lady; entreat Him to save from every harm those who flee unto thee.[^5629]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* My heart that is tossed by the waves of this life, O Lord, do Thou establish, guiding it into a quiet haven as God.[^5630]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Promising to repent unto Thee, O God, and sinning again, what shall become of me? How shall I appear when Thou judgest the earth?[^5631]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Let us bring supplications unto the Lord; let us sigh, let us shed tears here to cleanse defilements, that we may be delivered there.[^5632]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* With mortified mind the transgressors of the law wounded the victorious martyrs who loved life, as they confessed Christ.[^5633]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* The ranks of martyrs were numbered with the choirs of spiritual Angels, having become equal to the Angels by the grace of the Holy Spirit.[^5634]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Open now unto me the gates of repentance, O Virgin, gate of light: and close the entrances of passions of my humble soul.[^5635]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner.*[^5636]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* He who established the earth upon nothing by Thy command, and suspended it without restraint, though weighed down: upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments, O Christ, establish Thy Church, O only Good and Lover of mankind.[^5637]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Ever pouring forth healings unto those who draw near in faith unto thy temple, O marvelous Forerunner: heal the passions of my heart, I pray thee, which have all-wretchedly grown within me through heedlessness, O all-wealthy one.[^5638]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I sigh, and am ever held fast by lamentations, as I contemplate Thy judgment without bribe, O only most righteous Judge; wherein, by the entreaties of Thy Baptist, preserve me uncondemned, O Lord my God.[^5639]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having become mediator of the New and the Old [Covenant], O glorious Forerunner, by divine intercessions renew by repentance me who am grown old through many sins, I cry unto thee, that in praise I may honor thee.[^5640]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Holy Virgin Mother, only all-immaculate one, deliver us from the stain of transgressions; enlighten our...[^5641]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: ...thought, sanctify our hearts, and deliver us all from everlasting condemnation, we pray.[^5642]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* I heard, O Lord, the report of Thee, and I was afraid; I understood Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, O only Lover of mankind.[^5643]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having disregarded Thy words that enlighten, O Lord, I have done dark deeds; and I dread Thy fearful judgment there.[^5644]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With the sail of divine fear let us wing the ship of the soul, and reach the haven of repentance, having escaped the tempest of evils.[^5645]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Distilling sweetness, O Martyrs, ye were revealed as divine mountains and a God-planted paradise, having the Lord as the Tree of Life.[^5646]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* With the arrows of patience and endurance, O Holy Ones, ye shot down the taunting demons, and received crowns of glory.[^5647]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Most Pure Sovereign Lady, advocate of sinners, divine restoration of the fallen, as having given birth unto God, is glorified.[^5648]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner.*[^5649]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Having perceived Thy divine emptying, Habakkuk cried with trembling unto Thee, O Christ: Thou art come for the salvation of Thy people, to save Thine anointed.[^5650]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou hast taken up thy dwelling in the kingdom on high, as a true soldier of Christ the King, O Baptist: beseech Him incessantly to have compassion on the people that honor thee.[^5651]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The Lord sanctified thee from the womb, foreseeing the thankfulness of thy heart, O Blessed One: entreat Him to sanctify us all, we pray.[^5652]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Unto the dead didst thou preach the good tidings of the coming of Him who was put to death for our sake; beseech Him, O Forerunner, to make alive and save me also, who have been put to death by sins.[^5653]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Have mercy on me, O only All-immaculate One, who through exceedingly great goodness didst ineffably give birth unto the merciful God; and deliver me from eternal torment.[^5654]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* My wretched soul, that battles in the night against the darkness of passions, anticipate and have compassion upon; and shine forth, O Sun of righteousness, day-bright rays within me, so as to divide the night from the light.[^5655]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* From works there is no salvation for me; for much upon earth have I sinned, wretched one, and I tremble at Thy fearful judgment-seat, when Thou art about to judge the transgressors of Thy commandments, O God.[^5656]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* How have I become foolish? How have I been darkened, doing evil deeds? How did I not understand Thy fear, O Christ? I have bowed down unto the earth, and have become like irrational beasts; but turn me, O God of all.[^5657]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* The cloud of martyrs dispersed the clouds of bitter torments; and they illuminated the day of true understanding, and destroyed the gloom of polytheism, and attained unto the unwaning Light.[^5658]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Sanctify my mind by the prayers of Thy holy martyrs, O Christ, I pray, and show me full of enlightenment and a partaker of everlasting glory, that with glory I may hymn Thee, O Savior.[^5659]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* God by an ineffable Word hast thou borne unto us, O Virgin Mother, who grants repentance unto all that have sinned much, through thy good intercession, O refuge and haven of the faithful.[^5660]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner.*[^5661]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Clothed with light as with a garment, unto Thee I rise early, and unto Thee I cry: enlighten my darkened soul, O Christ, as the only tenderhearted One.[^5662]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A barren womb brought thee forth, O Forerunner, who showest hearts that are barren of good deeds to be fruitful in children, through thy fruitful words; therefore we call thee blessed.[^5663]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou hast blossomed forth as a fragrant lily, O ever-blessed one, in the wildernesses; therefore I cry unto thee: O Forerunner, drive far from my soul all foul stench of wickedness.[^5664]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou stoodest in the midst of the Law and of grace, O all-wise one; therefore I cry aloud: Have compassion upon me who am overcome by the law of sin, O Forerunner, wretchedly suffering in perils.[^5665]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Inpassable gate of glory, O Most Pure Lady, open unto me the gates of repentance, mediating for me divine entrances and the resting-place there.[^5666]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* As Thou didst deliver the prophet from the beast, O Lord, so also lead me up from the depth of uncontrollable passions, I pray, that I may look again toward Thy holy temple.[^5667]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Behold the time of turning, and I lie prostrate ever backward, held fast continually by much insensibility; loose the darkening of my heart, O Word, and have compassion on me.[^5668]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Groaning as once the publican, have compassion on me, O tenderhearted Christ; and as the harlot vouchsafe me warmly to shed tears, that I also may wash away the mire of my many transgressions.[^5669]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Great martyrs of Christ, snatch me who have sinned greatly from the great flame that is in Gehenna, awaiting me there, that greatly I also may glorify your memory ever.[^5670]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Having contended well, Thy sufferers were radiantly crowned by Thy life-originating right hand, O God and Lord; by their honorable entreaties save all Thy people.[^5671]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Tabernacle of sanctification that received the greeting "Rejoice", honorable ark, lampstand of divine light, Table of the Bread of Life, living Palace of the Word: show me to be a temple of the Spirit.[^5672]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner.*[^5673]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Raging with a soul-corrupting tempest, O Master Christ, calm the sea of passions, and bring me up from corruption, for Thou art tenderhearted.[^5674]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Shining with ineffable rays, O Forerunner of Christ, by thine active prayer enlighten the hearts of those that praise thee with piety.[^5675]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Held fast by the sleep of slothfulness, O Forerunner of Christ, enlighten me with grace, and raise me up zealously to do the divine desires.[^5676]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* From every hostile affliction deliver us, who have acquired thee as a divine advocate and intercessor before the Sovereign Lady, O Blessed One.[^5677]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A tempest of sin troubles me, O Most Pure Theotokos! Make haste to deliver me, guiding me unto the haven of repentance, O All-immaculate One.[^5678]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The prayer of the youths quenched the fire, bedewing the furnace, proclaiming the miracle, neither burning nor consuming the hymn-singers of the God of our fathers.[^5679]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* My lawless deeds and mine unrighteousnesses, my countless transgressions, O Christ, forgive, and deliver me from the torment that is...[^5680]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: ...to come, according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies, O God.[^5681]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Like the prodigal have I now wasted the wealth which I received, and I melt with hunger, deprived of divine food; accept me repenting, O Savior, and save me.[^5682]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Dead did ye make the contending enemy by members being put to death through many torments, O worthy-of-wonder Martyrs of the Lord! Therefore we faithful piously sing praise unto you.[^5683]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* The demonic hosts, the whole multitude of tormentors, O Martyrs, ye wounded with arrows, and by patience and valor ye now passed over unto true life.[^5684]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A saving haven hast thou appeared unto all, O Pure Lady, calming the storm of passions, and leading all the humble on earth unto quietness, O pure Mother of God.[^5685]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner.*[^5686]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The supremely exalted Lord of the fathers quenched the flame and bedewed the children as they sang in unison: Blessed art Thou, O God.[^5687]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* In words we pray thee, O Forerunner of the Word: as thou didst loose thy father's voice at thy birth, loose the snares of our transgressions.[^5688]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* All-radiant Sun, shine forth upon me the saving radiance of repentance, and deliver me from the darkness of passions that trouble my darkened heart.[^5689]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* A barren soul have I acquired, and a childless heart; O divine offspring of a barren woman, entreat incessantly Christ's Baptist, that fruits of repentance may sprout in me.[^5690]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Triadikon:* Equal to the Begetter we glorify the Son, and the Holy Spirit, divinely singing to the undivided Trinity: Blessed art Thou, O God.[^5691]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A young Child hast thou borne, O All-immaculate One, Christ who effects our renewal, who were grown old through the ancient transgression.[^5692]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The assembly of Angels, the congregation of men, the King and Creator of all, ye priests sing, ye Levites bless, ye peoples supremely exalt unto all ages.[^5693]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Behold, the wounds of my soul have become foul and corrupted, O Christ, and I have suffered and been brought completely low; by the remedies of repentance, O Savior, heal me.[^5694]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Deceitfully stealing upon me, the most crafty serpent filled me with evils; and sighing I cry: Cast me not away, O Word, who am condemned and brought low.[^5695]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Ye turned not aside from the better station, but cast down the enemies of the Cross who thought to trip you, O all-praised ones, having completely conquered, O most wise ones.[^5696]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* You, O all-praised Martyrs of the Lord, neither fire, nor sword, nor wild beasts, nor famine, nor breaking on wheels, nor any other torment was able to separate from Christ the Lover of mankind.[^5697]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Praise of Angels, and salvation of men, and surety be thou unto me, O Mother of God: that I may turn and receive forgiveness of the sins previously committed in knowledge and in ignorance.[^5698]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner.*[^5699]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Unto Thee, the Almighty Creator, the youths in the furnace, weaving a universal choir, sang: All ye works, bless the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^5700]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* With the streams of the Jordan thou washest the assembly of the people, preaching repentance, O great Forerunner. Therefore I cry unto thee: Dry up the flow of my passions, sending me fountains of tears.[^5701]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Be thou in all trembling, O soul, as thou contemplatest the judgment-seat of the Almighty, crying: O Compassionate One, for the sake of Thy Baptist, have compassion and save me, and deliver me from torments.[^5702]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Unclean lips and a defiled tongue do I move unto supplication to thee, holy Forerunner: hasten quickly to help me, who am continually shaken by all kinds of assaults of the deceiver.[^5703]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Triadikon:* Rain down upon us, O Father, and Son, and Spirit, consubstantial Trinity, forgiveness of transgressions: that having obtained perfect salvation, we may supremely exalt Thee unto all ages.[^5704]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou hast raised us up by thy lofty childbearing from the pit of fallings, O thou who art full of God's grace! Therefore with thankful voices in faith we hymn thee, O Maiden, unto all ages.[^5705]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Then we sing: "My soul magnifies the Lord:"*[^5706]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* For He that is mighty has done great things to thee, having shown thee a pure Virgin after childbearing, as having given birth without seed unto her Creator; therefore, O Theotokos, we magnify thee.[^5707]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* That I may magnify Thy long-suffering, O Jesus, be long-suffering yet toward me, and cut me not down as the barren fig tree, I cry unto Thee, that I may bring Thee fruits of repentance.[^5708]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* How terrible art Thou, O only Sovereign and Mighty One! And who shall stand against Thy fearful threatening, when Thou art about to sit Thyself in judgment? Wherein preserve me uncondemned.[^5709]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Bodily pains ye take away by the pains of your torments, O sufferers of the Lord; therefore heal the most grievous passions of my soul, as being most skilled physicians.[^5710]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* More than the rays of the sun shines the shrine of your relics, with beams of divine grace, and it enlightens hearts and illuminates souls of those that praise you in faith, O passion-bearers.[^5711]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A light-resembling cloud leading the new people unto the land of promise hast thou truly been revealed, O one full of God's grace, and the gate that leads unto life; therefore, O Theotokos, we magnify thee.[^5712]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner.*[^5713]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Rejoice, O Isaiah, a Virgin had in womb and bare a Son, Emmanuel, both God and man, Orient is His name; whom magnifying, we call the Virgin blessed.[^5714]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Behold, the beauty of thy temple is known as heaven upon earth, O Forerunner of Christ; coming into which, thou enlightenest with divine rays those that now call thee blessed in it throughout all days.[^5715]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As being the true friend of the Master, O Baptist, strengthen me unswervingly to love Him with an upright disposition, O all-blessed one, and to abhor corrupting passions that drag me down unto destruction.[^5716]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou wast not a reed shaken by contrary winds, O most wise one, but our divine establishment and the unshakable strengthening of the Church; which by thy prayers preserve unmoved, quelling every scandal.[^5717]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ ѿкры́ютсѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀! тма́мъ А҆́гг҃лѡвъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* The Creator's coming is at the doors! Why then dost thou not weep for thyself, O wretched soul, living in heedlessness? Arise and cry aloud unto the Lord: Spare me, O Savior, by the prayers of the Forerunner, as Lover of mankind.[^5718]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Свѣтоно́снаѧ колесни́ца со́лнца ꙗ҆ви́лася є҆сѝ вои́стинꙋ, возсїѧ́вшагѡ ѿ твоегѡ̀ Всенепоро́чнаѧ Чи́стаѧ бо́кꙋ, и҆ разрꙋши́вшагѡ пре́лести лю́тꙋю тмꙋ̀; тѣ́мже подо́лгꙋ тѧ̀ вѣ́рою оу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A light-bearing chariot of the Sun hast thou truly been revealed, of Him who shone forth from thy side, O All-immaculate, Pure One, and destroyed the grievous darkness of deceit; therefore as is due, in faith we call thee blessed.[^5719]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: и҆ є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: and the Little Ectenia. Then the Photagogicon and the customary Psalms.*[^5720]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Та́же свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̀ ѻ҆бы́чныѧ.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 5:*[^5721]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Мно́жества прегрѣше́нїй мои́хъ пре́зри Гдⷭ҇и, и҆́же ѿ Дѣ́вы рожде́йсѧ, и҆ всѧ̑ ѡ҆чи́сти беззакѡ́нїа моѧ̑; мы́сль мнѣ̀ подава́й ѡ҆браще́нїѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ человѣколю́бецъ, молю́сѧ, и҆ поми́лꙋй мѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Overlook the multitudes of my transgressions, O Lord born of the Virgin, and cleanse all mine iniquities; grant me a mindset of repentance, as the only Lover of mankind, I pray, and have mercy on me.[^5722]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: И҆спо́лнихомсѧ заꙋ́тра ми́лости твоеѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ возра́довахомсѧ и҆ возвесели́хомсѧ: - - - И҆ при́зри на рабы̀ твоѧ̑, и҆ на дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, и҆ наста́ви сы́ны и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad: - - - And look upon Thy servants and upon Thy works, and guide their sons.* [^5723]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀! комꙋ̀ оу҆подо́бихсѧ а҆́зъ? непло́днѣй смоко́вницѣ; и҆ бою́сѧ проклѧ́тїа съ посѣче́нїемъ: но нбⷭ҇ный дѣ́лателю Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, ѡ҆ладенѣ́вшꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ, плодоно́снꙋ покажѝ, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋ́днаго сы́на прїимѝ мѧ̀, и҆ поми́лꙋй мѧ̀.
