items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Woe is me! Unto what have I likened myself? Unto the barren fig tree; and I fear the curse together with the felling: but O heavenly Husbandman, Christ God, show my dried-up soul to be fruitful, and receive me as the prodigal son, and have mercy on me.[^5724]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: И҆ бꙋ́ди свѣ́тлость Гдⷭ҇а Бг҃а на́шегѡ на на́съ, и҆ дѣла̀ рꙋ́къ на́шихъ и҆спра́ви на на́съ; и҆ дѣ́ло рꙋ́къ на́шихъ и҆спра́ви.
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and prosper Thou the works of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands do Thou prosper.* [^5725]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Страстоте́рпцы твоѝ Гдⷭ҇и, чинѡ́мъ А҆́гг҃льскимъ подража́телїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ безпло́тнїи мꙋ́ки претерпѣ́ша, є҆диномꙑ́сленно оу҆пова́нїе и҆мꙋ́ще, ѡ҆бѣща́нныхъ бла́гъ наслажде́нїа; моли́твами и҆́хъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, ми́ръ мі́рови твоемꙋ̀ да́рꙋй, и҆ дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Thy Passion-bearers, O Lord, emulators of the Angelic ranks, endured torments as though bodiless, having unanimous hope of the enjoyment of promised blessings; by their prayers, O Christ God, grant peace unto Thy world, and great mercy unto our souls.[^5726]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Наде́жде ненаде́жныхъ, животѐ ѿча́ѧнныхъ, застꙋпле́нїе къ тебѣ̀ притѣка́ющихъ ст҃а́ѧ Влады́чице, Бцⷢе Дѣ́во: по́мощь твою̀ низпослѝ на́мъ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Hope of the hopeless, Life of the despairing, Protection of those who flee unto thee, O holy Lady, Virgin Theotokos: send down thy help upon us.[^5727]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Бла́го є҆́сть и҆сповѣ́датисѧ Гдⷭ҇еви: Трисвѧто́е; по Ѻ҆́тче на́шъ: тропа́рь є҆ктенїа̀ и҆ Ча́съ пе́рвый.
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise unto the Lord: Trisagion; after Our Father: troparion, ectenia, and the First Hour.*[^5728]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Разбо́йникъ на крестѣ̀ Бг҃а тѧ̀ бы́ти вѣ́ровавъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, и҆сповѣ́да тѧ̀ чи́стѣ ѿ се́рдца: помѧни́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и, вопїѧ̀, въ ца́рствїи твое́мъ.
items.english_text: *On Tuesday, The Beatitudes, Tone 5:*[^5729]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The thief on the cross having believed Thee to be God, O Christ, confessed Thee purely from the heart, crying: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom.[^5730]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Even as Thou didst justify, O Christ, the harlot who wept from her whole soul, so also me, O Master...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: ...who am despairing, snatch me from all torment, O Good One, I pray.[^5731]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* John who ran before Christ and prepared the good paths, let us unanimously call blessed, that by his divine prayers we may be delivered from transgressions.[^5732]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Ye who with fervent soul drank Christ's cup, O Martyrs, deliver us from turbid sins and diseases by the rain-showers of your divine prayers, O holy ones.[^5733]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Glory... Triadikon:* O incomprehensible God, almighty Trinity and Unity, by the prayers of Thy Forerunner save me, delivering me from darkness and from the fire that lies before me.[^5734]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Ever defiled by evil deeds, O Virgin, I pray thee, the undefiled Mother of the Master: cleanse me from every defilement, O Lady.[^5735]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *On Tuesday Evening:*[^5736]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 5:*[^5737]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Thou wast lifted up as a lamb upon the Cross, and didst cast down the haughtiness of the deceiver; having been slain, Thou didst sanctify the whole earth with Thy blood; and pierced with a spear, Thou didst immediately command the flaming sword to turn its back to me, O Christ, and grant entry into Paradise, and that I might fearlessly enjoy the Tree of Life. Therefore, being saved by Thy Passion, I cry rejoicing: Glory to Thy divine Cross, whereby we have been delivered from the ancient curse, and embrace the blessing from the Tree, and great mercy.[^5739]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Desiring to bring an end to the pains and reproaches of men, O most good Lord, my Savior, Thou didst endure a reproachful crucifixion and didst taste gall, O Innocent One, taking away our wicked bitterness; and being wounded, O Word, by the piercing of Thy side, Thou healest our wounds as Master. Therefore also we sing of Thy glorious willing condescension, and bowing down we venerate...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: ...the spear, and the sponge, and the reed, whereby Thou hast granted peace and great mercy unto Thy world.[^5740]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Desiring to tear up to the end the all-grievous handwriting of Adam the first-formed, O Lover of mankind, as Adam's Creator Thou wast affixed with nails, O sinless Christ; and having had Thy divine side wounded with a spear for our sake, Thou commandest the flaming sword, O Word, not to bar the entry unto us, Thy servants. Therefore, giving glory unto Thee, we sing of Thy dominion, and we venerate Thy Cross, and we hymn Thee, O Lover of mankind, whereby every nature has found a painless inheritance, and great mercy.[^5741]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Theotokos, the same Tone:*[^5742]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* How did the lawless Hebrew multitude condemn Thee, O Jesus, to be crucified upon the Cross, having no compassion on Thee who art compassionate? the Virgin cried weeping of old, when she beheld lifted up upon the Cross Him whom she impassibly bare from her womb: What has the lawless synagogue done unto Thee, O my longed-for Child, my most dearly beloved Son? Make haste and save those who in faith glorify Thy crucifixion, and who magnify me as Thou didst promise, as the only all-good One.[^5743]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* A ransom for our sake, and a great price, even Thy most pure blood, didst Thou deign to give, O my sinless Christ, desiring that all should obtain salvation. Therefore Thy Mother, beholding Thee nailed, lamented and tore her hair, saying: Child, all-immaculate Lamb, who desirest to deliver the world by Thy precious blood, how hast Thou set from mine eyes, O Savior, never-setting Sun, who grantest enlightenment, and peace, and great mercy unto all![^5744]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Truly a Cherubic throne higher than creation hast thou been; for into thee, O Pure One, desiring to renew our form, the divine Word entered, and having come forth from thee bearing flesh, as the Compassionate One, He accepted the Cross and Passion for our sake, and as God granted the Resurrection. Therefore, giving thanks to the Creator as having reconciled our condemned nature, unto Him and unto thee we cry: Grant us remission of transgressions and mercy, by thy prayers.[^5745]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding of old her Lamb hastening unto the slaughter, the Ewe-lamb followed fervently, crying these things unto Him: Whither goest Thou, my sweetest Child, O Christ? For what cause dost Thou run this course so swiftly without slackening, O Long-suffering One? O Jesus most desired, sinless and most merciful Lord, give a word unto Thy handmaid, my all-beloved Son! Disdain me not in silence, O Compassionate One, who marvelously bare Thee; O God the Giver of life, grant great mercy unto the world.[^5746]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light: Prokeimenon of the day. Vouchsafe, O Lord, to keep us this evening:*[^5747]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 5:*[^5748]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* O Lord, of old under Moses the Prophet, the mere image of Thy Cross when revealed conquered Thine enemies; but now having the Cross itself, we ask for help: strengthen Thy Church, and grant victory unto our Emperor *(Name)*, as unto Constantine, for the sake of Thy great mercy, O Lover of mankind.[^5749]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Thy Cross, O Christ, even though visible as wood in substance, is yet clothed with divine power; and visibly manifest unto the world, it spiritually works our salvation. Bowing down before it, we glorify Thee, O Savior: have mercy on us.[^5751]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us, for we are utterly filled with contempt. Our soul is exceedingly filled with the reproach of the prosperous, and with the contempt of the proud.* [^5752]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Pray for us, holy Martyrs, that we may be delivered from our transgressions; for unto you grace is given to pray for us.[^5753]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: Having taken on my entire form, the Creator and God clothed Himself, desiring to reshape the form of Adam that had fallen of old; He was lifted up upon the Cross willingly as guilty, now spreading out His hands, healing the hands that of old reached slackly toward the tree of eating. Beholding Him, the All-pure One cried aloud: What is this Thine ineffable long-suffering, O my Son? I cannot endure to see Thee lifted up upon the Cross, who holdest the ends of the whole earth in Thy hand![^5755]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparion of the Saint; Glory... Both now... Theotokion in the Tone of the Troparion; ectenia and dismissal.*[^5756]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *On Tuesday at Small Compline.*[^5757]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.*[^5758]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Horse and rider into the Red Sea, He that shatters battles with a high arm, Christ did shake off; and Israel He saved, as they sang a song of victory.[^5759]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^5760]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Receiving the prayers of thy servants brought faithfully unto thee from the depth of the heart, O Theotokos, and offering them unto thy Son, grant remission of transgressions...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: ...brought unto thee, O Theotokos, and offering them unto thy Son, grant remission of transgressions.[^5761]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Truly being a benefactress, enriching the earth-born, and the door of salvation leading unto life, O Virgin Mother of God, cease never standing in intercession for those who pray to thee.[^5762]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Glory... Troparion 3:* Now inclined by the supplications of thy singers, as being a mighty help toward salvation, delivering them from calamities by thy prayers, O Lady, preserve intact those who honor thee.[^5763]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Both now... Troparion 4:* Making haste quickly and interceding fervently, O most holy Virgin, having compassion deliver us who are sorely possessed by cruel circumstances, and set us free from sorrow.[^5764]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou who by Thy command didst establish the earth upon nothing, and didst suspend its weight hanging uncontained, establish Thy Church upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments, O Christ, the only Good One and Lover of mankind.[^5765]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having illuminated the dark cloud of my heart by the wakeful, divine prayer of thy light, O Mother of God, show me to be a son of the day enlightened by virtues, O guide of light for our souls.[^5766]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Desiring ever to hymn thee worthily, yet at a loss, we bring praise from humble lips; graciously accept it, and be attentive to the supplications of those who pray to thee in faith.[^5767]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Glory... Troparion 3:* Showing barren souls to be fruitful and cleansing what is grown wild by thy prayer, do thou, O Parent of God, show also my soul to bear fruit: faith and an undefiled life.[^5768]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Both now... Troparion 4:* How is He who holds the ends of the whole earth in His hand embraced by maternal arms? and He is nourished with milk from the breasts, who satisfies every living thing with goodwill, and He who is rich in outpouring becomes poor by being incarnate.[^5769]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Having understood Thy divine emptying, Habakkuk farsightedly cried out unto Thee with trembling, O Christ: For the salvation of Thy people, to save Thine anointed ones art Thou come.[^5770]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Knowing thee as our only Mediatress unto God, who looses the debts of sins...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: ...unto the guilty, O All-pure One, we honor thee with praises and hymns.[^5771]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having dwelt in thee, God showed thee to be a sanctified temple, O all-immaculate Virgin; pray Him unceasingly to preserve Thy servants unharmed.[^5772]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Glory... Troparion 3:* Hear the prayer of the poor who place their hope in thee, O Theotokos, and make haste to deliver us from misfortunes by thy maternal bold intercession.[^5773]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Both now... Troparion 4:* Having acquired thee, O Mother of God, as sweet consolation in afflictions, help in perils, and protectress in misfortunes, we are delivered from every oppression.[^5774]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Thou that coverest Thyself with light as with a garment, I awake early unto Thee and cry to Thee: Enlighten my darkened soul, O Christ, as the only Compassionate One.[^5775]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having in time brought forth in circumscribed flesh Him who is truly uncircumscribed by nature, the First Principle: pray Him unceasingly for thy servants.[^5776]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou drawest near quickly unto those in distress, ever helping and guiding toward salvation those who call upon thee in temptations, O All-pure One.[^5777]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Glory... Troparion 3:* Showing the merciful God to be propitious by nature through thy prayers, grant unto thy servants a peaceful life and deliverance from transgressions, O All-immaculate One.[^5778]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Both now... Troparion 4:* O thou who barest the live Coal whom Isaiah beheld, burn up for me the matter of sins, O All-immaculate One, and enlighten me, I pray.[^5779]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Raging with a soul-corrupting tempest, O Master Christ, tame the sea of passions, and bring me up from corruption, as Thou art compassionate.[^5780]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having raised us up who were slain by the passions of sin, make us alive by thy prayers, O Lady, as having given birth unto the Destroyer of corruption.[^5781]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having thee as our unfailing hope, an invincible rampart against enemies, and steadfast help, we shall not fear plots against us.[^5782]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Glory... Troparion 3:* Ever stand by the earth-born in afflictions, O Pure One, and preserve unharmed from the cruel wounds that afflict thy servants.[^5783]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Both now... Troparion 4:* Enlighten my soul darkened by the cloud of thoughts...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: ...that assault me, O Bride of God, through the plotting of the man-slaying demon.[^5784]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Then: Lord, have mercy (3 times). Glory... Both now...*[^5785]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 5:* By the Cross of thy Son, O woman full of God's grace, all idol deception was abolished, and demonic might was trampled down. Therefore as is due, we the faithful ever hymn and bless thee, and confessing thee truly as Theotokos, we magnify thee.[^5786]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The supremely exalted Lord of the fathers quenched the flame and bedewed the youths, who sang in unison: Blessed art Thou, O God.[^5787]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Receive the petitions of thy faithful servants, O Lady, taking away perils and saving from sorrows those who sing in faith: Blessed art Thou, O God.[^5788]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O thou who didst bear God the Worker of good things for us, entreat Him by maternal supplications, O Pure One, to show mercy unto those who boast in thee.[^5789]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Glory... Troparion 3:* Having acquired thee, O Lady, as an invincible protectress and an unshakable foundation, and being clothed with thy protection, we overcome the machinations of the archer that are against us.[^5790]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Both now... Troparion 4:* Behold the lowliness of thy servant, O Lady, and set me free from the eternal fire, as I unceasingly sing: Blessed art Thou, O God.[^5791]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Unto Thee, the Almighty Creator, the youths in the furnace, weaving a universal choir, sang: All ye works, sing the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^5792]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Weaving praise unto thee, O Virgin, with words and thoughts together, we the faithful cry aloud: Sing the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages.[^5793]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Solomon fore-inscribed thee in all thy beauty as the neighbor of God, as being nearest unto Him, O Virgin, delivering those who are in the world by maternal bold intercession.[^5794]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Glory... Troparion 3:* Having thee after God as the hope of salvation in perils, we the faithful cry aloud: All ye works of the Lord, sing the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages.[^5795]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Both now... Troparion 4:* Receive a song from humble lips, O all-hymned Virgin, of those who cry aloud unto thee: Rejoice, medicine of those sick in body, and salvation of despairing souls.[^5796]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Rejoice, O Isaiah, a Virgin had in womb and bare a Son, Emmanuel, both God and man, Orient is His name; whom magnifying, we call the Virgin blessed.[^5797]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Unto thee we pour out our prayer that comes from affliction: have mercy on us sinners, that we may not be put to shame in the day of temptation, who call upon thee the all-merciful Theotokos.[^5798]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Despise not the kinship of dust, O pure Lady, but be a helper who shields, strengthening in sorrows, and delivering all the infirm; for in thee do we place our hope, who art ready to save us.[^5799]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Glory... Troparion 3:* O God, hear the prayer of Thy people now, and deliver us from the harm of the enemy; behold, we bring unto Thee as true propitiation her who bare Thee, whom in love we call blessed.[^5800]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Both now... Troparion 4:* Under the dominion of thy might, O Lady, all of us earth-born diligently flee, asking for mercy and thy merciful compassions; having poured them forth, sanctify us all.[^5801]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Trisagion; after Our Father: Troparion and the rest as usual.*[^5802]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *At Wednesday Matins:*[^5803]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *After the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 5:*[^5804]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* The Place of the Skull became Paradise; for no sooner was the Tree of the Cross planted than it immediately brought forth the cluster of life unto our joy, even Thee, O Savior. Glory to Thee.[^5805]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Our Savior and Redeemer who was crucified willingly as He knows and as He was well pleased, let us the faithful hymn and glorify; for He nailed the sins of men upon the Cross, delivering the human race from deception, and has made them worthy of the Kingdom.[^5807]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* When she who bare Thee without travail beheld Thee lifted up upon the Tree, she lamented with weeping and cried aloud: Woe is me, sweetest Son! I am wounded in soul, beholding Thee upon the Cross between two thieves, nailed as a malefactor.[^5808]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *After the second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 5:*[^5809]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Thou who didst endure crucifixion of Thine own will, and didst deliver men from corruption...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: ...O Savior: we the faithful hymn and bow down before Thee, for Thou hast enlightened us by the power of the Cross; and in fear we glorify Thee, O merciful Lover of mankind, as the Giver of life and Lord.[^5810]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* The Tree of Thy Cross, O our Savior, has been revealed as salvation unto the world; for thereon Thou wast nailed willingly, and didst deliver the earth-born from the curse. O Joy of all, Lord, glory to Thee.[^5812]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* O Lord, Thy Passion-bearers having emulated the cup of Thy passions, abandoned the fairest things of life, and became partakers with the Angels; by their supplications grant peace and great mercy unto our souls, O Christ.[^5814]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* By the Cross of thy Son, O woman full of God's grace, all idol deception was abolished, and demonic might was trampled down; therefore as is due, we the faithful ever hymn and bless thee, and confessing thee truly as Theotokos, we magnify thee.[^5815]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *After the third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns:*[^5816]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* The prophetic utterances are now fulfilled, Thy counsel of old has reached its fulfillment; for Thou willingly, O King of all, didst impoverish Thyself in the flesh, O Christ, and didst accept for our sake to ascend the Cross and endure death; therefore we glorify Thy condescension beyond understanding, O Word.[^5818]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Beholding Thee nailed and asleep upon the Cross, the angelic ranks were terrified, O Jesus, All-King! and immediately the demonic regiments took flight, and the bars of hades were shattered, and the tyranny of death was overthrown, and the dead that were in the tombs were raised.[^5819]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Thee upon the Cross, O Christ, hanging willingly between two thieves, Thy Mother was torn in her maternal womb and said: O sinless Son, how art Thou unjustly nailed upon the Cross as a malefactor? Thou who desirest to make alive the human race, as Compassionate.[^5820]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Precious Cross.*[^5821]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: Raising up the world, O Christ, Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree.)*[^5822]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *The work of Joseph.*[^5823]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Horse and rider into the Red Sea, He that shatters battles with a high arm, Christ did shake off; and Israel He saved, as they sang a song of victory.[^5824]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Crucifixion.*[^5825]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Him who is understood in incomprehensibility, incarnate and manifest unto the world in the flesh, who of old willed it, the lawless Hebrew assembly lifted up upon the Tree.[^5826]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When the Hebrews, hanging upon Thee, lifted Thee up upon the Tree of the Cross as a fruitful vine, O Christ, then didst Thou distil the wine of gladness, O Word, taking away all intoxication of evils.[^5827]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Your endurance falls not under the laws of praise, O Martyrs; for beyond every human nature ye endured pains, and rejoicing ye settled in painless rest.[^5828]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Having sailed through the waves of torments by the pilotage of the Word, O all-lauded sufferers of Christ, ye reached the heavenly havens, now enjoying divine tranquility.[^5829]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beholding the Lord born of thy womb unjustly lifted up upon the Tree, O Virgin, thou didst weep, and didst hymn His truly ineffable condescension.[^5830]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos.*[^5831]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: A fifth song is now sung unto the Virgin.)*[^5832]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Tone 5. The same Heirmos:*[^5833]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Door of divine glory, who didst open the doors of Paradise, open unto me also the doors of repentance, I pray, and enlighten my mind to sing of thee, O thou full of God's grace.[^5834]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou hast stayed the assault of death, having given birth unto Him who holds sway over life and death, O All-immaculate One! Pray Him, therefore, to stay the transgressions that slay my soul, and to save me.[^5835]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* As the one beauty of Jacob from among the generations, the Word co-unoriginate with the Father chose thee, and was incarnate of thy blood. O Lady, save me by thine intercessions.[^5836]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* As the heavenly rain upon the fleece, having descended upon thee, hast thou brought forth, O All-pure One; therefore dry up the torrential downpours of my passions, I pray thee, O Mother Virgin.[^5837]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ блꙋдни́цꙋ пла́кавшꙋю ѿ всеѧ̀ дꙋшы̀, та́кожде и҆ менѐ Влⷣко...
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou who by Thy command didst establish the earth upon nothing, and didst suspend its weight hanging uncontained, establish Thy Church upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments, O Christ, the only Good One and Lover of mankind.[^5838]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Распина́ешисѧ, и҆ ра́й па́ки ѿверза́етсѧ, и҆ разбо́йникъ пре́жде всѣ́хъ ра́дꙋѧсѧ вхо́дитъ; оу҆мира́еши І҆и҃се мо́й, и҆ вра́гъ ле́стецъ оу҆мерщвлѧ́етсѧ, оу҆мерщвле́нный же А҆да́мъ ѡ҆живла́етсѧ. Сла́ва мно́гомꙋ твоемꙋ̀ милосе́рдїю.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou art crucified, and Paradise is opened again, and the thief enters rejoicing before all; Thou diest, O my Jesus, and the deceiving enemy is put to death, while dead Adam is brought to life. Glory to Thy great mercy.[^5839]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆вѧда́еши грѣхо́вный пла́мень, распина́емь І҆и҃се на дре́вѣ за бла́гость; рѣша́еши пре́лесть, свѧзꙋ́емь; ѡ҆бнаже́нъ бы́въ, ѡ҆дѣва́еши ѡ҆де́ждею сла́вы человѣ́ка. Сла́ва мно́гомꙋ благоꙋтро́бїю твоемꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou witherest the flame of sin, being crucified upon the Tree for goodness' sake, O Jesus; Thou dissolvest deception, being bound; stripped naked, Thou clothest man with a robe of glory. Glory to Thy great tender-heartedness.[^5840]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Светлѣ́й присносїѧ́ющїѧ ѕвѣ́зды мꙋ́ченики, нече́стїѧ тмꙋ̀ прогонѧ́ющїѧ; тѣ́хъ мольба́ми Хрⷭ҇тѐ, но́щь ѕѡ́лъ мои́хъ ѿженѝ, и҆ просвѣтѝ ѡ҆мраче́нное моѐ се́рдце.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* As brightly ever-shining stars, the Martyrs drive away the darkness of impiety; by their supplications, O Christ, drive off the night of my wicked deeds, and enlighten my darkened heart.[^5841]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Зако́ннѡ бг҃осла́внїи пострада́вше мч҃еницы, зако́нною вѣ́рою вѣнцы̀ вѣнча́ни бы́ша, и҆ беззако́ннꙋющихъ совѣ́ты оу҆клони́ша мꙋ́дрѣ, и҆ пи́щꙋ бж҃е́ственнꙋю прїѧ́ша, и҆ ра́йское вселе́нїе.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Having lawfully suffered, O divinely glorious Martyrs, ye were crowned with wreaths through lawful faith, and wisely turned away from the counsels of the lawless, and received divine nourishment and the dwelling of Paradise.[^5842]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Пою́тъ а҆́гг҃лстїи ли́ци тѧ̀ Всепѣ́таѧ, безъ разсꙋжде́нїѧ си́хъ преимꙋ́щꙋю; Бг҃а бо родила̀ є҆сѝ пло́тїю, ѿ дре́ва кла́твꙋ дре́вомъ погꙋ́бльшаго, и҆ благослове́нїе и҆сточи́вшаго.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The angelic choirs sing of thee, O All-hymned One, as excelling them beyond question; for thou hast in the flesh given birth unto God, who destroyed the curse of the tree by the Tree, and poured forth blessing.[^5843]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Стрѣла́ми грѣхо́вными оу҆ѧ́звеннаго мѧ̀, въ тебѣ̀ лѣчбо́ю всегѡ̀ и҆сцѣлѝ Чи́стаѧ, и҆ ѿ содержа́щихъ мѧ̀ и҆змѣнѝ болѣ́зней, ꙗ҆́же болѣ́зней премѣни́вшаѧ ро́дъ человѣ́ческїй, рождество́мъ твои́мъ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The same Heirmos:*[^5844]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же всѐ смире́нное се́рдце моѐ ѡ҆скорбллѧ́ющїѧ, и҆ и҆́щꙋщїѧ оу҆мертви́ти мѧ̀ неви́димыѧ врагѝ, Влⷣчце, твои́мъ низложѝ застꙋпле́нїемъ, да пребꙋ́дꙋтъ бездѣ́лни, стыда̀ и҆сполнѧ́еми.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Wounded by the arrows of sin, heal me entirely by the medicine that is in thee, O Pure One, and deliver me from the diseases that encompass me, O thou who by thy childbearing didst exchange the diseases of the human race.[^5845]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Во́дъ живо́тныхъ мѧ̀ и҆спо́лни Влⷣчце, ꙗ҆́же бж҃е́ственнꙋю во́дꙋ мі́рови и҆сточи́вшаѧ; беззако́нїй мои́хъ лю́тыѧ и҆зсꙋшѝ пото́ки, и҆ се́рдца моегѡ̀ вѡ́лны боже́ственною твое́ю тишино́ю оу҆кротѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Cast down by thy protection, O Lady, the invisible enemies that afflict all my humble heart and seek to put me to death, that they may remain ineffective, filled with shame.[^5846]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Fill me with living waters, O Lady, who didst pour forth divine water unto the world; dry up the grievous torrents of mine iniquities, and calm the waves of my heart by thy divine tranquility.[^5847]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* The things shadowily performed by the Law have passed away; for thou hast given birth unto Christ the Lawgiver, who ordains for us the grace of cleansing and enlightenment, and who delivers...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: ...from the curse, O all-immaculate, pure Virgin.[^5848]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Understanding Thine emptying, O Christ, Habakkuk cried out foresightedly unto Thee with trembling: Unto the salvation of Thy people, to save Thine anointed, art Thou come.[^5849]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Wrought complete deliverance for souls, O Christ, Thou didst commit Thy most holy soul into the hands of the Father, hanging willingly upon the Tree.[^5850]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The unjust judge condemned Thee, the righteous Judge, O Jesus, to die hanging upon the Tree, that Thou mightest justify us who had unjustly bowed down unto the enemy.[^5851]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Ye were accounted worthy to behold the good things from the ages, O Martyrs, having manifestly partaken of many perils, and tribulations, and innumerable torments upon the earth.[^5852]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Ye passed through the winter of temptations, and reached the spring of heavenly recompense, and were numbered among the Angelic choirs, O honorable Martyrs.[^5853]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The sword of the divine Passions passed through thy soul, O Blessed One, when thou didst behold thy Son crucified, and committing His soul into the hands of the Father.[^5854]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The same Heirmos:*[^5855]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* From works there is no salvation for me; therefore unto thy shelter do I flee with hope, O all-immaculate Virgin: save me, the despairing one, by thy prayers.[^5856]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O pure receptacle of the Light, honorable vehicle of the Sun: illuminate my heart darkened by the gloom of wicked evils, and save me, I pray, O Lady.[^5857]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Maiden who didst weave a garment from thy virginal blood for Him who clothes heaven with clouds: clothe me with the garment of incorruption, who am stripped naked through deception.[^5858]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having taken thee as a lily from the valleys of life, the Creator breathed forth from thee spiritual fragrance unto the world, O most holy Virgin, Bride of God.[^5859]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Thou who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, unto Thee do I rise early and unto Thee do I cry: Enlighten my darkened soul, O Christ, as the only Compassionate One.[^5860]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst stand to be judged, O righteous Judge, Christ, condemning enmity in the flesh; and struck with a reed...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: ...and Thou didst sign complete freedom for me.[^5861]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When the sun beheld Thee hanging in the flesh upon the Tree, O Christ, it turned its light into darkness, and the earth was shaken, and the rocks were split asunder.[^5862]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Ye sanctified the ends of the earth; for as fulfillers of the divine Law, O all-lauded Martyrs, suffering ye inherited holiness.[^5863]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Let the most noble and divinely radiant Martyrs be honored, who were clothed with divine glory and stripped bare the malice of the enemy.[^5864]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee, the all-immaculate Mother of God, do we call blessed, for whose sake the curse was made barren, and deliverance and blessing were given.[^5865]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The same Heirmos:*[^5866]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* May I find thee as a helper, O Virgin, delivering me in the judgment hour of condemnation, when I shall stand before the tribunal of Him who was born of thee.[^5867]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Overcome as I am by the law of sin, O Pure One, and often deceived by the deceits of the stranger, and cast down into the precipices of transgressions: turn me back.[^5868]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O thou who didst give birth unto the live Coal whom Isaiah beheld: consume the matter of my transgressions, O All-immaculate One, and enlighten me, I pray.[^5869]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having lent flesh from thy blood unto Christ, O Virgin: cleanse my carnal passions utterly, and show me the path of dispassion.[^5870]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Calm the sea of passions raging with a soul-corrupting tempest, O Master Christ, and bring me up from corruption, as Thou art Compassionate.[^5871]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Lifted up upon the Tree, O Long-suffering One, Thou didst cast down all the haughty risings of the enemy, and didst save him that was fallen, for the sake of Thy great goodness.[^5872]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When the souls of the righteous of old perceived Thee committing Thy soul upon the Tree, O Master Word, they were loosed from eternal bonds.[^5873]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* As steadfast diamonds, ye endured every kindling of torments with patient disposition, and having humbled yourselves, ye cast down the enemy.[^5874]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Having become emulators of Christ's...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: ...passions having become, ye endured every torment, O Passion-bearers of the Lord; therefore ye were accounted worthy of heavenly splendors.[^5875]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Marvelous is thy childbearing, which works great miracles and is glorified among the saints, O Theotokos, only all-marvelous Lady.[^5876]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The same Heirmos:*[^5877]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Let not the depth of despondency swallow me up, O Lady, and let not the wave of sin cover me; but by thy prayer may I be saved, O only Pure One.[^5878]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The lampstand of the Law prefigured thee, O All-pure One, who gavest birth unto the Light that enlightened all things; therefore I cry unto thee: Enlighten me who am darkened.[^5879]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O all-pure and good-loving Lady, who didst give birth unto the good Benefactor and Creator: make good my afflicted soul.[^5880]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Thou hast given birth unto the Cause of salvation, the Giver of life, who truly grants eternal deliverance unto us who proclaim thee as Theotokos.[^5881]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The supremely exalted Lord of the fathers quenched the flame and bedewed the youths, as they sang in unison: Blessed art Thou, O God.[^5882]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The law-transgressing council crowned Thee with thorns, O immortal King, who cuttest down from the root the thorny weeds of deception. Blessed art Thou, O God.[^5883]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* That Thou mightest clothe me with the garment of incorruption, O Word, Thou wast stripped naked willingly; and Thou endurest spittings, and crucifixion, and Passion, being impassible by essence.[^5884]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Conformed unto the Passions of Him that rules over all, O Saints, ye are truly sons and heirs of the unshakable Kingdom.[^5885]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Ye brought no honor unto senseless idols of wood, honoring Him who stretched out His hands upon the Tree as King and Master of all.[^5886]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Strange is thy childbearing, O All-immaculate One! For thou hast given birth unto God, who by the Tree withered the flame of deception, and enlightened the world.[^5887]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The same Heirmos:*[^5888]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I sing of thee, O All-hymned One! For seedlessly thou hast given birth unto the supremely hymned God, O most holy Virgin, who deifies those that sing: Blessed art Thou, O God.[^5889]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Put my passions to death, O thou who didst give birth unto Life; raise me up who lie in the tomb of insensibility, that with love I may glorify thee, O Bride of God.[^5890]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Look upon the entreaties of thy servants, O Lady, delivering from perils and saving from tribulations those who sing in faith: Blessed art Thou, O God.[^5891]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Thou hast given birth unto the Incalculably Powerful One who bare our infirmity, O Pure One; entreat Him to heal my soul that is grievously enfeebled.[^5892]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Unto Thee, Creator of all, the youths in the furnace, having woven a universal choir, sang: All ye works, sing the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^5893]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O most high God, Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross, being given gall to drink, O Sweetness of life! Pierced with a spear, Thou didst slay the serpent that cast Adam down in Paradise.[^5894]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou loosest me from the bonds of sin, O Word, being willingly bound, and with eternal bonds binding the apostate enemy, O Savior; therefore do I glorify Thy Passions unto the ages.[^5895]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Ye were revealed as partakers of the immaterial light, being secondary lights, O holy Martyrs, taking away the darkness of deception, and divinely enlightening the hearts of all the faithful.[^5896]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Ye became sons of the free Jerusalem above, O Martyrs, enlightening the church of the firstborn, and supremely exalting Christ unto the ages.[^5897]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst stand by the Cross, O Maiden, beholding nailed Christ, unto whom thou hadst given birth, O Lady; therefore thou didst cry aloud: Leave me not childless, O unoriginate Son and Word of the unoriginate Father.[^5898]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The same Heirmos:*[^5899]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O most fair and divinely radiant Virgin, having beautified me with the vision of good things, enlighten me, that I may cry: Sing the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages.[^5900]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Gate of light, open unto me the light-radiant gates of repentance, showing every right path of righteousness that leads unto the entrance of the divine will.[^5901]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Ineffably hast thou given birth unto the Holy Word who sanctifies the faithful, O Pure One; entreat Him, O Most Holy One, to sanctify now my humble soul, which is defiled by evil.[^5902]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* A bright stream and fountain of dispassion proceeded from thee, O holy Lady, even the Lord of all; therefore I cry unto thee, O Pure One: Dry up the streams of my wicked deeds with the showers of thy prayers.[^5903]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *My soul magnifies the Lord:*[^5904]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Rejoice, O Isaiah: a Virgin had in womb and bare a Son, Emmanuel, both God and man, Orient is His name; whom magnifying, we call the Virgin blessed.[^5905]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As a lamb Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree, O Master Christ, crushing the jaws of the spiritual wolf, and snatching Thy rational sheep from his mouth, and bringing them, O Master, unto the Father.[^5906]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With a crown of thorns wast Thou bound, O Christ, King of kings, destroying the kingdoms of the evil one, and cutting down the thorns of deception from the root; therefore in faith we glorify Thee, O Good One.[^5907]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* As the sun, your steadfast resistance shone forth, and destroyed all the enemy's mist, O invincible Martyrs, enlighteners of all the faithful, unbending pillars of piety, praised in glory.[^5908]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* A divinely gathered company, a heavenly army, a chosen assembly, a holy tabernacle were ye revealed, O all-lauded Martyrs of the Savior, destroying the strongholds of the evil one by divine grace.[^5909]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou hast given birth unto the Husbandman, the Planter of piety, who plants true understanding upon the earth, and destroys the curse that sprang from the garden; whom magnifying, we call thee blessed, O Virgin.[^5910]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The same Heirmos:*[^5911]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou hast given birth unto the unshakable Foundation, the Savior, who by divine command founded the earth upon the waters, O Pure One; entreat Him to establish us who purely call thee blessed.[^5912]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Make me to walk unerringly and without deceit in the path of humility of the divine commandments, O Pure One, driving off the turmoil of demons and the assaults of passions, and granting me tranquility.[^5913]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Seeing me held fast by the slumber of negligence, the enemy assails me unceasingly, hoping to steal me away with voluptuous sleep; but do thou thyself...

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: ...preserve me, O Pure One, by thy sleepless prayer, O Virgin Mother.[^5914]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
