items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* As one self-condemned, I ponder the multitude of my sins and the fearful tribunal of the Judge, whereat I am to be judged; but O thou who didst give birth unto God the Judge, keep me uncondemned at that time, O Theotokos.[^5915]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: and the Little Ectenia. Then the Photagogicon and the customary Psalms.*[^5916]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 5:*[^5917]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* No sooner was the Tree of Thy Cross planted, O Christ, than idol deception was driven away and grace blossomed forth; for no longer is there the tyranny of condemnation, but victory of salvation has been revealed unto us. For the Cross is our boast, the Cross is our establishment, the Cross is our rejoicing.[^5918]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad: - - - And look upon Thy servants and upon Thy works, and guide their sons.* [^5919]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* For our sake wast Thou led to the sacrifice, O Christ, as a sheep, and as a guileless lamb, Emmanuel, unto voluntary slaughter, and wast numbered with the transgressors. Come, ye kindreds of the nations, sing and bow down before Him who was hanged upon the Cross, the Life unending.[^5920]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and prosper Thou the works of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands do Thou prosper.* [^5921]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* The holy Martyrs, having contended upon earth, endured frost, were delivered unto fire, and the water received them. Their voice is: We passed through fire and water, and Thou broughtest us out into refreshment. By their prayers, O Christ God, have mercy on us.[^5922]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*[^5923]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: Standing by the Cross, O Jesus, she who bare Thee lamented grieving, crying aloud: I cannot bear to see Him nailed upon the Tree whom I brought forth, having escaped pains as a virgin; and how am I now held fast by sorrow, and am torn in heart, I the immaculate one? For now is fulfilled the word that Simeon spoke: A sword shall pierce through thine own heart. But now, O my Son, arise, and save those that sing of Thee.[^5925]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise unto the Lord: Trisagion; after Our Father: troparion...*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: ...ectenia, and the First Hour, and the dismissal.[^5926]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *On Wednesday, The Beatitudes, Tone 5:*[^5927]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The thief on the cross having believed Thee to be God, O Christ, confessed Thee purely from the heart, crying: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom.[^5928]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having ascended the Cross, Thou didst shake all the multitude of demons, and didst cast down the destructive power of the tormentor, O Master Christ, and didst save mankind.[^5929]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Pierced in Thy ribs, Thou didst pour forth streams of remission, O Christ; and having nailed Thy hands upon the Cross, Thou didst utterly destroy the passionate mind of men.[^5930]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Having become emulators of Christ's Passions, O blessed ones, ye submitted unto every torment, O Passion-bearers of the Lord; therefore ye were accounted worthy of heavenly splendors.[^5931]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Glory... Triadikon:* Upon the Cross, Thou who art indivisible from the Father and the divine Spirit didst endure voluntary passion, O Christ, taking away all our corruptive passions.[^5932]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Standing by the Cross, she who is full of God's joy, beholding her Son wounded, was wounded in soul; yet she sang of His great dispensation in truth.[^5933]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *On Wednesday Evening:*[^5934]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Holy Apostles, Tone 5:*[^5935]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Having traversed all the earth, ye sowed the divine teachings, carrying only the Word as a lamp and all wealth, O disciples of the Lord, whereby ye put kings and tormentors to shame, and tore apart the fury of philosophers and orators as cobwebs, calling all unto the knowledge of the Creator, and taking away the dark demonic services. Therefore I pray: Deliver me from irrational passions by your prayers.[^5937]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* From the turmoil of temptations, and the grievous falsehood of dishonorable heresies, from demonic evil counsel, and the bitter fellowship of men, and the tempest, O All-blessed ones, from unquenchable fire, and the eternal worm, the gnashing of teeth, and every other torment: deliver all of us by your supplications unto God; and entreat Him that, for our temperance and labors, we may receive the recompense of virtues, the inheritance of the heavenly Kingdom, and great mercy.[^5938]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Clearly receiving all brightness as a secondary trinitarian light of the ineffable dispensation, as much as was truly possible for human nature, the all-lauded Ten-and-Two were revealed perfectly leading the equally zealous assembly, having with them the Seventy-and-Two, and enlightening all the ends of the world that were darkened by the gloom of evil-minded heresies, entreating Christ, who grants great mercy unto the world.[^5939]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Holy Wonderworker Nicholas, Tone 5.*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Rejoice, O sacred head, pure dwelling-place of virtues, divine rule of blameless priesthood, great and manifest shepherd, bearing the bright name of victory, merciful bender unto those who pray, inclining unto the supplications of the infirm, ready deliverer, saving refuge unto all who with faith ever honor thy glorious memory: entreat Christ to send down great mercy upon us.[^5941]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Rejoice, O most sacred mind, pure abode of the Trinity, pillar of the Church, establishment of the faithful, helper of the afflicted, star who by the flashes of acceptable prayers dost ever disperse the darkness of temptations and afflictions, O Hierarch Nicholas, calm haven wherein those tossed by the surges of life find salvation when they flee thither: entreat Christ to send down great mercy upon our souls.[^5942]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Rejoice, rule among hierarchs, inexhaustible deep of divine miracles, beauty of the Church, bright star! Illumining each one of us with thy sacred flashes, O Blessed One, most holy one, enlightened by all-radiant lightnings, unconquerable pillar, degree of faith: entreat Christ to grant great mercy unto our souls, as we celebrate thy honorable memory in love.[^5943]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Rejoice, seal of the Prophets, and proclamation of the divinely speaking Apostles! For truly thou hast given birth unto the incarnate God beyond understanding and word, O Pure One, through whom having received our primal nobility, and...

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: ...enjoying the food of Paradise, we honor thee with hymns as the mediatress of such brightness and acceptable intercessor. Enriched by thee, O All-pure One, we are accounted worthy of the ever-existing life of thy Son, who richly grants great mercy.[^5944]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light: Prokeimenon. Vouchsafe, O Lord:*[^5945]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Apostles, Tone 5:*[^5946]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Disciples of the Savior, having been eyewitnesses of mysteries, ye proclaimed Him who is invisible and has no beginning, saying: In the beginning was the Word. Ye were not created before the Angels, nor were ye taught by men, but by the Wisdom from on high; therefore having boldness, pray for our souls.[^5947]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Let us praise the Apostles of the Lord in unison with hymns; for having clothed themselves with the armor of the Cross, they abolished idol deception, and were revealed as victorious crown-bearers. By their prayers and of all the Saints, O God, have mercy on us.[^5949]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us, for we are utterly filled with contempt; especially has our soul been filled with the reproach of the prosperous, and with the contempt of the proud.* [^5950]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* With insatiable love of soul, ye did not deny Christ, O holy Martyrs, who having endured grievous and diverse wounds of passions, cast down the audacity of the tormentors, and having preserved the faith unbending and uninjured, passed over unto heaven; therefore having boldness unto Him, ask that great mercy be granted unto us.[^5951]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* As is due, we the faithful call thee blessed, O Virgin Theotokos, and we glorify thee as an unshakable city, an insurmountable rampart, a firm intercessor, and refuge of our souls.[^5952]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Then, Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: and the rest.*[^5953]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *At Wednesday Small Compline:*[^5954]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 5:*[^5955]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Unto God the Savior, who guided the people in the sea with dryshod feet, and drowned Pharaoh with his entire army, unto Him alone let us sing, for He has been glorified.[^5956]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^5957]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Преидо́ша ꙗ҆́же сѣ́новнѡ зако́номъ соверша́емаѧ; законода́вца бо Хрⷭ҇та̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ, благода́ть ѡ҆чище́нїѧ и҆ просвѣще́нїѧ на́мъ законополага́юща, и҆ кла́твы и҆зн...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Light-bearing tabernacle of Christ the King, illuminate my mind...[^5958]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: мраче́ннꙋю ле́стію борца̀, и҆ тмо́ю ѡ҆слѣпле́ннꙋю прегрѣше́ній мои́хъ.
items.english_text: ...darkened by the deceit of the adversary, and blinded by the darkness of my transgressions.[^5959]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Помышле́ній лꙋка́выхъ смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ Бг҃ороди́тельнице свободѝ, и҆ жили́ще Бг҃ꙋ сію̀ содѣ́лай, да подо́лгꙋ тѧ̀ сла́влю всегда̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Free my humble soul from wicked thoughts, O Mother of God, and make it a dwelling-place for God, that I may worthily glorify thee always.[^5960]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Е҆гда̀ повелѣ́ніемъ Бж҃іимъ, ѿ вре́менныѧ жи́зни ѿитѝ хощꙋ̀, Пречи́стаѧ, бѣсо́вскіѧ рꙋкѝ покажи́ мѧ вы́шша, Ѧ҆́гг҃лы подаю́щи спꙋ́тники мнѣ̀.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* When by God's command I am about to depart from temporal life, O All-pure One, show me to be higher than demonic hands, granting me Angels as companions.[^5961]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Вскꙋ́ю, ѽ дꙋшѐ, въ ᲂу҆ны́ніи мно́зѣ всѐ житіѐ и҆жди́ла є҆сѝ? потщи́сѧ ᲂу҆́бѡ про́чее, и҆ возопі́й Гд҃ни Мт҃ери: ѡ҆чи́сти и҆ спаси́ мѧ Бг҃ороди́тельнице.
items.english_text: *Both now...:* Why, O my soul, hast thou spent all thy life in great despondency? Hasten therefore henceforth, and cry unto the Mother of the Lord: Cleanse and save me, O Mother of God.[^5962]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою креста̀ твоегѡ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, ᲂу҆твердѝ моѐ помышле́ніе, во є҆́же пѣ́ти и҆ сла́вити тридне́вное твоѐ воскресе́ніе.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* By the power of Thy Cross, O Christ, establish my thought, to sing and glorify Thy three-day Resurrection.[^5963]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: И҆зъ ро́ва страсте́й и҆ мꙋче́ній возведи́ мѧ, несꙋмнѣ́ннѡ пою́ща тѧ̀, Бцⷣе всеблаже́ннаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Raise me up out of the pit of passions and torments, who sing of thee without doubting, O all-blessed Theotokos.[^5964]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Вре́тище моѐ расто́ргни, безмѣ́рныхъ прегрѣше́ній мои́хъ, и҆ весе́ліемъ ѡ҆поѧ́ши добродѣ́тели, Бг҃облагода́тнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Rend the sackcloth of my boundless transgressions, and gird me with the gladness of virtue, O thou who art full of God's grace.[^5965]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Ка́плю мнѣ̀ Чи́стаѧ сле́зъ пода́ждь, ꙗ҆́кѡ да ѿженꙋ̀ се́рдца моегѡ̀ недоꙋмѣ́ніе, и҆ прилѣ́жнѡ воспою̀ тѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* Grant me a drop of tears, O Pure One, that I may drive away the perplexity of my heart, and diligently sing of thee.[^5966]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Низложѝ Пренепоро́чнаѧ врагѡ́въ безпло́тныхъ шата́ніе, и҆ тѣ́хъ томле́ніѧ вско́рѣ свободи́ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...:* Cast down the arrogance of bodiless enemies, O All-immaculate One, and quickly deliver me from their torment.[^5967]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ си́лы креста̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ ра́й ѿве́рзесѧ и҆́мъ, и҆ возопи́хъ: сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й, Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* I heard the report of the power of the Cross, that Paradise was opened by it, and I cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord.[^5968]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Вскꙋ́ю ᲂу҆подо́биласѧ є҆сѝ, дꙋшѐ непло́днѣй смоко́вницѣ, ника́коже боѧ́щисѧ посѣче́ніѧ, и҆ пла́мене вѣ́чнагѡ; ᲂу҆скорѝ ᲂу҆́бѡ пре́жде конца̀, и҆ возни́кни.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Why hast thou likened thyself, O soul, unto the barren fig tree, in nowise fearing felling and the eternal flame? Make haste therefore before the end, and arise.[^5969]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Кі́й ꙗ҆зы́къ и҆зрече́тъ содѣ́ѧнныхъ мои́хъ ѕѡ́лъ безмѣ́рное мо́ре, и҆ глꙋбинꙋ̀ прегрѣше́ній? Спаси́ мѧ Дв҃о пренепоро́чнаѧ ѿча́ѧннаго.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* What tongue shall declare the boundless sea of the evils I have committed, and the depth of my transgressions? Save me, O all-immaculate Virgin, who am in despair.[^5970]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Себѐ пла́чꙋ, є҆гда̀ въ ᲂу҆́мъ прі́идꙋ, мно́гихъ мои́хъ прегрѣше́ній, и҆ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ негаси́магѡ: и҆ молю́ тѧ да́ти мнѣ̀ вре́мѧ покаѧ́ніѧ, Чи́стаѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* I weep for myself when I come to my senses, because of my many transgressions and the unquenchable fire; and I entreat thee to grant me time for repentance, O Pure One.[^5971]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...:* Let not the perverse enemy seize my wretched soul like a lion; but by thy power crush his soul-destroying teeth, O Good One.[^5972]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Rising early we cry unto Thee, O Lord: Save us! For Thou art our God, for beside Thee we know no other.[^5973]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Look down and give ear, O Lady, unto my voice, and deliver me, I pray, from eternal condemnation.[^5974]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I am wounded with the arrows of sin, and I cry unto thee: Heal the wounds of my heart, O All-pure One.[^5975]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* Have mercy on me, O only compassionate Lover of mankind, by the prayers of Her who bare Thee; for Thou art my God and Lord.[^5976]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...:* Have mercy on me, O only All-hymned One, I beseech thy goodness, and vouchsafe me mercy.[^5977]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* The abyss encompassed me, the sea-monster was a grave unto me; but I cried unto Thee, the Lover of mankind, and Thy right hand saved me, O Lord.[^5978]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As a roaring lion, the deceitful one seeks to tear me apart and make me food for his malice, O Pure One; but deliver me from his harm.[^5979]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Cleanse, O Lover of mankind, by the prayers of Her who purely bare Thee, and deliver Thy world from every affliction, and vouchsafe it eternal glory.[^5980]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* The abyss of transgressions has encompassed me, bringing me down into the depth of despair; I pray thee, O Pure One, raise me up from nethermost Hades, who glorify thee.[^5981]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...:* My life is filled with transgressions and all slothfulness; therefore, turn me unto repentance before my end, O Pure One, and save me, O All-hymned One.[^5982]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Lord, have mercy (three times). Glory... Both now...:*

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Rejoice, firm, God-conquering wall! Rejoice, all-wretched downfall of the barbarians! Rejoice, uplifting of the faithful, Orthodox people, O Theotokos, who truly place our hope in thee: delivering us by thy prayers from all afflictions and godless enemies.*[^5983]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Thou who didst save the hymn-singing Children in the furnace of fire: Blessed is the God of our fathers.[^5984]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Grant me by thy goodness, O Lady, forgiveness of involuntary and voluntary evils.[^5985]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* My mind fails under the assaults of the impiety of wicked thoughts; help me, O Good One.[^5986]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* Heal now by the remedies of thy prayers, O Theotokos, the wounds of my spiritual passions.[^5987]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...:* Grant me a contrite soul and a humble mindset, O Good One, that I may glorify thee.[^5988]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Him who before the ages was begotten of the Father as Son and God, and in these latter times was incarnate of the Virgin Mother, O ye priests, praise; O ye peoples, supremely exalt unto all ages.[^5989]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having ended my life in slothfulness, wretch that I am, and drawn near unto the end of my life, I cry unto thee, O Theotokos: Snatch my humble soul from the nets of the adversaries.[^5990]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Tormented by bodily diseases, by grievous wounds of soul, and by the assault of passions: grant me the power of thy kingdom, as the only compassionate one.[^5991]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* Being tempest-tossed in the deep of life and submerged by demonic waves, save me, O Pure One, and by divine striving lead me into a life pleasing unto God, O Maiden.[^5992]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...:* Gabriel, being sent, entering as into a bridal chamber, O Virgin, cried out, saying: Rejoice, O most glorious palace of Christ, the King of all, who having taken up abode within thee, deified all earthly beings.[^5993]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Thee who beyond mind and word art the Mother of God, who in time didst ineffably bear the Timeless One, we the faithful unanimously magnify.[^5994]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thee who ineffably didst bear God, have we acquired as intercessor, and immovable wall, and salvation of souls, and fountain of miracles.[^5995]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Be merciful unto me, O Word of the true God, in the day of judgment, through the supplications of Her who bare Thee, and number me with those at Thy right hand.[^5996]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* Deliver me, O Pure One, who have placed my hope in thee, from the eternal fire, and from the sleepless worm, and from every torment.[^5997]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...:* When my soul is about to be separated from my wretched body, deliver me from the torment of invisible enemies, O Bride of God.[^5998]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Trisagion; after Our Father: troparia.*[^5999]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *On Thursday at Matins:*[^6000]

items.english_text: *After the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Apostles, Tone 5:*[^6001]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* As eyewitnesses and servants of the Word, let us praise the all-wise Apostles with spiritual songs...

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: ...and songs, all ye earthly-born: for they diligently pray unto Christ for us who sing of their sacred memory and bow down before their relics.[^6002]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* In unison let us praise the Apostles, as eyewitnesses of the Word and divine preachers, and spiritual fishers of the nations, who manifestly brought us unto the knowledge of Christ: having delivered the human race from deception, they made them worthy of the Kingdom.[^6004]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* I am condemned by the judgment of my conscience, and pondering the judgment before the judgment, I, wretch that I am, tremble, remembering the multitude of my wicked deeds; but unto thee, the invincible one, I cry with compunction, and as my protectress and shelter: deliver me from that judgment, and save me by thy prayers.[^6005]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *After the second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 5:*[^6006]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* In unison let us praise the Apostles, who proclaimed unto all the Orthodox teaching of the Lord, and drove away the heretical gloom: having made spiritual enlightenment shine forth in the world by the teaching of grace, they pray that we may be saved.[^6007]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *And speak the same Sessional Hymn again.*[^6009]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* At the achievements of the holy Martyrs, the Heavenly Hosts were exceedingly astonished: how, having fought well in a mortal body, they invisibly conquered the bodiless enemy by the power of the Cross! And they pray unto the Lord that He have mercy on our souls.[^6011]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Having found thee, O Theotokos, as a haven, and a wall, and a refuge, and hope, and shelter, and fervent intercession, we the faithful flee unto thee, and cry diligently, and call out faithfully: Have mercy, O Theotokos, on those who place their hope in thee, and deliver us from transgressions.[^6012]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *After the third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 5:*[^6013]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Disciples of the Savior, divine Apostles, who sowed the saving word unto the ends of the earth, and enlightened those sitting in darkness and the shadow of death: enlighten my soul that is darkened by the blackness of passions, through your supplications, O all-praised ones.[^6014]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* O Lord, the unwise who proclaimed the ineffable mystery of Thine Incarnation put philosophers to shame; fishermen silenced orators, and became the all-wise teachers of the nations, having enlightened the ends of the world with the light of divine knowledge; through them grant great mercy unto us.[^6015]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Being a shelter from diverse temptations and circumstances unto those who unhesitatingly have hope in thee, O all-pure Virgin: deliver us from cruel perils, praying unto thy Son together with His Apostles, and save all who sing of thee.[^6016]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy Apostles. A creation of Theophanes, Bishop of Nicaea:*[^6017]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Christ who crushes wars with a high arm shook horse and rider into the Red Sea; but He saved Israel, who sang a song of victory.[^6018]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Apostles, pray to God for us.*[^6019]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having been enriched, O glorious and divine Apostles, with the radiance of the primal gift of light of Him who deigned in the flesh to converse with men: destroy all darkness of my soul.[^6020]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having bent His divine bow, Christ sent you as arrows into the whole world, O Apostles: arrows crushing all the schemes of the crafty one, and healing the wounds of the faithful.[^6021]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having Wisdom Itself as teacher, ye made all the ends of the earth wise, O Apostles. Therefore make me wise to drive away every evil deed of the enemy.[^6022]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O only blessed one made glad of God, who by blessings didst make the human race rejoice: entreat Christ together with the divine Apostles, O Pure One, that He have mercy on us.[^6023]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Another Canon to our Father among the Saints, Nicholas the Wonderworker. (Whose Acrostic is: A fifth song do I offer unto thee, O Nicholas). A creation of Joseph:*[^6024]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Tone 5. The same Heirmos:*[^6025]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having appropriated thyself unto God in faith and love, O Father, thou didst fulfill His all-holy desires, through which thou wast holy in every way, O wise Hierarch Nicholas.[^6026]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having thee as intercessor before the Compassionate One, we who are held fast by temptations and sorrows flee unto thee: grant a hand saving us from every constraint.[^6027]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Christ anointed thee as hierarch of Myra, sweetening us with the fragrance of miracles; therefore we pray thee, Nicholas, to deliver us from the stench...

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Of old the choir of Prophets named thee the divine mountain, O Virgin, and the impassable door; therefore we pray thee: Open unto us the divine doors of repentance, O Maiden.[^6029]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou who didst establish the earth upon nothing by Thy command, and didst suspend what is uncontrollably weighed down: establish Thy Church, O Christ, upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments, O only Good One and Lover of mankind.[^6030]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* He who became poor in the flesh, being abundantly rich in goodness, enriched you, O glorious Apostles, who became poor for His sake, with all gifts, enriching the ends of the earth with divine and honorable knowledge.[^6031]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I am wounded by the poisonous biting of the serpent, and possess a wounded heart; therefore I cry unto Thee, O Christ, who wast wounded for my sake: Heal and save me, I pray, through the supplications of Thine Apostles.[^6032]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having drawn me up with the net of your prayers, O All-blessed ones, from the deep of the malice of the censurer, and from the surging of thoughts, and from deadly passions, bring me saved unto the God of all.[^6033]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O thou who didst receive the heavenly rain, entreat Him together with the Apostles to stop the torrents of my passions, drying up the flood of my sin, and to save me who purely glorify thee.[^6034]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. The same Heirmos:*[^6035]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst blunt the arrows of the crafty one, O Venerable One, by the resistance of thy divine labors; but by thy prayers, O All-wise One, preserve unharmed from his malicious deed and violence those who sing of thee, O great Nicholas.[^6036]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having shown forth an Angelic life upon earth, now with the Angels thou dost ever stand before the Trinitarian throne, O Holy One: asking remission of our transgressions and temptations, O Father, chief hierarch Nicholas.[^6037]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Drive away all the darkening of my mind, O Nicholas, by thy light-bearing prayers; calm the tempest of passions; guide me, O Father, unto the haven of dispassion, I pray, that in praise I may glorify thee.[^6038]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Standing at the right hand of Christ as Queen, arrayed in truth with golden woven borders, O thou who art graced of God: through thy prayers intercede for the heavenly kingdom for us, O Maiden all-immaculate.[^6039]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Understanding foresightedly Thy divine emptying, O Christ, Habakkuk cried out unto Thee with trembling: Unto the salvation of Thy people, to save Thine anointed, art Thou come.[^6040]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being the Door, Jesus our God and Lord, having opened the knowledge of Himself unto the Apostles, opened the door unto all nations through their teachings.[^6041]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Son of God, Thou hast revealed Thine Apostles to be sons by participation of Thy heavenly Father; through their supplication make all of us sons of light.[^6042]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Ye who are to sit most gloriously upon twelve thrones with the Judge and King: deliver me, O Apostles, from the fearful and dread judgment.[^6043]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O ark of divine sanctification, sanctify my soul; enlighten my mind, ever entreating Christ with the Apostles that He save me.[^6044]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. The same Heirmos:*[^6045]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* With passing things didst thou exchange future things; make us also partakers thereof by thy holy prayers, O Nicholas, delivering us from every worldly temptation.[^6046]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having been chief primate of Myra, O Nicholas, sweeten all the senses of my heart with the myrrh, O Holy One; and by thy prayers ever drive away foul-smelling passions therefrom.[^6047]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Crush the visible wiles of the enemy, O Nicholas, which ever wage war against us; send our enemies into endless destruction.[^6048]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Holy Theotokos, help me, who am continually submerged by bodily pleasures, and ever lie groaning upon the bed of despondency.[^6049]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Thou who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, unto Thee do I rise early and unto Thee do I call: Enlighten my darkened soul, O Christ, as the only Tender-hearted One.[^6050]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Spiritual orators, honorable Apostles, in the upper room in the appearance of fire, dreadfully received the Holy Spirit who had come unto them.[^6051]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Crushing impiety, heal with the dew of healing, O Apostles, my mind that is crushed by transgressions...

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: ...heal with the dew of healing, O Apostles.[^6052]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Christ sent you, O Apostles, as chosen arrows that crush the arrows of wickedness; therefore heal me who am wounded with the arrows of the enemy.[^6053]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Condemn me not, nor cast me away from Thy face, O Plenteous in mercy: She who purely bare Thee and the Apostolic choir entreat Thee.[^6054]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. The same Heirmos:*[^6055]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst shatter the idols of the images, O Holy One, and didst show the counsels of the heretics to be vain, O Nicholas, and didst deliver those led unto death.[^6056]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Rising early unto the Lord from youth, O Venerable One, thou wast wholly enlightened by the outpourings of light from there. Therefore I pray: Disperse the clouds of my soul.[^6057]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* We pray thee, O Father Nicholas: At this hour be in the midst of all who call upon thee, and grant us our requests that lead unto salvation.[^6058]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He who is incomprehensible to the mind, O thou who art full of God's grace, becoming flesh-bearing, accepted thee as His enclosure, delivering men from the afflictions that hold them fast.[^6059]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Calm the sea of passions raging with a soul-destroying tempest, O Master Christ, and lead me up from corruption, as Thou art tender-hearted.[^6060]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst stop the spreading corruption of malice in the souls of the nations, O Lover of mankind, with the salt of the teaching of Thy sacred disciples.[^6061]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou knowest the depth of my wicked deeds, O Master Christ: give me Thy hand, and save me, O Lover of mankind, through the supplications of Thy sacred Apostles.[^6062]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O most righteous Judge, in the day of the fearful judgment deliver me from trembling condemnation, through the supplications of Thy gloriously praised Apostles.[^6063]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Vouchsafe salvation unto me, O Lord, who am in despair because of the multitude of mine iniquities, through the supplications of Thy disciples and of Thy Mother.[^6064]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. The same Heirmos:*[^6065]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Make the Master merciful through thy prayers, O Nicholas, unto all who honor thee, that He may grant remission of our transgressions.[^6066]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Deliver from disease and worldly stumbling-blocks, temptations and sorrows, O Nicholas, those who have acquired thee as an intercessor before the Lord.[^6067]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Christ the Master showed thee to be an excellent physician; therefore heal the diseases of those who piously approach thee, O Nicholas.[^6068]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast an unwedded parent, Mother of God, O Pure One; therefore in faith I pray thee: Disperse the despondency of my soul.[^6069]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The supremely exalted Lord of the fathers quenched the flame, and bedewed the Children, who sang in unison: O God, blessed art Thou.[^6070]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The supremely exalted Lord of the fathers exalted you, and cast down all the power of the enemy, O disciples and God-seers of Christ.[^6071]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Wash away the defilement of my heart with streams of compunction, through your supplications, O Apostles, teaching me to cry: O God, blessed art Thou.[^6072]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* With the fire of the Holy Spirit ye consumed the substance of all idolatry; therefore deliver me from the burning Gehenna, O disciples of God the Word.[^6073]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O thou who art the restoration of Adam's fall: raise me up who have fallen into the pit of malice, by thy prayers, O Virgin, and of the divine Apostles.[^6074]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. The same Heirmos:*[^6075]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having committed thyself entirely unto God, O Nicholas, save me entirely, who ever fall wretchedly into worldly passions, O divinely wise one.[^6076]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O most divinely radiant luminary! Enlighten my mind that is continually darkened by the gloom of passions, and grant me to walk becomingly in life.[^6077]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Stop every deceitful mouth opened against me, O Nicholas, by thy prayers; and deliver me from enemies visible and invisible.[^6078]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* From thee did the never-setting Sun shine forth unto us, O all-radiant cloud, even Christ our God, enlightening those who were in the darkness of ignorance, O Theotokos.[^6079]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Unto Thee the Creator of all, the Children in the furnace, having woven a universal choir, sang: All ye works, praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^6080]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst spread out the Apostles as noetic clouds, O Word, dropping upon us the rain of all-wise and divine teachings, and watering us unto all ages.[^6081]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O most excellent pillars of the Church, who uphold her by the teachings of faith: by your divine craftsmanship establish the rotted dwelling of my soul, O God-seers.[^6082]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Groan, O my soul, and offer streams of tears from thy whole heart unto the Lord, crying: O only Compassionate One, save and cleanse me through the acceptable prayers of the all-glorious Apostles.[^6083]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O chosen Zion, royal city: make me a citizen of the city on high, entreating together with the divine disciples, O all-pure Virgin, thy timeless Son.[^6084]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. The same Heirmos:*[^6085]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having been great chief hierarch in Myra, O Nicholas, sweeten the senses of my soul with the myrrh, that I may escape the stench of passions, and receive the grace of the Comforter.[^6086]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst stop the stream of the blasphemies of Arius, O all-wise one, with the streams of thy holy tongue. Therefore I cry unto thee: Dry up the floods of my passions by thy prayers, O all-blessed Nicholas.[^6087]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Deliver us from transgressions, through thy prayers, from demonic affliction, from pagan captivity, and from the most crafty evil harm of all men; that we may praise thee as our deliverer.[^6088]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Triadikon:* Glorifying in faith unceasingly the Trinity in Monarchy, let us cry aloud: O Father, and Word, and All-Holy Spirit! We sing praises unto Thee unto all ages.[^6089]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* God who was clothed in flesh for our sake from thee, O pure and all-immaculate one, showed thee forth unto all our race, O Virgin, as a divine intercessor. Therefore we the faithful sing aloud unto thee.[^6090]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Then we sing: My soul magnifies the Lord:*[^6091]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Да не восхи́титъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ стропти́вый вра́гъ ѻ҆ка́нныѧ моеѧ̀ дꙋшѝ; но твое́ю си́лою дꙋшетлѣ̑нныѧ сокрꙋшѝ зꙋ́бы є҆гѡ̀, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Rejoice, O Isaiah: a Virgin had in womb and bare a Son, Emmanuel, both God and man, Orient is His name; Whom magnifying, we call the Virgin blessed.[^6092]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Небеса̀ оу҆ѕвѣ́здены свѣ́тлостьми бж҃е́ственныхъ добродѣ́телей оу҆́мнѡ ꙗ҆ви́стесѧ, посредѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ со́лнце и҆мꙋ́ще, и҆ земны̑ѧ концы̀ Премꙋ́дріи ѡ҆бнови́сте; сегѡ̀ ра́ди блажи́ми є҆стѐ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Ye appeared noetically as heavens bestarred with the brightness of divine virtues, having Christ in your midst as the Sun, and ye renewed the ends of the earth, O All-wise ones; therefore are ye called blessed.[^6093]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇то́вы ꙗ҆́звы на бж҃твеннѣмъ тѣлесѝ ва́шемъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ оу҆́тварь всеблаголѣ́пнꙋ носѧ́ще Премꙋ́дріи: оу҆ѧ́звленꙋю мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ де́монскими стрѣ́лами, ꙗ҆́же къ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ хода́тайствы и҆сцѣли́те.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Bearing the wounds of Christ upon your divine bodies as all-comely adornment, O All-wise ones: heal by your intercessions unto the Lord my soul that is wounded by demonic arrows.[^6094]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Въ ро́вѣ преиспо́днѣмъ мѧ̀ грѣха̀ слежа́ща, Хрⷭ҇тѐ, и҆ лѣ́ности лю́тыѧ сно́мъ дꙋ́шꙋ ѡ҆тагчи́вшаго, твои́ми Сло́ве оу҆чени́ки, ꙗ҆́кѡже Ла́зара воздви́гнꙋвый, спасѝ Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* As Thou didst raise Lazarus, O Christ, through Thy disciples save me, O Word, O Lord, who lie in the nether pit of sin and have weighed down my soul with the sleep of grievous sloth.[^6095]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ напра́ви ше́ствїа Сло́ве Бж҃ій, къ стєза́мъ за́повѣдей твои́хъ незаблꙋ́дныхъ: и҆мѣ́ѧ молѧ́щꙋюсѧ ро́ждшꙋю тѧ̀ пречи́стꙋю Дв҃ꙋ, и҆ премꙋ́дрыѧ Ꙗ҆пⷭ҇лы твоѧ̑, Многоми́лостиве.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Direct the goings of my soul, O Word of God, unto the unerring paths of Thy commandments, having as intercessors the all-pure Virgin who bare Thee and Thine all-wise Apostles, O Plenteous in mercy.[^6096]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Свѧти́тель боже́ственъ бы́въ, всѧ̑ за́пѡвѣди сохрани́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇то́вы; тѣ́мже вѣ̑рнымъ храни́тель бж҃е́ственный бы́лъ є҆сѝ, о́ч҃е Нїко́лае, соблюда́й тѣ́хъ ѿ всѧ́кихъ напа́стей и҆ ѡ҆ѕлобле́нїа.
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. The same Heirmos:*[^6097]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже и҆ногда̀ препита́лъ є҆сѝ гра́дъ тво́й и҆знемога́ющь гла́домъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ до́бръ па́стырь Преподо́бне: та́кожде и҆ ны́нѣ препита́й дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀, хлѣ́бомъ разꙋ́мнымъ о́ч҃е Нїко́лае, тѧ̀ застꙋ́пника блага́ стѧжа́вшаго.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having become a divine hierarch, thou didst keep all the commandments of Christ; therefore thou wast a divine guardian unto the faithful, O Father Nicholas; preserve them from every temptation and affliction.[^6098]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Тѧ̀ вели́кое со́лнце на высотѣ̀ лежа́щее при́снѡ, це́ркве Хрⷭ҇то́вы, преподо́бне па́стырю вѣ́рнѡ мо́лимъ: свѣтоно́сными блиста́ньми свѣ́та, глꙋбо́кꙋю тмꙋ̀ ѿженѝ грѣха̀ ѿ дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As once thou didst nourish thy city that was fainting with famine, as a good shepherd, O Venerable One: so also now nourish my soul with noetic bread, O Father Nicholas, who have acquired thee as a good intercessor.[^6099]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Прибли́жисѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡже пи́шетсѧ, де́нь стра́шный прише́ствїа Хрⷭ҇то́ва; подви́гнисѧ дꙋшѐ, ѿри́ни лѣ́ность, и҆ оу҆се́рднѡ Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ возопі́й: спаси́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и, Нїкола́а твоегѡ̀ моле́нїемъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thee, the great sun ever abiding upon the height of the Church of Christ, O venerable shepherd, we faithfully beseech: by the light-bearing flashes of light, drive away the deep darkness of sin from our souls.[^6100]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́телъ тѧ̀ свѣ́щникъ проро́къ прови́даше Пречи́стаѧ, свѣщꙋ̀ разꙋ́мнꙋю носѧ́щꙋю Хрⷭ҇та̀, и҆́мже просвѣти́хомсѧ, и҆́же въ тмѣ̀ лежа́щїе и҆ страстѣ́хъ: тѧ̀ оу҆блажа́емъ Бцⷢе Приснодѣ́во.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* As it is written, the fearful day of Christ's coming is drawn near; bestir thyself, O my soul, cast away sloth, and fervently cry out unto Christ: Save me, O Lord, through the supplication of Thy Nicholas.[^6101]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Prophet foresaw thee, O All-pure One, as a bright lampstand bearing the noetic candle, Christ, by Whom we who lie in darkness and passions have been enlightened: we call thee blessed, O Theotokos Ever-Virgin.[^6102]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Little Litany, Photogogikon, and the customary Psalms.*[^6103]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Apostles, Tone 5:*[^6104]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Having been eyewitnesses of the mysteries, O disciples of the Savior, ye proclaimed the Invisible One who hath no beginning, saying: In the beginning was the Word. Ye were not created before the Angels, nor were ye taught of men, but by the wisdom from on high; therefore, having boldness, pray for our souls.[^6105]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
