items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* In hymns let us praise the Apostles of the Lord in unison; for having put on the armor of the Cross, they abolished the deception of idols and were revealed as victorious crown-bearers. Through their prayers and of all the Saints, O God, have mercy on us.[^6106]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* When in torments, the Saints cried out rejoicing: These are for us a transaction unto the Master; for instead of the wounds upon our bodies, a radiant garment shall blossom forth for us in the resurrection; instead of dishonor, crowns; instead of prison bonds, Paradise; and instead of condemnation with evildoers, life with the Angels. Through their prayers, O Lord, save our souls.[^6107]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* We call thee blessed, O Virgin Theotokos, for from thee hath shone forth the righteous Sun, Christ, who hath great mercy.[^6108]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise: Trisagion; after Our Father: Troparion of the Saint, if there be one; litany and the First Hour.*[^6109]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *On Thursday, The Beatitudes, Tone 5:*[^6110]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The thief on the Cross, believing Thee to be God, O Christ, confessed Thee purely from the heart, crying: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy kingdom.[^6111]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Like radiant clouds ye traversed the earth, O divine disciples, sprinkling the living water and richly watering hearts melted by transgressions.[^6112]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Like mystical rays of the Sun that shone forth from the pure Virgin, ye enlightened those sitting in the darkness of ignorance, O divine disciples of Christ our God.[^6113]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having endured with fervent soul the burnings of grievous torments, O All-wise ones, ye consumed the deception of idols and passed over unto divine comfort, O Saints.[^6114]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 5:* That Thou mightest take up the coin buried in the depth of transgressions, O Christ, and bring it unto the Father, Thou didst make the Apostles preachers by the divine Spirit.[^6115]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Triadikon:* O transcendent Trinity: Father unoriginate, co-unoriginate Son, and Holy Spirit, one Godhead! Through the prayers of the preachers of all, preserve Thy Church.[^6116]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Being the adornment of the Apostles, O thou who art full of God's joy, enlighten me who am darkened by worldly pleasures with the rays of repentance, that I may magnify thee.[^6117]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *On Thursday Evening:*[^6118]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 5:*[^6119]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Let all the trees of the forest rejoice, beholding the all-honorable Wood, filled with joy by the Master's Passion, shining forth grace like a flame of fire, pouring forth gifts like waters unto all, enlightening souls and thoughts, healing diseases, and driving away invisible passions: visibly conquering foreign nations, ever granting victories unto monarchs over barbarians, and unto the faithful blessing and great mercy.[^6121]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Worshipping in faith the place where the feet of the Lord stood, as the Prophet said, we glorify Christ who was crucified and crucified our transgressions together with Himself, who abolished the curse from the tree and reconciled unto the Father those standing far off in thoughts: kissing also His hand- and foot-nails, the spear and the reed, the sponge and the crown; we honor with reverence the insults, scoffs, and all else that He submitted to, whereby we were saved.[^6122]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* With all our members let us be crucified together with Christ, and let us die unto the world; and desiring to walk in the footsteps of Christ the Master of the world, let us bear the divine Cross upon our shoulders, by the rejection...

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: ...of the leaping of the flesh and of evil desires that draw the soul unto sin; thinking to stand before Him, and to behold Him nailed to the Cross, and with expiration committing His soul into the hands of the Father, that we may ever be inseparable with Him.[^6123]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* When thou didst nurture the unplanted cluster of grapes as a vine, beholding Him suspended upon the Wood and pierced with a spear in His divine ribs: What is this, she said, O my Son and my God? How dost Thou, who healest all diseases and passions, endure passions, being impassible according to Thy divine nature? What is this that the ungrateful people have rendered unto Thee, their Benefactor, instead of benefits? cried the All-pure One. But through His Passion pray unceasingly that I be delivered from passions, that I may glorify thee.[^6125]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Let us all weep, and stretch forth our hands, and beat our breasts, warmly weeping: and bending our knees, striking the ground with our faces earnestly, let us send up sighs unto the height, we who by unseemly deeds have provoked God by rejecting His commandments, (crying out) that in the future judgment He deliver from all torment those who grieved Thee and turn back unto Thee, through the supplications of Thy Mother: for whose sake Thou didst endure the Cross, having become incarnate, and make them partakers of Thy Kingdom.[^6126]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Unto whom hast thou become likened, O my soul, ever advancing in worse things, and foolishly adding more sores unto thy wounds, so that the wound is over the whole body: not thinking that the Judge is drawing near, before Whom thou shalt stand to receive the retribution and torments according to thy deeds? But turn back and fall down before the Virgin, crying: O Sovereign Lady, Sovereign Lady! Despise me not, who have angered the gracious God born of thee for the salvation of men, and crucified in the flesh.[^6127]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: As a ransom for our sake and a great price, Thou wast pleased to give Thy most pure blood, O my sinless Christ, desiring that all attain salvation. Therefore, beholding Thee nailed, Thy Mother, weeping, tore her hair, saying: O Child, all-blameless Lamb! Desiring to deliver the world by Thy precious blood, how hast Thou set from mine eyes, O Savior, never-setting Sun? Granting enlightenment unto all, and peace, and great mercy.[^6129]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 5:*[^6130]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* O Lord, when of old under the Prophet Moses only the prefiguration of Thy Cross was shown, it conquered Thine enemies; but now, holding Thy Cross itself,...

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: ...we ask for help: strengthen Thy Church, and grant victory unto our Emperor [Name],[^6131] as unto Constantine, for the sake of Thy manifold mercy, O Lover of mankind.[^6132]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Verse: Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes, unto Thee that dwellest in heaven. Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hands of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hands of her mistress, so do our eyes look unto the Lord our God, until He have mercy on us.* [^6133]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Thy Cross, O Christ, even though it be wood visible in its essence, is nevertheless clothed with divine power: and appearing sensibly unto the world, it noetically works our salvation through wonders; worshipping it, we glorify Thee, O Savior: have mercy on us.[^6134]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us, for we are utterly filled with contempt; our soul is exceedingly filled with the reproach of the opulent, and the contempt of the proud.* [^6135]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Caring nought for all earthly things, and manfully braving torments, ye failed not of your blessed hopes; but ye became heirs of the heavenly Kingdom, O all-praised Martyrs! Having boldness unto the God who loves mankind, ask peace for the world, and for our souls great mercy.[^6136]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding of old her Lamb and Son lifted up upon the Cross, the Virgin-Mother and all-blessed Maiden cried out weeping: Woe is me, O my Son! How dost Thou die, who art God by nature immortal?[^6137]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Now dismissest Thou: Trisagion; after Our Father: Troparion of the Saint, litany, and dismissal.*[^6138]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *On Thursday at Compline:*[^6139]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos:*[^6140]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: Christ who shatters battles with a high arm shook off horse and rider into the Red Sea; and He saved Israel as they sang a song of victory.[^6141]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^6142]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* We know thee beyond compare as another noetic Paradise, O Virgin Bride of God, surpassing the Paradise in Eden, O Mother of God: for thou hast budded forth incorruption unto men.[^6143]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Adam was forbidden to find the tree of life in Paradise, having partaken of the tree of knowledge; but He who received flesh from thee, O Virgin, granted immortality.[^6144]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* First was Adam formed from the earth by the most pure hands of...

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: ...the Almighty; but from thee, O Virgin Theotokos, the new Adam was born without seed, the Creator of mankind.[^6145]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* The utter abyss of immeasurable transgressions hath compassed me about, and drags me down into the deep of grievous despair. O thou who didst bear the abyss of tender-heartedness, make haste and save me.[^6146]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou who didst establish the earth upon nothing by Thy command, and didst suspend what is uncontrollably weighed down: establish Thy Church, O Christ, upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments, O only Good One and Lover of mankind.[^6147]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* He who made the earth to be the parent of living plants, which were not upon it before: forthwith from a woman that knew not man, being incarnate without seed as from the earth, Thou didst come, O immutable Word of God.[^6148]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou art the hope and help of earthborn mortals, and joy, and protection, and refuge, O Sovereign Lady, Mother of Life; therefore we pray: Send down thy help unto all who sing unto thee.[^6149]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* We who are sick and held fast by grievous temptations, O Creator, Compassionate God of all things, bring Thine all-holy tabernacle unto Thee in prayer, and we cry unto Thee: Loosen the afflictions of Thy servants.[^6150]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Grievously doth the wave of sin trouble me, dragging me down into the depth of transgressions, O All-pure One, and the tempest of adverse thoughts buffets my soul: O thou who didst bear the Helmsman, make haste to rescue thy servant.[^6151]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Understanding foresightedly Thy divine emptying, O Christ, Habakkuk cried out unto Thee with trembling: Unto the salvation of Thy people, to save Thine anointed, art Thou come.[^6152]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Eve, submitting unto the serpent, bare sorrow unto women; but thou, O Virgin, having believed the divine utterances, didst blossom forth joy unto all the world.[^6153]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* First from the rib of Adam was Eve born, but now God is born from a Mother, the Bride of God; Whom incarnate the Virgin bare without an earthly father.[^6154]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Eve rejoices, for the Maiden showed her delivered from the ancient maternal condemnation, having...

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: ...incorruptibly conceived the Judge, and borne Him, the Compassionate One.[^6155]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* My life is filled with transgressions, and my mind is passionate, and my soul is condemned; therefore by thy tender compassion have mercy on me, and save me, O Sovereign Lady.[^6156]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Thou who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, unto Thee do I rise early and unto Thee do I call: Enlighten my darkened soul, O Christ, as the only Tender-hearted One.[^6157]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having found thee as a pillar and cloud of light, O Virgin Mother of the Light-giver, we who walk through the deceitful wilderness escape from evils.[^6158]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Rejoice, O thou who didst bear God in the flesh, who was born before the ages of the Father without flesh, and who forthwith was pleased to appear unto us.[^6159]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* The sun was surpassed by thy brightness, O Mary; for Thou didst clasp in thine arms Him who adorned heaven with luminaries, and didst nourish Him from thy breasts.[^6160]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Condemn me not unto the unquenchable fire, O Christ my Savior, through the entreaties of the pure One who bare Thee.[^6161]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Calm the sea of passions raging with a soul-destroying tempest, O Master Christ, and lead me up from corruption, as Thou art tender-hearted.[^6162]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Him who of old saved the Prophet Jonah in the whale, didst thou bear unharmed in thy womb, the marvelous God, O pure Ever-Virgin.[^6163]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Bearing the Lord who rules the sea, O all-pure Virgin, as the Powers bear God incomprehensibly, thou didst lull to sleep the salty surge of deception.[^6164]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Having borne the Peace of all things, Christ, O All-pure One, through thy prayers unto Him graciously calm the unsteady tempest of passions that assaults me.[^6165]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* In the day of sorrow, when I am about to be loosed from bodily bonds, stand by me, and snatch me away from demonic possession.[^6166]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Then, Lord, have mercy (3 times). Glory... both now...*[^6167]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 5:* Beholding Thee upon the Cross, O Christ, Thy Mother, hanging voluntarily in the midst of thieves, torn as a mother in her womb, said: O sinless Son, how...

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: ...unjustly on the Cross, like an evildoer, art Thou crucified? Desiring to bring the human race to life, as Thou art supremely good.[^6168]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The supremely exalted Lord of the fathers quenched the flame, and bedewed the Children, who sang in unison: O God, blessed art Thou.[^6169]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* God fulfilled His promise made unto the forefather Abraham, having become thy Son: and He blessed his seed among the nations, O Blessed One.[^6170]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou art the undefiled ladder of Jacob; for God inscribed thee alone as Mother, for whose sake God gathered together his offspring.[^6171]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* The Son, who is supremely exalted with the Father and the Spirit, having chosen thee, O Pure One, loved thee greatly as a dwelling for Himself, becoming incarnate.[^6172]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Ever entreat God, Whom thou didst bear, to save me who am in despair, and to obtain forgiveness for me who cry in faith: O God, blessed art Thou.[^6173]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Unto Thee the Creator of all, the Children in the furnace, having woven a universal choir, sang: All ye works, praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^6174]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thy childbearing escapes examination, O Virgin, and is revealed through faith unto those who cry: All ye works of the Lord, praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages.[^6175]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having in no wise fallen from virginal glory, thou wast enriched with maternal honor, O unwedded One: He knows who visibly wrought these wonders. Whom we supremely exalt unto the ages.[^6176]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Behold, O Good and All-pure One, the affliction of my humble soul: and change my sickness quickly, that I may glorify thee unto the ages.[^6177]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Receive graciously Thy Mother, O Word, who prays Thee to save Thy people, O Good One, whom Thou didst acquire by Thy precious blood: that we may bless Thee unto all ages.[^6178]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Rejoice, O Isaiah: a Virgin had in womb and bare a Son, Emmanuel, both God and man, Orient is His name; Whom magnifying, we call the Virgin blessed.[^6179]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Lady Theotokos, entreat the adored Trinity, of Whom thou didst impassibly bear One for us in the flesh, to bring peace unto those upon the earth, and for the remission of...

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: ...transgressions to be granted unto those who sing of thee.[^6180]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Though Emmanuel is understood to be one in Person, yet He is twofold in nature: for lo, He makes known two wills that are in Him, and two energies; Whose parent we confess to be the Theotokos.[^6181]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* I weep for myself, thinking of the multitude of my sins, and the assaults of passions, the despondency of my soul, and the aberration of my mind: make me, who am in despair, worthy of salvation.[^6182]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Mine enemies having fallen upon me, O Lord, like robbers, stripped me of my high, radiant, and light-formed garment, and laid many wounds upon me: do thou, standing by, raise me up who am barely alive.[^6183]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Trisagion; after Our Father: Troparia and the rest.*[^6184]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *On Friday At Matins:*[^6185]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *After the 1st Stichologia, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 5:*[^6186]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* The Place of the Skull became Paradise: for no sooner was the wood of the Cross set up, than immediately it blossomed forth the living Cluster, even Thee, O Savior, unto our gladness. Glory to Thee.[^6187]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Let us the faithful sing and glorify our Savior and Deliverer who was crucified voluntarily as He knew and as He was well pleased: for He nailed the sins of men upon the Cross, delivering the human race from deception, and made them worthy of the Kingdom.[^6189]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Standing once by the Cross of the Lord, the pure Theotokos cried out weeping: Woe is me, O my divine Child! O my sweetest Light! How art Thou stretched out upon the Cross, who divinely stretched out heaven like a curtain, and by Thy command bringest up springs of waters from the sea?[^6190]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Stichologia, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 5:*[^6191]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Having endured the crucifixion by Thy will, Thou didst deliver men from corruption, O Savior! We the faithful hymn and worship Thee, for Thou hast enlightened us by the power of the Cross: and all of us glorify Thee, O Lover of mankind, Compassionate One, as the Giver of life and the Lord.[^6192]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Voluntarily, O Compassionate One, Thou didst endure the Cross, and as almighty God Thou didst destroy the ancient curse incurred for the sake of food; therefore, O Master Christ, we hymn and worship Thy divine and precious passions, glorifying unceasingly Thy dispensation which is beyond all speech.[^6194]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Today the memory of the Passion-bearers shines forth; for it hath a beam also from heaven: the Angelic choir keeps festival, and the human race feasts together. Therefore they pray unto the Lord, that our souls may find mercy.[^6196]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Stavrotheotokion:* By the Cross of thy Son, O thou who art graced of God, all deception of idols was abolished, and the demonic might was trampled down. Therefore we the faithful, as is our duty, ever hymn and bless thee, and confessing thee truly to be the Theotokos, we magnify thee.[^6197]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Stichologia, Sessional Hymns, Tone 5:*[^6198]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Beholding Thee nailed upon the Cross and fallen asleep, O Jesus, King of all, the Angelic ranks were struck with awe, and forthwith the demonic hosts were defeated, and the bars of Hades were shattered; and the tyranny of death was cast down, and the dead who were in the tombs arose.[^6200]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Fleeing from the bitterness of the tree, Adam slipped into corruption through the envy of the serpent; but when Thou wast nailed, O Jesus, he enjoyed life, and for the sake of the tree of the Cross he is again settled in the heavens; and the serpent was abolished, and corruption was swallowed up, and all of us offer glory unto Thee.[^6201]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Thee, O Christ, hanging voluntarily upon the Cross in the midst of thieves, Thy Mother, torn in her maternal womb, said: O sinless Son, how art Thou unjustly nailed upon the Cross like an evildoer, desiring to bring the human race to life, as Thou art supremely good?[^6202]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Precious and Life-Giving Cross.*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: Thou savest me from passions by Thy Passion, O my Christ).*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos:*[^6203]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: Unto God the Savior, who guided the people in the sea with dry feet, and drowned Pharaoh with all his host: unto Him alone let us sing, for He hath been glorified.[^6204]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Crucifixion.*[^6205]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Є҆ктенїа̀ ма́лаѧ, Свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̑ ѡ҆бы̑чныѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Voluntarily, O Christ, Thou didst endure the passion that slays passions, and Thou slewest him who of old slew us in Paradise; therefore we glorify Thy goodness.[^6206]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Воздви́глсѧ є҆сѝ на кре́стъ, и҆ низпаде́сѧ вра́гъ, и҆ па́дшіи воздвиго́хомсѧ, и҆ ра́йстіи жи́тели Хрїстѐ бы́хомъ, держа́вꙋ сла́вѧще ца́рствїѧ твоегѡ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst ascend upon the Cross, and the enemy fell down, and we who were fallen have been raised up, and have become dwellers of Paradise, O Christ, glorifying the majesty of Thy kingdom.[^6207]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Щи́томъ кре́стнымъ воору́жившесѧ до́брѣ, къ боре́нію всѧ́комꙋ ѡ҆полчи́стесѧ, премꙋ́дрїи Великому́ченици: и҆ того̀ побѣди́вше, сла́вꙋ получи́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Being well armed with the shield of the Cross, ye drew yourselves up for every struggle, O all-wise Great Martyrs: and having conquered him, ye received glory.[^6208]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гнци честні́и, на́съ ра́ди страда́льци Ꙗ҆́гнцꙋ пожре́номꙋ принесо́стесѧ, нечи́стыѧ же́ртвы ꙗ҆́вѣ оу҆ста́вльше; тѣ́мже оу҆блажа́емъ ва́съ, всехва́льніи.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* As precious lambs, O sufferers, ye offered yourselves unto the Lamb slain for our sake, manifestly abolishing unclean sacrifices; therefore we call you blessed, O all-praised ones.[^6209]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Но́во ѻ҆троча̀ на́мъ, Ве́тхаго де́ньми, чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во родила̀ є҆сѝ, ѡ҆бветша́вшее є҆стество̀ человѣ́ческое ѡ҆бновлѧ́ющаго, Всенепоро́чнаѧ, бж҃твенною стра́стїю свое́ю.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A new Child unto us, the Ancient of days, hast thou brought forth, O pure Virgin, who renews aged human nature, O all-immaculate one, by His divine Passion.[^6210]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Благоꙋтро́бїѧ и҆сто́чникъ, и҆ предста́тельницꙋ те́плꙋю вѣ́мь тѧ̀, всенепоро́чнаѧ Дѣ́вома́ти Марї́е, и҆ взыва́ю тебѣ̀: поми́лꙋй и҆ оу҆ще́дри смире́нную мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ.
items.english_text: *Second Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Въ нѣ́дрѣхъ твои́хъ Сы́нъ Бж҃і́й Чи́стаѧ всели́всѧ, и҆ воспрїѧ́въ человѣ́ческое сꙋщество̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ преблагі́й, всѣ́хъ и҆зба́ви ѿ тлѝ ѕмі́евы.
items.english_text: *The same Heirmos.*[^6211]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣще́нїе мнѣ̀ бꙋ́ди, и҆ спасенї́ѧ наде́жда, Бг҃ороди́тельнице всенепоро́чнаѧ: прегрѣше́ній разрѣша́ющи плѣни́цы, и҆ и҆збавлѧ́ющи мѧ̀ бꙋ́дꙋщїѧ мꙋ́ки и҆ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A fountain of tender mercy and a fervent protectress do I know thee to be, O all-immaculate Virgin Mother Mary, and I cry unto thee: Have mercy and take pity upon my humble soul.[^6212]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Помышле́ній лꙋка́выхъ смире́нную мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ свободѝ Бг҃ороди́тельнице: и҆ жили́ще Бж҃їе тꙋ̀ содѣ́лай, да по до́лгꙋ тѧ̀ сла́влю всегда̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Within thy womb the Son of God took up His abode, O pure one, and having assumed human nature, as He is supremely good, He delivered all from the corruption of the serpent.[^6213]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою креста̀ твоегѡ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, оу҆твердѝ моѐ помышле́нїе, во є҆́же пѣ́ти и҆ сла́вити спаси́тельное твоѐ распѧ́тїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Be thou my enlightenment and hope of salvation, O all-immaculate Birthgiver of God, loosing the bonds of my transgressions, and delivering me from future torment and condemnation.[^6214]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆вѧда́еши пло́дъ тлѝ, на дре́во Спа́се воздвиза́емь, и҆ нетлѣ́нїѧ и҆сто́чники на́мъ ѿ ре́бръ и҆сточа́еши, Влады́ко.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Free my humble soul from evil thoughts, O Birthgiver of God, and make it a dwelling-place of God, that according to my duty I may ever glorify thee.[^6215]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Закла́всѧ на крестѣ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡже а҆́гнецъ, пра́ги назна́менаѧ дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ бж҃твенною твое́ю кро́вїю, Влады́ко: тѣ́мже тѧ̀ со стра́хомъ сла́вимъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* By the power of Thy Cross, O Christ, establish my mind, that I may sing and glorify Thy saving crucifixion.[^6216]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being lifted up upon the Tree, O Savior, Thou witherest the fruit of corruption, and Thou pourest forth unto us from Thy ribs the fountains of incorruption, O Master.[^6217]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Being slain upon the Cross as a lamb, marking the thresholds of our souls with Thy divine blood, O Master; therefore with fear we glorify Thee.[^6218]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Bound for the sake of Christ, O sufferers, and wounded in diverse ways, and cast unto beasts, ye remained immutable.[^6219]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* As clusters of the vine of life, the martyrs of our God poured forth the wine of suffering, gladdening the hearts of the faithful.[^6220]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Dying upon the Tree, O pure one, thy Son and Lord appeared as the Mediator of life unto us, glorifying those who sing to thee.[^6221]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The same Heirmos.*[^6222]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Lead me out by thy compassionate goodness, O Birthgiver of God, who have fallen into the pit of destruction of grievous sins.[^6223]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having arrived at the evening of life, and being held fast by perplexity, I cry unto thee, O all-hymned one: Appear as my helper.[^6224]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Holy pure Theotokos, grant forgiveness of my transgressions, and ask for me salvation and eternal rejoicing.[^6225]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Grant me a drop of tears, O pure one, that from my heart I may drive away perplexity, and sincerely hymn thee.[^6226]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* I heard the report of the power of the Cross, that Paradise was opened thereby, and I cried out: Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^6227]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* When Thou didst set upon the Cross, O Christ, Sun of righteousness, Thou didst shine forth unwaning light unto us who sing, O Word, of Thy dread dispensation.[^6228]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When Thou, O Judge, didst stand once before the judgment-seat, O Christ, Thou didst condemn the unrighteous enemy, and Thou wast crucified in the midst of the unrighteous, justifying us.[^6229]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Crowned victoriously, the sufferers of the Lord put the invisible enemy to shame, and cried out: Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^6230]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Coming together, ye faithful, let us honor the unfading flowers of the spiritual Paradise, the precious vessels of Christ, the passion-bearers.[^6231]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* When thou didst behold Christ upon the Cross, whom thou didst bear, O pure one, thou wast amazed at His ineffable long-suffering; therefore with Him we glorify thee.[^6232]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The same Heirmos.*[^6233]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Concerning my evil deeds and manifold transgressions, who shall be able to entreat the Judge, unless thou, O pure one,

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: the only protectress of those who sin?[^6234]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Raise me up by thy power, O all-pure one, who am fallen by many transgressions and have enslaved my soul to sin, and release me from servitude by thy prayer.[^6235]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* As having borne the Creator and King of all, O all-immaculate, pure Theotokos, do thou deliver me from every defiled transgression.[^6236]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* I weep for myself when I come to contemplate my many transgressions and the unquenchable fire. I pray: Grant me time for repentance, O all-pure one.[^6237]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Rising early, we cry unto Thee, O Lord: Save us! For Thou art our God; besides Thee we know no other.[^6238]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The rocks, perceiving Thee lifted up upon the rock, O Christ, were split asunder, and the foundations of the earth were shaken.[^6239]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The sun laid aside its brightness when Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree, O Sun of righteousness, long-suffering One.[^6240]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Ye shine with the brightness of miracles, O holy ones, driving away the darkness of diseases by grace.[^6241]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Your bodies were cut in pieces with swords, but the spirit of divine love ye kept uncut, O martyrs.[^6242]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beholding the Savior lifted up upon the Cross, weeping thou didst cry aloud, O all-immaculate Virgin Mother.[^6243]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The same Heirmos.*[^6244]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* When I have received the wound of sin in my whole body, heal me with the herb of thy tender mercy, O Lady.[^6245]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Of old thou didst stop the flow of corruption by thy divine childbirth; and now stop the flow of my transgressions, O all-immaculate one.[^6246]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Have mercy and take pity upon my soul, O Lady, and deliver it from condemnation and eternal torment.[^6247]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Look down and hear my voice, O Lady; and I pray: Deliver me from eternal torment.[^6248]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* The abyss surrounded me, the sea-monster became my tomb; but I cried unto Thee, the Lover of mankind, and Thy right hand saved me, O Lord.[^6249]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Cross was planted upon the earth, and the fall of the demons took place, and faith received the beginning of establishment, and wickedness was driven away from our midst.[^6250]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The sun was extinguished when Thou didst kindle Thy flesh like a candle upon the Tree, O Lord; and the drachma was found which had been buried by dark passions.[^6251]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* When Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree, O Lover of mankind, Thou hadst a choir of martyrs following in Thy footsteps, imitating Thy Passion, the mediatress of dispassion.[^6252]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Ye dried up deceitful streams by the pouring forth of your blood, and ye quenched the alien fire of the demons with divine dew, O crown-bearing martyrs.[^6253]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A sword pierced thy heart, O all-immaculate Virgin, when thou didst behold the Creator crucified, and His divine ribs pierced with a spear.[^6254]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The same Heirmos.*[^6255]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The abyss of transgressions hath encompassed me, and the depth of sin holds me fast, and brings me unto ruinous despair; O holy Lady, do thou now save me.[^6256]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Raise me up who lie upon the bed of sins, O most holy Lady, and grant me saving illumination through repentance.[^6257]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Cleanse me, O Lover of mankind, through the prayers of her who purely gave Thee birth, and deliver Thy world from every affliction; and make us worthy of eternal glory.[^6258]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Continually I promise to depart from evil deeds, but always I lie, and grieve my Master. O all-pure Lady, grant me amendment.[^6259]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* O Thou Who didst save the hymn-singing youths in the fiery furnace: Blessed is the God of our fathers.[^6260]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* That we might be delivered from pleasurable sin, Thou didst taste gall, O Christ, Thou vital Sweetness.[^6261]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When Thou wast wounded upon the Tree, O Christ, the ancient wounds of Adam were healed.[^6262]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* By their voluntary impulses the passion-bearers separated themselves unto suffering, and appeared as victors.[^6263]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Having honored God by painful dishonor, ye received the highest honor, O sufferers.[^6264]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* After childbirth, O pure one, thou remainest even as before childbirth; for He that was born was God, that He might deify mankind.[^6265]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The same Heirmos.*[^6266]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O pure Birthgiver of God, despise me not who continually flee under thy shelter with faith.[^6267]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Drying up the pasture of my passions, grant me to pour forth drops of tears, O Birthgiver of God.[^6268]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Bound as I am with the chains of sin, loose me by thy prayers, O all-immaculate one, who didst bear the all-hymned God.[^6269]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Unto thee I flee with faith, and upon thee, O pure one, do I call: Deliver me, O Virgin, from eternal fire.[^6270]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Him Who before the ages was begotten of the Father as Son and God, and in the last times was incarnate of the Virgin Mother: ye priests, sing; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^6271]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Thou Who by the Tree didst heal the curse of the tree, and didst pour forth blessing unto men, O Supremely-good One: Thee, O Savior, do we hymn, and Thee do we glorify unto the ages.[^6272]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst humble the exalted serpent by Thy Cross, and being humbled Thou didst raise up him who had fallen grievously: Thee, O Savior, do we hymn, and supremely exalt unto all ages.[^6273]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* The destroyers of deception and champions of the divine faith, pillars of the Church and truly firm diamonds, the weapons of Christ: with faith let us honor the passion-bearers in hymns.[^6274]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* The glorious passion-bearers, having shone forth like the sun, dispersed the clouds of diseases by grace, and destroyed the gloom of impiety by their Trinitarian faith.[^6275]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A bridal escort was sent unto thee, O Virgin, even Gabriel, crying unto thee and saying: Rejoice, most radiant palace of Christ the King of all, wherein taking up His abode, He deified all mankind.[^6276]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The same Heirmos.*[^6277]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being in perplexity both in heart and mind, not fearing the threat of Gehenna, I continually sin; but do thou, O Virgin,

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: dispel my perplexity, and deliver me from the fire.[^6278]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By the pleasures of my flesh I am often drawn away, and like a captive I am sold, continually angering God. O Theotokos, the only hope of the hopeless, do thou thyself have mercy on me.[^6279]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* For thy prayer is not put to shame, O all-immaculate one: for whatsoever thou wilt, thou bestowest, praying unto thy Son and God; therefore I pray unto thee: Have mercy and save my humble soul.[^6280]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* By bodily diseases, and passionate uprisings, and spiritual wounds I am grievously tormented; O thou who didst bear the only Benefactor, make me whole by thy prayers.[^6281]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Thee who beyond mind and word art the Mother of God, who in time didst ineffably bear the Timeless One, we the faithful magnify with one accord.[^6282]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The enemy's power and dominion were taken away, O only mighty Lord, when Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross, and didst cover Thy fingers with blood upon it.[^6283]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The lawless men who crucified Thee dug through Thy hands and Thy feet, O my Christ, and numbered Thy bones, and gave Thee gall with vinegar to drink.[^6284]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* With radiant lips ye proclaimed before the tormentors God Who became man, O passion-bearers, and ye inherited glory.[^6285]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* The enemies who wounded you received disease, striking you with wounds and diverse torments, O all-honored physicians of diseases, divine martyrs.[^6286]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Light shone forth unto us from thee, O pure one, even Jesus, and He enlightened all creation by His crucifixion, and drove away the demonic darkness.[^6287]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The same Heirmos.*[^6288]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Grant me tears of repentance, O all-pure one, that I may weep for my grievous and unrighteous deeds before the arrival of the end of my life.[^6289]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Why, O soul, dost thou grieve thy Master, doing unrighteous things, and dost not lift up thine eyes? Before the end, therefore, hasten and repent.[^6290]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Deliver me from evil transgressions

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: and sorrows; grant me mercy, O all-pure Virgin, and divine communion of incorruptible life.[^6291]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Thee who ineffably didst bear God have we acquired as protectress, and an invincible wall, and salvation of souls, and a fountain of miracles.[^6292]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Little Litany, Exapostilarion, and the usual psalms.*[^6293]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *On the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 5:*[^6294]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* No sooner was the wood of Thy Cross set up, O Christ, than deception was driven away, and grace blossomed forth; for no longer is there the tyranny of condemnation, but the victory of salvation hath appeared unto us. For the Cross is our boast, the Cross is our rejoicing.[^6295]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad: ... And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, and guide their sons.* [^6296]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* For our sake Thou wast led as a sheep to the sacrifice, O Christ, and as an innocent lamb, Emmanuel, unto voluntary slaughter, and Thou wast numbered with the transgressors. Come, ye families of the nations, sing and worship Him Who was suspended upon the Cross, the endless Life.[^6297]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us: ... And establish Thou the works of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish Thou.* [^6298]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Blessed is the host of the heavenly King! For though the passion-bearers were earth-born, yet they hastened to attain unto the angelic dignity, taking no heed for their bodies; and by reason of their sufferings they were counted worthy of the honor of the Bodiless Powers. Through their prayers, O Lord, save our souls.[^6299]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Stavrotheotokion:*[^6300]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: Assuage the affliction of my much-afflicted soul, cried out the Immaculate One in sorrow unto Christ: For if Thou savest the earthly by Thy Passion, yet Thou tearest my soul, O Word. Thou art my sweetest Light, Thou art my Child and my Creator: I hymn Thy long-suffering.[^6302]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *It is good to give thanks: Trisagion; after Our Father: troparion, Litany, and the rest as usual.*[^6303]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *On Friday, the Beatitudes, Tone 5:*[^6304]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The thief upon the cross, having believed Thee to be God, O Christ, confessed

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: Thee purely from the heart, crying: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy kingdom.[^6305]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having died upon the Cross on account of the tasting of food, Thou hast made us alive who were fallen, O compassionate Giver of life, and hast made us again, O Good One, to be dwellers of Paradise.[^6306]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou wast nailed upon the Cross, O Christ, the true Vine, and didst pour forth the drink of salvation, watering the hearts of all the faithful with grace.[^6307]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Being beaten, O wise ones, and dismembered in your limbs, ye imaged the slaughter of the Master; therefore, O martyrs of Christ, ye are continually called blessed.[^6308]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Glory: Triadikon:* We worship Thee with faith, the one God in three Persons, the indivisible and supremely divine essence, crying unto Thee: Glory to Thee, O consubstantial Trinity, our God![^6309]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* With weeping the Lady smote herself, seeing upon the Tree of the Cross our Life, Who had died voluntarily; therefore with divine voices we all continually call her blessed.[^6310]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *On Friday Evening.*[^6312]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerables, Tone 5:*[^6313]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* The passion-bearers quenched the flame of cruel impiety with the streams of their blood, kindling the brightness of piety in all the world, O martyrs; and the falsely named gods, and their wicked craft, and their temples, they burned down utterly. They shone forth a most pure light unto those upon earth, enlightened by which we flee the darkness of godlessness and idolatrous deception, worshipping Christ, Who grants great mercy unto the world.[^6315]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Having easily destroyed the words and snares of the impious heretics, ye became weapons of the unoriginate Father, the co-unoriginate Son, and the Holy Spirit, in three

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: Persons teaching the faithful with pious wisdom the unity of the Godhead, and confirming the Orthodox preaching. Therefore ye are called blessed, O all-sacred shepherds, for on life-bearing pastures ye tended the flock of Christ, for whose sake ye endured all pains and manifold tribulations.[^6316]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* The assembly of the venerable, having set forth, easily trampled bodily passions underfoot to the end, receiving through the practice of virtues the mind as sovereign; whereby they valiantly conquered all demonic wiles, and appeared as companions of the angels, having lived as bodiless ones. With them they now rejoice together, dwelling brightly in the mansions on high, and they stand before Christ, asking from Him that great mercy be granted unto our souls.[^6317]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Martyrs, same Tone:*[^6318]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* Clothed with the shield of faith, and strengthening themselves with the sign of the Cross, Thy holy ones, O Lord, bravely gave themselves over unto torments, and abolished the pride and deceit of the devil. Through their prayers, as Thou art almighty God, send down peace unto the world, and great mercy unto our souls.[^6319]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Вѧ́жеми Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лци, и҆ многообра́знѣ оу҆ранѧ́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непрело́жни пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5:* Caring nothing for all earthly things, and bravely venturing into torments, ye failed not of blessed hopes; but ye became heirs of the heavenly kingdom, O all-praised martyrs.
