Theotokion:* From enslavement unto the law of sin hast thou set us free, O Lady, having conceived in thy womb the Lawgiver and King, Christ, O only Virgin Mother, through Whom we are justified freely and by grace: Him do thou now entreat, that the souls of those who acknowledge thee as Mother of God may be written in the Book of Life; so that being saved by thy mediation, O All-Immaculate One, we may receive the beloved redemption of thy Son, worshipping Him Who grants unto the world great mercy.[^6511]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The thief on the cross, believing Thee to be God, O Christ, confessed Thee purely from the heart, crying: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy kingdom.[^6512]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (To the Martyrs):* Having died, O martyrs, ye destroyed the author-of-evil enemy, and ascended unto the heights, crowned with divine victories, and stood before God, the King of all.[^6513]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (To Hierarchs and Venerables):* Being enlightened by the light of the priesthood, the hierarchs were glorified, and the multitude of the venerable obtained life everlasting: therefore they are called blessed.[^6514]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Troparion 4 (For the Departed):* Settle with the choirs of the elect, in the place of refreshment, O Master, those whom Thou hast translated, O Word: looking past, O Christ, the transgressions committed by them upon earth.[^6515]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Glory: Triadikon:* O honorable Trinity! Be entreated by the struggles of the venerable hierarchs and honorable martyrs, and grant salvation and great mercy unto the souls of those who have died in faith.[^6516]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* O thou who didst contain Him Whom naught can contain, full of the grace of God, and didst bear Him beyond nature and word: do thou, O Lady, entreat Him to be merciful unto all.[^6517]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *[Engraved Tailpiece: An ornamental baroque floral cartouche with foliate scrolls and central rosette, marking the conclusion of Tone 5]*[^6518]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *[Engraved Headpiece: An ornate multi-panel baroque frieze depicting the Prophet Moses with the Tablets of the Law, King David, the Prophet Isaiah, the Holy Theotokos holding the Christ Child, Saint John the Baptist, and Saint John Chrysostom, framed in arabesque cartouches]*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," we set 4 verses, and sing 3 Resurrection Stichera, repeating the first.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1 (Resurrectional):* Having victory over hades, O Christ, Thou didst ascend the Cross, that Thou mightest raise with Thyself those sitting in the darkness of death, O Free among the dead: O Fountain of life from Thine own light, all-powerful Savior, have mercy on us. *(Twice)*[^6519]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 (Resurrectional):* Today Christ, having trampled down death, rose even as He said, and bestowed joy unto the world, that we all, crying aloud a song, may say thus: O Fountain of life, Unapproachable Light, all-powerful Savior, have mercy on us.[^6520]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3 (Resurrectional):* Whither shall we sinners flee from Thee, O Lord, Who fillest all creation?[^6521] In heaven Thou Thyself dwellest; in hades Thou hast trampled down death; into the depths of the sea? there is Thy hand, O Master. Unto Thee do we flee, falling down before Thee we pray: O Thou Who art risen from the dead, have mercy on us.[^6522]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* Come, all ye nations, let us praise with the voice of rejoicing the most holy Virgin and Mother of God, the crucible of human nature, the worker of ineffable wonders; for in her new things have come to pass: the Unoriginate begins, the Word takes on flesh, God becomes man, that He may make man God, not by a change of natures, but by union according to hypostasis; for there proceeds One from two opposites, in two perfect natures indivisibly made known, in will and in energy according to each essence. Being Himself believed according to His true reality, for the sake of saving dispensation, Christ our God, granting unto the world cleansing, peace, and great mercy.[^6523]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light. Prokeimenon: "The Lord is King," three times. Vouchsafe, O Lord.*[^6524]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Resurrection Sticheron, Tone 6:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: Thy Resurrection, O Christ Savior, the angels hymn in the heavens: and account us upon earth worthy to glorify Thee with a pure heart.[^6525]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Most Holy Theotokos.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: Having given birth unto the incarnate Word, Who is co-eternal with the Father before the ages, O all-immaculate Virgin...

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: ...loose the bonds of my humble soul, as I cry unto thee, the Helper of the world: deliver me from the dominion of passions and from sinful calamities; and I pray thee, save me, O All-Immaculate One, from the snares of the alien, for the sake of thy great mercy.[^6527]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Save me who am in despair through fornications, stripped bare of good works, and alienated from the Master's grace, O thou who alone didst bear the salvation of the world: deliver from perils and captivity me who willfully surrendered myself, and who through senselessness cast myself into the pit of destruction, O Lady, as thou art merciful and full of love for souls.[^6529]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Look upon my affliction, O Mother of God, and give ear unto the prayer of thy petitioner, O Pure One; grant me the mighty hand of thy help, O Mother of God! Receive the groaning from a defiled heart, O Most Holy One, and bear it unto thy Son and our God, O blessed Lady, for the sake of thy great mercy.[^6531]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Dogmatic Theotokion:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: It is truly meet to call thee blessed, O Mother of God: for entering into thy most pure womb, the Maker of all became flesh, not being changed in nature, nor imagining the dispensation; but being united according to hypostasis unto the rationally ensouled flesh taken from thee; whence piously we make distinction of those things manifested in both natures. Him do thou entreat, O honorable and most holy Lady, to send down upon us peace and great mercy.[^6532]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Then: Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart; Trisagion, and after Our Father: Troparion: "The angelic powers were upon Thy tomb"; Theotokion: "He that called Thy Mother blessed"; litany, and dismissal.*[^6533]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," we set 10 verses, and sing the following Resurrection Stichera, Tone 6:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1 (Resurrectional):* Having victory over hades, O Christ, Thou didst ascend the Cross, that Thou mightest raise with Thyself those sitting in the darkness of death, O Free among the dead: O Fountain of life from Thine own light, all-powerful Savior, have mercy on us.[^6534]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 (Resurrectional):* Today Christ, having trampled down death, rose even as He said, and bestowed joy unto the world, that we all, crying aloud, may say a song thus: O Fountain of life, Unapproachable Light, all-powerful Savior, have mercy on us.[^6535]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3 (Resurrectional):* Whither shall we sinners flee from Thee, O Lord, Who fillest all creation?[^6536] In heaven Thou Thyself dwellest; in hades Thou hast trampled down death; into the depths of the sea? there is Thy hand, O Master. Unto Thee do we flee, falling down before Thee we pray: O Thou Who art risen from the dead, have mercy on us.[^6537]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, Anatolian (Eastern), the same Tone:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4 (Anatolian):* In Thy Cross, O Christ, do we boast, and Thy Resurrection we hymn and glorify; for Thou art our God, besides Thee we know no other.[^6538]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5 (Anatolian):* Glory to Thy power, O Lord; for Thou hast brought to naught him that had the dominion of death; Thou hast renewed us by Thy Cross: grant unto us life and incorruption.[^6539]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 6 (Anatolian):* Ever blessing the Lord, we hymn His Resurrection; for having endured the Cross, by death He destroyed death.[^6540]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 7 (Anatolian):* Thy burial, O Lord, having broken in pieces the bonds of hades, tore them asunder; Thy Resurrection from the dead enlightened the world: O Lord, glory to Thee.[^6541]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Theotokos (The composition of Paul of Amorion), Tone 6:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 8 (By Paul of Amorion):* Seeing my bodily weakness, and the suffering of my soul, and the affliction of my heart, account me worthy of Thy divine...

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: ...visitation, O all-immaculate Virgin! Save me, I pray thee, by thy fervent supplications.[^6542]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 9 (By Paul of Amorion):* I have surpassed all in sins, O Lady; but having cleansed the multitude of them, O Virgin, account me worthy to obtain mercies, O Pure One, at the future judgment of thy Son and God.[^6543]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 10 (By Paul of Amorion):* Cleanse the multitude of my transgressions, O Pure One, who cry unto thee, and cut down with the sword of prayer the unbridled movements of my senses, that with faith and love I may hymn thy seedless childbirth.[^6544]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Dogmatic Theotokion:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: Who doth not call thee blessed, O all-holy Virgin? Who will not sing of thy most pure childbirth? For the only-begotten Son, Who shone timelessly from the Father, the same came forth from thee, the Pure One, ineffably incarnate: being God by nature, and having become man by nature for our sake; not divided into two persons, but known in two natures without confusion. Him do thou entreat, O pure and all-blessed one, that our souls may find mercy.[^6545]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light. Prokeimenon: "The Lord is King," and the rest.*[^6546]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Resurrection Sticheron:* Thy Resurrection, O Christ Savior, the angels hymn in the heavens: and account us upon earth worthy to glorify Thee with a pure heart.[^6547]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1 (Alphabetical):* Having broken in pieces the gates of brass, and shattered the bars of hades as almighty God, Thou didst raise up the fallen human race: for this reason we also cry out with one accord: O Lord Who art risen from the dead, glory to Thee.[^6549]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 (Alphabetical):* Desiring to right us from ancient corruption, Christ was nailed upon the Cross and laid in a tomb; Whom the myrrh-bearing women sought with tears, weeping and saying: Woe unto us, O Savior of all! How didst Thou deign to take up Thine abode in a tomb?[^6551] And having taken up Thine abode willingly, how wast Thou stolen away? How hast Thou been translated? What place hid Thy life-bearing body? But O Master, even as Thou didst promise, appear unto us, and soothe from us the weeping of tears! And while they were weeping, an angel cried unto them: Ceasing from weeping, say unto the Apostles that the Lord is risen, granting unto the world cleansing and great mercy.[^6552]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3 (Alphabetical):* Being crucified as Thou didst will, O Christ, and having despoiled death by Thy burial, Thou didst rise on the third day as God with glory: granting unto the world unending life and great mercy.[^6554]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* My Creator and Redeemer, O All-Pure One, Christ the Lord, coming forth from thy womb, clothed in me, delivered Adam from the first curse; therefore unto thee, O All-Immaculate One, as in truth the Mother of God and Virgin, we cry unceasingly with the angel: Rejoice! Rejoice, O Lady, protection and shelter, and salvation of our souls.[^6555]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart; Trisagion, and after Our Father:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: The angelic powers were upon Thy tomb, and the guards became as dead men; and Mary stood at the tomb, seeking Thy most pure body. Thou didst despoil hades, not being tempted by it; Thou didst meet the Virgin, granting life: O Lord Who art risen from the dead, glory to Thee.[^6556]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* Calling Thy Mother blessed, Thou camest unto the Passion by voluntary will, shining upon the Cross, desiring to seek out Adam, saying unto the angels: Rejoice with Me, for the lost drachma hath been found.[^6557] O our God Who hast wisely ordered all things, glory to Thee.[^6558]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Thereafter, the dismissal.*[^6559]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 6.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Having walked on foot upon the deep with dryshod steps as upon dry land, Israel, beholding Pharaoh the pursuer drowned, cried: Let us sing a song of victory unto God.[^6560]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^6561]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having unstinting grace as divine, O unwedded Mother, despise not those who flee unto thee, ever saving them from perils and afflictions.[^6562]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Behold, the time of my despondency is come: arise, O all-pure Lady, and give me a hand of help; for thou didst fill the world with divine joy.[^6563]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋ́дный по́стничествомъ преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ премꙋ́-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Being my protection, O Mother of God, grant speedily thy mighty protection unto me who am held fast by temptations, and preserve me unharmed by them.[^6564]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋшѝ мое́й сме́рть притѣка́етъ, и҆скꙋше́нїа же ненави́дѧщихъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́спїды ѡ҆быдо́ша погꙋби́ти мѧ̀; но сама́ мѧ Бцⷣе спасѝ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Death draws near unto my soul, and the temptations of those that hate me have surrounded me like asps to destroy me; but do thou thyself save me, O Mother of God.[^6565]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Разшири́шасѧ на врагѝ моѧ̑ оу҆ста̀ моѧ̑, ꙗ҆́ко оу҆тверди́сѧ ѡ҆ Гдⷭ҇ѣ се́рдце моѐ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* My mouth hath opened wide against mine enemies, for my heart is established in the Lord.[^6566]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нную дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ прегрѣше́ньми, живо́тъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ро́ждшаѧ Бцⷣе, ѡ҆живѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* My soul that is deadened by transgressions, O Mother of God who didst bear the Life, do thou quicken.[^6567]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿ всѧ́кагѡ и҆скꙋше́нїа соблюдѝ, къ тебѣ̀ прибѣга́ющихъ Бцⷣе, оу҆пова́нїе на́ше.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* From every temptation preserve those who flee unto thee, O Mother of God, our hope.[^6568]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿ воста́ющихъ на мѧ̀ напа́стей го́рькѡ, спасѝ мѧ Ма́ти Гдⷭ҇а моегѡ̀ пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* O all-immaculate Mother of my Lord, bitterly save me from the afflictions that rise up against me.[^6569]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́же мі́рови спасе́нїе подаю́щи, бж҃твеннымъ Рождество́мъ твои́мъ, ѿ бѣ́дъ мѧ̀ премѣнѝ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* O thou who grantest salvation unto the world through thy divine Nativity, deliver me from perils.[^6570]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́ша проро́къ прише́ствїе твоѐ Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ оу҆боѧ́ся, ꙗ҆́ко хо́щеши ѿ Дѣ́вы роди́тисѧ, и҆ человѣ́кѡмъ ꙗ҆ви́тисѧ, и҆ глаго́лаше: оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ оу҆боѧ́хсѧ: сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* The Prophet heard of Thy coming, O Lord, and was afraid, that Thou wast about to be born of a Virgin and appear unto men, and he said: I heard the report of Thee, and was afraid; glory to Thy power, O Lord.[^6571]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: И҆знемо́же нището́ю крѣ́пость дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀, Бг҃ороди́телнице, и҆ лю́тое на мѧ̀ ѻ҆мраче́нїе нападѐ, ѿ прегрѣше́ній и҆мꙋ́щее нахо́дъ: при́зри ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣтоно́сный ѻ҆́блакъ Бж҃їй, и҆ просвѣти́ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The strength of my soul hath failed through poverty, O Mother of God, and grievous darkening hath fallen upon me, having its onset from transgressions; look down, as the light-bearing cloud of God, and enlighten me, I pray thee.[^6572]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Бꙋ́ри ѕѡ́лъ мои́хъ, и҆ смꙋще́нїе прегрѣше́ній, преложѝ въ тишинꙋ̀ спасе́нїа, ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́щи приста́нище Всенепоро́чнаѧ, рыка́юще и҆́щꙋтъ мѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ льво́ве пожре́ти, па́гꙋбы тѣ́хъ и҆зба́ви мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Turn the tempest of mine evils and the confusion of transgressions into the calm of salvation, since thou art a haven, O All-Immaculate One; roaring like lions they seek to devour me: deliver me, I pray thee, from their destruction.[^6573]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Въ нощѝ и҆ въ днѝ, на землѝ же и҆ въ мо́ри, и҆ на всѧ́комъ мѣ́стѣ, спасе́нїе тве́рдо сꙋ́щи, Бцⷣе покро́ве непобѣди́мый, спаса́й мѧ: по Бз҃ѣ бо на тѧ̀ вои́стинꙋ Хрⷭ҇тїа́не оу҆пова́емъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* In night and in day, upon earth and at sea, and in every place, since thou art steadfast salvation, O Mother of God, an unconquerable protection, save me; for after God, we Christians truly place our hope in thee.[^6574]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿ вели́кихъ и҆ разли́чныхъ прегрѣше́ній же и҆ напа́стей, всегда̀ спаса́еши мѧ; тѣ́мже ꙗ҆́кѡ ро́ждшꙋю тѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇а, молю̀, и҆ къ тебѣ̀ прибѣга́ю, непобѣди́мѣй по́мощи скорбя́щимъ: ѿ бѣ́дъ и҆зведѝ мѧ мольба́ми твои́ми.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* From great and diverse transgressions and afflictions thou ever savest me; therefore, as having borne the Lord, O Virgin, I pray thee, and unto thee do I flee, the unconquerable help of the afflicted: bring me out of perils by thy supplications.[^6575]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тъ возсїѧ́й мі́рꙋ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, просвѣтѝ се́рдце моѐ ѿ но́щи тебѣ̀ зовꙋ́ща, и҆ спасѝ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Christ, Who didst cause the light to shine upon the world, enlighten my heart that cries unto Thee from the night, and save me.[^6576]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As the shelter of salvation we glorify thee, O all-immaculate Mother of the Word, not fearing the plottings of men.[^6577]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having thee as an insurmountable wall, we are delivered from temptations and from the uprising of sorrows, O All-Pure One.[^6578]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Deliver me from the tongue of evil men, O Pure One; for like a razor hath it been sharpened, bitterly seeking to destroy my soul.[^6579]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Diligently do I fall down before thee, praying: as the Mother of my Creator, set me free from the perils that hold me fast.[^6580]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Devoured by the sea-monster of sin, I cry unto Thee, O Christ: As the prophet, set me free from corruption.[^6581]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having received the taste of bitterness, I have become estranged from divine sweetness, O All-Pure One! Therefore I cry unto thee: Grant me help.[^6582]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The darkening of passions hath made me a slave of corruption; therefore, O Lady who didst bear the Light, set me free.[^6583]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* In harmony and in faith do I confess thee, O All-Pure One, and I will sacrifice unto thee a sacrifice, having been delivered through thee from sorrow.[^6584]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* The mouths of unrighteousness have opened against me, O Lady; therefore, as an intercessor, deliver me speedily from them.[^6585]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Then, Lord, have mercy, thrice. Glory... both now...*[^6586]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: Unashamed protectress of Christians, unwavering mediatress with the Creator, despise not the voices of sinners in prayer, but in thy goodness anticipate us for our help who faithfully cry unto thee: hasten unto prayer and speed unto supplication, ever interceding, O Mother of God, for those who honor thee.[^6587]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The angel made the furnace a source of dew for the holy children, but the command of God burning up the Chaldeans persuaded the tyrant to cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^6588]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Temptations have now surrounded my soul like fat bullocks; O most holy Virgin, do thou thyself set me free from them.[^6589]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou diligently protectest those who are in peril and in sorrow, ever granting joy, O Mother of God.[^6590]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Vanquished entirely by despair of deeds and sorrow, encompass me with a shield, O Virgin, as the indestructible protection of all.[^6591]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* By thine intercession we are delivered from perils and sorrows, and we find great and inexhaustible riches.[^6592]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Out of the flame Thou didst pour forth dew for the holy children, and the sacrifice of the righteous man with the water Thou didst consume with fire; for Thou doest all things, O Christ, merely by willing them; Thee do we highly exalt unto all ages.[^6593]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I am consumed by the malicious afflictions of men, and I pray thee, O Mother of God: Deliver me from their vain counsel.[^6594]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I have been overcome in sorrows by my temptations, and I pray thee, O Lady: Save me unharmed from them.[^6595]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Save me, O Pure One, from deceitful man, and from the tongue and lips, and tyranny, and every distress.[^6596]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Being deceived in character and without excuse, I cry unto the Mother of God: Deliver me from all evils.[^6597]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* O Virgin who didst receive from the angel the greeting "Rejoice," and didst bear thine own Creator, save those who magnify thee.[^6598]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Be merciful unto me, O Mother of God, in the sorrows of life, and save from perils him that now flees unto thee.[^6599]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In truth, alone upon earth and at sea, thou hast been shown forth, O Pure One, an indestructible shelter unto those who flee unto thee with unhesitating soul.[^6600]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Unto me who have mindlessly enslaved myself unto every grievous fall, grant freedom through thy supplications, O All-Praised One.[^6601]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Having gained thee as a steadfast hope and protection, O Pure One, magnifying thee as the Mother of God, I conclude the hymn with faith.[^6602]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Then, It is truly meet; Trisagion, and after Our Father: Hypakoe, and the rest as usual, and the dismissal.*[^6603]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *On Sunday Morning at the Midnight Office.*[^6604]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity. (Whose acrostic is: "A sixth hymn I offer unto Thee, O Divinity"). The work of Metrophanes.*[^6605]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Having walked on foot upon the deep with dryshod steps as upon dry land, Israel, beholding Pharaoh the pursuer drowned, cried: Let us sing a song of victory unto God.[^6606]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Trinity, our God, glory to Thee.*[^6607]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Three hypostases we hymn originating in God, the unchangeable form of a single nature, the good Lover of mankind, Who grants unto us the cleansing of transgressions.[^6608]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Thou Who art transcendent in essence, One, and thrice-radiant in Thy characters, O Lord, existing in one Godhead: give us understanding, and vouchsafe us Thy divine radiance.[^6609]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Adorning as a bride the Church from the nations, Paul taught us to worship Thee, the one God in three hypostases, from Whom and through Whom and in Whom all things were made.[^6610]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* From thy womb came forth the spiritual Sun, O Mother of God, and shone upon us with the rays of the thrice-radiant Godhead; Whom hymning, with piety we call thee blessed.[^6611]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* There is none holy as Thou, O Lord my God, Who hast exalted the horn of Thy faithful, O Good One, and established us upon the rock of Thy confession.[^6612]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having adorned the heavenly ranks, O thrice-radiant God, Thou hast ordained that they should sing unto Thee with thrice-holy voices; with them receive also us who hymn Thy goodness.[^6613]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Hymning the one immutable, threefold, harmonious, solitary Principle of Divinity, we pray Thee fervently: send down now unto us the forgiveness of many sins.[^6614]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* O Mind, unoriginate Father, co-essential Word of God, and divine Spirit, good and right: preserve those who faithfully hymn Thy dominion, as Thou art compassionate.[^6615]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* The pasture of corruption among men did my God consume, becoming man in essence within thy womb, O Pure One; and alone He set free our forebears from the former condemnation.[^6616]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Then, Lord, have mercy, thrice.*[^6617]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: O Master God, look down from heaven and behold our lowliness, as Thou art compassionate, and have mercy, O all-good Lover of mankind! For from nowhere do we hope to receive forgiveness of the evil things wherein we have sinned. Therefore be with us, and none can be against us.[^6618]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: O pure Lady, look down, O Mother of God; behold the pains of our wounds and have mercy, O All-Pure One, and heal the burning of conscience, bedewing it with thy mercy, and crying unto thy servants: I

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: am with you, and none can be against you.[^6619]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Christ is my power, God and Lord, the venerable Church sings in godly manner, crying out from a pure mind, keeping festival in the Lord.[^6620]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Thou Who liftest up the mind, O thrice-radiant Unity: speedily elevate the soul and heart of Thy chanters, and vouchsafe them Thy radiance and brightness.[^6621]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Transform and reshape me from all malice unto virtue, O single, uncircumscribed, and immutable Trinity, and enlighten me with Thy rays.[^6622]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Having devised them beforehand, Thou didst wisely assemble the ministering ranks of angels of Thy goodness, O Unity in three hypostases: with them receive my praise.[^6623]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* He Who by nature is uncreated God, co-eternal, taking upon Himself created human nature, reshaped it in thy holy womb, O Mother of God, Ever-Virgin.[^6624]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* With Thy divine light, O Good One, illumine in love the souls of those who awake early unto Thee, I pray: that they may know Thee, O Word of God, as the true God, calling them back from the darkness of sin.[^6625]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Meditating upon the divine Nature, providential and saving of all things, O Master, thrice-radiant and yet one, unto Thee do we awake early, asking forgiveness of transgressions.[^6626]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O unoriginate Father and God, and co-eternal Son, and Holy Spirit: establish Thy chanters, O Trinity of solitary rule, and deliver them from every affliction and sorrow.[^6627]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Guide me by these godlike splendors, and ever directing me unto the pleasing of Thy Godhead in three hypostases, O Sun of glory, make me a partaker of the divine kingdom.[^6628]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* O Word of God Who upholdest and preservest all things by Thine almighty hand, immutable One: preserve and keep those who glorify Thee, through the prayers of the Mother of God who bore Thee.[^6629]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Beholding the sea of life surging with the tempest of temptations, fleeing to Thy calm haven I cry unto Thee: Lead up my life from corruption, O Greatly-Merciful One.[^6630]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Wisdom and understanding, O thrice-radiant Principle of Divinity, grant unto Thy chanters, and with the beauties

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: of Thy light-creating goodness vouchsafe all to be illumined. Twice.[^6631]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* O Light indivisible in essence, thrice-radiant, almighty, unapproachable: enlighten the hearts of those who faithfully praise Thy dominion, and wing them toward divine love.[^6632]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* In thee the Sustainer and Lord of all manifestly took up His abode, O Ever-Virgin, and taught men to worship the single, thrice-radiant form of the Godhead.[^6633]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Lord, have mercy, thrice.*[^6634]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: O Father and Son with the Holy Spirit, look down upon us who with faith worship Thee, and who glorify Thy dominion, O Compassionate One, dust mingling with the fiery hosts; for we know none other besides Thee; and cry aloud unto those who hymn Thee: I am with you, and none can be against you.[^6635]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: Look down upon us, O all-praised Mother of God; cause enlightenment to dawn upon darkened hearts, and illumine thy flock, O All-Pure One! For whatsoever thou wilt, thou canst do, as being the Mother of thy Creator; and cry aloud unto those who pray to thee: I am with you, and none can be against you.[^6636]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The angel made the furnace a source of dew for the holy children, but the command of God burning up the Chaldeans persuaded the tyrant to cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^6637]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Establish a steadfast mind in me, O Unity thrice-radiant in Thy characters, that I may keep and observe Thy divine commandments, and ever sing unto Thee with faith: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^6638]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As hymned in the sameness of nature, O ineffable God, yet bearing the number of a Trinity in Persons: preserve us all from diverse temptations and distresses.[^6639]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Co-essential and co-eternal do we glorify Thee, the one God in essence, O Trinity, unconfused in hypostatic properties, simply presenting what is distinct in an unchangeable form manifestly.[^6640]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* The transcendent God, O All-Pure One, manifestly took from thy pure womb our mixture out of love for mankind, and taught all to

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^6641]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Out of the flame Thou didst pour forth dew for the holy children, and the sacrifice of the righteous man with the water Thou didst consume with fire; for Thou doest all things, O Christ, merely by willing them; Thee do we highly exalt unto all ages.[^6642]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Cleansing of transgressions speedily grant unto me, and deliverance from manifold passions, O harmonious Trinity, Unity in three hypostases! That I may glorify Thee unto all ages.[^6643]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Confirmed as the Lover of mercy, as Thou art a merciful God, have mercy upon all, O thrice-radiant Unity, and all-good Trinity, who praise Thy majesty.[^6644]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* From the Light of the co-eternal Father, the Word born as Light co-eternal, together with the Spirit Who proceeds as Light, with faith we glorify and highly exalt unto all ages.[^6645]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* A Physician for men hast thou borne, O All-Pure One: Christ the Lord, the all-powerful Word, Who heals the ancestral wounds of all that highly exalt Him unto the ages.[^6646]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* It is impossible for men to see God, upon Whom the ranks of angels dare not gaze; but through thee, O All-Pure One, the incarnate Word was shown forth unto men; Whom magnifying together with the heavenly hosts, we call thee blessed.[^6647]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The ranks of the Cherubim, O Master, unable to gaze upon the beauty of Thy glory, covering themselves with their wings, unceasingly cry the thrice-holy hymn, glorifying the dominion of Thy single, thrice-radiant Principle of Divinity.[^6648]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Grant Thy splendors into the hearts of Thy servants, O unsetting Sun; and enlighten our souls, and deliver us from many transgressions, O only All-Merciful One in three hypostases; and vouchsafe us Thy incorruptible life.[^6649]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* O Deity existing as Light equally honored, thrice-radiant, and light-creating: illumine those who hymn Thee with faith; and deliver us from dark malice, and vouchsafe us Thy most radiant habitations, as Thou art all-good.[^6650]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Most wisely did thy Son create man in the beginning, O Virgin, and through thee, O All-Praised One, He renewed him when corrupted; and with the unwaning rays of divine light He filled all who glorify thee in faith as the true Mother of God.[^6651]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *After this, the refrains of Gregory the Sinaite, and the rest of the Midnight Office.*[^6652]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *On Sunday at Matins.*[^6653]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *After the Six Psalms: "God is the Lord," in Tone 6. After this, the Resurrection Troparion: "The angelic powers were upon Thy tomb," twice. Glory: troparion of the Saint; Both now: Theotokion in the Tone of the troparion of the Saint. Then the customary reading of the Psalter.*[^6654]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Resurrection Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: While the tomb was open and hades was weeping, Mary cried aloud unto the hidden Apostles: Come forth, ye laborers of the vineyard, proclaim the word of the Resurrection: The Lord is risen, granting unto the world great mercy.[^6655]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: Life lay in the tomb, and a seal was placed upon the stone; as a sleeping king the soldiers guarded Christ; and having invisibly smitten His enemies, the Lord is risen.[^6657]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: O Virgin Mother of God, entreat thy Son, Christ our God, Who was willingly nailed upon the Cross and is risen from the dead, that our souls may be saved.[^6658]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Resurrection Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: O Lord, Mary Magdalene stood before Thy tomb, and she wept, crying aloud, and supposing Thee to be the gardener, she said: Where hast Thou hidden the eternal Life? Where hast Thou laid Him Who sits upon the Cherubic throne? For those who guarded Him have become as dead men from fear. Either give me my Lord, or cry out with me: O Thou Who wast among the dead, and hast raised up the dead, glory to Thee.[^6659]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: Jonah prefigured Thy tomb, and Symeon declares Thy divine rising, O immortal Lord: for Thou didst descend as a dead man into the tomb, Who didst destroy the gates of hades; and Thou didst rise without corruption as Master, for the salvation of the world, O Christ our God, Who didst enlighten those in darkness.[^6661]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: Gideon prefigured the conception, and David declares thy childbirth, O Mother of God: for as dew upon the fleece did the Word descend into thy womb, and without seed didst thou bud forth, O holy earth, for the salvation

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: of the world: Christ our God, O Full of Grace.[^6662]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *After the Evlogetaria, Hypakoe, Tone 6:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: By Thy voluntary and life-creating death, O Christ, having shattered the gates of hades as God, Thou didst open unto us the ancient Paradise; and having risen from the dead, Thou didst deliver our life from corruption.[^6663]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: Unto heaven do I lift up mine eyes, unto Thee, O Word: have compassion upon me, that I may live unto Thee.[^6664]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: Have mercy upon us who are brought to naught, fashioning Thy well-fitted vessels, O Word.[^6665]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Unto the Holy Spirit belongs every all-saving cause: if upon whomsoever He breathes according to worthiness, quickly He takes him from earthly things, wings him, makes him grow, and sets him on high.[^6666]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... the same.*[^6667]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: If the Lord had not been in us, none of us could have withstood the enemy's warfare; for they that conquer are exalted from hence.[^6668]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: Let not my soul be caught in their teeth as a bird, O Word: woe is me! How shall I escape from the enemy, being a lover of sin?[^6669]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Through the Holy Spirit is deification unto all, good pleasure, understanding, peace, and blessing; for He is of equal operation with the Father and the Word.[^6670]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... the same.*[^6671]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: They that hope in the Lord are fearful unto enemies, and marvelous unto all; for they look on high.[^6672]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: Unto iniquities the portion of the righteous puts not forth its hands, having Thee as a helper, O Savior.[^6673]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* The dominion of the Holy Spirit is over all: Whom the hosts on high worship, together with every breath below.[^6674]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now... the same.*[^6675]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: O Lord, stir up Thy might, and come to save us.[^6676]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Let every breath praise the Lord.*[^6678]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *The Resurrection Gospel. "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"; Psalm 50, and the rest in order.*[^6680]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Having walked on foot upon the deep with dryshod steps as upon dry land, Israel, beholding Pharaoh the pursuer drowned, cried: Let us sing a song of victory unto God.[^6681]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.*[^6682]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* With outstretched hands upon the Cross, O good Jesus, Thou didst fulfill the Father's good pleasure in all things: therefore a song of victory do we all sing unto Thee.[^6683]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With fear before Thee as a handmaid, death when commanded drew near unto the Master of life, Who through it grants unto us unending life and resurrection.[^6684]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having received thine own Creator, as He Himself willed, incarnate beyond comprehension from thy seedless womb, O Pure One, thou hast truly been shown forth the Lady of creation.[^6685]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross and Resurrection.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:* He Who with a wave of the sea hid the pursuing tyrant of old, the children of the saved hid beneath the earth; but let us, as the maidens, sing unto the Lord: For He hath been greatly glorified.[^6686]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* With fear the gates of death open unto Thee, and the eternal bars are shattered: for by Thy venerable descent, the dead of old rose again, thankfully singing Thy Resurrection, O Christ.[^6687]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In the lowest pit wast Thou laid, O Christ, having become dead; and Thou didst put to death the slayer, and the prisoners who were in hades didst Thou set free, who glorify Thy venerable Resurrection, O Master.[^6688]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, light-bearing tabernacle and candlestick, church, and table, and holy mountain! Rejoice, palace of glory, and throne of our God! Rejoice, insurmountable wall, unto us who hymn thee.[^6689]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Most Holy Theotokos.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: "O Mother of God, grant me unstinted grace").*[^6690]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos: Having walked on foot upon the deep:*[^6691]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having partaken of the food of disobedience from the tree, Eve brought in the curse; but this hast thou dissolved, O Pure One, having borne Christ, the Firstfruit of blessing.[^6692]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нїа тѧ̀ покро́въ сла́вимъ, Сло́ва Ма́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ, навѣ́тъ не боѧ́щеся человѣ́ческихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O thou who didst bear Christ, the Pearl from divine lightning: the gloom of my passions, and of transgressions...*[^6693]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: ній смꙋще́ніе Чи́стаѧ разженѝ, свѣ́томъ твоеѧ̀ свѣ́тлости.
items.english_text: ...the disturbance of transgressions do thou drive away, O Pure One, by the light of thy radiance.[^6694]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆зы́кѡвъ ча́ѧніе, Ꙗ҆́кѡвъ и҆зъ тебѐ воплоща́емаго предзрѧ́ше та́йнѡ оу҆́мныма ѻ҆чи́ма, Бг҃а: и҆зба́вльшаго на́съ хода́тайствомъ твои́мъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Jacob secretly foresaw with spiritual eyes God, the Expectation of the nations, becoming incarnate from thee, Who hath delivered us through thy mediation.[^6695]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скѹдѣ́вшимъ кнѧзе́мъ ѿ колѣ́на І҆ѹ́дова, Пречи́стаѧ, Сы́нъ тво́й и҆ Бг҃ъ, прише́дъ во́ждь, надъ концы̀ земны́ми ны́нѣ вои́стинꙋ воцари́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* When rulers from the tribe of Judah had failed, O Most Pure One, Thy Son and God, having come as Leader, hath now truly reigned over the ends of the earth.[^6696]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Нѣ́сть ст҃ъ, ꙗ҆́кѡже ты̀ Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е мо́й, вознесы́й ро́гъ вѣ́рныхъ твои́хъ Бла́же, и҆ оу҆тверди́вый на́съ на ка́мени и҆сповѣ́даніѧ твоегѡ̀.
items.english_text: *Katavasia: I shall open my mouth:*[^6697]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃а распина́ема пло́тію, зрѧ́щи тва́рь растава́шесѧ стра́хомъ; но содержи́тельною дла́нію на́съ ра́ди Распѧ́тагѡ, крѣ́пкѡ держи́ма бѣ̀.
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 3. Heirmos:* There is none holy as Thou, O Lord my God, Who hast exalted the horn of Thy faithful, O Good One, and established us upon the rock of Thy confession.[^6698]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Сме́ртію сме́рть разоре́на лежи́тъ ѻ҆каѧ́ннаѧ безъ дыха́ніѧ; живота́ бо не терпѧ́щи бж҃твеннагѡ прираже́ніѧ, оу҆мерщвлѧ́етсѧ крѣ́пкій, и҆ да́рѹетсѧ всѣ̑мъ воскресе́ніе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Beholding God crucified in the flesh, creation melted away with fear; but by the sustaining hand of Him Who was crucified for our sake, it was firmly held together.[^6699]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃твеннагѡ рождества̀ твоегѡ̀ Чи́стаѧ, всѧ́кій є҆стества̀ чи́нъ превосхо́дитъ чꙋ́до; Бг҃а бо преесте́ственнѣ зачала̀ є҆сѝ въ чре́вѣ, и҆ ро́ждши пребыва́еши Приснодѣ́ва.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By death is wretched death overthrown and lies breathless; for unable to endure the assault of divine life, the strong one is put to death, and resurrection is granted unto all.[^6700]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ на вода́хъ повѣ́сившаго всю̀ зе́млю неодержи́мѡ, тва́рь ви́дѣвши на Ло́бнѣмъ ви́сима, оу҆́жасомъ мно́гимъ содрога́шесѧ: нѣ́сть свѧ́тъ ра́звѣ тебѐ Гдⷭ҇и, взыва́ющи.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The wonder of thy divine childbirth, O Pure One, surpasses every order of nature; for supernaturally didst thou conceive God in thy womb, and having given birth, thou remainest Ever-Virgin.[^6701]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ воскре́сшаго тридне́внѡ, и҆ жена́мъ ꙗ҆́вльшагосѧ Мѵроно́сицамъ, Спа́се: и҆ си̑мъ, ра́дѹйтесѧ, ре́кшаго и҆сповѣ́дающе, глаго́лемъ: нѣ́сть свѧ́тъ, ра́звѣ тебѐ Гдⷭ҇и, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross and Resurrection.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва твоемꙋ̀ воста́нію Спа́се на́шъ, ꙗ҆́ко на́съ ѿ а҆́да тлѣ́ніѧ, и҆ сме́рти и҆зба́вилъ є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ; и҆ пою́ще глаго́лемъ: нѣ́сть свѧ́тъ ра́звѣ тебѐ Гдⷭ҇и, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 3. Heirmos:* Beholding Thee hanging upon Calvary, Who didst suspend the whole earth upon the waters without restraint, creation quaked with great terror, crying aloud: There is none holy save Thee, O Lord.[^6702]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ ѿ ст҃ы́ѧ Бг҃оѻтрокови́цы, вопло́щшагосѧ Сло́ва, и҆ спа́сшаго ѿ пре́лести, па́дшаго первозда́ннаго, бг҃олѣ́пнѡ сла́вимъ: нѣ́сть ст҃ъ, ра́звѣ тебѐ Гдⷭ҇и, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Confessing Thee Who didst rise on the third day and appeared unto the Myrrh-bearing women, O Savior, and said unto them: "Rejoice!" we say: There is none holy save Thee, O Lord, Lover of mankind.[^6703]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣ́нную мою̀ пло́ть и҆ сме́ртнꙋю, всечи́стаѧ Бг҃ома́ти, и҆зъ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ пріе́мъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Glory to Thy rising, O our Savior, for Thou hast delivered us from the corruption of hades and from death, as almighty; and singing, we say: There is none holy save Thee, O Lord, Lover of mankind.[^6704]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣ́нную мою̀ пло́ть и҆ сме́ртнꙋю, всечи́стаѧ Бг҃ома́ти, и҆зъ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ пріе́мъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* We piously glorify Thee, the Word incarnate of the holy Maiden of God, Who hast saved the fallen first-created man from deception: There is none holy save Thee, O Lord, Lover of mankind.[^6705]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣ́нную мою̀ пло́ть и҆ сме́ртнꙋю, всечи́стаѧ Бг҃ома́ти, и҆зъ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ пріе́мъ
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 3. Heirmos: There is none holy as Thou, O Lord:*[^6706]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣ́нную мою̀ пло́ть и҆ сме́ртнꙋю, всечи́стаѧ Бг҃ома́ти, и҆зъ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ пріе́мъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having ineffably taken from thy womb my corruptible and mortal flesh, O all-pure Mother of God...

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣ́нную мою̀ пло́ть и҆ сме́ртнꙋю, всечи́стаѧ Бг҃ома́ти, и҆зъ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ пріе́мъ
items.english_text: ...the Good One, having made it incorruptible, bound it unto Himself eternally.[^6707]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣ́нную мою̀ пло́ть и҆ сме́ртнꙋю, всечи́стаѧ Бг҃ома́ти, и҆зъ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ пріе́мъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Beholding God becoming incarnate from thee, O Virgin, the angelic choirs were struck with dread; and as the Mother of God, with unceasing hymns do they honor thee.[^6708]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣ́нную мою̀ пло́ть и҆ сме́ртнꙋю, всечи́стаѧ Бг҃ома́ти, и҆зъ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ пріе́мъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The Prophet Daniel was amazed, beholding thee as a spiritual mountain from which a Stone was cut out without hands, which mightily shattered the shrines of demons, O Mother of God.[^6709]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣ́нную мою̀ пло́ть и҆ сме́ртнꙋю, всечи́стаѧ Бг҃ома́ти, и҆зъ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ пріе́мъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Human word, nor tongue, O Virgin, can worthily praise thee; for from thee without seed Christ the Giver of life was well pleased to become incarnate, O Most Pure One.[^6710]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣ́нную мою̀ пло́ть и҆ сме́ртнꙋю, всечи́стаѧ Бг҃ома́ти, и҆зъ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ пріе́мъ
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 4. Heirmos:* Christ is my power, God and Lord, the venerable Church piously sings, crying out with a pure mind, keeping festival in the Lord.[^6711]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣ́нную мою̀ пло́ть и҆ сме́ртнꙋю, всечи́стаѧ Бг҃ома́ти, и҆зъ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ пріе́мъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The tree of true life blossomed forth, O Christ, for the Cross was set up; and being watered with blood and water from Thine incorruptible side, it budded forth life unto us.[^6712]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣ́нную мою̀ пло́ть и҆ сме́ртнꙋю, всечи́стаѧ Бг҃ома́ти, и҆зъ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ пріе́мъ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* No longer does the serpent falsely suggest deification unto me; for Christ, the Deifier of human nature, hath now unhindered opened the path of life unto me.[^6713]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣ́нную мою̀ пло́ть и҆ сме́ртнꙋю, всечи́стаѧ Бг҃ома́ти, и҆зъ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ пріе́мъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Truly unsearchable and incomprehensible unto those on earth and in heaven, O Ever-Virgin Mother of God, are the mysteries of thy divinely fitting childbirth.[^6714]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣ́нную мою̀ пло́ть и҆ сме́ртнꙋю, всечи́стаѧ Бг҃ома́ти, и҆зъ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ пріе́мъ
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross and Resurrection.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^6311]
items.slavonic_text: Тлѣ́нную мою̀ пло́ть и҆ сме́ртнꙋю, всечи́стаѧ Бг҃ома́ти, и҆зъ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ пріе́мъ
