items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Grant me streams of tears drying up the fountains of my passions, and washing away all mire of sin, O Compassionate and Plenteous in mercy, and quenching the eternal, unquenchable flame of Gehenna's fire.[^7090]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Unceasingly I scratch the sores of my soul with love of pleasure, and remain unhealed, not willing myself to come to my senses. What will become of me? And what shall I do? O compassionate Christ, heal and save me.[^7091]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Having by divine governance through faith sailed across the unstable deep of destructive waters and the storm of malice, O ever-blessed Martyrs, ye reached the distress-free and stormless haven of the heavenly Kingdom.[^7092]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Having become illuminators of piety and luminaries of truth, by the light of your struggles ye destroyed the grievous darkness of godlessness; and by the rays of miracles, O Martyrs...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: ...ye dispel the mist of passions.[^7093]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Of old [the Prophet] foresaw thee, O Maiden, as a seven-branched lampstand bearing the fire of the knowledge of God, shining upon those who are in distress in the darkness of ignorance; therefore I cry unto thee, O All-Immaculate One: Enlighten me, I pray.[^7094]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner. Heirmos:* I heard report of Thee and was afraid; I understood Thy works and was in dread. Glory to Thy power, O Lord.[^7095]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Heal my heart wounded upon the robbers' paths, I pray thee, O Forerunner, by the effective medicine of thy divine prayers.[^7096]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Cast down, O Forerunner, the sin that yet lives in my soul; and grant revival now unto me who slip towards pleasures.[^7097]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Be shown forth as a haven unto us who are tempest-tossed in the deep of the storm of life; bring all unto calm, O Exceedingly Rich One.[^7098]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Condemn me not, O Lord, according to my deeds, but show Thyself merciful unto me, O All-Merciful One: She that bare Thee entreats Thee together with the Baptist.[^7099]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 5. Heirmos:* Rising early from the night, O Lover of mankind, enlighten me, I pray, and guide me in Thy commandments, and teach me, O Savior, to do Thy will.[^7100]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Behold, I am he that hid Thy talent, O Christ, Thy slothful servant who have been made idle by the wicked deeds of passions; therefore send me not into the fire.[^7101]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having been Thy son by grace, O compassionate Christ, I became enslaved unto the enemy, and removed myself from Thee by living prodigally; therefore turn me back and save me.[^7102]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* The Martyrs stood before the judgment seat, bearing about the shield of faith; therefore with deceitful arrows the fierce apostate was unable to wound them.[^7103]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Being put to death in body, the Martyrs put to death all the wiles of the enemy, and passed over in joy unto life that grows not old, having received the crowns of victory.[^7104]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O impassable gate! Open unto me, I pray, the gates of true repentance; and show me the path of repentance, O Pure One, guide of all.[^7105]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner. Heirmos:* Early I rise unto Thee, O Word of God, Who for mercy's sake didst unchangeably empty Thyself, and without passion didst stoop down even unto sufferings: grant peace unto me who have fallen, O Lover of mankind.[^7106]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou wast a temple of the Holy Trinity, and we who are gathered in this holy temple of thine, with fervent faith entreat thee, O Forerunner: Deliver us from temptations and afflictions, O all-praised one.[^7107]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With my mind estranged from every virtue, I pray thee now, O Blessed One, who didst walk a strange path in life: Unite me unto the God of all, making me better through excellent entreaties.[^7108]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Prophet who didst immerse in the streams of the Jordan the abyss of tender mercy, dry up now by thy prayers the torrents of my passions, granting me fountains of tears.[^7109]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Adorned with divine rays, O Virgin, thou gavest birth unto Him Who is fair in beauty; Him do thou ever entreat, to save from corruption us who in faith and love glorify thee.[^7110]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 6. Heirmos:* I cried with my whole heart unto the merciful God, and He heard me from the lowest hades, and brought up my life from corruption.[^7111]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Show me not forth as a rejoicing for demons in the dread day, O Christ Jesus, that I may not hear then the voice that sends me away into the fire of Gehenna.[^7112]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The enemy of the righteous has drowned me in the depth of transgressions; I flee unto the deep of Thy compassions, O Jesus; guide me now unto the haven of life.[^7113]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Having renewed the furrow of the soul with the plow of many sufferings, O Most Wise Ones, by the divine seed of faith ye manifestly bare fruit in the abundant ear of martyrdom.[^7114]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* By wounds ye wounded him that wounded you, O pious warriors; therefore, having passed over unto life, ye now heal human passions.[^7115]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast shown forth as a temple unto God, O All-Immaculate One, in which He holy dwelt, deifying human nature, having made the faithful temples unto Himself.[^7116]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner. Heirmos:* The lowest abyss of sins has compassed me about, and enduring no longer its surging, as Jonah unto the Master I cry unto Thee...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: ...Lead me up from corruption.[^7117]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A branch from the root hast thou sprouted forth, O Prophet, and hearts barren of all good discernment hast thou shown fruitful in praise unto God.[^7118]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Swiftly crush the crafty one beneath our feet, and direct our spiritual steps into the path of peace, through thine intercessions, O Forerunner.[^7119]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Encompass thy flock with righteousness, O Prophet, delivering us from every demonic assault, and from eternal torment.[^7120]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A song of thanksgiving we offer unto thee now, O Virgin; through thee, O Pure One, having been saved from the ancient curse, we bear fruit in every blessing.[^7121]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 7. Heirmos:* We have sinned, we have transgressed, we have done unrighteously before Thee, neither kept nor done as Thou hast commanded us; but give us not up utterly, O God of the fathers.[^7122]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I look upon Thy measureless mercy, who have immeasurably sinned; I know Thy tender compassion; I know Thy longsuffering and meekness. Grant me fruits of repentance, O compassionate Christ, and save me.[^7123]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Heal, O Compassionate One, the incurable passions of my heart; grant the cutting off of my debts; lighten the heavy burden: that in compunction I may ever glorify Thee, the God of the fathers.[^7124]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Wounded, cut to pieces, consumed by material fire, given unto lions for food, and stretched upon wheels, they denied Thee not, our living God, the divine and sacred sufferers.[^7125]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Ye were separated from the body, but were shown not separated from God, O Martyrs, for the sake of the divine union of Him Who united Himself incorruptibly unto us. Him do ye ever entreat, that we may be delivered from every necessity.[^7126]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Without seed didst thou sprout forth Him Whom the Father incorruptibly begat; thou remainedst a Virgin after childbearing, even as before childbearing. Therefore art thou called blessed, and unceasingly glorified, O All-Pure One, as being the Mother of God.[^7127]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner. Heirmos:* The Children in Babylon feared not the flame of the furnace, but cast into the midst of the flame...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: ...being bedewed they sang: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.[^7128]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being the voice of the Word, receive now our voices, O Baptist, and deliver thy people from passions, tribulations, many distresses, and eternal torment.[^7129]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With thy hand thou pointest out, O Prophet, the Lamb of God Who takes away the sins of the world; Him do thou ever entreat, to take away my fierce transgressions held fast through the years, and to vouchsafe me life.[^7130]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O my soul, make haste and cry aloud, forsaking the darkening of irrational deeds: Have compassion upon me, O Jesus, by the supplications of the Baptist, and snatch me from the mire of my deeds.[^7131]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Him before Whom the heavenly ranks stand with trembling, hast thou brought forth, O Pure One, Who for goodness' sake united Himself unto men; Him do thou fervently entreat, to have compassion upon thy servants.[^7132]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 8. Heirmos:* Him Whom the heavenly hosts glorify, and before Whom the Cherubim and Seraphim tremble: let every breath and creation sing, bless, and supremely exalt unto all ages.[^7133]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I look upon the great mercy of Thy compassions, O Christ, having sinned more than David; and I cry with him: O only Merciful One, have mercy upon me swiftly.[^7134]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I pray that I may have a good end, yet I strive not ever to put an end to wicked deeds, having a heart hardened by darkening; have compassion upon me, O Word of God.[^7135]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* As chosen and blameless sacrifices, ye willingly offered yourselves unto the Only-begotten Word Who was sacrificed for our sake, bringing to nought all demonic sacrifices, O passion-bearers.[^7136]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* The severing of sinews, the pulling out of teeth, the cutting off of hands, the shattering of limbs, and every other torment did ye valiantly endure, O Martyrs, singing unto Christ the only Arbiter of the contest.[^7137]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A new Babe hast thou brought forth for us, Him Who is Ancient of Days, Who shows new paths upon earth and renews nature that had grown old, O unwedded, blessed Maiden.[^7138]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner. Heirmos:* In Babylon the blessed youths, imperiled for the ancestral laws...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: ...spat upon the senseless decree of him that reigned; and joined together, not consumed by the fire, they sang a worthy song unto the Sovereign Ruler: Sing, ye works, unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7139]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Above the Word being baptized, thou didst behold the Holy Spirit descending in the likeness of a dove, and wast vouchsafed to hear the Father's voice, O Blessed One: "This is My Son Who shares My throne," Whom all creation sings: Sing, ye works, unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7140]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By the fire of thy prayers, O Prophet, consume the brushwood passions of my mind, and rekindle the extinguished lamp of my heart, that looking clearly I may sing unto Him Who created the light of commandments: Sing, ye works, unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7141]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* I am that wretched servant who hid the talent which I received from Thee for trading; and what shall I do when Thou comest to judgment, demanding an account of everyone's work? But spare me by the supplications of Thy Forerunner, and send me not into the fire who cry aloud: Sing, ye works, unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages.[^7142]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Preserve my mind in humility, O Maiden full of God's grace, who by thy childbearing didst crush demonic arrogance; and raise me up from the dunghill of passions, and satisfy me who hunger for thy grace, singing: Sing, ye works, unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7143]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Canticle of the Theotokos: My soul doth magnify the Lord.*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 9. Heirmos:* The birth from a seedless conception is ineffable, the fruit of an unwedded Mother is incorrupt; for the birth of God renews nature. Therefore all generations rightly magnify thee as the Mother unwedded of God.[^7144]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Jesus Lover of mankind, Who alone knowest our weakness, for Thou didst clothe Thyself with it for mercy's sake, desiring to cleanse it: therefore cleanse the wicked defilements and suppurations of my evils, and save me.[^7145]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Like the harlot I offer tears unto Thee, O Lover of mankind; like the publican groaning I call unto Thee: Cleanse and save me! Like the Canaanite woman I cry: Have mercy on me! Like Peter who repented, vouchsafe me forgiveness.[^7146]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Grappling in the flesh with the bodiless ruler of this world, by the struggles of your sufferings ye cast him down, and worthily received the crowns of victory; therefore pray fervently for...

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: ...all who in faith praise you, O Saints.[^7147]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Thou hast sanctified the earth, O Lord, with the holy blood of Thy Saints, and their spirits, O All-Holy One, hast Thou joined unto the spiritual ranks of the holy Powers; and by them Thou dost ever sanctify those who in true faith sanctify Thee.[^7148]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* We offer the Archangel's voice unto thee, O All-Pure, Blessed One: Rejoice, thou that didst contain the uncontainable God; rejoice, loosening of the curse, and bringing in of blessing; rejoice, who alone didst open the door of Paradise.[^7149]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner. Heirmos:* Come, ye faithful, with lofty minds let us enjoy the Master's hospitality and the immortal table in the upper place, having learned the word of Him Who ascended from the Word, Whom we magnify.[^7150]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Heal my mind grievously wounded by the love of worldly pleasures, and calm the storm that exceedingly troubles me, and show me the upright paths of repentance, O Forerunner of the Lord.[^7151]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou wast seen standing in the midst of the Old and New: causing the one, O Prophet, to cease, and revealing the light of the other; in which guide us to walk diligently, with a divine conscience, that we may be delivered from eternal darkness.[^7152]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou hast been joined unto the heavenly hosts, O Divinely Wise One; with them entreat Christ to save us who are upon earth, who honor thee in this thine honorable temple, O Baptist John, Forerunner of the Lord.[^7153]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* A day full of wrath, a day of darkness is the dread judgment unto them that have dark deeds; O Baptist and Forerunner of Christ, by thy prayers deliver from all condemnation then those who honor thee.[^7154]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast shown forth holier than the Cherubim, O Virgin, as having given birth unto the all-holy God. Sanctify all of us who in holy voices with faith sanctify thee by night and by day.[^7155]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Little Litany, Exapostilarion, and the usual Psalms.*[^7156]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 6:*

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Having found me stripped of virtues, the enemy wounded me with the arrow of sin; but do Thou, as Physician of souls and bodies, heal the wounds of my soul, and have mercy upon me.[^7157]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Стíхъ: Испо́лнихомсѧ зау́тра ми́лости твоеѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ возра́довахомсѧ и҆ возвесели́хомсѧ: ... И҆ при́зри на рабы̑ твоѧ̑, и҆ на дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, и҆ наста́ви сы́ны и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad: ... And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, and guide their sons.* [^7158]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Се́рдца моегѡ̀ стро́пы, ѿ мно́гихъ согрѣше́ній возра́стшіѧ мнѣ̀ и҆сцѣлѝ Сп҃се, ꙗ҆́кѡ дꙋ́шъ и҆ тѣле́съ вра́чь, подаѧ̀ просѧ́щымъ согрѣше́ній проще́ніе при́снѡ; да́рꙋй мнѣ̀ сле́зы покаа́ніѧ, да́ѧ мнѣ̀ разрѣше́ніе долгѡ́въ Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ поми́лꙋй мѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Heal the sores of my heart, grown great from many transgressions, O Savior, as Physician of souls and bodies, granting forgiveness of transgressions ever unto those who ask; grant me tears of repentance, giving me release from debts, O Lord, and have mercy on me.[^7159]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Стíхъ: И҆ бꙋ́ди свѣ́тлость Гдⷭ҇а Бг҃а на́шегѡ на на́съ, и҆ дѣла̀ рꙋ́къ на́шихъ и҆спра́ви на на́съ; и҆ дѣ́ло рꙋ́къ на́шихъ и҆спра́ви.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* O Lord, if we had not Thy Saints as intercessors, and Thy goodness having mercy upon us, how should we dare, O Savior, to hymn Thee Whom the Angels ceaselessly glorify? O Knower of hearts, spare our souls.[^7161]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭ҇и, а҆́ще не бы́хомъ Ст҃ы̑ѧ твоѧ̑ и҆мѣ́ли моли́твенники, и҆ благосты́ню твою̀ ми́лꙋющꙋю на́съ, ка́кѡ смѣ́ли бы́хомъ Сп҃се пѣ́ти тѧ̀, є҆го́же славосло́вѧтъ непреста́ннѡ А҆́гг҃ли? Се́рдцевѣ́дче, пощадѝ дꙋ́ши на́ша.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Of great gifts hast thou been accounted worthy, O pure Virgin Mother of God: for in the flesh thou didst bring forth One of the Trinity, Christ the Giver of life, unto the salvation of our souls.[^7162]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Вели́кихъ дарова́ній, чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во Бг҃ома́ти ты̀ сподо́биласѧ є҆сѝ: ꙗ҆́кѡ родила̀ є҆сѝ пло́тію є҆ди́наго ѿ Трⷪ҇ци, Хрⷭ҇та̀ жизнода́вца, въ спасе́ніе дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *It is good to give thanks unto the Lord: Trisagion, and after Our Father: troparion, litany. Then the First Hour.*[^7163]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Бла́го є҆́сть и҆сповѣ́датисѧ Гдⷭ҇еви: Трисвѧто́е, и҆ по О҆́тче на́шъ: тропа́рь, є҆ктеніа̀. Та́же Ча́съ пе́рвый.
items.english_text: Remember me, O God my Savior, when Thou comest in Thy kingdom, and save me, as Thou alone art the Lover of mankind.[^7164]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Помѧнѝ мѧ Бж҃е Сп҃се мо́й, є҆гда̀ прїи́деши въ ца́рствіи твое́мъ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ человѣколю́бецъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Christ Who didst accept the weeping of Peter, accept also my repentance, and grant me forgiveness of transgressions.[^7165]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Петро́во прїе́мый рыда́ніе, прїимѝ и҆ моѐ, Хрⷭ҇тѐ, покаѧ́ніе; и҆ да́рꙋй мнѣ̀ согрѣше́ній проще́ніе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Baptist and Forerunner of the Lord, who didst proclaim repentance unto men, pray that I may repent from the soul.[^7166]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Проповѣ́давый покаѧ́ніе человѣ́кѡмъ, Гдⷭ҇ень Крести́телю и҆ Предте́че, пока́ѧтисѧ мнѣ̀ ѿ дꙋшѝ, моли́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having endured the surging waves of sufferings, O passion-bearers, ye now heal the infirmities of men; therefore are ye called blessed.[^7167]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: Треволне́нїа претерпѣ́вше страда́ній, Страстоте́рпци, человѣ́кѡвъ недꙋ́ги ны́нѣ и҆сцѣлѧ́ете; тѣ́мже блажи́ми є҆стѐ.
items.english_text: *Glory...* O God glorified by the prophets in Trinity, simple and unconfused, by the supplications of the Forerunner, save me.[^7168]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же проро́ки прославлѧ́емый Бг҃ъ въ Трⷪ҇цѣ, про́стѣй же и҆ неслїа́ннѣй, Предте́чи мольба́ми спасѝ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...* O mighty defense of those in tribulations: stand by me who partake of worldly passions, and save me, I pray.[^7169]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 6:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* When Thou wast crucified, O long-suffering Lord, Thou didst shake the whole earth, but didst establish the hearts of the faithful; therefore we sing Thy praise, and with love worship Thine unsearchable power.[^7171]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Thou wast struck upon the cheek, O Savior, and spat upon; Thou didst strike down the malice of the venomous foe, taking away the fall which Adam brought about, having been stolen away because of seeing.[^7172]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* The sun was darkened, and all the earth shook, when they saw Thee, O Savior, hanging unjustly upon the Tree, and forsaking desires.[^7173]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Then the Stichera from the Menaion for the Saint, if there be any. If not, these Stichera.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* Standing once by the Cross at the time of the Crucifixion, the Virgin, with the virgin disciple, weeping, cried aloud: Woe is me! How dost Thou suffer, O Christ, Who art the dispassion of all?[^7175]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5:* Meditating upon Thy seedless conception and all-pure birthgiving, I marvel greatly: how hast Thou thus consented to die like an evildoer, O Savior? cried the All-Pure.[^7176]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 6:* I am indeed crucified upon the Tree and nailed as man, and I am laid in the tomb as dead, O pure Virgin Mother! Yet as God in glory I shall rise again on the third day.[^7177]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding the most lawless people unjustly nailing Thee upon the Tree, O Savior, the Virgin and Thy pure Mother was wounded in her inward parts, even as Simeon foretold.[^7178]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 6:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Thy Cross, O Lord, is life and defense unto Thy people; and hoping thereon, we hymn Thee our God Who wast crucified in the flesh: have mercy on us.[^7179]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Thy Cross, O Lord, opened Paradise unto mankind, and delivered from corruption, we hymn Thee our God Who wast crucified...[^7181]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: ...in the flesh: have mercy on us.

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* They that suffered for Thy sake, O Christ, endured many torments, and received perfect crowns in the heavens: let them pray for our souls.[^7183]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding our Life hanging upon the Tree, the all-blameless Theotokos cried out weeping with a mother's grief: O my Son and my God, save those who praise Thee with love.[^7184]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion, and after Our Father: troparion, litany, and dismissal.*[^7185]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 6.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* When Israel traversed the deep on foot as on dry land, and saw Pharaoh the pursuer drowning, they cried aloud: Let us sing a song of victory unto God.[^7186]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^7187]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I bewail every aspect of my defiled life, and the multitude of my measureless evils; what then shall I confess unto thee, O Pure One? I am at a loss and terrified; but help me, O Sovereign Lady.[^7188]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Whence shall I begin to tell of my deceitful and grievous falls, passionate as I am? Woe is me, what shall become of me hereafter? But O Sovereign Lady, before the end have compassion upon me.[^7189]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...* The hour of death and the dread tribunal do I ever ponder, O All-Pure, yet being convicted I am all-grievously deceived by evil; but help me.[^7190]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...* The corrupter of good things, beholding me now stripped of divine virtues, and having fallen away far and become alienated from God, strives to swallow me up; O Sovereign Lady, go before and anticipate him.[^7191]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* There is none holy as Thou, O Lord my God, Who hast exalted the horn of Thy faithful, O Good One, and established us upon the rock of Thy confession.[^7192]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Passionate as I am, O Lady Mother of God, I have defiled my soul foully with measureless evils; and whither hereafter shall I go, being wholly possessed by despair?[^7193]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* And that which was made according to the image have I, prodigal one, defiled, woe is me, O Pure One, with high-minded thought;...[^7194]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: ...for in likeness, both by deed, and by word, and by thought, have I committed unseemly things.

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...* There is no other among men that has committed improper things, nor was any born in the world as I, O Good One, darkened in mind; for I have defiled divine baptism.[^7195]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...* I have reached the end of evils, O most holy Virgin: do thou help me quickly; heaven and earth cry bitterly because of unseemly, improper deeds.[^7196]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Christ is my power, God and Lord, the venerable Church godly sings, crying aloud from a pure mind, keeping festival in the Lord.[^7197]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The angelic ranks and hosts of the heavenly powers are terrified at the dominion of thy Son, O Pure One; but now having despaired, I am possessed by fearlessness.[^7198]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* All the earth was amazed and terrified, seeing me doing grievous and evil and unseemly things, and it marvels at the great tender mercy of thy Son.[^7199]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...* The bodily church have I evilly defiled, and the church of the Lord, into which men enter trembling; but I, prodigal, enter shamelessly; woe is me![^7200]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Show me not, O Sovereign Lady, show me not as a stranger, alienated from the protection of thy Son, being wholly unworthy; but wash me from the defilement of my transgressions.[^7201]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* With Thy divine light, O Good One, illumine, I pray, the souls of those who yearn early for Thee with love: that they may know Thee, O Word of God, the true God, calling them from the gloom of sin.[^7202]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* With thy divine radiance, O Good One, heal my soul's passions, which the corrupter sowed in me; and deliver me from this bitter captivity; for he laughs, seeing me without protection.[^7203]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Adam indeed transgressed one single commandment of thy Son, O Virgin, and fell into exile; how then shall I bewail the abyss of my transgressions, I who am a transgressor and an apostate from Him?[^7204]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...* A murderer indeed of old was Cain shown forth, and a fratricide, and he was cursed by God. What then shall I do, all-daring that I am? Having now slain my soul, and I am not ashamed.[^7205]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...* I have rivaled cruel Esau, wholly in gluttony and surfeit; I have defiled my soul with drunkenness, and my life with self-indulgence; and who does not weep for me, passionate that I am? Woe is me![^7206]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Beholding the sea of life surging with the tempest of temptations, fleeing unto Thy calm haven, I cry unto Thee: Lead up my life from corruption, O Greatly Merciful One.[^7207]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* My manner of life is prodigal, my soul is defiled, and my whole life is miserable, and all my body have I grievously defiled in evil things; therefore make haste, O Virgin, to help me.[^7208]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The end stands before me, and I endure not good things; conscience convicts me: for deceitful deeds and a prodigal life confront me, and I am terrified of the judgment seat of thy Son, O Pure One.[^7209]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...* A fiery river, dread and unquenchable, truly awaits the burning of my flesh, and the undying worm; but quench these for me by thy prayers, O All-Pure.[^7210]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Now am I seized with trembling, O Good One, and I am terrified of the snare of the deceitful one; for before the end the corrupter desires to slay me, holding me wholly as a captive and stripped of virtues.[^7211]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Then: Lord, have mercy, thrice. Glory... Both now...*[^7212]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: Hope and wall and haven art thou unto thy people, O Virgin: for from thee without passion was born the Savior of all, and He saved those that hope on thee. Whom thou didst bewail, Thine own Son at the Cross, Him do thou also now entreat: to deliver from corruption all who hymn thee.[^7213]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The Angel made the furnace dewy for the holy youths, but the command of God, consuming the Chaldeans, persuaded the tyrant to cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^7214]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Sevenfold did the deceitful one kindle the flame for me with passions, and with fornications he ever slays my heart; therefore with the streams of my tears quench it, O Mother of God, and save me.[^7215]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Defiled with the mire of my transgressions, cast me not away, O good Sovereign Lady: for seeing me in despair, the most deceitful enemy laughs; but do thou thyself...[^7216]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: ...with thy mighty hand raise me up.

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...* Dread indeed is the tribunal, O my passionate and senseless soul, and the torment is unending and terrible: but nevertheless now fall down before the Mother of thy Judge and God, and despair not of thyself.[^7217]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Darkened am I, passionate that I am, by the multitude of measureless evils, and I have defiled my soul and body and mind; therefore, O All-Pure, by the light of thy radiance quickly lead me into the dispassion of sweetness.[^7218]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* From the flame Thou didst pour forth dew for the holy ones, and didst consume the sacrifice of the righteous one and the water: for Thou, O Christ, dost do all things merely by willing them; Thee do we supremely exalt unto all ages.[^7219]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou that didst bring forth One of the Trinity, God, and didst bear Him in thine arms, O Virgin Mother, quench the fire-kindled furnace of passions, and with streams of tears wash my soul.[^7220]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I am terrified of the coming of death, O All-Pure, and of that judgment am I now wholly afraid: yet of evil deeds am I in no wise ashamed. Have compassion upon me before the end, by thy prayers, O Virgin.[^7221]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...* Unceasing groanings grant me, O Sovereign Lady, and give showers of tears, that I may wash away my many transgressions and incurable wounds, that I may obtain eternal life.[^7222]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...* The multitude of my evils have I confessed unto thee, O Sovereign Lady, for none other in the world has so angered God, thy Son and Lord: change Him quickly unto mercy toward me, O Virgin.[^7223]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* It is impossible for men to see God, upon Whom the ranks of Angels dare not gaze; but through thee, O All-Pure, the Word Incarnate appeared unto men; Whom magnifying with the heavenly hosts, we call thee blessed.[^7224]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Lo, I come unto thee, O All-Pure, with great fear and love, knowing the might of thy manifold prayer, I thy servant: for a mother's prayer unto the Son can truly do much, O Sovereign Lady; for He is inclined by tender mercy.[^7225]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Receive the choirs of Archangels, and the multitude of the highest hosts of my Creator, of the Apostles...[^7226]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: ...and assemblies of Prophets, and martyrs, and righteous, and venerable ones, and hieromartyrs: and make prayer, O Pure One, for us unto God.

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory...* Both now and then may I find thy help, O Pure One, in the hour wherein my spirit shall depart; quickly rescuing me, deliver me from the tormenting of demons, O All-Blameless One: and leave me not, O Good One, to be delivered up unto them.[^7227]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now...* I await the compassionate Judge, even Thine own Son, the Lover of mankind, O Pure One! Despise me not, but make Him propitious unto me, that He may place me on the right hand then, O All-Blameless One, before His all-pure judgment seat; for on thee have I set my hope.[^7228]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Trisagion; and after Our Father: Troparion and the rest as usual.*[^7229]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *After the First Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 6:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Thy Cross, O Lord, is sanctified; for thereby healings come unto those who are infirm with sins. Therefore we fall down before Thee: have mercy on us.[^7230]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Only was the wood of Thy Cross set up, O Christ, and the foundations of death were shaken, O Lord: for him whom hades had swallowed with desire, it released trembling; Thou hast shown us Thy salvation, O Holy One, and we glorify Thee, O Son of God: have mercy on us.[^7232]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Tone 6, Podoben: "O hope of the world" (Наде́жда мíра):*[^7233]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: Seeing God hanging dead upon the Tree, Whom in the flesh she bare, the Virgin weeping cried aloud: At Thine ineffable long-suffering, O Son, I marvel. How did the lawless nail Thee to the Cross as one condemned, Thee the righteous Judge and only Sovereign Master?

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *After the Second Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 6:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Today the prophetic word is fulfilled: for behold, we worship in the place where Thy feet stood, O Lord; and having tasted of the tree of salvation, we have obtained freedom from sinful passions, by the prayers of the Theotokos, O only Lover of mankind.[^7234]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* O Lord, the Jews condemned Thee unto death, the Life of all; they that passed through the Red Sea by the rod nailed Thee to the Cross; and they that sucked honey from the rock brought gall unto Thee. But of Thine own will Thou didst endure, that Thou mightest free us from the bondage of the enemy, O Christ our God: glory to Thee.[^7236]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Marvelous is God in His Saints, the God of Israel.*[^7237]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: The struggles of the sufferers before the tribunal, the wounds of the tyrants upon the martyrs: and the choirs of the bodiless stood by, holding the prizes of victory; the All-Wise confounded the tyrants and kings; they cast down the transgressor by the confession of Christ. O Lord Who didst strengthen them: glory to Thee.[^7238]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Standing by the Cross, the unwedded Mother cried aloud unto Him Who was born of her without seed: A sword has pierced my heart, O Son! unable to bear seeing Thee hanging upon the Tree, before Whom all creation trembles, as Creator and God. O long-suffering Lord, glory to Thee.[^7239]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *After the Third Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 6:*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* When creation saw Thee willingly nailed to the Cross for our sake, O Christ, it was shaken with fear; the sun wholly darkened its light; the rocks were rent, and the divine veil of the temple was torn in twain, for the conviction of the fierce and lawless Hebrews.

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* The tree brought corruption in Eden unto the first father; but the tree of the Cross blossomed forth life upon the Place of the Skull: for the malice of the enemy was trampled down, and Adam obtained mercy by the nailing of Christ, and found Paradise, crying aloud: O blessed tree![^7241]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Seeing Thee, O Christ, lifted up upon the Cross for our sake, the Ever-Virgin Maiden who gave Thee birth wounded her heart and soul with the sword of grief, and wept, lamenting with a mother's sorrow. By her supplications, have mercy on us.[^7242]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *(Whose Acrostic is: Thou savest me, O Savior, nailed upon the Wood.) The work of Joseph.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:* When Israel traversed the deep on foot as on dry land, and saw Pharaoh the pursuer...[^7243]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: ...drowning, they cried aloud: Let us sing a song of victory unto God.

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Crucifixion.*[^7244]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having stretched out Thy palms upon the Cross, O Master, Thou didst embrace cast-out men, and didst bring them unto Thine own Father, as His beloved Son and consubstantial with Him.[^7245]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As a lamb wast Thou lifted up upon the Cross, O Word, seeking Thine own strayed sheep; and having found it, Thou didst unite it unto those that had not strayed, O Jesus. Glory to Thy dominion.[^7246]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Desiring the life on high, the gloriously renowned passion-bearing Martyrs put themselves to death on earth, having endured many torments and diverse afflictions, O richly blessed ones.[^7247]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Standing before unjust tribunals for Christ Who is righteous in all things, O Sufferers, ye endured every unjust judgment, which justifies you in God.[^7248]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: That Thou mightest mediate dispassion for all born of Adam, O Master, Thou didst endure passion upon the Cross; and seeing Thee, the earth shook, and the Sovereign Lady weeping cried aloud with a mother's grief.[^7249]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos the same.*[^7250]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thee, O all-holy Virgin, the Lord Who stretched out heaven and founded the earth, having come forth from thee with flesh, has shown forth unto us as an earthly heaven.[^7251]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O thou who didst conceive God Who became man for our sake: entreat Him, O Pure One, in the day of judgment to have compassion upon us who have sinned greatly against Him.[^7252]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The Sun having shone forth from thy holy womb with most radiant beams illuminates all the earth, O Sovereign Lady; therefore, being enlightened, we honor thee as Mother of God.[^7253]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Dispel the gloom of improper thoughts that darken my soul, through trials, O Lady Theotokos, by the light of the holy commandments of Him Who was incarnate from thee.[^7254]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* There is none holy as Thou, O Lord my God, Who hast exalted the horn of Thy faithful, O Good One, and established us upon the rock of Thy confession.[^7255]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Cross was set up upon earth, and deception fell down; and creation was shaken, and hearts that were shaken by the enemy's assaults received confirmation through faith.[^7256]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Raving in madness, the unjust people condemned Thee, the only Righteous One, unto death, Who dost justify earthly men and rescue them from the unjust hand of the deceiver.[^7257]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The deceitful one stirred up all his malice, warring against the Saints; but he was vanquished, seeing those who were unyielding and partakers of the divine splendor.[^7258]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Bodily beauty was changed by severe wounds; but the spiritual brightness of Christ's passion-bearers shone forth all the more, by the operation of the Holy Spirit.[^7259]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: Fair in beauty beyond all sons of men did I know Thee to be, O Son, when I bare Thee; and how, being now crucified, hast Thou no beauty, O Christ? said the Virgin with tears.[^7260]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos the same.*

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Holding in thine arm Christ Who holds all things, deliver us from the hand of the deceitful devil and from every harm, O pure Birthgiver of God, who hymn thee.[^7261]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Deliver us, O Virgin, from demonic disturbance, and from unjust men, and from all temptations, and from corrupting diseases, by thy prayers, O all-blameless Sovereign Lady.[^7262]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Behold, all generations call thee blessed, O Maiden, who supernaturally didst bring forth in the flesh under time the timeless Word, and didst remain virgin again.[^7263]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O Virgin who didst give birth unto the Lover of mankind, God, deliver me, thine unprofitable servant, in the hour of His dread coming, from every condemnation.[^7264]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Christ is my power, God and Lord, the venerable Church godly sings, crying aloud from a pure mind, keeping festival in the Lord.[^7265]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Seeing Thee, the unsetting Sun, O Christ, crucified upon the Tree, the sun was darkened with fear, and all creation was released from dark deception, singing Thy praise.[^7266]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельство крѣ́пкое сꙋ́щымъ въ ско́рбѣхъ: предста́ни мнѣ̀ жите́йскимъ страсте́мъ приѡбща́ющемꙋсѧ, и҆ спасѝ мѧ, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Lawless people bound Thy hands, O Savior; and all they that were bound with indissoluble bonds...[^7267]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: рѣша́еми быва́хꙋ, и҆ свѧзꙋ́емь быва́ше вра́гъ, и҆ ле́сть разрꙋша́шесѧ.
items.english_text: ...were loosed, and the enemy was bound, and deception was destroyed.[^7268]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїемъ крове́й потопи́сте, Мч҃ницы, фараѡ́на гони́телѧ, оу҆мовре́днѡ безмѣ́рнѡ хва́лѧщасѧ, и҆ къ землѝ благо́й весе́лѧщесѧ преидо́сте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* By the stream of your blood, O Martyrs, ye drowned Pharaoh the persecutor, who with deranged mind boasted beyond measure; and rejoicing, ye passed over unto the good land.[^7269]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Крило́ма дх҃а прелетѣ́вше сѣ́ти вра́жїѧ, Страда́лцы, ра́дꙋющесѧ востеко́сте, и҆дѣ́же пе́рваѧ бла́гость и҆ жи́знь, и҆ свѣ́тъ невече́рнїй.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having flown over the snares of the enemy on the wings of the Spirit, O Sufferers, ye ascended rejoicing whither is the primal goodness, and life, and unwaning light.[^7270]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆рꙋ́жїемъ ꙋ҆ѧзви́ласѧ є҆сѝ страсте́й, Влады́чице, и҆зъ тебѐ Воплоти́вшагѡсѧ, є҆гда̀ того̀ ви́дѣла є҆сѝ распина́емаго, и҆ копїе́мъ въ пречи́стаѧ рє́бра на́съ ра́ди пробода́емаго.
items.english_text: Thou wast wounded with the sword of the passions of Him Who was incarnate from thee, O Sovereign Lady, when thou didst see Him crucified and pierced with a lance in His all-pure ribs for our sake.[^7271]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Хра́мъ Бж҃їй воспои́мъ ст҃ꙋ́ю Дв҃ꙋ, свѣ́тлѡ всѝ блажа́ще, ѡ҆божи́вшесѧ є҆ѧ̀ ра́ди, и҆ лю́тыхъ и҆зба́вльшесѧ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Tone 6. Ode 4. Heirmos the same:*[^7272]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ две́рь ведꙋ́щꙋю къ бж҃е́ственномꙋ вхо́дꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ра́й бж҃твенный, ꙗ҆́кѡ мы́сленно мѣ́сто свѧще́нїѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ добро́тꙋ І҆а́кѡвлю, Дв҃ꙋ ꙋ҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Let us hymn the temple of God, the holy Virgin, all of us radiantly blessing her, having been deified through her and delivered from grievous evils.[^7273]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Приста́нище благоꙋти́шное тѧ̀ показа̀ Хрⷭ҇то́съ, Влады́чице всенепоро́чнаѧ, вѣ́рою и҆ любо́вїю ѿ мы́сли чи́стыѧ призыва́ющимъ, тебѐ Бц҃ꙋ и҆́стиннꙋю.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As the door leading unto the divine entrance, as the divine paradise, as the spiritual place of sanctification, as the beauty of Jacob, we call the Virgin blessed.[^7274]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Марїе пречи́стаѧ чистѣ́йшее была̀ є҆сѝ прїѧ́телище простра́нное бж҃твеннагѡ вселе́нїѧ, дꙋше́внꙋю мою̀ скве́рнꙋ и҆ ка́лъ потреби́.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Christ has shown thee forth as a calm haven, O all-immaculate Sovereign Lady, unto those who with faith and love from a pure mind invoke thee as the true Mother of God.[^7275]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃їимъ свѣ́томъ твои́мъ Бла́же, ꙋ҆́тренюющыхъ тебѣ̀ дꙋ́ши любо́вїю ѡ҆зарѝ, молю́сѧ, тѧ̀ вѣ́дѣти Сло́ве Бж҃їй, и҆́стиннаго Бг҃а, ѿ мра́ка грѣхо́внагѡ взыва́юща.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O all-pure Mary, thou wast the most pure and spacious receptacle of the divine dwelling; consume the defilement and mire of my soul.[^7276]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆блача́ѧй не́бо ѡ҆́блаки, Хрⷭ҇тѐ, на крестѣ̀ на́гъ пригвозди́лсѧ є҆сѝ во́лею: наготꙋ̀ ѕло́бы моеѧ̀ приѡдѣва́ѧй, и҆ въ ри́зы нетлѣ́нїѧ ѡ҆бле́къ просвѣща́ѧ Влады́ко.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* With Thy divine light, O Good One, illuminate the souls of those who lovingly rise early unto Thee, I pray, that they may know Thee, O Word of God, as the true God, calling us forth from the gloom of sins.[^7277]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: На крестѣ̀ ра́спѧтъ бы́сть и҆́стинный вїногра́дъ Хрⷭ҇то́съ, ꙗ҆́кѡ вои́стиннꙋ сві́й сла́дость дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ мꙋ́стъ и҆ска́паѧ, пре́лести всѧ́кое пїѧ́нство бори́телѧ потреблѧ́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Thou Who clothest heaven with clouds, O Christ, Thou wast voluntarily nailed naked upon the Cross, clothing the nakedness of my malice, and having robed me in garments of incorruption, enlightening me, O Master.[^7278]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: И҆спещре́нїи свѧще́нными ꙗ҆́звами Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лцы, и҆ вѣнцы̀ ꙋ҆краша́емїи, пло́тїю пострада́вшемꙋ Бг҃ꙋ предстоѧ́ще, на́шихъ прегрѣше́нїй разрѣше́нїѧ про́сѧтъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Christ the true Vine was crucified upon the Cross, dropping for our souls sweet new wine as truly His own, destroying all the drunkenness of the adversary's deception.[^7279]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: И҆спещре́нїи свѧще́нными ꙗ҆́звами Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лцы, и҆ вѣнцы̀ ꙋ҆краша́емїи, пло́тїю пострада́вшемꙋ Бг҃ꙋ предстоѧ́ще, на́шихъ прегрѣше́нїй разрѣше́нїѧ про́сѧтъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Diversified with sacred wounds, Christ's sufferers, adorned with crowns, standing before God Who suffered in the flesh, ask remission of our transgressions.[^7280]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: И҆спещре́нїи свѧще́нными ꙗ҆́звами Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лцы, и҆ вѣнцы̀ ꙋ҆краша́емїи, пло́тїю пострада́вшемꙋ Бг҃ꙋ предстоѧ́ще, на́шихъ прегрѣше́нїй разрѣше́нїѧ про́сѧтъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Looking toward the glory there, and life, and true gladness, O Passion-bearers, ye endured every tempest of grievous things, strengthened by the Passion of the Master.[^7281]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: И҆спещре́нїи свѧще́нными ꙗ҆́звами Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви страда́лцы, и҆ вѣнцы̀ ꙋ҆краша́емїи, пло́тїю пострада́вшемꙋ Бг҃ꙋ предстоѧ́ще, на́шихъ прегрѣше́нїй разрѣше́нїѧ про́сѧтъ.
items.english_text: Having contained Thee in my womb, O Christ, Who alone canst not be contained by all, I bare Thee without travails; but now I suffer travails as Thou art crucified, O Christ, the all-pure Virgin weeping said.[^7282]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
