items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou wast seen as dead upon the Place of the Skull, Who didst slay hades by the passion of Thy flesh; hanging there, O Christ, Thou hadst neither form nor comeliness, desiring in Thy love for mankind to adorn me.[^7662]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Desiring to nail fast the passionate affections of the first Adam, Thou wast nailed fast with nails, and being pierced with a spear, Thou dost forbid the fiery sword, O Christ, to bar the entrance unto Thy servants.[^7663]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Following the passions of the Master, the choirs of martyrs were nailed unto the tree, and were deprived of both hands and feet, being directed divinely unto the path of honorable martyrdom.[^7664]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* With a perfect mind, O martyrs of Christ, ye utterly cast down the proud mind that exalts itself in audacity, having humbled yourselves in imitation of Him Who exalted all through humility of heart.[^7665]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst sprout forth from the root of Jesse, O Virgin, and as a flower didst bring forth the Planter of the world, Who dried up the sprouts of godlessness by the divine plant of the Cross, which He received in the flesh.[^7666]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Heirmos the same.*[^7667]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Piously glorifying thee as the true Birthgiver of God, O Pure One, and kissing thine...[^7668]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: ...icon, through thy supplications unto thy Son we indeed enjoy enlightenment and unceasing joy with all the saints, being delivered from fire and torment.[^7669]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* According to the multitude of thy mercies and tender compassion, O Good One, unto me who flee unto thee in faith and ask thy prayers, grant purification of sins and pardon of offenses, O Birthgiver of God, Ever-Virgin.[^7670]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* From cruel despair, brought on by frequent tribulations of life, passions, sorrows, and demonic attacks, deliver me, O good and most pure Virgin; and grant me the comfort and enlightenment of salvation.[^7671]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having spent my life in slothfulness, I anger thee, O Virgin; I, the wretched one, am ever in despondency, and neglect thy mercy. Yet I pray thee, O Good One: permit me not to become a cause of rejoicing for demons, and food for Gehenna.[^7672]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Jonah was caught, but not held fast in the belly of the sea monster; for bearing the image of Thee Who didst suffer and wast given over unto burial, he came forth from the beast as from a bridal chamber; and he cried unto the guard: Ye who observe vain and false things have forsaken this mercy.[^7673]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Crossing his hands of old, Jacob prefigured the Cross when blessing the children; therefore, O Most High, ascending thereon, Thou dost loose mankind from the ancient curse, and dost now pour forth blessing unto those who bless Thee, O only Blessed and Most Good Creator.[^7674]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Prefiguring Thy passion, O Word, the great Moses of old lifted up the brazen serpent upon the tree, snatching those who looked upon it from the venomous biting of serpents; for when Thou, O Master, wast crucified, we all the faithful were delivered from the injury of the God-detested serpent.[^7675]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* As though another were suffering, the divine and honorable sufferers of old endured their suffering, foreseeing eternal recompense and rejoicing. By their prayers, O merciful Christ, deliver those who hymn Thee from temptations, sins, and adversities.[^7676]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* By the streams of their blood, the honorable and divine passion-bearers stopped the torrents of delusion, and truly appeared as fountains...[^7677]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: ...pouring forth the water of the knowledge of God unto the faithful. By their prayers, O Savior of the world, shower down forgiveness unto all, both life and purification of sins, and great mercy.[^7678]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beholding the Chief Shepherd and Master lifted up upon the Tree, the Ewe-lamb wept and cried aloud maternally: What is this new mystery, O Child? How is it that, being immortal by essence, Thou hast received death, desiring to deliver mankind from corruption?[^7679]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Heirmos the same.*[^7680]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I fall down before thee and pray, O pure Lady of the world! Destroy the passions of my soul, the cruel desires of the flesh, and the defeats of my mind; and cast down utterly by thy power the demonic malice and snares, O Most Pure One, and save me.[^7681]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Enlighten by thy prayers, O Virgin Mother, my mind darkened by the murk of wicked thoughts, by the mist of pleasures, and by the darkness of transgressions, O thou who didst bring forth the Divine Light; and flash forth upon me the unceasing enlightenment of repentance and grace.[^7682]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Direct me unto the divine paths, O Mother of the King of all, delivering me from the trackless paths of passions and sin, and guiding me unto incorruptible life; for thou art the cause of all good things and the salvation of mankind, saving from corruption and leading upward unto salvation.[^7683]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having borne as a young Child Him Who is before all ages, O Pure One: pray Him unceasingly for the world, O all-blessed Virgin Mother; and as a most pure Mother, entreat the remission of my sins, having ever great boldness toward thy Son, O Pure One.[^7684]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Ineffable wonder! He Who delivered the holy youths from the flame in the furnace is laid in the tomb a breathless corpse, for the salvation of us who sing: Blessed art Thou, O God our Deliverer.[^7685]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* When the Jewish assembly condemned Thee upon the Cross, beholding it the earth was shaken, the sun hid its light; and those who were in darkness beheld the light, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God our Deliverer.[^7686]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst endure reproach, O Savior, being beaten with a reed and crowned with thorns...[^7687]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: ...as a king, being crowned voluntarily, O Christ God, for the salvation of us who sing: Blessed art Thou, O God our Deliverer.[^7688]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Ye are bound, O all-praised martyrs, loath to loose the delusion of the devil; ye endure torments and unjust death, desiring life on high, and crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God our Deliverer.[^7689]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:*[^7690] Ye stood in the midst of the flame, O all-praised martyrs, manifestly burning up delusion; and not being burned by the dew of divine grace, ye cried aloud, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God our Deliverer.[^7691]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou art crucified voluntarily, O unoriginate Son, cried aloud the Birthgiver of God, beholding Thee: I am now engulfed with sorrow of soul; Thou diest, Who grantest life unto those who sing: Blessed art Thou, O God our Deliverer.[^7692]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Heirmos the same.*[^7693]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Confirm my soul upon the rock of the desires of my Creator, O pure Lady, having stilled by thy prayers the tempest of pleasures and the tumult of passions, and granting me divine tranquility and peace.[^7694]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Grant me a shower of tears, O most pure Lady, washing away all defilement and the mire of passions from my soul, presenting me pure unto the Creator, and delivering me from all torments.[^7695]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having acquired thee as intercessor and unconquerable confirmation, O blameless and pure Lady: may we appear superior to the assaults and snares of the enemy, and be delivered from dread and eternal condemnation.[^7696]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* The night of my wicked sins holds me fast, and the mist of lawlessness and the depth of evils, lo, covers me; lead me forth from the pit of sin, O Birthgiver of God and intercessor of the faithful.[^7697]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Be astonished in fear, O heaven, and let the foundations of the earth be shaken; for lo, He Who dwells in the highest is numbered among the dead, and is lodged as a stranger in a narrow tomb. Ye youths, bless Him; ye priests, hymn Him; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7698]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou drinkest the cup which Thou didst desire, O Christ, through the passion of the Cross, pouring forth unto me fountains of forgiveness from Thy life-bearing ribs, unto me who died for the sake of the rib. Hymning Thee...[^7699]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: ...I sing: Ye youths, bless Him; ye priests, hymn Him; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7700]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When the lawless people condemned Thee to be crucified, O Jesus, in the midst of transgressors, O Lord, Giver of life, the earth was shaken, and all sang in fear: Ye youths, bless Him; ye priests, hymn Him; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7701]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Honorable before God was your death, O sufferers; for partaking of many passions, ye showed yourselves to be communicants of the honorable passions of Christ, crying aloud with one mind: Ye youths, bless Him; ye priests, hymn Him; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7702]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Truly your weapons against the array of enemies were not carnal, O martyrs, but hope, faith, and truth; through which having attained unto God, ye were joined unto the angelic choirs, crying aloud unto the Master: Ye youths, bless Him; ye priests, hymn Him; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7703]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Most High, unoriginate Son, enduring spitting, reproaches, and the Cross, being beaten mockingly with a reed, the Birthgiver of God cried aloud: I glorify Thy longsuffering, Whom the youths bless, the priests hymn, and the people supremely exalt unto all ages.[^7704]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Heirmos the same.*[^7705]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having given birth to Christ the Light, through thy luminous entreaties and prayers, O Virgin, fill with the unwaning Light thy servants who in faith piously hymn thee; for by thy prayer and thine intercession thou art mighty to save whomsoever thou wilt.[^7706]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Evil troubles and sorrows of hades have found me, and severe necessities and sicknesses cruelly hold and destroy me; but I invoke thy help, O Virgin: do thou deliver me from these troubles, directing me unto true tranquility.[^7707]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Overthrow the hostile hosts by thy might, O good Birthgiver of God, of those who war against me and torment me exceedingly, and rejoice at my ruin: guarding, preserving, and delivering me from their wicked frenzy and cruel craftiness.[^7708]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Behold my sorrow, O Pure One, which the multitude of sins hath brought upon me; and quench the furnace of my fiery passions with the dew of thy divine prayer, that I may hymn thy fervent protection, O Maiden, and supremely exalt thee unto all ages.[^7709]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *My soul magnifies the Lord.*[^7710]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Weep not for Me, O Mother, beholding in the tomb the Son Whom thou didst conceive in the womb without seed; for I shall arise and be glorified, and as God I shall exalt in glory unceasingly those who magnify thee in faith and love.[^7711]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* That Thou mightest deliver from corruption him who decayed through the sweet tasting of the tree, O only Savior, as Good One Thou didst will to be crucified in the flesh and put to death. We hymn unceasingly, O Jesus, Thy great compassion and Thy power.[^7712]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O how didst Thou endure pains, being stretched out upon the Cross, snatching me from cruel pains, O Savior? How, being crowned with thorns, didst Thou burn up all the thorns of passions? How, having been given vinegar to drink, didst Thou mingle for us the cup of gladness?[^7713]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 1:* Being all oppressed and cast into prisons, and cruelly dismembered in your limbs, O Sufferers, and stretched harshly upon wheels, and given over to be eaten by wild beasts, ye denied not Christ, the Master of all.[^7714]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Martyrikon 2:* Brighter than the sun's rays shines the all-radiant and celebrated memory of the sufferers; and it ever enlightens the souls of the pious, and drives away the darkness of passions and temptations, and scatters the profound demonic gloom.[^7715]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou bearest Him Who bears all things, and holdest as an infant upon thine arm Him Who delivered us from the hand of the adversary enemy, O most pure Lady; and thou seest Him lifted up upon the wood of the Cross, Who delivered us from the pit of malice.[^7716]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Heirmos the same.*[^7717]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Utterly from the heart I offer myself unto thee, and place all my hope in thee: through thee may I find deliverance from sins; through thee may I appear a partaker of the future kingdom and glory, O pure Birthgiver of God.[^7718]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having found thee as intercessor and protection, hope and wall, refuge, purification, and deliverance from cruel things, O Most...[^7719]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: ...Pure One, we are saved from assaults and troubles, sicknesses and passions, and unceasingly honor thy power.[^7720]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Firm salvation and certain hope, who didst make heavenly the human race, who didst pour forth divine rain upon us, O Virgin Birthgiver of God: save us from passions and troubles and from eternal fire.[^7721]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having ineffably given birth to the supremely unoriginate Word of the Father, the Only-Begotten Son and God: pray Him unceasingly, O pure Maiden, that they may be delivered from troubles and from every threat, who magnify thee in faith and love.[^7722]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *It is truly meet. Exaposteilarion and the rest.*[^7723]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 6:*[^7724]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* In the Cross have I hope, and boasting therein I cry aloud: O Lord, Lover of mankind, cast down the pride of those who do not confess Thee to be God and man.[^7725]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Being hedged about by the Cross, we oppose the enemy, fearing neither his craftiness nor his entrapment; for the proud one hath been brought to naught and trampled down upon the Tree by the power of Christ Who was crucified.[^7727]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* O Lord, in the commemoration of Thy saints, all creation keeps festival; the heavens rejoice with the angels, and the earth is glad with men. By their prayers have mercy upon us.[^7729]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Stavrotheotokion:* I was indeed nailed as a man upon the Tree, and was put to death, and was laid in the tomb as dead; but as God in glory, O Mother, pure Virgin, I rise again on the third day.[^7730]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise. Trisagion and the rest.*[^7731]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *On Friday, The Beatitudes, Tone 6:*[^7732]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Remember me, O God my Savior, when Thou comest into Thy kingdom, and save me as the only Lover of mankind.[^7733]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having spread forth Thy palms upon the Tree, Thou didst embrace the nations who hymn Thy tender compassion, O Christ our God.[^7734]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou wast nailed upon the Tree voluntarily, and by Thy power, O Christ, Thou didst utterly shatter the stings of the proud one...[^7735]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: ...O Christ, Thou didst utterly shatter.[^7736]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Delighting in torments, O passion-bearers, ye were counted worthy of the delight of Paradise, praying unceasingly for the world.[^7737]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Glory: Triadikon:* Deliver us from all torment, O Father, and Son, and Spirit Who shares the throne, Thy servants, O Lord.[^7738]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Both now: Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Thee stretched out upon the Cross, the Virgin sighed with tears; by her prayers save us, O Lord.[^7739]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *On Friday Evening.*[^7741]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerables, Tone 6:*[^7742]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Walking in the footsteps of Christ's passions, the whole assembly of martyrs went steadfastly unto many contests, and preached Him as God before ungodly tormentors and lawless kings, and endured many torments, expecting to receive heavenly honors; seeing which they now rejoice, and stand before the Lord with all the choirs of bodiless powers.[^7744]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* A God-chosen flock, imitators of Christ the Chief Shepherd were ye, O all-sacred shepherds: ye preserved unharmed unto the end the divine treasures of piety, having driven away the wild wolves, and guided it well into the heavenly fold; wherein being now established, remember with love those who praise you, and with boldness pray unto Christ for our souls.[^7745]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Having lived venerably, all ye venerable fathers, ye conquered the demons, and having quenched the burning consciences of the torment of passions, ye valiantly endured, O Blessed Ones; and ye now rejoice with the heavenly powers, for in the flesh ye were likened unto the life of those bodiless ones; with whom pray Christ, the most good God, to find deliverance from falls...[^7746]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: ...unto those who honor you.[^7747]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Thy martyrs, O Lord, denied Thee not, neither did they depart from Thy commandments. By their prayers have mercy upon us. *(Twice)*[^7749]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Passion-bearing martyrs, citizens of heaven, having suffered upon earth, endured many torments. By their prayers, O Lord, and by their entreaty, preserve us all.[^7750]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion (Dogmatikon):* Who will not call thee blessed, O all-holy Virgin? Who will not hymn thy birthgiving without defilement? For the Only-Begotten Son, Who shone forth timelessly from the Father, the same came forth from thee, O Pure One, having become ineffably incarnate: being God by nature, and having become man by nature for our sake: not divided into two persons, but known unconfusedly in two natures. Him do thou entreat, O pure and all-blessed one, that our souls may be saved.[^7751]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *O Joyful Light. Prokeimenon of the day.*[^7752]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Martyrs, Tone 6:*[^7753]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Those who suffered for Thy sake, O Christ, endured many torments, and received perfect crowns in the heavens: that they may pray for our souls.[^7754]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Thy Cross, O Lord, became an unconquerable weapon unto the martyrs; for beholding impending death and foreseeing future life, they were strengthened by their hope in Thee; by their prayers have mercy upon us.[^7756]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us... Our soul is exceedingly filled with the reproach of the prosperous, and with the contempt of the proud.* [^7757]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* Thy creative command was my beginning and foundation; for desiring to fashion me as a living creature out of invisible and visible nature, Thou didst fashion my body from the earth, and didst give me a soul by Thy divine and life-creating breathing. Therefore, O Savior, give rest unto Thy servants in the land of the living, and in the tents of the righteous.[^7758]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿча́ѧвсѧ спасенїа моегѡ̀, зовы́й вопїю̀ тебѣ̀, и҆ рꙋ́цѣ простира́ю:
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* By the prayers of her who gave Thee birth, O Christ, of Thy martyrs, and apostles, and prophets, and hierarchs, venerable ones, and righteous...[^7759]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: ведныхъ, и҆ всѣ́хъ Ст҃ы́хъ, оу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑ оу҆поко́й.
items.english_text: ...righteous, and of all the saints, give rest unto Thy departed servants.[^7760]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Помо́щникъ и҆ покрови́тель бы́сть мнѣ̀ во спасе́ніе, се́й мо́й Бг҃ъ, и҆ просла́влю є҆го̀; Бг҃ъ ѻ҆тца̀ моегѡ̀, и҆ вознесу̀ є҆го̀: сла́внѡ бо просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: *On Friday at Compline.*[^7761]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Припѣ́въ. Прест҃а́ѧ Гпⷣже́ Бцⷣе, спасѝ на́съ.
items.english_text: *Supplicatory Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.*[^7762]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Не ѿри́ни Блага́ѧ, не ѡ҆мерзѝ менѐ, не пре́зри менѐ, подъ твоѐ милосе́рдіе Чи́стаѧ, те́плѣ прите́кшаго; но да́ждь мнѣ̀ є҆́же въ тебѣ̀ напита́тисѧ благода́тію.
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:* He was my helper and protector unto salvation; this is my God, and I will glorify Him; the God of my father, and I will exalt Him; for gloriously is He glorified.[^7763]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Бцⷣе блага́ѧ, скорбѧ́щихъ застꙋ́пнице, пріимѝ моѐ ѿ душѝ стена́ніе, и҆ и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ ѿ всѣ́хъ безмѣ́рныхъ ѕѡ́лъ, ꙗ҆́же лю́тѣ содѣ́ѧхъ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^7764]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ припа́даю Блага́ѧ, ско́рбныхъ предста́тельнице: и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ вѣ́чнующагѡ, и҆ тмы̀ и҆ про́пасти, въ все́мъ житіѝ ѕлѣ̀ пожи́вшаго.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Cast me not away, O Good One, abhor me not, nor despise me, who have fervently fled beneath thy tender compassion, O Pure One; but grant me to be nourished in thee by grace.[^7765]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀! ка́кѡ тѧ̀ И҆зба́вителю оу҆молю̀ І҆и҃се мо́й, безмѣ́рнѡ къ тебѣ̀ согрѣши́въ? про́чее хода́таицу тебѣ̀ приноша́ю ро́ждшую тѧ̀ Чи́стую, поми́луй и҆ спаси́ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O good Theotokos, helper of the sorrowing, receive the sighing from my soul, and deliver me from all the immeasurable evils which I have cruelly committed.[^7766]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆твердѝ Гдⷪі на ка́мени за́повѣдей твои́хъ, подви́гшеесѧ се́рдце моѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ свѧ́тъ є҆сѝ и҆ Гдⷪь.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Unto thee I fall down, O Good One, intercessor for the sorrowful: deliver me from the eternal fire, and the darkness, and the abyss, who have lived evilly throughout my whole life.[^7767]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Припа́даю тебѣ̀, Ма́ти Сло́ва, пріими́ мѧ щедро́тами твои́ми; просѧ́щему же прегрѣше́ній проще́ніе пода́ждь, те́плыми моли́твами твои́ми.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Woe is me! How shall I entreat Thee, O Deliverer, my Jesus, having sinned immeasurably against Thee? Therefore I bring unto Thee as intercessor the Pure One who gave Thee birth: have mercy and save me.[^7768]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Поми́луй мѧ̀ Влады́чице, поми́луй, и҆ и҆зба́ви ѿ всѧ́кагѡ лꙋка́вствіѧ, и҆ ѡ҆ѕлобле́нїа бѣсѡ́въ, и҆ вѣ́чнагѡ мꙋче́нїа.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Establish, O Lord, upon the rock of Thy commandments my shaken heart, for Thou alone art holy and Lord.[^7769]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆кротѝ Влады́чице, сласте́й мои́хъ го́рькое піѧ́нство, трезвѣ́ніе бж҃е́ственное мнѣ̀ подаю́щи покаѧ́нїа, и҆ ѡ҆браще́ніе спаси́тельное.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I fall down before thee, O Mother of the Word: receive me with thy compassions; and grant forgiveness of transgressions unto me who ask, by thy fervent prayers.[^7770]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Всѧ́ческихъ Гдⷪа и҆ содержи́телѧ, Бг҃ороди́тельнице, неизглаго́ланнѡ ро́ждшаѧ, оу҆молѝ сего̀ є҆́же спастѝ ста́до твоѐ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Have mercy on me, O Lady, have mercy, and deliver me from every malice, and the affliction of demons, and eternal torment.[^7771]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́ша проро́къ прише́ствіе твоѐ Гдⷪі, и҆ оу҆боѧ́сѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ хо́щеши ѿ Дв҃ы роди́тисѧ, и҆ человѣ́кѡмъ ꙗ҆ви́тисѧ, и҆ глаго́лаше: оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ оу҆боѧ́хсѧ; сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й Гдⷪі.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Subdue, O Lady, the bitter drunkenness of my pleasures, granting me the divine sobriety of repentance and saving conversion.[^7772]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* O Parent of God, who ineffably gavest birth unto the Lord and Ruler of all, entreat Him that He may save thy flock.[^7773]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* The Prophet heard of Thy coming, O Lord, and was afraid, that Thou wast about to be born of a Virgin and appear unto men, and he said: I heard the report of Thee, and was afraid; glory to Thy power, O Lord.[^7774]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Ceaselessly do I scratch the wounds of my soul with love of pleasure, and the pains of ulcers have been added unto me...[^7775]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: ...pains, and I remain insensible and incurable; have mercy, O Parent of God, and heal and save me by thy prayers.[^7776]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The darkness of sin hath covered my soul, O Parent of God, so that I walk as in night in the light, ignorant of Christ's commandments; O thou who gavest birth to the Divine Light, have mercy on me and enlighten me, I pray.[^7777]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory:* The Word of the living God came down into thy womb, O Virgin-Mother, and taking from thy most pure blood my whole nature, He comes twofold in one Hypostasis; entreat Him to save our souls.[^7778]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* Diligently have I pursued bodily desires and all pleasures, and I am wholly corrupted, defiled, and abominable; O most pure Parent of God, have mercy and save me by thy tender compassion.[^7779]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Enlighten, I pray, him who rises early from the night, O Lover of mankind, and guide me unto Thy commandments, and teach me, O Savior, to do Thy will.[^7780]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I have kindled for myself the fire of Gehenna, doing unfitting deeds, and have cruelly drawn upon myself the wrath of God; help me, O Pure One, and forsake me not.[^7781]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Ceaselessly do I ask remission of transgressions, yet I cease not committing most lawless deeds, and I grieve thee, O Most Pure One; O cleansing of the faithful, have compassion on me.[^7782]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory:* Whom thou hast borne from thy blood, O Pure One, perfect man and true God, Jesus: entreat Him that we may be delivered from eternal fire.[^7783]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* O Impassable Gate, I pray: open unto me the doors of true repentance, and show me the paths of repentance, O Pure One, who art the guide of all.[^7784]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* I cried with all my heart unto the merciful God, and He heard me from the lowest hades, and brought up my life from corruption.[^7785]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The waves of improper thoughts now submerge me; but do thou, O Lady, guide me by thy tender compassion unto the calm haven of true repentance.[^7786]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having acquired thee as hope and unconquerable wall, and a firm protectress, O Maiden...[^7787]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: ...we are delivered from transgressions, and cruel passions, and every harm.[^7788]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory:* I fall down before thee, O pure Virgin, and cry aloud with weeping, O Theotokos: deliver my wretched soul from the future judgment and the eternal fire.[^7789]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* Thou art the strength, O Most Pure One, of those infirm in soul through thy supplications; therefore despise me not who am sick in soul, but heal me.[^7790]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Then, Lord, have mercy (40 times). Glory... both now...*[^7791]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 6:* For the tender compassion of Thy mercies, O Christ, Thou camest down to earth, and taking flesh of the Virgin, Thou didst sanctify all, and didst call all from earth to heaven; therefore, hoping in Thee, we shall never err, but are delivered by Thee from present assaults; for Thou art our Savior, O our Creator God.[^7792]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* We have sinned, we have transgressed, we have done unrighteously before Thee, neither have we kept nor done as Thou hast commanded us; but deliver us not up utterly, O God of the fathers.[^7793]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* When my wretched soul must endure separation from the body, and there will be none to deliver it or comfort it: then stand forth, O Lady, and deliver me from the malice of demons.[^7794]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I fall down before thee, and offer fervent drops of tears; I know thy love for mankind, I know thy longsuffering and meekness: do thou now have mercy on me, O Pure One, pardon and save me.[^7795]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory:* Have mercy, O Virgin, upon my passionate and wretched soul; see the turmoil of passions, see also the inconstant burning of the flesh; and grant me saving help and deliverance.[^7796]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* The Son and Word, consubstantial and co-unoriginate with the Father, took flesh from thee, equal, endowed with mind and soul, unchangeably, as He Himself knows; and He renewed our nature therein for the better, O pure Virgin.[^7797]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Whom the heavenly hosts glorify, and Cherubim and Seraphim tremble before: let every breath and creation sing, bless, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7798]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I am at a loss pondering my deeds, and I tremble before the Judge of the dread tribunal; what defense shall I, the wretched one, then offer? O Lady...[^7799]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: ...Lady of the world, be thou my protectress.[^7800]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Do not thou thyself, O Lady, cast me away from thy face when I look upon thine icon; but be merciful unto me, and alter my present condemnation.[^7801]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory:* O Bride of God, unwedded Mary! Deliver me from every wicked harm as I, thy servant, cry unto thee; and stand by me in the future trial, O only protectress of Christians.[^7802]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* That Thy Son might deify mankind, O Lady, He appeared from thee as perfect man; entreat Him therefore to show me, perfectly cleansed, a partaker of His divine kingdom.[^7803]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* O Virgin who didst receive from the Angel the "Rejoice," and gavest birth to thy Creator: save those who magnify thee.[^7804]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou alone art the protectress of mankind, O Most Pure One! Thou art the wall of Christians, O Pure One! Thee do I now present as an intercessor unto Christ for me the humble one, that by thy prayers He may have mercy on me the wretched.[^7805]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I have wrought the works of night, and the night of torment is now about to cover me justly, convicted, and to receive all torment of hades; but O pure Virgin who didst bear the Judge and God, deliver me from every torment.[^7806]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory:* I have spent the time of my life in evils, and have drawn near unto the gates of hades, and all unprepared do I go thither. Help me, O good Theotokos, for in thee have I placed my hope.[^7807]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* O good-loving Lady, adornment of Angels, glory of Martyrs: with these pray that we may find mercy and remission of debts, and that all may be able rightly to finish the course of our life, doing divine things.[^7808]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *It is truly meet. Trisagion. After the Our Father: troparia and the rest as usual.*[^7809]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *On Saturday at Matins.*[^7810]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *After the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 6:*[^7811]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Thou art ever a light unto the righteous, O Lord! For the saints, having been enlightened in Thee, shine ever as luminaries...[^7812]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: ...having quenched the lamp of the ungodly. By their prayers, O our Savior, enlighten Thou my lamp, and save me.[^7813]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Having endured the struggle of suffering, O saints, and received from Thee the honors of victory, they brought to nought the devices of the lawless, and received incorruptible crowns. Being entreated by them, O God, grant us great mercy.[^7815]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* Thou Who didst call Thy Mother blessed, camest to Thy passion by voluntary counsel, shining forth upon the Cross, desiring to seek out Adam, saying unto the Angels: Rejoice with Me, for the lost coin is found. O our God Who hast ordered all things wisely, glory to Thee.[^7816]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *After the second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 6:*[^7817]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* The suffering standing in the contest, and the wounds of torment upon the martyrs: and the choirs of the bodiless stood holding the honors of victory: the all-wise ones amazed tormentors and kings; they cast down the apostate by the confession of Christ. O Lord Who didst strengthen them, glory to Thee.[^7818]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* O Lord, the memory of Thy saints today is shown forth as the Paradise that was in Eden; for therein all creation rejoices, and by their supplications Thou grantest us peace and great mercy.[^7820]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* Truly all things are vanity, and life is but a shadow and a dream; for in vain doth everyone born of earth disquiet himself, as the Scripture saith: when we have acquired the world, then do we dwell in the grave, where kings and paupers are together. Therefore, O Christ God, give rest unto the departed, as the Lover of mankind.[^7822]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Tone 6, Podoben: "O hope of the world" (Наде́жде мі́ра):*[^7823] O defense of those born of earth, protectress Mary, who didst bear in time the timeless Son and Word of God: entreat Him earnestly, as His Mother, with the martyrs, and prophets, and divine fasters, to save those who have departed.[^7824]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, Venerables, and the Departed.*[^7825]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: With words I honor the lovers of the Word.) A work of Joseph.*[^7826]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:* The sensory Pharaoh was drowned with all his host, but Israel, having passed through the midst of the sea, cried aloud: Let us sing unto the Lord our God, for gloriously is He glorified.[^7827]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Martyrs, pray to God for us.*[^7828]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* With radiant mind ye enlightened those in darkness, and having put to shame the impious tormentors, O Martyrs, being clearly victorious, ye passed over unto the unwaning light.[^7829]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Hierarchs of Christ, pray to God for us.*[^7830]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The hierarchs of Christ, and the choir of the venerable, and of the prophets, and the unique solemnity of all the righteous, shining with virtuous beauties, have entered into the heavenly mansions.[^7831]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Refrain: All Saints, pray to God for us.*[^7832]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The whole multitude of women, having betrothed themselves unto Christ and trampled underfoot with manly labors him who slew Eve by cruel deceit, are called blessed with divine songs.[^7833]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory: Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* Thou Who from the earth didst create man in the beginning, O Christ: give rest to the souls of Thy servants, we pray, in the mansions of the righteous and in places of refreshment, as Thou art most good.[^7834]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* More sacred than the Cherubim and Seraphim, O Pure One, wast thou revealed, having given birth to the Creator of creation; entreat Him unceasingly to have compassion upon thy servants who glorify thee.[^7835]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Departed.*[^7836]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: A sixth song I sing for the departed.) We sing it in order where there is no Menaion. A work of Theophanes.*[^7837]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Traversing the deep on foot as on dry land, Israel, seeing Pharaoh their pursuer drowning, cried aloud: Let us sing a song of victory unto God.[^7838]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* In the heavenly chambers the noble martyrs ever pray Thee, O Christ: vouchsafe the faithful whom Thou hast removed from the earth to obtain eternal blessings.[^7840]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having adorned all things, Thou didst create between them man, a mixed creature, both of humility and greatness; therefore give rest, O Savior, to the souls of Thy servants.[^7842]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory:* In the beginning Thou didst establish me as a dweller and worker of Paradise...[^7843]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: ...yet when I transgressed Thy commandment, Thou didst drive me out; therefore give rest, O Savior, to the souls of Thy servants.[^7844]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* He Who from a rib created of old Eve our first mother, is clothed in flesh from thy most pure womb, whereby, O Pure One, He hath destroyed the power of death.[^7845]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Having established the thoughts of my soul upon the firm rock of Thy faith, establish me, O Lord; for I have Thee, O Good One, as refuge and affirmation.[^7846]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Blended with bodily pains, the sufferers looked rejoicing toward the painless recompense; and now they soothe our many pains by grace.[^7847]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Driving away evil beasts with a firm understanding, the divine hierarchs delivered unharmed from their malice the divine nurslings of Christ.[^7848]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The choir of Venerables, voluntarily submitting beneath the yoke of the Lord, mortified carnal wisdom, and received eternal life.[^7849]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory: Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* Deliver from eternal fire those who in piety have departed from this life, O Christ, and grant remission of their debts, O Good One, and eternal delight.[^7850]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* The women who loved Christ, standing about thee who didst ineffably give Him birth, O most pure Lady, dance in chorus with joyful mind.[^7851]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Departed. Heirmos:* There is none holy like Thee, O Lord my God, Who hast exalted the horn of Thy faithful, O Good One, and established us upon the rock of Thy confession.[^7852]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having lawfully suffered, Thy martyrs, O Giver of life, adorned with crowns of victory from Thee, earnestly intercede for eternal honor for the departed faithful.[^7853]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having chastened me who had gone astray of old with many wonders and signs, at last Thou didst empty Thyself, being compassionate; and having sought, Thou didst find and save me.[^7854]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory:* Vouchsafe those who have passed over unto Thee from the fleeting, inconstant corruption, to dwell with joy in eternal habitations, O Good One, having justified them by faith and grace.[^7855]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* There is none blameless like thee, O most pure Mother of God; for thou alone...[^7856]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: ...didst conceive in thy womb the true God before the ages, Who destroyed the power of death.[^7857]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* I heard, O Lord, the report of Thee, and was afraid; I understood Thy works, and was filled with awe: glory to Thy power, O Lord.[^7858]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Standing, the passion-bearers beheld the proud one trampled under their feet, and thankfully they glorified the Creator of all.[^7859]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Armed with the splendors of words unto the light of understanding, the hierarchs saved men from the darkness of heresies.[^7860]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Appearing as burning coals through fervent understanding toward God, and having burned up material passions, the Venerable are greatly glorified.[^7861]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory: Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* Ruling over both the living and the dead, O Lord: give rest to those whom Thou hast removed, with all who have well-pleased Thee, O Master.[^7862]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* The Lord, O Most Pure One, having ineffably clothed Himself in flesh from thee, received the company of women who contended courageously.[^7863]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Departed. Heirmos:* Christ is my power, God and Lord, the venerable Church sings in God-befitting manner, crying out from a pure mind, feasting in the Lord.[^7864]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Manifesting a greater knowledge of wisdom, and in Thy gifts an all-perfect goodness, O Master, Thou didst unite the choirs of martyrs with the Angels.[^7865]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Vouchsafe the departed who have passed unto Thee to obtain Thine ineffable glory, O Christ, where is the habitation of those who rejoice, and the sound of pure gladness.[^7866]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory:* Receive those singing of Thy divine dominion, whom Thou hast received from the earth: making them children of light, cleansing the mist of sin, O Plenteous in mercy.[^7867]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* As a most pure receptacle, a blameless church, an all-holy ark, a virginal place of sanctification: thee, the beauty of Jacob, hath the Master chosen.[^7868]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Christ Who hast shone forth light unto the world: enlighten my heart, as I cry to Thee from the night, and save me.[^7869]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having clothed yourselves in the garment woven of grace from on high, O sufferers, ye stripped the enemy bare.[^7870]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With the holy prophets let us honor the God-wise high priests, and...[^7871]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: ...the venerable who have well-pleased God.[^7872]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* In psalms and songs let us praise the company of women, as having well-pleased God rightly.[^7873]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory: Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* In the habitations of Thy righteous, O Lord, establish Thy servants, overlooking their sins in this life.[^7874]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* Delivering us from every harm of the enemy, thou hast appeared, O Lady, praying to Christ the only compassionate One.[^7875]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Departed. Heirmos:* With Thy divine light, O Good One, illumine, I pray, the souls of those who rise early unto Thee with love, that they may know Thee, O Word of God, as the true God, calling them back from the darkness of sin.[^7876]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Offered as a consecrated whole burnt-offering and as the first-fruits of human nature unto God Who is glorified, the Martyrs ever intercede for our salvation.[^7877]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Vouchsafe Thy departed faithful servants heavenly dwelling and the distribution of gifts, O Lord, granting them deliverance from transgressions.[^7878]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory:* O Thou Who alone art the Life-creator by nature, Who art truly an unsearchable abyss of goodness: vouchsafe Thy kingdom unto those who have reposed, O Merciful, only Immortal One.[^7879]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* Strength and song is He Who was born of thee unto the world, O Lady, and became salvation unto the lost, delivering from the gates of hades those who bless thee in faith.[^7880]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Swallowed by the whale of sin, I cry unto Thee, O Christ: as the Prophet, deliver me from corruption.[^7881]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By the flow of your divine blood ye drowned the noetic enemies; and ye watered the hearts of the faithful, O Passion-bearers.[^7882]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having crucified yourselves to the world and passions, O Venerable ones and all-wise Hierarchs, ye were counted worthy of divine glory.[^7883]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* As is due, let us call blessed the choir of prophets, and the assembly of honorable women who strove well.[^7884]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory: Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* Give rest, O God, to the souls of those who have departed before, with Thine elect, overlooking their transgressions.[^7885]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* O thou who didst bear Christ in the flesh, mortify the passions of my flesh, and...[^7886]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: ...quicken my soul, O Virgin, by thine intercession.[^7887]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Departed. Heirmos:* Beholding the sea of life surging with the tempest of temptations, having fled to Thy calm haven, I cry unto Thee: Lead up my life from corruption, O Plenteous in mercy.[^7888]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being nailed to the Cross, Thou didst gather unto Thyself the choirs of martyrs who imitated Thy passion, O Good One; therefore we pray Thee: give rest to those who have departed unto Thee.[^7889]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When Thou comest in Thine ineffable glory dreadfully to judge the whole world, be well pleased, O Deliverer, that the faithful servants whom Thou hast taken from the earth may meet Thee radiantly upon the clouds.[^7890]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory:* Being the Fountain of life, O Master, in divine strength bringing out the bound, settle Thy servants who have departed unto Thee in faith in the delight of Paradise.[^7891]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
