items.english_text: *Both now:* Unto the earth we returned having transgressed the commandment of God; but for thy sake, O Virgin, we were lifted up from earth to heaven, having shaken off mortal corruption.[^7892]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Thou Who didst hear the song of Thy holy Children and didst bedew the burning furnace: blessed art Thou, O Lord.[^7893]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Let us honor with songs the passion-bearers of Christ, who quenched the flame of cruel godlessness with showers of blood.[^7894]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The all-glorious Hierarchs, having dispelled the winter of heresies, passed rejoicing unto the divine springtime.[^7895]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* By endurance ye inherited the rich grace of the Spirit, O Fasters, and destroyed a multitude of demons.[^7896]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Glory:* Vouchsafe those who in faith have departed from this life to inherit the haven of Thy sweetness, O Merciful One, as Thou art plenteous in mercy.[^7897]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Both now:* He Who showed thee to be a pure Virgin even after childbirth hath saved the choirs of holy women who followed thee.[^7898]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Departed. Heirmos:* The Angel made the furnace dew-yielding for the holy Children; while the command of God, consuming the Chaldeans, persuaded the tormentor to cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^7899]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ не преста́ѧ чешꙋ̀ любосла́стьми, и҆ приложи́шасѧ мнѣ̀ стрѹ́пѡвъ болѣ́зни,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Delivered by Thy blood from the first transgression, the Martyrs...[^7900]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: ѡ҆кропи́вшесѧ же свое́ю кро́вїю, проѡбразꙋ́ютъ ꙗ҆́вѣ твоѐ заколе́нїе. Благослове́нъ є҆сѝ Бж҃е ѻ҆те́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: ...and being sprinkled with their own blood, they clearly prefigure Thy slaying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^7901]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Свирѣпѣ́ющꙋю сме́рть ꙋ҆мертви́лъ є҆сѝ, Сло́ве живонача́льнѣйшїй: въ вѣ́рѣ же твое́й ꙋ҆со́пшыѧ прїимѝ, тебѐ пою́щыѧ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, и҆ глаго́лющыѧ: благослове́нъ Бг҃ъ ѻ҆те́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst put to death raging death, O most life-originating Word; but receive in Thy faith those who have reposed, who hymn Thee, O Christ, and say: Blessed is the God of our fathers.[^7902]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Воѡдꙋши́въ мѧ̀ человѣ́ка вдохнове́нїемъ бж҃е́ственнымъ, бг҃онача́льнѣйшїй Влады́ко: преста́вленыѧ ца́рствїа твоегѡ̀ сподо́би, пѣ́ти тебѣ̀ Спа́се: благослове́нъ є҆сѝ Бж҃е ѻ҆те́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Having enlivened me, man, with divine inbreathing, O Sovereign Master origin of Godhead: vouchsafe the departed Thy kingdom, to sing unto Thee, O Savior: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^7903]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Превы́шши всѣ́хъ тва́рей, Пренепоро́чнаѧ, была̀ є҆сѝ, заче́нши Бг҃а сокрꙋши́вшаго сме́ртныѧ врата̀, и҆ вереѝ сте́ршаго; тѣ́мже тѧ̀, Чи́стаѧ, пѣсносло́вимъ вѣ́рнїи ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ома́терь.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Thou wast higher than all creatures, O All-immaculate One, having conceived God Who shattered the gates of death and broke the bars; therefore, O Pure One, we the faithful hymn thee as Mother of God.[^7904]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Преподо́бнїи твоѝ ѻ҆́трѡцы въ пещѝ Херꙋві́мы подража́хꙋ, трист҃ꙋ́ю пѣ́снь воспѣва́юще: благослови́те, по́йте Гдⷭ҇а, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* In the furnace Thy venerable Children imitated the Cherubim, chanting the thrice-holy hymn: Bless, sing the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^7905]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: До́блественнѣ мꙋче́нїй треволне́нїемъ ꙋ҆ра́нѧеми, бж҃твеннїи Мꙋ́ченици, благода́тїю проше́дше въ тишинꙋ̀ глубо́кꙋю, вы́шнагѡ ца́рствїа достиго́ша.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Valiantly wounded by the surge of tortures, the divine Martyrs, having passed through by grace into deep calm, reached the kingdom on high.[^7906]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Преподо́бнїи и҆ всемꙋ́дрїи Свѧти́телїе, просїѧ́вше ꙗ҆́кѡ со́лнце, просвѣща́ютъ вселе́нную ꙋ҆че́нїй лꋋча́ми, и҆ и҆сцѣле́нїй свѣ́тлостьмѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The venerable and all-wise Hierarchs, having shone forth like the sun, enlighten the universe with the rays of their teachings and the brightness of their healings.[^7907]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́внїи прорѡ́цы, и҆ первосщ҃е́нницы, преподо́бнїи всѝ и҆ пра́веднїи, мꙋ́ченикъ мно́жества и҆ же́нъ: ста́до ва́ше всѐ сохрани́те, ѿ бѣсѡ́въ непоколеби́мо.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Glorious Prophets and Chief Priests, all venerable and righteous ones, multitudes of martyrs and women: preserve all your flock unshaken by demons.[^7908]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Воспое́мъ ꙗ҆̀же ѿ вѣ́ка пра́ведныѧ, и҆ бг҃оглаго́ливыѧ проро́ки, и҆ возопіе́мъ съ ꙋ҆миле́нїемъ: тѣ́хъ Сло́ве моли́твами, въ вѣ́рѣ ꙋ҆со́пшїѧ ꙋ҆поко́й.
items.english_text: *Glory: Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* Let us hymn the righteous from of old and the God-speaking Prophets, and let us cry aloud with compunction: By their prayers, O Word, give rest unto those who have reposed in faith.[^7909]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Всю́ тѧ бли́жнюю Бг҃а, Дѣ́во, ли́къ же́нскїй возлюбѝ, и҆ въ слѣ́дъ тебѐ приведе́сѧ Влады́цѣ всѣ́хъ, согла́снѡ блажа́ще тѧ̀, Пречи́стаѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* The choir of women loved thee, O Virgin, as neighbor wholly to God, and was brought after thee unto the Master of all, praising thee with one accord, O Most Pure One.[^7910]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зъ пла́мене преподо́бнымъ ро́сꙋ и҆сточи́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ пра́веднагѡ же́ртвꙋ и҆ во́дꙋ попали́лъ є҆сѝ; всѧ̑ бо твори́ши Хрⷭ҇тѐ то́кмѡ є҆́же хотѣ́ти; тѧ̀ превозно́симъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Departed. Heirmos:* From the flame Thou didst pour out dew for the holy Children, and didst consume with fire the sacrifice of the righteous one and the water; for Thou, O Christ, doest all things by the mere act of willing; Thee do we supremely exalt unto all ages.[^7911]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Steadfastly showing forth their struggles, they received crowns of victory, the...[^7912]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: ...Martyrs, passion-bearers of Christ, crying aloud: Thee, the Lord, do we supremely exalt unto the ages.[^7913]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Receive gently, and give rest as Thou art compassionate, unto the faithful who have holily left earthly things and departed unto Thee, the Master, who supremely exalt Thee unto the ages.[^7914]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Glory:* Now in the land of the meek, be well pleased, O Savior, that all who have reposed before may take up their dwelling, having justified them through faith in Thee and by grace, who supremely exalt Thee unto the ages.[^7915]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Both now:* We all call thee blessed, O All-blessed One, as having given birth unto the Word truly existing and blessed, Who became flesh for our sake, Whom we supremely exalt unto all ages.[^7916]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *My soul doth magnify the Lord.*[^7917]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* O Virgin who didst receive from the Angel the "Rejoice," and gavest birth to thy Creator: save those who magnify thee.[^7918]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As pure sheep ye were brought unto the Master, O Passion-bearing Martyrs: pray Him to save our souls.[^7919]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As pastors upon the pasture of piety, O Hierarchs, ye shepherded the faithful; and now ye have taken up your dwelling in the divine sheepfold.[^7920]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* With the holy Hierarchs and Prophets, and with the choir of women who suffered valiantly, let us call blessed the choirs of the venerable.[^7921]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Glory: Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* The perpetual joy whereof the assemblies of the Saints partake: vouchsafe the departed to obtain this, O Plenteous in mercy.[^7922]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Both now:* O Virgin who didst give birth to the Light, enlighten my soul, driving away the darkness of sin and of my slothfulness.[^7923]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Canon to the Departed. Heirmos:* It is not possible for men to see God, upon Whom the ranks of Angels dare not gaze; but through thee, O All-pure One, the Word Incarnate appeared unto men; Whom magnifying with the heavenly hosts, we call thee blessed.[^7924]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Hope strengthened the choirs of the martyrs, and winged them with burning desire unto Thy love, prefiguring for them the truly unshaken rest to come; whereof vouchsafe the departed faithful, O Good One.[^7925]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Be well pleased, O Christ, that those who have reposed in faith may obtain Thy radiant and divine illumination, and the rest in the bosom of Abraham, as Thou alone art merciful unto them...[^7926]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: ...granting it, and accounting them worthy of eternal blessedness.[^7927]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Glory:* O Thou Who art by nature good and compassionate, and the Desirer of mercies, and an abyss of loving-kindness: settle in the place where Thy light shines, O Savior, those whom Thou hast translated from this place of affliction and the shadow of death.[^7928]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Both now:* We know thee, O Pure One, to be the holy Tabernacle, and the Ark, and the Tablets of the Law and of grace; for for thy sake forgiveness was granted unto those justified by the blood of Him Who was incarnate from thy womb, O All-immaculate One.[^7929]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise: Litany, Exapostilarion, and the usual Psalms.*[^7930]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 6:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: O Lord, at the memory of Thy Saints all creation keeps festival; the heavens rejoice with the Angels, and the earth is glad with men: by their prayers have mercy on us.[^7931]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: O Lord, if we had not Thy Saints as intercessors, and Thy goodness showing mercy upon us, how should we dare, O Savior, to hymn Thee, Whom the Angels ceaselessly glorify? O Knower of hearts, spare our souls.[^7932]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: The memory of the Martyrs is joy unto those that fear the Lord; for having suffered for Christ's sake, they received crowns from Him; and now with boldness they pray for our souls.[^7933]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: Our God is marvelous in His chosen and holy ones. Rejoice and be glad, all ye His servants; for He hath prepared for you crowns and His kingdom. But we pray you, forget us not also.[^7934]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* Pain came upon Adam through the tasting of the tree of old in Eden, when the serpent vomited out venom; for on account thereof all-generational death entered in, devouring man; but the Master came and cast down the serpent, and granted us resurrection. Unto Him therefore let us cry aloud: Spare, O Savior, and give rest with the Saints unto those whom Thou hast received, as Thou art the Lover of mankind.[^7935]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* Thou art our God, Who in wisdom createst and fulfillest all things: Thou didst send Prophets, O Christ, to foretell Thy coming; and Apostles, to proclaim Thy majesty. And the former...[^7936]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: ...indeed prophesied Thy coming, while the latter enlightened the nations by baptism; and the martyrs obtained that which they desired; and the choir of both entreats Thee, together with her that bare Thee: Give rest, O Lord, to the souls which Thou hast received; and vouchsafe us Thy kingdom, O Thou Who didst endure crucifixion for the sake of me the condemned, my Deliverer and God.[^7937]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 6.*[^7938]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: Possessing incomprehensible compassion toward us, and an inexhaustible fountain of divine goodness, O Plenteous in mercy: settle those who have departed unto Thee, O Master, in the land of the living, in the beloved and longed-for dwellings, granting an abiding possession; for Thou didst shed Thy blood for all, O Savior, and didst redeem the world with a life-bearing price.[^7939]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: Thou didst willingly endure life-creating putting-to-death, and didst pour out life, and gavest eternal nourishment unto the faithful; wherein station those who have reposed in the hope of resurrection, pardoning all their transgressions by grace, as Thou alone art without sin, and alone art good and the Lover of mankind, that Thy name may be sung by all, O Christ, and Thy saving love for mankind be glorified.[^7941]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: Knowing Thee, O Christ, Who rulest over the living with authority of divine origin, and exercisest lordship over the dead, we pray Thee: give rest unto Thy faithful servants who have departed unto Thee the only Benefactor, with Thine elect, O Lover of mankind, in the place of comfort, in the brightness of the Saints; for Thou art the Desirer of mercy, and as God savest those whom Thou didst create after Thine image, O only Plenteous in mercy.[^7943]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* Thou didst appear as a God-befitting dwelling, O Most Pure One; for thou didst contain God, and gavest birth unto Christ, O unwedded Virgin-Mother, in two essences, yet in one Hypostasis. Him do thou entreat, O Pure One, the only-begotten Firstborn, Who preserved thee an immaculate Virgin even after...[^7944]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: ...childbirth: to give rest in the light and in incorruptible blessedness unto the souls of those who have reposed in faith.[^7945]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise: Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparion, Litany, and Dismissal.*[^7946]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: Remember me, O God my Savior, when Thou comest into Thy kingdom, and save me as Thou alone art the Lover of mankind.[^7947]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: O Lover of mankind Who didst glorify the prophets and teachers, and the venerable and righteous: by their prayers save our souls.[^7948]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: Having not feared the onslaught of fire and sword and wild beasts, O glorious Passion-bearers, ye were accounted worthy of life everlasting.[^7949]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: Station with all the saints and righteous ones, O Word, those whom Thou hast translated in faith from temporal things, that we may glorify Thee.[^7950]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Glory: Triadikon:* O Almighty Trinity, praised in unity! Station in the bosom of Abraham the faithful whom Thou hast translated from the earth.[^7951]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Both now:* Blessed hast thou appeared in all generations; for thou gavest birth ineffably unto God Who is truly blessed, O Most Pure One.[^7952]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *[Engraved Tailpiece: An ornamental baroque vignette in the form of a chalice with floral garlands and arabesques, marking the conclusion of Tone 6]*[^7953]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *[Engraved Headpiece: An ornamental baroque frieze depicting the Most Pure Theotokos holding the Pre-eternal Christ Child, surrounded by holy prophets, angels, and foliate cartouches, marking the beginning of Tone 7]*[^7954]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," we set 4 verses, and sing 3 Resurrection Stichera, repeating the first.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1 (Resurrectional):* Come, let us rejoice in the Lord, Who shattered the dominion of death and enlightened the human race, crying aloud with the Bodiless Powers: O our Creator and Savior, glory to Thee! *(Twice)*[^7955]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 (Resurrectional):* Thou didst endure the Cross and burial for our sake, O Savior, and by death, as God, Thou didst put death to death; therefore we worship Thy third-day Resurrection: O Lord, glory to Thee![^7956]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3 (Resurrectional):* Beholding the Resurrection of the Creator, the Apostles were astonished, singing the angelic praise: this is the glory of the Church, this is the richness of the Kingdom! O Thou Who didst suffer for our sake: O Lord, glory to Thee![^7957]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion (Dogmatikon), Tone 7:* Truly dread and ineffable is the mystery wrought in thee, O Immaculate One! The Word Who is the Cause of all, above cause and word, being incarnate by the Holy Spirit, thou didst bear, taking flesh of thee, remaining unchangeably in His own nature; for when both came together subsistently in a single Hypostasis, twofold in nature He proceeds: perfect God and perfect man, manifest in both perfections by active properties; for having suffered upon the Cross in the flesh, He remained impassible in His Godhead; dying as man, as God He lived again on the third day, casting down the dominion of death, and delivering mankind from corruption. Him, as the Deliverer and Savior of our race, O Mother of God, do thou entreat, to send down upon us the great mercy of His tender compassions.[^7958]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light. Prokeimenon: "The Lord is King," three times. Vouchsafe, O Lord.*[^7959]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Resurrection Sticheron, Tone 7:* Risen from the tomb, O Savior of the world, Thou didst raise up men together with Thy flesh: O Lord, glory to Thee![^7960]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Most Holy Theotokos.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 7.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Tone 7, Podoben: "Having disregarded temporal things" (Неради́вше ѡ҆ вре́менныхъ):*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Thou wast the East of the noetic Sun, O Virgin, in the setting of our nature; but as thou hast boldness, entreat Him, O all-hymned Mother of God: to free our souls from immeasurable transgressions.[^7962]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Clearly didst thou bud forth, O Virgin, as a rod from the root of Jesse, which destroyed the plant of deceit from the root; but as thou hast boldness, unceasingly pray, O All-hymned One, to uproot the passions of my heart, and to plant therein His fear, and to save me.[^7964]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* O all-holy Gate of God! Deliver me from the gates of hades, and show me the path of repentance, turning away from which the gates lead unto life; O guide of the lost, preserve the race of faithful men, and save our souls.[^7966]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* From thee, O all-holy Virgin Mother of God, was Christ our God ineffably born, truly being the pre-eternal God and a new man: being on the one hand eternal, and on the other having become man for our sake; for by Himself He saves the property of each nature: on the one hand shining forth in miracles, and on the other confirming by passions. Therefore being one and the same, He both dies as man and rises as God; entreat Him, O pure unwedded One, that our souls may be saved.[^7967]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Then, Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion, and after Our Father: Troparion: "Thou didst shatter death by Thy Cross." Theotokion: "As the treasure of our resurrection." Litany and Dismissal.*[^7968]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *[Engraved Vignette: Small ornamental foliate tailpiece]*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," we set 10 verses, and sing Resurrection Stichera, Tone 7.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *(Composition of John of Damascus):*[^7969]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1 (Resurrectional):* Come, let us rejoice in the Lord, Who shattered the dominion of death and enlightened the human race, crying aloud with the Bodiless Powers: O our Creator and Savior, glory to Thee![^7970]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 (Resurrectional):* Thou didst endure the Cross and burial for our sake, O Savior, and by death, as God, Thou didst put death to death; therefore we worship Thy third-day Resurrection: O Lord, glory to Thee![^7971]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3 (Resurrectional):* Beholding the Resurrection of the Creator, the Apostles were astonished, singing the angelic praise: this is the glory of the Church, this is the richness of the Kingdom! O Thou Who didst suffer for our sake: O Lord, glory to Thee![^7972]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, Eastern (by Anatolius), in the same Tone:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* Even though Thou wast seized, O Christ, by lawless men, yet Thou art my God, and I am not ashamed; Thou wast struck upon the shoulders, and I deny Thee not; Thou wast nailed upon the Cross, and I conceal it not; in Thy Resurrection do I boast, for Thy death is my life. O Almighty Lord and Lover of mankind, glory to Thee![^7973]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5:* Fulfilling David's prophecy, Christ revealed His majesty in Zion unto the disciples, showing Himself praised and ever glorified, with the Father and the Holy Spirit: first indeed bodiless as the Word, and afterwards incarnate for our sake, and put to death as man, and risen with power as the Lover of mankind.[^7974]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 6:* Thou didst descend into hades, O Christ, even as Thou didst will; Thou didst overthrow death, as God and Master; and Thou didst rise on the third day, raising Adam with Thyself from the bonds of hades and corruption...[^7975]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: ...crying aloud and saying: Glory to Thy Resurrection, O only Lover of mankind![^7976]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 7:* Thou wast laid in the tomb as one asleep, O Lord, and Thou didst rise on the third day as mighty in strength, raising Adam with Thyself from mortal corruption, as Thou art Almighty.[^7977]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Most Holy Theotokos (by Paul of Amorium), Tone 7.*[^7978]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 8 (Theotokion 1):* Thou art the joy of Angels, thou art the glory of men, thou art the hope of the faithful, O all-hymned Lady, our protectress; and unto thee do we flee in every need, that by thy supplications we all who hymn thee, O Bride of God, may be delivered from the soul-destroying arrows of the enemy and from all afflictions.[^7979]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 9 (Theotokion 2):* Thou art my hope, O Mother of God, thou art my protectress, and a wall and a refuge, O all-hymned Lady, who didst bear God in the flesh without man, the Savior of the world; do thou by thy supplications deliver us from the temptations, dangers, and distresses that encompass us, O only refuge of Christians.[^7980]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 10 (Theotokion 3):* Subdue the surgings of my flesh, quench the flame of my passions, take away from me, O Mother of God, the wicked burning of my desire; and turn my stubborn habit, O Virgin, from every demonic impulse, that in quietness of heart and in dispassion of my soul I may hymn thee, the all-hymned.[^7981]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion (Dogmatikon):* Thou wast known as a Mother above nature, O Mother of God, yet thou didst remain a virgin above word and reason; and the wonder of thy childbirth no tongue can tell; for since thy conceiving was all-glorious, O Pure One, incomprehensible is the manner of thy giving birth; for where God wills, the order of nature is overcome. Therefore, knowing thee to be the Mother of God, we all pray thee fervently: entreat Him that our souls may be saved.[^7982]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light. Prokeimenon of the day, and the rest as usual.*[^7983]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Resurrection Stichera, Tone 7:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Risen from the tomb, O Savior of the world, Thou didst raise up men together with Thy flesh: O Lord, glory to Thee![^7984]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Come, let us worship Him Who rose from the dead and enlightened all things; for from the tyranny of hades He delivered us by His third-day Resurrection, granting us life and great mercy.[^7986]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Having descended into hades, O Christ, Thou didst lead captivity captive; and having risen on the third day, Thou didst raise us with Thyself, who glorify Thine all-powerful rising, O Lord and Lover of mankind.[^7988]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* Thou didst appear awesome, O Lord, lying in the tomb as one asleep; but having risen on the third day as mighty, Thou didst raise Adam with Thyself, who cried: Glory to Thy Resurrection, O only Lover of mankind![^7990]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* Beneath thy protection, O Lady, do all we earth-born flee, crying aloud unto thee: O Mother of God, our hope, deliver us from immeasurable transgressions, and save our souls.[^7991]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion, and after Our Father: we sing the Resurrectional Troparion, Tone 7:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Troparion, Tone 7:* Thou didst destroy death by Thy Cross, Thou didst open paradise to the thief, Thou didst change the weeping of the Myrrh-bearers, and didst command Thine Apostles to preach: that Thou art risen, O Christ God, granting unto the world great mercy.[^7992]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* As the treasure of our resurrection, O All-hymned One, lead up from the pit and the depth of transgressions those who hope in thee; for thou hast saved those guilty of sin, having given birth to our Salvation: who before childbirth wast a Virgin, and in childbirth a Virgin, and after childbirth still remainest a Virgin.[^7993]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *[Engraved Vignette: Ornamental foliate divider]*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 7.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Unto Him Who shattered warfare with His arm, and submerged the three-tiered chariot riders, let us sing as unto our Deliverer God, for He hath been glorified.[^7994]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^7995]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As an adornment with singing, and a God-befitting song of thanksgiving, we bring gifts unto thee: the "Rejoice," now, O Pure One, for from sorrow thou hast bestowed joy upon us.[^7996]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The grace of thy mercy and the strength of thy protection we will not keep silent, O most pure Virgin; for from cruel distresses thou hast saved us.[^7997]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкѡ по́двиги показꙋ́юще, побѣ́ды вѣнцы̀ прїѧ́сте, мꙋ́ченици
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having been delivered from various temptations and afflictions by thy maternal prayers, O Most Pure One, with one accord and fervently we all sing songs of thanksgiving unto thee.[^7998]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Въ Сꙋббѡ́тꙋ на Повече́ріи, Гла́съ з҃.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Variously adorned with fringes, as with golden virtues and with the graces of the Spirit, O Most Pure One, having adorned thyself as the Bride of the Father, thou hast truly been shown forth as the Mother of God.[^7999]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ра́снами и҆спещре́на, ꙗ҆́кѡ златы́ми добродѣ́тельми, и҆ Дх҃а благода́тьми, Пречи́стаѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ невѣ́ста О҆́тча ᲂу҆краси́вшисѧ, вои́стинꙋ ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ Ма́ти Бг҃а.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Lord and Savior, Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens by Thy all-powerful Word, and all the host thereof by the all-effecting and Divine Spirit: establish me upon the unshakable rock of the confession of Thee.[^8000]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Въ нача́тцѣхъ небеса̀, всеси́льнымъ Сло́вомъ твои́мъ ᲂу҆твержде́й Гдⷭᵎи Спа́се, и҆ вседѣ́тельнымъ и҆ Бж҃їимъ Дх҃омъ, всю̀ си́лꙋ и҆́хъ: на недвижи́момъ мѧ̀ ка́мени и҆сповѣ́данїѧ твоегѡ̀ ᲂу҆твердѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Diligently do we offer voices of thanksgiving unto the majesty of divine joy, as unto the cause of our gladness from the beginning, honoring her as our protectress.[^8001]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дости бж҃твенныѧ вели́чїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ нача́ла на́мъ весе́лїю, благодаре́нїѧ гла́сы прино́симъ прилѣ́жнѡ, почита́юще ю҆̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ предста́тельницꙋ на́шꙋ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having been delivered from distresses through thee, and having obtained joy for thy sake, O unwedded Mother, we all glorify thee as the good bestower and lauded protectress.[^8002]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же тобо́ю и҆зба́вльшесѧ ѿ бѣ́дъ, и҆ тебѐ ра́ди ра́дость полꙋчи́вше, Ма́ти безневѣ́стнаѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ пода́тельницꙋ благꙋ́ю, и҆ застꙋ́пницꙋ благохва́льнꙋ, всѝ прослаблѧ́емъ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Receiving the transformation of our transgressions and adversities through thy divine prayer, O Mother of Christ God, we faithfully hymn Thee with thankful voices, as the cause of good things.[^8003]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: И҆змѣне́нїе прегрѣше́нїй и҆ напа́стей, бж҃твенною твое́ю моли́твою прїе́млюще, Ма́ти Хрⷭᵎта̀ Бг҃а, ꙗ҆́кѡ винꙋ̀ благи́хъ воспѣва́емъ тѧ̀ вѣ́рнѡ, благода́рными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Both now:* She who is the fountain of joy ever pours forth streams of immortality, and herself saves all, as an ever-living thanksgiving unto us, the Mother of Christ God.[^8004]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́же ра́дости и҆сто́чникъ, безсме́ртныѧ то́читъ стрꙋи̑ при́снѡ, и҆ спаса́етъ всѣ́хъ сама̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ присножи́зненное на́мъ благода́нїе, Ма́ти Хрⷭᵎта̀ Бг҃а.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* The virtue of Thine ineffable wisdom, O Christ God, hath covered the heavens by Thy dispensation, O Lover of mankind.[^8005]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Покры́ла є҆́сть небеса̀ Хрⷭᵎтѐ Бж҃е смотре́нїемъ твои́мъ, добродѣ́тель неизрече́нныѧ мꙋ́дрости твоеѧ̀, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Rejoicing, we offer unto thee a worthy song of rejoicing, O pure Virgin, having been delivered from distresses by thy prayers.[^8006]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йнꙋ тебѣ̀ пѣ́снь ра́дованїѧ, чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, весе́лѧщесѧ прино́симъ, и҆зба́вльшесѧ ѿ бѣ́дъ твои́ми моли́твами.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With thanksgiving, O pure Virgin, we bring forth a hymn unto thee with hands of the soul, leaping for joy with divine songs, having been delivered from much sorrow.[^8007]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Благода́рственно тебѣ̀ Дѣ́во чи́стаѧ, дꙋше́вныма рꙋка́ма вно́симъ пѣ́нїе, бж҃е́ственными пѣ́сньми и҆гра́юще, ѿ печа́ли и҆зба́вльшесѧ мно́гїѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Passionate sins have raised up many distresses against us; but by thy divine protection, O Pure One, deliver us.[^8008]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Воздвиго́ша на ны̀ бѣды̑ мнѡ́ги стра́стнїи грѣсѝ; но бж҃е́ственнымъ твои́мъ покро́вомъ, Чи́стаѧ, на́съ и҆зба́ви.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Blessed truly are they that honor thee, O most pure Mother of God, for through thee have we been delivered from sin and sorrow.[^8009]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Блаже́ни вои́стинꙋ чтꙋ́щїи тѧ̀, Бцⷣе пречи́стаѧ: ꙗ҆́ко тобо́ю грѣха̀ и҆ печа́ли и҆зба́вихомсѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Night without light is unto the unbelieving, O Christ, but illumination unto the faithful in the sweetness of Thy words; therefore I rise early at dawn unto Thee, and hymn Thy Divinity.[^8010]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Но́щь несвѣ́тла невѣ́рнымъ Хрⷭᵎтѐ, вѣ̑рнымъ же просвѣще́нїе въ сла́дости слове́съ твои́хъ: сегѡ̀ ра́ди къ тебѣ̀ ᲂу҆́треннюю, и҆ воспѣва́ю твоѐ Божество̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst give birth, O Virgin, unto Christ the consumer of sin, by Whom the world was saved from adversities and sicknesses;...[^8011]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: ...therefore, "Rejoice!" we also cry unto thee, having been delivered from sorrows.[^8012]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Encompassed by various adversities, O pure Sovereign Lady, and by sorrow and affliction and grievous circumstance, in our despair we found thee as the hope of gladness.[^8013]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Glory:* As a treasury of salvation for us thy servants, O Pure One, thou drivest away adversities and keepest us unharmed; therefore, partakers of thy many good things, we thank thee with songs.[^8014]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Both now:* We thank thee, having been delivered through thee from many sins, and weaknesses and sicknesses, and grievous ailments, O most pure Sovereign Lady; for thou art a steadfast hope unto thy faithful servants.[^8015]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Fallen into the depth of sins, O Good One, as Jonah from the sea monster I cry aloud unto Thee: Lead up my life from corruption, and save me, O Lover of mankind.[^8016]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Angelic tongues cannot worthily sing thy praises, O Pure One; yet we now, undertaking as servants, bring Gabriel's greeting unto thee.[^8017]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having fallen into the depth of sorrow and tribulation through our sins, we have been delivered through thee from distress and adversities, O Virgin, pure Mother of God.[^8018]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Glory:* The whole world hath been made debtor, O Pure One, to give thanks, and praise, and piously glorify thy grace; for through thee have we been delivered from perils and sorrows.[^8019]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Both now:* Both in night and in day, openly and in secret, we who faithfully glorify thee flee beneath thy protection, O most pure Virgin.[^8020]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Lord, have mercy, three times. Glory... both now...*[^8021]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 7:* O Lord, we are Thy people, and the sheep of Thy pasture: as a Shepherd turn us who have gone astray; gather us who have been scattered by corruption; have mercy on Thy flock, O Lover of mankind; have compassion on Thy people, through the prayers of the Mother of God, O Thou Who alone art without sin.[^8022]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Cast into the fiery furnace, the venerable Children turned the fire into dew, crying aloud thus with singing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.[^8023]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A thankful rejoicing do we bring unto thee, O Mother of God, for truly through thee have we been delivered from every evil undertaking; and with one accord we sing unto thee: Blessed art thou.[^8024]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* At evening we took up our abode in weeping of sorrows, and in expectation of evils: but by thy God-befitting shelter, O Virgin, having been deified, we found joy in the morning; for thou hast saved us.[^8025]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Glory:* Having all acquired thy protection toward God as a divine refuge, in adversities and persecutions and sins we flee unto thee, and through thee receive transformation, O Most Pure One.[^8026]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Both now:* The grace of thy prayer, O Pure One, we proclaim with lips and with spirit, O Glorious One: for for thy sake are we all delivered from adversities and tempest and grievous sorrows, and the passions of sin.[^8027]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Him Who is awesome unto the Cherubim, and marvelous unto the Seraphim, and the Creator of the world: ye priests and servants, and spirits of the righteous, sing, bless, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^8028]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having been delivered from the tempest of sin, and from passions, and from adversities by thy prayers, O good Mother of God, with a thankful voice we cry aloud unto thee: "Rejoice!" for through thee have we passed from sorrow into joy.[^8029]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Despise not those held fast in sicknesses and adversities, O Good One: but giving ear unto our poor supplication, free us from great afflictions, that we may faithfully hymn thy mercy, O Pure One.[^8030]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Glory:* O cause of the dissolution of transgressions, raise us up now from sorrows, adversities, and passions of men, and from unseemly temptation; and by thy divine supplications, O Mother of God, most gloriously deliver us from them.[^8031]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Both now:* Thy compassions are ever sent down upon all, O Christ, truly by grace and by the supplications of her that bare Thee; for from Thee, O merciful Savior, do we Christians receive Thy mercy.[^8032]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Her that is a Mother above nature, and a Virgin according to nature, the only blessed one among women, let us the faithful magnify with songs as the Mother of God.[^8033]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A worthy rejoicing, with a voice of acclamation, do we now offer unto thee, O Virgin, with the Angel...[^8034]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: ...Gabriel, having been delivered from various temptations, O Mother of God, by thy prayers.[^8035]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Divine joy and gladness and exultation, O Virgin that knewest not man, hath multiplied unto us from God; for lo, we who weep grievously rejoice by thy prayers.[^8036]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Glory:* I will sacrifice a sacrifice of praise, and with tongue and voice diligently render a song of thanksgiving unto thee, O Virgin, that praying unto thee, I may be delivered through thee in the day of affliction.[^8037]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Both now:* We piously rejoice together, O Most Pure One, in thy divine Childbearing; for thou hast gushed forth joy for us from adversities and sorrows. Therefore unto thee do we also thankfully accomplish a hymn, faithfully praising thee.[^8038]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Trisagion Prayers, Our Father: Troparia and the rest.*[^8039]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *On Sunday Morning at the Midnight Office.*[^8040]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity. (The acrostic whereof is: I praise the Trinity, the monarchical nature.) A composition of Metrophanes.*[^8041]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Tone 7. Ode 1. Heirmos:* By Thy nod the watery nature, formerly flowing easily, was transformed into dry land, O Lord. Therefore Israel, having journeyed on foot dry-shod, sings unto Thee a song of victory.[^8042]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Trinity our God, glory to Thee.*[^8043]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Open Thou the noetic mouth of my heart, and my material lips unto Thy praise, O thrice-radiant single Godhead of all: to sing unto Thee, O Author of Light, a song of thanksgiving.[^8044]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* That Thou mightest show forth the superabundant riches of Thy goodness, O Trinity of immeasurable power, Thou didst create man, an earthly image of Thy sovereign Lordship, O Creator.[^8045]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Unoriginate Mind, Who didst beget the co-ever-existing Word, and didst cause to shine forth the co-unoriginate Spirit: vouchsafe us to worship conformably the One God by essence, in three Hypostases.[^8046]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst appear unto Moses at the bush, O Word of God, as a cleansing fire that consumed not at all, prefiguring Thine incarnation, whereby Thou didst fashion men anew.[^8047]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Lord and Savior, Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens by Thy all-powerful Word, and all the host thereof by the all-effecting and Divine Spirit: establish me upon the unshakable rock of the confession of Thee...[^8048]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: ...and all the host thereof by the all-effecting and Divine Spirit: establish me upon the unshakable rock of the confession of Thee.[^8049]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Hymning Thee, the single, thrice-radiant, and all-effecting Master, we ask deliverance from sins and temptations, O God of immeasurable power: therefore despise not those who praise Thy goodness in faith.[^8050]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* A branch hath appeared from the Father, as from an unoriginate root, God the Word, equal in power with the co-sprouting and Divine Spirit; and therefore we the faithful glorify the one Lordship in threefold Persons.[^8051]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Equally glorified and co-growing, the tri-hypostatic nature, undividedly and dividedly, and the monarchical Trinity, all we faithful praise, and bowing down we ask forgiveness of transgressions.[^8052]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Unchangeably likened unto men in all things, O Word of God, Thou didst manifestly come forth from the pure Maiden; and Thou hast shown unto all the Godhead thrice-radiant, single in essence, of unchangeable Hypostases.[^8053]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Lord, have mercy, three times.*[^8054]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: Have mercy on Thy servants who have sinned, O Holy Trinity; and receive those who repent unto Thee, O Tender-hearted One, and vouchsafe forgiveness.[^8055]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* Sweeten our souls embittered by sins, O all-pure Mother of God, and deliver from transgressions those who hymn thee, O Bride of God.[^8056]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Leaving not the Father's bosom, and having descended to earth, O Christ God: I have heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I have glorified Thee, O only Lover of mankind.[^8057]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O all-holding, thrice-radiant Monad, origin of Godhead, and Savior of all: protect now Thy singers, and save from sorrow and passions, and from every affliction.[^8058]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Being in perplexity at significant words concerning Thine incomprehensible thrice-radiant Godhead, we hymn Thee, O Lord Lover of mankind, and we glorify Thy power.[^8059]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* On earth as in heaven with the bodiless choirs, O Monad and Trinity, undividedly do we divide Thee, and with love we glorify Thee, as exercising lordship over all that exist.[^8060]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Not departing from the paternal glory, Thou didst descend unto our lowliness...[^8061]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: ...willingly, being incarnate, O Super-essential One; and Thou hast raised us up unto divine glory, as Thou art tender-hearted.[^8062]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Night without light is unto the unbelieving, O Christ, but illumination unto the faithful in the sweetness of Thy words; therefore I rise early at dawn unto Thee, and hymn Thy Divinity.[^8063]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Nature source of light, Trinity in hypostatic forms, and Monad in counsel, and glory, and honor: establish us in Thy love. *(Twice)*[^8064]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Glorifying Mind, and Word, and Spirit, one divine origin and thrice-sunned nature, we ask to be delivered from temptations and all sorrows.[^8065]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having taken form in human nature, O Word of God, from the holy Virgin, Thou didst teach us to sing of the Trinity in Unity, of the same image and co-enthroned.[^8066]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Sailing in the surge of worldly cares, engulfed with my ship by sins, and cast forth unto the soul-corrupting beast, as Jonah, O Christ, I cry aloud unto Thee: From the deadly depth lead me up.[^8067]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The equally-glorious dominion and monarchical Godhead, existing in three Hypostases, we unchangeably glorify one with another, having distinction only by the existence of each property. *(Twice)*[^8068]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The noetic ranks of Angelic splendors praise Thee, O thrice-sunned Godhead; with whom we also with mortal lips sing of Thee as the Creator of all, One, and faithfully glorify Thee.[^8069]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* By an incomprehensible word, the Word begotten of the Sun the Father, another Sun before the ages, in the last times shone forth from the Virgin, and proclaimed the One God in three Persons, past finding out.[^8070]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: O consubstantial Trinity, tri-hypostatic Monad! Have mercy on those whom Thou hast created, O Immortal One! consuming the wickednesses of those who sin, and enlightening the hearts of those who hymn Thy tender compassion: O our God, glory to Thee![^8071]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* Brighter than fire, more effectual than light is the mercy of thy grace, O Sovereign Lady, consuming the sins of men, and bedewing the thoughts of those who praise...[^8072]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: ...thy majesties, O all-blameless Mother of God.[^8073]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Cast into the fiery furnace, the venerable Children turned the fire into dew by singing, crying aloud thus: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.[^8074]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Ever shining with light-beaming flashes, O thrice-radiant God, unapproachable and super-essential Monad: save those who piously believe in Thee, O Master, and bow down before Thee.[^8075]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Submitting unto the saying of the divine Prophets, we glorify Thee alone, the God of all in three characters, crying aloud thus: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.[^8076]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* With mortal lips we, together with the immaterial ranks, sing of Thee with songs, O Holy Trinity, in unity of essence, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.[^8077]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* That He Who fashioned Adam might refashion him again, O All-pure One, He manifestly became man from thee, deifying men, who cry aloud thus: Blessed, O Most Pure One, is the fruit of thy womb.[^8078]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The bush unconsumed by fire that had communion on Sinai revealed God unto Moses slow of speech and stammering; and zeal for God showed forth the three invincible Children as singers in the fire: All ye works of the Lord, sing the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^8079]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Vouchsafe the hearts of Thy singers to be illuminated with light-effecting rays of the thrice-radiant Sun; and grant now ever to behold Thy beauty, O Trinity, O Monad, as is possible, unto all who with fitting faith sing of Thy majesty unto all ages.[^8080]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O threefold and single unoriginate Lordly Dominion, Thou upholdest all things, and rulest heaven and earth; therefore keep me ever drawn by Thy love, to sing unto Thee: All ye works of the Lord, sing the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^8081]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Make me a temple of Thy thrice-radiant splendor, O Benefactor and Lover of mankind; and show me unapproachable to invisible enemies and to fleshly passions by communion and partaking, O Master, my monarchical God and Lord of glory, to sing of Thee unto all ages...[^8082]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: ...O my monarchical God and Lord of glory, to sing of Thee unto all ages.[^8083]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The God-originating Light, having shone forth from thy womb, O all-pure Mother of God, illuminated the whole world with thrice-sunned light, and showed the earth to be as another heaven, singing: All ye works of the Lord, sing the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^8084]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Mother of God and Virgin, who gavest birth and still remainest virgin: this is not a work of nature, but of God's condescension; therefore, as her who alone wast accounted worthy of God's wonders, we magnify thee ever.[^8085]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* To speak sublime words and worthily sing of Thee, Whom the Seraphim in the highest unceasingly hymn, we mortals are unable; yet taking courage as before the Master of all and most man-befriending God, we magnify Thee.[^8086]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Deliver Thy singers from bodily sicknesses and spiritual passionate attachment, O single undivided Trinity; and vouchsafe us to be preserved unharmed from all worldly temptations.[^8087]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O equal in power, origin of Godhead, thrice-radiant, all-powerful dominion, unchangeable beauty of essential goodness: grant forgiveness of transgressions unto Thy servants, and deliver from temptations and passions.[^8088]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having received mind and soul and fleshly commingling from thy most pure womb, O Mother of God, God the Word truly appeared as man; and He manifestly showed man to be a partaker of the Divine nature.[^8089]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *After this, the refrains of Gregory of Sinai: It is truly meet: and the rest.*[^8090]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *At Matins:*[^8091]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *After the Six Psalms: "God is the Lord," and hath appeared unto us: in Tone 7; and we say the Resurrectional Troparion: "Thou didst destroy death by Thy Cross": twice. Glory: to the Saint, from the Menaion. Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion of the same Tone as the troparion of the Saint. Then the usual stichology of the Psalter.*[^8092]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: *After the First Stichology, Resurrectional Sessional Hymns, Tone 7:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: When the tomb was sealed, Thou, O Christ God, the Life, didst shine forth from the tomb; and while the doors were shut, Thou, the Resurrection of all, didst stand before the disciples, through them renewing an upright spirit in us, according to Thy great mercy.[^8093]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
items.english_text: By Thy three-day burial having despoiled death, and corrupt...[^8095]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^7740]
items.slavonic_text: Грѣха̀ потреби́телѧ Хрⷭᵎта̀, Дѣ́во, родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѿ напа́стей и҆ болѣ́зней спасе́сѧ мі́ръ;
