items.english_text: *On Monday, the Beatitudes, Tone 7.*[^8453]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^8255]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Fair was the fruit that put me to death, and good for food; but Christ is the Tree of Life, of Which eating I die not, but cry aloud with the thief: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy kingdom [cf. Gen. 3:6; Luke 23:42].[^8454]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^8255]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Even as the faithful Canaanite woman, I cry in the sickness of my heart: Have mercy on me, O Savior, as Thou art good; for I have a soul suffering distress by all manner of enemy wiles, and ever tempest-tossed [cf. Matt. 15:22].[^8455]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^8255]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Cherubim and Seraphim, and Thrones, Principalities, and Powers ever, Archangels, armies of Angels, and Dominions, and the assemblies of the all-wise Authorities, glorify Thee, O Benefactor and Lord.[^8456]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^8255]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Martyrion:* Being elevated unto God, the Sufferers utterly cast down the wicked exaltations of the enemy; and having been shown forth as victors, they now dwell with joy in the heavens, radiant with incorruptible glory.[^8457]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^8255]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Glory... Triadikon:* I worship the unoriginate Father, with the Son and the Spirit, the uncreated Essence and Nature, Who beneficially created all things from non-being, Which is the Trinity and is known as the Unity.[^8458]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^8255]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* I have defiled myself with worldly pleasures; unto thee the undefiled have I fled, O Virgin: from every blemish and transgression deliver my all-wretched soul, that I may call thee blessed, who art ever-blessed.[^8459]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *On Monday Evening.*[^8461]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 7.*[^8462]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* O Master and all-merciful God, by whatever judgments Thou knowest, grant me to have Thy fear in my heart; grant me to abhor the deeds of the evil one; grant me to love Thee with all my soul, and to do Thy saving will; for Thou art our God, Who didst say: Ask, and ye shall receive [cf. Matt. 7:7].[^8464]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* I became indeed a laughingstock unto demons, and an abasement unto men, a lamentation unto the righteous, and a weeping unto Angels, a defilement unto the air, and unto the earth and waters; for I befouled my body, and defiled soul and mind with countless deeds, and became an enemy of God. Woe is me, O Lord! I have sinned against Thee, I have sinned, forgive me.[^8465]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* I pray Thee, be long-suffering toward me who am barren, O Master! And cut me not down as a barren tree by the cutting of death, sending me into the fire; but be entreated to make me fruitful, granting me time for repentance as the Lover of mankind, that I may wash away, O Christ my Savior, my many sins.[^8466]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Then the Stichera from the Menaion for the Saint. Glory... to the Saint. Both now... Theotokion of the Tone. But if there is no Menaion:*[^8467]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Holy Prophet and Forerunner John, Tone 7.*[^8468]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* O thou who didst live a blameless life in the wilderness: renew my mind, which is desolate with sins, O Forerunner.[^8469]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Knowing thee to be the most beauteous turtledove, O Prophet, we glorify thee, who didst proclaim the divine spring unto those in the world.[^8470]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* O protector of my life, guardian of my soul, divine Forerunner: deliver me, thy servant, from the deceitful tongue of man.[^8471]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Rejoice, O Pure One, honorable wealth of virginity! Rejoice, O Honorable One, divine adornment! Rejoice, O Virgin, salvation of the faithful! Rejoice, O Sovereign Lady, Bride unwedded![^8472]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light: and the rest.*[^8473]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 7.*[^8474]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* As the prodigal son, I have come, O Tender-hearted One...[^8475]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: ...receive me who fall down, as one of Thy hired servants, O God, and have mercy on me, O Lover of mankind [cf. Luke 15:19].[^8476]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* As he that fell among thieves and was wounded, so also have I fallen through many sins, and my soul is wounded; unto whom shall I flee, guilty that I am? Only unto Thee, the tender-hearted Physician of souls: pour out upon me, O God, Thy great mercy [cf. Luke 10:30–35].[^8478]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Martyrion:* Holy Martyrs, who have suffered well and received crowns: pray ye unto the Lord, that our souls may be saved.[^8480]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Rejoice, O cloud of the noetic and ineffable Sun, O Sovereign Lady! Rejoice, all-radiant torch! Rejoice, all-golden lampstand: through thee, O All-holy One, was Eve delivered from the curse. But as thou hast boldness toward thy Son and God Who is easily reconciled: by thy maternal prayer, fail not to pray, O Most-pure One.[^8481]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparion, Litany, and Dismissal.*[^8482]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *On Monday at Small Compline.*[^8483]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Supplicatory Canon to the Most Holy Mother of God, Tone 7. Ode 1. Heirmos:*[^8484] Unto Him Who crushed wars by His arm, and drowned the captains of the chariots, let us sing as unto our Redeemer and God, for He hath been glorified [cf. Exod. 15:3–4].[^8485]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Mother of God, save us.*[^8486]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thee, the cause of our salvation and divine redemption, do we entreat, O Most-pure One: pray that we may be saved.[^8487]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I am wholly in cruel temptations, in afflictions and transgressions; I cry unto thee, O Most-pure One: save me, thy servant.[^8488]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Glory...* Thee, the pure Virgin and Mother of the Creator, do we entreat: deliver us from every maltreatment of demons.[^8489]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Both now...* O thou who didst bear the Word in the flesh beyond word, Christ the Author of life and our God: pray that we may be saved.[^8490]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:*[^8491] The Church of Christ is established in faith; for unceasingly with songs she cries aloud, singing: Holy art Thou, O Lord, and my spirit hymns Thee![^8492]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Walking along the path of all-destructive malice, I found not the way of my salvation: direct me unto it, O all-blameless Sovereign Lady.[^8493]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thee alone do I write down as my strength, and establishment, and help, and hope, O All-immaculate One: be thou an intercessor for me in the day of my departure.[^8494]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Glory...* I ever pray thee, O All-immaculate One: in the hour of my death stand by me, and deliver thy servant from torment.[^8495]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Thou wast born of the Virgin ineffably, Thou wast manifested as our Savior, and didst renew the world, O Lord.[^8496]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:*[^8497] I have heard Thy report, and was afraid; I understood Thy works, and was filled with dread, O Lord [cf. Hab. 3:2].[^8498]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having transgressed the commandments of my Master, I was easily held fast by the enemy: do thou deliver me, O Sovereign Lady.[^8499]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In the hour of death deliver me, O Most-pure One, and save my passionate soul from demons.[^8500]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Glory...* Loose, O most pure Sovereign Lady, the bonds of my transgressions, and be an advocate unto eternal life for me through thy prayers.[^8501]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Both now...* We hymn thee as Virgin again after childbearing, and glorify thee, O Most-pure One, as the Mother of our God.[^8502]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:*[^8503] Rising early at dawn, O Word, unto Thy glory and praise, we unceasingly praise the form of Thy Cross, which Thou hast given unto us as a weapon unto help.[^8504]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O haven for those tempest-tossed in a cruel storm, door of salvation for those saved by faith, O good Virgin: save me, thy servant.[^8505]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thy many tender mercies, O Virgin Mother of God, manifest richly upon me, thy servant, delivering me from the fearful and coming judgment.[^8506]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Glory...* The unstable night of passions holds fast my soul, and dispatches it unto the pit of destruction; by the light of thy prayer, O Mother of God, save me, thy servant.[^8507]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Both now...* O all-holy Virgin full of grace, who didst bear the Word in time beyond...[^8508]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: ...word: pray Him to save our souls.[^8509]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:*[^8510] Jonah cried aloud from the belly of hades: Lead up my life from corruption; and we cry aloud unto Thee: O all-powerful Savior, have mercy on us [cf. Jonah 2:3, 7].[^8511]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* In temptations we have thee as a firm protectress, in tribulations a strong salvation, rest in sorrows, help in distresses, O Ever-virgin.[^8512]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Show thyself unto me as guardian in this life, O Most-pure One; deliver me from demons in the hour of death; and after death give me rest.[^8513]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Glory...* Thou art the beauty of the honorable and holy Angels, the joy of all men, O Virgin Mother of God: direct me unto life.[^8514]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Heal, O All-immaculate One, my wretched soul, incurably sick with the deceits of life and with the shutting of many doors.[^8515]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Then: Lord, have mercy (40 times). Glory... Both now...*[^8516]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 7:*[^8517] For the tender-heartedness of Thy mercy, O Christ God, Thou wast pleased to be incarnate of the Holy Virgin; for her sake preserve our life, as Thou art the Lover of mankind.[^8518]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:*[^8519] Thou didst bedew the burning furnace, O Savior, and didst save the Children who sang and said: Blessed art Thou unto ages, O Lord God of our fathers [cf. Dan. 3:26, 50].[^8520]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Considering the multitude of my transgressions, I fall into despair, O all-blameless Virgin! Therefore I cry unto thee: Help me, that I perish not utterly.[^8521]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Knowing thee to be the Mother of Life, O Pure One, I cry unto thee: Deliver me from the death of the soul, and account me worthy of eternal life.[^8522]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Glory...* Deliver, O All-immaculate One, from afflictions, and passions, and diseases, and maltreatment, and from the sins of this life, and from the unquenchable eternal fire, those who faithfully honor thee with songs.[^8523]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Every tongue glorifies thee, O Pure One, who art the glory and praise of our race, and the guide of the errant, O all-hymned Mother of God.[^8524]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:*[^8525] Him Who is fearful unto the Cherubim, and marvelous unto the Seraphim, and the Creator of the world: ye priests, and servants, and spirits of the righteous, praise, bless, and highly exalt Him unto all ages [cf. Dan. 3:56–57].[^8526]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* All my life have I spent in laziness, wretch that I am, and now I am at a loss, and have drawn near unto the end: help me, O Sovereign Lady.[^8527]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou art the refuge of sinners, the correction of the fallen, O Sovereign Lady: therefore do I flee unto thy protection; save me.[^8528]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Glory...* As thou hast sleepless prayer, O all-blameless Sovereign Lady of the world: deliver from the coming judgment those who honor thine icon with faith.[^8529]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Every tongue sings thy glory, for thou didst bear the all-hymned God, O Virgin Bride of God! Him unceasingly pray, that the souls of those who hymn thee may be saved.[^8530]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:*[^8531] The Mother beyond nature, and Virgin by nature, alone blessed among women: with songs, ye faithful, we magnify the Mother of God.[^8532]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* They who flee with faith beneath thy tender mercy are delivered from the grievous afflictions of this life; therefore have I also fled unto thy protection, O Mother of God.[^8533]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O strong protectress, invincible rampart of the sorrowful, O Pure One: save me from the passions of sins, and from the eternal fire.[^8534]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Glory...* With the bright splendors of the Word Who shone forth from thee, O pure Virgin, enlighten me and save me as thou art good, and snatch me from torments.[^8535]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Thou carriest in thy holy arms Him Who upholds all things: Him entreat, O Pure One, that we who are not held fast by the enemy's malice may be saved.[^8536]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparia and the rest as usual.*[^8537]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *On Tuesday at Matins.*[^8538]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *After the 1st Stichologia, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 7.*[^8539]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, ро́ждшꙋю престо́е Сло́во, є҆го́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ воспѣва́ютъ немо́лчными гла́сы.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Having the medicine of repentance, O my soul, draw near falling down, and calling aloud with sighing unto the Physician of souls and bodies: Liberate me, O Lover of mankind, from my many transgressions; number me with the harlot, and the thief, and the publican, and grant me, O God, the forgiveness of mine iniquities, and save me.[^8540]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Петро́во ѿверже́ніе слеза́ми ѡ҆чи́стивъ, и҆ мытаре́ва согрѣше́нїѧ воздыха́нїемъ прости́въ, человѣколю́бче Гдⷭ҇и, поми́луй мѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* O Lord and Lover of mankind, Who by tears didst cleanse Peter's denial, and by sighing didst forgive the publican's transgressions: have mercy on me.[^8542]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дуйсѧ Невмѣсти́маго въ небесѣ́хъ, вмѣсти́вшаѧ въ оу҆тро́бѣ твое́й. Ра́дуйсѧ Дѣ́во, проро́кѡвъ проповѣ́даніе, є҆́юже возсїѧ̀ Е҆мманꙋ́илъ. Ра́дуйсѧ Ма́ти Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Rejoice, thou who didst contain in thy womb Him Whom the heavens cannot contain! Rejoice, O Virgin, the proclamation of the prophets, through whom Emmanuel shone forth! Rejoice, O Mother of Christ God![^8543]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Мытаре́вꙋ покаѧ́нію не поревнова́хъ, блꙋдни́цы сле́зъ не стѧжа́хъ; ѿчаѧва́юсѧ бо ѿ недоꙋмѣ́нїа такова́гѡ и҆справле́нїа: но твои́мъ благоꙋтро́бїемъ спаси́ мѧ Бж҃е, ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣколю́бецъ.
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Stichologia, Sessional Hymns, Tone 7.*[^8544]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Гдⷭ҇и, да не ꙗ҆́ростію твое́ю ѡ҆бличи́ши менѐ, нижѐ гнѣ́вомъ твои́мъ нака́жеши менѐ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* I have not emulated the repentance of the publican, nor have I acquired the tears of the harlot; for I fall into despair from the perplexity of such amendment: yet by Thy tender compassion save me, O God, as Thou art the Lover of mankind.[^8545]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же блꙋдни́цы сле́зы, и҆ Петра̀ прїе́мый, и҆ мытарѧ̀ ѡ҆правда́вый, и҆зъ глубины̀ воздохнꙋ́вша, и҆ менѐ ѿча́ѧннаго ѿ дѣ́лъ оу҆ще́дри Спа́се, и҆ спаси́ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* O Savior, Who didst accept the tears of the harlot and of Peter, and didst justify the publican who sighed from the depths: have compassion also upon me, who am in despair because of my deeds, and save me.[^8547]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ въ ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having contended on earth, O Lord, Thy Saints trampled down the enemy and abolished the idolatrous deceit; therefore they also received crowns from Thee, the Master and Lover of mankind, the merciful God, Who grantest great mercy unto the world.[^8549]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃і́и твоѝ Гдⷭ҇и, на землѝ подви́гшесѧ, врага̀ попра́ша, и҆ ле́сть і҆́дѡлскꙋю оу҆праздни́ша; тѣ́мже и҆ вѣнцы̀ ѿ тебѐ прїѧ́ша человѣколю́бца Влады́ки и҆ ми́лостивагѡ Бг҃а, подаю́щагѡ мі́рови ве́лію ми́лость.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* As thou hast compassion for our lowliness, and coverest the people who are in distress upon earth: be compassionate, O blessed Mother of God; abide in prayer that we perish not grievously; as thou art pure, entreat the propitious God, O most holy Virgin, to save our souls.[^8550]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆мꙋ́щаѧ сострада́тельство къ смире́нію на́шемꙋ, и҆ покрыва́юща сꙋ́щїа на землѝ въ ѡ҆бстоѧ́ніи лю́ди, оу҆милосе́рдисѧ благослове́ннаѧ Бцⷣе: пребꙋ́ди молѧ́щисѧ, да не поги́бнемъ лю́тѣ; молѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ пречи́стаѧ благоꙋвѣ́тливаго Бг҃а, спастѝ дꙋ́ши на́шѧ, прест҃а́ѧ Дѣ́во.
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Stichologia, Sessional Hymns, Tone 7.*[^8551]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋдни́ца припа́даю тебѣ̀ Человѣколю́бче, а҆́ще и҆ слеза́ми ве́сь недоꙋмѣ́юсѧ къ оу҆миле́нію: моли́твами Предте́чи ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆нꙋ̀ оу҆милѝ Ми́лостиве, и҆ спаси́ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Even as the harlot I fall down before Thee, O Lover of mankind, though in tears I am altogether at a loss for compunction: by the prayers of the Forerunner, pity me even as her, O Merciful One, and save me.[^8553]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭ҇и, скве́рнꙋ дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀, ми́лости твоеѧ̀ ѵ҆ссѡ́помъ, оу҆ми́лостивисѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ бла́гъ ѡ҆мы́й, Спа́се: и҆ ѡ҆чи́стивъ ѿ скве́рны тимѣ́нїа страсте́й, поми́лꙋй мѧ Влады́ко: спасѝ созда́ніе твоѐ, мольба́ми Предте́чи твоегѡ̀, є҆ди́не Многоми́лостиве.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* O Lord, with the hyssop of Thy mercy be compassionate, and wash away the filth of my soul as Thou art good, O Savior; and having cleansed me from the filth of the mire of passions, have mercy on me, O Master: save Thine own creation through the supplications of Thy Forerunner, O Thou Who alone art abundant in mercy.[^8554]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Thou art the fervent protectress and defender of Christians, O all-hymned Mother of God; there-...[^8555]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: ...fore, together with the Forerunner, pray Thy Son that we may find mercy.[^8556]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to His Holy Martyrs. By Joseph.*[^8557]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Tone 7. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Unto Him Who with His arm crushed battles and drowned the chariot-captains, let us sing, as unto our Deliverer and God, for He hath been glorified [cf. Exod. 15:1, 4].[^8558]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*[^8559]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I ever sin, and fear Thee not, O Christ, Who in long-suffering seekest my repentance: grant me a thought of conversion, as Thou art good, and despise me not.[^8560]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Adding sins unto sins, O Christ, I, wretched one, in no wise cease: O Thou Who alone art Good and sinless, have compassion on me and save me.[^8561]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Boldly the valiant sufferers cried aloud: Behold the arena filled with contests! Let us run: Christ the Master of the contest sits as president, crowning the victors over the enemy![^8562]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Ye stripped off the body by manifold wounds, and were clothed with the robe of incorruption, O wise Martyrs, and became sons of the Father of compassions.[^8563]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Heal my soul, afflicted by many sins, O Virgin Mother of God, that with voices of thanksgiving I may diligently and ever glorify thee.[^8564]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Honorable and Great Prophet, John the Forerunner. By Joseph.*[^8565]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Tone 7. Ode 1. Heirmos:* At Thy nod the watery nature, before easily poured forth, was changed into earthly form, O Lord; therefore Israel, having journeyed on foot without wetting his feet, sings unto Thee a song of victory [cf. Exod. 14:21–22].[^8566]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Adorned as the beauty of the Church hast thou been manifested, O blessed Forerunner: by thy prayers ever save her from every tempest of heretics, strong and steadfast.[^8567]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As an immaculate and sacred sacrifice wast thou offered unto the Creator, being slain, O divine Forerunner, like an innocent lamb; therefore with faith I pray thee: deliver me from all malice of the enemy.[^8568]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Heal our bodily and spiritual infirmities, O ever-glorious Forerunner, praying ever to the Word...[^8569]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: ...Who compassionately took upon Himself the sicknesses and infirmities of all [cf. Matt. 8:17].[^8570]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst bear, O All-holy One, the incomprehensible Word, Who in flesh was hypostatically united unto us; Him ever pray, to save those who with faith ever call thee blessed.[^8571]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Thou Who by Thy word didst establish the heavens, and on many waters didst strengthen the earthly foundation: establish my mind in Thy will, O Lover of mankind [cf. Ps. 32:6; 135:6 LXX].[^8572]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Christ, Who overlookest the sins of men because of Thine abundant love for mankind: O only Savior, overlook my many evils, that I may glorify Thee Who art all-good.[^8573]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* That I might fulfill carnal desires, I, shameless one, despised Thy desires, O Christ, and I dread the fiery torment, O Word; from which deliver me.[^8574]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having communion with bodily afflictions, the sufferers gazed upon the painless life and respite; which having attained in joy, they ever lighten afflictions for the faithful.[^8575]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* With the rays of your contests, O passion-bearers, ye dispelled the cruel night of deceit, and passed over unto the unwaning light, taking away the darkness of our infirmities.[^8576]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The prophet foresaw thee as the gate of God, through which He Himself alone passed, even as He knows, O most pure Virgin; therefore I pray thee: do thou thyself open unto me the gates of repentance [cf. Ezek. 44:2].[^8577]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner. Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Lord and Savior, Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens by Thy powerful Word, and all their host by the all-effecting and divine Spirit: establish me upon the immovable rock of Thy confession [cf. Ps. 32:6 LXX].[^8578]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* With sun-like lightnings thou enlightenest all creation, for thou wast shown forth as a bright star of the spiritual Sun, O Forerunner; Him diligently entreat, to drive away the darkness of passions from our all-afflicted hearts.[^8579]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Standing between the Law and grace, O divine Prophet, thou clearly makest known unto all the cessation of the one, and the pure shining forth of the other, a perfect renewal for those grown old in sins.[^8580]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* From demonic assault, from the temptations of life, and from every tribulation deliver us, we cry aloud, O Baptist of Christ, praying...[^8581]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: ...unto the All-good One; and in the day of judgment free us from torments.[^8582]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O blessed Lady, who ineffably didst bear God: together with His divine Baptist, pray unceasingly, O pure Lady, for us who fall into worldly temptations and are held fast by sins.[^8583]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Confirming Thy coming in the flesh, O Christ, the Prophet Habakkuk cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord [cf. Hab. 3:2].[^8584]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I wandered away from the path leading me unto life, and fell into the pit of evils: O Savior, despise me not.[^8585]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Send down streams of tears unto me, O Master, Word of God, that I may wash away the mire of my many transgressions.[^8586]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Led like lambs unto the slaughter, the Martyrs slew the battling enemy, being accounted worthy of glory [cf. Isa. 53:7].[^8587]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Poured forth, the streams of your blood, O all-praised ones, prepared for all the reception of the torrents of delight [cf. LXX Ps. 35:9].[^8588]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Lord was incarnate of thy pure blood, granting repentance unto all men, O Maiden, through thine intercession.[^8589]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner. Ode 4. Heirmos:* Leaving not the Father's bosom, and descending unto earth, O Christ God, I have heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, O only Lover of mankind.[^8590]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having overthrown the host of adversaries, and valiantly triumphed over them in brightness, O Baptist: overthrow by thy prayers the sin that reigns within me, I pray thee.[^8591]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having appeared as a spiritual lamp, O blessed one, thou didst show forth unto men Jesus, the great Sun of righteousness; pray that the hearts of all may be illumined by Him [cf. John 5:35; Mal. 4:2].[^8592]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Conceived and born in iniquities, I live in negligence, and fear the torments of that place; snatch me from them, O Baptist, by entreating God [cf. LXX Ps. 50:7].[^8593]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Bring supplications unto God for us who honor thee, O Baptist, that He may deliver us from every grievous distress and demonic harm, we pray.[^8594]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The shadows of the Law manifoldly foreshadowed thee who gavest birth to God; Him entreat, O all-immaculate Lady, from all...[^8595]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: ...iniquity and bodily passions to deliver me.[^8596]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Thou Who didst disperse the night of passions, shine upon me the spiritual light, having driven away the primordial darkness of the abyss, and Who didst cause the first-created light to shine upon the world, O Creator of all [cf. Gen. 1:2–3].[^8597]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Deliver me, O Word, from Thy righteous wrath when Thou judgest the earth; and having cleansed me from many transgressions by repentance, show me forth as a temple of Thy goodness, O only Creator of all.[^8598]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By the heavy gloom of passions I am blinded in mind, and know not what I do, having become insensate in heart: convert me, O Christ, and grant me repentance that cleanses from defilements.[^8599]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having run youthfully through the stadium filled with sweat, O sufferers, ye attained unto heavenly brightness, receiving the honors of victory from the life-originating hand; therefore ye rejoice now.[^8600]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* By the strong sinews of your sacred sufferings, O sufferers, ye truly strangled the prince, the evil serpent, and were accounted worthy of the sweetness of paradise; therefore we praise you.[^8601]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O bright cloud of the Sun, make to shine upon me the spiritual light of true repentance, and drive away the darkness of wicked thoughts, that with faith I may sing of thee as the salvation of the faithful.[^8602]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner. Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Lord my God, rising early from the night I pray unto Thee: grant me remission of my transgressions, and direct my paths unto the light of Thy commandments, I pray [cf. Isa. 26:9 LXX].[^8603]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst sprout forth as the voice of one crying in desolate thoughts the knowledge of God, O most wise one; therefore I pray thee: renew my soul, made desolate by all manner of transgressions [cf. Isa. 40:3; Matt. 3:3].[^8604]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* An honorable vessel of the Master wast thou shown forth, O divine Prophet: deliver me from unclean deeds by thy prayers, and entreat the Benefactor that I may obtain eternal honor.[^8605]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Iniquities have drawn near against me by the entrance of negligence; make me better through patterns of repentance, O blessed Forerunner, that I may zealously walk in the ways of the Lord.[^8606]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Mortify the earthly mindsets of my flesh, O Mother of God, who didst bear the Life...[^8607]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: ...who by death utterly destroyed death by divine power, O all-holy and pure one.[^8608]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Having fallen into the depth of sins, O Good One, as Jonah from the whale I cry unto Thee: Lead up my life from corruption, and save me, O Lover of mankind [cf. Jonah 2:3, 7].[^8609]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A new prodigal was I shown forth, having lived vilely upon the earth, and bowed down to the impulse of lusts; convert me, O Christ my God, and save me as Thou art the Lover of mankind [cf. Luke 15:11–32].[^8610]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Sigh, O my soul, that thou mayest be delivered from sighing; weep, that thou mayest not experience unceasing tears there, which have no profit in affliction.[^8611]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Ye were clearly manifested as stones set in the crown of Christ's Church, and became her beauteous ornament, O honorable Great-martyrs.[^8612]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having attained an end worthy of God, O most wise ones, ye inherit endless recompenses; therefore pray, O Martyrs, that our ends may be in repentance.[^8613]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* From the depth of negligence and immeasurable evils lead me up, O good Lady, who didst bear the abyss of compassion, and grant me a fountain of tears, O Ever-virgin.[^8614]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner. Ode 6. Heirmos:* Jonah cried aloud from the belly of hades: Lead up my life from corruption; and we cry aloud unto Thee: O all-powerful Savior, have mercy on us [cf. Jonah 2:3, 7].[^8615]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Clearly shining with the rays of virtues, and beaming with radiant martyrdom, thou enlightenest all creation, O close friend of the spiritual Dayspring [cf. Luke 1:78].[^8616]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst sprout forth from a barren aged woman, O blessed one; therefore I cry unto thee: renew me, who have grown old through many sins, by the beauties of repentance through thy prayers.[^8617]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O lamp of the unwaning Light, divine Prophet! kindle by thy prayers the extinguished lamp of my heart, and make me a partaker of the divine Light.[^8618]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Even as rain the Word came down into thy womb: Him entreat, O most pure Virgin, to dry up the torrents of mine immeasurable evils, I pray thee [cf. LXX Ps. 71:6].[^8619]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The fire touched not, nor distressed, Thy Children in the furnace, O Savior. Then the three, as with one mouth, sang and blessed, saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers [cf. Dan. 3:26, 50].[^8620]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I fell into passions of dishonor, I was likened unto the beasts, O Savior, and being darkened I perceive not Thy long-suffering expectation, O Word: grant me time for conversion, and save me [cf. LXX Ps. 48:13].[^8621]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In negligence have I ended my life, doing what is not lawful to do; and lo, now at last I draw near to the gates of hades without gaining understanding: despise me not, O Christ, Who alone art good.[^8622]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having desired life eternal, ye died unto the world, O most wise ones; and having utterly slain the enemy, ye flew up unto the heavens, ever praying for us, O sufferers.[^8623]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Being released from bodily constraints, ye loosed the bonds of deceit, and with firm love bound your souls unto Christ, O Martyrs, Who was bound in the flesh and dissolved the curse.[^8624]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The prophet foresaw thee as a new scroll, wherein the Word of the Father was written; therefore, O pure Lady, I pray thee: pray that I may be written in the book of the living, tearing up the handwriting of my many evils [cf. Isa. 8:1; Col. 2:14].[^8625]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner. Ode 7. Heirmos:* Of old the Children showed the fiery furnace to be dew-dropping, singing unto the one God and saying: Supremely exalted and most glorified is the God of our fathers [cf. Dan. 3:50].[^8626]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Grant me showers of tears by thy prayers, O Forerunner, who didst wash the Abyss of compassion with river streams; and cleanse me from all filthiness, both of flesh and of spirit [cf. 2 Cor. 7:1].[^8627]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Offer supplication, O blessed one, unto our God Who is over all, that He may also have mercy upon me as He is tender-hearted, who have sinned much and now have no uplifting.[^8628]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O barren soul, make haste to repent, lest like the barren fig tree the divine judgment cut thee down from the root; cry aloud unto the Master: O God, having cleansed me, save me [cf. Luke 13:6–9].[^8629]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* My soul, deadened by the evil wounds of transgressions...[^8630]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: ...I pray thee, O Lady, who by thy childbearing didst slay hades: quicken me by patterns of repentance.[^8631]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Unto God Who is unceasingly glorified on high by the Angels, ye heavens of heavens, earth, and mountains, and hills, and the abyss, and all the race of mankind: with songs bless Him as Creator and Deliverer [cf. LXX Ps. 148].[^8632]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having superabundantly taken pleasure in harmful lusts, I, foolish and injured in mind, surpassed every sinner; O Thou Who hast an exceeding abundance of tender compassion, grant me cleansing of my transgressions.[^8633]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Now the Bridegroom is at the doors! Adorn thy lamp, O soul, watering it with the oil of mercy and with all good deeds; before the door be shut, make haste to enter with Christ into incomparable joys [cf. Matt. 25:1–13].[^8634]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Fearing not torments, the valiant sufferers cried aloud: Behold the acceptable time! Let us all stand with a steadfast mind; let us acquire through small sufferings the painless life and unfading sweetness [cf. 2 Cor. 6:2].[^8635]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Ever watered with divine streams, O passion-bearers of the Savior, ye irrigate all the earth through imitation of your contests, and make her fruitful in virtues in Christ unto all ages.[^8636]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Mother of God, sure protection and hope of Christians! In the fearful day stand by me who have sinned much, and deliver me from fearful Gehenna, numbering me with the sheep on the right hand [cf. Matt. 25:33].[^8637]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner. Ode 8. Heirmos:* The only unoriginate King of glory, Whom the heavenly hosts bless, and before Whom the angelic ranks tremble: praise Him, ye priests, and highly exalt Him, O people, unto all ages [cf. Dan. 3:56–57].[^8638]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Cease not unto all ages, O Prophet, to pray the only Deliverer, Who was bound and granted release unto the bound, that I, who ever glorify thee, may be loosed from the bonds of my many transgressions.[^8639]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I am wounded, O Forerunner, by the weapon of lusts, and in pain of heart I cry unto thee: heal the sicknesses of my soul, praying Christ, the only Physician of souls and bodies.[^8640]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* With thy hand, O Forerunner, fail not unceasingly to pray the Word Whom thou didst baptize...[^8641]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: ...to deliver me from the hand of sin, who have sinned much, and am humble and condemned.[^8642]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Because I foolishly buried in the earth the talent entrusted unto me by God, I await bitter torment: from which snatch me by thy prayers, O Baptist, I faithfully pray thee [cf. Matt. 25:24–30].[^8643]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst remain unconsumed, having received the unendurable Fire into thy womb, O Virgin; therefore snatch me from the unquenchable fire, bedewing me now with the most excellent patterns of continual repentance.[^8644]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *My soul magnifies the Lord [LXX Ps. 146:1 / Luke 1:46–55].*[^8645]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Who among men can tell the conception of a birth without seed? At the birth of an incorrupt birthgiving, who of the earthborn will not marvel? Therefore, O Mother of God, we, the earthly tribes, magnify thee [cf. Isa. 53:8].[^8646]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* That we may inherit future good things, let us weep, let us sigh, let us entreat Christ while we have time, ye faithful, for repentance and supplication.[^8647]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Even as the Canaanite woman I cry unto Thee: Have mercy on me, O Christ; even as the woman bowed down of old, straighten me, O Jesus; and save me, O Savior, even as Peter, when sinking in sins [cf. Matt. 15:22; Luke 13:11–13; Matt. 14:30–31].[^8648]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Constrained by tribulations, prisons, and torments, the passion-bearing Martyrs passed over unto the broad space of consolation, delivering us from the constraint of transgressions.[^8649]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* The earth indeed hath now covered your bodies, but heaven holds your spirits, O Saints, which ever stand before the throne of glory, rejoicing with the Angels.[^8650]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having clothed Himself in me, the Lord came forth from thee, O most pure Lady: Him therefore pray, O Virgin, to enlighten me with a garment of light, who have now stripped off the most grievous sackcloth of passions.[^8651]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Forerunner. Ode 9. Heirmos:* O Mother who knewest not man, Virgin Mother of God, who didst bear without experience of corruption, and didst lend flesh unto the all-devising Word, receptacle of the Unendurable, dwelling-place of thine uncontainable Creator: thee do we magnify.[^8652]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* From a sacred root didst thou sprout forth, O Prophet, and didst uproot all evil roots, by which I am choked and become unprofitable; visit me, O blessed one, and direct me to sprout forth fruits of divine repentance...[^8653]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: ...The Church knows thee as the most beauteous turtledove and nightingale, O great Forerunner: for thou didst proclaim the song of repentance unto souls that were desolate and dominated by evils; therefore with faith we call thee blessed.[^8654]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou hast shown unto all the paths leading unto the entrances of salvation, O glorious Forerunner; strengthen me to walk in them, who wander through all the pathless ways of life, and through deceit have committed wickedness.[^8655]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The fearful day at the doors is drawn near, and having deeds of condemnation, I weep: O Lord, Lord, Who alone art merciful, by the prayers of Thy Forerunner and of all the Saints, show me then uncondemned.[^8656]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O thou who didst bear the divine Light, O woman full of the grace of God: enlighten my soul, darkened by transgressions, I pray thee, and show me free from eternal darkness, that I may magnify and glorify thee, the ever-blessed one.[^8657]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Litany, Exapostilarion, and the usual Psalms.*[^8658]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 7.*[^8659]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* As the barren fig tree, cut me not down, O Savior, a sinner; but grant me forgiveness for many years, watering my soul with tears of repentance, that I may bring forth unto Thee the fruit of almsgiving [cf. Luke 13:6–9].[^8660]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord: - - - and look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, and guide their sons [LXX Ps. 89:14, 16].* [^8661]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Being the Sun of righteousness, enlighten the hearts of those who sing unto Thee: O Lord, glory to Thee![^8662]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us; and direct Thou the works of our hands upon us, yea, direct Thou the work of our hands [LXX Ps. 89:17].* [^8663]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3 (For the Martyrs):* In the midst of the tribunal of the lawless, Thy passion-bearers rejoiced and cried aloud: O Lord, glory to Thee![^8664]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* O Christ, Thou hast shone forth as the Light from the Virgin, and hast enlightened the human race: O Lord, glory to Thee![^8665]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *On Tuesday, the Beatitudes, Tone 7.*[^8666]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́тельнице те́плаѧ, и҆ застꙋ́пнице Хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ: тѣ́м-...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Beauteous was the fruit and good for food that slew me:...[^8667]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇то́съ є҆́сть дре́во живо́тное, ѿ негѡ́же ꙗ҆ды́й не ᲂу҆мира́ю, но вопі́ю съ разбо́йникомъ: помяни́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и, въ ца́рствїи твое́мъ.
items.english_text: ...Christ is the tree of life, whereof eating I die not, but cry aloud with the thief: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy kingdom [cf. Luke 23:42].[^8668]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Стрᲂу́пы моегѡ̀ се́рдца неисцѣ́льныѧ, Гдⷭ҇и ᲂу҆врачᲂ́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ вра́чъ дꙋ́шъ же и҆ тѣле́съ; и҆ стꙋпа́ти мнѣ̀ пра́вѡ всегда̀ поспѣ́й въ спаси́тельныѧ пꙋти̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Heal the incurable wounds of my heart, O Lord, as Thou alone art the Physician of souls and bodies; and make me ever to walk uprightly along saving paths.[^8669]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Предте́чїй пра́ведномꙋ со́лнцꙋ, Хрⷭ҇то́въ Крести́телю, свѣти́лникъ дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ ᲂу҆гаше́ный мно́гою ѕло́бою, возжезѝ бж҃е́ствеными моли́твами твои́ми, ꙗ҆́кѡ да ᲂу҆блажа́ю тѧ̀ всегда̀ спаса́емь.
items.english_text: *To the Forerunner:* O Forerunner of the righteous Sun, Baptist of Christ: kindle the lamp of my soul, which is quenched by much malice, through thy divine prayers, that being saved I may ever call thee blessed.[^8670]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Страда́вше и҆ вѣнча́ни бы́вше, врага̀ посрами́ли є҆стѐ; и҆ ны́нѣ жи́телствꙋете на небесѣ́хъ, свѣ́та непристꙋ́пнагѡ и҆сполня́еми, премꙋ́дрїи Мч҃еници, молѧ́щесѧ ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having suffered and received crowns, ye put the enemy to shame; and now ye dwell in the heavens, filled with unapproachable light, O all-wise Martyrs, praying for our souls.[^8671]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆врачᲂ́й дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ стра̑сти неисцѣ̑льныѧ, бж҃е́ственнаѧ Трⷪ҇це: и҆ и҆схыти́ мѧ гее́ны и҆ и҆скꙋше́нїй, ꙗ҆́же въ є҆ди́номъ бж҃ествѣ̀ сла́вимаѧ бл҃гоче́стнѡ; и҆ вѣ́чнꙋющее мнѣ̀ ца́рство да́рꙋй.
items.english_text: *Glory... Trinity:* Heal the incurable passions of my soul, O divine Trinity, Who in one Godhead art piously glorified; and snatch me from Gehenna and temptations, and grant me the eternal kingdom.[^8672]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^8460]
items.slavonic_text: Вмѣсти́ла є҆сѝ нетѣ́сномѣ́стнѡ въ чре́вѣ Невмѣсти́маго: є҆го́же всегда̀ молѝ, Ма́ти чи́стаѧ, тѣсноты̀ всѧ́кїѧ и҆ страсте́й наведе́нїа, и҆зба́вити рабы̑ твоѧ̑, любо́вїю тѧ̀ сла́вѧщыѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Thou didst unconfinedly contain in thy womb the Uncontainable: Him ever entreat, O pure Mother, to deliver from every constraint and assault of passions thy servants who glorify thee with love.[^8673]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: На Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ: стїхи̑ры кре́стны. Гла́съ з҃.
items.english_text: *On Tuesday Evening.*[^8675]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Подо́бенъ: Не ктомꙋ̀ возбраня́еми є҆смы̀:
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 7.*[^8676]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Дре́во и҆згна́ мѧ дре́вле и҆зъ раѧ̀; ны́нѣ же дре́во къ раю̀ возведѐ, тебѣ̀ распе́ншꙋсѧ Хрїстѐ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* A tree cast me out of paradise of old; but now a tree hath led me unto paradise, since Thou wast crucified, O Christ.[^8678]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́до стра́шно! созда́нїю ка́кѡ Созда́тель предстоѧ̀, ѡ҆сꙋжда́емь є҆́сть и҆ распина́емь, на спасе́нїе человѣ́кѡвъ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* A fearful wonder! How the Creator, standing before His creation, is condemned and crucified for the salvation of men.[^8679]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* O Cross of Christ, wonder of the holy Angels, and great wound unto the devil and demons: save thy servants![^8680]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Then the Stichera from the Menaion for the Saint. Glory... to the Saint, if there be one. Both now... Stavrotheotokion of the Tone. But if there is no Menaion, we sing:*[^8681]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera of the Mother of God, Tone 7.*[^8682]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Seeing the Lamb stretched out upon the tree between two thieves, the immaculate Ewe-lamb and Virgin cried aloud: Woe is me, my sweetest Child! What is this fearful and most glorious mystery? How hath the lawless council lifted Thee up upon the Cross, and given gall to drink unto Thee Who didst satisfy men with manna?[^8684]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* When the Virgin and Thy Mother beheld Thee nailed upon the Cross, O my Christ, by unlawful judgment of the Jews on the Place of the Skull, she cried aloud: Woe is me, my most beloved Son! What is this fearful sight? How do the senseless children of the Hebrews nail Thee, the Lord of all, unto the Cross?[^8685]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
