items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* All we have known thee, O all-holy Sovereign Lady, to be revealed a Virgin after childbearing; and seeing Him Whom thou didst bear without seed having His hands nailed upon the tree, the Most-pure One wept and cried aloud: Willingly, O Long-suffering One, Thou diest, delivering from death all who hymn Thee.[^8686]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* O all-holy Sovereign Lady Virgin, who didst bear the Lord Who for tender mercy's sake was nailed upon the Cross and poured forth streams of life for the world: pray Him that our souls may be saved; for we the faithful have thee alone as refuge, wall, and defense; therefore we also flee beneath thy protection.[^8687]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 7.*[^8688]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* No longer are we forbidden the tree of life, having Thy Cross as our hope: O Lord, glory to Thee![^8689]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Being suspended upon the tree, O Immortal One, Thou didst destroy the snares of the devil: O Lord, glory to Thee![^8691]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us: - - - For our soul hath been exceedingly filled with the reproach of them that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud [LXX Ps. 122:3–4].* [^8692]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having been unmindful of all earthly things, O holy Martyrs, and having manfully preached Christ in the judgment hall, ye received from Him recompense for your torments; but as ye have boldness, entreat Him as the all-powerful God to save our souls who flee unto you, we pray.[^8693]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding of old her Son upon the tree, her heart with a sword...[^8694]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: ...of sorrow did the Most-pure One pierce.[^8695]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion, and the rest.*[^8696]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *On Tuesday at Small Compline.*[^8697]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Supplicatory Canon to the Most Holy Mother of God, Tone 7.*[^8698]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* At Thy nod the watery nature, before easily poured forth, was changed into earthly form, O Lord; therefore Israel, having journeyed on foot without wetting his feet, sings unto Thee a song of victory [cf. Exod. 14:21–22].[^8699]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Mother of God, save us.*[^8700]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Still the storm of pleasures and of my passions by the calm of thy divine prayer, O All-immaculate One, that with a quiet heart I may glorify thine ineffable childbearing.[^8701]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* All desire and sweetness of salvation came to be by thy childbearing, O Sovereign Lady Mother of God: drive away from thy servants every bitterness arising from the passions of transgressions.[^8702]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Glory...* Deliver me, O Most-pure One, from demonic deception, and mistreatment, and harm, and temptation, that with faith I may glorify thee who, after God, art my protectress and defense.[^8703]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Thou didst appear unto Moses at the bush, O Word of God, burning as fire, and yet utterly unconsumed, prefiguring Thy birth from the Virgin, for whose sake Thou didst take the form of man [cf. Exod. 3:2].[^8704]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Lord and Savior, Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens by Thy powerful Word, and all their host by the all-effecting and divine Spirit: establish me upon the immovable rock of Thy confession [cf. LXX Ps. 32:6].[^8705]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Him Who was lifted up upon the Cross and cast down hades, O Mother of God: diligently entreat Him for those who ever faithfully hymn thee with sacred voices and songs, O hope of the world and defense of the faithful.[^8706]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Higher than the heavens and more glorious than the Cherubim, having conceived thou didst bear God; therefore pray Him to deliver me from transgressions and from the fearful condemnation, through thy merciful supplication and through thy power surpassing word.[^8707]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Glory...* O Sovereign Lady, who by thy childbearing didst change men from the corruption of death: deliver me from the corruption of passions and sicknesses, and from grievous transgressions, and grant me unaging life by thy di-...[^8708]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: ...vine intercession.[^8709]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Having unchangeably become like unto men in all things, O Word of God, Thou didst manifestly come forth from the pure Virgin, and didst reveal unto all the thrice-radiant Godhead in one undifferentiated essence and unchangeable hypostases.[^8710]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Leaving not the Father's bosom, and descending unto earth, O Christ God: I have heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, O only Lover of mankind.[^8711]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Extend thy mercy and tender compassion over thy servants, O Pure One, who ever pray thee, delivering them from fearful torments by thy prayers.[^8712]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With pure prayer and fervent faith I flee unto thee, O All-immaculate One: be thou the propitiation for my many transgressions, delivering and saving me.[^8713]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Glory...* Through thy childbearing, O Most-pure One, thou wast revealed as the mediatress of our joy, O Sovereign Lady: entreat Him, O All-immaculate One, to deliver me from tribulations and account me worthy of eternal life.[^8714]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Being not separated from the Father's bosom, and incarnate of the Virgin, O Christ God: preserve Thy flock belonging to Thy dispensation, which venerates Thy divine icons.[^8715]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Night without light is unto the unbelieving, O Christ, but enlightenment unto the faithful in the sweetness of Thy words; therefore unto Thee I rise early at dawn, and hymn Thy Godhead.[^8716]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thee I pray, O pure Virgin, to deliver my soul from dark sin, and to illumine it with the divine ray of repentance of thy mercy.[^8717]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Deliver by thy prayers and supplications those who are in the deep of grievous tribulations and dire passions, O Most-holy and Pure One, and save those who praise thee.[^8718]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Glory...* O all-holy Mother of God, who didst conceive God in thy virginal womb and didst bear Him: deliver from all eternal condemnation those who hymn thee.[^8719]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Knowing thee to be the Mother of God, O Pure One, and our defense, we set thee forward as the mediatress of our salvation unto the compassionate Lord.[^8720]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* I cried aloud unto Thee, O Lord, when I was in affliction, and Thou didst lead up my life, O Abundant in mercy [cf. Jonah 2:3, 7].[^8721]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Pray Thy Son, O Sovereign Lady, Who was lifted up upon the Cross and delivered men from corruption, that we may be saved.[^8722]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O most pure Sovereign Lady, forsake me not who hope in thee, but make haste with thy help.[^8723]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Glory...* Deliver from sorrow those who call upon thy divine name, and liberate them from fearful torment.[^8724]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Both now...* O most pure Sovereign Lady, firm hope: preserve those who with love hymn thee as the true Mother of God.[^8725]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Then: Lord, have mercy (40 times). Glory... Both now...*[^8726]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 7:*[^8727] Unceasingly pray Christ God, Who was crucified for our sake and cast down the dominion of death, O Virgin Mother of God, that He may save our souls.[^8728]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The children showed the burning furnace of old to be pouring forth dew, as they hymned the one God and said: Exalted and most glorious is the God of our fathers [cf. Dan. 3:50].[^8729]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* In perplexity, and sorrows, and tribulations, O Most-pure One, I call upon thee fervently from my heart: come quickly and deliver me, and grant me consolation, O Pure One.[^8730]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The surges of many transgressions and passions tempest me, and bring me down unto the depth of perdition: give me thy hand, O Mother of God, and save me, and have mercy on me by thy power.[^8731]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Glory...* I bring Thy Mother unto Thee in prayer, O Savior, Lover of mankind: accepting her, deliver me from transgressions and the coming judgment, and snatch me from eternal torment.[^8732]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Having acquired a soul deadened by grievous transgressions, I pray thee, O Sovereign Lady, who didst put hades to death by thy childbearing: quicken me by patterns of repentance.[^8733]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Christ, Who is truly God, and the Cause of the nature of all things, we highly exalt, and we glorify Him unto all ages.[^8734]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Save me, O Most-pure One, from tribulations and corruption and passions; for unto thee do I flee, my hope and divine salvation.[^8735]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In the final hour, taking me away from cruel calumniators, O Sovereign Lady Virgin, do thou thyself guide me unto the divine dwelling.[^8736]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Glory...* Arise, O my soul! falling down before the Mother of God cry aloud: O hope and salvation of all, deliver me from the eternal fire.[^8737]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Both now...* Let us sing of the Virgin, alone blessed among women, highly exalting Christ and glorifying Him unto all ages [cf. Luke 1:28].[^8738]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Mother of God and Virgin, who didst bear and yet remain a Virgin again: this is not a work of nature, but of God's condescension; therefore, as the only one accounted worthy of God's marvelous wonders, thee do we ever magnify.[^8739]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Mother of God brings supplication unto Thee for me, O Master Christ: receiving her, deliver me from every torment.[^8740]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I ever pray thee, O Sovereign Lady: deliver my humble soul from the coming judgment and torment.[^8741]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Glory...* Pray my Creator and Maker, O Virgin, to deliver me from the fearful judgment, and to grant me life.[^8742]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Both now...* O all-immaculate and pure Mother and Virgin: deliver from defilements thy flock which magnifies thee.[^8743]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparia and the rest.*[^8744]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *On Wednesday at Matins.*[^8745]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *After the 1st Stichologia, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 7.*[^8746]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* The Church cries aloud unto Thee, O Christ God, worshiping Thee in the pine, the cedar, and the cypress: grant victories unto our Emperor [Name] for the sake of the Mother of God, and have mercy on us [cf. Isa. 60:13].[^8747]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* O Thou Who for my sake didst endure nailing upon the Cross: accept my vigilant praise, O Christ God, and save me.[^8749]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Pray Christ God, Who was crucified for our sake and cast down the dominion of death, O Virgin Mother of God, that He may save our souls.[^8750]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Stichologia, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 7.*[^8751]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* The tree brighter than fire and more effectual than flame...[^8752]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: ...of Thy Cross hast Thou shown forth, O Christ, consuming the sins of men and enlightening the hearts of those who hymn Thy voluntary crucifixion: O Christ God, glory to Thee![^8753]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* O Thou Who rulest over the bodiless hosts, and knowest the slothfulness of my soul: by Thy Cross save me, O Christ God, as Thou art the Lover of mankind.[^8755]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Rejoice, ye righteous! Let the heavenly things be glad! For the Martyrs, having contended upon earth, trampled down the enemy. Let the triumphant Church leap for joy, keeping festival unto the only President of the contest and Author of victory, Christ God, Who grants great mercy unto the world.[^8757]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* When the Virgin beheld Thee crucified, O Lord, weeping she cried aloud unto Thee: I hymn Thine ineffable long-suffering, O my Son, and Thy supreme and divine condescension unto men.[^8758]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Stichologia, Sessional Hymns, Tone 7.*[^8759]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* When Thou wast crucified, O Master Christ, the enemy was bound, and death was put to death; and the souls held fast in hades in the nether regions were loosed from their bonds.[^8760]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* O Thou Who for our sake didst accept voluntary crucifixion: crush the enemies that know Thee not as the true God, and save us.[^8761]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* Ever guarded by the Cross of thy Son, O Virgin, we escape the assaults of demons; therefore, as is meet, hymning thee we glorify thee, O all-hymned Mother of God.[^8762]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Honorable and Life-Giving Cross of the Lord. (Whose acrostic is: The planted Cross hath uprooted deception.) By Lord Joseph.*[^8763]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Tone 7. Ode 1. Heirmos:* At Thy nod the watery nature, before easily poured forth, was changed into earthly form, O Lord; therefore Israel, having journeyed on foot without wetting his feet, sings unto Thee a song of victory [cf. Exod. 14:21–22].[^8764]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, O Lord, to Thy Cross and crucifixion.*[^8765]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Bearing reproach, the Master endures crucifixion, taking away the reproaches of men as the Lover of mankind; He is pierced in the ribs with a spear, thereby slaying the warring enemy [cf. John 19:34].[^8766]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having bent Thy Cross like a bow, O Merciful One, with the arrows of...[^8767]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: ...the nails Thou didst wound the adversary, O Savior, and didst heal men who of old were wounded by him.[^8768]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* By the blood of the Saints the abominable defilements of blood offered unto idols ceased; and the whole earth was sanctified, ever calling them blessed with praises.[^8769]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* The heavenly hosts sang praise, beholding earthly men in the body contending with the bodiless; therefore the President of the contest crowned them with crowns as victors.[^8770]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The handwriting of Adam was torn up, didst thou cry aloud, O most pure Sovereign Lady, when Thou, O Son, wast pierced with the spear; therefore I hymn Thy suffering, which hath poured forth dispassion unto all, O Master [cf. Col. 2:14; John 19:34].[^8771]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Most Holy Mother of God. By Joseph.*[^8772]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Tone 7. The same Heirmos.*[^8773]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Preserve thy people who hymn thy greatness with love, O Mother of God, and deliver them from harm; for thou art the protectress, pure guide, and establishment of all.[^8774]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Virgin who didst bear the Water of immortality: grant us waters of healing, washing away all death-bearing passions of our souls and bodies.[^8775]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* An honorable dwelling unto the Master wast thou revealed, O woman full of the grace of God, of Him Who honored the nature of our forefather; therefore we pray thee, O Pure One: deliver us from all the dishonor of passions.[^8776]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having borne the Sun of righteousness unto the world, drive away the darkness from those who hymn thee with faith, O Maiden, in this thy radiant and holy temple, O All-immaculate One [cf. Mal. 4:2].[^8777]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Lord and Savior, Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens by Thy powerful Word, and all their host by the all-effecting and divine Spirit: establish me upon the immovable rock of Thy confession [cf. LXX Ps. 32:6].[^8778]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Thou Who didst stretch out the heaven like a curtain: Thou didst spread out Thy hands upon the tree, O Jesus, healing the intemperance of Adam's hand in sin, as Thou art merciful, and snatching all from the hand of the deceitful warrior [cf. LXX Ps. 103:2].[^8779]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With thorns do the lawless people crown Thee, O King, Who hast crowned men with glory...[^8780]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: ...and rooted out the thorns of Adam's disobedience, O Christ, and planted for all the sprouting forth of the knowledge of God [cf. Matt. 27:29; Gen. 3:18].[^8781]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Being mortal by nature, ye chose to meditate therein on immortality, O all-wise Martyrs; therefore wounds and afflictions, persecutions, beatings, and the severing of limbs did ye all endure with rejoicing.[^8782]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* With steadfast resolve, all ye Sufferers humbled the deceitful enemy who threatened to destroy all things, having humbled yourselves in Christ; and ye were exalted by divine power, having armed yourselves against him.[^8783]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beholding the Lamb Who came willingly unto His passion to be slain, the Mother and Ewe-lamb shed fountains of tears, saying: What is this, O sacred Child? How art Thou put to death, providing to quicken all the dead?[^8784]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Mother of God. The same Heirmos.*[^8785]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Grant unto thy servants, O Pure One, saving petitions in this thy divine temple, wherein thou hast shown forth a fount of wonders, ever pouring forth by divine visitation, and deliver them from eternal torment.[^8786]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Pure One, who beyond cause and word didst bear the Abyss of mercies, Christ, the Giver of all good things: by thy divine overshadowing thou truly showest this thy divine temple to be a cleansing of all manner of passions.[^8787]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Blessed is the fruit of thy womb, O Virgin Mother of God, joy of all: for thou hast truly borne joy and gladness unto the whole world, the Lover of mankind, having dispersed the sorrow of sin, O Bride of God [cf. Luke 1:42].[^8788]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O noetic Ark, who truly didst bear the incorruptible Manna unto the world: come into the midst of us in this hour, O Virgin, and change us from all defilement, who purely call thee blessed [cf. Heb. 9:4].[^8789]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Leaving not the Father's bosom, and descending unto earth, O Christ God: I have heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, O only Lover of mankind.[^8790]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having appeared as man upon earth, Thou didst make men heavenly; for being lifted up upon the tree, O Master, Thou didst raise up together with Thyself all who hymn Thy sufferings [cf. John 12:32].[^8791]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* For mortals Thou diest, O Life; for the unrighteous, O my righteous Jesus, Thou endurest a reproachful passion. We hymn, O Long-suffering One, Thy boundless tender compassion [cf. 1 Pet. 3:18].[^8792]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* The onrushes of wild beasts, fiery burnings, severing of hands and feet, tearing out of limbs, and every other torment did ye endure, O Martyrs, which mediated divine delight.[^8793]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* From the ends of the flesh, O Sufferers, crying unto Christ the God of all, ye were heard; and ye were lifted up upon the rock of divine consolation.[^8794]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Make supplication for us unto Him Who was incarnate of thee, O Mother of God, that we who glorify His passions may find help in time of affliction.[^8795]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Mother of God. The same Heirmos.*[^8796]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thee Habakkuk proclaimed of old as the mountain overshadowed by virtues, O most pure Mother of God, which overshadows all, O Sovereign Lady, from the burning heat of the malice of the primal warrior [cf. Hab. 3:3].[^8797]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Offer supplication unto the Lord Who was incarnate of thy most pure blood, O Sovereign Lady: to save thy people from all harm, who bless thee as is meet.[^8798]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* This thy most glorious church full of God's grace hath come to be for the healing of souls and bodies; for it stills every disease, and cleanses from passions those who faithfully bless thee.[^8799]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* By thy fervent and honorable visitation, O Virgin, save all who with love flee unto thy defense, O Sovereign Lady: visit them and grant petitions that lead unto life.[^8800]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Lord my God, rising early from the night unto Thee I pray: grant me forgiveness of my transgressions, and direct my paths unto the light of Thy commandments, I pray [cf. Isa. 26:9].[^8801]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst accept crucifixion for the taking away of evils, O Word of God; and Thou didst taste of gall, destroying the bitter harm of the sweet food of old: Glory to Thy great tender compassion! [cf. Matt. 27:34; Gen. 3:6].[^8802]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇те Хрⷭ҇то́въ, А҆́гг҃лъ ст҃ы́хъ чꙋ́до! діа́волꙋ же и҆ бѣсѡ́мъ вели́каѧ ꙗ҆́зва! спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Thou Who by Thy lifting up upon the Cross didst shake the whole earth...[^8803]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: ...є҆сѝ бж҃твенною твое́ю держа́вою, и҆ и҆сцѣля́еши ꙗ҆̀, Влады́ко сокрꙋше́нїа: и҆ коле́блемаѧ сердца̀, къ твоемꙋ̀ ᲂу҆твержда́еши позна́нїю.
items.english_text: ...by Thy divine power, and Thou healest their afflictions, O Master; and dost establish wavering hearts in knowledge of Thee.[^8804]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Распросте́ръ Велі́аръ всю́дꙋ сѣ́ти ѕлѡ́бныѧ, но не ᲂу҆вѧ́злъ є҆́сть Хрⷭ҇то́вы мꙋ́ченики; крилѣ́ бо прїе́мше ѻ҆́гненныѧ, къ ѡ҆би́телемъ бж҃твеннымъ достиго́ша.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Beliar spread malignant snares on every side, yet he ensnared not Christ's Martyrs; for having received fiery wings, they reached the divine abodes.[^8805]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Ма́нїемъ неоскꙋ́днымъ, ѿ Бг҃а ѡ҆божа́еми страстоте́рпци: болѣ́зненныхъ мꙋче́нїй ѿню́дъ не ᲂу҆страши́стеся: ꙗ҆́кѡже и҆но́мꙋ стра́ждꙋщꙋ, си́це премꙋ́дрїи са́ми пребы́сте.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Being deified by the unfailing nod of God, O Passion-bearers, ye feared not at all painful torments; as if another were suffering, so did ye yourselves abide, O all-wise ones.[^8806]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Кі́има ѻ҆чи́ма воззрю̀, ѻ҆́ко и҆зсꙋша́ющее всѧ̑ бе́здны, Сы́не мо́й, ᲂу҆гаса́емое на крестѣ̀ ви́сящꙋ тебѣ̀? чи́стаѧ Дѣ́ва вопія́ше, рыда́ньми себѐ смꙋща́ющи.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With what eyes shall I gaze upon the Eye that dries up all abysses, O my Son, extinguished as Thou hangest upon the Cross? the pure Virgin cried aloud, troubling herself with lamentations.[^8807]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Но́щь несвѣ́тла невѣ́рнымъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, вѣ́рнымъ же просвѣще́нїе въ сла́дости слове́съ твои́хъ; сегѡ̀ ра́ди къ тебѣ̀ ᲂу҆́тренюю, и҆ воспѣва́ю твоѐ Божество̀.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Mother of God. Ode 5. Heirmos:* Night without light is unto the unbelieving, O Christ, but enlightenment unto the faithful in the sweetness of Thy words; therefore early in the morning do I rise unto Thee, and hymn Thy Godhead [cf. Isa. 26:9].[^8808]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆тагче́нныхъ сно́мъ грѣхо́внымъ, Чи́стаѧ, бѡ́дры творя́щи: ѻ҆ба́че же въ пречестнѣ́мъ хра́мѣ твое́мъ, твое́ю бѡ́дренною бж҃е́ственною моли́твою на́съ ᲂу҆ще́дри, Бг҃оневѣ́сто.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Making watchful those weighed down by the sleep of sin, O Pure One, yet in thy most honorable temple, through thy watchful and divine prayer, have tender mercy upon us, O Bride of God.[^8809]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Да́ждь Чи́стаѧ, всѣ̑мъ на́мъ рꙋ́кꙋ по́мощи, къ тебѣ̀ прибѣга́ющимъ, и҆ ѡ҆мы́й всѧ́кїа ѕло́бы скве́рнꙋ, и҆ болѣ́зни ѡ҆чи́сти моли́твами твои́ми.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Grant unto all us who flee unto thee a helping hand, O Pure One, and wash away the defilement of every malice, and cleanse diseases by thy prayers.[^8810]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́же Бг҃а зача́нши въ ᲂу҆тро́бѣ дѣви́честѣй, и҆ ро́ждши, Бцⷣе пречи́стаѧ: тѧ̀ пою́щихъ и҆зба́ви всѧ́кагѡ вѣ́чнагѡ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїа.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O most pure Mother of God, who didst conceive God in thy virginal womb and bear Him: deliver from all eternal condemnation those who hymn thee.[^8811]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Въ хра́мъ тво́й вѣ́рою приходя́щихъ дꙋ́ши ѡ҆бновля́ютсѧ, ѡ҆бветша́вшїа грѣхмѝ, и҆ по до́лгꙋ тѧ̀ всѝ Пренепоро́чнаѧ сла́вятъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* The souls of those coming with faith into thy temple are renewed, which were waxed old through sins; and all glorify thee as is meet, O All-immaculate One.[^8812]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Пла́ваѧ въ молвѣ̀ жите́йскихъ попече́нїй, съ корабле́мъ потопла́емь грѣхѝ, и҆ дꙋшетлѣ́нномꙋ ѕвѣ́рю примета́емь, ꙗ҆́кѡ І҆ѡ́на Хрⷭ҇тѐ вопію́ тебѣ̀: и҆зъ смертоно́сныѧ глꙋбины̀ возведи́ мя.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Sailing in the surge of worldly cares, overwhelmed with the ship by sins, and cast forth unto the soul-corrupting beast, like Jonah I cry unto Thee, O Christ: Bring me up from the death-bearing abyss! [cf. Jonah 2:3–7].[^8813]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́вителю сы́й є҆ди́не, цѣ́нꙋ твою̀ да́лъ є҆сѝ спаси́тельнꙋю кро́вь, и҆ и҆скꙋпи́лъ є҆сѝ плѣне́нныѧ ны̀ Преблагі́й, и҆ твое́мꙋ Роди́телю приве́лъ є҆сѝ, ᲂу҆би́въ кресто́мъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, мꙋчи́телѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being the only Redeemer, Thou didst give Thy saving blood as a ransom, and didst redeem us who were captive, O All-good One, and brought us unto Thy Father, having slain the tormentor by the Cross, O Christ [cf. 1 Tim. 2:6].[^8814]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By intemperance of old I brought about a grievous fall; but Christ...[^8815]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: ...being lifted up upon the tree, spreading out His hands, raised up me that was fallen; and having willingly been wounded, manifestly healed all my wounds [cf. Isa. 53:5].[^8816]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* By no means slumbering with the slumber of delusion, ye put to sleep every onslaught of the tormentors, O Martyrs; and having fallen asleep in the slumber meet for the righteous, O blessed ones, ye became watchful intercessors for all.[^8817]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Established upon the rock of Christ's divine commandments, ye remained immovable against the wiles of the enemy, O all-glorious Martyrs; and having trampled him underfoot in godly wisdom, ye journeyed unto God in a manner worthy of God.[^8818]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A young Child thou bearest, O Mother of God, Who before the ages was timelessly co-understood with the Father, Who by the Cross renews mankind, which was waxed old through sins by the counsel of the author of evil, O All-immaculate One [cf. Isa. 9:6].[^8819]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Mother of God. Ode 6. Heirmos:* Jonah cried out of the belly of Hades: Bring up my life from corruption; and we cry unto Thee: O all-powerful Savior, have mercy on us! [cf. Jonah 2:2, 6].[^8820]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou alone didst pour forth for us the water of salvation; thou alone, O Pure One, having dried up the burning heat of delusion, dost bedew the true understanding of thy servants.[^8821]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O animate city of our God: deliver thy flock from godless barbarians, and from earthquake, and constraint, and every temptation [cf. LXX Ps. 86:3].[^8822]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Drive away the wounds of our souls, O Mother of God, and bodily infirmities, by the sprinkling of thy prayers, that with divine voices we may hymn thee.[^8823]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O Virgin Maiden, who through thy most pure childbearing didst loose Eve from sorrows: loose the sorrowful passions of my soul and body [cf. Gen. 3:16].[^8824]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Of old the Children showed forth the fiery furnace as dropping dew, hymning the one God and saying: Exalted above all is the God of our fathers, and supremely glorified [cf. Dan. 3:52].[^8825]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Our forefather found a life free of pain, when Thou willingly didst suffer pain upon the Cross, and wast dead, and didst put the serpent to death, O Jesus Christ, abundant in mercy.[^8826]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* We all have been delivered from the curse of the law; for the Lawgiver was lifted up upon the Cross, pouring forth an ever-flowing blessing, and grace, and mercy, and the destruction of corruption [cf. Gal. 3:13].[^8827]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Approaching torments with voluntary impulse, the Martyrs imaged Him Who suffered willingly; and having been crowned by Him, they now dance with the Angels.[^8828]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having surrendered your bodies unto various torments, O all-praised Martyrs, by the shedding of your blood ye drowned the bodiless enemies, and ye pour forth fountains of healings.[^8829]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* How shall I not weep, O sweetest Child, beholding Thee upon the Cross? How shall I not wail, seeing Thee suffering unjustly, O most righteous Judge? the Virgin Mother spoke.[^8830]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Mother of God. The same Heirmos.*[^8831]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Virgin who didst bear the divine Fire: consume the brushwood passions of those who hymn thee, O All-praised One; and illuminate all with the light of repentance, we pray.[^8832]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O incorrupt Maiden, deliver us from corruption; O animate palace of God, show us forth to be temples of the Divine Spirit, who in thy church unceasingly hymn thee with faith [cf. 1 Cor. 6:19].[^8833]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou pourest forth a stream of healings unto all; for thou didst bear the Fount of life: and by thy fervent prayer, O Mother of God, cleanse this thy flock from defilement, O Bride of God.[^8834]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having seen all the images of thy divine childbearing, the divine Prophets sang with joy, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O supremely praised God of our fathers! [cf. Dan. 3:52].[^8835]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The bush on Sinai that communed with the fire without being burned revealed God unto Moses slow of speech and halting of tongue; and the zeal of God showed the three Children in the fire to be unconquerable singers: All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages! [cf. Exod. 3:2; Dan. 3:57].[^8836]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The blood and water that flowed from Thy side, O Savior, renewed the whole world and poured forth incorruption; and the abominable sacrifices and shedding of defiled blood ceased. Therefore all ye works hymn Thee as Lord, and supremely exalt Thee unto all ages! [cf. John 19:34].[^8837]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With a crown of thorns Thou wast encircled, O Savior, and didst taste of vinegar and gall...[^8838]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: ...and wast spat upon, and beaten, and lifted up upon the Cross, receiving nails; whereby being saved, I cry unto Thee: All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages! [cf. Matt. 27:30, 34].[^8839]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having been most radiantly enriched from the inexhaustible treasures of the truth, O Sufferers, ye spat upon all idolatrous poverty and were shown forth as enrichers of the poor, crying aloud: All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^8840]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having disregarded the ordinances of the impious, like the Children, O Martyrs, ye were cast into burning fire, wherein ye found the dew of God cooling you, crying aloud: All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages! [cf. Dan. 3:21, 50].[^8841]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The legal ark of old prefigured thee, O Pure One, bearing within not the tablets, but Christ the Lawgiver, Whom the lawless people nailed unto the Cross, Who saves us that cry aloud: All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages! [cf. Heb. 9:4].[^8842]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Mother of God. Ode 8. Heirmos:* The only unoriginate King of glory, Whom the heavenly hosts bless, and the ranks of Angels tremble before: praise Him, ye priests, and supremely exalt Him, ye people, unto the ages! [cf. Dan. 3:57].[^8843]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O thou who pourest forth an abyss of wonders unto the world, All-praised One: dry up the stream of our passions, and pour forth for us the dew of forgiveness, who honor thee with untroubled faith, O Virgin.[^8844]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* From thee the righteous Sun shone forth upon those sitting in the darkness of passions, and made thee light, O all-praised and pure Maiden! Therefore we hymn thee as is meet, O Mother of God [cf. Mal. 4:2; Luke 1:79].[^8845]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having become the all-radiant church of God, O Pure One: show forth thy servants who assemble in thy holy temple to be dwellings of the Spirit, who glorify thee unto all ages [cf. 1 Cor. 3:16].[^8846]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* By the light of thy childbearing thou didst marvelously enlighten the universe, O Mother of God, having borne in thine arms the true God, Who ever enlightens those who call out with faith: All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages![^8847]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Mother of God, and Virgin who didst bear and again remain a virgin, not a work of nature...[^8848]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: ...was this, but the condescension of God; therefore as the only one accounted worthy of God's wonders, we ever magnify Thee.[^8849]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The enemy's power utterly failed, when Thou didst cry out mightily upon the tree unto Thy supremely unoriginate Father, O Mighty One, and didst gather Thy scattered sheep unto knowledge of Thee, O Master Christ [cf. Matt. 27:46, 50; John 11:52].[^8850]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As a Lamb Thou wast lifted up willingly upon the Cross, O Master, snatching Thy noetic sheep from the wolf, O Savior; and enclosing them in the fold of Thy commandments, who hymn Thee [cf. John 1:29; 10:11–12].[^8851]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Manifested as imitators of Thy sufferings, the gloriously renowned passion-bearers endured manifold kinds of torments, O Lover of mankind; whence they obtained crowns of glory and were accounted worthy of Thy kingdom, O Christ.[^8852]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Solar graces flash forth, enlightening the faithful: the praiseworthy festival of the honorable passion-bearers; wherefrom we who ever celebrate it are delivered from the darkness of grievous transgressions.[^8853]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thy Son shone forth as noetic Light upon the Cross, O Most-pure One, and reproved the rulers of darkness, O All-immaculate One: He darkened the sun's light and enlightened the assembly of the faithful, O Pure Maiden [cf. Eph. 6:12; Luke 23:44–45].[^8854]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Mother of God. Ode 9. Heirmos:* O Mother who knewest not man, Virgin Mother of God, who didst bear without experience of corruption and lend flesh unto the all-skillful Word: receptacle of the Unbearable One, dwelling-place of the Uncontainable One, thy Creator: thee do we magnify.[^8855]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* More sacred than the hosts on high wast thou revealed, having brought forth the Creator of all, O Mother unwedded, holy Mother of God; therefore with the Angels we glorify thee, unceasingly hymning thy great deeds [cf. Luke 1:49].[^8856]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As one enlightened by the beams of the Divine Spirit, the most sacred Prophet of old beheld thee, O Virgin, as the overshadowed mountain, O Mother of God; therefore we of the earth with the Angels call thee blessed, as thou didst foretell, O God-blessed one [cf. Hab. 3:3; Luke 1:48].[^8857]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* A jar wast thou shown to be, bearing the divine Manna; a ladder wast thou seen, leading men up from earth, O only unwedded Virgin Mother of God [cf. Heb. 9:4; Gen. 28:12]:...[^8858]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: ...therefore we the faithful, having come together, glorify thee as is meet, O woman full of the grace of God.[^8859]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O Maiden who becamest the dwelling-place of the Godhead: me, who have become a den of soul-corrupting thieves and a workshop of all lawlessness, wash clean with the bath of tears, and show forth as a dwelling-place of the Divine Spirit [cf. Matt. 21:13; 1 Cor. 6:19].[^8860]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 5:* O thou who alone didst bear the pre-eternal Light: deliver me from eternal darkness, O Sovereign Lady, and enlighten my soul, O Virgin, which is wholly darkened by the passions of this life, that with love I may ever glorify thee.[^8861]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Litany, Photogogicon, and the customary Psalms.*[^8862]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 7.*[^8863]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Being Master, Lover of mankind, and Giver of life, Thou didst redeem the universe by Thy Cross: O Lord, glory to Thee![^8864]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced: - - - And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, and guide their sons [LXX Ps. 89:14, 16].* [^8865]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* The true Vine was nailed upon the Cross, and the nations embraced paradise with the thief. This is the glory of the Church; this is the wealth of the kingdom: O Lord Who didst suffer for our sake, glory to Thee! [cf. John 15:1; Luke 23:43].[^8866]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us: and direct Thou the works of our hands over us, yea, the work of our hands direct Thou [LXX Ps. 89:17].* [^8867]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Luminaries were ye revealed unto the universe, O all-praised passion-bearers, crying unto Christ: O Lord, glory to Thee![^8868]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* When the All-immaculate One beheld Thee willingly nailed upon the tree, weeping she sang praise unto Thy dominion.[^8869]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise: Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparia, Litany, and the rest.*[^8870]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *On Wednesday, the Beatitudes, Tone 7.*[^8871]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Comely was the fruit and good for food that put me to death; but Christ is the tree of life, whereof eating I die not, but cry aloud with the thief: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy kingdom [cf. Gen. 3:6; Luke 23:42].[^8872]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou didst spread out Thy palms upon the Cross, rectifying the stumbling of Adam's outstretched hands toward the tree of food, O Compassionate One, by reason of Thy manifold goodness; therefore we glorify Thee, O Lord Benefactor.[^8873]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* On the Place of the Skull the Jewish assembly, O Christ King, cru-...[^8874]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: ...cified Thee Who crushest the destructive head of the deceitful one, and pourest forth for us from Thy holy ribs rivers of forgiveness [cf. John 19:34; Gen. 3:15].[^8875]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having been made conformable unto Christ's honorable and saving passions, O all-praised Martyrs, ye endured manifold torments and passed together unto immortality; therefore ye are called blessed.[^8876]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Glory... Trinity:* Preserve Thy servants who hymn Thee, O Holy Trinity; strengthen them by the power of the Cross, and direct us to walk toward the city on high, where having arrived we may find mercy [cf. Heb. 11:10].[^8877]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^8674]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Seeing Him Who was born of thee being crucified, shedding tears, troubled in her womb, the pure Mother cried aloud: How dost Thou suffer these things willingly, O Son, desiring to deliver mankind from passions?[^8878]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *On Wednesday Evening.*[^8880]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Holy Apostles, Tone 7.*[^8881]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Having cultivated the whole earth with the plow of the knowledge of God, O glorious Apostles, ye raised up a multitude of the faithful.[^8883]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Dispel the winter of my passions, and make the calm of pure pouring forth to dawn upon me, O blessed Apostles.[^8884]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* As disciples of the Word, ye brought the assemblies of the nations from senselessness unto the understanding of God.[^8885]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Holy Wonderworker Nicholas, sung if there is no Menaion.*[^8886]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* As of old thou didst deliver the generals that were about to die, O Father, through thy prayers, O Nicholas: so now also save us.[^8888]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Deliver from sorrows all those who call upon thee and hymn thee with faith and love, O all-blessed hierarch Nicholas.[^8889]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Deliver thy servants from famine and destruction, from earthquake and afflictions, and from every constraint, O all-wise hierarch Nicholas.[^8890]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Offer the supplication of thy servants unto thy Son, O All-pure One, that He may save all whom He created.[^8891]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light: Prokeimenon of the day.*[^8892]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Apostles, Tone 7.*[^8893]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Glorious Apostles, pillars of the Church, heralds of truth, radiant luminaries: by spiritual fire ye burned up all delusion, and enlightened mankind by faith. Therefore we pray you: entreat our Savior and God to give peace unto the world, and to save our souls [cf. Gal. 2:9].[^8894]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Verse: Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes, O Thou that dwellest in heaven: - - - So our eyes look unto the Lord our God, until He have mercy on us [LXX Ps. 122:1–2].* [^8895]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Apostles of Christ, laborers of the Savior, carrying the Cross upon your shoulders like a plow: having cleansed the earth that was overcome by the delusion of idols, ye sowed the word of faith. Ye are worthily honored, O holy Apostles of Christ.[^8896]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us: - - - For our soul hath been exceedingly filled with the reproach of them that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud [LXX Ps. 122:3–4].* [^8897]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* O all-praised Martyrs, spiritual sheep, rational whole-burnt offerings, acceptable sacrifices, well-pleasing unto God: neither did the earth hide you, but heaven received you; ye became partakers with the Angels. Together with them entreat—we pray you—our Savior and God to grant peace unto the world, and to save our souls [cf. Rom. 12:1].[^8898]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Let us hymn the Virgin who alone is most pure after childbearing, as Mother of God the Word, saying: Glory to thee![^8899]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparion.*[^8900]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *On Wednesday at Small Compline.*[^8901]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Mother of God, Tone 7.*[^8902]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
