items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* By Thy nod the water's nature, before easily molded, was transformed into an earthy form, O Lord; therefore Israel, having journeyed on foot dryshod, sings unto Thee a song of victory [cf. Exod. 14:21–22, 29].[^8903]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Mother of God, save us.*[^8904]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* With living waters, O Virgin, refresh my soul that is wasted by the burning heat of sin, that I may bring forth a fruitful ear of divine compunction, O Pure One [cf. John 4:10].[^8905]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Rain down upon me drops of compunction, O Pure One, with drops of tender mercies, wherewith I may wash away, O Mai-...[^8906]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: ...den, all the defilement of the soul that hath come upon it through heedlessness.[^8907]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Glory:* Having received thy Creator in thy womb, thou didst bear Him without corruption, an infant Who was God; a strange wonder! thou art handmaid and Mother, O unwedded Sovereign Lady [cf. Luke 1:38, 43].[^8908]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Both now:* Thou didst bear for us the Redeemer of mankind, both Deliverer and Savior, Christ, O most pure Virgin Mother; therefore manifestly knowing thee to be the mediatress of eternal life, we glorify thee.[^8909]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Lord and Savior, Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens by Thy powerful Word, and all their host by the all-effecting and divine Spirit: establish me upon the immovable rock of Thy confession [cf. LXX Ps. 32:6].[^8910]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having dyed the bodily purple from thy most pure blood, the King of all, and having worn it without corruption by nature, being both God and man, came forth from thee, O Virgin, possessing a kingdom immutable.[^8911]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As a treasury of good and ineffable things given unto all from God, O Virgin, thou impartest unto us the ungrudging grace of marvelous gifts in temptations, afflictions, and infirmities, who pray unto thee.[^8912]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Glory:* The marvelous Daniel foresaw thee as the mountain, O Pure One, wherefrom was cut the stone, Christ, Who crushed the demonic idols; therefore we hymn thee as the cause of all good things, being redeemed by thy childbearing [cf. Dan. 2:34, 45].[^8913]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Both now:* The God-proclaiming one of old foresaw thee as the scroll wherein the Word was written, O Pure One, by the Father's finger; therefore I pray thee: tear up the evil record of my sins, and write me in the book of life [cf. Ezek. 2:9–10; Rev. 20:12].[^8914]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Leaving not the Father's bosom, and descending unto earth, O Christ God: I have heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, O only Lover of mankind.[^8915]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Offer supplication unto Him Who was born of thee, O Mother of God, that we who glorify His sufferings may find help in time of circumstance.[^8916]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The Creator of nature, having been poured forth as Myrrh from thee, O all-holy and pure Maiden, filled all things with fragrance by divine understandings, and drove away the foul-smelling delusion [cf. Song 1:3].[^8917]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Glory:* Christ God, having set thee as a noetic ladder for those upon earth, O Pure One, by thee leads up the faithful unto divine heavenly deeds, as He is merciful [cf. Gen. 28:12].[^8918]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Both now:* Weighed down with many a burden of sins, O Good One, I cry unto thee: Appear as cleansing unto me, O thou who didst bear God Who takes away the sins of the world [cf. John 1:29].[^8919]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Lord my God, rising early from the night unto Thee I pray: grant me forgiveness of my transgressions, and direct my paths unto the light of Thy commandments, I pray [cf. Isa. 26:9].[^8920]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Mother of the Lover of mankind and God, all-hymned Mother of God: unto me who ever praise thee with faith and love in hymns, send down by thy supplications cleansing of my transgressions.[^8921]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O most pure Mother of God, who art the receptacle of the immutable Light and the temple of the divine radiance: enlighten my darkened soul with thy light, I pray.[^8922]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Glory:* O Lord my God, Who wast pleased to become man, I pray Thee: be pleased to save me, the prodigal, for the sake of the Virgin who purely bare Thee, and the pure Maiden.[^8923]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Both now:* O Sovereign Lady Mother of God: grant forgiveness of my transgressions, O all-immaculate one who didst bear the hypostatic Life unto the world.[^8924]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Sailing in the surge of worldly cares, overwhelmed with the ship by sins, and cast forth unto the soul-corrupting beast, like Jonah I cry unto Thee, O Christ: Bring me up from the death-bearing abyss! [cf. Jonah 2:3–7].[^8925]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* From the corruption of death and from the sin that was of Adam were we delivered, O Mother of God, by thy seedless childbearing; for God and man together, one and the same, being the Son, bestows upon the faithful redemption of sins [cf. Rom. 5:12–19].[^8926]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Tear up the handwriting of my transgressions, O Sovereign Lady, having written me in the book of the saved by thy divine prayers, that in praise I may hymn thee who art holier than the Cherubim [cf. Col. 2:14; Rev. 20:12].[^8927]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Невоздержа́нїемъ дре́вле паде́нїе лю́тое пода́хъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ же...
items.english_text: *Glory:* Them that of old were cast away from Thy presence by Thy righteous judgment, O Christ, Thou didst call back through Thy bodily coming, as...[^8928]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: милосе́рдъ, и҆ ны́нѣ Бла́же согрѣши́вшыѧ ны̀ прїимѝ, и҆ ѿ ѕѡ́лъ премѣнѝ.
items.english_text: ...compassionate; and now, O Good One, receive us who have sinned, and change us from evils.[^8929]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆чище́нїе ро́ждшꙋю, и҆ грѣ́шникѡвъ благодѣ́телѧ, Дѣ́во пречи́стаѧ, молю́ тѧ: вины̑ безмѣ́рныхъ прегрѣше́нїй мои́хъ разрѣшѝ ма́тернею твое́ю моли́твою; и҆́маши бо ꙗ҆́кѡ ма́ти къ Сы́нꙋ є҆́же мощѝ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* O most pure Virgin, who didst bear the Cleansing and the Benefactor of sinners, I pray thee: loose the guilt of my boundless transgressions by thy maternal prayer; for as a Mother unto the Son thou hast the power [cf. John 2:1–11].[^8930]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Та́же, Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй, м҃. Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ:
items.english_text: *Then, Lord, have mercy (40). Glory... Both now...*[^8931]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: По́дъ кро́въ тво́й всѝ земноро́днїи прибѣга́емъ: и҆зба́ви вѣ́чнꙋющагѡ ѻ҆гнѧ̀, дꙋ́шы на́ша, Блага́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 7:* Under thy protection all we earthborn flee: deliver our souls from the eternal fire, O Good One.[^8932]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Пе́щь ѻ҆́троцы ѻ҆гнепа́льнꙋ дре́вле росоточа́щꙋ показа́ша, є҆ди́наго Бг҃а воспѣва́юще, и҆ глаго́люще: превозноси́мый ѻ҆тце́въ Бг҃ъ, и҆ препросла́вленъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Of old the youths showed forth the fiery furnace to be dropping dew, praising the one God, and saying: O God of the fathers, supremely exalted and exceedingly glorious [cf. Dan. 3:49–50].[^8933]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆тагче́нный ᲂу҆́мъ мо́й сно́мъ, Всенепоро́чнаѧ, къ благи̑мъ дѣла́нїемъ воздви́гни, ꙗ҆́ко да ᲂу҆блажа́ю тѧ̀ честнѣ́йшꙋю всѧ́кїѧ тва́ри.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Raise up my mind, weighed down by sleep, O all-immaculate one, unto good deeds, that I may call thee blessed who art more honorable than all creation.[^8934]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́нїи трїѐ ѻ҆́троци посредѣ̀ пе́щи твоѐ проѡбража́хꙋ рождество̀: не ѡ҆пали́ся ᲂу҆́бѡ, ѻ҆́гнь ро́ждшаѧ Чи́стаѧ. Тѣ́мже ве́щныѧ моѧ̑ стра̑сти се́рдца попалѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The three young children in the midst of the furnace prefigured thy childbearing; for it was not burned, O Pure One who didst bear the Fire; therefore burn up the material passions of my heart [cf. Dan. 3:49–50].[^8935]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Въ жена́хъ тѧ̀ краснꙋ̀ и҆ добрꙋ̀, прекра́сный Гдⷭ҇ь ᲂу҆разꙋмѣ́въ, и҆зъ тебѐ воплоти́ся. Того̀ ᲂу҆́бѡ молѝ прест҃а́ѧ О҆трокови́це, спасти́ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Having perceived thee, beautiful and good among women, the most comely Lord was incarnate of thee; Him therefore implore, O most holy Maiden, to save me [cf. Song 1:8, 15].[^8936]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃твеннаѧ роса̀ и҆зъ тебѐ проше́дши, и҆ста́вшыѧ зно́емъ грѣхо́внымъ, ѡ҆роша́етъ, Пренепоро́чнаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ молю̀, и҆ста́вшꙋю дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ ѡ҆росѝ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* The divine dew, having gone forth from thee, O all-immaculate one, bedews them that are languishing in the burning heat of sin; therefore I pray thee: bedew my languishing soul.[^8937]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Неѡпа́льнаѧ ѻ҆гню̀ въ Сїна́и прича́щшаѧся кꙋпина̀ Бг҃а ꙗ҆вѝ, медленоѧзы́чномꙋ и҆ гꙋгни́вомꙋ Мѡѷсе́ови: и҆ ѻ҆́троки ре́вность Бж҃їа трѝ непребори́мыѧ въ ѻ҆гнѝ пѣвцы̀ показа̀: Всѧ̑ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇на, Гдⷭ҇а по́йте, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The bush that held communion with the fire on Sinai without being consumed made God known unto Moses, slow of tongue and of an impediment in his speech; and the zeal of God showed forth the three children in the fire to be unconquerable singers: Praise the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages [cf. Exod. 3:2; 4:10; Dan. 3:57].[^8938]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Неѡпа́льна ѻ҆гне́мъ въ Сїна́и бесѣ́довавши кꙋпина̀, твоѐ показва̀ стра́нно рождество̀ бг҃ови́дцꙋ Мѡѷсе́ю. Тѣ́мже ᲂу҆ди́влься стра́нномꙋ рождествꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀, Чи́стаѧ, ра́дꙋйся вопія́ше: всѧ̑ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇на, Гдⷭ҇а по́йте, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The bush on Sinai that communed with the fire without being burned showed forth thy strange childbearing unto Moses the God-seer; therefore, having marveled at thy strange childbearing, O Pure One, he cried aloud: Rejoice! Praise the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages [cf. Exod. 3:2].[^8939]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* My mind that is mortified by sin, O pure Virgin who didst bear the Life, quicken...[^8940]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: ...and save me through thy maternal supplications unto God, who ever sing: Praise the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages.[^8941]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Having thee, O Pure One, as an unceasing guardian by night and by day against noetic and visible enemies, I am in no wise afraid of any evil and deceitful assault, as I sing unto Christ: Praise the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^8942]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Being inclined by His love for mankind, O Mother of God, thy Son, as He is good, gave thee as help against enemies and as healing of passions unto them that call with faith: Praise the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^8943]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Thee who without trial of corruption didst give birth, and didst lend flesh unto the Word, the all-craftsman, O Mother unwedded, Virgin Mother of God: receptacle of the Uncontainable, dwelling-place of thine uncontainable Creator, we magnify thee.[^8944]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The unstolen wealth of thy virginity, O Mother in the flesh, thou wast revealed as the Mother of the Almighty, O unwedded Bride, Virgin Mother of God: having nurtured as an infant Him Who nurtures and sanctifies the whole world as Creator.[^8945]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having borne the most mankind-loving Word, O Virgin, Who takes away the sins of the world: Him implore to send down forgiveness of sins unto us who bless thee as is meet with undoubting faith [cf. John 1:29].[^8946]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Being a lover of sin, I tremble and fear lest the end of life suddenly overtake me, O pure Sovereign Lady, protectress of all the wronged: be thou now entreated to strengthen me in patterns of repentance.[^8947]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Both now:* That Thou send me not into the fire prepared for me, the Virgin who bare Thee implores Thee, and the divine incorporeal Choir, the Apostles, Prophets, Martyrs, and Hierarchs, and the spirits of the righteous, O all-bountiful and most merciful One [cf. Matt. 25:41].[^8948]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *It is truly meet. Trisagion. After Our Father: the troparion and the rest according to the custom, and the dismissal.*[^8949]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *On Thursday at Matins.*[^8950]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *After the first Kathisma reading, Sessional Hymns of the Apostles, Tone 7:*[^8951]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Thou didst show forth Thine Apostles, O Word, as laborers of Thy field, cutting...[^8952]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: ...down the idols; therefore having preached Thee as Master among the nations, they magnified Thee in godly manner.[^8953]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Ye loved not earthly glory upon earth, O glorious ones; having proclaimed the heavenly God unto men, ye brought all unto Him.[^8955]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* The Fruit of thy womb, O most pure one, is the fulfillment of the Prophets and the Law; therefore, glorifying thee in knowledge as the Mother of God, we magnify thee in godly manner [cf. Matt. 5:17].[^8956]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *After the second Kathisma reading, Sessional Hymns, Tone 7:*[^8957]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* As the all-wise pilots of our salvation, let us duly honor with chants and hymns the Apostles of Christ God; for having driven away the ungodliness of delusion, they saved the world, having become eyewitnesses, servants, friends, and brethren of the Word [cf. Luke 1:2; John 15:14–15; 20:17].[^8958]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* The Prophets preached, the Apostles taught, the Martyrs confessed, and we have believed that Thou art Christ, the Son of God, the Redeemer of the world [cf. John 11:27].[^8960]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Thy Martyrs, O Lord, overcame the enemy and put to shame the delusion of idols, having armed themselves with the power of Thy Cross; therefore together with the Angels singing praise unto Thee, they cry aloud the triumphal hymn, glorifying Thee, O Christ: by their prayers grant cleansing unto our souls, and great mercy.[^8962]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Rejoice, from whom the Word unchangeably became flesh and dwelt among us; rejoice, pure one, the rejoicing of the Apostles and Martyrs, and the salvation of us the faithful; rejoice, Mother of Christ God [cf. John 1:14].[^8963]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *After the third Kathisma reading, Sessional Hymns, Tone 7:*[^8964]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* All-praised disciples of the Lord, who, like radiant luminaries, have enlightened all that is under the sun: pray that I, who am in the darkness of passions and transgressions, may be enlightened.[^8966]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Being the luminaries of the world, O Apostles of the Lord, ye ever cause the Word to shine upon the faithful, driving away exceedingly the mist of delusion; therefore ye also enlighten the nations through baptism, as...[^8967]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: ...preachers of the Trinity as ye are, ever revered.[^8968]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* O Virgin, the joy of the world, unceasingly implore thy Son together with the Apostles to grant forgiveness of our transgressions and amendment of life.[^8969]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Canon to the holy, glorious, and all-praised Apostles. A creation of Theophanes.*[^8970]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Tone 7. Ode 1. Heirmos:* By Thy nod the water's nature, before easily molded, was transformed into an earthy form, O Lord; therefore Israel, having journeyed on foot dryshod, sings unto Thee a song of victory [cf. Exod. 14:21–22, 29].[^8971]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Apostles, pray to God for us.*[^8972]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having become godlike by a nod toward the divine, ye crushed the gods of the godless, and raised up all who have believed in God unto divine love, O all-honored ones.[^8973]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having become the salt of all the earth, O God-proclaiming Apostles of the Lord, stay all the rot of my heart, and heal that which has become bitterly foolish [cf. Matt. 5:13].[^8974]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* When the most righteous Judge of all is about to sit with you at the second coming, O divine Apostles: then deliver us from all condemnation [cf. Matt. 19:28].[^8975]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O most pure Mother of God, together with the incorporeal Angels, and the Prophets, and the Martyrs, and the Apostles, pray that we may receive forgiveness of transgressions, O Virgin, and rich mercy.[^8976]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Second Canon to the holy wonderworker Nicholas. (Whose acrostic is: Accept, Nicholas, the seventh supplication of Joseph.)*[^8977]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Tone 7. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Unto God Who aided Moses in Egypt to bring forth Israel, unto Him alone let us sing, for He hath been glorified [cf. Exod. 15:1].[^8978]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having passed through a glorified life upon earth, O Nicholas, make them that glorify thee partakers of the glory that is there.[^8979]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Sailing in the abyss of cruel things, we are compassed about by the waves of worldly temptations, O all-blessed one: deliver us from them.[^8980]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Extend unto me now a helpful hand of aid, O Father Nicholas: deliver me from enemies visible and invisible.[^8981]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who made the immaterial servants was born of thee, O Mother of God, because of ineffable mercy, and became visible unto men.[^8982]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Lord and Savior, Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens by Thy powerful Word, and all their host by the all-effecting and divine Spirit: establish me upon the immovable rock of Thy confession [cf. LXX Ps. 32:6].[^8983]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As the heavens declare the glory of God, as said the prophet, ye proclaim it, O divine disciples, explaining His divine incarnation and sufferings openly, O wise ones, whereby ye deliver all from passions, death, and corruption [cf. LXX Ps. 18:2].[^8984]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Ye were shown forth as sharpened arrows of Christ the Mighty One, O wise disciples of the Lord; deliver me from the arrows of the deceitful one, and heal my heart that is sorely wounded by the weapon of sin [cf. LXX Ps. 44:6; 119:4; Eph. 6:16].[^8985]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Me who have been bitterly deceived and stripped of the divine vesture, O disciples of Christ, hasten to enlighten with divine garments; for ye stripped bare all the wiles of the enemy, and clothed him with shame [cf. Gen. 3:7; Ps. 34:26; Eph. 6:11].[^8986]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Word, Who didst establish the heavenly hosts, Who gavest grace unto the Prophets, and the Disciples, and unto all the Martyrs: by their prayers, O God, and those of Thy most pure Mother, save all, and show bounty, as Thou art compassionate [cf. LXX Ps. 32:6].[^8987]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Canon to Nicholas. Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Lover of mankind, Who didst establish the heavens by a word, and didst establish the foundation of the earth upon many waters: establish my mind in Thy will [cf. LXX Ps. 32:6; 103:2, 5].[^8988]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Offering supplications for the world, save us from every necessity and countless afflictions, holy Nicholas.[^8989]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As thou didst deliver from prison them that were inextricably bound, so having torn asunder the bonds of my evils, reconcile me unto God by thy prayers, holy Nicholas.[^8990]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* By night and by day we call thee protector; offer our prayers unto the Lord, ever preserving us, holy Nicholas.[^8991]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Tongs, who didst receive the divine Coal within thy divine womb without being burned in any wise: burn up our transgressions, O Pure One [cf. Isa. 6:6].[^8992]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Leaving not the Father's bosom, and descending unto earth, O Christ God: I have heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, O only Lover of mankind.[^8993]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Son Who is co-enthroned with the Father, having become incarnate upon earth as...[^8994]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: ...man, chose you as disciples, to preach His Divinity unto all nations.[^8995]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having fallen in a mind-damaging way unto the creators of all passions, wretched that I am, I was wounded in heart; therefore I pray: heal me, O physicians of the sick, Apostles.[^8996]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Deliver us from passions, and from cruel misfortunes and sorrows, O glorious Apostles, and from every assault and all-painful torment.[^8997]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Chosen Mother of God, together with the holy Angels, and Martyrs, and Prophets, pray that we may be delivered from misfortunes, and afflictions, and transgressions.[^8998]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Canon to Nicholas. Ode 4. Heirmos:* The heavens have been covered by Thy dispensation, O Christ God, with the virtue of Thine ineffable wisdom, O Lover of mankind [cf. Hab. 3:3].[^8999]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By thy wisdom having blackened the mind of Arius that was darkened by heresy, O Nicholas, thou didst enlighten them that were deceived by him.[^9000]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Heal my many wounds by thy God-acceptable prayers, O God-blessed Father Nicholas, and enlighten my heart.[^9001]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having put to death passionate wantonness, and having quickened me who was mortified thereby through thy prayers, O all-blessed one, make me new.[^9002]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst bear in the flesh the Timeless One; implore Him, O all-immaculate one, to deliver us who sing of thee from evils of many years.[^9003]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Lord my God, rising early from the night unto Thee I pray: grant me forgiveness of my transgressions, and direct my paths unto the light of Thy commandments, I pray [cf. Isa. 26:9].[^9004]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Lord my God, Who of old didst bestow peace upon Thine Apostles: by their prayers grant peace unto all, and forgiveness of transgressions [cf. John 14:27; 20:19, 21].[^9005]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Lord my God, Who knowest the sins of my soul, and the uncorrected disposition of my heart: show bounty and save me, through the supplications of Thine Apostles.[^9006]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Lord my God, Who for Thy great goodness didst save the thief and the harlot who had sinned: by the prayers of Thine Apostles show bounty also unto me, the prodigal [cf. Luke 7:37–50; 23:39–43].[^9007]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Lord my God, Who wast born of the unwedded Virgin: by her...[^9008]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: ...prayers, and those of Thine Apostles, grant me cleansing of transgressions, and deliver me from future torment.[^9009]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Canon to Nicholas. Ode 5. Heirmos:* My spirit rises early unto Thee, O God, for Thou art light, and Thy commandments have become healings unto Thy servants, O Lover of mankind [cf. Isa. 26:9].[^9010]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The counsels of undisciplined men that are ever stirred up against us, O father Nicholas, make of no effect by thy prayers.[^9011]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Tear asunder the bonds of our evils by thy prayers, O all-holy Nicholas, who didst bind the malice of the soul-destroying serpent [cf. Gen. 3:1; Rev. 20:2].[^9012]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Ever sinning in mind, and held fast by a multitude of cruel things, O father, we warmly call upon thee, Nicholas, as our protector.[^9013]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Mary, Lady of all creation, completely set free my humble heart from the enemy who shamelessly seeks to dominate it, O Mother of God.[^9014]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Sailing in the surge of worldly cares, overwhelmed with the ship by sins, and cast forth unto the soul-corrupting beast, like Jonah I cry unto Thee, O Christ: Bring me up from the death-bearing abyss! [cf. Jonah 2:3–7].[^9015]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having become divine disciples of Wisdom Itself, they made foolish the Greek philosophy, and destroyed the sophist of malice; and them that were wandering in ignorance, the all-wise ones enlightened with the light of piety [cf. 1 Cor. 1:20].[^9016]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou Who of old didst cleanse Peter's transgression through his tears: by his prayers cleanse the innumerable transgressions of my soul, for the sake of Thy boundless tender compassion and Thine abundant goodness, O Christ [cf. Matt. 26:75].[^9017]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou Who of old didst show bounty unto the Ninevites who repented: by Thine accustomed tender mercy have mercy also upon me, for the sake of Thine Apostles; and because of the multitude of transgressions, O Redeemer, do not add a multitude of torments [cf. Jonah 3:5–10].[^9018]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O thou who didst bear the Light: enlighten my soul that is darkened by passions, and pray with the Apostles, and with the Prophets and Martyrs, that I may be delivered from every sin, every harm, and all malice of the enemy.[^9019]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Canon to Nicholas. Ode 6. Heirmos:* Jonah cried aloud from the belly of hades: Bring up my life from corruption; and we cry aloud unto Thee: O all-powerful Savior, have mercy upon us [cf. Jonah 2:3, 7].[^9020]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst destroy the unjust sentence of death, and by thy mercy, O Father Nicholas, didst save them that were about to die, as a fervent helper unto them that call upon thee [cf. the deliverance of the three innocent men from execution].[^9021]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Still the infirmities of our souls, and shut the mouths that are ever opened against them that love thee, O most holy pastor.[^9022]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou didst destroy the bitter pasture of Arius's impiety, O Nicholas, by the tempering of thy words, O sacred initiate; thou wast an establishment unto the Orthodox.[^9023]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Heal my wretched soul that is incurably sick with worldly deceptions, O all-immaculate one, and the besetment of many sins.[^9024]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Of old the youths showed forth the fiery furnace to be dropping dew, praising the one God, and saying: O God of the fathers, supremely exalted and exceedingly glorious [cf. Dan. 3:49–50].[^9025]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Of old ye quenched the furnace of bitter godlessness with the dew of divine preaching, O glorious Apostles, crying aloud: O God of the fathers, supremely exalted and exceedingly glorious.[^9026]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Snatch me, O Christ, from cruel sin, and from torment in hades, and from pains in Gehenna, and save me, I pray, by the supplications of Thine Apostles, O Word.[^9027]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having caught men with the net of the Word from the abyss of ignorance, O disciples of Christ, save me who am overwhelmed by boundless transgressions and tempest-tossed [cf. Matt. 4:19].[^9028]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With the Angels, with the Martyrs, with the Venerable, and the Apostles, O all-immaculate one, implore thy Son and Lord, that Thy servants may be saved from all manner of assaults and afflictions.[^9029]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Canon to Nicholas. Ode 7. Heirmos:* Thou didst bedew the burning furnace, O Savior, and didst save the children who sang and said: Blessed art Thou unto the ages, O Lord God of our fathers [cf. Dan. 3:49–50, 52].[^9030]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having become the beauty of the Church, O wise Nicholas, deliver me from all the ugliness of disgraceful passions, ever praying unto the Benefactor of the whole world, O hierarch.[^9031]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With the showers of thy prayers, O wise Nicholas, water the hearts of us all, that we may bring forth fruits worthy of repentance, O hierarch Nicholas [cf. Matt. 3:8].[^9032]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Enlighten with thy prayers the thoughts of us who rise early with faith and glorify God, O hierarch Nicholas, who by thy supplications didst destroy the temple of Artemis.[^9033]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Every tongue glorifies thee with faith, O Pure One, who art the glory and boast of our race, and the guide of the wandering, O all-blessed Mother of God.[^9034]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The bush that held communion with the fire on Sinai without being consumed made God known unto Moses, slow of tongue and of an impediment in his speech; and the zeal of God showed forth the three children in the fire to be unconquerable singers: Praise the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages [cf. Exod. 3:2; 4:10; Dan. 3:57].[^9035]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having been kindled as coals with the noetic fire, the disciples of Christ burned up all the idol delusion like reed, and enlightened the souls of the faithful who cry aloud: Praise the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^9036]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Enlighten now my soul darkened by sin, and my heart darkened by disgraceful passions, O Apostles of Christ, partakers of the ever-existing Light, that I may unceasingly cry aloud: Praise the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^9037]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Heal my soul that is wounded by the venomous bites of the proud one, O Thou Who didst receive wounds in the flesh, through the prayers of Thy sacred disciples, and save them that sing: Praise the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^9038]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having unburningly borne the Fire, thou wast preserved, O most pure Virgin; therefore implore Him Whom thou didst bear, together with the incorporeal Choirs and the Apostles, that they who sing with faith may be saved: Praise the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^9039]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Canon to Nicholas. Ode 8. Heirmos:* Imitating the children in the furnace, having received the spiritual dew, we cry aloud in faith: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord [cf. Dan. 3:49–50, 57].[^9040]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* In Myra thy body, fragrant with myrrh, O all-holy Nicholas, lying in the tomb, pours forth myrrh unto them that draw near, and stays infirmities in men.[^9041]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The Creator and Lord of the world showed thee forth as an intercessor for the world; therefore unto them that call upon thee in...[^9042]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: ...necessities now, O Nicholas, thou art found to be a most ready deliverer.[^9043]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* There is none who calls upon thee in afflictions, and does not quickly find consolation; therefore we pray thee: lighten all our infirmities, Nicholas.[^9044]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Every tongue sings of thee and glorifies thee, O Virgin Bride of God; for thou didst bear the all-hymned God; Him unceasingly implore, that our souls may be saved.[^9045]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *My soul magnifies the Lord:*[^9046]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Thee who without trial of corruption didst give birth, and didst lend flesh unto the Word, the all-craftsman, O Mother unwedded, Virgin Mother of God: receptacle of the Uncontainable, dwelling-place of thine uncontainable Creator, we magnify thee.[^9047]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Word of God the Father showed you forth as sons of the light and of the day; having loved Him, O divine Apostles, lights of the universe, destroyers of demons, guides of the wandering, ye were shown forth as firm foundations of the Church [cf. 1 Thess. 5:5; Eph. 2:20].[^9048]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Ye plows of the Word, who bore His easiest yoke upon your necks: renew now my soul that has grown barren through passions, and make it fruitful with the seed of repentance [cf. Matt. 11:30].[^9049]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Me who have been heedless of the divine commandments, and who have become a dwelling-place of demons and a workshop of every sin: show bounty unto me, O Word, through the prayers of Thy glorious Apostles, as Thou art the Lover of mankind.[^9050]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* The earth is sanctified by the divine relics of the all-glorious Apostles through the Holy Spirit; and the Church of the firstborn on high is unceasingly brightened by their spirits: for their sake, O Savior, show bounty unto all [cf. Heb. 12:23].[^9051]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* That Thou send me not into the fire prepared for me, the Virgin who bare Thee implores Thee, and the divine incorporeal Choirs, the Apostles, Prophets, and Martyrs, Hierarchs, and the spirits of the righteous, O all-bountiful, Most Merciful One [cf. Matt. 25:41].[^9052]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Canon to Nicholas. Ode 9. Heirmos:* Mother beyond nature, and Virgin according to nature, the only blessed one among women: with hymns we the faithful magnify the Mother of God [cf. Luke 1:28, 42].[^9053]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ный мо́й ᲂу҆́мъ грѣхо́мъ, ꙗ҆́же живо́тъ ро́ждшаѧ чи́стаѧ Дѣ́во ѡ҆животво-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having followed the manners of the holy Apostles, thou didst inherit their thrones, as a venerable hierarch, praiseworthy Nicholas.[^9054]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Въ Четверто́къ ѹ҆́тра, Гла́съ з҃. [шкд]
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As a divine zealot and a most great helper throughout all the world unto them that warmly call upon thee, O blessed one, the Creator showed thee forth.[^9055]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ревни́телѧ тѧ̀ бж҃е́ственнагѡ, и҆ помо́щника по всемѹ̀ тебѐ призыва́ющимъ те́плѣ, въ все́мъ мі́рѣ, Блаже́нне, Творе́цъ превели́ка показа̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* With a contrite heart we cry aloud unto thee, O Father: be thou consolation unto us in afflictions, ever driving away griefs from our souls, O Nicholas [cf. LXX Ps. 50:19].[^9056]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Сокрѹше́ннымъ се́рдцемъ вопіе́мъ тебѣ̀ ѻ҆́тче: ѹ҆тѣше́ніе на́мъ бѹ́ди въ ско́рбѣхъ, печа́ли разгонѧ́ѧ всегда̀ ѿ дѹ́шъ на́шихъ, Нїко́лае.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* The felling of death, like an axe unto a tree, lies before thee, O soul; be not slothful therefore, but strive earnestly to show forth fruits of repentance unto God [cf. Matt. 3:8, 10].[^9057]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Сме́ртное посѣче́ніе, ꙗ҆́кѡже сѣки́ра дре́вѹ предлежи́тъ тебѣ̀, ѽ дѹшѐ! не лѣни́сѧ ѹ҆́бѡ; покаѧ́ніѧ плоды̀ Бг҃ѹ показа́ти ѹ҆се́рдствѹй.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Thou dost bear Him Who bears all things with thy holy hands: Him implore, O Pure One, that we may be saved unharmed from the malice of the stranger [cf. Heb. 1:3].[^9058]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Но́сиши Носѧ́щаго всѧ́ческаѧ, ст҃ы́ми твои́ми рѹка́ми: є҆го́же молѝ Чи́стаѧ, ѿ чѹжда́гѡ ѕлодѣ́йствїѧ невре́днымъ на́мъ спасти́сѧ.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet. Litany, Exapostilarion, and the customary Psalms.*[^9059]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: є҆ктенїа̀, свѣти́ленъ и҆ ѱалмы̀ ѻ҆бы́чныѧ.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Apostles, Tone 7:*[^9060]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: На Стїхо́внѣ, стїхи̑ры А҆пⷭ҇толски, Гла́съ з҃.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Glorious angels, pillars of the Church, preachers of truth, being bright luminaries: by the spiritual fire ye burned up all delusion, and enlightened the human race [cf. Gal. 2:9; Phil. 2:15]. Therefore we pray you: implore the Savior and our God to bring peace to the world, and to save our souls.[^9061]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: А҆́гг҃ли сла́вніи, столпѝ церко́вніи, и҆́стины проповѣ́дницы, свѣти̑ла сѹ́ще свѣ́тлаѧ: вы̀ ѻ҆гне́мъ дх҃о́внымъ всѧ́кѹ пре́лесть попали́сте, человѣ́ческій же ро́дъ просвѣти́сте. Тѣ́мже мо́лимъ вы̀: моли́те Спа́са и҆ Бг҃а на́шего, ѹ҆мири́ти мі́ръ, и҆ спастѝ дѹ́ши на́шѧ.
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced... And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, and guide their sons [LXX Ps. 89:14, 16].* [^9062]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: И҆спо́лнихомсѧ заѹ́тра ми́лости твоеѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ возра́довахомсѧ: - - И҆ при́зри на рабы̑ твоѧ̑, и҆ на дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, и҆ наста́ви сы́ны и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Apostles of Christ, laborers of the Savior! Bearing the Cross like a plow upon your shoulders, having cleansed the earth possessed by idol delusion, ye sowed the word of faith [cf. Luke 9:62; Mark 4:14]: truly worthily are ye named the holy Apostles of Christ.[^9063]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: А҆́пⷭ҇ли Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви, дѣ́латели Спа́сѡви! кре́стъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ра́ло на ра́мѣхъ носѧ́ще, ѡ҆ладѣ́вшѹю зе́млю ѿ і҆́дѡлскїѧ ле́сти ѡ҆чи́стивше, вѣ́ры сло́во всѣ́ѧсте: вои́стиннѹ досто́йнѡ нарица́етесѧ ст҃і́и Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви А҆́пⷭ҇ли.
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and direct Thou the works of our hands over us; yea, the work of our hands do Thou direct [LXX Ps. 89:17].* [^9064]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: И҆ бѹ́ди свѣ́тлость Гдⷭ҇а Бг҃а на́шегѡ на на́съ, и҆ дѣла̀ рѹ́къ на́шихъ и҆спра́ви на на́съ; и҆ дѣ́ло рѹ́къ на́шихъ и҆спра́ви.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Breathing as one and looking unto one thing, O passion-bearing Martyrs, having found one way of life, which is death for Christ, being zealous for one another's end, O what a marvel! anticipating tortures like treasures, they said one to another: For if we die not now, we shall die in any case, and we shall pay what is due to existence; let us make necessity a point of honor, let that which is common be reckoned as our own; by death let us purchase life. By their prayers, O God, have mercy on us.[^9065]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^8879]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́но ды́шѹще, и҆ на є҆ди́но взира́юще страстоте́рпци Мѹ́ченици, є҆ди́нъ пѹ́ть живота̀ ѡ҆брѣ́тше, є҆́же за Хрⷭ҇та̀ сме́рть, ревнѹ́юще дрѹ́гъ дрѹ́га кончи́нѣ, ѽле чѹдесѐ! ꙗ҆́кѡ сокро́вища мѹ́ки предвосхища́юще, дрѹ́гъ къ дрѹ́гѹ глаго́лахѹ: ꙗ҆́ко а҆́ще не ны́нѣ ѹ҆́мремъ, ѹ҆́мремъ же всѧ́кѡ, и҆ бытїю̀ дѡ́лжнаѧ послѹ́жимъ; сотвори́мъ нѹ́ждѹ любоче́стїемъ, ѻ҆́бщее своѐ да вмѣни́мъ; сме́ртїю живо́тъ кѹ́пимъ. Моли́твами и҆́хъ Бж҃е, поми́лѹй на́съ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Thou wast born ineffably of the Virgin, O Christ, and Thou hast enlightened them that are in darkness, who cry aloud: Lord, glory to Thee [cf. Isa. 9:2; Luke 1:79].[^9066]

items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having driven away the darkening of cruel delusion by the light of preaching, O Apostles of the Lord, ye manifestly enlightened the hearts of the pious; therefore with divine songs we call you blessed.[^9071]

items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Though cut limb by limb with the sword, O divine sufferers, ye remained uncut from the love of the Redeemer [cf. Rom. 8:35]; ascending unto Whom, ye now live in joy, all illumined with heavenly glory.[^9072]

items.english_text: *Glory:* The most wicked corrupter of the human race holds me fast; through the prayers of Thy preachers, O almighty Trinity, snatch me from his throat, that I may magnify Thy boundless mercy.[^9073]

items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* That Thou mightest make man God, O Christ, Thou becamest man, O all-good Christ, and Thou wast crucified. Glory to Thy power![^9079]

items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Seeing the Lamb outstretched upon the Tree between two thieves, the spotless Ewe-lamb and Virgin cried aloud: Woe is me, my sweetest Child! What is this strange and most glorious mystery? How has the lawless assembly raised Thee upon the Cross, and given Thee gall to drink, Who didst satisfy men with manna [cf. Matt. 27:34, 38; Exod. 16:15]?[^9084]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́но ды́шѹще, и҆ на є҆ди́но взира́юще страстоте́рпци Мѹ́ченици, є҆ди́нъ пѹ́ть живота̀ ѡ҆брѣ́тше, є҆́же за Хрⷭ҇та̀ сме́рть, ревнѹ́юще дрѹ́гъ дрѹ́га кончи́нѣ, ѽле чѹдесѐ! ꙗ҆́кѡ сокро́вища мѹ́ки предвосхища́юще, дрѹ́гъ къ дрѹ́гѹ глаго́лахѹ: ꙗ҆́ко а҆́ще не ны́нѣ ѹ҆́мремъ, ѹ҆́мремъ же всѧ́кѡ, и҆ бытїю̀ дѡ́лжнаѧ послѹ́жимъ; сотвори́мъ нѹ́ждѹ любоче́стїемъ, ѻ҆́бщее своѐ да вмѣни́мъ; сме́ртїю живо́тъ кѹ́пимъ. Моли́твами и҆́хъ Бж҃е, поми́лѹй на́съ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* When the Virgin and Thy Mother saw Thee nailed to the Cross by the judgment of the lawless Jews upon the Place of the Skull, O my Christ, she cried aloud: Woe is me, my most beloved Son! What is this strange sight? How do the senseless Jewish children nail Thee, the Lord of all, unto the Cross [cf. Matt. 27:33]?[^9085]

items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Knowing thee alone, O all-holy Sovereign Lady, to be revealed as a Virgin after childbearing, seeing Him Whom thou didst bear without seed willingly nailing His hands unto the Tree, the all-pure one weeping cried aloud: Willingly, O Long-suffering One, Thou diest, delivering from death all them that sing praise unto Thee.[^9086]

items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:* I am wounded with the sword of grief, seeing Thee upon the Cross Who suspended the earth upon the waters and didst stretch out the heaven like a skin [cf. Luke 2:35; Job 26:7; LXX Ps. 103:2]; for I see Thee hanging naked and outstretched, and I choose rather to die first, O my most beloved Son! Tremble, O earth, and be shaken! said the all-pure one weeping.[^9087]

Luke 2:10–14]; but these things have manifestly been turned into sorrow by Thy crucifixion, and grief tears me apart, and I choose to die, sorrow having filled my heart.[^9095]

items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Sovereign Lady Mother of God, save us.*[^9100]

items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́но ды́шѹще, и҆ на є҆ди́но взира́юще страстоте́рпци Мѹ́ченици, є҆ди́нъ пѹ́ть живота̀ ѡ҆брѣ́тше, є҆́же за Хрⷭ҇та̀ сме́рть, ревнѹ́юще дрѹ́гъ дрѹ́га кончи́нѣ, ѽле чѹдесѐ! ꙗ҆́кѡ сокро́вища мѹ́ки предвосхища́юще, дрѹ́гъ къ дрѹ́гѹ глаго́лахѹ: ꙗ҆́ко а҆́ще не ны́нѣ ѹ҆́мремъ, ѹ҆́мремъ же всѧ́кѡ, и҆ бытїю̀ дѡ́лжнаѧ послѹ́жимъ; сотвори́мъ нѹ́ждѹ любоче́стїемъ, ѻ҆́бщее своѐ да вмѣни́мъ; сме́ртїю живо́тъ кѹ́пимъ. Моли́твами и҆́хъ Бж҃е, поми́лѹй на́съ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Foreseeing the end of my life that has come, O Sovereign Lady, I cry aloud: do thou grant me cleansing of sins, O Bride of God.[^9101]

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having fled unto the deep of thy goodness, I cry aloud: O good Sovereign Lady, deliver me from all torment.[^9102]

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O thou who ineffably didst conceive God and the Master, deliver me who am held fast by the tempest of sin from these things, and save me, O all-pure one.[^9106]

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Illumine me with the rays of repentance, who am held fast by the night of unseemly sins, O Maiden, granting me ever to do bright deeds [cf. Rom. 13:12].[^9107]

items.english_text: *Glory:* O Mother of God who didst bear the heavenly Bread, Who nourishes the hearts of all the faithful: satisfy my passionate, hungering soul [cf. John 6:33, 35].[^9108]

items.english_text: *Both now:* I was established, having understood thy divine childbearing, and I am enriched by thy protection, O Virgin, crying: Holy art Thou, O Lord, Who savest our souls.[^9109]

items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* I heard report of Thee, and was afraid; I considered Thy works, and was astonished, O Lord [LXX Hab. 3:2].[^9110]

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Despise me not, neither put me to shame, who groan before thee, O Sovereign Lady, and diligently cry aloud from my mind.[^9111]

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Burn up the thorns of carnal pleasures that have pierced my wretched soul, O Sovereign Lady who didst bear the divine Fire [cf. Heb. 6:8; 12:29].[^9112]

items.english_text: *Glory:* Grant me remission of sins, O all-blessed Pure One, and deliver me from eternal and fearful torment.[^9113]

items.english_text: *Both now:* The Word that dwelt within thee, O all-pure one, fashioned anew my nature that was fallen through transgressions.[^9114]

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I, most wretched, have become like irrational beasts, serving my wretched flesh through irrational passions [cf. LXX Ps. 48:13, 21]: do thou, O Mother of God, grant me revival.[^9116]

items.english_text: *Glory:* O Virgin who didst release Eve from pangs by thy most pure childbearing: release for me, O Maiden, the passionate sicknesses of my soul and body [cf. Gen. 3:16].[^9123]

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 7:* The Fruit of thy womb, O Pure One, planted the Cross in the ends of the earth, and delivered the world from corruption; therefore as most glorious we magnify thee.[^9126]

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The threat of my transgressions has multiplied, worthy of judgment; O Pure One, I fall down and cry unto thee: before the end grant me cleansing, and tears of compunction, and amendment of ways.[^9128]

items.english_text: *Glory:* O good Mother of God, delivering them that call with faith upon thy ever-living grace from spiritual death, vouchsafe them the kingdom through thy most pure prayers.[^9130]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́но ды́шѹще, и҆ на є҆ди́но взира́юще страстоте́рпци Мѹ́ченици, є҆ди́нъ пѹ́ть живота̀ ѡ҆брѣ́тше, є҆́же за Хрⷭ҇та̀ сме́рть, ревнѹ́юще дрѹ́гъ дрѹ́га кончи́нѣ, ѽле чѹдесѐ! ꙗ҆́кѡ сокро́вища мѹ́ки предвосхища́юще, дрѹ́гъ къ дрѹ́гѹ глаго́лахѹ: ꙗ҆́ко а҆́ще не ны́нѣ ѹ҆́мремъ, ѹ҆́мремъ же всѧ́кѡ, и҆ бытїю̀ дѡ́лжнаѧ послѹ́жимъ; сотвори́мъ нѹ́ждѹ любоче́стїемъ, ѻ҆́бщее своѐ да вмѣни́мъ; сме́ртїю живо́тъ кѹ́пимъ. Моли́твами и҆́хъ Бж҃е, поми́лѹй на́съ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* We glorify the incomprehensible childbearing of the Virgin, whereby we were delivered from death; on Whose account being born into incorruption, we cry: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.[^9131]

items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The one unoriginate King of glory, Whom the heavenly powers bless, and the angelic hosts tremble before: praise Him, ye priests; supremely exalt Him, ye people, unto the ages [cf. Dan. 3:57–58].[^9132]

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The furnace of passions burns me, O Virgin, and subjects me to the fire of pleasures; do thou make haste and quench it with thy merciful dew, granting strong cooling unto my soul.[^9133]

items.english_text: *Glory:* Implore God Whom thou didst bear, O Virgin, to send down salvation unto them that honor thee with faith, and release from perils, and swift change from cruel infirmities, and eternal grace.[^9135]

items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* O all-hymned one, higher than the heavens, who without seed didst conceive the unoriginate Word, and didst bear incarnate God unto men: therefore we all magnify thee.[^9137]

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O all-radiant Virgin Mother, Mother of God, guide brightly into the fear of God my wretched soul, grievously darkened by carnal passions, by the light of thy prayers.[^9138]

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having despaired of salvation because of the multitude of my transgressions, and being found in perplexity, O all-holy Sovereign Lady: send down upon me thy beneficence and thy mercy.[^9139]

items.english_text: *Both now:* Strip me, O Virgin, of the garments of mortification and corruption, who didst bear the garment of salvation, the incarnate Word, unto men [cf. Isa. 61:10]; therefore we all ever magnify thee.[^9141]

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* The Church cries aloud unto Thee, O Christ God, in the pine, the cedar, and the cypress, worshiping Thee [cf. Isa. 60:13]: grant victories unto our Emperor (Name)[^9145] for the sake of the Mother of God, and have mercy on us.[^9146]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́но ды́шѹще, и҆ на є҆ди́но взира́юще страстоте́рпци Мѹ́ченици, є҆ди́нъ пѹ́ть живота̀ ѡ҆брѣ́тше, є҆́же за Хрⷭ҇та̀ сме́рть, ревнѹ́юще дрѹ́гъ дрѹ́га кончи́нѣ, ѽле чѹдесѐ! ꙗ҆́кѡ сокро́вища мѹ́ки предвосхища́юще, дрѹ́гъ къ дрѹ́гѹ глаго́лахѹ: ꙗ҆́ко а҆́ще не ны́нѣ ѹ҆́мремъ, ѹ҆́мремъ же всѧ́кѡ, и҆ бытїю̀ дѡ́лжнаѧ послѹ́жимъ; сотвори́мъ нѹ́ждѹ любоче́стїемъ, ѻ҆́бщее своѐ да вмѣни́мъ; сме́ртїю живо́тъ кѹ́пимъ. Моли́твами и҆́хъ Бж҃е, поми́лѹй на́съ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* O Thou Who for my sake didst endure nailing to the Cross, receive my vigilant praise, O Christ God, and save me, as Thou art the Lover of mankind.[^9148]

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Seeing Thy Cross ever exalted, O Lord, we approach with songs and hymns in faith, kissing it with fear and joy: sanctify Thy servants and bring peace to Thy world by its manifestation, O only Most Merciful One.[^9153]

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Thy precious Cross, O Christ, is the weapon of the world and unconquerable victory: whereby casting down invisible enemies, we thankfully sing praise unto Thee.[^9158]

Моли́твами и҆́хъ Бж҃е, поми́лѹй на́съ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Christ, being lifted up upon the Cross, drew all men unto Himself, and cast down the enemy who had cast down all [cf. John 12:32].[^9164]

items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Seeing Him Who shone forth from thee in His exceeding tender compassion hanging upon the Cross, O Sovereign Lady, thou didst weep, glorifying Him.[^9168]

items.english_text: *Second Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. A creation of Joseph. Tone 7. Heirmos the same.*[^9169]

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst renew our forefather Adam who had fallen into the corruption of disobedience, O all-pure one, having borne God in the flesh [cf. Rom. 5:19].[^9170]

items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Quicken my mortified mind by the life-giving energy of Him Who was truly born of thee, O all-pure Virgin.[^9172]

items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* They that bless thee in faith are manifestly blessed by God; for thou didst bear the fountain of blessing, O only All-Hymned One [cf. Gen. 12:3; Gal. 3:9].[^9173]

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The assembly of the Orthodox is set aright, singing of thee, the all-holy one, as Mother of God, crying unto thee with the Archangel: Rejoice [cf. Luke 1:28]![^9193]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́но ды́шѹще, и҆ на є҆ди́но взира́юще страстоте́рпци Мѹ́ченици, є҆ди́нъ пѹ́ть живота̀ ѡ҆брѣ́тше, є҆́же за Хрⷭ҇та̀ сме́рть, ревнѹ́юще дрѹ́гъ дрѹ́га кончи́нѣ, ѽле чѹдесѐ! ꙗ҆́кѡ сокро́вища мѹ́ки предвосхища́юще, дрѹ́гъ къ дрѹ́гѹ глаго́лахѹ: ꙗ҆́ко а҆́ще не ны́нѣ ѹ҆́мремъ, ѹ҆́мремъ же всѧ́кѡ, и҆ бытїю̀ дѡ́лжнаѧ послѹ́жимъ; сотвори́мъ нѹ́ждѹ любоче́стїемъ, ѻ҆́бщее своѐ да вмѣни́мъ; сме́ртїю живо́тъ кѹ́пимъ. Моли́твами и҆́хъ Бж҃е, поми́лѹй на́съ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Smitten is the face of Nestorius, who would not profess thee to be the pure Mother of God; for truly, O all-pure one, thou didst bear God.[^9194]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́но ды́шѹще, и҆ на є҆ди́но взира́юще страстоте́рпци Мѹ́ченици, є҆ди́нъ пѹ́ть живота̀ ѡ҆брѣ́тше, є҆́же за Хрⷭ҇та̀ сме́рть, ревнѹ́юще дрѹ́гъ дрѹ́га кончи́нѣ, ѽле чѹдесѐ! ꙗ҆́кѡ сокро́вища мѹ́ки предвосхища́юще, дрѹ́гъ къ дрѹ́гѹ глаго́лахѹ: ꙗ҆́ко а҆́ще не ны́нѣ ѹ҆́мремъ, ѹ҆́мремъ же всѧ́кѡ, и҆ бытїю̀ дѡ́лжнаѧ послѹ́жимъ; сотвори́мъ нѹ́ждѹ любоче́стїемъ, ѻ҆́бщее своѐ да вмѣни́мъ; сме́ртїю живо́тъ кѹ́пимъ. Моли́твами и҆́хъ Бж҃е, поми́лѹй на́съ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Finding thee fair and radiant in beauties, the Bridegroom made His abode in thee, and made thee the Mother of God, O all-pure one [cf. LXX Ps. 44:3; Song 1:15–16].[^9195]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́но ды́шѹще, и҆ на є҆ди́но взира́юще страстоте́рпци Мѹ́ченици, є҆ди́нъ пѹ́ть живота̀ ѡ҆брѣ́тше, є҆́же за Хрⷭ҇та̀ сме́рть, ревнѹ́юще дрѹ́гъ дрѹ́га кончи́нѣ, ѽле чѹдесѐ! ꙗ҆́кѡ сокро́вища мѹ́ки предвосхища́юще, дрѹ́гъ къ дрѹ́гѹ глаго́лахѹ: ꙗ҆́ко а҆́ще не ны́нѣ ѹ҆́мремъ, ѹ҆́мремъ же всѧ́кѡ, и҆ бытїю̀ дѡ́лжнаѧ послѹ́жимъ; сотвори́мъ нѹ́ждѹ любоче́стїемъ, ѻ҆́бщее своѐ да вмѣни́мъ; сме́ртїю живо́тъ кѹ́пимъ. Моли́твами и҆́хъ Бж҃е, поми́лѹй на́съ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* My spirit seeks Thee early in the morning, O God, for Thou art light, and Thy commandments... [cf. LXX Isa. 26:9].[^9196]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Въ Пато́къ ѹ҆́тра, Гла́съ з҃. [шл҃д]
items.english_text: ...have become healing unto Thy servants, O Lover of mankind.[^9197]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: бы́ша и҆сцѣле́нїа рабѡ́мъ твои̑мъ, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being lifted up upon the Tree in the flesh, O Master, Thou didst draw all creation forth from the pit of grievous ignorance unto the knowledge of Thyself, O Lover of mankind.[^9198]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Воздви́жимь Влады́ко на дре́во пло́тїю, тва́рь всю̀ и҆зъ ро́ва лю́тыхъ неразѹ́мїа и҆звле́клъ є҆сѝ, къ ра́зѹмѹ твоемѹ̀ Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* At the Place of the Skull, the lawless people demanded to crucify Thee, O Jesus, Who crushest the ruinous head of the serpent.[^9199]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: На Ло́бнѣмъ тѧ̀ мѣ́стѣ и҆спроси́ша лю́дїе беззако́ннїи распѧ́ти І҆и҃се, главѹ̀ па́гѹбнѹю ѕмі́евѹ сокрѹша́ющаго.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Ye stayed the flow of impiety, O martyrs of Christ, by your divine blood, and in it ye drowned the tormentor Pharaoh.[^9200]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ста́висте ѕлоче́стїа тече́нїе Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви Мч҃еници, бж҃е́ственными кровмѝ ва́шими, и҆ Фараѡ́на мѹчи́телѧ въ си́хъ потопи́сте.
items.english_text: *Another for the Martyrs:* Being scraped mercilessly with iron claws, O passion-bearers, by your refutations ye tore asunder the vain-minded hearts, and became victors.[^9201]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Ногтьмѝ неща́днѡ стро́жеми, растерза́сте ѡ҆бличе́ньми Страда́лцы сердца̀ сѹемѹ́дреннаѧ, и҆ побѣди́телїе бы́сте.
