items.english_text: *Glory... Both now: Stavrotheotokion:* God hath sanctified Thy womb, O holy and pure one, and made His abode therein; and being lifted up upon the Cross, He co-elevated creation with Himself.[^9202]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆свѧти́лъ є҆́сть Бг҃ъ ѹ҆тро́бѹ твою̀ ст҃а́ѧ Чи́стаѧ, и҆ всели́сѧ въ ню̀; и҆ на крⷭ҇тъ воздви́женъ, тва́рь совоздви́глъ є҆́сть.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The Heirmos the same:*[^9203]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃олѣ́пнѹю твою̀ Госпожѐ и҆ кра́снѹю, и҆ сладча́йшѹю и҆ благѹ́ю добро́тѹ возлюби́въ Влады́ка, въ тѧ̀ Дѣ́во всели́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having loved Thy God-befitting, comely, most sweet, and good beauty, O Lady, the Master took up His abode in Thee, O Virgin.[^9204]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Всест҃а́ѧ и҆ свѣтоно́снаѧ две́ре благода́ти, вселе́ннѹю свѣтлѣ́йшимъ твои́мъ свѣ́томъ ѡ҆зари́вши Ѻ҆трокови́це, тебѐ пою́щїѧ просвѣтѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O all-holy and light-bearing portal of grace, having illumined the universe with Thy most bright light, O Maiden, enlighten those who sing of Thee.[^9205]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Бцⷣѹ и҆сповѣ́дающїи тѧ̀ Ма́ти Дѣ́во, непреидѹ́щагѡ ца́рствїа и҆ пи́щи, тобо́ю Бг҃ома́ти, ѹ҆лѹчи́ти да сподо́батсѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* May those who confess Thee to be the Theotokos, O Virgin Mother, be counted worthy through Thee, O Mother of God, to attain unto the unfading kingdom and delight.[^9206]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Хра́мъ ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ Всеви́дца и҆ Вседержи́телѧ; твою̀ бо ѹ҆тро́бѹ честнѣ́йшѹю небе́съ ѡ҆брѣ́тъ водвори́сѧ, Бг҃ороди́тельнице всечи́стаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* A temple of the All-seeing and Almighty One hast Thou been shown to be; for finding Thy womb more honorable than the heavens, He took up His dwelling therein, O all-pure Theotokos.[^9207]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: І҆ѡ́на и҆зъ чре́ва а҆́дова вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й; мы́ же тебѣ̀ вопїе́мъ: всеси́льне Спа́се, поми́лѹй на́съ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Jonah cried out from the belly of Hades: Lead my life up from corruption! And we cry aloud unto Thee: O almighty Savior, have mercy upon us![^9208]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Недѹ́говавшее человѣ́ческое є҆стество̀, ꙗ҆́вльсѧ за милосе́рдїе ми́лости, врачѹ̀ недѹ́гѹющихъ, и҆сцѣли́лъ є҆сѝ кресто́мъ и҆ стра́стїю твое́ю.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having appeared by reason of the tender compassion of Thy mercy, O Physician of the diseased, Thou didst heal ailing human nature by Thy Cross and Passion.[^9209]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Дре́вомъ дре́вле А҆да́мъ ѡ҆сѹди́сѧ; дре́вомъ же ны́нѣ кре́стнымъ ѡ҆правда́сѧ, вхожде́ніе прїе́мъ въ ра́й, и҆ сла́дости воспрїѧ́тїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By the tree of old Adam was condemned; but by the Tree of the Cross he hath now been justified, receiving entrance into Paradise and the reception of its sweetness.[^9210]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* We sing of Thee Who wast crucified in the flesh; we glorify Thee Who wast crowned with thorns and hast crowned mankind with glory, O most good King.[^9211]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having cast away the destructive harm of idolatry, O sufferers, having partaken of torments and died, ye reign with Christ.[^9212]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Another for the Martyrs:* Neither persecution, nor famine, nor nakedness, nor perils, nor death at all separated the divine passion-bearers from the love of Christ.[^9213]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now: Stavrotheotokion:* Thou dost hymn in song Him Who was incarnate of Thee, and dost weep, beholding Him lifted up upon the Cross, O holy and all-immaculate Virgin Mother.[^9214]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The Heirmos the same:*[^9215]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* In God-manly manner, Thou didst bear Him Who dwelt among mankind, O Theotokos Virgin, the only Benefactor, Who grants unto men their very being.[^9216]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Theotokos, Thou didst give birth unto Emmanuel, twofold in essence, Who was aforetime the perfect Word, God incarnate, Who grants redemption unto us.[^9217]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The ark that received the tables of the law prefigured Thee, O Theotokos, as having received in Thy womb the Word of God incarnate for our sake.[^9218]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Though filled with angelic tongues, they cannot proclaim Thy praises, O pure one. Yet we now, having received it as servants, offer Gabriel's "Rejoice!"[^9219]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The children of old showed the fiery furnace to be dew-dropping, hymning the one God and saying: The highly exalted and most glorious God of our fathers.[^9220]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Lightening the burden of my lawlessness, Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross in the midst of the lawless, O most good Jesus: the highly exalted and most good God of our fathers.[^9221]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Being pierced with a spear in Thy divine side, Thou didst right the stumbling of the rib, O Savior, and Thou commandest the fiery sword ever to give me entrance into Paradise.[^9222]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Having become stars upon the height of the founded Church, O martyrs, ye illuminate creation with the brightness of your sufferings and with the radiance of healings.[^9223]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Another for the Martyrs:* The book of the living ever records the Lord's martyrs who have zealously preserved the written ordinances of God and suffered valiantly.[^9224]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now: Stavrotheotokion:* The all-holy one, beholding the all-holy Word Who shone forth from her lifted up upon the holy Cross and sanctifying those upon earth, wept aloud.[^9225]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The Heirmos the same:*[^9226]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thy Child indeed saved those in the fiery furnace of old; and now save us, O all-immaculate one, who cry aloud unto His coming which is beyond word: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^9227]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* David the Forefather of God, indeed, inscribs Thy glory, O Virgin, and clearly prophesies Thee to be the Queen of creatures, standing at the right hand, O all-immaculate one, of the God of our fathers.[^9228]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou didst renew the nature of earthborn men, O pure one, by the renewal of Thy childbearing. Therefore we cry aloud unto Thee: Blessed unto all ages, O Lady, is the fruit of Thy womb.[^9229]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Having had mercy through Thee upon Adam who was condemned and held fast by death, O all-pure one, the second Adam called him, who cried: Blessed art Thou Who wast born and hast renewed me.[^9230]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The only unoriginate King of glory, Whom the heavenly hosts bless and the angelic ranks tremble before: praise Him, ye priests; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^9231]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The tree of knowledge showed me dead; yet Thou, O my Christ, having died upon the Tree, didst make me alive and enlighten me to sing: Praise Him, ye priests; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^9232]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The law-transgressing council crowned Thee with thorns, O King, Who uprootest the thorns of disobedience of the first-created Adam, and lifted Thee up upon the Cross, Who didst draw all men out of the abyss of deceit.[^9233]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The senseless people stretched Thee upon the Tree, Who by understanding didst stretch out the heavens, Who healest our passions by Thy Passion, O Savior, and stayest our sicknesses by the pangs of the nails.[^9234]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* The relics of the martyrs emit the fragrance of miracles unto those who draw near with undoubting heart, and ever drive away the stench of passions, and grant health in God unto all.[^9235]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now: Stavrotheotokion:* The ranks of the saints pray unto the Master Who came forth from Thy womb, O Virgin, Who showed them upon the Cross the path of suffering, O pure one; and they hymn Thee in glory as Queen of all.[^9236]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The Heirmos the same:*[^9237]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The incomprehensible Master of all, Whom the heavens cannot contain, O Theotokos, is contained within Thy womb, O Virgin; therefore, we faithful supremely exalt Thee with love unto the ages.[^9238]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Him Who is higher than the intellect of all creation, O Maiden, Whom created nature cannot behold, hast Thou borne in Thy most pure arms; therefore, we faithful supremely exalt Thee with love unto all ages.[^9239]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Entreat God, Whom Thou didst bear, O Virgin, to send down salvation unto those who faithfully honor Thee, and deliverance from perils, and swift relief from grievous infirmities, and eternal grace.[^9240]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Knowing Thee to be adorned with diverse virtues and an illuminated temple of the Most High, O all-holy Virgin, we piously sing of Thee and hymn Thee in glory unto all ages.[^9241]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *My soul magnifies the Lord:*[^9242]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* O all-hymned one, higher than the heavens, who didst conceive without seed the unoriginate Word and bear incarnate God unto mankind: therefore do we all magnify Thee.[^9243]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* When the sun beheld Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O King of the ages, it was darkened, and the earth was shaken, and the veil of the temple was rent in its brightness, O Jesus all-powerful.[^9244]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The lawless dug into Thy hands and Thy feet, and pierced Thy life-bearing side with a spear, and gave Thee gall with vinegar to drink, O my Christ, the Sweetness of all and true God.[^9245]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Crushed by every form of torment, they broke the snares of the author of evil; and having become crown-bearers in victory, the valiant sufferers are called blessed.[^9246]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Another for the Martyrs:* The passion-bearers sanctified all the earth by the deposition of their relics, and quenched the foul stench of idol-sacrifices, commingling with fire and therein being mystically offered as whole burnt-offerings.[^9247]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now: Stavrotheotokion:* O lover of goodness, holier than the Cherubim, who didst bear in the flesh God the Word of God...[^9248]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: ...Who was lifted up voluntarily upon the Cross: diligently entreat Him on behalf of all.[^9249]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. The Heirmos the same:*[^9250]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Humanity was all-perfectly assumed from Thee, O all-pure Maiden, the Word having united Himself unto ensouled flesh adorned with a rational soul; therefore do all we faithful magnify Thee.[^9251]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Let the babbling of orators be silent, and let the apostolic trumpet sound forth, praising Thee with true voices, O Virgin, and proclaiming Thee to be truly the Theotokos.[^9252]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* By Thy sake hath humanity found mercy, being truly united hypostatically unto the Word, and by recompense made divine, O Virgin; therefore do we all ever magnify Thee.[^9253]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Through prophetic keenness of sight the mystery of Thy childbearing was foreshown, O Maiden, in that Thou didst bear incarnate God unto mankind, Who delivers us from tribulations by Thy prayers.[^9254]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Litany, Exapostilarion, and the customary psalms.*[^9255]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 7:*[^9256]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Being Master, Lover of mankind, and Giver of life, Thou hast redeemed the universe by Thy Cross. O Lord, glory to Thee.[^9257]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced: [and in all our days we were glad. Let us be glad for the days wherein Thou hast humbled us, for the years wherein we have seen evils.] And look upon Thy servants, and [upon Thy works,] and guide their sons.* [^9258]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* The true Vine was nailed to the Cross; the Gentiles took possession of Paradise with the thief. This is the glory of the Church! This is the wealth of the Kingdom! O Lord Who didst suffer for our sake, glory to Thee.[^9259]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us: [and the works of our hands do Thou direct upon us;] and the work of our hands do Thou direct.* [^9260]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Celebrating the memory of Thy holy passion-bearers, we sing of Thee, O Christ, crying aloud: O Lord, glory to Thee.[^9261]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now: Stavrotheotokion:* Crucifixion and slaughter as an evildoer didst Thou submit to, O Long-suffering One, that Thou mightest raise us up again by Thy Tree of the Cross, who were fallen by reason of the tree. But the Virgin who bore Thee was struck with dread, beholding Thee dead, and groaning cried aloud: O unrighteous fury! How do the lawless slay the Righteous One?[^9262]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise: Trisagion, and after Our Father: Troparion, Litany, First Hour, and Dismissal.*[^9263]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *On Friday, The Beatitudes, Tone 7:*[^9264]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Comely was the fruit and good for food that put me to death; but Christ is the Tree of Life, whereof eating I die not, but cry aloud with the thief: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom.[^9265]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Healing Adam's ailment, which was inflicted by the enemy's counsel, Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree, O King of all, and didst endure afflictions, being nailed in hands and feet; therefore do we glorify Thy long-suffering, O Word.[^9266]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Between the two lawless ones the Jewish gathering crucified Thee, the only Lawgiver and Redeemer, Who deliverest mankind from every lawlessness, O Christ; therefore we sing of Thee.[^9267]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *For the Martyrs:* Bearing the wounds of many torments as comely adornments, O valiant sufferers, ye were recognized as a radiant adornment of the Church, ever praying for our souls.[^9268]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Glory: Triadikon:* O Holy Trinity, deliver from torments Thy faithful servants who have believed in Thee, Who art in one Godhead unceasingly glorified with piety, and grant us Thine eternal Kingdom.[^9269]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^9075]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Both now: Stavrotheotokion:* Having neither form nor comeliness, beholding Thee, O Christ, lifted up in the flesh upon the Tree of the Cross, the all-pure Virgin cried out with pain: Woe is me! How have the lawless wounded Thee, O Child?[^9270]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *On Friday Evening.*[^9272]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerables, Tone 7:*[^9273]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* The martyrs drove away the darkness of godlessness, having shown forth the light of the knowledge of God unto all mankind.[^9275]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* By Orthodox teachings, as with divine rays, ye illuminated the Church of the Lord, O all-wise shepherds.[^9276]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Ye shattered the snares of the demons, dwelling ever in trackless wildernesses, O venerable fathers.[^9277]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Martyrs, in the same Tone:*[^9278]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* Put me not to shame, O Savior, when Thou comest to judge the whole world, for I have wrought shameful deeds.[^9279]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5:* Glory to Thee, O Christ God, the boast of the Apostles and the joy of the Martyrs, whose proclamation was the consubstantial Trinity.[^9280]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 6:* O holy martyrs, who have fought the good fight and been crowned: pray unto the Lord that our souls may be saved.[^9281]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now: Theotokion (Dogmatikon):* A Mother indeed wast Thou known to be beyond nature, O Theotokos, yet Thou didst remain a virgin beyond word and understanding; and the miracle of Thy childbearing tongue cannot express. For the conception being most glorious, O pure one, incomprehensible is the manner of Thy giving birth; for wherever God wills, the order of nature is overcome. Therefore, knowing Thee to be the Mother of God, we all earnestly beseech Thee: Pray that our souls may be saved.[^9282]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light: Prokeimenon of the day.*[^9283]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Martyrs, Tone 7:*[^9284]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Taking no thought for any earthly things, O holy martyrs, and having manly preached Christ before the judgment seat, ye received from Him the recompense for your torments. But as ye have boldness, entreat Him as almighty God, we pray you, to save our souls who flee unto you.[^9285]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Verse: Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes, unto Thee that dwellest in heaven. [Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hands of their masters, as the eyes of the maiden unto the hands of her mistress,] so do our eyes look unto the Lord our God, until He take pity on us.* [^9286]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* O all-praised martyrs, spiritual sheep, rational whole burnt-offerings, a sacrifice acceptable and well-pleasing unto God: neither did the earth conceal you, but heaven received you. Ye became companions of the angels; with them pray, we beseech you, our Savior and God, to pacify the world and save our souls.[^9287]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3 (Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ)):* In Thine own image and likeness having fashioned man in the beginning, O Lord, Thou didst place him in Paradise to rule over Thy creations; but deceived by the envy of the devil, he partook of the food, becoming a transgressor of Thy commandments. Therefore back into the earth...[^9289]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: ...whence he was taken, didst Thou condemn him to return, O Lord, and to ask for rest.[^9290]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *For the Departed:* Give rest, O our Savior and Giver of life, unto our brethren whom Thou hast translated from temporal things, who cry: O Lord, glory to Thee.[^9291]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now: Theotokion:* Daniel beheld Thee as the divine holy mountain, and wise Isaiah proclaimed Thee as Mother of God, O pure one, who didst contain in the flesh God, Who fashioned Adam: Whom, being incarnate, the Cherubim tremble before, singing and glorifying Him unceasingly with thrice-holy voices; and Him they entreat that our souls may be saved.[^9292]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *On Friday at Compline, Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 7:*[^9293]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* At Thy nod the once fluid watery nature was changed into an earthly form, O Lord; therefore Israel, having journeyed on dry land, sings unto Thee a hymn of victory.[^9294]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Refrain:* Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.[^9295]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Lady Theotokos, deliver those who have hope in Thee and flee unto Thee from afflictions and tribulations, and from falling, and from eternal fire and torment.[^9296]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With the dew of Thy tender mercy, O pure Virgin, quench the flame of my downfalls, that I may not come unto the trial of all condemnation and future fire.[^9297]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Rain down upon me, O Virgin, drops of Thy tender mercy, who am ever dried up by the heat of passions, that I may unceasingly glorify God and our Savior Who was born of Thee.[^9298]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Both now:* With the water of Thy prayer, O Virgin, bedew my soul which is inflamed with sorrowful heat, that I may bring forth fruits of divine gladness unto Him Who was born of Thee.[^9299]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* In the beginning, having established the heavens by Thy all-powerful Word, O Lord Savior, and all their host by the all-effective and divine Spirit: establish me upon the immovable rock of the confession of Thee.[^9300]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thee do I entreat, O Virgin: grant salvation and cleansing unto my soul, and ungrudging grace, as Thou art powerful and good, and as a maiden loving mankind, and vouchsafe me incorruptible life.[^9301]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O unerring salvation and protectress of the world, who didst bear the Creator...[^9302]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: ...O pure Virgin: deliver from perils those who faithfully sing of Thee, and from the tribulations of life, and from eternal condemnation.[^9303]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Glory:* We diligently pray unto Thy compassions, O Maiden: despise not Thy humble servants, but as Thou art good, look down with Thy merciful eye, and deliver us from the indissoluble tyranny of the devil.[^9304]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Now am I gripped by the violence of sorrow, O Virgin, having weakened all my strength, and I lie wholly prone upon the earth; yet I cry aloud unto Thee from my soul: Do Thou raise me up again, and strengthen me by Thy consolation.[^9305]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Not having left the Father's bosom, and having come down to earth, O Christ God, I have heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I have glorified Thee, the only Lover of mankind.[^9306]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Mother of God, deliver me from corruption, and from the deceitful tormentor serpent who ever prowls around me and trapps my steps that are directed according to God.[^9307]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O noetic portal of life, open unto me the doors of repentance; for now have I drawn near unto the doors of despair, wretched that I am by reason of my many sins.[^9308]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Having thoroughly shaken off the mire of passions and pleasures by Thy tender mercy, O all-holy one, show me forth pure, and clothe me with the light-fashioned garment of grace.[^9309]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Having cleansed the defilement of my soul and the uncleanness of my body, O pure one, by Thy acceptable supplications, present me pure ever to sing of Thee and glorify Thee.[^9310]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Night is unilluminated unto the unbelieving, O Christ, but unto the faithful there is enlightenment in the sweetness of Thy words; therefore early in the morning do I rise unto Thee, and sing praise unto Thy Divinity.[^9311]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Entreat the all-good Word, O all-immaculate Virgin, that we may be saved; for we have acquired Thee as a protectress and a mighty help in necessities.[^9312]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Deliver me not up unto the enemies, O pure one, who vehemently seek my ruin by reason of my sins; but by Thy tender mercy snatch me from their harm.[^9313]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Knowing Thee to be the God of all, O Christ, and Creator of all, in Thee alone...[^9314]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: ...have we placed the hope of our salvation, Who for our sake didst become man.[^9315]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Rejoice, O pure cloud that pourest forth living water! Rejoice, O Virgin, the confirmation of the martyrs and of the apostles! Rejoice, honorable praise, O all-immaculate one![^9316]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Voyaging amid the turmoil of worldly cares, submerged with my ship by sins, and cast forth unto the soul-corrupting beast, like Jonah I cry aloud unto Thee, O Christ: Lead me up from the deadly deep![^9317]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The comeliness and the beauty of excellence which I possessed through baptism have I destroyed by unseemly deeds, O Lady; yet do Thou by Thy fervent protection restore it unto those who faithfully honor Thee.[^9318]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Deliver me from suffering and distressing constraint and grief, O Theotokos, granting me Thy consolation; for I have no other protectress save Thee, O all-immaculate one, I Thy servant.[^9319]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Having borne the Redeemer, the Benefactor, and the Savior, Thou hast strength and canst do whatever Thou desirest, O all-immaculate one; therefore do we Thy servants entreat Thee: Deliver us from passionate turmoil.[^9320]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Thee did the Prophet Isaiah of old behold as a light cloud, being enlightened by the Spirit, upon which the Lord of glory sat, and came, and cast down all the graven images of Egypt, O all-pure Virgin Mother.[^9321]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Then, Lord, have mercy (forty times). Glory... Both now:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 7:*[^9322]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: Deliver from everlasting fire those who venerate Thy childbearing; for Christ hath shown Thee forth as a protectress unto us who sing of Thee.[^9323]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The children of old showed the fiery furnace to be dew-dropping, hymning the one God and saying: The highly exalted and most glorious God of our fathers.[^9324]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A multitude of sins holds me fast, and brings me down unto the corruption of ruin and despair. O Theotokos, anticipate me, and grant me saving help.[^9325]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю распе́ншагосѧ, сла́вимъ те́рнїемъ вѣнча́вшагосѧ, и҆ сла́вою вѣнча́вшаго человѣ́ки, Царю̀ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Deliver me from every malice of the enemy, and from temptation and affliction; and preserve my soul in stillness and peace, O all-pure one, that rejoicing I may sing of Thy power.[^9326]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Въ Пѧто́къ на Повече́ріи, Гла́съ з҃. ѡм҃д
items.english_text: *Glory:* Foreseeing the condemnation of my wicked deeds, wretch that I am, I cry unto Thee from the depths of my heart, O all-pure one: Be Thou my protection, O Lady, and save me.[^9327]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆сѹжде́ніе прови́дѧ дѣлѡ́мъ мои̑мъ лѹка̑вымъ ѻ҆каѧ́нный, взыва́ю тебѣ̀ и҆зъ глѹбины̀ се́рдца моегѡ̀, Пречи́стаѧ: ты̀ мнѣ̀ бѹ́ди Влады́чице застѹпле́ніе, и҆ спаси́ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* With the Martyrs, with the Angels, and with the Apostles, O all-immaculate one, entreat Thy Son and Lord to save Thy servants from assaults, perils, and griefs.[^9328]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Съ Мч҃ники, съ А҆́гг҃лы, и҆ съ А҆пⷭ҇лы, Всенепоро́чнаѧ, твоегѡ̀ Сн҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а молѝ, спастѝ рабы̑ твоѧ̑ ѿ напа́стей и҆ бѣ́дъ, и҆ печа́лей.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Imitating the youths in the furnace, having received the spiritual dew, with faith we call out: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord![^9329]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Въ пещѝ ѻ҆́троки подража́юще, дѹхо́внѹю ро́сѹ пріе́мши, вѣ́рою зове́мъ: благослови́те дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇нѧ Гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Be Thou a help unto me, O most holy Virgin, who flee unto Thee and cry aloud with faith: Have mercy, O pure one, and grant me cleansing of sins before the end; and at the hour of demise grant salvation, and after demise bestow rest.[^9330]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Бѹ́ди мнѣ̀ по́мощь, Дв҃о прест҃а́ѧ, къ тебѣ̀ прибѣга́ющемѹ, и҆ вопію́щемѹ съ вѣ́рою: поми́лѹй Чи́стаѧ, и҆ пре́жде конца̀ ѡ҆чище́ніе согрѣше́ній да́ждь мнѣ̀, и҆ въ ча́съ кончи́ны пода́ждь спасе́ніе, и҆ по кончи́нѣ поко́й да́рѹй.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Grievous dread takes hold of me when I ponder the fearful examination and the inexorable Judge of those who have wrought evil, such things as truly I, the wretched one, have wrought, and those torments that have no end. O Lady of the world, be Thou my salvation![^9331]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́жасъ ѡ҆держи́тъ мѧ̀ лю́тъ, є҆гда̀ помышлѧ́ю стра́шное и҆спыта́ніе, и҆ сѹдію̀ не оу҆моли́маго, содѣ́вавшимъ лѹка̑ваѧ, ꙗ҆кова̑ же вои́стинѹ ꙗ҆́же а҆́зъ ѻ҆каѧ́нный содѣ́ѧхъ, и҆ мѹ́ки ѻ҆́ныѧ конца̀ не и҆мѹ́щїѧ. Влады́чице мі́ра, бѹ́ди мнѣ̀ спасе́ніе.
items.english_text: *Glory:* O Thou Who art the cause of salvation for those born of earth, O champion of the faithful, cleansing of sinners! O fountain of all goodness, and bestower of good things, O pure Parent of God: heal Thou the diseases of my soul, and pour forth eternal grace, and glory, and gladness.[^9332]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́же земноро́дныхъ вино́вна спасе́нію, ѡ҆ вѣ́рныхъ побо́рнице, грѣ́шникѡвъ ѡ҆чище́ніе! Ѡ҆ и҆сто́чниче всегѡ̀ добра̀, и҆ пода́телю благи́хъ, Бг҃ороди́тельнице чи́стаѧ! ты̀ мнѣ̀ дѹше́вныѧ болѣ́зни и҆сцѣлѝ, и҆ и҆сточѝ благода́ть вѣ́чнѹю, и҆ сла́вѹ и҆ весе́ліе.
items.english_text: *Both now:* As an offering from us, who wast given unto the Master as from the beginning of nature, accept our supplications, O all-pure one, rendering unto us Thy help as fair gifts, that unceasingly we may hymn Him Who was born of Thee, and highly exalt Him unto the ages.[^9333]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Да́ръ ѿ на́съ ꙗ҆́же дана̀ є҆сѝ Влады́цѣ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ нача́ла є҆стества̀, мольбы̑ на́шѧ, Пречи́стаѧ пріимѝ, да́ры красны̑ воздаю́щи на́мъ твою̀ по́мощь, ꙗ҆́кѡ да непреста́ннѡ и҆зъ тебѐ Ро́ждшагосѧ пое́мъ, и҆ превозно́симъ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Mother of God and Virgin, having given birth and remaining a virgin still, this is not a work of nature, but of God's condescension; therefore as the only one accounted worthy of the marvels of God, Thee do we ever magnify.[^9334]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Ма́ти Бж҃іа, и҆ Дв҃а ро́ждшаѧ, и҆ дѣ́вствѹющаѧ па́ки, не є҆стества̀ дѣ́ло, но Бж҃іа снизхожде́ніѧ; тѣ́мъ ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нѹ, Бж҃іихъ чуде́съ сподо́бльшѹюсѧ, тѧ̀ при́снѡ велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Under Thy protection, O Virgin, have I now fled; tempest-tossed by a multitude of transgressions and perishing, save me, O Thou Who didst bear the Savior and Creator, and deliver me from eternal condemnation.[^9335]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: По́дъ тво́й кро́въ Дв҃о нн҃ѣ прибѣго́хъ, ѿ мно́жества прегрѣше́ній ѡ҆бѹрева́емаго, и҆ погиба́ющаго спаси́ мѧ, ꙗ҆́же Спа́са и҆ Зижди́телѧ ро́ждшаѧ, и҆ вѣ́чнагѡ и҆зба́ви ѡ҆сѹжде́ніѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Entreat the Creator, God and Lord, Who was incarnate of Thy most pure blood, O pure one, on our behalf...[^9336]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: ...to have compassion in His tender mercy upon a despairing people.[^9337]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory:* Deliver me from the unquenchable fire, and the outer darkness, and eternal weeping, who am worthy of condemnation, O most holy and pure Theotokos, by Thy fervent intercession unto God![^9338]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now:* Preserved beneath Thy grace, O Theotokos, I remain undevoured by the assaults of the adversary enemies; therefore, as a divine foundation and ascent, I sing praise, and bow down, and magnify Thee.[^9339]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *It is truly meet. Trisagion. After the Our Father: troparia and the rest as usual.*[^9340]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *On Saturday at Matins.*[^9341]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *After the first Kathisma reading, Sessional Hymns to the Martyrs, Tone 7:*[^9342]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* O saints, pray that remission of our sins may be given unto us, and that we may be delivered from the grievous things that are expected, and from bitter death, we pray you.[^9343]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Thy saints, O Lord, having struggled upon earth, trod down the enemy and abolished the deception of idols; therefore also did they receive crowns from Thee, the Master Who lovest mankind and the merciful God, Who bestowest great mercy upon the world.[^9345]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now: Theotokion:* As the treasury of our resurrection, bring up from the pit and depth of transgressions those who trust in Thee, O all-hymned one; for Thou didst save those guilty of sin, having given birth unto our salvation, who wast a Virgin before childbearing, and a Virgin in childbearing, and after childbearing remainest still a Virgin.[^9346]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *After the second Kathisma reading, Sessional Hymns, Tone 7:*[^9347]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Rejoice, ye righteous, and let the heavens be glad! For the martyrs, having struggled upon earth, trod down the enemy and abolished the deception of idols. Let the Church leap for joy, celebrating the victory unto the author of the contest and only author of victory, Christ God, Who bestows great mercy upon the world.[^9348]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Thy martyrs, O Lord, overcame the enemy and put to shame the deception of idols, having armed themselves with the power of Thy Cross; therefore also...[^9350]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: ...singing with the Angels, they call out a song of victory, glorifying Thee, O Christ. By their prayers grant unto our souls cleansing and great mercy.[^9351]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 3 (Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ)):* Thy death, O Lord, caused life to bud forth unto the dead; for Thou didst despoil Hades, releasing those that slept in darkness. Therefore we beseech Thee, the Life-giver, as God: give rest with the righteous unto those whom Thou hast taken from us, that they may find great mercy at the judgment.[^9353]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now: Theotokion:* O unwedded Maiden all-immaculate, entreat our God Who was incarnate of Thy blood ever with the Prophets, Hierarchs, and Martyrs, that our souls may be saved.[^9354]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, Venerables, and the Departed.*[^9355]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: With choirs I sing of shepherds and martyrs, I, Joseph.)*[^9356]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Tone 7. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Unto God Who aided Moses in Egypt to lead Israel forth, unto Him alone let us sing, for He is gloriously glorified.[^9357]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Martyrs, pray to God for us.*[^9358]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The choir of guileless martyrs, having overcome all the deceptions of the adversary, leaps with joy, rejoicing before the face of Him Who created it.[^9359]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Hierarchs of Christ, pray to God for us.*[^9360]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Hierarchs of Christ, and all venerable ones who have fought the good fight, were accounted worthy of eternal delight by grace.[^9361]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Refrain: All Saints, pray to God for us.*[^9362]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Deliver us, O Christ, from all wrath, by the supplication of the Prophets, and Venerables, and holy women, and save our souls.[^9363]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Give rest, O Lord, to the souls of Thy departed servants.*[^9364]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* O Word, Who didst fashion me from the earth and command me to return unto the earth again: give rest unto those whom Thou hast translated in the faith.[^9365]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O all-pure Mother, who didst bear the most holy Word of God: sanctify all who glorify Thee with love.[^9366]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Departed.*[^9367]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *(A work of Theophanes.)*[^9368]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Tone 7. Ode 1. Heirmos:* At Thy nod the once fluid watery nature was changed into an earthly form, O Lord; therefore, having journeyed on dry land...[^9369]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: ...Israel, having journeyed on dry land, sings unto Thee a hymn of victory.[^9370]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* An adornment embellished with forms of virtue, and a divine dedicated offering radiant with diverse beauties in piety, O Martyrs, were ye offered unto Christ God.[^9372]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Vouchsafe Thy servants who have been translated, O most merciful Lord, to attain the radiance of the unapproachable and thrice-sunned dawn: whence all sickness, sorrow, and sighing have fled away.[^9374]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory:* The nature condemned unto mortification, Thou Thyself, O Christ, being hypostatic Life and the Life-giver, didst raise up; therefore, as the only compassionate One, give rest unto those who have been translated in faith unto Thee.[^9375]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* Thou didst set upright the ancestral mother's fall, O all-pure one, having given birth unto the Lord Word, Who raised her up and breathed life into those in the tombs by divine authority.[^9376]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou Who didst establish the heavens by Thy word, and strengthen the earth's foundation upon many waters: establish Thou my mind in Thy will, O Lover of mankind.[^9377]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Martyrs, pray to God for us.*[^9378]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Crushed with stones and cast into a pit, ye crushed all the power of the deceitful one, and unbroken in mind did ye remain, O Martyrs.[^9379]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Hierarchs of Christ, pray to God for us.*[^9380]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With the radiance of divine teachings and the rays of virtues, the all-wise Hierarchs, enlightening the faithful, drove away all the mist of heresies.[^9381]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Refrain: All Saints, pray to God for us.*[^9382]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having died unto the world, Thy venerable ones, O Word, inherited indeed life above the world; for their sake, O Christ, have compassion upon us all.[^9383]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Give rest, O Lord, to the souls of Thy departed servants.*[^9384]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* For those who have been translated in faith and hope, we all beseech the good Master to have mercy on them in the hour of judgment.[^9385]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now: Theotokion:* Without emptying the Father's bosom, the Word appeared in Thy womb, O all-pure one, held as an Infant: the Beginningless One receiving a beginning from Thee.[^9386]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Departed. Ode 3. Heirmos:* In the beginning having established the heavens by Thy all-powerful Word, O Lord Savior, and all their host by the all-effective and divine Spirit: establish me upon the immovable rock of the confession of Thee.[^9387]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Youthful and steadfast endurance the choirs of martyrs manfully showed forth; for they yielded up the onslaught of wounds and the stripes of torments, desiring Thine incorruptible glory and beauty, O Savior.[^9388]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Into Thine eternal life receive the souls of those who have fallen asleep in hope, O Merciful One; and settle them within the longed-for and divine bosom of divine Abraham, O Master, and number them with Lazarus and Thine elect.[^9389]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory:* Having come down from heaven to save the human race, O compassionate Savior: vouchsafe those who have piously been translated, by Thy tender mercy, to be filled with immaterial light, and Thy divine glory, and joy.[^9390]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* The laws of nature were dissolved in Thee, who didst conceive the incomprehensible Word, O pure one; and the divine law was given unto us, granting remission of transgressions unto all who are in despair, by the grace of divine goodness.[^9391]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Perceiving Thy coming in the flesh, O Christ, the Prophet Habakkuk cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^9392]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Strengthened by love for the Lord, the Martyrs enfeebled the power of the enemy; therefore are they called blessed.[^9393]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As sheep of the Shepherd and Lamb, O blessed Hierarchs, ye presided over the rational flock by divine grace.[^9394]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Like stars of many lights, with the brilliance of virtue ye illuminated the fullness of the faithful, O our venerable Fathers.[^9395]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory:* The unique triumph of the valiant women, and the assembly of the holy Prophets, have attained heavenly good things.[^9396]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* Entreat God, Whom Thou didst bear, O all-hymned one, that Thy flock may be delivered from all temptations and afflictions.[^9397]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Departed. Ode 4. Heirmos:* Not having left the Father's bosom, and having come down to earth, O Christ God, I have heard the mystery...[^9398]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: ...of Thy dispensation, and I have glorified Thee, the only Lover of mankind.[^9399]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Patiently displaying the pains of suffering, O Christ, the Martyrs were bound with the crowns of Thy righteousness, and they glorify Thy power.[^9400]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Of Thy supernatural brilliance vouchsafe those who have been piously translated, when Thou shalt come in Thy glory with Thine Angels, O all-compassionate and most merciful One.[^9401]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory:* Vouchsafe those who have departed before us and glorify Thee, O good One and Lover of mankind, to delight in the thrice-radiant dawn and the single shining of the Godhead.[^9402]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* He Who left not the Father's bosom, Christ, took up His dwelling in the virginal womb, and hath delivered from death those who call Thee blessed, O Mother of God, only all-hymned one.[^9403]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* My spirit rises early unto Thee, O God, for Thou art light, and Thy commandments have become healing unto Thy servants, O Lover of mankind.[^9404]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Ye took no thought for bodily wounds, O valiant sufferers, and by your divine wounds ye heal the wounds and sufferings of all.[^9405]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Ye received the authority to bind and to loose upon earth, O Hierarchs of Christ; therefore loose our indissoluble bonds of sin.[^9406]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having been united unto God with a pure mind, the ascetic choirs, of the Prophets and Righteous, and of honorable women, make glad, rejoicing with an indestructible rejoicing.[^9407]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory: Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* As the only one Who art most merciful, make those who in faith have been translated from this life, O Christ, citizens of Paradise, O Lover of mankind.[^9408]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* Having been shown forth as an indestructible bridal chamber unto God, entreat Him, O all-holy Virgin, to make me an inhabitant of the noetic bridal chamber.[^9409]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Departed. Ode 5. Heirmos:* O Lord my God, rising early from the night I pray unto Thee: grant me remission of my transgressions, and direct my paths unto the light of Thy commandments, I pray Thee.[^9410]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Clothed brightly with life-bearing death, woven through martyrdom, all-praised Martyrs, entreat divine rest for the souls of those who have fallen asleep before...[^9411]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: ...us, entreat divine rest.[^9412]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Pouring forth tender compassion from inexhaustible treasures, O Savior: be well pleased that the souls whom Thou hast translated may take up their dwelling with Thy firstborn in the heavenly habitations.[^9413]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
