items.english_text: *Glory:* Having put off heaviness and been loosed from bonds, and passed over unto the life on high, Thy servants, O Christ, vouchsafe, O Savior, to delight in Thy holy radiances.[^9414]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* O Lady Mother of God, grant loosening of my transgressions, and bestow upon me forgiveness of my sins, O Thou who didst bear the hypostatic Life unto the world, O all-immaculate one.[^9415]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Jonah cried out from the belly of Hades: Lead my life up from corruption! And we cry aloud unto Thee: O almighty Savior, have mercy upon us![^9416]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Ye cast down the haughtiness of the enemy, being lifted up unto God in sufferings, O all-glorious warriors, and became heavenly citizens.[^9417]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Driving away the winter of heresies, the true Hierarchs of Christ brought a multitude of the pious unto the true spring.[^9418]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* By Thy strength, O Christ, the multitude of Venerables, and Prophets, and holy women were justified, and delight in the unsetting light.[^9419]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory: Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* Thou hast translated Thy servants from temporal things, O compassionate One; yet vouchsafe them to be partakers of eternal gladness and true life.[^9420]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* Sanctify Thy servants, O most holy Virgin, who didst bear the most holy Word in the flesh, Whom every breath hymns, sanctifying them.[^9421]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Departed. Ode 6. Heirmos:* Voyaging amid the turmoil of worldly cares, submerged with my ship by sins, and cast forth unto the soul-corrupting beast, like Jonah I cry aloud unto Thee, O Christ: Lead me up from the deadly deep![^9422]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The choir of martyrs, having steadfastly endured intolerable pains, inherited painless delight, receiving the crowns of righteousness from the life-bearing right hand. *(Twice)*[^9423]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory:* With the Righteous, where the angelic choirs are, and where the radiances of the saints and the enjoyment of eternal life abide...[^9424]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: ...rank Thy servants who have fallen asleep before us, O Merciful One, as Thou art immortal God.[^9425]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* He Who by divine will and creative power composed all things out of non-being came forth from Thy womb, O pure one, and with God-originating brightness hath enlightened those that were in the darkness of death.[^9426]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Being in the Chaldean furnace, the children of Abraham rejoiced with the Angel, saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^9427]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By the streams of their blood the passion-bearers quenched the flame of impiety, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^9428]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* We praise the Hierarchs who became the enlighteners of the world, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^9429]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* With songs let the holy assembly of the Prophets and the Venerables be honored, who sing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^9430]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory: Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* Deliver from Gehenna Thy faithful servants whom Thou hast received, O compassionate Christ, who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^9431]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* As more honorable than the Angels do we hymn the Theotokos, crying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^9432]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Departed. Ode 7. Heirmos:* The children showed the fiery furnace of old to be dew-dropping, hymning the one God and saying: The highly exalted and most glorious God of our fathers.[^9433]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Wearing crowns, the choirs of martyrs clearly stand round Christ the King in mind, with the angelic choirs, calling out: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^9434]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou Who hast authority over death and life, O compassionate One, make those who have been transferred in Thy faith, O Savior, partakers of divine delight, who call out: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^9435]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory:* Enlightening them with the light of immaterial brilliance, O Christ, settle the souls whom Thou hast translated in the heavenly habitations, to glorify Thee unceasingly with Thy favored ones.[^9436]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* He Who aforetime was without mother from the Father, now without father was ineffably born of Thee, O Virgin, Christ, having clothed Himself in flesh for the sake of us men: Blessed...[^9437]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: ...is the fruit of Thy womb, O all-pure one![^9438]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Imitating the youths in the furnace, having received the spiritual dew, with faith we call out: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord![^9439]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Ye cast down the temples of idols, O all-glorious ones, and made yourselves temples unto the Spirit, O passion-bearers, having finished your course bravely.[^9440]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Ye appeared as sweet-scented flowers, O Hierarchs, gladdening the souls of the faithful with the knowledge of piety; therefore are ye worthily called blessed.[^9441]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Ye became sojourners on all the earth, O venerable ones, as Prophets of God, looking unto the inheritance on high and the ever-abiding glory.[^9442]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory: Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* As Lord of the living and the dead, O Word, unite Thy servants who have fallen asleep in faith unto the choirs of all who are being saved, as the only Lover of mankind.[^9443]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* The assembly of all women who sought the Lord by fasting and suffering prays unceasingly unto Thy divine person, O all-pure one.[^9444]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Departed. Ode 8. Heirmos:* The only beginningless King of glory, Whom the heavenly Powers bless, and before Whom the angelic ranks tremble: sing praise, ye priests, and highly exalt Him, ye people, unto all ages![^9445]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Looking unto the heavenly glory of Christ's coming, the Martyrs took no thought for earthly glory, piously singing of Him as King unto all ages.[^9446]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Thou Who didst destroy the earthly tabernacle, grant a heavenly tabernacle unto those who have fallen asleep in hope of life, giving them rest in the habitations of the Righteous unto all ages.[^9447]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory:* As God Who grantest resurrection unto the dead, Who hast the fountain of life: do Thou water those who have fallen asleep before us with torrents of delight, as the only good One, unto all ages.[^9448]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* Having ineffably received the unapproachable Light in Thy womb, O Virgin Theotokos, Thou didst enlighten those who were in the darkness of this life, to glorify piously Christ Who ineffably came forth from Thee.[^9449]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Mother beyond nature, and Virgin according to nature, the only blessed one among women, with hymns do we the faithful magnify the Theotokos.[^9450]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By the prayers of the holy Martyrs, and of the Prophets and the Righteous, who from all ages have lived virtuously, O Christ, have mercy on our souls.[^9451]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having been shown forth as ministers unto the Master, stewards of sacred mysteries, ye were joined unto the heavenly servants; with them offer supplications for us.[^9452]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having finished the blessed course together with the women, let us honor the holy ascetic choirs, that by their prayers we may obtain sanctification.[^9453]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory: Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* The glory of which the choirs of all the saints were accounted worthy, O Christ, vouchsafe those who have been translated, who served Thee in Orthodox manner, to partake of.[^9454]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* Loving sin as I do, I tremble before the fearful judgment seat of Him Who was born of Thee, O pure one: wherein, as Thou art good, preserve me uncondemned.[^9455]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Departed. Ode 9. Heirmos:* Mother of God and Virgin, having given birth and remaining a virgin still, this is not a work of nature, but of God's condescension; therefore as the only one accounted worthy of the marvels of God, Thee do we ever magnify.[^9456]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Manifestly the valiant martyrs enlighten the world, being pillars of the faith, an unshakable bulwark for the churches, and ramparts of piety; them do we the faithful worthily call blessed.[^9457]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Deliver from eternal fire, O Master, those who have been translated from us, having torn asunder the bond of their sins with the spear of Thy side, O only Lover of mankind, and vouchsafe them the brightness of the Saints.[^9458]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Glory:* As a good God, and Lover of mankind by nature, as merciful and compassionate, as the inexhaustible treasure of immortal life, O Savior: vouchsafe those who have fallen asleep before us in faith Thine incorruptible sweetness.[^9459]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* The shadows of the Law and the ancient riddles have passed away through Thy childbearing; for Christ became the fulfillment of the Law and the Prophets; singing of Whom in two essences, Thee, the pure Ever-Virgin, do we call blessed.[^9460]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *It is truly meet. Litany, Photogogikon (Exapostilarion), and the customary psalms.*[^9461]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Martyrs, Tone 7:*[^9462]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Творца̀ Бг҃а и҆ Гдⷭ҇а, ѿ твои́хъ вопло́щшагосѧ пречи́стыхъ крове́й, ѡ҆ на́съ Чи́стаѧ молѝ,
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Celebrating the memory of Thy holy passion-bearers, Thee...[^9463]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: пое́мъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, вопію́ще: Гдⷭ҇и, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: ...we praise, O Christ, crying aloud: O Lord, glory to Thee![^9464]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Посредѣ̀ сꙋди́ща законопрестꙋ́пныхъ, ра́дꙋющеся вопіѧ́хꙋ страстоте́рпци: Го́споди, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* In the midst of the judgment hall of the transgressors of the law, the passion-bearers cried aloud with joy: O Lord, glory to Thee![^9465]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́ла ꙗ҆ви́шася вселе́ннѣй, прехва́льніи страстоте́рпци, Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ вопію́ще: Го́споди, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* As luminaries have ye appeared unto the universe, O all-praised passion-bearers, crying aloud unto Christ: O Lord, glory to Thee![^9466]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́но ды́шꙋще и҆ къ є҆ди́номꙋ взира́юще страстоте́рпци Мч҃еници, є҆ди́нъ пꙋ́ть живота̀ ѡ҆брѣ́тше, є҆́же за Хрⷭ҇та̀ сме́рть, ревнꙋ́юще дрꙋ́гъ дрꙋ́га кончи́нѣ: ѽле чудесѐ! ꙗ҆́кѡ сокро́вища мꙋ́ки превосхища́юще, дрꙋ́гъ къ дрꙋ́гꙋ глаго́лахꙋ: ꙗ҆́ко а҆́ще не ны́нѣ ᲂу҆мре́мъ, ᲂу҆мре́мъ же всѧ́кѡ, и҆ бытію̀ дѡ́лжная послꙋ́жимъ; сотвори́мъ нꙋ́ждꙋ любоче́стіемъ, ѻ҆́бщее своѐ вмѣни́мъ, сме́ртію живо́тъ кꙋпꙋ́юще. Моли́твами и҆́хъ Бж҃е поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* Breathing as one and looking unto One, the passion-bearing Martyrs, having found the one path of life, which is death for Christ, striving with zeal one for the end of another—O the wonder!—as though snatching up treasures did they eagerly seize torments, saying one to another: For if we die not now, we shall die in any case, and we shall pay the debt due to our being; let us make necessity our honor, let us account what is common to all as our own, purchasing life with death. By their prayers, O God, have mercy on us.[^9467]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: По ѻ҆́бразꙋ твоемꙋ̀ и҆ по подо́бію, созда́вый и҆спе́рва человѣ́ка, въ раѝ поста́вилъ є҆сѝ владѣ́ти твои́ми тва́рьми: за́вистію же дїа́волею прельще́нъ бы́въ, снѣ́ди причасти́ся, заповѣ́дей твои́хъ престꙋ́пникъ бы́въ; тѣ́мже па́ки въ зе́млю, ѿ неѧ́же взѧ́тъ бы́сть, ѡ҆сꙋди́лъ є҆сѝ є҆го̀ возврати́тисѧ Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ и҆спроси́ти поко́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* According to Thine image and likeness, having created man in the beginning, Thou didst place him in Paradise to rule over Thy creatures; but being seduced by the envy of the devil, he partook of the food, becoming a transgressor of Thy commandments; therefore Thou didst condemn him, O Lord, to return again unto the earth from which he was taken, and to ask for rest.[^9468]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Въ странѣ̀ Пра́ведныхъ твои́хъ Ми́лостиве, вѣ́рою къ тебѣ̀ преста́вленныѧ ѿ вре́менныхъ, ᲂу҆чини́ Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Glory:* In the land of Thy Righteous, O Merciful One, do Thou appoint those who in faith have been translated from temporal things unto Thee, O Lover of mankind.[^9469]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Молѝ Дѣ́во, съ А҆пⷭ҇толы и҆ Мч҃еники, ѡ҆брѣстѝ на сꙋдѣ̀ преста́вльшимся ве́лію ми́лость.
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* Pray, O Virgin, with the Apostles and the Martyrs, that those who have been translated may find great mercy at the judgment.[^9470]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: На Стїхо́внѣ, стїхи̑ры ме́ртвенны. Гла́съ з҃. Подо́бенъ: Неради́вше:
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Departed. Tone 7, Podoben: "Having disregarded temporal things" (Неради́вше):*[^9471]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ ви́дѣнъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ на крестѣ̀, є҆ди́не Безсме́ртне: и҆ въ гро́бѣ ꙗ҆́кѡ ме́ртвъ положе́нъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, ᲂу҆мерщвле́нїа и҆ тлѝ сме́ртныѧ человѣ́ки и҆збавлѧ́ѧ; но ꙗ҆́кѡ пꙋчи́на милосе́рдїа сы́й неистощи́маѧ, и҆ и҆сто́чникъ благосты́ни, дꙋ́ши твои́хъ ра̑бъ, ѿ на́съ преста́вленныхъ ᲂу҆поко́й.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Put to death wast Thou seen upon the Cross, O only Immortal One, and in the tomb wast Thou laid as one dead, delivering men from slaughter and mortal corruption; but as Thou art an inexhaustible deep of tender compassions and a fountain of goodness, do Thou give rest unto the souls of Thy servants who have been translated from us.[^9472]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Блаже́ни, ꙗ҆́же и҆збра́лъ, и҆ прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* With Thine incorruptible beauty, and with the sweetness of comeliness, and with the divine...[^9474]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: ...rays of Thy light, vouchsafe those who have been translated unto Thee, O Good One, to be enlightened, in the immaterial radiance of Thy manifest light, dancing with the Angels around Thee, the Master, and King of glory, and Lord.[^9475]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* As Thou hast an inexhaustible magnificence of gifts, as an unfailing treasure of rich goodness, as God settle those who have been translated unto Thee in the lands of Thine elect: in a place of refreshment, in the house of Thy glory, in the delight of Paradise, in the virginal bridal chamber, as Thou art tender-hearted.[^9477]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* The fulfillment of the Law didst thou bear, the Deliverer Who became flesh; for there was no justification for those who formerly were under the Law, but Christ was crucified for our sake and justified us. Therefore, having boldness as His Mother, pray Thy compassionate Son to give rest to the souls of those who have piously been translated from us, O all-hymned one.[^9478]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *On Saturday, The Beatitudes. Tone 7:*[^9479]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Beautiful was the fruit, and good for food, that put me to death; Christ is the tree of life, eating of which I die not, but cry aloud with the thief: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom.[^9480]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having finished the good fight, and having kept the faith, ye received incorruptible crowns from God, and were accounted worthy of His glory, O all-praised Martyrs, companions of the Angels.[^9481]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Let the choirs of the Hierarchs, and the Venerable, and the Prophets, and the company of honorable women be sacredly honored, who now dwell in joy in the temples of the firstborn, and abide together with the bodiless ranks.[^9482]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Appoint in the temples of the Saints those whom Thou hast translated from us, O Word of God, overlooking their spiritual sins committed in knowledge and in ignorance upon the earth, and have compassion on Thy servants.[^9483]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Glory: To the Trinity:* Thy servants, O Holy Trinity, who...[^9484]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: ...dying, come unto Thee to be delivered from those dreadful torments, and asking to obtain the good things of Thy holy glory in the hour of judgment.[^9485]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* The Father's radiance dwelt in thy womb, O all-holy and pure one, and renewed again those who were deceived by the evil counsel of the enemy and had fallen into corruption.[^9486]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *[Engraved Tailpiece: An ornamental baroque vignette with floral scrollwork and arabesques, marking the conclusion of Tone 7]*[^9487]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *[Engraved Headpiece: An ornamental baroque headpiece frieze with medallions depicting the Annunciation, the Crucifixion of Christ, and the Mother of God with the Christ Child, amidst ornate arabesques and foliate scrollwork, marking the beginning of Tone 8]*[^9488]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," we set 4 verses, and sing the Resurrection Stichera.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1 (Resurrectional):* An evening hymn and rational worship do we offer unto Thee, O Christ: for Thou wast well-pleased to have mercy on us by Thy Resurrection. *(Twice)*[^9490]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 (Resurrectional):* O Lord, O Lord, cast us not away from Thy presence; but be Thou well-pleased to have mercy on us by Thy Resurrection.[^9491]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion (Dogmatikon), Tone 8:* How shall we call thee blessed, O Theotokos? How shall we hymn, O most blessed one, the incomprehensible mystery of thy childbearing? For the Creator of the ages and Fashioner of our nature, taking pity on His own image, brought Himself down into unfathomable self-emptying; being in the immaterial bosom of the Father, He dwelt in thy womb, O pure one, and unchangeably became flesh from thee, O unwedded one: remaining what He was, God by nature. Therefore we worship Him as perfect God and perfect man, the same in both forms: for both natures are truly in Him; and we proclaim all His natural properties as twofold according to His twofold essence, reverencing two operations and wills. For being consubstantial with God and the Father, He sovereignly wills and operates as God; and being consubstantial also with us, He sovereignly wills and operates as man. Pray Him, O pure and all-blessed one, that our souls may be saved.[^9492]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Resurrection Sticheron. Tone 8:*[^9493]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1 (Resurrectional):* Thou didst ascend upon the Cross, O Jesus, Who camest down from heaven; Thou camest unto death, O immortal Life; unto those in darkness, the true Light; unto the fallen, the Resurrection of all. O our Enlightenment and Savior, glory to Thee![^9494]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Most Holy Theotokos. Tone 8.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Rejoice, O all-hymned Theotokos! Rejoice, fountain welling forth life unto the faithful...[^9497]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: ...rejoice, Sovereign Lady of all and blessed Mistress of creation! Rejoice, all-immaculate and most glorified one! Rejoice, all-pure one! Rejoice, palace! Rejoice, divine dwelling! Rejoice, pure one! Rejoice, Virgin-Mother! Rejoice, Bride of God![^9498]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Rejoice, all-pure Mother of God! Rejoice, hope of the faithful! Rejoice, cleansing of the world! Rejoice, thou who deliverest thy servants from every affliction! Rejoice, life-bearing consolation of men! Rejoice, protection! Rejoice, rampart of those who call upon thee! Rejoice, divine abode of God, and holy mountain![^9500]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Rejoice, O Theotokos, Mother of Christ! Rejoice, only hope and protection of men! Rejoice, refuge and radiant candlestick of the Light! Rejoice, taper! Rejoice, sanctified palace! Rejoice, paradise! Rejoice, fountain welling forth waters unto those who hasten unto thee![^9502]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion (Dogmatikon), Tone 8:* He Whom heaven could not contain, O Virgin Theotokos, was roomily contained in thy womb, and thou didst remain pure by the ineffable Word, without thy virginity being defiled in any way. For thou alone among women wast both Mother and Virgin; and thou alone, O All-Pure One, didst nurse the Life-giving Son, and didst bear in thine embrace the slumberless Eye: yet He left not the Father's bosom, as He was before the ages; but on high He is wholly God with the Angels, and below wholly from thee with men, and everywhere ineffably. Him do thou beseech, O all-holy Sovereign Lady, that they may be saved who in Orthodox manner confess thee as the pure Theotokos.[^9503]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]

items.english_text: *Then: "Now lettest Thou depart." Trisagion, and after "Our Father," the Resurrection Troparion:* From on high didst Thou descend. *Theotokion:* Thou Who for our sake wast born of a Virgin. *Litany, and Dismissal.*[^9504]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *[Engraved Tailpiece: An ornamental baroque vignette with floral motifs, marking the conclusion of Saturday Little Vespers in Tone 8]*[^9505]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," we set 10 verses, and sing the Resurrection Stichera.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1 (Resurrectional):* An evening hymn and rational worship do we offer unto Thee, O Christ: for Thou wast well-pleased to have mercy on us by Thy Resurrection.[^9507]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 (Resurrectional):* O Lord, O Lord, cast us not away from Thy presence; but be Thou well-pleased to have mercy on us by Thy Resurrection.[^9508]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3 (Resurrectional):* Rejoice, O holy Zion, mother of churches, dwelling-place of God: for thou wast the first to receive the remission of sins by the Resurrection.[^9509]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, Eastern (Anatolian). Tone the same:*[^9510]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4 (Anatolian):* The Word of God the Father, begotten before the ages, in the latter times the Same having willingly been incarnate of the Unwedded One, endured crucifixion unto death: and anciently slain man He saved by His Resurrection.[^9511]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5 (Anatolian):* Thy Resurrection from the dead do we glorify, O Christ, whereby Thou didst set free the race of Adam from the torment of Hades: and as God Thou hast granted unto the world life everlasting, and great mercy.[^9512]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 6 (Anatolian):* Glory to Thee, O Christ the Savior, only-begotten Son of God, Who wast nailed to the Cross, and didst rise from the tomb on the third day.[^9513]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 7 (Anatolian):* Thee do we glorify, O Lord, Who willingly didst endure the Cross for our sake; and Thee do we worship, O almighty Savior: cast us not away from Thy presence, but hear and save us by Thy Resurrection, O Lover of mankind.[^9514]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Most Holy Theotokos, by Paul of Amorion. Tone 4.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 8 (To the Theotokos):* The ranks of Angels glorify thee; for, O Pure One, thou didst give birth to God, Who with the Father and...[^9516]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: ...the Spirit is co-eternal, and Who brought into being by His will the angelic hosts out of nothingness. Pray Him to save and enlighten the souls of those who in Orthodox manner praise thee as the Theotokos.[^9517]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 9 (To the Theotokos):* As a fountain of sanctification and an all-golden ark illumined by the Divine Spirit, I pray and fall down before thee: do thou enlighten my soul, O Sovereign Lady, given over to passions and wretched, delivering me from the bitter torment of demons, and granting me an unhindered path of salvation.[^9518]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 10 (To the Theotokos):* When the thrones shall be set, and the books opened, and deeds exposed, and every man shall stand burdened and naked, wholly trembling before the indignation of God and that righteous sentence: then spare me, O Sovereign Lady, and snatch me away from all judgment, me who am guilty of every torment.[^9519]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion (Dogmatikon), Tone 8:* The King of heaven, through His love for mankind, appeared on earth and lived with men; for having taken flesh from the pure Virgin, and having come forth from her with the assumption, He is one Son, twofold in nature, but not in hypostasis; therefore, proclaiming Him truly as perfect God and perfect man, we confess Christ our God. Pray Him, O unwedded Mother, that our souls may have mercy shown them.[^9520]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light. The Prokeimenon of the day, and the rest.*[^9521]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Resurrection Stichera. Tone 8:*[^9522]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1 (Resurrectional):* Thou didst ascend upon the Cross, O Jesus, Who camest down from heaven; Thou camest unto death, O immortal Life; unto those in darkness, the true Light; unto the fallen, the Resurrection of all. O our Light and Savior, glory to Thee![^9523]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera (Alphabetical):*[^9524]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 (Alphabetical):* Christ do we glorify, Who is risen from the dead; for taking soul and body, He cut off the passions from both: His most pure soul indeed having descended into Hades, which also He despoiled, and in the tomb His holy body saw no corruption, the Deliverer of our souls.[^9526]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3 (Alphabetical):* With psalms and hymns do we glorify Thy Resurrection from the dead, O Christ, whereby Thou didst deliver us from the tyranny of Hades, and as God hast granted unto us life everlasting, and great mercy.[^9528]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4 (Alphabetical):* O Master of all, incomprehensible Creator of heaven and earth...[^9530]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: ...having suffered through the Cross, Thou didst pour forth impassibility unto me; and having received burial and risen in glory, Thou didst raise Adam together with Thyself by Thine almighty hand. Glory to Thy third-day rising, whereby Thou hast granted us life everlasting, and cleansing from sins, as Thou alone art compassionate.[^9531]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* O Unwedded Virgin, who ineffably didst conceive God in the flesh, Mother of the Most High God, accept the supplications of thy servants, O all-immaculate one, granting unto all the cleansing of transgressions. Now receiving our entreaties, pray that we all may be saved.[^9532]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou depart. Trisagion, and after "Our Father," the Resurrection Troparion, Tone 8:*[^9533]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: From on high didst Thou descend, O Compassionate One; Thou didst accept three days' burial, that Thou mightest free us from the passions. O our Life and Resurrection, Lord, glory to Thee![^9534]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* O Good One, Who for our sake wast born of a Virgin, and didst endure crucifixion, who by death didst despoil death, and didst manifest the Resurrection as God: despise not those whom Thou hast fashioned with Thy hand; show forth Thy love for mankind, O Merciful One; accept the Theotokos who bore Thee, who prays for us; and save, O our Savior, a despairing people.[^9535]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *On Saturday at Compline. Supplicatory Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos:*[^9536]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: Let us sing unto the Lord, Who led His people through the Red Sea: for He alone is gloriously glorified.[^9537]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Refrain:* Most Holy Sovereign Lady Theotokos, save us.[^9538]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Come mystically, O brethren, as from the beginning let us the faithful bring a new song unto the holy Theotokos, today praising her magnificent deeds.[^9539]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Anciently illumined in mind by the vision of God, Moses was clearly taught concerning thy God-befitting conception, O Pure One, beyond nature, O Virgin, when the bush in the garden was manifested unto him.[^9540]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Unto thee do I offer the workings of my heart, and acceptably do I present this writing, having put thee forward as a divine shelter of protection close at hand unto Christ the Master.[^9541]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Incline thine ear unto me, O Pure One, who with Orthodox faith hasten unto...[^9542]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: ...the shadow of thy countenance, and with honor and love venerate thee in fear: hear my supplicatory voice.[^9543]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou art the confirmation of those that hasten unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the light of the darkened, and my spirit praises Thee.[^9544]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Anciently the Patriarch's ladder prefigured thee, O all-immaculate one; for the descent of Angels manifested the divine descent of God unto us, coming down into thy womb.[^9545]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The tribe of Judah settled, which Jacob foretold, that out of his tribe should bud forth the Deliverance, Jesus Christ: Whom having borne, O All-Pure One, thou hast been glorified.[^9546]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Despairing because of sins, I have found thee as a haven of salvation, O pure Theotokos, our hope and help: therefore guide me unto repentance.[^9547]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Both now:* I have thee as one who art close unto the Master, O all-glorious Sovereign Lady: the book of my deeds have I laid upon thee in faith; keep not silence to have compassion on me.[^9548]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* From the overshadowed mountain, O Word, the prophet in a divine manner perceived that Thou wast to be incarnate of the only Theotokos, and with fear he glorified Thy power.[^9549]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Arrayed as with golden necklaces, O Bride of the Father, having received grace and been adorned with the comeliness of virginity, thou wast shown forth as the Mother of the Son of God.[^9550]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thee as the true Zion did Christ the Word choose for Himself as a divine dwelling, having chosen thee, an elect one, O Theotokos, for the renewal of all the world.[^9551]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Rejoice, beautiful palace of the Word, virginal bridal chamber of the King! Rejoice, boast of all the bodiless ones! Rejoice, help of men![^9552]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Both now:* They withdraw from God and therefore perish, who reject the icons of Thy Son, O Mother of God, Virgin Theotokos, through which they that honor thee are saved.[^9553]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Dispel the darkness of my soul, O Christ God, Giver of light, having driven away the primeval darkness of the abyss; and grant me the light of Thy commandments, O Word, that waking early I may glorify Thee.[^9554]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having assembled together with the divine Gabriel, let us faithfully cry aloud unto the Theotokos: Rejoice, O holy Virgin, full of grace, the Lord is with thee, Who for thy sake consumed sorrow and granted joy.[^9555]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Gideon beheld thy most pure womb, O pure Virgin, into which the Word came down as dew and was incarnate by the Divine Spirit, remaining inseparable from the Father's Godhead.[^9556]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Glory:* Thou art the helper of the world and protector of sinful men, O Virgin Mother of God! Unto those that flee unto thee in faith and love thou art a saving change and the loosing of many transgressions.[^9557]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Both now:* Without seed didst thou bud forth Him Who before all creation was the Offshoot of the Father, ageless and without beginning, through the Divine Spirit, O pure Mother of God: the likeness of Whose form we all revere.[^9558]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Accept me, held fast by many sins, O Lover of mankind, who fall down before Thy compassions, as Thou didst the Prophet, O Lord, and save me.[^9559]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As the mirror of virginity and the pure receptacle of the Godhead, we praise thee with hymns, O unwedded Virgin.[^9560]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* God was incarnate in thy womb, impassibly and awesomely, O Bride of God, as upon a new scroll written by the Father's finger.[^9561]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Glory:* We have thy protection as cleansing, and an assured hope and defense, O pure Virgin! Put not to shame Thy servants, O Sovereign Lady.[^9562]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Both now:* By thine intercession, O Bride of God, stay the unceasing madness of passions into stillness; and guide us unto the haven of calm.[^9563]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Then: Lord, have mercy, thrice. Glory... both now...*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn. Tone 8:*[^9564]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: To thee, the Champion Leader, do we, thy servants, dedicate a thank-offering of victory, having been delivered from evils, O Theotokos: but as thou hast invincible might, free us from all dangers, that we may cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Bride Unwedded![^9565]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The fire in Babylon was once put to shame by God's condescension; therefore the children in the furnace, dancing with joyful step as in a flowery garden, sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^9566]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣ́нною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃твен-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou wast shown forth as the mediatress of our joy, O Virgin, and of grace...[^9567]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: приносѧ́ще вѣне́цъ любо́вїю, ра́дꙋйсѧ, вопїе́мъ тебѣ̀, благослове́ннаѧ Чи́стаѧ, похвалѧ́юще.
items.english_text: ...bringing a crown with love, we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O blessed and pure one, praising thee.[^9568]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Гора̀ ст҃а́ѧ є҆сѝ Бж҃їѧ приносѣне́ннаѧ; гора̀ тꙋ́чна, Пренепоро́чнаѧ; гора̀ оу҆сыре́нна бж҃твенными сїѧ́нїи; гора̀, въ не́йже Бг҃ъ благоволѝ жи́ти.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* A holy mountain art thou of God, overshadowed; a fertile mountain, O Most Undefiled One; a curdled mountain in divine radiances; a mountain in which God was pleased to dwell.[^9569]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Побѣжда́ѧй благода́ть твою̀ нѣ́сть грѣ́хъ: ма́терне бо дерзнове́нїе и҆ во́лю и҆́маши, и҆ рѣши́ши прегрѣше́нїѧ моли́твами твои́ми, и҆ прево́диши всѧ̑ стремле́нїѧ.
items.english_text: *Glory:* There is no sin that overcoms thy grace: for thou hast maternal boldness and will, and dost loose transgressions by thy prayers, and dost turn aside every onslaught.[^9570]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿ Тр҃цы родила̀ є҆сѝ є҆ди́наго Бц҃е, бы́вша непрело́жна плотски́мъ соединенї́емъ, сꙋгꙋ́ба сꙋ́ща є҆стество́мъ; є҆гѡ́же ви́да ѡ҆́бразъ почита́емъ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Of the Trinity thou didst bear One, O Theotokos, Who became unchangeable by bodily union, being twofold in nature; the image of Whose form we revere.[^9571]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: На горѣ̀ ст҃ѣ́й просла́вльшасѧ, и҆ въ кꙋпинѣ̀ ѻ҆гне́мъ Приснодѣ́вы Мѡѷсе́ови та́йнꙋ ꙗ҆́вльшаго Гдⷭа, по́йте, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Hymn the Lord Who was glorified on the holy mountain, and revealed to Moses in the bush by fire the mystery of the Ever-Virgin, and exalt Him unto all ages.[^9572]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Кади́лница ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ проро́кꙋ, бж҃твеннагw оу҆́гла сꙋ́щи, грѣхѝ ѿе́млющагw, Бц҃е Дѣ́во ма́ти Бг҃а на́шегw.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A censer wast thou shown forth unto the prophet, bearing the divine coal that takes away sins, O Virgin Theotokos, Mother of our God.[^9573]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Данїи́лъ прови́дѣ тѧ̀ го́рꙋ ве́лїю, Бц҃е Дѣ́во: и҆зъ неѧ́же честны́й ка́мень Хрⷭто́съ, пло́тїю ѡ҆блече́сѧ, и҆ ле́сти низложѝ і҆́дѡлскїа хра́мы.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Daniel foresaw thee as a great mountain, O Virgin Theotokos, from which Christ, the precious stone, was clothed in flesh, and cast down the deceitful temples of idols.[^9574]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Вели́кїй ки́тъ и҆́щетъ пожре́ти мѧ̀, лю́тагw грѣха̀, и҆ страсте́й мои́хъ ѿча́ѧнїа; но предварѝ, и҆ спасѝ раба̀ твоего̀, Влады́чице.
items.english_text: *Glory:* The great sea-monster of grievous sin and the despair of my passions seeks to swallow me up; but forestall, and save thy servant, O Sovereign Lady.[^9575]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же тобо́ю бесѣ́довавый къ человѣ́кѡмъ, Бг҃ъ сы́й всѧ́ческихъ, зра́къ человѣ́ка воспрїѧ́тъ; є҆гѡ́же взо́ръ почита́емъ, Дѣ́во, въ писа́нїихъ.
items.english_text: *Both now:* He Who through thee conversed with men, being God of all things, took on the likeness of man; Whose countenance we revere, O Virgin, in sacred icons.[^9576]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Вои́стиннꙋ Бц҃ꙋ тѧ̀ и҆сповѣ́дꙋемъ, спасе́ннїи тобо́ю Дѣ́во чи́стаѧ, съ безпло́тными ли́ки тѧ̀ велича́юще.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* In truth we confess thee as Theotokos, who are saved through thee, O pure Virgin, with the bodiless choirs magnifying thee.[^9577]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Вертогра́дъ затворе́нъ тѧ̀ Дѣ́во Бц҃е, и҆ запеча́танъ и҆сто́чникъ, Дх҃омъ бж҃твеннымъ, премꙋ́дрый въ пѣ́снѣхъ пое́тъ; тѣ́мже ꙗ҆́кѡ са́дъ жи́зни, воплоща́етсѧ Хрⷭто́съ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A garden enclosed and a fountain sealed by the Divine Spirit doth the all-wise one sing of thee in the Canticle, O Virgin Theotokos; therefore, as the garden of life, Christ is incarnate.[^9578]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Твоегѡ̀ несказа́ннѡ рождества̀ прописꙋ́ѧ проро́къ, кни́гꙋ запеча́танꙋ прови́дѣ: є҆́ѧже никто́же та́инство разꙋмѣ̀, вочеловѣ́ченїа рождества̀ твоегѡ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Prefiguring thine ineffable childbearing, the prophet foresaw a sealed book, the mystery whereof no one hath understood, the incarnation of thy childbearing.[^9579]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory:* Unto thee in compunction of soul do we all pray: despise not our prayers, O our Sovereign Lady, but be...[^9580]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: ...a brightly-shining protection for us, and hear our prayer.[^9581]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Both now:* I fall down before thine icon and that of thy Son; and those who hesitate to venerate them, as falsehoods of Manes, I reject, O Virgin Theotokos; therefore I conclude my song in an Orthodox manner.[^9582]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Trisagion Prayers, and the rest according to custom.*[^9583]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *The Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Creating Trinity.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *(The acrostic whereof is: Trinity, O Unity, save me, thy servant.)*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *A composition of Metrophanes.*[^9584]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos:* The charioteer Pharaoh did the wonder-working rod of Moses once plunge into the deep, striking crosswise and dividing the sea; but it saved fugitive Israel marching on foot, as they sang a song unto God.[^9585]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Trinity our God, glory to Thee.*[^9586]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Unto the thrice-radiant King, and Builder, and Provider of all things, and the only Good One, existing by nature and possessing the single glory of Godhead, unto God the One Principle do we fall down, singing the thrice-holy song.[^9587]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Remembering the divine sayings and the prophecies from on high, manifestly do we glorify the single God-originating nature, ever-existing, co-unoriginate, in three Persons: the Father, and the Son, and the Spirit, all-powerful and creative.[^9588]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory:* Abraham, having become an initiate of sacred mysteries, in a sacred manner of old, received with joy the Creator of all and God and Lord, in three Hypostases; and he showed forth the single dominion of the three Hypostases.[^9589]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* Without knowing wedlock didst thou bear Christ, Who for our sake took on our nature, O Most Pure One, and remained unchanged in both; Whom unceasingly entreat, that He may grant me forgiveness of sins and deliverance from temptations.[^9590]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens with understanding, and didst found the earth upon the waters: establish me, O Christ, upon the rock of the Church; for there is none holy save Thee, O only Lover of mankind.[^9591]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thee, the unapproachable God and King of glory, did Isaiah behold upon a high throne, and the Cherubim and Seraphim glorifying Thee with unceasing hymns, the single Tri-hypostatic One.[^9592]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having attained unto the Word, Who alone was begotten of the Father as from the Mind, and the Spirit proceeding ineffably, according to each of the thoughts and teachings of the scriptures, we revere the One thrice-radiant God.[^9593]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory:* The unbegotten Father, Who is the radiance of His own essence, having incorruptibly begotten the Son, Light of Light, by procession brings forth the co-growing Light of the Spirit, all-effecting and equal in honor.[^9594]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* A pure temple wast thou shown forth, O Virgin Mother Mary, unto Christ Who all-powerfully and all-wisely fashioned all things, and set them in order, and sustains them; Whom make merciful unto me by thy maternal prayers.[^9595]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: The power of the thrice-radiant and honorable Godhead, let us the faithful now praise, for by a mere nod He hath constituted all the angelic choirs on high, and the lowlier church hierarchies below, that they might cry: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O most good God! Glory and praise be unto Thy dominion![^9597]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* Having borne the immutable God, O Good One, do Thou by Thy maternal prayers establish my heart, which is ever altered by sin and slothfulness through the assaults of the deceitful one; that I also may thankfully glorify thee, O Mother of God Mary: have mercy on Thy flock, which Thou hast acquired, O All-Undefiled One.[^9598]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Thou art my strength, O Lord, Thou art also my power; Thou art my God, Thou art my rejoicing, Who leftest not the bosom of the Father, and didst visit our poverty. Therefore with the Prophet Habakkuk do I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind![^9599]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Dayspring of the Godhead, having appeared unto those in darkness, drove away the whole somber night of the passions, and the Sun of Righteousness shone forth, simple indeed in essence, but thrice-radiant in Persons; Whom we ever sing and glorify.[^9600]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Him Who is hymned by the mouths of the Seraphim, we with clay lips glorify as the single and Triune Lord of glory, in essence and Hypostases, crying aloud: O Sovereign King of all, grant unto Thy servants forgiveness of diverse transgressions![^9601]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory:* O honorable and God-originating Trinity, Who sustainest all things that exist, invisible, all-bountiful, tender-hearted, Lover of mankind! Forget not me, Thy servant, utterly, nor make void the covenant which Thou hast ordained for Thy servants, according to Thine ineffable mercy.[^9602]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* Having found thee, O Most Pure Maiden, as the only fair beauty of Jacob from of old, the pre-unoriginate Word, having dwelt in thee for the sake of tender compassion, renewed human nature; Whom unceasingly entreat, that I may be delivered from every sorrow.[^9603]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Why hast Thou cast me off from Thy countenance, O Light unwaning, and alien darkness hath covered me, a wretch? But turn me back, and direct my ways toward the light of Thy commandments, I pray.[^9604]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* We glorify the three co-ever-existing Persons, and the single Lord, the divine nature, simply dividing and uniting; and we faithfully cry aloud: O holy God-originating Trinity, deliver Thy servants from sorrow.[^9605]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* I weep bitterly over the weakness of my mind, how unwillingly I suffer truly an involuntary change! Therefore I cry aloud: O holy Life-Creating Trinity, establish me in the state of the good.[^9606]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory:* Weighted down with the slumber of sin, and plunging into the sleep of death, do Thou, as a Trinity holy, God-originating, Lover of mankind, all-good, and all-merciful, show compassion and raise me up.[^9607]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* O Mother-Virgin Maiden, most pure, all-undefiled, full of divine grace, by thy prayers make thy Son and God and Lord merciful unto me, and deliver thy servant quickly from passions and transgressions.[^9608]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine iniquities; and lead me up from the depth of evils, I pray: for unto Thee have I cried, and hear me, O God of my salvation.[^9609]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Imitating the ranks of heavenly minds, O transcendent Trinity, monarchical over all, with thrice-holy hymns we glorify Thee with our clay lips.[^9610]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Unto Him Who fashioned man according to Thine image, and from non-existence...[^9611]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: ...all things didst all-wisely compose, unto the Tri-hypostatic God do I bow down, and honor, and hymn, and magnify Thee.[^9612]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory:* O Almighty God, and only Uncircumscribed One, dwell Thou in me according to Thine ineffable mercy, O thrice-radiant Master, and enlighten me, and give me understanding, as Thou art tender-hearted.[^9613]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* A temple of the uncontainable God wast thou shown forth, O Most Pure One: make me also a temple of His divine grace, O all-holy Sovereign Lady, by thy supplications, and keep me unharmed.[^9614]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: The unoriginate Father, the co-unoriginate Son, and the Divine Spirit, let us the faithful truly praise in song: undividedly, immutably, and unchangeably, the simple, holy, and co-growing Trinity, crying aloud with the Angels: Holy art Thou, O Father, O Son, with the All-Holy and Honorable Spirit! Have mercy on those whom Thou hast created according to Thine image, O Master.[^9616]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* We give thanks unto thee ever, O Theotokos, and we magnify thee, O pure one, and bow down, hymning thy childbearing, O full of grace, crying unceasingly: Save us, O all-merciful Virgin, as thou art good, in the hour of trial, that we thy servants may not be put to shame.[^9617]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* By God's condescension the fire in Babylon was once put to shame; therefore the children in the furnace, dancing with joyful step as in a flower-garden, sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^9618]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By Thine ineffable wisdom and by the abyss of goodness, show me, Thy servant, to be pitied freely; and now, as of old, deliver me from affliction, O Trinity, O Unity, God, of sins and passions. *Twice.*[^9619]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory:* Unbegotten Mind the Father, and the Word begotten of Him, and the Divine Spirit, incomprehensibly proceeding, O God, One Principle, thrice-radiant, I sing unto Thee: Blessed is the God of our fathers.[^9620]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* I have been slain, O Most Pure One, having been given to drink of the venom of sin, and I flee unto thee in faith, who didst bear the Prince of life: by thy prayers make thy servant alive, and from tempta-...[^9621]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: ...-tions and passions deliver me, O only Pure One.[^9622]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Sevenfold did the Chaldean tyrant madly kindle the furnace for the godly; but seeing them saved by a greater power, he cried aloud unto the Creator and Deliverer: Ye children, bless; ye priests, sing; ye people, exalt Him unto all ages.[^9623]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being an unwaning Light, thrice-radiant and thrice-sunlit, and of one principle, sovereign, most simple, God incomprehensible, and sovereign Lord: do Thou now enlighten my dark and clouded heart, and make me to sing unto Thee brightly and luminously, and to glorify Thee unto all ages.[^9624]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With most sacred wings do the most divine Seraphim reverently veil their faces and their feet, not enduring the glory of Thine incomprehensible beauty, O most holy Trinity, well-originating, God-originating, monarchical; yet do we also dare to hymn Thee and glorify Thee, faithfully unto all ages.[^9625]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory:* The unoriginate Dominion, all-powerful and all-good, perfectly originating, beneficent, uncircumscribed, causeless cause, creative, ever-existing, provident, and saving unto all, Unity in essence, and Trinity in Persons, do I glorify Thee, my God, faithfully unto all ages.[^9626]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
