items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* Upon the earth hath the unwaning Sun shone forth by the virginal childbearing from thee, O Most Pure Sovereign Lady, and delivered men from the clouded gloom of idols; therefore do thou now enlighten me with the rays of that Godhead beyond measure, and keep thy servant.[^9627]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Heaven was struck with awe at this, and the ends of the earth were amazed, that God appeared unto men in the flesh, and thy womb became more spacious than the heavens. Therefore the hierarchies of Angels and of men magnify thee, O Theotokos.[^9628]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Reigning over all things, and all-creative sovereign nature, ageless, life-creating, tender-hearted, Lover of mankind, good, monarchical Trinity: as we now glorify Thee, we ask forgiveness of sins, peace for the world, and oneness of mind for the churches. *Twice.*[^9629]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory:* One Lordship and thrice-radiant, single Godhead thrice-sunlit: receive Thy singers...[^9630]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: ...in a manner befitting God: and deliver us from transgressions, and from temptations, and from cruel things, and swiftly grant peace in Thy love for mankind, and union unto the churches.[^9631]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* Having settled into the virginal womb, O Christ my Savior, Thou wast shown forth unto Thy world as God-man, truly unchangeable and unconfused; and Thou didst promise to be manifestly ever with Thy servants. Therefore, by the prayers of her that bore Thee, establish peace for all Thy flock.[^9632]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *After this, the refrains of Gregory of Sinai: It is truly meet: and the rest of the Midnight Office, written at the end of this book.*[^9633]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *On Sunday, at Matins:*[^9634]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *After the Six Psalms: "God is the Lord," and hath appeared unto us: in Tone 8; and we say the Resurrectional Troparion: "From the heights didst Thou descend": twice. Glory: to the Saint, from the Menaion. Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion of the same Tone as the troparion of the Saint. Then the usual stichology of the Psalter.*[^9635]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *After the First Stichology, Resurrectional Sessional Hymns, Tone 8:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: Thou art risen from the dead, O Life of all, and a radiant Angel cried aloud unto the women: Cease from tears, announce the good tidings unto the Apostles, cry out singing: That Christ the Lord is risen, Who was pleased as God to save the human race.[^9636]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: Having risen from the tomb in truth, Thou didst command the venerable women to proclaim the rising unto the Apostles, as it is written; and speedy Peter came to the tomb, and beholding the light in the tomb, he was struck with awe. Therefore he beheld the winding sheets alone lying in it, without the Divine Body, and with fear he cried aloud: Glory to Thee, O Christ God, for Thou savest all things, O our Savior; for Thou art the Father's Radiance.[^9638]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory... both now... Theotokion:* The Heavenly Door, and the Ark, the all-holy Mountain, the radiant Cloud let us hymn, the Heavenly Ladder, the spiritual Paradise, the deliverance of Eve, the great treasure of all the universe: for in her was salvation wrought for the world, and remission of ancient transgressions. Therefore do we cry unto thee: Pray thy Son and God, to grant remission of transgressions unto those that piously worship thy most holy childbearing.[^9639]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *After the Second Stichology, Resurrectional Sessional Hymns, Tone 8:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: Men sealed Thy tomb, O Savior, but an Angel rolled away the stone from the doors; the women beheld Thee risen from the dead, and they announced the good tidings unto Thy disciples in Zion: That Thou art risen, O Life of all, and loosed are the bonds of death. O Lord, glory to Thee![^9640]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: Having brought funeral myrrh, the women heard the angelic voice from the tomb: Cease from tears, and in place of grief receive joy; cry aloud singing: That Christ the Lord is risen, Who was pleased as God to save the human race.[^9642]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *(We sing not sitting, but standing, and with fear and reverence.)*[^9643]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: In thee rejoices, O Thou Who art full of grace, all creation: the assembly of Angels, and the race of men; O sanctified temple, and spiritual paradise, virginal boast, from whom God was incarnate, and became a child, Who is our God before the ages: for He made thy womb a throne, and fashioned thy body more spacious than the heavens. In thee rejoices, O Thou Who art full of grace, all creation. Glory to Thee![^9644]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Hypakoe, Tone 8:*[^9645]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: The Myrrh-bearers, standing before the tomb of the Giver of Life, sought the immortal Master among the dead; and having received the joy of the good tidings from the Angel, they announced unto the Apostles: That Christ God is risen, granting unto the world great mercy.[^9646]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Songs of Ascents [Anabathmoi], Tone 8:*[^9647]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: From my youth the enemy tempts me, he burns me with pleasures; but trusting in Thee, O Lord, I vanquish him.[^9648]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: Let them that hate Zion become even as grass before it is plucked up; for Christ will cut through their necks with the severing of torments.[^9649]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory:* By the Holy Spirit all things have life: Light of Light, great God! We hymn Him with the Father, and with the Word.[^9650]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Both now: The same.*[^9651]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: I have cried unto Thee, O Lord, attend, incline Thine ear unto me...[^9652]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: ...who cry aloud, and cleanse me before Thou takest me hence.[^9653]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: He that hath hope in the Lord will not be terrified then, when He will judge all things with fire and torment.[^9654]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory:* By the Holy Spirit, every one who is godly beholds and foretells, and works exalted wonders, singing unto the One God in three Persons; for though it shines with three radiances, the Godhead reigns as one.[^9655]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Both now: The same.*[^9656]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: Let my heart, humbly minded, be covered with Thy fear, lest being lifted up it fall away from Thee, O All-Compassionate One.[^9657]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: Whosoever departs unto the earth his mother, is loosed again to receive torments, or the rewards of life lived.[^9658]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory:* By the Holy Spirit, theology is a thrice-holy Unity: for the Father is unoriginate, of Whom the Son was agelessly begotten, and the Spirit, co-enthroned, co-formed, who shone forth from the Father.[^9659]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Both now: The same.*[^9660]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: Behold now, what is so good or what is so pleasant, but for brethren to dwell together? For in this the Lord hath promised life eternal.[^9661]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: He that adorns the lilies of the field commands that it is not fitting to be anxious concerning one's garment.[^9662]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Glory:* By the Holy Spirit, as the single Cause, all things are sustained peace-bestowing; for this is God, consubstantial with the Father and the Son in lordship.[^9663]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Both now: The same.*[^9664]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: The Lord shall reign for ever, thy God, O Zion, unto generation and generation [LXX Ps. 145:10].

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos:* The charioteer Pharaoh did the wonder-working rod of Moses once plunge into the deep, striking crosswise and dividing the sea; but it saved fugitive Israel marching on foot, as they sang a song unto God.[^9667]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy holy Resurrection.*[^9668]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* How should we not marvel at the almighty Godhead of Christ? Which from the passions pours forth dispassion and incorruption unto all the faithful, and from...[^9669]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: ...the holy rib trickling a fountain of immortality, and life everlasting from the tomb.[^9670]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* How comely did an Angel now appear unto the women, bearing bright natural images of immaterial purity, and by his aspect announcing the light of the Resurrection, crying: The Lord is risen![^9671]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Most glorious things have been spoken of thee in generations of generations, who didst contain God the Word in thy womb, yet remainedst pure, O Virgin Mary Theotokos; therefore do we all honor thee, our true protection after God.[^9672]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross and Resurrection.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Having passed through the water as dry land, and having escaped the evils of Egypt, the Israelite cried aloud: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God.[^9673]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Resurrection.*[^9674]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The gates of pain were shattered, and the gatekeepers of hades were struck with fear, beholding Him Who descended into the nethermost parts, Who is on high above all nature.[^9675]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The angelic ranks were amazed, beholding human nature, which had fallen and was shut up in the nethermost parts of the earth, seated upon the Father's throne.[^9676]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The angelic and human ranks unceasingly praise thee, O unwedded Mother; for their Creator hast thou borne as a babe in thine arms.[^9677]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Most Holy Theotokos.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Let us sing unto the Lord, Who led His people through the Red Sea, for He alone is gloriously glorified.[^9678]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^9679]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O Most Pure Theotokos, who didst bear the incarnate, ever-existing, and supremely divine Word beyond nature: we sing unto thee.[^9680]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* A life-bearing cluster of grapes, trickling the sweetness of universal salvation, did the Virgin bear, even Christ.[^9681]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The race of Adam, having been raised up through thee unto blessedness beyond understanding, O Theotokos, worthily glorifies thee.[^9682]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Katavasia: I shall open my mouth:*[^9683]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ въ оу҆миле́нїи дꙋшѝ мо́лимсѧ всѝ: не пре́зри Влады́чице на́ша мл҃твы; но бꙋ́ди
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens with understanding, and didst found the earth upon the waters: establish me, O Christ, upon the rock of the Church; for there is none holy save Thee, O only Lover of mankind.[^9684]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆сꙋжде́на бы́вша А҆да́ма вкꙋше́ніемъ грѣха̀, пло́ти твоеѧ̀ спаси́тельною стра́стію ѡ҆правда́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ: са́мъ бо непови́ненъ сме́ртнагѡ и҆скꙋ́са бы́лъ є҆сѝ, Безгрѣ́шне.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Adam having become condemned by the tasting of sin, Thou didst justify by the saving passion of Thy flesh, O Christ; for Thou Thyself wast not liable to the trial of death, O Sinless One.[^9685]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Воскресе́нія свѣ́тъ возсіѧ̀ сꙋ́щымъ во тмѣ̀, и҆ сѣ́ни сме́ртнѣй сѣдѧ́щымъ, Бг҃ъ мо́й І҆исꙋ́съ, и҆ свои́мъ Бж҃тво́мъ крѣ́пкаго свѧза́въ, сегѡ̀ сосꙋ́ды расхи́тилъ є҆́сть.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The light of the Resurrection dawned upon those in darkness and sitting in the shadow of death,[^9686] even Jesus my God; and having bound the strong one by His Godhead, He plundered his vessels.[^9687]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Херꙋві́мѡвъ и҆ Серафі́мѡвъ превы́шши ꙗ҆ви́лася є҆сѝ Бцⷣе: ты́ бо є҆ди́на пріѧ́ла є҆сѝ невмѣсти́маго Бг҃а, въ твое́мъ чре́вѣ, Нескве́рнаѧ: тѣ́мже тѧ̀ вѣ́рніи всѝ, пѣ́сньми при́снѡ ꙋ҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Higher than the Cherubim and Seraphim hast thou been shown to be, O Theotokos; for thou alone didst receive the uncontainable God in thy womb, O Undefiled One; therefore do all we, the faithful, ever bless thee with hymns.[^9688]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Кан: крⷭ҇товоскре́сенъ І҆рмо́съ. Небе́снагѡ крꙋ́га верхотво́рче Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ це́ркве Зижди́телю, ты́ менѐ ꙋ҆твердѝ въ любвѝ твое́й, жела́ній кра́ю, вѣ́рныхъ ꙋ҆твержде́ніе, є҆ди́не Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Lord, Maker of the vault of heaven and Builder of the Church: do Thou establish me in Thy love, O summit of desires, firm support of the faithful, O only Lover of mankind.[^9689]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Непоко́ршасѧ пре́жде за́повѣди, Гдⷭ҇и, сотво́ршагѡ мѧ̀ вои́стинꙋ, ты̀ ꙋ҆страни́лъ є҆сѝ, въ ѻ́ньже воѡбра́жсѧ, послꙋша́нію же наказа́въ собо́ю, ѡ҆бнови́лъ є҆сѝ распѧ́тіемъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having alienated myself from the commandment of Him Who truly made me, O Lord, Thou, having fashioned Thyself into my form and taught obedience through Thyself, didst renew me by Thy crucifixion.[^9690]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Премꙋ́дростію всѧ̑ прови́дѣвый Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ ра́зꙋмомъ твои́мъ водрꙋзи́вый преиспѡ́днаѧ, не не сподо́билъ є҆сѝ снизхожде́ніемъ твои́мъ Сло́ве Бж҃ій, воскреси́ти є҆́же по ѻ҆́бразꙋ твоемꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Lord, Who by wisdom didst foresee all things, and by Thine understanding didst establish the nethermost parts: Thou didst not deem it unworthy, by Thy condescension, O Word of God, to raise up that which was made according to Thine image.[^9691]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Всели́всѧ въ Дв҃ꙋ тѣле́снѣ Гдⷭ҇и, ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ человѣ́кѡмъ, ꙗ҆́кѡже подоба́ше ви́дѣти тебѐ: ю҆́же и҆ показа́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ вои́стинꙋ Бцⷣꙋ, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ помо́щницꙋ, є҆ди́не Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having bodily made Thy dwelling in the Virgin, O Lord, Thou didst appear unto mankind as it was fitting to see Thee; and her hast Thou revealed as truly the Theotokos, and helper of the faithful, O only Lover of mankind.[^9692]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Кан: Бцⷣѣ. І҆рмо́съ. Ты̀ є҆сѝ ꙋ҆твержде́ніе притѣка́ющихъ къ тебѣ̀ Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ є҆сѝ свѣ́тъ ѡ҆мраче́ныхъ, и҆ пое́тъ тѧ̀ дꙋ́хъ мо́й.
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou art the firm foundation of those who flee unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the light of the darkened, and my spirit sings of Thee.[^9693]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Да́ждь на́мъ по́мощь твои́ми моли́твами Всечи́стаѧ, прило́ги ѿража́ющи лю́тыхъ ѡ҆бстоя́ній.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Grant us help by thy prayers, O All-Pure One, repelling the assaults of grievous tribulations.[^9694]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Є҆́ѵѣ прама́тери ты̀ и҆справле́ніе была̀ є҆сѝ, нача́лника жи́зни мі́рови Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бцⷣе, ро́ждшаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou wast the restoration of our foremother Eve, O Theotokos, having borne Christ, the Author of life for the world.[^9695]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Препоѧ́ши мѧ̀ си́лою Всечи́стаѧ, ꙗ҆́же вои́стинꙋ Бг҃а ро́ждшаѧ пло́тію, О҆́тчꙋю ѵ҆поста́снꙋю си́лꙋ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Gird me with power, O All-Pure One, who didst truly bear God in the flesh, the hypostatic Power of the Father.[^9696]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 4. Heirmos:* Thou art my strength, O Lord, Thou art my power, Thou art my God, Thou art my rejoicing; Who, without leaving the bosom of the Father, didst visit our po-...

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: ...verty; therefore with the Prophet Habakkuk I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind.[^9697]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being Thine enemy, Thou didst love me exceedingly; by a strange emptying Thou didst descend to earth, O Compassionate Savior, not rejecting my uttermost humiliation; and remaining on the height of Thine ineffable glory, Thou didst glorify him who was formerly dishonored.[^9698]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Beholding, O Master, who is not now amazed at death being destroyed by passion, corruption fleeing through the Cross, and hades emptied of its riches through death? A marvelous deed of the divine power of Thee, Who wast crucified, O Lover of mankind.[^9699]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou art the praise of the faithful, O Unwedded One; thou art the protectress, thou art the refuge of Christians, a wall and a haven; for thou bearest petitions unto thy Son, O All-Blameless One, and dost save from perils those who with faith and love know thee as the pure Theotokos.[^9700]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 4. Heirmos:* I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I considered Thy works, and glorified Thy Godhead.[^9701]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The children of the lawless nailed Thee upon the Cross, O Christ God; by which, as Compassionate, Thou didst save those who glorify Thy sufferings.[^9702]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having risen from the tomb, Thou didst raise up together all the dead who were in hades, and didst enlighten, as Compassionate, those who glorify Thy Resurrection.[^9703]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Pray unto God, Whom thou didst bear, O most pure Mary, to grant unto thy servants the forgiveness of sins.[^9704]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O untilled field, who didst bring forth the life-creating ear of corn that gives life unto the world, O Theotokos: save those who sing of thee.[^9705]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having been enlightened, we all proclaim thee to be the Theotokos, O All-Pure One; for thou didst bear the Sun of righteousness, O Ever-Virgin.[^9706]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Grant cleansing unto our ignorances, as Thou art sinless, and give peace unto Thy world, O God, through the prayers of her who gave Thee birth.[^9707]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 5. Heirmos:* Why hast Thou cast me off from Thy presence, O Never-Setting Light, and alien darkness hath covered me, the wretched one? But convert me, and direct my paths unto the light of Thy commandments, I pray.[^9708]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Mocked before Thy passion, O Savior, Thou didst endure to be clothed in purple, covering the shapeless nakedness of the first-fashioned; and naked in the flesh wast Thou nailed upon the Cross, stripping off, O Christ, the garment of deadness.[^9709]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having risen from the dust of death, Thou didst build up again my fallen essence, O Christ; and Thou didst make it unaging, showing it once more as a royal image, glistening with the light of incorruption.[^9710]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having motherly boldness toward thy Son, O All-Pure One, despise not, we pray, the kindred providence for us; for thee alone do Christians mercifully offer unto the Master as propitiation.[^9711]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 5. Heirmos:* Enlighten us by Thy commandments, O Lord, and by Thine arm on high grant us Thy peace, O Lover of mankind.[^9712]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Guide us by the power of Thy Cross, O Christ, for by it we fall down before Thee; grant us peace, O Lover of mankind.[^9713]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Steer our life, as Most Good, as we sing of Thy rising; and grant us peace, O Lover of mankind.[^9714]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beseech thy Son and our God, O pure and unwedded Mary, most pure one, to send down great mercy upon us, the faithful.[^9715]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 5. Heirmos:* Rising early from the night, we cry unto Thee: O Lord, save us; for Thou art our God, and we know none other beside Thee.[^9716]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Still the unbearable tempest of my passions, O thou who didst bear God, the Helmsman and Lord.[^9717]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The angelic ranks and the assembly of men serve thy Childbearing, O most pure Theotokos.[^9718]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Mary Theotokos, unwedded one: bring to naught the hopes of the enemies, and gladden those who sing of thee.[^9719]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 6. Heirmos:* Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine iniquities; and lead me up from the depth of evils, I pray; for unto Thee have I cried, and hear me, O God of my salvation.[^9720]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By a tree did the author of evil mightily cast me down; but Thou, O Christ, having been lifted up upon the Cross, didst more mightily cast him down, putting him to shame, and didst raise up him who had fallen.[^9721]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having shone forth from the tomb, Thou didst show compassion unto Zion, having by Thy divine blood made it new instead of old, as Compassionate; and now Thou reignest therein unto the ages, O Christ.[^9722]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* May we be delivered from grievous transgressions by thy petitions, O pure Mother of God; and may we obtain the divine radiance of the Son of God, ineffably incarnate of thee, O Most Pure One.[^9723]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 6. Heirmos:* I will pour out my prayer unto the Lord, and unto Him will I declare my griefs; for my soul is filled with evils, and my life hath drawn near unto hades; and like Jonah I pray: Lead me up from corruption, O God.[^9724]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst stretch out Thine hands upon the Cross, healing the hand of the first-fashioned incontinently stretched out in Eden; and having of Thine own will tasted gall, Thou didst save, as Mighty, those who glorify Thy sufferings, O Christ.[^9725]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The Deliverer tasted of death and of the ancient condemnation, that He might destroy the kingdom of corruption; and having descended into the nethermost parts, Christ rose again and saved, as Mighty, those who sing of His Resurrection.[^9726]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Cease not to pray for us, O most pure Theotokos and Virgin, for thou art the firm foundation of the faithful; by hope in thee and love for thee are we strengthened, and Him Who was ineffably incarnate of thee do we glorify.[^9727]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 6. Heirmos:* Grant me a robe of light, Thou Who deckest Thyself with light as with a garment, O greatly merciful Christ our God.[^9728]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* A temple of God and an ark, an animate bridal chamber and a heavenly portal, do we, the faithful, proclaim thee to be, O Theotokos.[^9729]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having as God destroyed the idolatrous shrines, Thy Child, O Mary, Bride of God, is worshipped together with the Father and the Spirit.[^9730]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The Word of God showed thee, O Theotokos, to be a heavenly ladder unto earthly beings; for through thee He came down unto us.[^9731]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: Having risen from the tomb, Thou didst raise up the dead and didst resurrect Adam; and Eve keeps festival in Thy Resurrection, and the ends of the world celebrate Thine arising from the dead, O Greatly Merciful One.[^9732]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: Having despoiled the kingdoms of hades and resurrected the dead, O Long-Suffering One, Thou didst meet the Myrrh-bearing women, bringing joy instead of sorrow; and unto Thine Apostles Thou didst announce the tokens of victory, O my Savior, Giver of life, and Thou dost enlighten creation, O Lover of mankind! Therefore the world also rejoices together at Thine arising from the dead, O Greatly Merciful One.[^9733]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 7. Heirmos:* The fire was put to shame before God's condescension in Babylon of old; therefore the Children in the furnace, dancing with joyful foot as in a meadow of flowers, sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^9734]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The glorious emptying, the divine wealth of Thy poverty, O Christ, amazes the Angels, as they behold Thee nailed upon the Cross to save those who cry with faith: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^9735]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By Thy divine descent Thou didst fill the nethermost parts with light, and the darkness that formerly pursued was driven away; whence the prisoners from the ages arose, crying: Blessed is the God of our fathers.[^9736]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Triadicon:* Proclaiming Thee in orthodox manner as Lord of all, and as the only Father unto the only Only-begotten Son, we bless Thee, and we acknowledge the one upright Spirit proceeding from Thee, co-natural and co-eternal.[^9737]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 7. Heirmos:* The Children having arrived from Judea in Babylon of old, by faith in the Trinity trampled down the flame of the furnace, singing: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.[^9738]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst work salvation in the midst of the earth, as was prophesied, O God; for having been lifted up upon the Tree, Thou didst call all who cry with faith: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.[^9739]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having risen from the tomb as from sleep, O Compassionate One, Thou didst deliver all from corruption; and creation is assured by the Apostles who proclaim the Resurrection: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.[^9740]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Triadicon:* We worship the Father, and honor the Son, and the Holy Spirit, confessing three consubstantial Hypostases, and one God and Lord, crying aloud: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.[^9741]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having become incarnate from virginal loins, Thou didst appear for our salva-...

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: ...tion; therefore, acknowledging Thy Mother as Theotokos, we cry in orthodox manner: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.[^9742]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thou didst bud forth as a rod from the root of Jesse, O All-Blessed Virgin, bearing flower-blossoming fruit of salvation unto those who cry with faith unto thy Son: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.[^9743]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Fill all with wisdom and divine power, O hypostatic Wisdom of the Most High, through the Theotokos, who sing unto Thee with faith: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou.[^9744]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 8. Heirmos:* Sevenfold did the Chaldean tormentor furiously heat the furnace for the godly ones; but seeing them saved by a higher power, he cried unto the Creator and Deliverer: Ye children, bless; ye priests, sing; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all the ages.[^9745]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The supremely divine power of Jesus' Godhead hath divinely shone forth in us; for having tasted death on the Cross in the flesh for all, He destroyed the power of hades: Whom unceasingly, ye children, bless; ye priests, sing; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all the ages.[^9746]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* He Who was crucified is risen; the stiff-necked one hath fallen; he that was fallen and crushed is righted; corruption is cast out, and incorruption hath blossomed; for mortality hath been swallowed up by life. Ye children, bless; ye priests, sing; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all the ages.[^9747]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Triadicon:* The thrice-radiant Godhead, shining forth one radiance from one three-hypostatic essence—the unoriginate Begetter, the Word consubstantial with the Father, and the co-reigning, consubstantial Spirit—ye children, bless; ye priests, sing; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all the ages.[^9748]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 8. Heirmos:* Having become victors over the tormentor and the flame by Thy grace, cleaving earnestly unto Thy commandments, the Children cried: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord.[^9749]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Him Who stretched out His hands upon the Tree unto me who was naked, and calls me to be warmed by His comely nakedness: bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all the ages.[^9750]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Him Who raised me up, the fallen one, from nethermost hades, and honored me with the high-enthroned glory of the Begetter: bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all the ages.[^9751]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Triadicon:* The indivisible three-hypostatic Godhead depicted in three Persons, in one essence and glory: bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and supremely exalt Him unto all the ages.[^9752]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 8. Heirmos:* The King of heaven, Whom the angelic hosts hymn: praise and supremely exalt Him unto all the ages.[^9753]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Quench the fiery and flaming arrows of the adversaries directed against us, that we may sing of thee unto all the ages.[^9754]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Beyond nature didst thou bear the Creator and Savior, God the Word, O Virgin; therefore do we sing of thee and supremely exalt thee unto all the ages.[^9755]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The unapproachable Light that made His dwelling in thee, O Virgin, revealed thee as an enlightening and golden-radiant lamp unto all the ages.[^9756]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *My soul magnifies the Lord:*[^9757]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 9. Heirmos:* Heaven was amazed thereat, and the ends of the earth were astonished, that God appeared bodily unto mankind, and thy womb became more spacious than the heavens; therefore the hierarchies of angels and men magnify thee as Theotokos.[^9758]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Being simple by Thy divine and unoriginate nature, Thou didst become composite by the assumption of the flesh, having hypostasized it within Thyself, O Word of God; and having suffered as man, Thou didst remain beyond passions as God; therefore in two natures, indivisibly and without confusion, we magnify Thee.[^9759]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having become man by nature, Thou didst call the Father according to the divine essence Thy God, O Most High, condescending unto Thy servants; having risen from the tomb, by grace Thou didst grant Him Who is by nature God and Master to be the Father of the earthborn; with Whom all we magnify Thee.[^9760]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast revealed, O Virgin Mother of God, having beyond nature borne in the flesh God the Word, Whom the Father belched forth from His heart before all ages as Good; Whom we now understand to be higher than bodily forms, even though He clothed Himself in a body.[^9761]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 9. Heirmos:* Every hearing was affrighted at the ineffable condescension of God, that the Most High willingly came down even unto the flesh from the Virgin's womb, having become man; therefore, we the faithful magnify the most pure Theotokos.[^9762]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* We know Thee, O Son, to be God by nature, conceived in the womb of the Mother of God, and having become...

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: ...man for our sake; and beholding Thee upon the Cross, suffering indeed by human nature, but remaining impassible as God, we magnify Thee.[^9763]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The gloomy darkness hath been destroyed; for from hades Christ, the Sun of righteousness, hath shone forth, enlightening all the ends of the earth, shining with the light of the Godhead, the heavenly man, the earthly God: Whom in two natures we magnify.[^9764]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Direct, and prosper, and reign, O Son of the Mother of God, subduing the Ishmaelite people that war against us, granting unto our pious Emperor (Name)[^9765] the Cross together with the spear as an invincible weapon, when he comes unto Thee.[^9766]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 9. Heirmos:* Confessing thee to be truly the Theotokos, having been saved through thee, O pure Virgin: with the bodiless choirs we magnify thee.[^9767]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Thy memory is full of joy and gladness, pouring forth healings unto those who draw near, who piously proclaim thee to be the Theotokos.[^9768]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With psalms do we sing of thee, O Full of Grace, and unceasingly offer the greeting, "Rejoice!"; for thou didst pour forth joy unto all.[^9769]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Fair sprang forth thy Fruit, O Theotokos, not mediating corruption unto those who partake, but life, unto those who magnify thee with faith.[^9770]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *After the Katavasia, the Little Litany. Then: Holy is the Lord our God. Thereafter the Exapostilarion.*[^9771]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Resurrectional Stichera. Tone 8.*[^9772]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* O Lord, though Thou didst stand before the tribunal to be judged by Pilate, yet Thou didst not depart from the throne, seated with the Father; and having risen from the dead, Thou didst deliver the world from the bondage of the alien, as Compassionate and Lover of mankind.[^9773]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* O Lord, Thou hast given us Thy Cross as a weapon against the devil; for he trembles and shakes, not enduring to look upon its power; for it raises up the dead and hath abolished death. Therefore do we worship Thy burial and Thy rising.[^9774]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* O Lord, though the Jews laid Thee in the tomb as dead, yet as a sleeping King did the soldiers watch over Thee, and as a treasure of life did they seal Thee with a seal; but Thou didst rise again and didst bestow incorruption upon our souls.[^9775]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* Thine Angel, O Lord, having proclaimed the Resurrection, affrighted the guards, but cried aloud unto the women, saying: Why seek ye the living among the dead? He is risen, being God, and hath granted life unto the universe.[^9776]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, Anatolian. Same Tone.*[^9777]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5:* Thou didst suffer by the Cross, being impassible in Thy Godhead; Thou didst accept three-day burial, that Thou mightest free us from the bondage of the enemy; and having made us immortal, Thou dost make us alive by Thy Resurrection, O Christ God, Lover of mankind.[^9778]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 6:* I worship, and glorify, and sing, O Christ, of Thy Resurrection from the tomb; whereby Thou didst free us from the indissoluble bonds of hades, and didst grant unto the world, as God, eternal life and great mercy.[^9779]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 7:* Guarding Thy life-receiving tomb, the transgressors of the law sealed it then with a custody of soldiers; but Thou, as immortal and almighty God, didst rise on the third day.[^9781]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 8:* When Thou didst reach the gates of hades, O Lord, and hadst shattered them, the captive cried aloud thus: Who is this, that He is not condemned in the nethermost parts of the earth, but hath dissolved the prison of death as a shadow? I received Him as dead, and I tremble at Him as God. O Almighty Savior, have mercy upon us.[^9783]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Glory: The Evangelical Sticheron. Both now: Theotokion: Most blessed art thou: Great Doxology, troparion: Having risen from the tomb: Litanies and Dismissal.*[^9784]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes. Tone 8.*[^9785]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, even as Thou didst remember the thief upon the Tree; and make all worthy, O only Compassionate One, of Thy heavenly Kingdom.[^9786]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Hear, O Adam, and rejoice with Eve; for he that formerly stripped you both, and through deception took you captive, hath been brought to naught by the Cross of Christ.[^9787]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having been nailed upon the Tree of Thine own will, O our Savior, Thou didst deliver Adam from the curse of the tree, restoring, as Compassionate, that which is according to Thine image, and the dwelling of Paradise.[^9788]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Today Christ is risen from the tomb, granting incorruption unto all the faithful; and He renews joy unto the Myrrh-bearing women after the Passion and the Resurrection.[^9789]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 5:* Rejoice, ye wise Myrrh-bearing women, who first beheld the Resurrection of Christ and announced it unto the Apostles, the recalling of the whole world.[^9790]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 6:* As the multitude of Angels in heaven, so also upon earth the human race celebrates the most holy Resurrection of Thy goodness, O Lord.[^9791]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Troparion 7:* Thou didst raise us up from the grave of sin, O Savior, who were slain by many passions; and by Thy rising Thou didst destroy the tyranny of death, as Lover of mankind.[^9792]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Glory: Triadicon:* Unoriginate Trinity, indivisible Essence, co-enthroned Unity, equal in honor of glory, supreme-beginning Nature and Kingdom: save those who sing of Thee with faith.[^9793]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* Rejoice, holy Theotokos for us. Rejoice, thou that didst bear joy unto the world. Rejoice, only protectress of mankind and salvation of our souls.[^9794]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *On Sunday Evening.*[^9795]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *At Lord, I have cried, Penitential Stichera. Tone 8.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* O Lord, Who didst come into the world to call sinners and robbers and publicans, and didst receive the harlot and the prodigal: call me also in Thy love for mankind, who have sinned against Thee, O my Christ, more than all, and am no longer repentant.[^9796]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты́ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты́ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты́ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра О҆́тча, и҆ на́шꙋ ни-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* O Lord, Who from among publicans dost appoint pastors for Thy Church, and didst make him who was formerly its persecutor now to be its defender: through their prayers reveal me also as Thine own sheep, O Savior, that I, being unprofitable, may not become food for the alien.[^9797]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Пла́чи, ѻ҆каѧ́ннаѧ дꙋшѐ, пре́жде конца̀, и҆ Бг҃ꙋ прилѣпи́сѧ, зовꙋ́щи є҆мꙋ̀ ѿ се́рдца и҆ стена́ньми, ѡ҆ всескве́рнаѧ: согрѣши́хъ тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, не гнꙋша́йсѧ менѐ, молю́сѧ, но ѡ҆брати́въ мѧ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ми́лостивъ, и҆ проще́нїѧ сподо́би.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Weep, O wretched soul, before the end, and cleave unto God, crying unto Him from the heart and with groanings, O all-defiled one: I have sinned against Thee, O Christ; abhor me not, I pray Thee, but turning me back as Compassionate, vouchsafe me forgiveness.[^9798]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Та́же Минє́и стїхи̑ры ст҃о́мꙋ. А҆́ще нѣ́сть Минє́и:
items.english_text: *Then the Stichera of the Menaion for the Saint. If there is no Menaion:*[^9799]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны стїхи̑ры, безпло́тнымъ ст҃ы̑мъ а҆́гг҃лѡмъ.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the holy Bodiless Angels.*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭ҇и, безпло́тныхъ собо́ри непреста́ннѡ сла́вѧтъ тѧ̀, твоеѧ̀ наслажда́ющесѧ красоты̀, и҆ неизрече́нною добро́тою, и҆ трисо́лнечными лꙋча́ми бога́тнѡ ѡ҆зарѧ́еми; и҆́хже моли́твами и҆ предста́тельствомъ Сп҃се, спасѝ дꙋ́ши на́шѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* O Lord, the assemblies of the bodiless hosts unceasingly glorify Thee, delighting in Thy beauty and ineffable goodness, and richly illumined with thrice-radiant beams; by whose prayers and intercession, O Savior, save our souls.[^9801]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭ҇и, всесли̑чныѧ ли́ки а҆́гг҃лскїѧ ты̀ поста́вилъ є҆сѝ всеси́льнымъ твои́мъ Сло́вомъ, и҆ прест҃ы́мъ твои́мъ Дх҃омъ, неѿпа́дающими зарѧ́ми сїѧ́нїе дарова́въ; и҆́хже мольба́ми и҆ предста́тельствꙑ Сп҃се, спасѝ дꙋ́ши на́шѧ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* O Lord, Thou didst establish the all-comely angelic choirs by Thine all-powerful Word and by Thy Most Holy Spirit, having granted them radiance with unfailing rays; by whose entreaties and intercessions, O Savior, save our souls.[^9802]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭ҇и, Серафі́ми воспѣва́ютъ тѧ̀, и҆ Вла́сти, и҆ А҆́гг҃ли, Нача̑ла, Гдⷭ҇ьствїа Престо́ли, и҆ Си̑лы, и҆ А҆рха́гг҃ли, и҆ Херꙋві́ми стра́шнїи, хвале́нїе тебѣ̀ прино́сѧтъ; и҆́хже мольба́ми, и҆ предста́тельствꙑ Сп҃се, спасѝ дꙋ́ши на́ша.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* O Lord, the Seraphim hymn Thee, and Powers, and Angels, Principalities, Dominions, Thrones, and Authorities, and Archangels, and the awesome Cherubim offer praise unto Thee; by whose entreaties and intercessions, O Savior, save our souls.[^9803]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дꙋйсѧ, бѣсѡ́мъ ᲂу҆мерщвле́нїе. Ра́дꙋйсѧ, дщѝ А҆да́мла, цвѣ́тъ вои́стинꙋ процвѣ́тшїй неꙋвѧда́емый. Ра́дꙋйсѧ, сла́ва рабѡ́мъ твои̑мъ. Ра́дꙋйсѧ Всенепоро́чнаѧ, лю́тыхъ разрѣше́нїе. Ра́дꙋйсѧ, да́ре ѿ Бг҃а дарова́нный, мі́рꙋ спаси́тельный. Ра́дꙋйсѧ, честна́ѧ призыва́ющымъ тѧ̀. Ра́дꙋйсѧ Влады́чице, сла́во сла́вѧщымъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, slaying of demons! Rejoice, daughter of Adam, flower truly blossomed and unfading! Rejoice, glory of thy servants! Rejoice, O All-Immaculate, release from cruel woes! Rejoice, gift granted by God, saving unto the world! Rejoice, precious protectress of those who call upon thee! Rejoice, O Sovereign Lady, glory of those who glorify thee![^9805]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́те ти́хїй: Прокі́менъ днѐ. Сподо́би Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light: The Prokeimenon of the day. Vouchsafe, O Lord:*[^9806]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: На Стїхо́внѣ, стїхи̑ры покаѧ́нны, Гла́съ и҃.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 8.*[^9807]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ Царѧ̀ и҆ Влады́кꙋ, а҆́гг҃ли непреста́ннѡ воспѣва́ютъ; а҆́зъ же тебѣ̀ припа́даю ꙗ҆́кѡ мыта́рь зовы́й: Бж҃е, ѡ҆чи́сти мѧ̀, и҆ поми́лꙋй мѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* The Angels unceasingly hymn Thee, the King and Master; and I fall down before Thee, crying as the publican: O God, cleanse me and have mercy on me.[^9808]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Къ тебѣ̀ возведо́хъ ѻ҆́чи моѝ живꙋ́щемꙋ на небесѝ... Та́кѡ ѻ҆́чи на́ши къ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ Бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ, до́ндеже ᲂу҆ще́дритъ ны̀.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Being immortal, O my soul, be not engulfed by the waves of this life; but rise up, crying aloud unto thy Benefactor: O God, cleanse me and save me.[^9810]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Безсме́ртна сꙋ́щи дꙋшѐ моѧ̀, волна́ми жите́йскими не покрыва́йсѧ; но возни́кни вопїю́щи къ своемꙋ̀ благодѣ́телю: Бж҃е, ѡ҆чи́сти мѧ̀, и҆ спаси́ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us, for we are utterly filled with contempt; our soul is exceedingly filled with the reproach of the prosperous, and with the contempt of the proud.* [^9811]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Поми́лꙋй на́съ Гдⷭ҇и, поми́лꙋй на́съ, ꙗ҆́кѡ по мно́гꙋ и҆спо́лнихомсѧ ᲂу҆ничиже́нїѧ. Наипа́че напо́лнися дꙋша̀ на́ша поноше́нїѧ гобзꙋ́ющихъ, и҆ ᲂу҆ничиже́нїѧ го́рдыхъ.
items.english_text: *Martyrion:* O Martyrs of the Lord, ye sanctify every place and heal every sickness; and now pray ye...[^9812]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: ...that our souls may be delivered from the snares of the enemy, we beseech you.[^9813]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, ensouled palace, spiritual dove! Rejoice, city of thy Creator! Rejoice, refuge and bulwark of the faithful, protectress of those who love thee, and salvation and deliverance! Rejoice, bridge that leadest all unto heaven! Rejoice, all-honored holy Sovereign Lady![^9815]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion Prayers. After the Our Father: dismissal troparion, litany, and dismissal.*[^9816]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *On Sunday at Compline.*[^9817]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos:* The wonder-working rod of Moses, striking crosswise and dividing the sea, once engulfed Pharaoh the chariot-driver, but saved Israel the fleeing foot-traveler as he sang a song unto God.[^9818]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^9819]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Glorious things have been spoken of thee, O All-Pure One, who alone hast become the glory of the faithful; therefore by thy prayers show me, who glorify thee, to be a partaker of the glory to come, O most holy and all-hymned Virgin.[^9820]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Blessed is the Fruit of thy womb, O All-Pure One, whereby all we earthborn were delivered from the curse, O blessed and All-Immaculate Lady! O ineffable wonder! O incomprehensible tidings, and salvation of all the faithful![^9821]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Glory:* The multitude of Angels, the assembly of Disciples and Prophets, the company of Martyrs, and Thy Venerable Ones pray unto Thee ever, O Lord: for the sake of the Theotokos grant us forgiveness of sins, as Lover of mankind.[^9822]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
