items.english_text: *Both now:* Unto thee, O Most Pure, who didst receive in thy womb the unendurable Fire, I pray with faith: that by thy acceptable prayers I may be delivered and snatched from the fire of Gehenna, and freed from eternal torment.[^9823]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Lord, Supreme Creator of the celestial vault and Builder of the Church, do Thou establish me in Thy love, O Summit of desire, Confirmation of the faithful, O only Lover of mankind.[^9824]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having fallen away from a pure life, O All-Pure One, I have become like unto the beasts, and am wholly condemned; O thou that didst bear the Judge, deliver me from all condemnation and save me.[^9825]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Grant me sighing, O Pure One, and a tear of the soul, and perpetual contrition, O Maiden: that I may bewail the passions that hold me captive through ignorance, O Lady full of God's grace.[^9826]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Glory:* The heavenly ranks, the ministering spirits, the assembly of Prophets and Apostles, and Thy Martyrs pray unto Thee unceasingly, O Compassionate One: grant Thy people remission of transgressions.[^9827]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Both now:* Beseech the Merciful One, O all-merciful and Most Pure Lady, to vouchsafe me now His divine compassions; for having mercilessly acquired unmerciful ways, I have become worthy of the eternal fire.[^9828]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Thou art my strength, O Lord, Thou art my power, Thou art my God, Thou art my rejoicing; Who didst not leave the bosom of the Father, and didst visit our poverty; therefore with the Prophet Habakkuk I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind.[^9829]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Tear up the malicious handwriting of my sins, O Most Pure One, with the divine spear that pierced the divine side of Him Who willed to become incarnate of thee; and pray Him to inscribe me in the book of the saved, who have foolishly estranged myself from Him.[^9830]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* That I may glorify thee with voices of thanksgiving, that I may magnify thee with divine love, O All-Immaculate Lady: who through thy great childbirth didst magnify all those that had estranged themselves; vouchsafe divine forgiveness unto me who have greatly estranged myself and grievously fallen.[^9831]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Glory:* The laws of nature were abolished in thee, for beyond nature thou didst bear God the Word; therefore with faith I pray thee, O All-Immaculate One: save by thy prayers him who hath sinned exceedingly beyond human nature, and hath estranged himself from God, now turning back.[^9832]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Both now:* The enemy hath wounded my whole soul with the arrows of sin, and defiled my heart with pleasures, and led me away from the straight path; therefore, O Virgin, I cry unto thee: turn me back, heal me, and save me.[^9833]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Why hast Thou cast me away from Thy countenance, O unwaning Light, and a strange darkness hath covered me, the wretched one? But turn me back, and guide my paths to the light of Thy commandments, I pray Thee.[^9834]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Generations of generations now bless thee, O Virgin, ever-blessed by the heavenly hosts, as having united the earthly with the heavenly; they praise thee, the only blessed among women, the setting-right of fallen Adam.[^9835]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* That I may remain whole, and obtain an unshakeable stance, walking well and doing what is pleasing unto God: pray thou, O good Sovereign Lady, who didst bear the Good Word Who delivered us from unreason.[^9836]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Glory:* O Word, Who didst shed Thy Blood upon the Cross, by the exceeding abyss of Thy mercy dry up the abyss of my passions; and for the sake of the Theotokos vouchsafe me in contrition to be well-pleasing unto Thee, our God.[^9837]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Both now:* O Virgin Mother Maiden, Bride of God, who didst bear in the flesh the Uncontainable One, the glory of the Angels and the plague of demons: vouchsafe divine healing unto my heart which hath been wounded by sin.[^9838]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine iniquities, and lead me up from the abyss of evils, I pray Thee; for unto Thee have I cried, and hear me, O God of my salvation.[^9839]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Human nature was shown mercy through thee, O merciful Sovereign Lady, for thou didst bear the Merciful One, O All-Pure; therefore I pray thee: have mercy on my soul.[^9840]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The ranks of the bodiless powers, together with Thy Martyrs, Prophets, and Apostles, pray unto Thee, O Christ: for the sake of her that bare Thee, save Thy people from every tribulation.[^9841]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Glory:* O unplowed land that didst bear the Cultivator and Creator of all: by divine understanding show forth my soul, which hath grown barren with passions, to be fruitful.[^9842]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Both now:* I have transgressed the commandments that lead unto God, and willy-nilly have become enslaved to wicked passions; therefore I pray thee, O Ever-Virgin: snatch me away from their dominion.[^9843]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Then: Lord, have mercy (40 times). Glory: Both now:*[^9844]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 8:* We the faithful praise the Virgin Mother Maiden, the heavenly piety of the angelic powers and the laudable height for our souls: Rejoice, thou that didst conceive in thy womb the Creator of Angels! Rejoice...[^9845]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: ...thou cleansing of the fallen, who didst incarnate God the Word! Rejoice, O Bride unwedded![^9846]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The fire was abashed in Babylon of old before God's condescension; therefore the Children, dancing with joyful step in the furnace as in a meadow of flowers, sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^9847]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By thy ineffable childbirth thou hast made us worthy of awesome and unutterable things, O Theotokos; therefore deliver me from the awesome torment, and fill me with ineffable joy, that I may ever hymn thee, the much-hymned one.[^9848]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having spent my life in slothfulness, I have become unfruitful, and I dread the examination and the unquenchable fire of Gehenna; O thou that didst bear the unendurable Fire, O Theotokos, hasten to deliver me by thy prayers.[^9849]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Glory:* The great wonder of thy childbirth is higher than all wonders, O pure Virgin; therefore I cry unto thee, O Mother of God: show marvelous Thy mercies upon me, and deliver and save me from the wrath to come.[^9850]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Both now:* As the Benefactor God and plenteous in mercy, have compassion, O Savior, for the sake of her that bare Thee, upon me who have lived in slothfulness and disregarded Thy holy laws and Thy precious commandments, O Christ.[^9851]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* In his fury the Chaldean tormentor heated the furnace sevenfold for the godly; but seeing them saved by a higher power, he cried unto the Creator and Deliverer: Ye children, bless; ye priests, sing; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all the ages.[^9852]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Quicken my deadened soul, raise it up fallen, heal it wounded; calm my mind, still the waves of temptations, O Virgin, and save me who cry: Ye children, bless; ye priests, sing; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto the ages.[^9853]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* As the thief I cry unto Thee: Remember me, O Lover of mankind! I weep as the harlot, and I cry: I have sinned, even as of old the prodigal; receive me, the despairing one who repents, for the sake of the Theotokos, that I may fervently cry unto Thee: Ye priests, sing; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto the ages.[^9854]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Glory:* In servant-like manner we cry unto thee, O all-hymned Theotokos, together with the countless noetic Powers, the Prophets and Venerable Ones, and the Apostles and...[^9855]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: ...Martyrs: make supplication for all men who divinely sing: Ye priests, sing; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto the ages.[^9856]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Both now:* Thou art more honorable than the transcendent angelic ranks, O all-immaculate Theotokos; for from a virginal and unwedded womb thou didst bear their Creator and Lord, incarnate in two essences, unconfusedly and unchangeably in one Hypostasis, O Theotokos.[^9857]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Every ear trembled at the ineffable condescension of God, that the Most High willingly came down even unto the flesh, having become man from a virginal womb; therefore, we the faithful magnify thee, the most pure Theotokos.[^9858]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O divine bed of Solomon, which the sixty mighty ones, the words of divine Scripture, now surround, upon which God rested: keep me, who am ever surrounded by myriads of demons, unharmed by thy power, O pure Ever-Virgin.[^9859]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O thou that droppest divine sweetness, having borne the Sweetness of all: sweeten my soul, which hath been embittered by the venom of the serpent, alienating me from bitter harm ever through thine intercession, O unashamed Protectress of the faithful.[^9860]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Glory:* O Jesus, Sun of glory, enlighten my wretched soul through the supplications of the pure Maiden of God who bare Thee, and of the bodiless servants, Thine honored Apostles, the Hierarchs, the Prophets, the chosen Martyrs, and Thy Venerable Ones.[^9861]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Both now:* I am terrified, O only King, of Thy second and fearful coming, being wholly condemned and perplexed, O Lord; therefore before the end I cry unto Thee: for the sake of her that bare Thee, spare me and save me, O merciful, good Lover of mankind.[^9862]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^9271]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Trisagion Prayers. After the Our Father: dismissal troparion and the rest as usual.*[^9863]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *After the first stichology, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 8.*[^9865]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Look upon my humility with a compassionate eye, O Lord, for in a little while my life is ending, and from deeds there is no salvation for me; therefore I pray: look upon my humility with a compassionate eye, O Lord, and save me.[^9866]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Since the Judge is at hand, take heed, O soul, and ponder the hour of the fearful day; for judgment is without mercy unto those who have shown no mercy. Therefore before the end cry aloud: Spare me, O Savior! For Thou alone art without sin.[^9868]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Glory: Both now: Theotokion:* Having received the command mystically in his mind, the bodiless angel came with haste into Joseph's dwelling, saying unto the Unwedded One: He that bowed the heavens by His descent is contained wholly and unchangeably in thee. And beholding Him having taken a servant's form in thy womb, I am amazed and cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Bride unwedded![^9869]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *After the second stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 8.*[^9870]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Pondering that fearful day, O my soul, watch, kindling thy lamp, illuminating it with oil; for thou knowest not when the voice shall come unto thee, saying: Behold, the Bridegroom! Beware therefore, O my soul, lest thou slumber like the five virgins; but watchfully wait, that thou mayest meet Christ with rich oil, and He will grant thee the divine bridal chamber of His glory.[^9871]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* As the harlot I fall down before Thee, that I may receive remission, and instead of myrrh I offer tears from my heart unto Thee: that even as her Thou mayest have compassion on me, O Savior, and grant me cleansing of sins; for like her I cry unto Thee: deliver me from the mire of my deeds.[^9873]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Martyrion:* Today this temple is illumined with heavenly light; for in it the angelic hosts rejoice, and with them the choirs of the righteous make merry in memory of the passion-bearers. By their prayers send down peace upon Thy world, O Christ, and great mercy.[^9875]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Glory: Both now: Theotokion:* The Master and Creator of all, having taken flesh from thy most pure womb, showed thee forth as protectress unto men, O All-Immaculate Lady. Therefore we all flee unto thee, asking cleansing of transgressions, O Sovereign Lady, and...[^9876]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: ...to be delivered from eternal torment and from every anguish there (we pray thee); that with faith we may cry unto thee: pray unto Christ God to grant remission unto all, O Maiden, who with faith flee unto thy protection.[^9877]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *After the third stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 8.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* How long, O my soul, dost thou live in negligence? How long dost thou pine away in despondency? Arise from the sleep of despondency, O wretched one, and taking thy deeds to heart, groan and tremble at the sentence of the righteous Judge. What wilt thou answer in that hour? Or how wilt thou escape the burning that awaits thee, remaining uncorrected? Before the end cry aloud unto the Judge: Grant me remission of transgressions, O Savior, for Thou alone art long-suffering.[^9879]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* Receive before the end, O soul, the groaning of the publican and the lamentation of the harlot; cease not confessing with lamentation and weeping unto Him Who knows thy secret deeds, crying aloud with fasting and vigilance and prayer: I have sinned! Cleanse me, O Savior, through the prayers of Thine Angels, as Thou art compassionate, and save me.[^9880]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Glory: Both now: Theotokion:* O pure and blessed Lady rejoiced by God, for the sake of the mercy of compassions of Him Who was born of thee, unceasingly pray with the Hosts on high and the Archangels, and with all the Bodiless Powers, to give us before the end pardon and cleansing of sins, and correction of life, that we may find mercy.[^9881]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon to our Lord Jesus Christ, and to His Holy Martyrs.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: Snatch me from the fire of Gehenna, O my Christ; Joseph's).*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos:* Having passed through the water as on dry land, and having escaped the Egyptian evil, the Israelite cried aloud: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God.[^9882]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*[^9883]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Deliver me from Gehenna, which I have procured for myself by improper deeds, O Deliverer; and kindle in my thought the divine fire of Thy love.[^9884]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having been darkened, I bowed down unto passions, and appeared irrational, though honored with reason, O Lord: grant recovery unto my soul, and by the judgments that Thou knowest, save me.[^9885]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Martyrs, pray to God for us.*[^9886]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Martyrion 1:* Having their body tormented with scourgings, the all-lauded crown-bearing martyrs manifested an upright and unbending disposition, and love toward the Creator.[^9887]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Martyrion 2:* Rivers of blood having flowed from the holy bodies of Thy glorious passion-...[^9888]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: ...bearers, choked the thorns of idolatry by Thy power, O Compassionate One.[^9889]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Heal me, O Pure Lady, who am grievously diseased with deadly sin, from carnal and spiritual passions, that with faith I may ever call thee blessed.[^9890]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Second Canon to the Bodiless Holy Angels.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is according to the alphabet. A creation of Kyr Theophanes).*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Heirmos the same.*[^9891]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Archangels and Angels, pray to God for us.*[^9892]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As chiefs of the holy Angels, enjoying the vision of God in radiance, pray unto the Giver of good and the Savior for us, O Archangels.[^9893]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Held fast by dire distresses, we the faithful now flee unto you as our defenders, O divine Archangels: earnestly entreat the Master now for us.[^9894]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Be thou unto me a refuge, O Virgin, a harbor, a wall, and a protectress, O Mother of God, who didst bear God in the flesh, the all-compassionate Deliverer.[^9895]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* O Lord, Supreme Creator of the celestial vault and Builder of the Church, do Thou establish me in Thy love, O Summit of desire, Confirmation of the faithful, O only Lover of mankind.[^9896]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* With what eyes shall I then behold Thee, O Christ Savior, having kept not one of Thy commandments on earth? How shall I stand before Thine unendurable throne, giving account of mine immeasurable evils?[^9897]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Stretching forth the hands of Thy compassions, receive me even as formerly the prodigal, who likewise have become enslaved to dishonorable passions and estranged from Thee, O Jesus, most good Lover of mankind.[^9898]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Martyrion 1:* Having been established upon the rock of the knowledge of God, O passion-bearing Martyrs of Christ: with the weapon of faith ye uprooted the thorns of senselessness, and cultivated the fruits of suffering.[^9899]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Martyrion 2:* Let the Martyrs be praised, the unshakable pillars, the all-radiant adornments of the Church of the true faith, the most sacred sheep of Christ slain of their own will.[^9900]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* I have acquired thee, O Most Holy Lady, as a guardian in tribulations; thee...[^9901]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: ...after God I have as my sleepless protectress; may I find thee, O Most Pure One, delivering me from all condemnation in the day of judgment.[^9902]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Bodiless Powers. Heirmos the same.*[^9903]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Adorned with manifold gifts of the angelic rank, appearing as leaders of the order, O Archistrategoi, steadfastly preserve the churches of Christ by your intercessions. (Twice)[^9904]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Crowned now with the beauties of orthodoxy, the fulfillment of the faithful, with the weapon of good-will: deliver us from distresses as glorious protectors of God, O divine Archangels.[^9905]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast the divine tabernacle of incorruptible life, revealed as the only pure Virgin Mother from the ages: therefore, O All-Hymned Lady, guide me who am in the shadow of death unto life now by thy prayers.[^9906]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon. Ode 4. Heirmos:* From the overshadowing mountain, even the only Theotokos, the Prophet with divine vision perceived Thee, O Word, about to become incarnate, and with fear he glorified Thy power.[^9907]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Great is the struggle of the departing soul, fearful the trembling, when the Judge sits, and men who have sinned are judged! Woe is me! What shall I do, the condemned one?[^9908]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having a heart filled with defilements, and the barely bearable burdens of sins, I flee unto Thy compassions, O Master: despise me not, but have compassion on me, I pray Thee.[^9909]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Martyrion 1:* Precious was your death in the sight of God, O valiant passion-bearers; for ye did not deny Him, though surrounded by myriads of pains and wounds.[^9910]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Martyrion 2:* The enemy was wounded by the wounding of the martyrs, his prideful blood fell: and the Bestower of their crowns is magnified, glorified in divine songs.[^9911]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee, the pure receptacle of the Master, O Mother of God, I pray with faith: cleanse me from every defilement, and reveal me as a dwelling of the all-effecting and Holy Spirit.[^9912]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Bodiless Powers. Ode 4. Heirmos:* I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Godhead.[^9913]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченици Гдⷭ҇ни, всѧ́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆свѧща́ете, и҆ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́ете; и҆ ны́нѣ моли́теся,
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* O foremost pair of the assembly of Archangels, those who re-...[^9914]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: ...тѣка́ющїа къ покро́вꙋ ва́шемꙋ, ѿ всѧ́кїѧ бѣды̀ спаса́йте. Два́жды.
items.english_text: ...who flee unto your protection, save ye from every calamity. (Twice)[^9915]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Зри́телїе свѣ́тлости бг҃онача́льныѧ, и҆ благодѣ́ѧнїѧ, А҆рхїстрати́зи всесла́внїи, ны́нѣ ста́до ва́ше просвѣща́йте.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Beholders of the divine brightness and beneficence, O all-glorious Archistrategoi, enlighten now your flock.[^9916]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Свяще́ннѡ тѧ̀ сла́вѧтъ безпло́тныхъ бж҃твеннаѧ вѡ́инства, Бг҃ома́ти всенепоро́чнаѧ: Зижди́телѧ бо и҆́хъ родила̀ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Sacredly do the divine hosts of the bodiless hymn thee, O all-immaculate Mother of God; for thou didst bear their Creator.[^9917]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́ на́съ повелѣ́нїи твои́ми Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ мы́шцею твое́ю высо́кою, тво́й ми́ръ пода́ждь на́мъ, є҆ди́не Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon. Ode 5. Heirmos:* Enlighten us by Thy commandments, O Lord, and by Thine arm on high grant us Thy peace, O only Lover of mankind.[^9918]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Нра́вомъ лꙋка́вымъ преогорчи́хъ тѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇и, дѣ́лаѧ безмѣ́стнаѧ; но ᲂу҆ще́дри мѧ̀ ѡ҆браща́ющагосѧ, и҆ спасѝ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.*[^9919]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: И҆мѣ́ѧ по́мыслъ ѿ ѕлы́хъ невозница́ющь, нечꙋ́вствꙋю несмы́сленный. Недоꙋмѣ́нїе моѐ І҆и҃се разрѣшѝ, и҆ спаси́ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By a deceitful disposition have I provoked Thee to anger, O Lord, doing improper things; but have compassion on me who return, and save me.[^9920]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Положѝ ва́съ, бж҃ественнїи Мꙋ́ченици Свѣтода́тель, ꙗ҆́кѡже ка́менїа сїѧ́ющаа бг҃оразꙋ́мїемъ, и҆ пре́лести тмꙋ̀ разорѧ́ющаа.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having a mind that rises not above evil things, I am insensible, senseless one that I am; resolve my perplexity, O Jesus, and save me.[^9921]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Зако́нѡмъ лꙋка́вымъ, зако́ны бж҃твенныѧ сопротивоположи́сте, и҆ Бг҃а проповѣ́дающе, ᲂу҆мертви́тисѧ є҆гѡ̀ ра́ди ᲂу҆се́рднѡ пода́сте.
items.english_text: *Martyrion 1:* The Giver of light hath set you, O divine Martyrs, as stones shining with the knowledge of God, and destroying the darkness of error.[^9922]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Оᲂу҆мертвѝ Чи́стаѧ пло́ти моеѧ̀ двиза́нїа, ᲂу҆мертви́вшаа рождество́мъ твои́мъ, О҆трокови́це, живꙋ́щїй грѣ́хъ пра́отца.
items.english_text: *Martyrion 2:* Unto deceitful laws ye opposed the divine laws, and proclaiming God, ye eagerly gave yourselves over to be put to death for His sake.[^9923]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: О҆́крестъ Бг҃а предстоѧ́ще А҆рхїстрати́зи, и҆ ѿтꙋ́дꙋ и҆стека́ющими зарѧ́ми просвѣща́еми, ста́до ва́ше сохрани́те. В҃.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Put to death, O Pure Lady, the movements of my flesh, who by thy childbearing, O Maiden, didst put to death the living sin of the forefather.[^9924]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: И҆збавлѐнїе на́мъ дарова́ти, моли́тесѧ Влады́цѣ и҆ Бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ предста́телїе всѣ́хъ и҆збавлѐнїа.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Bodiless Powers. Same Heirmos.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Мѵ́ро та́йнѣ и҆менꙋ́емъ тѧ̀ Всечи́стаѧ сꙋ́щее, ро́ждшꙋю Бг҃а пло́тїю, благоꙋха́нїа точа́щаго дарова́нїа.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Standing round about God, O Archistrategoi, and illumined with the rays streaming thence, preserve your flock. (Twice)[^9925]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: І҆ѡ́нꙋ въ ки́тѣ Гдⷭ҇и є҆ди́наго всели́лъ є҆сѝ, менѐ же свѧ́занаго мре́жами вра́жїими, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ тлѝ ѻ҆́наго, спасѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Pray ye unto our Master and God that deliverance be granted unto us, as protectors of the deliverance of all.[^9926]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Mystically do we call thee true Myrrh, O All-Immaculate, who didst bear God in the flesh, Who pours forth the gifts of sweet fragrance.[^9927]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon. Ode 6. Heirmos:* Jonah alone didst Thou settle in the sea-monster, O Lord; but me who am bound in the nets of the enemy, as him from corruption, save Thou.[^9928]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Shine upon me the sun-like light of repentance, O Christ Light-Giver, who am in the darkness of transgressions, that I may sing of Thy goodness.[^9929]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Before Thy fearful judgment-seat...[^9930]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: ...I tremble ever, yet from evil deeds I desist not, serving evil custom; correct me, O Christ, that I may sing of Thy goodness.[^9931]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Martyrion 1:* The choirs of the honorable martyrs suffered, and conquered the demonic legions, and joined in joy with the angelic choirs; by their prayers, O Lord, save our souls.[^9932]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Martyrion 2:* By Thy strength didst Thou show Thy martyrs to be strong, O Lord, and they cast down all the power of the ancient supplanter; by their prayers, O Lord, save our souls.[^9933]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* That with thankful voices I may ever praise thee, O All-Immaculate, drive away the darkness of my soul, and by the light of repentance loose my gloomy transgressions.[^9934]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Bodiless Powers. Ode 6. Heirmos:* I will pour out my prayer unto the Lord, and unto Him will I declare my griefs; for my soul is filled with evils, and my life hath drawn near unto hades; and like Jonah I pray: Lead me up from corruption, O God.[^9935]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having now been vouchsafed to stand unwaveringly before the awesome throne, O God-beholders, and to be filled with the radiance of the Holy Trinity: pray ye that we who flee unto you be delivered from tribulations and passions, O Archangels. (Twice)[^9936]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Pray ye, O God-beholding Archangels, Gabriel and Michael all-glorious, that those who hymn you in songs may attain unto the Master's pilgrimage, and be vouchsafed everlasting joy and divine brightness.[^9937]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Let the ensouled bridal chamber of the Master be praised, which is bright with the radiant beams of virginity, like a lily shining in the midst of the thorny turmoil, even the most pure and comely Virgin Theotokos.[^9938]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon. Ode 7. Heirmos:* The Children that went down from Judea in Babylon of old, by faith in the Trinity trampled upon the furnace flame, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^9939]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Grant me groaning, O Christ, even as of old unto the publican and as unto the harlot, having washed away with tears the festerings of mine evils; and have compassion on me who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^9940]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having fallen among soul-destroying thieves, O Savior, and grievously...[^9941]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: ...wounded, heal me with the oil of sincere repentance, and grant me compunction to sing unto Thee: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^9942]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Martyrion 1:* Ye died unto the world, and in no wise denied the life-bearing Christ Who became dead, O valiant Passion-bearers, suffering and singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^9943]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Martyrion 2:* Confessing the one nature of the Trinity in three Hypostases, O wise Passion-bearers, ye destroyed the polytheistic error of idols, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^9944]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* God the Word of God, having dwelt in thy womb, O pure Virgin Mother, shows thee forth as protectress unto all that are wronged, who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^9945]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Bodiless Powers. Same Heirmos.*

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Manifold grace hath the Benefactor of all granted unto you, O divine Archistrategoi; whose Church now singing, save ye: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers. (Twice)[^9946]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Strengthened by the power of the All-Seeing One, ye clearly oversee all the ends of the earth, and save all who sing with faith: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^9947]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having thee now as a saving haven, O Virgin Theotokos, we escape worldly perils and turmoils, crying unto thy Son: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^9948]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon. Ode 8. Heirmos:* Him that was glorified on the holy mountain, and in the bush through fire revealed the mystery of the Ever-Virgin unto Moses, praise ye the Lord, and supreme exalt Him unto all ages.[^9949]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Brought down by carnal self-indulgence, and foolishly having distanced myself from Thee, O Word, and having become like unto all the beasts: despise me not, O Savior, but turning me back before the end, save me.[^9950]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In no wise do I desist from sins, never working conversion, and I cry, wretched one that I am: I have sinned against Thee, O Lord; soften my hardened soul, O Compassionate One.[^9951]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Martyrion 1:* The valiant passion-bearers of the Lord, having been baptized with streams of blood, were not defiled with second blemishes, and as crown-bearers they dance unceasingly with the Angels,[^9952]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Martyrion 2:* Girded with the hope of future blessings, the martyrs of piety bravely endured the cruelty of torments; and having finished their course, they stand unceasingly before the throne of the Master.[^9953]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou art the confirmation of those that stand, and the restoration of those that have fallen, O Virgin; therefore raise me up who have fallen, that I may glorify thee, the blessed one full of grace.[^9954]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Bodiless Powers. Ode 8. Heirmos:* The King of heaven, Whom the angelic hosts hymn, praise ye and supreme exalt Him unto all ages.[^9955]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The protectors and chanters of Thine in- ineffable and unutterable glory, receive Thou, O Christ, now praying unto Thee unto ages. (Twice)[^9956]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O only Good Christ, receive now the angelic hosts praying unto Thee for us, who hymn Thee unto ages.[^9957]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With thy brightest radiants, O Mother of God, thou dost enlighten those who sing of thee with faith, who praise thee unto all ages.[^9958]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *My soul doth magnify the Lord: with the refrain: More honorable than the Cherubim:*[^9959]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Penitential Canon. Ode 9. Heirmos:* Every ear was terrified at the ineffable condescension of God, that the Most High willingly came down even unto the flesh, having become man from a Virgin's womb; therefore, the all-pure Theotokos do we, the faithful, magnify.[^9960]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Even as of old Thou didst cleanse the harlot that fell down before Thee with weeping, O Savior; and even as Thou justifiedst the publican, O Word, who only groaned; and even as Thou didst accept Manasseh, and even as Thou hadst mercy on David who repented: so also receive me, and save me, O Lover of mankind.[^9961]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Groan and shed tears, O soul; desist from thy former transgressions, and fall down openly before Him Who knows thy secrets, and cry warmly: I have sinned against Thee, O Lord; freely have compassion on me, Thou Who hast a heart of compassions, O Plenteous in mercy.[^9962]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Martyrion 1:* The God-radiant passion-bearers suffered patiently upon earth, and have now received the unshakable inheritance of the kingdom, and rejoicing they partake of heavenly sweetness; by their prayers, O Christ God, make us partakers of Thy glory.[^9963]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Martyrion 2:* Ye were shown forth as luminaries, having enlightened the unwaning Orient, and ye destroyed the night of godlessness, O All-Wise Ones,...[^9964]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: ...and with sacred rays ye enlighten all who magnify your light-bearing feast, O Passion-bearers.[^9965]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Enlighten, O Sovereign Lady, door of light, the eyes of my heart, I pray, which the deep darkness of sin hath darkened; and send down upon me the dawn of repentance, and from eternal fire, by thine intercession, O Pure One, set me free.[^9966]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Bodiless Powers. Ode 9. Heirmos:* Confessing thee in truth as the Theotokos, saved through thee, O pure Virgin, with the bodiless choirs we magnify thee.[^9967]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Show now Thy Church to be an imitator of the choirs of the Bodiless in virtue, O Christ, fencing Thy flock with Angels.[^9968]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Pray ye, all-glorious Angels, our protectors, that salvation from God may be granted unto our souls who flee under your protection.[^9969]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As a dawn unto those in darkness and wandering, O Virgin, holding the Sun of righteousness in thy hands, Christ, didst thou shine forth.[^9970]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Little Litany, Exapostilarion, and the usual Psalms.*[^9971]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 8.*[^9972]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* When I take into my mind the multitude of evils wrought by me, and come to the thought of that fearful examination, seized with trembling I flee unto Thee, the God Who lovest mankind; therefore despise me not, I pray Thee, O only Sinless One: grant compunction unto my humble soul before the end, and save me.[^9973]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad... And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, and guide their sons.* [^9974]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Grant me tears, O God, even as formerly unto the sinful woman; and vouchsafe me to wet Thy feet, which freed me from the way of error, and to offer unto Thee as sweet-smelling myrrh a pure life, created for me by repentance: that I also may hear Thy desired voice: Thy faith hath saved thee, go in peace.[^9975]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and establish Thou the works of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish Thou. Martyrion:* [^9976]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Martyrion:* What shall we call you, O Saints? Cherubim? For upon you Christ hath rested. Seraphim? For unceasingly ye glorified Him. Angels? For ye turned away from the body. Powers? For ye...[^9977]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: ...work wonders. Many are your names, and greater are your gifts. Pray that our souls may be saved.[^9978]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Glory: Both now: Theotokion:* The heavenly hosts sing of thee, O Maiden full of grace, unwedded Mother; and we glorify thine unfathomable childbearing, O Theotokos: pray that our souls may be saved.[^9979]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise: Trisagion Prayers; after the Our Father: dismissal troparion, litany, and the rest.*[^9980]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *On Monday, the Beatitudes, Tone 8.*[^9981]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, even as Thou rememberedst the thief upon the Tree; and vouchsafe all, O only Compassionate One, Thy heavenly kingdom.[^9982]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Heal, O Christ, the passions of my soul, O only Physician of souls and bodies; and having washed me with streams of compunction, cleanse me wholly as Thou art tender-hearted.[^9983]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Standing round about the throne of the honorable Godhead, Thrones, Cherubim, Principalities, and Authorities, the other chieftains of the bodiless hosts, sacredly sing.[^9984]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Kindled with the burning of the love of Christ, the sufferers remained unburned in the midst of the fire, having burned up the thorns of impiety by divine grace.[^9985]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Glory: Triadikon:* O Thrice-Holy Trinity, unity supremely originating, deliver Thy servants from unquenchable fire, through the entreaties of Thy divine bodiless powers, and vouchsafe them Thy kingdom.[^9986]

items.office: Monday: The Holy Bodiless Powers[^9864]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* Isaiah once foresaw thee as a scroll, O Lady rejoicing in God, wherein with the Father's finger was the Word ineffably written, inscribing us in the book of life.[^9987]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *On Monday Evening.*[^9989]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 8.*[^9990]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Neither compunction have I acquired, nor a fountain of tears, nor warm confession, nor weeping that cleanses, nor contrition of heart; neither have I become an emulator of the publican, nor of the har-...[^9992]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: ...-lot, nor of the prodigal youth. How then shall I find forgiveness of my many sins? But by whatever judgments Thou knowest, O Christ, save me.[^9993]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Estranged have I become from every divine commandment, and for the better virtue I have in every way cared not, and foolishly have I spent all my life in slothfulness; in fornication have I wrought all my deeds, improper and unlawful; therefore, O Christ, have compassion as Thou art tender-hearted, and freely save me.[^9994]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Rebuke me not in Thine anger, the work of the hands of Thy goodness, who have severed myself by an unreasoning mind, O Thou Who for my sake didst deign to be as I am, for the sake of the ineffable abyss of compassion, O Lover of mankind; but through the prayers of the Ever-Virgin, Thy Mother, O Word, vouchsafe me divine conversion as God.[^9995]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Holy Forerunner John.*[^9996]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* O blessed Forerunner John, make my humble soul ever to grow with love toward the Lord by thy sacred intercessions; quench the fire of my passions, leading me unto the fulfillment of divine commandments, and truly cleanse the feelings of my heart, that I may glorify thee.[^9998]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Offspring of the barren woman, and the garden of purity of the Master, adornment of men, O all-lauded Forerunner John, divine guardian of my humble soul: by thy prayers and help grant good favor, delivering me from the serpent's deceit, and from his malicious barks and assaults.[^9999]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Thou art wholly sweetest, and filled with divine sweetness, O Ever-Glorious One, and thou makest glad all who with faith come unto thee, sweetening the feelings both of soul and of body, ever delivering us from diseases and afflictions, and evil assaults, and soul-corrupting passions.[^10000]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Glory: Both now: Theotokion:* With faith do I flee unto thy protection, O pure Mother of God: from tribulations and perils, and the confusion of passions, and from demonic affliction save me, as having an abyss of mercy, and having appeared as mediatress of salvation, O Sovereign Lady who didst bear God the merciful, the only all-compassionate and plenteous in mercy.[^10001]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *O Gladsome Light: and the rest.*[^10002]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 8.*[^10003]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Thee, King and Master, the Angels unceasingly hymn; but I...[^10004]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: ...fall down before Thee, crying as the publican: O God, cleanse me and have mercy on me.[^10005]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Being immortal, O my soul, be not engulfed by the waves of this life; but rise up, crying aloud unto thy Benefactor: O God, cleanse me and save me.[^10007]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us, for we are utterly filled with contempt; our soul is exceedingly filled with the reproach of the prosperous, and with the contempt of the proud.* [^10008]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Martyrion:* O Martyrs of the Lord, pray unto our God, and entreat for our souls a multitude of compassions, and cleansing of many transgressions, we beseech you.[^10009]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Glory: Both now: Theotokion:* Rejoice, praise of the universe! Rejoice, temple of the Lord! Rejoice, overshadowing mountain! Rejoice, refuge of all! Rejoice, golden candlestick! Rejoice, honorable glory of the Orthodox! Rejoice, paradise! Rejoice, divine table! Rejoice, tabernacle! Rejoice, all-golden jar! Rejoice, hope of all![^10010]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion Prayers, and the rest as usual.*[^10011]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *On Monday at Compline.*[^10012]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Supplicatory Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.*[^10013]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos:*[^10014] Having passed through the water as on dry land, and having escaped the Egyptian evil, the Israelite cried aloud: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God.[^10015]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^10016]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Knowing thee, O Mother of God, to be a prayerful fountain of waters, pouring forth unto the faithful streams for souls and bodies, therefore do we unceasingly glorify thee.[^10017]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Beyond nature didst thou bear the divine and originating Word, O Virgin, and hast delivered our nature from corruption; therefore free me from irrational and unnatural passions.[^10018]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The pastures of carnal passions now surround me, and grievously afflict me; visit speedily thy servant, O Virgin, and save me from those who oppress me.[^10019]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Both now: Theotokion:* He that upholds all creation, and bears and saves it, appeared circumscribed upon thine arm, O Pure One, and renewed the human race.[^10020]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Troparion 1:* Lull the confusion of the cruel sickness that now holds me fast, O most pure Sovereign Lady, and free me from transgressions and passions.[^10021]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* An ineffable abyss of thy compassions, O Most Pure One: whereby deliver me also from transgressions and diseases.[^10022]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Make haste and visit me that am diseased, O Most Pure One, and deliver me from grievous sicknesses and all manner of sorrow.[^10023]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Both now:* Magnify the mercy and protection of thy prayers upon me, O Most Pure One, and deliver me from perils and afflictions.[^10024]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Godhead.[^10025]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Show forth unto my heart ever, O Most Pure One, a place of cleansing: the remembrance of the saints, and the cleansing of transgressions.[^10026]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Grant me salvation of soul and body, O All-Immaculate One; and unto him that is sick grant healing, and deliverance from cruel woes.[^10027]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Glory:* Abolish the wiles of the subtle demons, O Most Pure One, and the uprisings of passions; and grant power unto us that are weak.[^10028]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: *Both now:* From thy womb, O Most Pure One, the Sun of righteousness hath shone forth and enlightened the world; with Whose divine rays enlighten me also.[^10029]

items.office: Tuesday: The Holy Forerunner[^9988]
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечный свѣ́тъ покаѧ́нїа возсїѧ́й мнѣ̀, Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣтода́телю, сꙋ́щемꙋ въ тмѣ̀ прегрѣше́нїй, да пою̀ твою̀ благосты́ню.
