items.english_text: That which grew of old in Eden, in Paradise, was a tree for food in the midst of the orchards; but Thy Church, O Christ, hath blossomed Thy Cross, pouring forth life unto all the world. But that one indeed slew by eating Adam who ate thereof; while this made alive the thief who was saved by faith: of whose salvation show us also partakers, O Christ God, Who by Thy passion...[^10339]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10157]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: ...hast destroyed the wiles of the enemy against us, and vouchsafe us Thy kingdom, O Lord.[^10340]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10157]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and direct Thou the works of our hands upon us; yea, direct Thou the work of our hands.* [^10341]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10157]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: O invincible Martyrs of Christ, having conquered deceit by the power of the Cross, ye received the grace of eternal life; not fearing the threats of the tormentors, wounded with torments ye rejoiced; and now your blood hath become healings for our souls: pray ye that our souls may be saved.[^10342]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10157]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Seeing Thee hanging upon the Cross, O Lord, the Pure One who bare Thee, being nearby, weeping said: O Child, why dost Thou suffer these things in the flesh, and makest haste to leave me childless? Make haste to be glorified, that I may be magnified by Thy passion.[^10343]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10157]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise: Trisagion, and after Our Father: troparion, litany, and the rest.*[^10344]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10157]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *On Wednesday, The Beatitudes.*[^10345]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10157]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, even as Thou didst remember the thief upon the Tree; and vouchsafe all, O only Compassionate One, Thy heavenly kingdom.[^10346]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10157]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Prefiguring the Cross with his rod, Moses divided the deep, leading across the Israelite people; but we, portraying it, conquer our noetic enemies.[^10347]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10157]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Of old Jacob, blessing the children, the sons of his sons, stretched out his hands crosswise, signifying Thy Cross, O Christ Savior, whereby all of us were freed from the curse.[^10348]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10157]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Zealous for Christ's passions, O passion-bearers, ye manfully endured bitter torments, and crowned with incorruptible crowns, ye dwell in the heavens.[^10349]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10157]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Glory to the Father, the only Immortal; glory to the Son, Who lives unto the ages; glory together to the All-Holy Spirit, Who sanctifies all creation.[^10350]

items.office: Wednesday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10157]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Out of thy virginal womb, O Pure One, shone forth the Creator of the sun and the moon; Whom beholding hanging upon the Tree, all creation trembled.[^10351]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *On Wednesday Evening.*[^10353]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Holy Apostles, Tone 8.*[^10354]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: O Lord, Thou didst enlighten Thine Apostles with the rays of the Comforter, and having set them as luminaries for the confirmation of the faith, by the spiritual illumination of Thy knowledge, O Master: therefore we worship Thine ineffable love for mankind.[^10356]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: O Lord, by the prayers of the Apostles Thou hast fenced this Thy flock, preserving it unharmed from the temptation of enemies, since Thou didst redeem it by Thy precious blood from the servitude of the stranger, as Thou art compassionate and a lover of mankind.[^10357]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Ye appeared together in the foundation of the Church like precious stones, shining with a radiant beam unto the universe the sure knowledge of God, O divine Apostles, standers-before the Trinity, and intercessors for our souls.[^10358]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Then in the Menaion, stichera to the Saint, if there be any. If there be no Menaion:*[^10359]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Holy Wonderworker Nicholas, Tone 8.*[^10360]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: O Lord, Thou hast glorified Thy precious hierarch Nicholas unto the ends of the earth, having given unto him the grace of miracles; and Thou hast shown him forth as a helper unto them that are in grievous perils, and in afflictions and tribulations, who fall down and ask his protection.[^10361]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: O Lord, through the divine entreaties of Thy hierarch, have compassion, and free Thy servants from every peril, and from every affliction and assault of the enemy, who in faith worship Thine invincible might.[^10362]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: O Lord, Thou hast shown forth the hierarch in the world as a sweet fragrance: for he makes fragrant the hearts of all the faithful by miracles, driving away diseases and passions of souls by Thy grace. By his prayers, as Thou art compassionate, save them that hymn Thee.[^10363]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Behold the sighing of my contrite heart, O Bride of God. Accept, O pure Virgin Mary, the lifting up of my hands, as thou art a lover of mankind, and cast me not away, O All-Immaculate, that I may hymn and magnify thee, who hast magnified our race.[^10364]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Joyful Light: and the rest.*[^10365]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Apostles, Tone 8:*[^10366]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ моѧ̀ и҆ си́ла, ты̀ мо́й Бг҃ъ, ты̀ моѐ ра́дованіе, не ѡ҆ста́вль нѣ́дра Оу҆́ч҃а, и҆ на́шꙋ нищетꙋ̀ посѣти́въ; тѣ́мъ съ проро́комъ Авваку́момъ зовꙋ́ тебѣ́: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва, Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: O Lord, having fervently loved Thee upon the earth, the Apostles counted all things as refuse...[^10367]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: нѣ́йша всѧ̑, да тебѐ є҆ди́наго приѡбрѧ́щꙋтъ, и҆ за тѧ̀ на ра́ны тѣлеса̀ своѧ̑ преда́ша; сегѡ̀ ра́ди просла́влени бы́вше, мо́лѧтсѧ ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: ...more vile than all things, that they might gain Thee alone, and for Thy sake they gave over their bodies unto wounds; therefore having been glorified, they pray for our souls.[^10368]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Къ тебѣ̀ возведо́хъ ѻ҆́чи моѝ живꙋ́щемꋋ на небесѝ. - - - Та́кѡ ѻ҆́чи на́ши къ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ Бг҃ꙋ на́шемꋋ, до́ндеже оу҆ще́дритъ ны̀.
items.english_text: O Lord, Thou hast magnified the memory of the Apostles upon the earth; for we all, having assembled together therein, doxologize Thee: that for their sake Thou grantest us healings, and unto all the world pacification by their prayers, and great mercy.[^10370]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ А҆пⷭ҇лѡвъ па́мѧть на землѝ возвели́чилъ є҆сѝ; всѝ бо вкꙋ́пѣ соше́дшесѧ въ не́й славосло́вимъ тѧ̀: ꙗ҆́кѡ подае́ши на́мъ тѣ́хъ ра́ди и҆сцѣле́нїа, и҆ всемꙋ̀ мі́рꙋ оу҆мире́нїе моли́твами и҆́хъ, и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us, for we are greatly filled ... Our soul is exceedingly filled with the reproach of them that are at ease, and the contempt of the proud.* [^10371]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ: Поми́лꙋй на́съ Гдⷭ҇и, поми́лꙋй на́съ, ꙗ҆́кѡ по мно́гꙋ - - - наипа́че напо́лнися дꙋша̀ на́ша поноше́нїа гобзꙋ́ющихъ, и҆ оу҆ничиже́нїа го́рдыхъ.
items.english_text: If there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, it is fitting for the Saints; for they bowed their necks unto the sword, for Thy sake Who didst bow the heavens and come down; they shed their blood for Thy sake Who didst empty Thyself and take the form of a servant; they humbled themselves even unto death, imitating Thy poverty. By their prayers, according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies, O God, have mercy on us.[^10372]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще ка́ѧ добродѣ́тель, и҆ а҆́ще ка́ѧ похвала̀, подоба́етъ ст҃ы̑мъ: мече́мъ бо преклони́ша вы̑и, тебѐ ра́ди прекло́ншагѡ небеса̀ и҆ соше́дша; пролїѧ́ша кро́ви своѧ̑ тебѐ ра́ди и҆стощи́вшагѡ себѐ, и҆ зра́къ раба̀ прїе́мшагѡ; смири́шасѧ да́же до сме́рти, нищетѣ̀ твое́й подо́бѧщесѧ. И҆́хже моли́твами, по мно́жествꙋ щедро́тъ твои́хъ Бж҃е, поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: I, O holy Virgin Theotokos, flee unto thy protection: I know that through thee I shall find salvation; for thou art able, O Pure One, to help me.[^10373]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: А҆́зъ, Дѣ́во ст҃а́ѧ Бцⷣе, къ покро́вꙋ твоемꋋ прибѣга́ю: вѣ́мъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆брѧ́щꙋ тобо́ю спасе́нїе; мо́жеши бо Чи́стаѧ, помощи́ мнѣ̀.
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: Trisagion. After Our Father: troparion, litany, and dismissal.*[^10374]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ны́нѣ ѿпꙋща́еши: Трисвѧто́е. По Ѻ҆́тче на́шъ: тропа́рь, є҆ктенїа̀ и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ.
items.english_text: *On Wednesday at Compline.*[^10375]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ моле́бный, къ прест҃ѣ́й Бцⷣѣ.
items.english_text: *Supplicatory Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.*[^10376]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Колесницегони́телѧ фараѡ́на погрꙋзѝ, чꙋдотво́рѧй и҆ногда̀ Мѡѷсе́йскїй же́злъ, крестоѡбра́знѡ порази́въ, и҆ раздѣли́въ мо́ре: І҆и҃лѧ же бѣ́глеца, пѣ́шеходца спасѐ, пѣ́снь Бг҃ови воспѣва́юща.
items.english_text: The charioteer Pharaoh did the wonderworking rod of Moses of old drown, striking crosswise and dividing the sea; but it saved Israel a fugitive, walking on foot, singing a song unto God.[^10377]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Припѣ́въ: Прест҃а́ѧ Гпⷭ҇жѐ Бцⷣе, спасѝ на́съ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^10378]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Сло́во Бж҃їе родила̀ є҆сѝ воплоще́нно, є҆́же пре́жде безпло́тное, па́че є҆стества̀ всенепоро́чнаѧ Бцⷣе Дѣ́во, бг҃омꙋ́жнѡ въ мі́рѣ пожи́вшее; тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѝ сла́вимъ, по Бз҃ѣ̀ застꙋпле́нїе на́ше.
items.english_text: Thou didst bear incarnate the Word of God, Who was before bodiless, beyond nature, O all-immaculate Virgin Theotokos, Who in a God-manly manner lived in the world; therefore we all glorify thee, after God our protection.[^10379]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: И҆спещре́на разли́чїемъ ша́ра Бг҃облагода́тнаѧ: Ѻ҆́тчее Сло́во пло́ть бы́вшее за милосе́рдїе неизрече́нное, па́че оу҆ма̀ и҆ сло́ва, Благослове́ннаѧ родила̀ є҆сѝ, пребы́вши дѣ́ва нескве́рнаѧ.
items.english_text: Variegated with divers colors, O graced of God: the Father's Word having become flesh through ineffable compassion, beyond mind and word, O Blessed One, thou didst bear, remaining an undefiled virgin.[^10380]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: From a royal root, O Pure One, thou didst sprout forth; Christ the King, God's...[^10381]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: ...Word, incarnate beyond mind and understanding, thou didst bear from thy pure blood, shown forth two-fold in nature and single in hypostasis.[^10382]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Whosoever proclaims thee to be Theotokos, O All-Pure, bears victory over all heresies: for Him Who unchangeably became flesh hast thou brought forth, O Mother of God, higher than all creation, the co-eternal Word of God.[^10383]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Thou Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens by understanding, and didst found the earth upon the waters: establish me, O Christ, upon the rock of the Church; for there is none holy save Thee, O only Lover of mankind.[^10384]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Into thy holy womb God took up His abode, and became incarnate as He willed, O Mother of God, and saved us by His life-bearing passions; therefore we glorify thee as the door of salvation.[^10385]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: He that breathed a soul into all men, having become incarnate upon the earth, lived with men, having come forth from thy womb without seed, the Pre-divine; therefore we all, the faithful, bless thee with hymns, O Pure One.[^10386]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Having conceived in thy womb without wedlock, O Virgin, Him that was begotten of the Father before the ages, thou didst bear together God and man, perfect in both natures and indivisible.[^10387]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: The rod that budded Christ the blossom of incorruption, and the golden censer, do we all know thee to be, O Pure One, bearing the divine essence as a coal upon thine arm, O God-blessed Virgin.[^10388]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Thou art my strength, O Lord, Thou art also my power; Thou art my God, Thou art my rejoicing, Who hast not left the bosom of the Father, yet hast visited our poverty; therefore with the Prophet Habakkuk I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind.[^10389]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: The ark that received the God-written law prefigured from afar the Life-originating Word in thy womb, ineffably conceived, O All-Immaculate, richly nourishing the souls of them that sing: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind.[^10390]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Thou wast the true cause of salvation, O Mother of God, unto the Creator and Maker, having lent flesh from thy most pure blood; whereby the gates of death were shattered, and life was bestowed upon men.[^10391]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: That Thou mightest seek out the image buried by passions through the riches...[^10392]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: ...of goodness, Thou didst dwell in the Virgin's womb, out of which Thou, the Wisdom of God, didst create a temple, wherein having lived with men, O Compassionate One, Thou didst save the ends of the world.[^10393]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: After God we have acquired thee as protectress, O All-Immaculate: for thou wast the Mother of God the Creator and Maker, Who took our form, and saved it from corruption and perils, and glorified it with divine glory.[^10394]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Why hast Thou cast me away from Thy face, O unwaning Light, and strange darkness hath covered me, wretch that I am? But convert me, and unto the light of Thy commandments direct my paths, I pray Thee.[^10395]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: As having conceived God the Maker, Creator, and Lord, O All-Pure, the generations of all men call thee blessed, and the noetic chieftains of the bodiless powers glorify thee as Mother of God.[^10396]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: The hosts of the higher powers call thee blessed, O All-Pure; for through thee alone do those upon earth, being united with the heavenly, hymn thy Nativity.[^10397]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: In an ineffable manner, O Virgin, the Word made His dwelling within thee, and became man, Who shone forth from the Father before the ages, and delivering men from corruption, leading them unto incorruptible life, the only Tender-hearted One.[^10398]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Thou wast adorned, O all-pure Virgin, with the beauties of virginity, and hast loosed the ill-favoredness of the first Eve, having borne Christ Who bestows the robe of immortality upon them that hymn thee.[^10399]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Cleanse me, O Savior! for many are my iniquities, and lead me up from the depth of evils, I pray; for unto Thee have I cried, and give ear unto me, O God of my salvation.[^10400]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: He Who by almighty power upholds all things clothed Himself in fleshly weakness from thee, O all-immaculate Virgin, for the benefaction of men, as He is the Lover of mankind.[^10401]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: The all-effecting Spirit came upon thee, O All-Immaculate, and the Word of God made His abode within thee, and ineffably became flesh, remaining unchanged.[^10402]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Enlighten the souls of them that orthodoxly hymn thee: the sayings of the Prophets proclaimed beforehand thy most pure conception and thy birthgiving beyond speech, O Bride of God...[^10403]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: As the habitation of God, truly divine and most honorable, we piously hymn the most pure Mary; for she received God, containing Him Who is uncontainable and incomprehensible.[^10404]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *Then, Lord, have mercy (thrice). Glory... Both now...*[^10405]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: As all-immaculate bride of the Creator, as unwedded Mother of the Deliverer, as being the vessel of the Comforter, O All-Hymned One: make haste to deliver me who am a foul dwelling of iniquity and have consciously become a plaything of demons, from their evildoing, making me a bright habitation through virtues, O giver of light; and disperse the corrupting cloud of passions, and vouchsafe me heavenly communion and unwaning light by thy prayers.[^10406]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: At God's condescension the fire was put to shame in Babylon of old; therefore the Children in the furnace, with joyful step, dancing as in a meadow of flowers, sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^10407]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: O All-Pure Sovereign Lady, who didst conceive the Deliverer of all: vouchsafe me ineffable and divine deliverance, who cry aloud with a loud voice and sing: Blessed is the God of our fathers.[^10408]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Now all things are filled with divine light through thee, O All-Pure: for thou wast shown forth as the door whereby God conversed with the world, enlightening them that cry in faith: Blessed is the God of our fathers.[^10409]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Behold, now is fulfilled the divine prophecy of divine David: truly they entreat thy countenance, O pure Mother of God, who have acquired the wealth of grace, now blessing the God of our fathers.[^10410]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Thou didst conceive, O All-Pure, God and Lord over all, Who was well-pleased to save the human race from death and corruption; Whom worthily hymning, we cry: Blessed is the God of our fathers.[^10411]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Having become conquerors of the tormentor and of the flame by Thy grace, cleaving earnestly unto Thy commandments, the Children cried: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord.[^10412]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: O Blessed All-Pure One, cleanse the wounds of my soul and the sinful...[^10413]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: ...stripes, having born God Who is over all, O pure Maiden, from a virginal unwedded womb: Whom bless, ye children, and supremely exalt unto the ages.[^10414]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Thou wast the vessel of the unwaning Light, O All-Pure, shining with the beauties of virginity; thou hast illuminated all who from the soul confess thee to be the true Theotokos, and cry: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages.[^10415]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Sanctified by the Holy Spirit, O all-immaculate Theotokos, truly didst thou receive in thy womb the unoriginate and co-eternal Son of the Father, Who in thee became incarnate, O Pure One, for the benefaction of them that cry in faith: Ye children, bless; ye priests, sing, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages.[^10416]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: As having born God beyond word and understanding, entreat Him, O all-pure Mother of God, to be clement unto all of us who are unworthy, at His dread and fearful coming, when He shall judge human nature, when all stand naked and are judged with fear.[^10417]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Heaven was struck with awe at this, and the ends of the earth were amazed, that God hath appeared in the flesh unto men, and thy womb became more spacious than the heavens; therefore the ranks of Angels and of men magnify thee, O Theotokos.[^10418]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Us who were rejected from eternal dwelling and who had fallen wretchedly into death, hast thou called back, O All-Pure, having become the Mother of the Deliverer, and vouchsafed us to run unto our former fatherland; therefore, O Mother of God, unceasingly we magnify thee.[^10419]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Easily grant me, O Theotokos, to pass through life's wave of temptations, and the onset of passions, as thou art good, subduing them, and guiding me unto the virtue of the heavenly journey: that as benefactress I may unceasingly magnify thee.[^10420]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: O pure, most glorious Mother of God, save from temptations them that hymn thee with love, mercifully quelling turmoil, as thou didst bear God: for all that thou desirest to do, thou dost unhindered, and thou art able, O Virgin; therefore we all magnify thee...[^10421]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Show forth the precious Church conquering juvenile heresies, which Christ Thy Son, O Full of Grace, as He is good, acquired by His precious blood, and save her from perils and from the violence that holds us, O Sovereign Lady.[^10422]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Trisagion. After Our Father: troparion and dismissal.*[^10423]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *On Thursday at Matins.*[^10424]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *After the First Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Apostles, Tone 8:*[^10425]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: As luminaries of the world, and guides of our salvation, let us hymn the divine disciples of our God from the beginning; for they shone forth as light unto us that were in darkness, and proclaimed the Sun of glory unto all. Therefore also they cast down idol delusion, having preached the Trinity in one Godhead. Therefore we pray unto you, O Apostles: entreat Christ God, to grant us the remission of sins, and great mercy.[^10426]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Your most wise sound having gone out unto all the ends of the world, O truly all-praised Apostles of the Lord, manifestly proclaimed the knowledge of God unto all, and brought heathen ignorance unto understanding. Therefore also having driven away the mist of idolatry, the light of understanding shone forth unto them that were in darkness. Therefore we pray: entreat Christ God, to grant remission of transgressions unto them that honor your holy memory with love.[^10428]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Having fallen into many-woven temptations from enemies visible and invisible, and being held fast by the tempest of my countless sins, O All-Pure: I flee unto the warm intercession, and protection, and haven of thy goodness. Therefore, O All-Pure, entreat Him Who was incarnate of thee without seed on behalf of all thy servants who unceasingly hymn thee, O all-pure Theotokos: praying Him earnestly to grant remission of sins unto them that worship thy Nativity in faith.[^10429]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *After the Second Stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 8:*[^10430]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Into all the earth, as the Prophet said, went forth the sound of the most wise Apostles; for having preached the Word, all the nations...[^10431]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: ...they enlightened. Therefore worthily praising them with hymns, let us honor them, as they ever entreat Christ, that our souls may be saved.[^10432]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: The Lord's testaments having received in their soul by faith as a wealth-producing treasure, the Apostles were shown forth as benefactors unto all: driving away demonic poverty, and enriching all with the wealth of God; unto whom let us all cry aloud: Enrich us also, we pray, who are now impoverished in virtuous deeds.[^10434]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: By self-control having mortified the fiery appearances and stirrings of the passions, the Martyrs received Christ's grace to drive away infirmities from the sick: and both while living and after their end to work miracles, truly a most glorious wonder, that bare bones pour forth healings. Glory to the only all-wise Creator God.[^10436]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Protectress of the faithful, Mother of God, joy of the sorrowing, and great consolation of them that weep: entreat Him Who was born beyond nature from thy womb, O Virgin, the All-Holy One, unceasingly together with the holy Apostles on our behalf, to deliver us in the hour of trial from bitter condemnation.[^10437]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *After the Third Stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 8:*[^10438]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Luminaries bright were ye shown forth, eyewitnesses of Christ, ever enlightening the whole earth, and driving away the darkness of polytheism by the light of piety through your teachings; therefore enlighten me who am in the darkness of passions, walking without fear, by your holy prayers, O God-bearing Apostles.[^10440]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: With the net of divine words, catching reasonable men alive as fish, ye brought them as first-fruits unto our God: and having loved Christ's wounds, ye clothed yourselves therein, and were shown forth as imitators of His passions. Therefore having assembled, we worthily honor your festivity now, O glorious Apostles, and with one accord cry aloud: Entreat Christ God, that remission of transgressions be granted unto them that honor your holy memory with love.[^10441]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Entreat the incomprehensible Word, the Son of God, Who was ineffably born of thee beyond understanding, O Theotokos, together with the Apostles: to grant pure pacification unto the universe, and before the end to bestow upon us forgiveness of transgressions, and for the sake of extreme goodness to vouchsafe Thy servants the heavenly kingdom.[^10442]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy, Glorious, and All-Praised Apostles.*[^10443]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: The choir of the most wise Apostles saves me. A composition of Joseph.)*[^10444]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Having passed through the water as it were dry land, and having escaped the Egyptian evil, the Israelite cried aloud: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God.[^10445]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Apostles, pray to God for us.*[^10446]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: O light-like choir of the Apostles, standing before the great Light: illuminate my darkened heart, and guide me unto saving paths.[^10447]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: O intimate friends of the Deliverer, deliver me from the love of passions, who have been deceived by many delusions of life and am covered by the night of senselessness.[^10448]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: As ye are arrows of the Mighty One, O divine Apostles, heal them that are wounded by the weapon of the evil one, who flee under your protection in faith.[^10449]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: He that is full is emptied in a God-befitting manner, and from thy womb, O pure Mother, He comes forth bearing flesh: saving by His tender-heartedness them that were deceived by the serpent's malice.[^10450]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Holy Wonderworker Nicholas.*[^10451]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *(Whose acrostic is: Unto thee, O Nicholas, the eighth song is fitting. Of Joseph.)*[^10452]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: That which was severed cut through the unseverable, and the sun beheld the earth which it had not seen; the water drowned the fierce enemy, and Israel traversed the impassable, while a song was sung: Let us sing unto the Lord, for gloriously is He glorified.[^10453]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *Refrain: Hierarch of Christ Nicholas, pray to God for us.*[^10454]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: With the choirs of the higher powers standing before the King of all, O blessed one: save us on earth who ever call upon thee from every evil temptation, O Nicholas, asking remission of our transgressions.[^10455]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Enriched with thee as protector, O Nicholas, both by day and by night we cry unto thee in faith: come quickly now unto us that are in great peril through demonic evil snares and corrupting men; that having obtained quietness, we may praise thee.[^10456]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: By the strong sinews of thy prayers, O Nicholas, give over unto final strangling them that strive to strangle us, delivering us from their evil snares, unto...[^10457]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: ...praise crying aloud: Let us sing unto the Lord, for gloriously is He glorified.[^10458]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Apart from the laws of nature, thou didst bear God and the Lawgiver, Who became man; entreat Him, as He is good, O All-Immaculate, to overlook our iniquities, who ever cry aloud: Let us sing unto the Lord, for gloriously is He glorified.[^10459]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Thou art the confirmation of them that flee unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the light of the darkened, and my spirit hymns Thee.[^10460]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Gird with power, O Apostles of the Savior, my heart that is weakened by passions and thoughts.[^10461]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Proclaiming the one, thrice-radiant brightness of God, the disciples destroyed the mist of polytheism.[^10462]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Assuage the evil corruption of my heart, as physicians of divine healing, O disciples of our God.[^10463]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Save me, O pure Sovereign Lady, who didst bear beyond nature the Deliverer of all, both Master, and Savior, and Lord.[^10464]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. Same Heirmos.*[^10465]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: That we may honor thee, that we may ever sing of thee: stretch forth unto us a helping hand, O hierarch Nicholas.[^10466]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Lull to sleep by thy sleepless prayers, O Nicholas, the temptations that rise up against us, we pray thee.[^10467]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Deliver me who am wholly assailed by passions and the temptations of evil men, by thy mediation, O holy Nicholas.[^10468]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Entreat the Deliverer to grant me remission of sins, O Pure One, and from grievous worldly temptations.[^10469]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Divinity.[^10470]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Ye were adorned, O glorious Apostles, beautified by divine splendors, and enlightened by the rays of Him Who showed you forth as luminaries.[^10471]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Deliver me from every storm, O pilots of all, divine Apostles, who am in peril in the deep and tossed about by worldly temptations.[^10472]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: O God-chosen horses, who trouble the sea of polytheism: drown the abyss of my transgressions by your prayers.[^10473]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Thou didst incarnate from thy womb, O Virgin, the Word Who is co-effective with the Father: therefore thou wast shown forth higher than all creatures, O Sovereign Lady.[^10474]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. Same Heirmos.*[^10475]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: From the multitude of my transgressions I fall into many countless sorrows; make haste, O holy Nicholas, to help me, imitating the Benefactor.[^10476]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: I weep for myself who am perishing, living in slothfulness; by thy prayers, O Nicholas, lead me unto repentance.[^10477]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Thou who didst deliver the three youths who were about to die, O father Nicholas: deliver me from every distress and from eternal condemnation.[^10478]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Strengthen me, O All-Pure, to do heavenly understandings; and direct the movements of my soul unto the life-bearing entrances.[^10479]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Rising early from the night we cry unto Thee, O Lord: Save us; for Thou art our God, besides Thee we know no other.[^10480]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Direct me who am hemmed in by many transgressions unto saving breadth, as helmsmen, O Apostles.[^10481]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Deliver me who honor your all-honorable assembly, O God-beholding Apostles, from every dishonorable deed, I pray.[^10482]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: As ye were conformed unto the Savior's passions, O holy ones: drive away all voluptuousness from my soul, O Apostles.[^10483]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Heal my ailing soul, O all-pure Sovereign Lady, who didst bear Him Who takes away the infirmities of all.[^10484]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. Same Heirmos.*[^10485]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Strengthen us by thy prayers, O God-blessed Nicholas, to keep the commandments of Christ, our only God.[^10486]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Having lived in Myra, O Nicholas, fill with divine fragrance us who piously sing of thee.[^10487]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Show mercy upon us by thy prayers, O hierarch Nicholas, entreating the all-merciful God, that we may be delivered from perils and tribulations.[^10488]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́рене, Чи́стаѧ, ца́рска прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ; Царѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇та̀, Бж҃їе
items.english_text: Being full of life-giving waters, O Maiden, give drink unto all of us who sing of thee in godly-mindedness.[^10489]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Въ Четверто́къ оу҆́тра, Гла́съ и҃. цм҃ѳ
items.english_text: A prayer I will pour out unto the Lord, and unto Him will I declare my sorrows; for my soul is filled with evils, and my life has drawn near unto hades; and I pray as Jonah: From corruption, O God, lead me up.[^10490]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Моли́твꙋ пролію̀ къ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ, и҆ томꙋ̀ возвѣщꙋ̀ печа́ли моѧ̑: ꙗ҆́кѡ ѕѡ́лъ дꙋша̀ моѧ̀ и҆спо́лнися, и҆ живо́тъ мо́й а҆́дꙋ прибли́жися; и҆ молю́ся ꙗ҆́кѡ І҆ѡна̀: ѿ тлѝ Бж҃е возведи́ мя.
items.english_text: Having shaken down the strongholds of the enemy by the invocation of prayers, ye cast down the idol temples, O disciples of Christ. But I pray with faith: Shatter the idols of my mind, and show me forth as a temple of God who am guilty of many sins.[^10491]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Стря́сше моли́твъ призыва́ніемъ, низложи́сте хра́мы і҆́дѡлскіѧ, оу҆ченицы̀ Хрⷭ҇тѡ́ви. Но молю́ся вѣ́рою: оу҆ма̀ моегѡ̀ сокрꙋши́те і҆́дѡлы, и҆ покажи́те хра́мъ Бж҃ій мно́гими грѣхѝ пови́ннаго.
items.english_text: Ye who were founded as stones upon the unshakable rock, O chosen eyewitnesses of God: save my heart which is harmfully founded upon the sand; for the rivers of temptations rush together, and fiercely engulf me with storm.[^10492]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же на ка́мени непоколеби́мѣмъ созда́вшеся ꙗ҆́кѡ ка́меніе, и҆збра́нніи Бг҃ови́дцы: моѐ се́рдце на песцѣ̀ оу҆мовре́днѡ созда́нное спаси́те; стека́ются бо напа́стей рѣ́ки, и҆ лю́тѣ ма̀ ѡ҆бꙋрева́ютъ.
items.english_text: From deceitful love which is toward the flesh, and from him that appeared vile because of much malice, deliver me, O friends of the Word, and bring me unto the love of Him Who loved the forgiveness of sinners because of great mercy.[^10493]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Любвѐ льсти́выѧ ꙗ҆́же къ пло́ти, и҆ ме́рзка мно́гія ра́ди ѕло́бы ꙗ҆́вльшагося, и҆зба́вите ма̀ дрꙋ́зи Слѡ́ва, и҆ къ любвѝ приважи́те Возлюби́вшагѡ грѣ́шныхъ мно́гія ра́ди ми́лости ѡ҆ставле́ніе.
items.english_text: As a sweet-briar rose, as a most pure lily, as a fragrant scent from the beautiful valleys of the world, the Creator chose thee, O Maiden, and having dwelt within thy womb and having been born, He filled all things with fragrance.[^10494]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ шипо́къ, ꙗ҆́кѡ чистѣ́йшій крї́нъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ благоꙋха́нное ѡ҆бона́ніе ѿ кра́сныхъ оу҆до́лїй мїрски́хъ, Творе́цъ и҆збра́въ тѧ̀ О҆трокови́це, всели́вся въ оу҆тро́бꙋ твою̀ и҆ роди́вся, благоꙋха́нїа всѧ́ческаѧ и҆спо́лнилъ є҆́сть.
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. Same Heirmos.*[^10495]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Ра́й се́рдце твоѐ ꙗ҆ви́ся Нїко́лае, жи́зни дре́во посредѣ̀ и҆мѣ́ѧ и҆зба́вителѧ Хрⷭ҇та̀; є҆го́же молѝ непреста́ннѡ: раѧ̀ сотвори́ти жи́тели всѧ̑ ны̀, те́плымъ застꙋ́пникомъ тобо́ю ѡ҆богати́вшыѧся.
items.english_text: Thy heart was shown forth as a paradise, O Nicholas, having the Deliverer Christ in its midst as the tree of life; Whom entreat unceasingly: that He make all of us citizens of paradise, who have been enriched by thee as a fervent protector.[^10496]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Въ лѣ́ности жи́знь мою̀ прехождꙋ̀, и҆ безбоѧ́зненнѡ согрѣша́ю ѻ҆каѧ́нный; и҆ та́мѡ неѡ҆рица́емое сꙋди́ще помышлѧ́ѧ, и҆ стра́хомъ содержѝмъ є҆́смь: оу҆ще́дри мѧ̀ Бж҃е, Нїкола́а моли́твами, ꙗ҆́кѡ благоꙋтро́бенъ.
items.english_text: In slothfulness I spend my life, and without fear I sin, wretched that I am; and thinking upon the inescapable judgment seat there, I am gripped with fear: Have compassion upon me, O God, through the prayers of Nicholas, for Thou art tender-hearted.[^10497]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Внеза́пꙋ находѧ́щꙋю мнѣ̀ бꙋ́рю и҆скꙋше́ній многоѡбра́зныхъ, за мно́жество мои́хъ согрѣше́ній, вопію̀: не ѡ҆ста́ви менѐ, Блаже́нне, безъ застꙋпле́нїа; но прострѝ мнѣ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ми́лостивъ по́мощи рꙋ́кꙋ, и҆ спаси́ мѧ.
items.english_text: At the storm of manifold temptations coming suddenly upon me because of the multitude of my transgressions, I cry aloud: Leave me not without protection, O blessed one; but stretch forth unto me a helping hand, as thou art merciful, and save me.[^10498]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: A palace of the exalted King and a fiery throne wast thou, O Virgin: higher than the Cherubim, and having become beyond understanding above the Seraphim. Therefore thee all...[^10499]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: ...creation magnifies, as the Mother of the Creator.[^10500]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: The Hebrew children in the furnace boldly trampled upon the flame, and turned the fire into dew, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages.[^10501]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: The night of slothfulness holds me fast, and the darkness of sin covers me; O all-wise Apostles, having appeared as the light of the world, make haste to enlighten my darkened heart.[^10502]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Having appeared as another heaven declaring the glory of our God, deliver from the dishonor of passions, O God-proclaiming ones, them that flee in faith unto your sovereign protection.[^10503]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Having appeared as fiery coals, O Apostles, ignited by the fire of the Comforter: burn up every material of our malice, and deliver us from the unquenchable fire unto the ages.[^10504]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Thou wast shown forth as the shadowed mountain unquarried by hand, from which a stone was cut off; therefore, O Sovereign Lady, grant compunction unto my darkened soul, petrified by bitter pleasures.[^10505]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. Same Heirmos.*[^10506]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Thou didst pour forth streams of teachings, drying up the torrents of heresies, richly watering the souls of the faithful, O sacred minister Nicholas; therefore we honor thee.[^10507]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Thou wast strengthened, empowered by the power of the Trinity, to destroy deceitful idols. Therefore I pray thee with faith, O father: Drive away the passionate idols of my mind.[^10508]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Having become the primate of the people of Myra, O venerable one, after death thou pourest forth divine myrrh: driving away our foul-smelling infirmities, O all-blessed Nicholas, from them that approach thee with faith.[^10509]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Thou didst assuage the mortal course, having given birth unto the immortal God: Whom entreat, O Pure One, to mortify the passions of my humble body, and to vouchsafe me life.[^10510]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Sevenfold the Chaldean tyrant madly kindled the furnace for the godly ones; but seeing them saved by a higher power, he cried aloud unto the Creator and Deliverer: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^10511]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Strengthen my soul that is shaken by passions, O ye who are unyielding...[^10512]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: ...foundations and unshakable pillars of the Church, bulwarks of the faithful, catchers of them that are in the deep of destruction, calm havens of them that sing in faith: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto the ages.[^10513]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Have compassion to bring me up by your prayers, who lie in the tomb of dark despair and in the lowest parts of the fall of pleasures, O disciples of the Savior: who were manifestly accounted worthy to be enriched with the Master's tender-heartedness, O Apostles, eyewitnesses of God, unto all ages.[^10514]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: As radiant in the beauties of virtues wast thou shown forth, O All-Immaculate One: thou didst contain in thy womb the beneficent, all-creative splendor; Whom entreat diligently, O Pure One, to enlighten unto all ages my soul, held fast by the sins of passions and seeking the ancient beauty most splendidly.[^10515]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: The God-proclaiming children in the furnace, trampling upon the flame with the fire, sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord.[^10516]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Enlightened as thou art, O godly-wise hierarch, by the light-bearing rays of the thrice-radiant Godhead: destroy the darkness of my passions by thy prayers, O Nicholas.[^10517]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Thou who didst deliver the three commanders from death by thy fearsome appearing, O sacred initiate Nicholas: deliver us also from every death-bearing harm.[^10518]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Establish us by thy prayers, who are shaken by demonic temptations and by abusive men, and preserve us unharmed, O all-blessed Nicholas.[^10519]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Offer supplication unto the Lord, to have compassion and to save them that flee unto thee in faith, O all-holy Virgin, helper of men.[^10520]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Heaven was amazed at this, and the ends of the earth were astonished, that God appeared bodily unto men, and thy womb became more spacious than the heavens. Therefore the ranks of Angels and men magnify thee, O Theotokos.[^10521]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Having shattered the jaws of soul-corrupting lions by the power of God, O Apostles, as ye were appointed princes upon the earth by Christ according to the Psalm, piously subduing it unto the Spirit: therefore the unruly movements of my heart...[^10522]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: ...subdue unto the divine law.[^10523]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Having proclaimed in the world the Word of God, Who appeared comely beyond all the sons of men, ye made your feet beautiful, O all-wise heralds of good tidings, bringing peace and life. Therefore pacify by your prayers my soul, troubled by passions.[^10524]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Having mortified your members which are upon the earth, ye clothed yourselves in all life, prefiguring by your passions the honorable Passion. Therefore revive me who am slain by the arrow of the evil one's malice, by the remedies of true repentance, O God-blessed Apostles.[^10525]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Heal my soul, ailing with grievous passion, as thou art merciful, O thou who didst give birth unto the all-good God; and deliver me ever, O All-Immaculate One, from enemies inciting and assailing me, that being saved I may diligently magnify thee, who hast magnified our race.[^10526]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Truly confessing thee as Theotokos, saved through thee, O pure Virgin, with the bodiless choirs we magnify thee.[^10527]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: As a deliverer in affliction for them that pray to thee in faith, deliver me from every malice, O Nicholas, entreating the good God and Lord.[^10528]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Being now with the heavenly choirs, O most holy father Nicholas: entreat the good God to save us.[^10529]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: The judgment is at the doors; take heed, O my soul, and cry aloud unto God the Judge: Through the prayers of Nicholas, save me, O Lord.[^10530]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Being the receptacle of the Light, O Virgin, enlighten my soul, darkened by passions, that in faith and love I may ever glorify thee.[^10531]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Litany, and Photagogicon, and the customary Psalms.*[^10532]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Apostles, Tone 8:*[^10533]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: O Lord, the Apostles having diligently loved Thee upon the earth, counted all things as refuse, that they might gain Thee alone; and for Thy sake they gave up their bodies unto wounds. Therefore, being glorified, they pray for our souls.[^10534]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad: ... And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, and guide their sons.* [^10535]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: O Lord, Thou hast magnified the Apostles' memory upon earth; for we all, having assembled together therein, doxologize Thee: for through them Thou grantest us healings, and unto all the world peace through their prayers, and great mercy.[^10536]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and direct Thou the works of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands do Thou direct.* [^10537]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Having clothed yourselves well in the breastplates of faith, and armed yourselves with the weapon of the Cross, ye were shown forth as stalwart soldiers. Ye manfully resisted the tormentors, and cast down the devil's deceit; having become victors, ye were accounted worthy of crowns. Pray unceasingly for us, that our souls may be saved.[^10538]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Snatch me, O Sovereign Lady, from the hand of the man-slaying serpent, which desires to swallow me utterly by subtlety. Shatter his jaws, I pray thee, and destroy his wiles: that having escaped from his claws, I may magnify thy protection.[^10539]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise: Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparion and the rest.*[^10540]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *On Thursday, The Beatitudes, Tone 8.*[^10541]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
