items.english_text: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, as Thou didst remember the thief upon the Tree; and account all worthy, O only Compassionate One, of Thy heavenly kingdom.[^10542]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: The Apostles were shown forth as the trumpets of Christ: ye raised up them that lay in the graves of false belief, and made them partakers of divine life.[^10543]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: By the mystical seed of the Word, O God-proclaiming ones, ye made the barren hearts of all the nations fruitful in divine understanding; therefore ye are worthily called blessed.[^10544]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Having stripped themselves of all malice, the sufferers valiantly passed through the midst of cruel torments, and from heaven were clothed in the robe of salvation.[^10545]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Mortify the assaults of evil-working passions of my wretched soul, O honorable, all-holy Trinity, through the prayers of Thy divine Apostles, that being saved I may glorify Thee.[^10546]

items.office: Thursday: The Holy Apostles and Saint Nicholas[^10352]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Rejoice, tongs of the divine Coal. Rejoice, seal of the Prophets and preaching of the Apostles, O all-immaculate Theotokos, through whom we were delivered from corruption.[^10547]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *On Thursday Evening.*[^10549]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 8.*[^10550]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: O most marvelous wonder! The life-bearing garden, the all-holy Cross, lifted on high is manifested today; all the ends of the earth doxologize, the demonic legions are terrified. O what a gift has been bestowed upon earthly beings! Whereby, O Christ, save Thou our souls, for Thou alone art tender-hearted.[^10552]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: O most marvelous wonder! As a cluster full of life, having borne the Most High, the Cross is seen raised from the earth today; whereby we all were drawn unto God, and death was swallowed up utterly. O most honorable Tree, whereby we received immortal food in Eden, glorifying Christ.[^10553]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: O Thine abundant goodness toward us, O good Jesus! How Thou didst humble Thyself, and becamest man, and wast pleased to suffer, enduring the Cross and shameful death for the sake of unprofitable servants! What worthy, God-befitting gift shall we offer Thee? Only in thanksgiving do we, the faithful, glorify Thee.[^10554]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 8.*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: O the ineffable goodness of Him Who was incarnate of thee, O all-hymned Theotokos! For as the Lover of mankind He endured the Cross and death, that He might save the world which He created. Entreat Him: that He deliver me also, wretched and sorely afflicted, from torment, and establish me where the unwaning light shines.[^10556]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: "What is this sight seen, which is beheld by mine eyes, O Master? Holding all creation, Thou hast been lifted up upon the Tree, and diest, Who givest life unto all!" the Theotokos said weeping, when she beheld lifted up upon the Cross God and man, Who had ineffably shone forth from her.[^10557]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Deliver from perils by thy precious prayers the flock which Thy Son and God acquired, sprinkling it with blood, O All-Immaculate One, driving away visible and invisible enemies like beasts; and fill their faces with dishonor, as the hymn-singer David proclaimed of old, O Pure One.[^10558]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Beholding Thee nailed upon the Cross, O Jesus, and willingly receiving...[^10559]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: ...the passions, the Virgin and Thy Mother, O Master, cried aloud: "Woe is me, sweet Child! How dost Thou endure wounds unjustly, O Physician Who didst heal human infirmity, and by Thy tender-heartedness didst deliver all from corruption?"[^10560]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *Then, "O Gladsome Light." Prokeimenon of the day. "Vouchsafe, O Lord."*[^10561]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 8:*[^10562]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross, O Christ God, and didst save the human race. We glorify Thy sufferings.[^10563]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Thou wast nailed upon the Cross, O Christ God, and didst open the gates of paradise; therefore we glorify Thy Divinity.[^10565]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *Verse: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us, for we are utterly: ... our soul has been exceedingly filled with the reproach of them that prosper, and with the contempt of the proud.* [^10566]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Martyrs of the Lord, ye sanctify every place, and heal every infirmity. And now pray, we beseech you, that our souls may be delivered from the snares of the enemy.[^10567]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: The unblemished heifer, beholding the Young Bull willingly nailed upon the Tree, weeping mournfully, cried aloud: "Woe is me, most beloved Child! What has the ungrateful Jewish assembly rendered unto Thee, desiring to make me childless of Thee, O All-Beloved?"[^10568]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart, and the rest.*[^10569]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *On Thursday Evening, at Compline.*[^10570]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 8.*[^10571]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Let us sing unto the Lord, Who led His people through the Red Sea, for He alone has been gloriously glorified.[^10572]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^10573]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Make Christ merciful unto me, O all-immaculate Virgin, snatching me away in the day of fearsome condemnation.[^10574]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Rain down upon me drops of compunction, I pray, O Sovereign Lady, washing away the filth that is in me, that I may glorify thee.[^10575]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Enlighten me, O Virgin, who didst give birth unto the unwaning Light, driving away the deep darkness of my slothfulness.[^10576]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Save me, O Theotokos, who am perishing in many sins; and from every torment...[^10577]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: ...and bitter condemnation deliver me.[^10578]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: O Lord, Maker of the vault of heaven and Builder of the Church: do Thou establish me in Thy love, O summit of desires, confirmation of the faithful, O only Lover of mankind.[^10579]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Having fallen from holy living, O All-Immaculate One, I was likened unto the beasts, and became wholly condemned; but thou who didst give birth unto the Judge, deliver me from every condemnation, and save me.[^10580]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Unto thee I flee ever, O Sovereign Lady, compassed about by a multitude of temptations: have compassion and save me, O thou who didst give birth unto the Savior and Lord of all, O only All-Hymned One.[^10581]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: O impassable gate leading unto God, O Maiden: open unto me the gates of repentance, I pray, cleansing the filth of my sins with the showers of thy mercy, O thou full of God's grace.[^10582]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Deliver me from the assault of passions, O Sovereign Lady, and now vanquish mine warring enemies; establish me upon the rock of the divine desires, and enlighten my soul, O gate of divine light.[^10583]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Divinity.[^10584]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Heal the wounds of my soul, O Virgin full of God's grace; enlighten my mind, O Pure One, darkened by the assaults of passions.[^10585]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Call me unto repentance, O All-Immaculate One, who sleep in despondency and am covered with sin, as thou art the Mother of the Word.[^10586]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: O unwedded Sovereign Lady, who didst give birth unto the incarnate Word: enlighten my soul, and deliver me from Gehenna and torment.[^10587]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Upon thee I have placed all my hope, O Mother-Virgin: preserve my soul, O thou who didst give birth unto God, my Savior.[^10588]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Why hast Thou cast me away from Thy face, O unwaning Light, and an alien darkness has covered me, the wretched one? But turn me back, and direct my ways unto the light of Thy commandments, I pray.[^10589]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Heal the all-incurable passions of my soul, O Maiden, and rekindle my lamp which has been extinguished through slothfulness, and guide me unto the paths of repentance, O Virgin...[^10590]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: ...that in faith and love I may glorify thee.[^10591]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: I condemn myself before the trial, O thou who hast been made glad of God: I bear shameful deeds, a solitary condemned one; but stand by me, as thou art the protectress of all, and deliver me from bitter condemnation.[^10592]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Cease not delivering me from captivity, and from the soul-corrupting turmoil that grips me, and from the cruel passions that slay me, O all-holy Maiden, protectress of sinners, ready helper of men.[^10593]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Revive me who am wholly slain by the sting of death through transgression, O All-Immaculate One: who didst conceive Life for the world, the Deliverer and King, and guide me unto the light.[^10594]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine iniquities; and lead me up from the deep of evils, I pray; for unto Thee have I cried, and do Thou give ear unto me, O God of my salvation.[^10595]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Revive me who am slain by many transgressions, O pure Virgin, who ineffably didst give birth unto Life for men, O Theotokos, and guide me to do the will of the Lord.[^10596]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Thee all we faithful have acquired as protectress and wall, who are ever submerged in the deep of evils, turmoils, and sorrows, O Theotokos, only refuge of the faithful.[^10597]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: O thou who didst wither the orchards of godlessness by thy holy offspring, O All-Immaculate One: consume the enemy's malice that ever grows within me, O Pure One.[^10598]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Sanctify my mind, and enlighten my heart, O holy Mother of God: and change the evils that hold me fast, that I may glorify thee, my firm protectress.[^10599]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: *Then, "Lord, have mercy" (40). Glory... Both now...*[^10600]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: "O new wonder! O fearsome mystery!" cried the Ewe-lamb, beholding her Son outstretched upon the Tree of the Cross: "What is this, O immortal Word of God? How art Thou seen dead, and shakest the earth as almighty? But I hymn Thy fearsome and divine condescension."[^10601]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: The Hebrew children in the furnace boldly trampled upon the flame, and turned the fire into dew, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages.[^10602]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Be merciful unto me, O Virgin, and heal me who am wounded by the weapon of sin with the plaster of thy prayer; and snatch me away from the unquenchable fire unto the ages.[^10603]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Deliver me, O Mother of the Savior, from the cruel captivity that grips me, from wicked thoughts, and from the seizures of transgression, that being ever saved, I may glorify thee as is due.[^10604]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Now unto thee I flee, O Mother of God, bound with the cords of transgressions: through the tender mercy of loving-kindness loose me, O Virgin, and deliver me from the torment and malice of demons.[^10605]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Have compassion and save me, O Virgin, who didst give birth unto the compassionate Word of God; and with the light that is in thee enlighten my soul, and deliver me from the cruel craft of demons.[^10606]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Sevenfold the Chaldean tyrant madly kindled the furnace for the godly ones; but seeing them saved by a higher power, he cried aloud unto the Creator and Deliverer: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^10607]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: He Who is in every way perfect and inaccessible by nature, appeared touchable unto me, clothed in flesh from thee, O Unwedded One: Whom entreat diligently to lighten the burden of mine iniquities, and to deliver me from the future judgment.[^10608]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: O thou who didst give birth unto the Judge and Lord beyond word, entreat Him as Thy Son, O All-Holy One: in the hour of judgment to deliver me from condemnation, and fire, and lightless darkness, and gnashing of teeth, who ever sing of thee in faith and piety.[^10609]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: O all-immaculate Parent of God, cleanse the wounds of my soul and sinful offenses, washing them with the fountain that flowed from the side of Thine Offspring, and with the streams that flowed therefrom; for unto thee do I cry, and unto thee I flee, and thee I entreat, who art full of God's grace.[^10610]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пала́та высо́кагѡ Царѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆гнеобра́зный была̀ є҆сѝ престо́лъ, Дѣ́во: Херꙋвї́мъ превы́шши, и҆ Серафї́мъ, па́че оу҆ма̀ бы́вшаѧ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѧ́-
items.english_text: Revive my soul, slain by the serpentine bite, O All-Immaculate One, who didst manifestly give birth unto Life alone; and hasten to do the desires of Him Who was born for our sake, O Virgin, as I cry aloud: Ye children, bless; ye priests...[^10611]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: ници воспо́йте, лю́дїе превозноси́те є҆го̀ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: ...ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^10612]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆жасе́ся ѡ҆ се́мъ не́бо, и҆ землѝ оу҆диви́шася концы̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ ꙗ҆ви́ся человѣ́кѡмъ пло́тски, и҆ чре́во твоѐ бы́сть простра́ннѣйшее небе́съ; тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ Бцⷣꙋ, А҆́гг҃лѡвъ и҆ человѣ́къ чинонача̑лїа велича́ютъ.
items.english_text: Heaven was amazed at this, and the ends of the earth were astonished, that God appeared bodily unto men, and thy womb became more spacious than the heavens; therefore the ranks of Angels and men magnify thee, O Theotokos.[^10613]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣтѝ две́ри свѣ́та, ѡ҆слѣпле́нꙋю дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ, и҆ лꙋка́выми по́мыслы ѡ҆чернѣ́вшꙋю, и҆ бѣ́дствꙋющꙋю; и҆ и҆зба́ви ма̀ напа́стей, и҆ ѿ бѣ́сѡвъ ѡ҆злобле́нїа и҆ и҆стѧза́нїа лю́тагѡ, и҆ бꙋ́дꙋщагѡ пла́мене и҆ мꙋ́ки.
items.english_text: O gate of light, enlighten my soul, blinded by passions, darkened and imperiled by subtle thoughts; and deliver me from temptations, and from the afflictions and cruel torment of demons, and from the future fire and punishment.[^10614]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пощадѝ ма̀ Спа́се рожде́йся ѿ Дѣ́вы, и҆ сохрани́вый Ро́ждшꙋю тѧ̀ нетлѣ́ннꙋ и҆ по рождествѣ̀, є҆гда̀ ся́деши сꙋди́ти дѣлѡ́мъ мои̑мъ, беззакѡ́нїа и҆ грѣхѝ моѧ̑ пре́зри, ꙗ҆́кѡ безгрѣ́шенъ, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ ми́лостивъ, и҆ человѣколю́бецъ.
items.english_text: Spare me, O Savior Who wast born of the Virgin, and Who didst preserve her that gave Thee birth incorrupt even after childbirth, when Thou shalt sit to judge my deeds: overlook mine iniquities and sins, as Thou art sinless, and as God art merciful and the Lover of mankind.[^10615]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Нося́щи небе́сный ѻ҆́гнь рꙋка́ма ꙗ҆́кѡ клеща́ми, Бг҃облагода́тнаѧ: дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ стра̑сти попалѝ Чи́стаѧ, и҆ стра́шнагѡ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїа и҆ ѻ҆гнѧ̀, и҆ томле́нїа лю́тагѡ бѣсо́вскагѡ свободѝ ма̀.
items.english_text: Bearing the heavenly Fire in thy hands as with tongs, O thou full of God's grace: burn up the passions of my soul, O Pure One, and deliver me from the fearsome judgment, and the fire, and the cruel vexation of demons.[^10616]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆сїа́нїемъ твои́мъ мы́сленнымъ просвѣтѝ на̑ша помышле́нїа, и҆ сердца̀, и҆ ра́зꙋмы, О҆трокови́це бг҃облагода́тнаѧ: ꙗ҆́ко да стеза́ми живо́тными пра́вѣ ходѧ́ще, ми́лость полꙋчи́мъ, возвѣща́юще при́снѡ хвалы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: By thine intelligible radiance enlighten our thoughts, hearts, and minds, O Maiden full of God's grace: that walking rightly in the paths of life, we may obtain mercy, ever proclaiming thy praises.[^10617]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йно є҆́сть: Трисвѧто́е. По Ѻ҆́тче на́шъ: тропа́рь и҆ про́чее.
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Trisagion. After Our Father: Troparion and the rest.*[^10618]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: По а҃-мъ стїхосло́вїи, сѣда́лны кре́стны. Гла́съ и҃.
items.english_text: *On Friday at Matins.*[^10619]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Ви́дѧ разбо́йникъ Нача́лника жи́зни, на крестѣ̀ ви́сѧща, глаго́лаше: а҆́ще не бы̀ Бг҃ъ бы́лъ вопло́щїйсѧ, и҆́же съ на́ми распны́йсѧ, не бы̀ со́лнце лꙋчи̑ своѧ̑ потаи́ло, нижѐ бы̀ землѧ̀ трепе́рщꙋщи трѧсла́ся; но всѧ̑ терпѧ́й, поманѝ ма̀ Гдⷭ҇и, въ ца́рствїи твое́мъ.
items.english_text: *After the First Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 8.*[^10620]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Возноси́те Гдⷭ҇а Бг҃а на́шего, и҆ покланѧ́йтеся подно́жїю нѡ́гъ є҆гѡ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ свѧ́то є҆́сть.
items.english_text: Beholding the Author of life hanging upon the Cross, the thief said: "If He Who is crucified with us were not God incarnate, the sun would not have hidden its rays, nor would the earth have quaked trembling; but O Thou Who endurest all things, remember me, O Lord, in Thy kingdom."[^10621]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Посредѣ̀ двою̀ разбо́йникѡвъ мѣ́рило пра́ведное ѡ҆брѣ́теся кре́стъ тво́й: ѻ҆́вомꙋ оу҆́бѡ низводи́мꙋ въ а҆́дъ тѧгото́ю хꙋле́нїа, дрꙋго́мꙋ же легча́щꙋся ѿ прегрѣше́ній къ позна́нїю бг҃осло́вїа. Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: In the midst of two thieves Thy Cross was found to be a righteous balance: for the one indeed was dragged down into hades by the weight of blasphemy, but the other was lightened of sins unto the knowledge of theology. O Christ God, glory to Thee.[^10623]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Being ever preserved by the Cross of Thy Son and God, O Virgin,...[^10624]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: ...we drive away demonic assaults and wiles: truly chanting thee as the Theotokos, and in love all generations call thee blessed, O Pure One, even as thou didst foretell; therefore grant us remission of sins through thy prayers.[^10625]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *After the Second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 8.*[^10626]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: In the midst of Eden a tree blossomed forth death, but in the midst of all the earth a Tree put forth life: for tasting of the first, being incorruptible, we became corruptible; but attaining unto the second, we were nourished with incorruption. For by the Cross, as God, Thou savest the human race.[^10627]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: In paradise a tree formerly stripped me naked, the enemy introducing mortality by tasting; but the Tree of the Cross, bearing for men the vesture of eternal life, was planted upon the earth, and all the world was filled with all joy; beholding which lifted on high, O people, let us cry aloud in faith unto God with one accord: Thy house is full of glory.[^10629]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: With heavenly light this temple is enlightened today, for in it the angelic hosts rejoice; with whom also the choirs of men make merry in the memory of the passion-bearers. By their entreaties, O Christ, send down upon Thy world peace and great mercy.[^10631]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Beholding Him Who was incarnate of thy pure blood, and Who beyond understanding was born of thee, O Pure One, hanging upon the Tree in the midst of malefactors, thy womb was pierced, and weeping maternally thou didst cry aloud: "Woe is me, my Child! What is this Thy divine and ineffable dispensation, whereby Thou hast brought to life Thy creation? I hymn Thy tender-heartedness."[^10632]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 8.*[^10633]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Christ Savior, and by Thy death, the tyranny of the enemy was overthrown, and death was put to death: and the dead whom hades held bound within itself from the ages, it suddenly released, even all the captives, who hymn Thy dominion, and Thy fearsome and divine descent, O Good One, whereby Thou didst save all.[^10635]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: By the expectation of false deification, the forefather became the author of corruption unto all that came from him; but Thou by Thy Cross pourest forth life, as Thou art all-good; for Thou wast willingly nailed, that Thou mightest loose us from the first condemnation. Therefore we hymn Thy voluntary Passion, O Christ.[^10636]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: The unblemished Ewe-lamb, beholding the Lamb and Shepherd hanging upon the Cross, cried aloud: "My Child! What strange and unexpected sight is this? How is the Life of all condemned unto death in likeness of earthly beings? But rise on the third day from the dead, O Word, as Thou didst say, that rejoicing I may glorify Thee."[^10637]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Precious and Life-Giving Cross.*[^10638]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *(The acrostic whereof is: The Cross abides the fullness of all good things, Amen.)*[^10639]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *The work of Joseph.*[^10640]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Moses, tracing a cross with his rod straightly, cleaved the Red Sea for Israel that walked on foot; and striking it transversely, he brought it together again over the chariots of Pharaoh, drawing the invincible weapon. Therefore let us sing unto Christ our God, for He has been glorified.[^10641]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Glory, O Lord, to Thy precious Cross.*[^10642]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Having stretched out Thy divine palms upon the Cross, O Jesus, Thou didst gather unto Thyself the creation made by Thy hand; and Thou didst deliver all from the hand of the evil one, and didst subdue him with a sovereign hand, O King of all. Therefore we the faithful sing unto Thy majesty, for Thou hast been glorified.[^10643]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Harmful in Eden was the bitter tasting of the tree, which brought in death; but Christ, having been put to death upon the Tree, poured forth life unto all, and slew the serpent by divine power. Therefore let us sing unto Him, our God, for He has been glorified.[^10644]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Having acted valiantly, O Jesus, the multitude of Martyrs, by the Cross and Thy Passion, rose up against passions; and before enemies they confessed Thee Who reignest over creation, and endured torments and boundless afflictions. Therefore they all attained Thy glory of everlasting life.[^10645]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: By the sprinkling of Thy divinely-wrought precious Blood, Thy Martyrs, O Lord, having found deliverance, truly poured out their own blood, being unjustly tormented rather than offer sacrifice unto defiled, soul-corrupting demons. Therefore they were offered as precious slayings unto Thee, O King of all.[^10646]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: When she beheld Thee nailed upon the Cross, Who beholdest all things, the Immaculate One, weeping, said: "What is this, my Child? What have they rendered unto Thee who enjoyed Thy many gifts? How shall I endure these pains? Glory to Thy tender-heartedness and fearsome dispensation, O Long-Suffering One!"[^10647]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Most Holy Theotokos.*[^10648]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Having traversed the water as dry land, and escaped the evil of Egypt, the Israelite cried aloud: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God.[^10649]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most Holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^10650]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: My soul, darkened by the pleasures of life and untimeously troubled by worldly cares, O Mother of God, do thou enlighten with thine enlightenment.[^10651]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: The heavenly gates were opened by thy divine giving of birth, O Mother of God: grant entry thereinto unto my soul as thou art merciful, and guide me unto them.[^10652]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: My soul, pierced by the arrow of the evil one, and wounded by his wiles and cunning, O Virgin, heal by thy mercy.[^10653]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: O hope of the hopeless, restoration of the fallen, who didst give birth unto the divine Light: enlighten my soul that abides in darkness.[^10654]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: The rod is taken as an image of the mystery, for by budding it predetermines the priest; and for the formerly barren Church the Tree of the Cross has now blossomed forth, for strength and confirmation.[^10655]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Into black vesture the sun changed, beholding Thee unjustly lifted up upon the Tree; and the rocks were rent, and all the earth shook with fear, O only Savior, deliverance of all.[^10656]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Having stretched forth his hands, Moses prefigured the precious Cross; which we now portraying with pious mind, conquer all the foreign demonic legions, remaining free from all harm thereof.[^10657]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Enduring passions, the passion-bearers figured the Passion, having shared in manifold sufferings of Him Who suffered willingly, and put passions to death, and shone forth life unto the world.[^10658]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Having trodden the path of torments without turning back, the glorious trophy-bearers cast down from their hearts the stumbling-blocks of deceit, and hastened rejoicing unto divine rest.[^10659]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Apart from the customary laws...[^10660]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: ...of men, I gave Thee birth, O Child," the Theotokos said weeping, "and how have the lawless lifted Thee up upon the Tree in the midst of lawless ones, Who alone hast laid down the law of life?"[^10661]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. Ode 3. Heirmos:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: O Lord, Maker of the vault of heaven and Builder of the Church: do Thou establish me in Thy love, O summit of desires, confirmation of the faithful, O only Lover of mankind.[^10662]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Unceasing groanings, fervent tears, and a contrite heart grant me, O Virgin, that I may weep for the things wrought by me; and consume my passions that grow together with me, O only All-Hymned One.[^10663]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Snatch away my soul, weighed down with sinful slumber and slipped down unto the womb of hades, O Sovereign Lady: and grant me the thought of true repentance, O divinely-blessed one.[^10664]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Grant love of compunction and virtues, O All-Immaculate One, unto my soul submerged in transgressions, and to love heavenly living, and to have the desire of God.[^10665]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Upon thee I place hope, O Mother of God, and quickly shall I be delivered from despair; for I know, yea, I know the wealth of thy tender-heartedness, knowing the strength of thy boldness.[^10666]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Divinity.[^10667]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Bearing piety as a cedar, faith as a cypress, and love as a pine, let us worship the divine Cross.[^10668]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Savior, paradise was opened, and condemned man entered therein again, magnifying Thy goodness.[^10669]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Men who were slain Thou didst bring to life, O Savior, having become dead; and Thou didst put to death the serpent who brought in sin.[^10670]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Having become conformed unto the passions of Christ, the divine Martyrs appeared also as partakers of heavenly splendor.[^10671]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Ye were adorned, O Martyrs, being united unto the comely Word; and ye were radiantly enlightened, having loved the Sun of righteousness.[^10672]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Thou didst give birth unto a new Child, Who before...[^10673]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: ...the ages is perfect, O all-immaculate Maiden, and Who perfects all things by the Cross and by goodness.[^10674]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. Ode 4. Heirmos:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Thou art my strength, O Lord, Thou art my power; Thou art my God, Thou art my rejoicing, Who leaving not the bosom of the Father, didst visit our poverty; therefore with the Prophet Habakkuk I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind.[^10675]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: O thou who didst ineffably give birth unto God the Word: bind up the sores of my soul with effective herb, pouring on the precious Blood of Thy Son, Who destroyed the soul-corrupting belly of hades and poured forth resurrection unto the world.[^10676]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: O Bride of God, send down upon my soul streams of cleansing from transgressions, and wash away evil thoughts, accounting it worthy to be pure; for unto thy mediation and thy help have I fled, O Theotokos Virgin.[^10677]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Unto thy protection I now flee, O Pure One: make haste to deliver me from the cruel storm of the enemy and from the troubling torrents of iniquity; and unto thy haven and unto thy stillness guide me unswervingly, O Mother of God.[^10678]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: The enemy with sinful arrows hath wounded all my soul, and defiled my heart with pleasures, and turned me away from the right way. Therefore I cry aloud unto thee: Having converted me, heal me and save me.[^10679]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: O thrice-blessed Tree, whereon Christ was crucified, the King and Lord: whereby he that deceived by a tree fell, being deceived by thee, when God was nailed in the flesh, Who grants peace unto our souls.[^10680]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Desiring to clothe us who were naked with the garment of incorruption, Thou wast stripped, and being crucified upon the Cross, Thou didst strip naked the enemy's wiles, O Christ; therefore we glorify Thy sufferings.[^10681]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: The saving Blood that manifestly flowed from the side cleansed the world, and destroyed temple blood-sacrifices, and renewed those that were corrupted by the rational fruit, and poured forth incorruption unto our souls.[^10682]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Enlightened by the beauty of manifold wounds, the glorious Martyrs...[^10683]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: ...and marked with divine Blood, manifestly passed through the sword that formerly barred the way, and settled rejoicing into paradise.[^10684]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: How wonderful art Thou in Thy saints, O Christ, who have loved Thee in faith! For being enriched by Thee, they pour forth streams of divine healings unto the world, and dry up the flooding of our passions.[^10685]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Them that were sick with sin thou didst heal, O Virgin, who didst give birth unto the Savior and Physician of all, Who was nailed upon the Tree of the Cross, O Pure One: and Who poured forth salvation unto our souls.[^10686]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. Ode 5. Heirmos:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Why hast Thou cast me away from Thy face, O unwaning Light, and an alien darkness has covered me, the wretched one? But turn me back, and direct my ways unto the light of Thy commandments, I pray.[^10687]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: With all zeal I hasten unto thy protection, O All-Immaculate One, and lift up the eye of my soul: turn me not away, but protect me as thou art good, and deliver me, and wash away the filth of my transgressions.[^10688]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Deadly venom was injected by sinful teeth; but do thou destroy it by the nails and the divine spear of Thine Offspring, Who for tender mercy suffered in the flesh for our sake, O only All-Hymned One.[^10689]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Revive me who am slain in manner of life and corrupted by transgressions, O thou who didst give birth unto life eternal; and by spiritual renewal transform me unto incorruption, O divinely-blessed one.[^10690]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: From demonic malice and the wicked deeds of men deliver me, O Sovereign Lady, and quickly heal bodily and spiritual sickness, O thou who alone didst give birth unto the Physician of all flesh and sins, the Savior and Lord.[^10691]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: In the belly of the aquatic beast Jonah, having stretched forth his palms in the form of a cross, manifestly prefigured the saving Passion; wherefrom coming forth on the third day, he depicted the transcendent Resurrection of Christ God nailed in the flesh, Who by His three-day Resurrection enlightened the world.[^10692]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: The Cross was planted upon the Place of the Skull in the midst of the earth, and healed the wound that blossomed through a tree in the midst of paradise; for the Messiah Jesus, having appeared as the one righteous One in the midst of lawless thieves, raised all up together with Himself, and cast down into the abyss him that had fallen from...[^10693]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: ...the heights.[^10694]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Having bent Thy divine and all-honorable Cross as a bow, O Christ, Thou didst shoot arrows against the murderer; and Thou didst drive the nails of Thy hands, O Master, into his wrathful and all-defiled heart, and didst put him to death utterly, and those slain by him Thou didst bring to life, O Compassionate One.[^10695]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: By the streams of blood that flowed from the bodies of the holy sufferers, they quenched by the Spirit all the flame of idolatry, and watered the honorable furrows of the Church, and caused to grow an ear of corn of the hope and faith of salvation, whereby every soul is nourished through divine grace.[^10696]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: The glorious suffering passion-bearers burned in disposition more than fire, when they were delivered over by the sentence of wicked judges to be burned with material fire; and they were preserved unwounded by the operation and grace of the Holy Spirit, Who crowned them that suffered lawfully.[^10697]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: A sword pierced thy heart, O all-pure Maiden, beholding Thy Son outstretched upon the Cross, enduring sufferings, and slaying the serpent, the ruler of darkness; therefore weeping maternally thou didst magnify Him.[^10698]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. Ode 6. Heirmos:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine iniquities; and lead me up from the deep of evils, I pray; for unto Thee have I cried, and do Thou give ear unto me, O God of my salvation.[^10699]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: I departed from God, having lived prodigally, and became a wretched slave of pleasures, and was stripped of every divine virtue; but visit me, O Pure One.[^10700]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: I became a fugitive from the commandments given unto me, and having estranged myself from life, I drew near unto death; but guide me unto return, O all-pure Mother of God.[^10701]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: My life is deceitful, full of negligence; but let thy great and ineffable mercy, O Pure One, and the compassion of thy goodness prevail over my feeble mind.[^10702]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: O thou who didst give birth unto the Savior and Deliverer and All-Compassionate One: have compassion...[^10703]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: ...upon me, O Pure One, and save me, and deliver me from the evils that compass me about and mercilessly assault my weakness.[^10704]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: The senseless decree of the impious tyrant shook the people, breathing forth threat and God-abhorred blasphemy; yet the three children were not dismayed by beastly wrath nor by consuming fire, but when a dew-bearing wind blew counter to the fire, they sang: Blessed art Thou, O all-hymned God of our fathers and our God.[^10705]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: When Thou wast outstretched upon the Tree of the Cross as a grapevine, O Word of the Father, Thou didst drop the sweet new wine of the mystery, replacing the drunkenness of transgression and gladdening all that know Thee as God and Creator, suffering willingly, and saving them that sing: Blessed art Thou, O all-hymned God of our fathers and our God.[^10706]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Thou didst endure a shameful crucifixion, O my Christ Jesus, putting an end to all reproach and sighing for men; and Thou didst taste of gall, taking away all malicious bitterness. Thou didst wound Thy hands, O Compassionate One, healing our spiritual wounds and commanding us to sing: Blessed art Thou, O all-hymned God of our fathers.[^10707]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: By sufferings, O noble sufferers, ye acquired a life free from pain; therefore ye wholly lighten our sicknesses, having received grace from on high, O holy ones, to heal passions and drive away spirits; and ye stand before the faithful and save them that cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O all-hymned God of our fathers.[^10708]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Ye stood at the judgment seat, O Martyrs, confessing Christ, Who for our sake received flesh like unto ours, yet without corruption; and being truly shown forth as imitators of His sufferings, ye endured the affliction of fire and all other torments, crying aloud in gladness: Blessed art Thou, O all-hymned God of our fathers.[^10709]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: "I am filled with grief beholding Thee, O Savior, suffering without righteousness; I am pierced in Thy ribs," the Theotokos, the only Sovereign Lady, cried aloud weeping and wailing; whom all we worthily call blessed, and piously cry: Blessed art Thou, O all-hymned God of our fathers.[^10710]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. Ode 7. Heirmos:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: The Hebrew children in the furnace boldly trampled upon the flame, and turned the fire into...[^10711]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: ...dew, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages.[^10712]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Thou art all light-bearing, having received the unwaning Light, O Virgin, and enlightening them that cry aloud unto thee in faith, O pure one: Blessed, O Most Pure One, is the fruit of thy womb.[^10713]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: That thou mayest show forth thy love for mankind and thy mercy, O Virgin, lead me up from the deep of evils who cry aloud: Blessed, O Most Pure One, is the fruit of thy womb.[^10714]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Unto thee I flee, O Mother-Virgin, wounded by soul-corrupting arrows: encompass me wholly with thy prayer who cry aloud: Blessed, O Most Pure One, is the fruit of thy womb.[^10715]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Deliver me, O Mother of the Savior, from the cruel captivity of subtle thoughts that grips me, and from sinful causes, that being ever saved I may glorify thee as is due.[^10716]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Bless, ye children, equal in number to the Trinity, God the Father, the Creator; hymn the Word Who came down and turned the fire into dew; and supremely exalt unto all ages the all-holy Spirit, Who gives life unto all.[^10717]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Blessed is the Tree whereby the deceitful curse that was in Eden, which grew through the wicked eating of the tree, was utterly consumed; and Christ is lifted on high, the supremely glorified One, Who for tender mercy was pleased of His own will to be lifted up thereon.[^10718]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Sacredly crossing his hands of old, the ever-glorious one, in blessing his grandsons, showed forth the image of the sacred Tree, whereby blessing was granted unto all who were cursed through the wicked eating of the tree and had slipped down into the deep of evils.[^10719]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: All mankind is restored, O Master, when Thou wast outstretched upon the Cross, and the legion of deceitful demons fell; and things divided receive union, and the dominion of Thy power and Thy might is supremely exalted unto the ages.[^10720]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Blessed glory, incorruptible food, and radiant mansions have ye now inherited, O divine sufferers of the Lord: and ye have been joined unto the heavenly ranks, and have now received with gladness the end of your ever-glorious hopes.[^10721]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́на твоегѡ̀ Дѣ́во и҆ Бг҃а кресто́мъ сохранѧ́еми при́снѡ,
items.english_text: Your courage shone forth brighter than the sun, O radiant sufferers of Christ...[^10722]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: страда́лцы, и҆ всю̀ дїа́волю пре́лесть бж҃е́ственною си́лою помрачѝ, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ всѣ́хъ сердца̀ благочестномꙋ́дреннѣ просвѣтѝ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: ...sufferers, and by divine power darkened all the deceit of the devil, and piously enlightened the hearts of all the faithful unto the ages.[^10723]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Мы́сленный ѻ҆́блакъ, и҆ сѣ́нь свѧще́нїа, престо́лъ Бж҃їй, и҆ две́рь свѣ́та, свѣти́льникъ, и҆ восто́къ Сло́ва, вѣ́рнїи всѝ и҆менꙋ́емъ тѧ̀, Пречи́стаѧ Дѣ́во, всѧ̑ Сꙋтво́ршагѡ ма́ти сꙋ́щи благослове́ннаѧ.
items.english_text: A spiritual cloud, and tabernacle of sanctification, throne of God, and gate of light, candlestick, and Orient of the Word, do all we faithful call thee, O all-immaculate Virgin, who art the blessed Mother of Him Who created all things.[^10724]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Кан: Бц҃ѣ. І҆рмо́съ: Седмери́цею пе́щь халда́йскїй мꙋчи́тель бг҃очести́вымъ неи́стовнѡ разжжѐ, си́лою же лꙋ́чшею спасе́ны сїѧ̑ ви́дѣвъ, Творцꙋ̀ и҆ И҆зба́вителю вопїѧ́ше: ѻ҆́троцы благослови́те, свѧще́нницы воспо́йте, лю́дїе превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. Ode 8. Heirmos:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Вседержи́тель Гдⷭь всели́выйсѧ въ оу҆тро́бꙋ твою̀, и҆ сто́лпъ оу҆твержде́нїа вѣ́рнымъ тѧ̀ показа̀; къ немꙋ́же прибѣга́юще напа́стей и҆збавлѧ́емсѧ и҆ бѣ́дъ, и҆ свобожда́емсѧ и҆скꙋше́нїа, согла́снѡ пою́ще: сщ҃е́нницы воспо́йте, лю́дїе превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Sevenfold did the Chaldean tyrant frantically kindle the furnace for the pious; but having seen them saved by a greater power, he cried aloud to the Creator and Deliverer: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^10725]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннагѡ Влады́чице ѿпадо́хъ житїа̀, къ грѣхꙋ̀ невоздержи́мѡ вле́комь, и҆ си́мъ порабоща́емь, свобожде́нїа є҆́же въ Хрⷭтѣ̀, и҆ пра́вды и҆́стинныѧ ѡ҆бнажи́хсѧ; но не пре́зри ма̀ сокро́вище спасе́нїа, къ тебѣ̀ прибѣга́ющаго, на́га и҆ ѻ҆бнища́вшаго.
items.english_text: The Almighty Lord, having dwelt within Thy womb, showed thee forth unto the faithful as a pillar of confirmation; fleeing unto whom, we are delivered from perils and distresses, and are set free from temptation, singing in unison: Ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages.[^10726]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Да и҆спра́витсѧ мольба̀ моли́твы моеѧ̀ къ Гдⷭꙋ, и҆зъ оу҆тро́бы твоеѧ̀ произше́дшемꙋ, Влады́чице: и҆ ѿ престꙋпле́нїа за́повѣдей да и҆зба́витъ ма̀, и҆ ѻ҆сꙋжде́нїа и҆ кла́твы зако́нныѧ; и҆ скве́рнꙋ да ѿмы́етъ лю́тыхъ мои́хъ прегрѣше́нїй, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ ми́лостивъ.
items.english_text: I have fallen away from a consecrated life, O Sovereign Lady, being uncontrollably dragged toward sin and enslaved by it, and I am stripped of the freedom that is in Christ and of true righteousness; yet despise me not, O treasury of salvation, who flee unto thee, naked and impoverished.[^10727]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ороди́тельнице пречи́стаѧ, дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ ꙗ҆́звы и҆ грѣхѡ́вныѧ собла́зны ѻ҆чи́сти, и҆сто́чникомъ ѿмыва́ющи и҆̀же и҆зъ ре́бръ Сы́на твоегѡ̀, ѿ ни́хъ поте́кшими стрꙋѧ́ми; къ тебѣ́ бо взыва́ю, и҆ къ тебѣ̀ прибѣга́ю, и҆ тебѐ призыва́ю Бг҃облагода́тнꙋю.
items.english_text: Let the petition of my prayer be directed unto the Lord Who came forth from thy womb, O Sovereign Lady: and may He deliver me from transgression of the commandments, and from condemnation and the legal curse; and may He wash away the defilement of my grievous transgressions, as He alone is merciful.[^10728]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь ѳ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Снѣ́дїю дре́ва, ро́дꙋ прибы́вшаѧ сме́рть, кресто́мъ оу҆праздни́сѧ дне́сь; и҆́бо прама́тернаѧ всеро́днаѧ кла́тва разрꙋши́сѧ, прозѧбе́нїемъ чи́стыѧ Бг҃ома́тере, ю҆́же всѧ̑ си́лы небе́сныѧ велича́ютъ.
items.english_text: O all-immaculate Birthgiver of God, cleanse the wounds and sinful stumbling-blocks of my soul, washing them with the fount of streams that flowed from the ribs of Thy Son; for unto thee do I cry, and unto thee do I flee, and thee do I invoke, who art full of God's grace.[^10729]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *Then, "My soul magnifies the Lord:"*[^10730]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Death, which came upon our race through the eating from the tree, has been abolished today through the Cross; for the ancestral universal curse has been dissolved through the offshoot of the pure Mother of God, whom all the heavenly hosts magnify.[^10731]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Most sacredly exalting Thee, O Compassionate One, we venerate Thy Cross, and the spear, the sponge, and the reed, and the holy nails driven into Thy hands and feet...[^10732]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: ...O Master, whereby we have found perfect remission and have been accounted worthy of the life of paradise.[^10733]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Oh, how unjustly wast Thou condemned to be nailed, crucified upon the Tree, O Thou Who alone art the most righteous King of all! Seeking to justify all who with faith glorify Thy voluntary sufferings and dispensation, and who faithfully magnify Thee, O my Christ.[^10734]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Having surrendered their bodies whole-souledly unto torments, the glorious Martyrs endured wounds and violent death, the severing of limbs, lacerations, and burning by fire, being inflamed with love for the Lord. Therefore, as crown-bearers, they dwell in the heavens.[^10735]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O Sweetness of Apostles and Martyrs, by the prayers of them all fill us with mercy, as Thou art compassionate, granting remission of sins, and deliverance from all grievous things, and dwelling in Thy Kingdom, O Christ God, Who didst appear as man for our sake.[^10736]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Thou didst appear as a light-formed bridal chamber, O Virgin, unto Him Who dwelt in thy incorrupt womb, and Who of His own will endured the blessed Passion, and Who granted dispassion unto all according to His ineffable mercy; Whom worshipping with faith, we piously magnify thee.[^10737]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. Ode 9. Heirmos:*

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
