items.english_text: Heaven was amazed at this, and the ends of the earth were astonished, that God appeared unto men in the flesh, and thy womb became more spacious than the heavens. Therefore the ranks of angels and men magnify thee as the Mother of God.[^10738]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Truly, O Mother of God, cease not to pray unto the existing God Whom thou didst bear, that He may grant remission of sins unto thy servants, and all-perfect forgiveness for the evil deeds now wrought by them, and account them worthy of eternal delight together with all the saints.[^10739]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: With might and spiritual strength, and with armor and dominion, gird my humble soul, O all-holy Theotokos, and clothe me with the weapon of the Cross; and cleanse the wounds of my sin with the dew of thy love for mankind and with thy great mercy.[^10740]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Be thou unto me a pillar of salvation, O Pure One: render idle the regiments of demons, driving away the tumult of assaults and perils, and chasing far off the incursions of passions...[^10741]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: ...and granting pure liberation.[^10742]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O pure, all-glorified Mother of God, save them that hymn thee with love, mercifully dispersing the tumult of temptations; for as thou didst give birth unto God, O Virgin, whatsoever thou desirest, thou art able to do, and thou dispensest mercy unhindered; therefore do all we magnify thee.[^10743]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: litany, Exaposteilarion, and the customary psalms.*[^10744]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 8:*[^10745]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: The rod of Moses prefigured Thy precious Cross, O our Savior; for thereby Thou savest Thy people, as from the depth of the sea, O Lover of mankind.[^10746]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *Verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord: - - - And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, and guide their sons. [Ps. 89:14, 16]* [^10747]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Of old in Eden, in paradise, a tree good for food sprouted in the midst of the orchard; but Thy Church, O Christ, blossomed forth Thy Cross, pouring forth life unto all the world. But that tree indeed brought death through food unto Adam who ate thereof, whereas this Tree made alive the thief who was saved through faith. Make us also partakers of his salvation, O Christ God, Who by Thy Passion didst destroy the enemy's wiles against us, and account us worthy of Thy Kingdom, O Lord.[^10748]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *Verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us: - - - and direct the works of our hands upon us; yea, direct Thou the work of our hands. [Ps. 89:17]* [^10749]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: What shall we call you, O saints? Cherubim? For Christ rested upon you; Seraphim? For unceasingly ye glorified Him; Angels? For ye turned away from the body; Powers? For ye work with miracles. Many are your names, and greater are your gifts. Pray that our souls may be saved.[^10750]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O most marvelous wonder! O awesome mystery! How hangs He upon the Tree Who is immortal by nature? How does He now taste of death? How is the innocent One condemned? Hide thy light and be dismayed, O sun, beholding such audacity, the Virgin cried aloud with sighing, beholding Christ crucified, Whom she had borne.[^10751]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *It is good to give praise: the Trisagion, and the rest as usual.*[^10752]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *On Friday, the Beatitudes, Tone 8:*[^10753]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, as Thou didst remember the thief upon the Tree; and account all worthy, O Thou Who alone art compassionate, of Thy heavenly Kingdom.[^10754]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Thou didst stretch forth Thy palms upon the Tree, O Christ, and having exposed the wicked principalities and powers, Thou didst save from their injury them that piously glorify Thee.[^10755]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Pierced with a spear while hanging upon the Tree, Thou didst pour forth unto us streams of immortality, who were senselessly put to death by transgression; therefore with fear we glorify Thee.[^10756]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Showing themselves strangers to the introduction of earthly pleasures, the sufferers surrendered themselves unto strange torments, wounding the apostate by their holy wounds.[^10757]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Being One of the unoriginate Trinity, Thou didst endure the Passion upon the Cross of Thine own will; dry up all the torrents of my passions, and account me worthy of salvation.[^10758]

items.office: Friday: The Precious and Life-Giving Cross[^10548]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Beholding Emmanuel, the Lamb of God and the Word, hanging in the flesh upon the Tree, the only undefiled Ewe-lamb and Virgin was gripped with sorrow, shedding tears.[^10759]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *On Friday Evening.*[^10761]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *On "Lord, I have cried," Stichera to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerables, Tone 8:*[^10762]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: I, wretched one, am ever wounded by the arrows of the enemy, and what shall I do, I am at a loss. But ye who suffered valiantly broke his arrows, and by the effusion of your blood sanctify all creation; heal me who am diseased, O divine Martyrs, as ye have boldness before the Lord, O right-blessed ones.[^10764]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: I am wholly gripped with perplexity when I consider that dreadful hour of Thine examination, O Judge of all and God, and I weep and lament, and...[^10765]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: ...wailing as I remember the abyss of my evils; therefore save me, O Lover of mankind, by the supplications of Thy martyrs, and deliver me from torment, as Thou art compassionate.[^10766]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: For them that with faith celebrate your all-sacred memory, pray unto God, O divine Martyrs, that they may be delivered from temptations and attain heavenly mansions; and those whom Thou hast translated, as Thou alone art Benefactor and Lover of mankind, ordain their souls, O Long-suffering One, where the ranks of the Patriarchs ever rejoice.[^10767]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Martyrs, in the same Tone:*[^10768]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O Martyrs of the Lord, every place do ye sanctify, and every disease do ye heal; and now pray that our souls may be delivered from the snares of the enemy, we entreat you.[^10769]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O Martyrs of the Lord, pray unto our God, and entreat for our souls a multitude of compassions and cleansing of many transgressions, we pray.[^10770]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O invincible Martyrs of Christ, having conquered deceit by the power of the Cross and received the grace of eternal life, ye feared not the threats of the tyrants, but rejoiced when wounded with torments; and now your blood has become healings for our souls. Pray that our souls may be saved.[^10771]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *Glory, both now: Theotokion (Dogmatikon):*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: The King of heaven, for His love of mankind, appeared upon earth and lived among men; for having taken flesh from the pure Virgin, and having come forth from her with the assumption, He is one Son, twofold in nature, but not in hypostasis. Therefore, truly preaching Him as perfect God and perfect man, we confess Christ our God. Whom beseech, O unwedded Mother, that our souls may be saved.[^10772]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *Then, "O Joyful Light:" and the rest.*[^10773]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 8:*[^10774]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Thy Martyrs, O Lord, forgetting the things of this life and disregarding torments for the sake of the life to come, were shown forth as heirs thereof; therefore they also rejoice with the Angels. By their prayers grant unto Thy people great mercy.[^10775]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: If there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, it is meet for the Saints; for they bowed their necks to the sword for Thy sake, Who didst bow the heavens and come down; they shed their blood for Thy sake, Who didst empty Thyself and take the form of a servant;...[^10776]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: ...they humbled themselves even unto death, imitating Thy poverty. By their prayers, according to the multitude of Thy compassions, O God, have mercy upon us.[^10777]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: I weep and lament when I contemplate death, and behold our beauty created according to the image of God lying in the tombs, formless, inglorious, and without shape. O wonder! What is this mystery that has come to pass concerning us? How have we been surrendered unto corruption? How have we been yoked unto death? Truly by the command of God, as it is written, Who grants rest unto them that are translated.[^10778]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O Sovereign Lady, receive the prayers of thy servants, and deliver us from every distress and sorrow.[^10779]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart: and the rest as usual.*[^10780]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *On Friday at Small Compline.*[^10781]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 8.*[^10782]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Let us sing unto the Lord, Who led His people through the Red Sea; for He alone is gloriously glorified.[^10783]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *Refrain: Most holy Lady Theotokos, save us.*[^10784]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Put to death the carnal mind of my flesh, O all-pure Virgin who didst give birth unto Life, and deliver me from every torment.[^10785]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: With the most radiant ray of Him Who shone forth from thee, O Virgin, enlighten the pupils of my soul, that I may glorify thee.[^10786]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Pray, O Sovereign Lady, only holy Theotokos, that on the day of judgment I may obtain salvation and divine radiance.[^10787]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O all-pure Theotokos, soothe the pains of my heart, who didst bear Christ without pain, beyond understanding and expression.[^10788]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Thou art the confirmation of them that flee unto Thee; Thou art the Light of them that are darkened; and my spirit hymns Thee.[^10789]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Deliver me by thy prayers, O Most Pure One, from the arrows of the enemy; and spare my heart from assaulting thoughts.[^10790]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Heal the wounds of my soul, O All-Immaculate One; O Mother of God, calm the turmoil of my heart by thy prayers.[^10791]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Subdue the unrest of my thoughts, O pure Sovereign Lady, and take away all sorrow from my soul, who didst give birth unto Joy...[^10792]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Rejoice, salvation of them that flee unto thee, O Virgin-Mother of Christ. Rejoice, boast of Apostles and Martyrs.[^10793]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Divinity.[^10794]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Heal the wounds of my soul, O Word of God, Who wast wounded for my sake as Lover of mankind, and enlighten the darkness of my mind.[^10795]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Through the slumber of my negligence, the sleep of sin overtook me, O Virgin: by thy watchful prayer raise me up unto repentance.[^10796]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O All-Immaculate One, who didst pour forth the water of remission from founts: water my heart that is dried up by all manner of transgressions.[^10797]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O most holy Bride of God, Sovereign Lady of the world: save me, changing misfortunes and driving away the tumult of passions.[^10798]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Rising early, we cry aloud unto Thee: Lord, save us, for Thou art our God; besides Thee we know no other.[^10799]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Look down, O Most Pure One, and hear my voice, and cleanse all mine iniquities, O Sovereign Lady.[^10800]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O Theotokos, who didst give birth unto the unwaning Sun: enlighten me wholly who am darkened by passions, that I may glorify and praise thee, O All-Immaculate One.[^10801]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Have compassion upon my soul, O most holy Maiden, and deliver me from judgment and from eternal torment.[^10802]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Heal my ailing soul, O most holy Sovereign Lady, who didst give birth unto Him Who takes away the diseases of all.[^10803]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: An abyss of sins and a storm of transgressions troubles me, and thrusts me into the deep of violent despair; but stretch forth Thy strong hand unto me as unto Peter, O Helmsman, and save me.[^10804]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Put to death, O Theotokos, the disorderly motions of my flesh, who didst make alive those slain by malice through thy living Nativity; that I may glorify thee as the cause of mankind's renewal.[^10805]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O Theotokos Virgin, who didst give birth unto an abyss of compassions: save my soul from the sorrows of this life, and open unto me the doors of spiritual joy; for in thee alone have I placed my hope.[^10806]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: That I may joyfully hymn thy greatness, O all-pure Virgin, and...[^10807]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: ...the great grace of miracles, do thou alter by thy prayers the unseemly thoughts that ever afflict me.[^10808]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Beyond nature didst thou give birth unto Him Who is unparted from the Father's bosom, and Who through thee, O Virgin, conversed with men. But as thou art the boast and confirmation of us all, O Theotokos, have compassion upon them that flee unto thee.[^10809]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *Then, "Lord, have mercy" (40). Glory, both now:*[^10810]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 8:*[^10811]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: The Father's Word came down upon the earth, and a radiant Angel said unto the Theotokos: Rejoice, O blessed one, who alone hast preserved thy chamber, having received the conception of the pre-eternal God and Lord, that as God He might save the human race from deceit.[^10812]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: The Hebrew children in the furnace boldly trampled upon the flame, and turned the fire into dew, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages.[^10813]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Woe is me! How shall I escape the torments that await me, having lived evilly here? How shall I, wretched one, appear before the awesome Judge? O Birthgiver of God, Sovereign Lady, be my helper then.[^10814]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Quench the flame of my passions, and calm the storm of my heart, O pure Mother of God: and deliver me, O All-Immaculate One, from the torment of demons and from eternal fire.[^10815]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Behold my affliction, O Virgin, which the multitude of mine evils hath brought on; and grant me rest before my departure, entreating Thy Son by thy maternal prayers.[^10816]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Quench the flame of my heart's passions with thy dew, O Virgin, and rescue me, O Maiden, from the fearful fire, from eternal judgment, and from demonic torment.[^10817]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Bless God the Father, the Creator, ye children equal in number to the Trinity; hymn the Word Who came down and transformed the fire into dew; and supremely exalt unto all ages the all-holy Spirit, Who gives life unto all.[^10818]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Put to death, O Virgin, all our carnal motions, who didst make the serpent dead by thy life-bearing Nativity; and pray that we may attain the life that waxes not old, that we may hymn thee unto the ages.[^10819]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Thee, O Birthgiver of God, do I ever invoke unto aid: do not...[^10820]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: ...put me to shame who have acquired deeds of shame, but have compassion upon me, O Most Pure One, rescue me from the flame, and deliver me from eternal torments.[^10821]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O full of grace, appear unto me as helper in the distress of evils, delivering me from the assaults of demonic wiles that come upon me, that I may ever bless thee, O Theotokos, mediatress of all.[^10822]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O most holy Maiden, boast of Apostles, glory of Martyrs: make me a partaker of eternal glory, who cry aloud: Bless the all-holy Spirit unto all the ages.[^10823]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Thou didst transcend the laws of nature, having conceived the Creator and Lord, and wast the door of salvation unto the world; therefore we unceasingly magnify thee, O Theotokos.[^10824]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: By thine unwaning light, O gate of light, drive away the cruel darkness of my soul, and show unto me the light-bearing paths of repentance, that walking therein, I may escape the murky darkness of sin and unceasingly magnify thee.[^10825]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Cleanse Thy servants, O Good One, and grant forgiveness of transgressions; and deliver us from eternal flame, and make us partakers of Thy Kingdom, O Word of God; for desiring to save the human race, Thou didst endure the Cross.[^10826]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Grant me, O Theotokos, easily to pass through the journey of this life, and as thou art good, subdue the uprisings of assaults and passions, and guide me unto the virtue of the heavenly Kingdom and divine rest, that being saved, I may glorify thee.[^10827]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Heal my soul that hath suffered with grievous passion, as thou art merciful, who didst give birth unto the all-good God; and deliver me, O Most Pure One, from them that ever afflict me and from grievous things that increase, that being saved, I may fervently magnify thee who hast magnified our race.[^10828]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: the Trisagion; after "Our Father:" the troparion and dismissal.*[^10829]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *On Saturday at Matins.*[^10830]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Martyrs, Tone 8:*[^10831]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: With heavenly light this temple is enlightened today, for in it the angelic hosts rejoice, and together with them the choirs of martyrs make merry in the memory of the passion-bearers. By their prayers send down, O Christ, unto our souls...[^10832]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: ...peace and great mercy.[^10833]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Spiritual luminaries were ye shown forth, O holy Martyrs, for by faith ye abolished the darkness of deceit, and enlightened your spiritual lamps, and with the Bridegroom entered in glory into the heavenly bridal chamber; and now we entreat you: Pray that our souls may be saved.[^10835]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Numbered among the righteous in the mansions of the elect, O Master, those who have piously departed from temporary things: giving them rest in the places of those that keep festival and in unending paradisaical delight, as Thou art good, forgiving their voluntary and involuntary transgressions according to Thine utmost goodness, O Lover of mankind.[^10837]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Thou Who for our sake wast born of the Virgin, and didst endure crucifixion, O Good One, Who by death didst overthrow death, and didst manifest the Resurrection as God: despise not them whom Thou hast fashioned with Thine own hand; show forth Thy love for mankind, O Merciful One; accept the Theotokos who bare Thee, who intercedes for us, and save, O our Savior, a despairing people.[^10838]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 8:*[^10839]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: Ever-radiant luminaries unto the universe were ye shown forth through faith, having placed all your hope martyrlike upon the Lord; and with the spiritual oil of the Holy Spirit ye enlightened your spiritual lamps. Therefore also as spiritual cups that dispense healings unto men, even as waters, were ye shown forth, O all-praised passion-bearers; pray unto Christ God that He grant remission of transgressions unto them that lovingly honor your holy memory.[^10841]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннѣйше тѧ̀ возносѧ́ще Ще́дре, покланѧ́емсѧ твоемꙋ̀ крестꙋ̀, копїю́ же и҆ гꙋ́бцѣ, и҆ тро́сти, и҆ въ рꙋ́кꙋ вонзе́ннымъ и҆ въ но́гꙋ ст҃ы̑мъ гвозде́мъ
items.english_text: O Prophets, Martyrs of Christ, and Hierarchs, who piously and lawfully finished the good fight and received unfading crowns from God: unceasingly pray unto His goodness for us, that He may grant us forgiveness of transgressions, as He is a God Who is easily entreated.[^10843]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Глꙋбино́ю мꙋ́дрости человѣколю́бнѡ всѧ̑ стро́ѧй, и҆ поле́зное всѣ̑мъ подава́ѧй є҆ди́не Содѣ́телю, ᲂу҆поко́й Гдⷭи дꙋ́ши ра̑бъ твои́хъ; на тѧ́ бо ᲂу҆пова́ніе возложи́ша, Творца̀ и҆ Зижди́телѧ и҆ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: Who with profound wisdom orderest all things in philanthropy, and dispensest unto all that which is profitable, O only Creator: give rest, O Lord, unto the souls of Thy servants; for they have placed their hope in Thee, our Creator, Fashioner, and God.[^10845]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ и҆ стѣ́нꙋ, и҆ приста́нище и҆́мамы, и҆ моли́твенницꙋ благопрія́тнꙋ къ Бг҃ꙋ, є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ, Бцⷣе безневѣ́стнаѧ, вѣ́рныхъ спасе́ніе.
items.english_text: In thee do we have a wall and a haven, and an acceptable intercessor before God Whom thou didst bear, O unwedded Theotokos, salvation of the faithful.[^10846]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: ст҃ы̑мъ Мꙋ́ченикѡмъ, І҆ера́рхѡмъ, Преподо́бнымъ, и҆ ᲂу҆со́пшымъ. (Е҆гѡ́же краестро́чіе си́це: Осмогла́сника но́вагѡ бж҃е́ственный коне́цъ.) Трꙋ́дъ же І҆ѡ́сифовъ.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, Venerables, and the Departed. (Whose acrostic is this: The divine end of the new Octoechos.) The labor of Joseph.*[^10847]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Пои́мъ Гдⷭви, прове́дшемꙋ лю́ди своѧ̑ сквозѣ̀ Чермно́е мо́ре, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ сла́внѡ просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: Let us sing unto the Lord, Who led His people through the Red Sea; for He alone is gloriously glorified.[^10848]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Припѣ́въ: Ст҃і́и Мꙋ́ченици, моли́те Бг҃а ѡ҆ на́съ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Holy Martyrs, pray unto God for us.*[^10849]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Честні́и би́серіе ꙗ҆ви́стесѧ, вѣне́цъ просвѣща́юще честны́ѧ це́ркве, страстоте́рпци Хрⷭтѡ́ви до́блественнѣйшіи.
items.english_text: Precious pearls were ye shown forth, adorning the crown of the honorable Church, O most valiant passion-bearers of Christ.[^10850]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Припѣ́въ: Свѧти́телїе Хрⷭтѡ́ви, моли́те Бг҃а ѡ҆ на́съ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Hierarchs of Christ, pray unto God for us.*[^10851]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆блиста́ша догма́тъ и҆ добродѣ́телей бж҃твенными свѣ́тлостьми премꙋ́дріи свѧти́телїе, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ сердца̀ просвѣти́ша.
items.english_text: The all-wise hierarchs shone forth with the divine splendors of dogmas and virtues, and enlightened the hearts of the faithful.[^10852]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Припѣ́въ: Всѝ Ст҃і́и, моли́те Бг҃а ѡ҆ на́съ.
items.english_text: *Refrain: All ye Saints, pray unto God for us.*[^10853]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ въ проро́цѣхъ, и҆ преподо́бныхъ чꙋ́днаго мо́лимъ Сло́ве: тѣ́хъ мольба́ми спасѝ на́съ.
items.english_text: Thee Who art marvelous in the prophets and the venerables do we entreat, O Word: by their supplications save us.[^10854]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Е҆гда̀ сꙋ́дъ пра́ведный прі́йдеши сотвори́ти, Пра́веднѣйшій, неосꙋжде́ннѡ Сло́ве тѣ́хъ мольба́ми спасѝ на́съ.
items.english_text: When Thou comest to work righteous judgment, O most Righteous One, without condemnation, O Word, save us by their supplications.[^10855]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭа ро́ждшꙋю тѧ̀ свѣ́дый, же́нскій ли́къ тебѐ въ слѣ́дъ Дѣ́во страда́льчествовавъ, томꙋ̀ приведе́сѧ.
items.english_text: Knowing that she bare the Lord, the choir of women, having suffered martyrdom after thee, O Virgin, was brought unto Him.[^10856]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Во́дꙋ проше́дъ ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́шꙋ, и҆ е҆гѵ́петскагѡ ѕла̀ и҆збѣжа́въ, І҆илтѧнинъ вопіѧ́ше: И҆зба́вителю и҆ Бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ пои́мъ.
items.english_text: *Second Canon, of the Departed. The work of Theophanes.*[^10857]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Припѣ́въ: Ди́венъ Бг҃ъ во Ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ, Бг҃ъ І҆и́левъ.
items.english_text: Having passed through the water as upon dry land, and having escaped the evil of Egypt, the Israelite cried aloud: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God.[^10858]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Сме́ртїю сме́рть Хрⷭто́вꙋ, и҆ страстьмѝ стра́сть подража́вше честнꙋ́ю, мꙋ́ченици всѝ, бж҃твеннꙋю и҆ блаже́ннꙋю жи́знь полꙋчи́ша.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Wonderful is God in His saints, the God of Israel. [Ps. 67:36]*[^10859]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Припѣ́въ: Оу҆поко́й Гдⷭи дꙋ́ши ᲂу҆со́пшихъ ра̑бъ твои́хъ.
items.english_text: By death having imitated the death of Christ, and by sufferings His honorable passion, all the martyrs obtained the divine and blessed life.[^10860]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Refrain: Give rest, O Lord, unto the souls of Thy departed servants.*[^10861]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Overlooking the offenses of their youth, and remitting their sins, O Christ the Savior, number Thy servants who departed before...[^10862]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: ...with Thine elect.[^10863]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: The glory and joy which they who have acquired the blessed abode have obtained, grant richly unto Thy servants whom Thou hast received, O Many-merciful One.[^10864]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Thou didst conceive the Father's Word, Which was united to the flesh according to hypostasis, Which from thee, O all-immaculate Maiden, abolished hades by divine power.[^10865]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Thou Who didst establish the heavens by the Word, and didst found the earth upon many waters, establish me unto the singing of Thy doxology, O Lord.[^10866]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Having cast off abominable sacrifices with strongest resolve, the sufferers became a purest sacrifice unto the Word Who was sacrificed.[^10867]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Renewing with sacredly-working words those grown old through all manner of passions, ye were shown forth as divine disciples of Him Who renewed the world.[^10868]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: The grace of the All-Holy Spirit given unto the prophets aforetime manifestly filled the ascetics in the last times with divine gifts.[^10869]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Unite unto the choirs of the Saints, O God, them that have faithfully departed from life, and make them dwellers of paradise, through Thine ineffable mercy.[^10870]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: He Who is nowise containable, Jesus and the Lord, dwelt without being straitened in thy sanctified womb, O all-pure, all-hymned Virgin.[^10871]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Canon of the Departed. Ode 3. Heirmos:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: O Lord, Supreme Creator of the celestial vault and Builder of the Church: do Thou confirm me in Thy love, O summit of desires, confirmation of the faithful, O only Lover of mankind.[^10872]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Having cleansed yourselves from the ancient ancestral fall by baptism and regeneration, and having sprinkled yourselves with the streams of your own blood, O blessed ones, ye reign together with Christ.[^10873]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Thou Who willingly wast laid dead in the tomb, and Who callest forth them that dwell in the tombs, O Savior: be well pleased that those whom Thou hast received from us should dwell in the mansions of Thy righteous ones.[^10874]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Entreated by the loving-kindness of Thy divine goodness, O Master, and by that goodness which is known as co-natural with Thee, giving remission of sins unto Thy servants...[^10875]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: ...O Savior, give rest.[^10876]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Incarnate from thy womb and having become man, He Who is pre-eminently the only Lover of mankind saves man from the gates of death, O all-pure, only all-hymned Mother of God.[^10877]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Divinity.[^10878]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Having run the course of martyrdom with spiritual warmth, O divinely blessed sufferers, ye burned up material deceit.[^10879]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Hierarchs and Venerables):*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Thy Venerables, O Lord, and Hierarchs hast Thou radiantly glorified; by their divine supplications make me a partaker of Thy glory.[^10880]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: The inspiration of the Divine Spirit which enlightened the prophets granted strength unto women to destroy the insolence of enemies.[^10881]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Vouchsafe Thy servants whom Thou hast translated, O All-Good One, being entreated, to join the choir together with all the Saints in the mansions of Thy holy ones.[^10882]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Above the law of nature didst thou give birth unto the Giver of the divine law, Who rebuilds fallen human nature, O All-Immaculate One.[^10883]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Canon of the Departed. Ode 4. Heirmos:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Thou art my strength, O Lord, Thou art my power; Thou art my God, Thou art my rejoicing, Who left not the bosom of the Father, and visited our poverty. Therefore with the Prophet Habakkuk I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind.[^10884]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: That they might behold Thy glory, O Master, and radiantly obtain Thy light-giving splendor in the heavens, the divine martyrs endured to bear every manner of torments, singing unto Thee, O Christ: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind.[^10885]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Many mansions are with Thee, O Savior, distributed unto all according to their worth, according to the measure of their virtues: vouchsafe, therefore, O Compassionate One, that these who have departed in faith may fill them, piously crying unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind.[^10886]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: A man like unto us didst Thou appear, O Immortal One, and Thou didst endure death equally for all, and didst show the path of life; those who have departed...[^10887]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: ...vouchsafe them, as Lover of mankind, granting remission of sins as Master, and bestowing communion in light.[^10888]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Thou art the praise of the faithful, O unwedded Maiden. Thou art the protectress, thou art the refuge of Christians, a wall and a haven. Thou bearest supplications unto thy Son, O All-Immaculate One, and dost save from perils them that know thee with faith and love as the pure Theotokos.[^10889]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Enlighten us by Thy commandments, O Lord, and by Thy high arm grant us Thy peace, O only Lover of mankind.[^10890]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: The divine martyrs endured bodily wounds, and for this reason they ever heal our wounds, wounding the demons.[^10891]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Hierarchs and Venerables):*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Holy hierarchs of God, with all the venerables, pray unto Christ to grant us remission of sins.[^10892]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Having worn out the flesh with wounds and ascetical discipline, O Lover of mankind, the venerable women were vouchsafed good hopes.[^10893]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Having destroyed death by Thy death, O Immortal One: give rest, as Lover of mankind, unto Thy faithful servants who have died in hope of life.[^10894]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Thou didst abolish the condemnation of our foreparents, O Pure One, having borne in the flesh Jesus, the only Lord, Who justifies all.[^10895]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Canon of the Departed. Ode 5. Heirmos:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Why hast Thou cast me off from Thy presence, O Light never setting, and a strange darkness hath covered me, wretched one? But turn me, and direct my ways unto the light of Thy commandments, I pray.[^10896]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Having shown compassion, vouchsafe, O only Lover of mankind, those who have been translated unto the dispassionate life to partake of Thine ineffable glory, and of Thy blessedness which surpasses words, in the mansions of the saints, where is the voice of them that keep festival.[^10897]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Where the angelic ranks and where the assemblies of the righteous rejoice, in the bosom of Abraham settle Thy servants, O Savior; and be well pleased, O Merciful One, that with boldness they may stand before the awesome and divine throne.[^10898]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Purification wast Thou shown forth unto us, and righteousness and redemption; and by Thy wound Thou didst heal our infirmities. Do Thou, therefore, O Compassionate One...[^10899]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: ...as Thou art good, place those who have departed in the delight of paradise.[^10900]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Compassionately, O Merciful One, Thou didst take upon Thyself the measure of humanity; Thou Who adornest with highest exaltations of divine glory, having received from virginal loins ensouled, rational flesh, wherewith Thou didst destroy death.[^10901]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine iniquities; and lead me up from the depth of evils, I pray; for unto Thee have I cried, and hear me, O God of my salvation.[^10902]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: By your honorable suppurations ye heal the sicknesses of souls, O holy martyrs, and ever take away the putrefactions of bodies, wounding the multitude of deceitful demons.[^10903]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Venerables, Hierarchs, and Holy Women):*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: The choir of the venerables, the assembly of hierarchs, and the divine company of holy women, having firmly suffered, inherited heavenly delights.[^10904]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Having put the flesh to death, O ascetics, ye obtained life; and having well pastured the flock of Christ, O all-wise hierarchs, ye were vouchsafed immortal glory after your end.[^10905]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Being the life of the living and the rest of the dead, O Word: settle Thy departed servants, translated from among us by Thy divine nodding, in the bosom of Abraham Thy servant.[^10906]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: The Father's radiance dwelt in thee, O Pure One, and by the immaterial rays of His Divinity shattered the darkness of polytheism, and enlightened the world.[^10907]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Canon of the Departed. The same Heirmos.*[^10908]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Thy martyrs, O Savior, endured many torments, being wounded in soul by Thy love, O holy ones, desiring Thine ever-existing glory and sweet communion.[^10909]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Thou didst tear open the belly of the enemy by death, O Savior, and didst raise up all the prisoners that were in him, bestowing life; whereof vouchsafe those who have departed, O Benefactor.[^10910]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: From tears and sighing free Thy servants who are in hades, O Savior: for as Thou alone art compassionate, Thou hast taken away every tear...[^10911]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: ...from every face of them that faithfully theologize Thee.[^10912]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: He Who is Creator by nature is created in thy womb; full as God, He empties Himself, O All-Immaculate One: the only Immortal One dies by death for the salvation of all.[^10913]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: With the Saints give rest, O Christ, unto the souls of Thy servants, where there is no sickness, nor sorrow, nor sighing, but life unending.[^10914]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Thou alone art immortal, Who didst make and fashion man; for we earthly were fashioned from the earth, and unto the same earth shall we go, as Thou didst command, Who didst fashion me and say unto me: Earth thou art, and unto earth shalt thou depart; whither all we mortals go, making our funeral lamentation the song: Alleluia.[^10915]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: The godly Children in Babylon bowed not down unto the golden image, but bedewed in the midst of the fiery furnace, they sang a hymn, saying: O supremely exalted God of our fathers and our God, blessed art Thou.[^10916]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Having broken down the wall of impiety by your holy wounds, O all-praised ones: disperse the burden of my sins, and save him that cries, O Martyrs: Blessed is the God of our fathers.[^10917]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: With showers of your sacred blood ye quenched the fire of heresies, and with the flame, O all-wise Hierarchs, ye burned up the tares of impiety's deceit, and enlightened the souls of the faithful.[^10918]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Ascetics, Prophets, and Holy Women):*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Ascetics, having mortified the flesh by temperance, live after death; the righteous choir of prophets and the company of women that suffered martyrdom have been glorified. By their prayers, O Christ, deliver us from perils.[^10919]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Give rest, O Christ, unto the souls of all that have fallen asleep in hope of life, overlooking their sins committed in life, according to Thine abundant loving-kindness, O compassionate, only Savior, God of the fathers.[^10920]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Wholly pure, thou didst receive into thy womb the incarnate Word; pray Him, O Most Pure One, to cleanse me of transgressions, of soul...[^10921]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: ...and body, of him that flees unto thee with pure faith.[^10922]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Canon of the Departed. Ode 7. Heirmos:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: The Hebrew Children in the furnace boldly trampled upon the flame, and turned the fire into dew, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages.[^10923]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: All the desire of the martyrs was extended toward the one Master, being united unto Him with love, and singing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages.[^10924]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Thou Who grantest the splendor of the divine Kingdom unto them that have departed in faith, bestow the garment of incorruption upon them that cry: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages.[^10925]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Fill with joy and gladness Thy servants whom Thou hast translated, O Compassionate One, having vouchsafed them to cry unto Thee and sing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages.[^10926]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Loosing the curse of Eve, Thou didst dwell in the all-immaculate Virgin, pouring forth a fount of blessing unto them that cry: Blessed, O Most Pure One, is the fruit of thy womb.[^10927]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: The divinely-speaking Children in the furnace, trampling upon the flame with fire, sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord.[^10928]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Suffering, ye cast down the idol temples, and made yourselves divine temples of the Trinity, O passion-bearers of the Lord, companions of the Angels.[^10929]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Thy priests, O Christ, having clothed themselves holily with righteousness, now rejoice with them that are from the age, beholding Thy divine beauty most clearly.[^10930]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Prophets, Holy Women, and Righteous):*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: By the supplications of Thy most sacred Prophets, and of the ever-glorious women, and of the righteous from the age, grant Thy mercies unto Thy world, O Word.[^10931]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Refrain: We bless the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, the Lord.*[^10932]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: O Righteous Judge, when Thou desirest to judge those whom Thou hast received from us, preserve them uncondemned, overlooking their sins, O Master.[^10933]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Having appeared, O Virgin, drive away the darkest clouds of my soul with thine illumination, who didst give birth unto the Sun of Righteousness.[^10934]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Canon of the Departed. Ode 8. Heirmos:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: When the musical instruments sounded in harmony, and numberless peoples worshipped the image in Dura, the three Children, refusing to submit, sang hymns and doxologies unto the Lord unto all the ages.[^10935]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Having finished earthly struggles, the true martyrs received heavenly crowns, crying unto Thee unceasingly: Hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all the ages.[^10936]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Having descended into the nethermost pit, Thou didst resurrect them that dwell in the tombs with Thy life-originating palm, and didst grant rest, O Compassionate One, unto Thy servants who have fallen asleep before in faith.[^10937]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: As Thou art a fount of ever-existing life, as Thou art a stream of delight: vouchsafe Thy servants who have piously departed unto Thee to hymn and doxologize Thee unto all the ages.[^10938]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
