items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Mary, Virgin Theotokos, who didst bear God the Savior unto men in the flesh: save them that sing thy Nativity in faith, and supremely exalt it unto all the ages.[^10939]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Then: "My soul doth magnify the Lord:"*[^10940]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Thee, the Mother of the most high God without bridegroom, thee who didst bear God in truth by word beyond understanding, who art higher than the all-pure powers, with unceasing doxologies we magnify.[^10941]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: The martyrs stood before unjust judges, having condemned all unrighteousness by the grace of Christ: and delivering them that were held by them, and receiving the crowns of righteousness.[^10942]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Ye were shown forth as the helms of the Church, having piously directed the whole ship unto the haven of God's commandments, all ye blessed hierarchs and pastors: therefore as helmsmen we honor you.[^10943]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Prophets, Venerables, and Holy Women):*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: The assembly of Prophets and Venerables entreats Thee, O Lord; the company of women who suffered martyrdom most radiantly and who shone forth in ascetical discipline entreats Thee, O Lover of mankind: grant Thy compassions unto us.[^10944]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Of that honor and eternal glory wherewith all the saints of Christ have been vouchsafed: vouchsafe Thy servants who have faithfully departed from vain life to partake, O Merciful One, by the prayers of Thy saints.[^10945]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Carrying in thine embraces the fullness of good things, O All-Immaculate One, fulfill the supplications of us, thy servants: and direct our journeyings toward God, strengthening us to live virtuously.[^10946]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *Canon of the Departed. Ode 9. Heirmos:*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Every hearing was terrified at the ineffable condescension of God, that the Most High willingly came down even unto the flesh, having become man from the virginal womb; therefore the faithful magnify the all-pure Theotokos.[^10947]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Having an invincible and unconquerable strength, O martyrs of Christ, ye brought to nought the godless decree of the tyrants; and manifestly were ye vouchsafed the heavenly Kingdom, enlightened by Trinity-rays, O laudable ones.[^10948]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Bitter hades was destroyed when Thou didst destroy it, O Lover of mankind, and didst resurrect those who had been sleeping there from the age; but now also, as Thou art good, vouchsafe those who have departed unto Thee, O Compassionate One, of Thine unwaning light.[^10949]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Thou art wholly sweetness, O Savior; Thou art wholly desire and love truly insatiable; Thou art wholly ineffable beauty: be well pleased, therefore, that those who have departed unto Thee may delight in Thy comeliness, and vouchsafe them of Thy divine beauty.[^10950]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Save me, O Mother of God, who didst bear Christ my Savior, God and man, twofold in nature and in hypostasis: only-begotten indeed of the Father, and from thee the firstborn of all creation. Whom in twofold nature we magnify.[^10951]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *It is truly meet: Litany, and Exapostilarion, and customary psalms.*[^10952]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 8:*[^10953]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: What shall we call you, O holy ones? Cherubim? For upon you Christ rested. Seraphim? For unceasingly ye glorified Him. Angels? For ye turned away from bodies. Powers? For ye work miracles. Many are your names, and greater your gifts. Pray that our souls may be saved.[^10954]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Mightily did ye contend, O holy ones, having valiantly endured the torments of the lawless, and confessed Christ before kings; and having departed from life, ye work powers in the world, and heal the sick of their passions, O holy ones, praying that our souls may be saved.[^10955]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Invincible martyrs of Christ, having conquered deceit by the power of the Cross, ye delight in the grace of eternal life; ye feared not the threats of the tyrants, and being wounded by torments ye made merry...[^10956]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: ...and now your blood has become healings unto our souls. Pray that our souls may be saved.[^10957]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Having well clad yourselves in the breastplates of faith, and armed yourselves with the sign of the Cross, ye were shown forth as valiant warriors; ye manfully opposed the tyrants, and cast down the deceit of the devil; having become victors, ye were vouchsafed crowns. Pray ever for us, that we may be saved.[^10958]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Numberless torment is for them that live profligately: gnashing of teeth, and comfortless weeping, fiery Gehenna, and outer darkness, and the sleepless worm, useless tears, and the unmerciful Judge. Therefore before the end we cry, saying: O Master Christ, give rest with Thine elect unto those whom Thou hast chosen.[^10959]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: O pure Virgin, door of the Word, Mother of our God: pray that we may be saved.[^10960]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera for the Departed, Tone 8:*[^10961]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: A royal decree of freedom hast Thou signed for me, having reddened Thy fingers with scarlet ink, and stained them with Thine own blood, O Master; therefore in faith we entreat Thee: number with Thy firstborn, and vouchsafe to obtain the joy of Thy righteous ones, those who have passed over unto Thee, the Tenderhearted One.[^10963]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Having exercised the priesthood as man, and having been slain as a lamb, Thou didst offer Thyself an oblation unto the Father, taking man out from corruption. Do Thou therefore, as Lover of mankind, settle those who have departed in the land of the living, where the streams of delight pour forth, where the fountains of eternal life gush out.[^10965]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: By the depth of Thine ineffable wisdom Thou limitest life, and foreseest the future, and translatest Thy servants unto another life; those whom Thou hast received, therefore, settle beside the waters of rest, in the splendor of the saints, O Lord, where is the voice of rejoicing and praise.[^10967]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ю҆́ности прегрѣше́нїѧ презрѧ̀, и҆ грѣхѝ ѡ҆ставлѧ́ѧ Хрⷭтѐ Спа́се, пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшыѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑...
items.english_text: Being the invisible Word, co-originate with the Father, and...[^10969]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: зра́чный,* менѐ ра́ди человѣ́ка пло́тїю ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ; ꙗ҆́кѡ ми́лостивъ ᲂу҆́бѡ и҆ человѣколю́бецъ,* ꙗ҆̀же ѿ житїѧ̀ преше́дшїѧ,* благолѣ́пїа твоегѡ̀* и҆ красоты̀ добро́тами* тѣ́хъ просвѣтѝ, живонача́льнѣйшїй.
items.english_text: ...form, for my sake didst appear in the flesh as man; since therefore Thou art merciful and Lover of mankind, enlighten those who have passed over from this life with the beauties of Thy comeliness and loveliness, O most Life-Originating One.[^10970]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ заче́нши безнача́льное Сло́во Бг҃а О҆тца̀, ма́тернимъ твои́мъ дерзнове́нїемъ прилѣ́жнѡ молѝ, Бг҃ородителнице, ᲂу҆чини́ти рабы̑ твоѧ̑, и҆́деже ликова́нїе пра́ведныхъ непреста́нное, весела́щихсѧ и҆ хва́лѧщихъ тѧ̀; и҆́деже свѣ́тлость вѣчнꙋ́ющаѧ, и҆ сла́дкїй гла́съ пра́зднꙋющагѡ.
items.english_text: As thou didst conceive the unoriginate Word of God the Father, by thy maternal boldness diligently pray, O Theotokos, to establish thy servants where is the unceasing rejoicing of the righteous, who make merry and praise thee; where is the everlasting brightness and the sweet voice of them that keep festival.[^10971]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Поманѝ на́съ Хрⷭтѐ Сп҃се мі́ра, ꙗ҆́кѡже разбо́йника помѧнꙋ́лъ є҆сѝ на дре́вѣ; и҆ сподо́би всѣ́хъ, є҆ди́не Ще́дре, небе́сномꙋ ца́рствїю твоемꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *On Saturday, at the Liturgy, The Beatitudes, Tone 8:*[^10972]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ̑мъ болѣ́знемъ крѣ́пкѡ приѡбща́ющесѧ, ꙗ҆́звами ва́шими ст҃ы́ми страстоте́рпци, ᲂу҆ѧзви́сте всѧ̑ тмы̑ бѣсѡ́въ, бж҃твенною благода́тїю.
items.english_text: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, as Thou rememberedst the thief upon the tree; and vouchsafe us all, O only Compassionate One, of Thy heavenly Kingdom.[^10973]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Преподо́бнїи Хрⷭтѡ́ви и҆ бж҃е́ственнїи Ст҃и́телїе, собо́ръ Проро́ческїй, и҆ всѣ́хъ ст҃ы́хъ Пра́ведныхъ, небе́сное полꙋчи́ша наслѣ́дїе; и҆́хже по достоѧ́нїю да ᲂу҆блажи́мъ.
items.english_text: Firmly partaking of all afflictions, by your holy wounds, O passion-bearers, ye wounded all the dark hordes of demons by divine grace.[^10974]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ вѣ́рнѡ ѿ житїѧ̀ преста́вленыхъ, ᲂу҆чинѝ Бж҃е въ страна́хъ пра́ведныхъ; и҆ раѧ̀ покажѝ наслѣ́дники, бг҃олѣ́пнѡ пѣсносло́вѧщихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Hierarchs and Venerables):*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́нїе тебѣ̀ Трⷪце приношꙋ̀ коне́чное: и҆́хже ѿ землѝ преста́вила є҆сѝ въ вѣ́рѣ, Ст҃ы́хъ сподо́би селе́нїа, и҆ менѐ блꙋ́днаго поми́лꙋй.
items.english_text: The venerable of Christ and the divine hierarchs, the assembly of prophets, and all the holy righteous have obtained the heavenly inheritance; whom let us worthily call blessed.[^10975]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: All who in faith have departed from this life, establish, O God, in the lands of the righteous; and show forth as heirs of paradise those who in a manner befitting God sing praises unto Thee.[^10976]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: A final song I offer unto Thee, O Trinity: those whom Thou hast translated from the earth in faith, vouchsafe of the dwellings of the saints, and have mercy upon me, the prodigal.[^10977]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Having given birth to the fullness of all good things, fulfill our supplications, O Virgin: asking for us remission of offenses, and enlightenment, and great mercy.[^10978]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: *End of Tone 8.*[^10979]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: *Triadica of Gregory of Sinai, sung on all Sundays, after the Triadic Canon at the Midnight Office:*[^10980]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: It is meet in a manner befitting God to glorify Thee, O Holy Trinity, boundless and transcendent, and our all-good God, Whom all the earth-born praise, and the heavenly Hosts glorify; Who art in faith worshipped by all, a Monad in essence, three in hypostases.[^10981]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Master-Origin of the Cherubim, and Divine Origin beyond compare of the Seraphim, indivisible Trinity in Unity, the existing Divine Principality: we magnify Thee.[^10982]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Unto the unoriginate Father and God, unto the co-unoriginate Word with the Spirit, I bow down. The inseparable single united essence, the threefold Unity, let us honor with hymns.[^10983]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Let us all sing in a manner befitting God with divine hymns unto the Father, and the Son, and the divine Spirit: the three-hypostatic dominion, the one Kingdom and Lordship.[^10984]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Make Thy beam-radiant lightnings to shine upon me, O my God, three-hypostatic Creator of all; and show me forth as a house of Thine unapproachable glory, bright, light-bearing, and unchanging.[^10985]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Before Whom the Cherubim tremble and quake, and Whom the angelic hosts glorify: Christ the Giver of life, Who was ineffably incarnate of the Virgin, let us praise with fear.[^10986]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: It is meet in all reverent awe to pray unto Thee with tears, the All-Merciful and All-Compassionate One, and the Savior of our souls.[^10987]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Receive tears, O King; receive the weeping and lamentation of the wretched one; and deliver me from the flame and the outer darkness, and make me a partaker of the divine Kingdom.[^10988]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: O Father Almighty, Word of God, All-Holy Spirit: one power...[^10989]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: ...and form, one Kingdom and Godhead and dominion: have mercy and save those who worship Thee.[^10990]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Having seen thy Son resurrected from the dead in a manner befitting God, O all-pure Virgin, creation was filled with ineffable joy; glorifying Him, we magnify thee.[^10991]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet: Trisagion: after Our Father: the Hypakoe of the Tone, or the Troparia: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us: Then the litany, and the dismissal.*[^10992]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: *Troparia sung after the Blameless (Kathisma 17) on all Sundays, Tone 5:*[^10993]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: *Refrain: Blessed art Thou, O Lord, teach me Thy statutes. [Ps. 118:12]*[^10994]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: The angelic host was astonished, beholding Thee numbered among the dead, yet destroying the might of death, O Savior, and raising Adam with Thyself, and setting all free from hades.[^10995]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Why do ye mingle the myrrh with compassionate tears, O ye women disciples? The angel shining in the tomb said unto the myrrh-bearing women: See ye the tomb, and understand; for the Savior is risen from the tomb.[^10996]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Very early in the morning the myrrh-bearing women ran unto Thy tomb weeping; but the angel stood before them and said: The time of lamentation has ceased, weep not; but proclaim the Resurrection unto the Apostles.[^10997]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: The myrrh-bearing women, having come with myrrh unto Thy tomb, O Savior, lamented; but the angel spoke unto them, saying: Why think ye of the Living One with the dead? For as God He is risen from the tomb.[^10998]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Let us worship the Father, and His Son, and the Holy Spirit: the Holy Trinity in one essence, crying with the Seraphim: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O Lord.[^10999]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Having given birth unto the Giver of life, O Virgin, thou didst deliver Adam from sin; and joy instead of sorrow didst thou bestow upon Eve; and those fallen from life did He direct unto the same, the God and man Who was incarnate of thee.[^11000]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: *Alleluia, thrice. Glory to Thee, O God.*[^11001]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: *The Resurrectional Morning Gospels, with the Resurrectional Exapostilaria and Evangelical Stichera.*[^11002]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: *(The Morning Stichera are the work of Emperor Leo the Wise; and the Exapostilaria of his son, Emperor Constantine.)*[^11003]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Gospel 1. From Matthew, Pericope 116 [Matt. 28:16-20]:*[^11004]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: At that time, the eleven disciples went into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them. And when they saw Him, they worshipped Him; but some doubted. And Jesus came and spoke unto them, saying: All power is given unto Me in heaven and in earth. Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you; and lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the age. Amen.[^11005]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: With the disciples let us ascend the mountain of Galilee, in faith to behold Christ, saying that He has received authority over heavenly and earthly things; let us learn how He teaches to baptize all nations in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, and to abide with the initiates of His mysteries, as He promised, even unto the end of the age.[^11006]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: With the disciples thou didst rejoice, O Theotokos Virgin, for thou didst behold Christ risen from the tomb on the third day as He said; unto whom He also appeared, teaching and revealing better things, and commanding to baptize in the Father, and the Son, and the Spirit, so that we may believe in His rising, and glorify thee, O Maiden.[^11007]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: When the disciples went up into the mountain for the earthly ascension, the Lord stood before them; and having worshipped Him, and learned of the authority given Him everywhere, they were sent into all under heaven to preach the resurrection from the dead, and the ascension into heaven; with whom also the truthful Christ God, the Savior of our souls, promised to abide unto the ages.[^11008]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Gospel 2. From Mark, Pericope 70 [Mark 16:1-8]:*[^11009]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: At that time, when the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint Jesus. And very early in the morning, on...[^11010]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: ...the first day of the week, they came unto the tomb at the rising of the sun. And they said among themselves: Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the tomb? And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great. And entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted. And he says unto them: Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, Who was crucified: He is risen; He is not here: behold the place where they laid Him. But go your way, tell His disciples and Peter that He goes before you into Galilee: there shall ye see Him, as He said unto you. And they went out quickly, and fled from the tomb; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.[^11011]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Seeing the stone rolled away, the myrrh-bearing women rejoiced; for they saw a young man sitting in the tomb, and he said unto them: Behold, Christ is risen; say unto the disciples with Peter: hasten unto the mountain of Galilee, there shall He appear unto you, as He foretold unto His friends.[^11012]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: An angel indeed brought unto the Virgin the "Rejoice" before Thy conception, O Christ; and an angel rolled away the stone of Thy tomb: the former instead of sorrow bringing tokens of ineffable joy, and the latter instead of death proclaiming and magnifying the Giver of life, and speaking of the Resurrection unto the women and the initiates of the mysteries.[^11013]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Unto the women who came with Mary bringing myrrh, and were at a loss how they might obtain their desire, the stone appeared taken away, and a divine young man assuaged the turmoil of their souls: for Jesus the Lord is risen, says he; therefore preach ye unto His preachers, the disciples, to hasten unto Galilee, and to behold Him risen from the dead, as Giver of life and Lord.[^11014]

items.english_text: *Resurrectional Gospel 3. From Mark, Pericope 71 [Mark 16:9-20]:*[^11015]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: At that time, when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week,[^11016] He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom He had cast seven devils. And she went and told them that had been with Him, as they mourned and wept. And they, when they had heard that He was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not. After that He appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country. And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them. Afterward He appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen Him...[^11017]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: ...after He was risen. And He said unto them: Go ye into all the world, and preach the Gospel to every creature. He that believes and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believes not shall be condemned. And these signs shall follow them that believe: In My name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues; they shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover. So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, He was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God. And they went forth, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.[^11018]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Let no one disbelieve that Christ is risen; for He appeared unto Mary, and afterward was seen of two walking into the country; and again He appeared unto the eleven initiates of His mysteries as they sat at meat, whom having sent forth to baptize, He was received up into heaven, whence also He had descended, confirming the preaching by multitudes of signs.[^11019]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: The Sun that has shone forth this day from the tomb as a bridegroom from his chamber, having despoiled hades and abolished death: by the prayers of her that bare Thee, send down light upon us, light enlightening hearts and souls, light guiding all to walk in the paths of Thy commandments and in the way of peace.[^11020]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: When Mary Magdalene announced the Savior's resurrection from the dead and His appearance, the disbelieving disciples were upbraided for their hardness of heart; but being armed with signs and wonders, they were sent forth to preach. And Thou indeed, O Lord, didst ascend unto the Father, the primal Light; while they preached the word everywhere, confirming it by miracles. Therefore, being enlightened by them, we glorify Thy resurrection from the dead, O Lord and Lover of mankind.[^11021]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Gospel 4. From Luke, Pericope 112 [Luke 24:1-12]:*[^11022]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: At that time, on the first day of the week,[^11023] very early in the morning, the women came unto the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them. And they found the stone rolled away from the tomb. And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus. And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments: and as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them: Why seek ye the living among the dead? He is not here, but is risen...[^11024]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: ...remember how He spoke unto you when He was yet in Galilee, saying: The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again. And they remembered His words, and returned from the tomb, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest. It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the Apostles. And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not. Then arose Peter, and ran unto the tomb; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.[^11025]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Shining with virtues, let us behold the men in shining garments standing in the life-bearing tomb, while the myrrh-bearing women bowed their faces to the earth; let us learn of the Resurrection of the Ruler of the heavens, and run with Peter unto the tomb of life, and having marveled at that which was done, let us remain to see Christ.[^11026]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Saying "Rejoice," Thou didst turn the sorrow of the forebears into joy, O Lord, bringing the joy of Thy resurrection into the world; by her that bare Thee, O Giver of life, send down therefore light enlightening hearts, the light of Thy compassions, that we may cry unto Thee: O Lover of mankind, God-Man, glory to Thy resurrection.[^11027]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: It was very early in the morning, and the women came unto Thy tomb, O Christ; but the body was not found which they desired. Therefore as they were perplexed, those who stood by them in shining garments said: Why seek ye the living among the dead? He is risen, as He foretold; why remember ye not His words? And believing them, they proclaimed what they had seen; but their glad tidings seemed as idle tales: so dull of heart were the disciples still. But Peter ran, and having seen, glorified in himself Thy wonders.[^11028]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Gospel 5. From Luke, Pericope 113 [Luke 24:12-35]:*[^11029]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: At that time, Peter arose, and ran unto the tomb; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass. And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs. And they talked together of all these things which had happened. And it came to pass...[^11030]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: ...that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus Himself drew near, and went with them. But their eyes were holden that they should not know Him. And He said unto them: What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad? And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto Him: Art Thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days? And He said unto them: What things? And they said unto Him: Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered Him to be condemned to death, and have crucified Him. But we trusted that it had been He which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done. Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the tomb; and when they found not His body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that He was alive. And certain of them which were with us went to the tomb, and found it even so as the women had said: but Him they saw not. Then He said unto them: O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into His glory? And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, He expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning Himself. And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and He made as though He would have gone further. But they constrained Him, saying: Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And He went in to tarry with them. And it came to pass, as He sat at meat with them, He took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them. And their eyes were opened, and they knew Him; and He vanished out of their sight. And they said one to another: Did not our heart burn within us, while He talked with us by the way, and while He opened to us the scriptures? And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them, saying: The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon. And they told what things were done in the way, and how He was known of them in breaking of bread.[^11031]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Christ, the Life and the Way, having risen from the dead, journeyed with Cleopas and Luke, unto whom also He was made known in Emmaus in the breaking of bread; whose souls and hearts were burning when He talked with them by the way, and expounded the scriptures concerning that which He endured. With them let us cry: He is risen, and has appeared also unto Peter.[^11032]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: I sing of Thine unnumbered mercy, O my Creator, for Thou didst empty Thyself to bear and save afflicted human nature; and being God, Thou wast pleased to become as I am from the pure Maiden of God, and to descend even unto hades, willing that I should be saved, through the prayers of her that bare Thee, O All-Compassionate Master.[^11033]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: O how all-wise are Thy judgments, O Christ! How unto Peter indeed by the winding-sheets alone didst Thou grant to understand Thy resurrection? And journeying with Luke and Cleopas, Thou didst converse; and conversing, didst not immediately reveal Thyself? Therefore also Thou wast reproached as being the only stranger in Jerusalem who took no part in their counsel unto the end. But Thou Who dispensest all things for the benefit of creation didst also open the prophecies concerning Thyself, and in the blessing of the bread Thou wast recognized by them; whose hearts even before that burned unto the knowledge of Thee, who also unto the assembled disciples now clearly preached Thy resurrection; through whom have mercy upon us.[^11034]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Gospel 6. From Luke, Pericope 114 [Luke 24:36-53]:*[^11035]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: At that time, Jesus having risen from the dead stood in the midst of His disciples, and says unto them: Peace be unto you. But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit. And He said unto them: Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts? Behold My hands and My feet, that it is I Myself: handle Me, and see; for a spirit has not flesh and bones, as ye see Me have. And when He had thus spoken, He showed them His hands and His feet. And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, He said unto them: Have ye here any meat? And they gave Him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb. And He took it, and did eat before them. And He said unto them: These are the words which I spoke unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning Me. Then opened He their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures, and said unto them: Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in His name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem. And ye are witnesses of these things. And, behold, I send the promise of My Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high. And He led them out as far as to Bethany, and He lifted up His hands, and blessed them. And it came to pass, while He blessed them, He was parted from them, and carried up into heaven. And they worshipped Him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.[^11036]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Showing that Thou art man in essence, O Savior, having risen from the tomb Thou didst partake of food, and standing in the midst didst teach to preach repentance; immediately...[^11037]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: ...also Thou wast taken up unto the heavenly Father, and didst promise to send the Comforter unto the disciples, O Most-Divine God-Man: glory to Thy resurrection.[^11038]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: The Creator of creation, and God of all, took human flesh from thy most pure blood, O all-holy Virgin, and remade all my corrupted nature, leaving thee after childbearing again even as thou wast before childbearing. Therefore we all in faith praise thee, crying: Rejoice, Sovereign Lady of the world.[^11039]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Thou art the true Peace, O Christ; giving Thy divine peace unto men, after Thy rising unto the disciples, Thou didst show them affrighted, supposing they saw a spirit; but Thou didst calm the turmoil of their souls, showing Thy hands and Thy feet. Yet while they still disbelieved, by partaking of food, and by reminding them of Thy teachings, Thou didst open their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures: unto whom having also promised the Father's promise, and having blessed them, Thou wast parted unto heaven. Therefore with them we worship Thee: O Lord, glory to Thee.[^11040]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: At that time, on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene comes early, when it was yet dark, unto the tomb, and sees the stone taken away from the tomb. Then she runs, and comes to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and says unto them: They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we know not where they have laid Him. Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the tomb. So they ran both together: and the other disciple outran Peter, and came first to the tomb. And stooping down, he saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in. Then came Simon Peter following him, and entered into the tomb, and saw the linen clothes lie, and the napkin, that was about His head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself. Then entered also that other disciple, who came first to the tomb, and he saw, and believed. For as yet they knew not the scripture, that He must rise again from the dead. Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.[^11042]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ и҆сполне́нїе ро́ждши, и҆спо́лни на́ша Дѣ́во моле́нїѧ: согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїа просѧ́щи, и҆ просвѣще́нїа, и҆ ве́лїѧ ми́лости.
items.english_text: Mary having said that they had taken away the Lord, Simon Peter and the other initiate of Christ's mysteries whom He loved ran unto the tomb; and they ran both together, and found the linen clothes...[^11043]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: ны внутрь лежа́ща, и҆ гла́вный же бѣ̀ суда́рь кромѣ̀ и҆́хъ. Тѣ́мже па́ки оу҆молча́ста, до́ндеже Хрⷭ҇та̀ ви́дѣста.
items.english_text: ...lying within, and the napkin that was about His head apart from them. Therefore again they held their peace, until they beheld Christ.[^11044]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Ве́лїа и҆ пресла́внаѧ менѐ ра́ди содѣ́лалъ є҆сѝ, Хрⷭ҇тѐ мо́й многоми́лостиве: ѿ Дв҃ы бо О҆трокови́цы роди́лсѧ є҆сѝ несказа́ннѡ, и҆ кре́стъ пода́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ сме́рть претерпѣ́вый, воскре́слъ є҆сѝ въ сла́вѣ, и҆ на́ше є҆стество̀ ѿ сме́рти свободи́лъ є҆сѝ. Сла́ва Хрⷭ҇тѐ сла́вѣ твое́й, сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й.
items.english_text: Great and most glorious things hast Thou wrought for my sake, O my Christ Many-merciful: for of the Virgin Maiden Thou wast born ineffably, and didst submit unto the Cross, and having endured death, Thou didst rise in glory, and set our nature free from death. Glory, O Christ, to Thy glory; glory to Thy power.[^11045]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Сѐ тьма̀, и҆ ра́нѡ; и҆ что̀ оу҆ гро́ба Марїе стои́ши, мно́гую тьмꙋ̀ и҆мѣ́ющи въ ра́зумѣ? въ не́йже гдѣ̀ положе́нъ бы́сть вопроша́еши, І҆и҃съ; но ви́ждь сри́щущыѧсѧ Оу҆ченикѝ, ка́кѡ плащани́цами и҆ сꙋдаре́мъ воскресе́нїе ѡ҆брѣто́ша, и҆ помянꙋ́ша ꙗ҆̀же ѡ҆ си́хъ писа̑нїа. Съ ни́миже и҆ и҆́миже и҆ мы̀ вѣ́ровавше, воспѣва́емъ тѧ̀ жизнода́вца Хрⷭ҇та̀.
items.english_text: Lo, it is dark and early morning; and why, O Mary, standest thou at the tomb, having much darkness in thy mind? in which thou inquirest where Jesus is laid; but behold the disciples running together, how by the linen clothes and the napkin they discovered the Resurrection, and remembered the scriptures concerning these things. With whom and through whom we also having believed, sing praises unto Thee, Christ the Giver of life.[^11046]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Єѵ҃лїе воскрⷭ҇но и҃. ѿ І҆ѡа́нна зача́ло ѯ҃д.
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Gospel 8. From John, Pericope 64 [John 20:11-18]:*[^11047]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Во вре́мѧ ѻ҆́но, Марїа стоѧ́ше оу҆ гро́ба внѣ̀ пла́чꙋщи; ꙗ҆́коже пла́кашесѧ, прини́че въ гро́бъ, и҆ ви́дѣ два̀ А҆́гг҃ла въ бѣ́лыхъ ри́захъ, сѣдѧ́ща, є҆ди́наго оу҆ главы̀, и҆ є҆ди́наго оу҆ ногꙋ̀, и҆́дѣже бѣ̀ лежа́ло тѣ́ло І҆и҃сово. И҆ гл҃аста є҆́й ѻ҆́на: же́но, что̀ пла́чеши? Глагѡ́ла и҆́ма: ꙗ҆́ко вза́ша Гдⷭ҇а моегѡ̀, и҆ не вѣ́мь, гдѣ̀ положи́ша є҆го̀. И҆ сїа̑ ре́кши, ѡ҆брати́сѧ вспѧ́ть, и҆ ви́дѣ І҆и҃са стоѧ́ща; и҆ не вѣ́даше, ꙗ҆́ко І҆и҃съ є҆́сть. Гл҃го́ла є҆́й І҆и҃съ: же́но, что̀ пла́чеши? когѡ̀ и҆́щеши! О҆на́ же мнѧ́щи, ꙗ҆́ко вертогра́дарь є҆́сть, гл҃го́ла є҆мꙋ̀: Гдⷭ҇и, а҆́ще ты̀ є҆сѝ взѧ́лъ є҆го̀, повѣ́ждь мѝ, гдѣ̀ є҆сѝ положи́лъ є҆го̀, и҆ а҆́зъ возмꙋ̀ є҆го̀. Гл҃го́ла є҆́й І҆и҃съ: Марїе? О҆на́ же ѡ҆бра́щшисѧ глаго́ла є҆мꙋ̀: раввꙋнѝ, є҆́же глаго́летсѧ, оу҆чи́телю! Гл҃а є҆́й І҆и҃съ: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀, не оу҆́ бо взыдо́хъ ко О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ моемꙋ̀; и҆ди́ же ко бра́тїи мое́й, и҆ рцы̀ и҆̀мъ: восхождꙋ̀ ко О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ моемꙋ̀ и҆ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ва́шемꙋ, и҆ Бг҃ꙋ моемꙋ̀ и҆ Бг҃ꙋ ва́шемꙋ. Прїи́де же Марїа Магдали́на повѣ́дающи оу҆чн҃кѡ́мъ, ꙗ҆́ко ви́дѣ Гдⷭ҇а, и҆ сїа̑ речѐ є҆́й.
items.english_text: At that time, Mary stood without at the tomb weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the tomb, and sees two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain. And they say unto her: Woman, why weepest thou? She says unto them: Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid Him. And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus. Jesus says unto her: Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing Him to be the gardener, says unto Him: Sir, if Thou have borne Him hence, tell me where Thou hast laid Him, and I will take Him away. Jesus says unto her: Mary. She turned herself, and says unto Him: Rabboni; which is to say, Master. Jesus says unto her: Touch Me not; for I am not yet ascended to My Father: but go to My brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto My Father, and your Father; and to My God, and your God. Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that He had spoken these things unto her.[^11048]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: Having seen two angels within the tomb, Mary was amazed, and not knowing Christ, as of a gardener she inquired: Sir, where hast Thou laid the Body of my Jesus? But recognizing Him by His calling her to be the Savior Himself, she heard: Touch Me not; I depart unto the Father, say thou unto My brethren.[^11049]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: One of the Trinity hast thou borne, O Maiden, ineffably being in two natures, and twofold in operation, and one in hypostasis. Him therefore pray thou ever, for them that worship in faith, to be delivered from every assault of the enemy; for we all now flee unto thee, O Sovereign Lady Theotokos.[^11050]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: Mary's tears are not shed warmly in vain: for lo, she was vouchsafed both the teaching Angels, and the sight of Jesus Himself; yet she still minded earthly things, as a weak woman; therefore also she is sent away not to touch Christ, but yet is sent as a herald unto Thy disciples, unto whom she declared the glad tidings, proclaiming the ascent unto the Father's portion. With her vouchsafe us also of Thine appearance, O Master Lord.[^11051]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Gospel 9. From John, Pericope 65 [John 20:19-31]:*[^11052]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week,[^11053] when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and says unto them: Peace be unto you. And when He had so said, He showed unto them His hands and His feet and His side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord. Then said Jesus to them again: Peace be unto you: as My Father has sent Me, even so send I you. And when He had said this, He breathed on them, and says unto them: Receive ye the Holy Spirit: whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained. But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came. The other disciples therefore said unto him: We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them: Except I shall see in His hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into His side, I will not believe. And after eight days again His disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said: Peace be unto you. Then says He to Thomas: Reach hither thy finger, and behold My hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into My side: and be not faithless, but believing. And Thomas answered and said unto Him: My Lord and my God. Jesus says unto him: Thomas, because thou hast seen Me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed. And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book: but these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through His name.[^11054]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: The doors being shut, O Master, when Thou didst enter in, Thou didst fill the Apostles with the All-Holy Spirit, having peacefully breathed upon them, unto whom Thou didst say to bind and loose sins; and after eight days Thou didst show Thy side and hands unto Thomas. With whom we cry: Thou art Lord and God.[^11055]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: When thou didst behold thy Son risen on the third day from the tomb, O Bride of God, all-holy Virgin, thou didst put away all the sorrow which thou didst endure as a Mother when thou beheldest Him suffering; and filled with joy, with His disciples thou praisest and singest unto Him. Therefore save those who now confess thee to be the Theotokos.[^11056]

items.english_text: As in the latter years, at evening on the first day of the week, Thou didst stand before Thy friends, O Christ; and by wonder Thou didst confirm wonder: by the shut entrance of the doors, Thy resurrection from the dead. But Thou didst fill the disciples with joy, and didst impart unto them the Holy Spirit, and didst bestow authority to remit sins; and Thou didst not leave Thomas to be drowned in the tempest of unbelief. Therefore grant unto us also true understanding and remission of transgressions, O Tenderhearted Lord.[^11057]

items.english_text: At that time, Jesus showed Himself again to the disciples (having risen from the dead), at the Sea of Tiberias; and on this wise showed He Himself. There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of His disciples. Simon Peter says unto them: I go a fishing. They say unto him: We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing. But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus. Then Jesus says unto them: Children, have ye any meat? They answered Him: No. And He said unto them: Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes. Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved says unto Peter: It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea. And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.[^11059]

items.english_text: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread. Jesus says unto them: Bring of the fish which ye have now caught. Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken. Jesus says unto them: Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask Him: Who art Thou? knowing that it was the Lord. Jesus then comes, and takes bread, and gives them, and fish likewise. This is now the third time that Jesus showed Himself to His disciples, after that He was risen from the dead.[^11060]

items.english_text: The Sea of Tiberias of old had Nathanael with Peter, together with the children of Zebedee, and two others, and Thomas, at fishing: who, having cast on the right side at Christ's command, drew out a multitude of fishes; Whom Peter having recognized, swam unto Him; unto whom He appeared for the third time, and showed bread, and fish upon coals.[^11061]

items.english_text: Pray the Lord Who rose on the third day from the tomb, O Virgin, for them that sing of thee and with love call thee blessed; for we all have thee as a saving refuge and an intercessor before Him; for we are thy heritage and servants, O Theotokos, and unto thy protection we all look.[^11062]

items.english_text: After Thy descent into hades and Thy resurrection from the dead, grieving as was meet over Thy parting, O Christ, the disciples turned unto work, and again there were ships and nets, and catch nowhere; but Thou, O Savior, having appeared as Master of all, dost command to cast the nets on the right side. And the word was deed straightway, and the multitude of fishes was great, and a strange supper was prepared upon the land; of which when Thy disciples then partook, vouchsafe us also now spiritually to delight therein, O Lover of mankind.[^11063]

items.english_text: At that time, Jesus showed Himself unto His disciples, having risen from the dead, and says to Simon Peter: Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou Me more than these? He says unto Him: Yea, Lord; Thou knowest that I love Thee. He says unto him: Feed My lambs. He says to him again the second time: Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou Me? He says unto Him: Yea, Lord; Thou knowest that...[^11065]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: ...I love Thee. He says unto him: Feed My sheep. He says unto him the third time: Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou Me? Peter was grieved because He said unto him the third time: Lovest thou Me? And he said unto Him: Lord, Thou knowest all things; Thou knowest that I love Thee. Jesus says unto him: Feed My sheep. Truly, truly, I say unto thee: When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not. This spoke He, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when He had spoken this, He says unto him: Follow Me. Then Peter, turning about, sees the disciple whom Jesus loved following; who also leaned on His breast at supper, and said: Lord, who is he that betrays Thee? Peter seeing him says to Jesus: Lord, and what shall this man do? Jesus says unto him: If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou Me. Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? This is the disciple who testifies of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true. And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.[^11066]

items.english_text: After His divine rising, the Lord, having thrice asked Peter: Lovest thou Me? appointed him chief shepherd of His sheep; who seeing him whom Jesus loved following after, asked the Master: And what of this man? If I will, He said, that he remain until I come again, what is that to thee, friend Peter?[^11067]

items.english_text: O fearful mystery! O most glorious wonder! By death, death has been utterly destroyed. Who therefore will not praise, and who will not worship Thy resurrection, O Word, and the Theotokos who purely bare Thee in the flesh? By whose prayers deliver all from Gehenna.[^11068]

items.english_text: Manifesting Thyself unto Thy disciples after the Resurrection, O Savior, Thou gavest unto Simon the pasturing of sheep, as a reward of love, seeking the care of pasturing; therefore also Thou saidst: If thou lovest Me, Peter, feed My lambs, feed My sheep. And he straightway showing friendliness, asked concerning the other disciple. By their prayers, O Christ, preserve Thy flock from the wolves that destroy it.[^11069]

items.english_text: Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos: for through Him Who was incarnate of thee, hades was taken captive, Adam was recalled, the curse was annulled, Eve was set free, death was put to death, and we were made alive. Therefore singing praises we cry aloud: Blessed is Christ our God, Who was thus well-pleased; glory to Thee.[^11071]

items.english_text: Today salvation is come unto the world; let us sing unto Him Who rose from the tomb, the Author of our life; for having destroyed death by death, He has given us the victory and great mercy.[^11073]

items.english_text: Having risen from the tomb, and burst the bonds of hades, Thou didst loose the condemnation of death, O Lord, delivering all from the snares of the enemy; manifesting Thyself unto Thine Apostles, Thou didst send them forth unto the preaching, and through them didst grant Thy peace unto the universe, O only Many-merciful One.[^11074]

items.english_text: *Exapostilaria, that is, Daily Photagogica for the Whole Week.*[^11075]

items.english_text: Archangels and Angels, Principalities and Dominions, Powers and Authorities, Thrones and many-eyed Cherubim, and six-winged Seraphim: pray for us, that we may be delivered from perils and the unquenchable fire.[^11076]

items.english_text: Thou Who didst adorn heaven with stars as God, and by Thine Angels didst enlighten all the earth, O Creator of all: save them that sing praises unto Thee.[^11077]

items.english_text: Thou art my protectress, O Most Pure One, and a strong rampart, and intercessor for the world; and unto thee...[^11078]

items.english_text: ...I fall down crying: deliver me from cruel things, and snatch me from eternal fire, O Virgin, who place my hope in thee.[^11079]

items.english_text: O most glorious prophet and forerunner of grace, who didst preach the repentance of salvation unto all, and show forth the Lamb that takes away the sins of the world, O blessed one: pray Him even now to have mercy upon the world.[^11080]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]

items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: John the Forerunner and Baptist of the Savior, prophet among prophets, nursling of the desert, and offspring of Elizabeth, let us all praise.[^11081]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: Thee did all the prophets foretell, O Virgin; David called thee mountain, and ark, and lampstand, and ladder, and bridge, and urn bearing manna, and budded rod. And we honor thee worthily as the Theotokos.[^11082]

items.english_text: An invincible weapon and confirmation of faith, the divine Cross do we hymn, and worship in faith: great refuge, boast of Christians, guardian of the Orthodox, glory of passion-bearers, worthily do we praise thee.[^11083]

items.english_text: The Cross is the guardian of the whole universe, the Cross is the beauty of the Church, the Cross is the might of kings, the Cross is the glory of Angels and the wounding of demons.[^11084]

items.english_text: Standing by the Cross, the Most Pure One, and seeing her Son crucified upon the Tree lifeless, lamented, crying out as a mother with tears, and saying: What is this most glorious thing? that the Creator of creation submits to be nailed upon the Cross?[^11085]

items.english_text: Peter and Paul let us all, Andrew, James, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James, Philip, Thomas, and Simon, Luke, and John, and Mark: the Apostles of the Lord let us faithfully praise.[^11086]

items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)

items.english_text: Having run into all under the sun, ye truly preached Christ's holy incarnation from the Virgin, from...[^11087]

items.english_text: ...delusion turning the nations, and enlightening them, and teaching all to venerate the Holy Trinity, O Apostles of the Savior.[^11088]

items.english_text: *Tone 3, Podoben: "Thou Who didst adorn heaven with stars" (Не́бо ѕвѣзда́ми):*
