items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: O holy Twelve, glory of the Apostles: with honorable Nicholas and the Hierarch of Myra, unceasingly pray the Savior for us.[^11089]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: O Virgin unwedded, unceasingly pray Christ with the wise Apostles, and with the multitude of Martyrs, and with wise Nicholas: that they who place their hope in thee may be delivered from every peril, O Maiden.[^11090]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: Rejoice, O most holy Cross, unconquerable rampart of the world, refuge of the sorrowing, and guardian of them that are in distress: victory of kings, protection of warriors, and conquest of barbarians, crown of the Apostles, and salvation of the faithful.[^11091]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: The Cross is the guardian of the whole [universe]: (see Wednesday).[^11092]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: Beholding Thee nailed upon the Cross, the Most Pure One, weeping and lamenting, cried out: How hast Thou set, O Sun of glory, O Pre-eternal Light? How art Thou nailed upon the Cross, and pierced in the side with a spear, O my Son and my God, for the sake of human salvation?[^11093]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]

items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: From the bed and sleep Thou hast raised me up, O Lord: enlighten my mind and heart, and open Thou my lips, that I may sing of Thee, O Holy Trinity: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: through the Theotokos have mercy upon us.[^11111]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: O Trinity consubstantial and undivided, Monad three-hypostatic and co-eternal: unto Thee as God we cry the angelic song: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God:[^11113]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: The unoriginate Father, the co-unoriginate Son, the co-eternal Spirit, one Godhead: daring with the Cherubim to glorify, we say: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God: through the prayers of all Thy Saints have mercy upon us.[^11114]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: Suddenly the Judge shall come, and each one's deeds shall be laid bare; but with fear let us cry at midnight: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God: through the Theotokos have mercy upon us.[^11115]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: Daring, as mortals, to offer the hymn of Thy spiritual servants, we say: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God:[^11116]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Два̀ А҆́гг҃ла ви́дѣвши вну́трь гро́ба, Марїа оу҆дивла́шесѧ, и҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ не зна́ющи, ꙗ҆́кѡ вертогра́дара вопроша́ше: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Тѣ́ло І҆и҃са моегѡ̀? зва́нїемъ же того̀ позна́вши бы́ти самого̀ Спа́са, слы́ша: не прикаса́йсѧ мнѣ̀; къ О҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й.
items.english_text: As the Angelic ranks now in heaven, and the companies of men with fear upon earth, we offer the song of victory unto Thee, O Good One: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God: through the prayers of all Thy Saints have mercy upon us.[^11117]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Безнача́лнагѡ твоегѡ̀ О҆тца̀, и҆ тебѐ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, и҆ преста́го твоегѡ̀ Дх҃а, херуві́мски славосло́вити дерза́юще глаго́лемъ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ Бж҃е на́шъ, Бцⷣею поми́луй на́съ.
items.english_text: Daring to hymn with the Cherubim Thine unoriginate Father, and Thee, O Christ God, and Thy Most-holy Spirit, we say: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God: through the Theotokos have mercy upon us.[^11118]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́нїю вре́ма, и҆ моли́твѣ ча́съ, прилѣ́жнѡ возопїи́мъ є҆ди́номꙋ Бг҃ꙋ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ Бж҃е на́шъ:

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆бразова́ти дерза́юще оу҆́мнаѧ твоѧ̑ вѡ́инства, Трⷪ҇це безнача́лнаѧ, оу҆сты̑ недосто́йными вопїе́мъ тѝ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ Бж҃е на́шъ, моли́твами всѣ́хъ Ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: It is the time for singing, and the hour for prayer: let us diligently cry aloud unto the one God: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God:[^11120]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ ложесна̀ Дѣви́ческаѧ вмѣсти́выйсѧ, и҆ нѣ́дръ Ѻ҆́ческихъ не разлꙋчи́выйсѧ, со А҆́гг҃лы и҆ на́съ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е прїимѝ, вопїю́щихъ тѝ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ Бж҃е на́шъ, Бцⷣею поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: Daring to form the likeness of Thy spiritual armies, O unoriginate Trinity, with unworthy lips we cry unto Thee: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God: through the prayers of all Thy Saints have mercy upon us.[^11121]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Предстоѧ́ще со стра́хомъ херꙋві́ми, оу҆жаса́ющесѧ съ тре́петомъ серафі́ми, трист҃ꙋ́ю пѣ́снь прино́сѧтъ немо́лчнымъ гла́сомъ; съ ни́миже и҆ мы̀ вопїе́мъ грѣ́шніи: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ Бж҃е на́шъ:
items.english_text: Thou Who wast contained in the virginal womb, and yet wast not separated from the Father’s bosom, receive us also with the Angels, O Christ God, as we cry unto Thee: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God: through the Theotokos have mercy upon us.[^11122]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Безпло́тными оу҆сты̀, немо́лчными славосло́вленми, шестокрила́тїи вопїю́тъ тѝ трист҃ꙋ́ю пѣ́снь, Бж҃е на́шъ; и҆ мы̀ и҆́же на землѝ недосто́йными оу҆сты̀, хвалꙋ̀ тѝ возсыла́емъ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ Бж҃е на́шъ, моли́твами всѣ́хъ Ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: The Cherubim standing before Thee with fear, and the Seraphim dreading with trembling, offer the thrice-holy hymn with unceasing voice; with them also we sinners cry aloud: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God:[^11123]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Тро́йчныѧ є҆ди́ницы Бж҃тво̀, неслїѧ́ннымъ соединенї́емъ сла́вимъ, и҆ а҆́гг҃лскꙋю пѣ́снь вопїе́мъ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ Бж҃е на́шъ, Бцⷣею поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: With bodiless lips and unceasing glorifications, the six-winged ones cry unto Thee the thrice-holy hymn, O our God; and we who are upon earth with unworthy lips send up praise unto Thee: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God: through the prayers of all Thy Saints have mercy upon us.[^11124]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: We glorify the Godhead of the Trinity in Unity with unconfused union, and we cry aloud the angelic song: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God: through the Theotokos have mercy upon us.[^11125]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: Hymned with the Cherubim by the power on high, and worshipped with the Angels in divine glory, receive us also who are upon earth, with un-[^11126]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: -worthy lips sending up praises unto Thee: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God:[^11127]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: Having cast off sloth as sleep, O my soul, show forth amendment for praising the Judge, and with fear cry aloud: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God: through the prayers of all Thy Saints have mercy upon us.[^11128]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: Sending up Seraphic thrice-holy praise unto the unapproachable Godhead in the Trinity in Unity, with fear let us cry aloud: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God: through the Theotokos have mercy upon us.[^11129]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: Having our hearts on high, let us imitate the Angelic order, and with fear let us fall down before the Judge, crying aloud the song of victory: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God:[^11130]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: The Cherubim daring not to gaze upon Thee, flying, cry with shouting the divine song of thrice-holy voice; with them also we sinners cry unto Thee: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, our God: through the prayers of all Thy Saints have mercy upon us.[^11131]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: Bowed down by the multitude of our transgressions, and daring not to look up unto the height of heaven, having bent down soul and body, with the Angels we cry a song unto Thee: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: through the Theotokos have mercy upon us.[^11132]

items.english_text: *Daily Photagogica [Exapostilaria],*[^11133]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: *which we sing in the Holy Great Fast [Forty Days], or when there is Alleluia, in the occurring Tone of the Octoechos, thrice each.*[^11134]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: Thou Who didst cause light to shine forth, O Lord, cleanse my soul from every sin (—) and save me.[^11135]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: *Where the mark (—) is placed, say:*[^11136]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]

items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: *On Monday, indeed: By the intercession, O Lord, of Thy Bodiless Powers,*[^11137]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: *On Tuesday: Through the prayers, O Lord, of Thy Forerunner,*[^11138]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: *On Wednesday and Friday: By the power, O Lord, of Thy Cross,*[^11139]

items.english_text: *how the Octoechos is sung with the Menaion.*[^11162]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: It is meet to know: if a Saint having a vigil occurs on Sunday: at Great Vespers on Saturday, Resurrection Stichera 6, Anatolian 1, and to the Saint 6; Glory: to the Saint; Both now: Theotokion of the Tone. In like manner it is sung on forefeasts and afterfeasts with a Saint, or when two Saints occur. At the Aposticha we always sing the Resurrectional Stichera, except for the Temple. Glory: to the Saint; Both now: Theotokion in the same Tone. On Sunday at Matins, after the Kathismata, Resurrection Sessional Hymns, Polyeleos to the Saint, and his Sessional Hymns all in order, except the Theotokia, only after Glory: Both now: Theotokion. Graduals of the Tone. Sunday Gospel, except for the Temple. Resurrection Canon with Heirmos to 4, of the Theotokos to 2, and to the Saint to 8. Thus it is sung if two Saints occur, or a forefeast or afterfeast with a Saint. But if a Saint is celebrated to 6: the Cross-Resurrection Canon is omitted, and we sing the Resurrection Canon to 4, of the Theotokos to 2, and to the Saint to 8. But if a Saint is celebrated to 4: the Resurrection Canon with Heirmos is sung to 4, the Cross-Resurrection to 3, of the Theotokos to 3, and in the Menaion to 4. The Resurrection Kontakion after Ode 6 always takes precedence, except for a feast and the Temple. The rest as indicated in the Typikon.[^11163]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: On Sunday evening we say as indicated in the Octoechos, only at "Lord, I have cried": Stichera in the Octoechos 3, then to the Saint 3; Glory: to the Saint, if there is one; Both now: Theotokion. If not: Glory: Both now: Theotokion. Then the Prokeimenon of the day, and the rest. At the Aposticha in the Octoechos, Glory: to the Saint, if there is one; Both now: Theotokion. If not: Glory: Both now: Theotokion. If to the Saint in the Typikon to 6: then in the Octoechos the evening Stichera are omitted, and we sing Stichera to the Saint to 6; Glory: to the Saint, if there is one; Both now: Theotokion. If not: Glory: Both now: Theotokion. But if it be for two Saints, and each has their own Stichera, likewise we say to them 3 Stichera each, and we say Glory likewise if there be one for either Saint; Both now: Theotokion. If not, then we say Glory: Both now: Theotokion. After "Now lettest Thou depart" and after the Trisagion, we say the Troparion to the Saint; Glory: Both now: Daily Theotokion according to the Tone of the Troparion. If there are two Saints and they have two Troparia: we say the Troparion to the Saint; Glory: Troparion to the other Saint; Both now: Theotokion of the lesser, according to the Tone of the other Troparion.[^11164]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: If there be a forefeast or an afterfeast: at "Lord, I have cried": Stichera of the feast 3, and to the Saint 3; Glory: to the Saint, if there is one; Both now: of the feast. If not, then we say Glory: Both now: of the feast. At the Aposticha, of the feast; Glory: to the Saint, if there is one; Both now: of the feast. If not, then we say Glory: Both now: of the feast. After "Now lettest Thou depart" and after the Trisagion, we say the Troparion to the Saint, if there is one; Glory: Both now: of the feast. If not, then we say one Troparion of the feast; and the rest as usual, and the Dismissal. If there be a forefeast or afterfeast and of a Saint who has a Polyeleos or Vigil: we sing evening and morning and at the Liturgy as indicated in the Typikon in order. Compline we sing according to the custom. After "It is truly meet" and after the Trisagion, we say the Troparion of the Temple. If it be the Temple of a Saint, we-[^11165]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: -say the Troparion of the day, and thereafter of the Temple of the Saint; then the general Troparion: "O God of our fathers"; thereafter: "Thou Who in all the world"; then Glory: "With the Saints give rest"; Both now: Theotokion: "Through the prayers, O Lord, of all the Saints." If it be a Temple of Christ, on Tuesday at Compline, likewise also on Thursday, we do not say the Troparion of the Temple during the entire year, because the Troparion of the day is said: "Save, O Lord, Thy people"; thereafter to the Temple of the Theotokos or of the Saint, then the general ones, as was also indicated before. Thus we say on the other days also, except Saturdays and Sundays, and forefeasts and afterfeasts. If it occur for a Saint with a Polyeleos, then after the Trisagion we say the Kontakion to the Saint, but the daily Troparia and to the Temple which were indicated, we then do not say. If there be a forefeast or afterfeast, then after the Trisagion we say the Kontakion of the feast alone. If it be for a Saint with a Polyeleos or with a Vigil, after the Trisagion we say the Kontakion to the Saint; Glory: Both now: Kontakion of the feast, and the rest as usual, even unto the Dismissal.[^11166]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: Midnight Office we sing according to the custom, as indicated in the Typikon; only if there be a Master’s [Dominical] Feast, or a Feast of the Theotokos—which Feasts of the Theotokos are numbered among the Master's Feasts—then at the Midnight Office after the first Trisagion, instead of "Behold, the Bridegroom comes," we say the Troparion of the feast alone; and after the second Trisagion we say the Kontakion of the feast alone, and thereafter "Lord, have mercy," 12 times, and the Dismissal; but the prayers "Remember, O Lord, in hope" on those feasts we do not say. On Lazarus Saturday, and on Mid-Pentecost, and on the morrow of Pentecost, and on the morrow of the Nativity of Christ at the Synaxis of the Theotokos, and on the morrow of Theophany at the Synaxis of John the Forerunner, we say likewise at the Midnight Office. And at the Apodosis of Pascha, at the Midnight Office we say: after the first Trisagion, instead of "Behold, the Bridegroom comes," the Resurrection Troparion: "The Word co-unoriginate"; Glory: Both now: its Theotokion. After the second Trisagion, instead of "Remember, O Lord, as Thou art good," we say the Kontakion of Pascha: "Though Thou didst descend into the tomb"; thereafter, "Lord, have mercy," 12 times, and the Dismissal; but the prayers "Remember, O Lord" we do not say. If it occur for the Temple of a Saint: instead of "Behold, the Bridegroom comes," we say the Troparion of the Temple; Glory: Both now: Resurrection Theotokion according to the Tone of the Troparion of the Saint; and after the second Trisagion, instead of "Remember, O Lord," we say the Kontakion of the Temple alone. Thereafter, "Lord, have mercy," 12 times, and the Dismissal. If there be the Feast of the Nativity of John the Forerunner, or the Beheading, or of the Chief Apostles Peter and Paul: at the Midnight Office we say after the first Trisagion, instead of "Behold, the Bridegroom comes," the Troparion to the Saint; Glory: Both now: Resurrection Theotokion according to the Tone of the Troparion of the Saint; after the second Trisagion, instead of "Remember, O Lord, as Thou art good," we say the Kontakion to the Saint; thereafter, "Lord, have mercy," 12 times, and the Dismissal; but the prayers "Remember, O Lord, in hope" we do not say.[^11167]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: On Monday we sing Matins according to the custom, as indicated, only at "God is the Lord": the Troparion to the Saint twice; Glory: Both now: Theotokion according to the Tone of the Troparion of the Saint, from the lesser Theotokia. But if there be no Troparion to the Saint in order, then we say the general Troparion to the Saint according to his hierarchic rank or monastic venerable dignity, twice; Glory: Both now: Theotokion according to the Tone of the Troparion. If there be a forefeast or afterfeast, then we say the Troparion of the feast twice; Glory: to the Saint, if there is one; Both now: of the feast.[^11168]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: If there be no Troparion to the Saint, then we say the Troparion of the feast twice; Glory: Both now: the same Troparion of the feast. The Penitential Canon we sing with the Heirmos to 6, and of the Bodiless Powers to 4, and of the Saint from the Menaion to 4. But if the Saint is sung to 6, then both Martyria in the Octoechos are omitted, and we sing to the Saint to 6. But if a Polyeleos of the Saint is sung, then the Octoechos is not sung, but we sing the Canon to the Theotokos—or if there be a forefeast or afterfeast—with the Heirmos to 6 (the Heirmos twice, troparia to 4), and to the Saint to 8. Thus indeed throughout the whole week we sing to a Saint with a Polyeleos the Canon to 8. If two Saints occur, the Canon of the Bodiless Powers is omitted, and we sing the Penitential Canon with the Heirmos to 6, and to the Saints to 4 verses each. On Tuesday at Matins: the Penitential Canon with the Heirmos to 6, and to the Forerunner to 4, and of the Saint from the Menaion to 4. But if the Saint is sung to 6, both Martyria in the Octoechos are omitted, and we sing to the Saint to 6. The Polyeleos is according to what was prescribed above. The same happens if there are two Saints: their Canons to 4 verses each. On Wednesday at Matins: the Canon of the Cross with the Heirmos to 6, and of the Theotokos to 4, and of the Saint to 4. But if the Saint is sung to 6, both Martyria in the Octoechos are omitted, and the Canon of the Cross is sung with the Heirmos to 4, of the Theotokos to 4, and to the Saint to 6. If there are two Saints, the Canon of the Theotokos in the Octoechos is omitted, and we sing to the Saints to 8. On Thursday at Matins: we sing the Canon of the Holy Apostles with the Heirmos to 6, and of Saint Nicholas to 4, and of the Saint from the Menaion to 4. But if the Saint from the Menaion is sung to 6: we sing the Canon of the Apostles with the Heirmos and with the Theotokia to 5, and of Saint Nicholas with the Theotokion to 3, and of the Menaion to 6. If there are two Saints: we sing the Canon to the Apostles with the Heirmos to 6, and to the Saints to 8. On Friday we sing as was declared for Wednesday, without change.[^11169]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: After Ode 3, Sessional Hymn to the Saint; Glory: Both now: Theotokion. If there be two Saints, and they have two Kontakia and two Sessional Hymns: we say first the Kontakion to the Saint (if there is one) and Ikos, then the Sessional Hymn to the same; Glory: Sessional Hymn to the other Saint; Both now: Theotokion; and to the other Saint we say the Kontakion and Ikos after Ode 6. If there be a forefeast or afterfeast, we say instead of the Theotokion: Both now: of the feast. If it be to the Saint to 6, we say the Sessional Hymn to him twice; Glory: Both now: of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion and Ikos to the Saint, if there is one; but if not, then we say the general Kontakion to the Saint according to his hierarchic rank or monastic venerable dignity. If it be for a Saint with a Polyeleos or with a Vigil, then we say the Kontakion and Ikos to the Saint. But during a forefeast or afterfeast we say the Kontakion and Ikos in this manner: after Ode 3, Kontakion and Ikos of the feast, then Sessional Hymn to the Saint twice; Glory: Both now: Sessional Hymn of the feast; and the rest in order, as indicated in the Typikon.[^11170]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: *Concerning the Photagogica [Exapostilaria],*

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: *how they are said on weekdays apart from Sunday.*[^11171]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: Photagogicon in the Octoechos; Glory: Both now: its Theotokion. But if there be a Photagogicon of the Saint in the Menaion: say it at Glory, after the daily Pho-[^11172]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: -tagogicon; Both now: its Theotokion. But if there be two Saints in the Menaion, and two Photagogica: we say the 1st in the Octoechos, thereafter of the Saint; Glory: of the other Saint; Both now: its Theotokion. But if it be Wednesday or Friday: Both now: Stavrotheotokion in the Octoechos. On Saturday, if the Saint of the day has one: after Ode 9 we say the Photagogicon of the Saint before the Menaion, then Glory: in the Octoechos; Both now: its Theotokion. Thus are the Photagogica said when the Octoechos is sung with the Menaion.[^11173]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: At the Praises [Lauds] to the Saint, if there be any, and as many as indicated in the Typikon; Glory: to the Saint; Both now: Theotokion according to the Tone of the Saint; thereafter we say: "Glory to Thee Who hast shown us the light." But if there be none to the Saint at the Praises, then we say: "To Thee glory is due."[^11174]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: At the Aposticha in the Octoechos, Glory: to the Saint, if there is one; Both now: Theotokion according to the Tone of the Saint. If not, then we say Glory: Both now: in the Octoechos. If there be a verse with a refrain to the Saint at Matins, then we say at the Aposticha in the Octoechos, with the verses: "We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord" [Ps. 89:14 LXX]; second: "And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us" [Ps. 89:17 LXX]. Then we say the refrain to the Saint which occurs, and the verse, and Glory: to him; Both now: Theotokion. And at Vespers at the Aposticha we say likewise. If there be a forefeast or afterfeast, when the Octoechos is not sung: then at the Aposticha we say of the feast with the verses. If there be a verse with a refrain to the Saint, then after the festal verses, before the festal Glory, we say the verse to the Saint with the refrain; Glory: to the Saint; Both now: of the feast. And at Vespers at the Aposticha we say likewise. After "It is good to give praise to the Lord": after the Trisagion, Troparion to the Saint; Glory: Both now: Theotokion according to the Tone of the Troparion of the Saint. If there be a forefeast or afterfeast, then we say the Troparion to the Saint; Glory: Both now: of the feast. If there be no Troparion to the Saint, then we say one Troparion of the feast. If there be no forefeast or afterfeast, we say the general Troparion to the Saint according to his hierarchic rank or monastic venerable dignity; Glory: Both now: Theotokion according to the Tone of the Troparion.[^11175]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: At the First Hour, Glory: Troparion to the Saint; Both now: Theotokion of the Hours. After the Trisagion, Kontakion to the Saint. If for two Saints there are two Troparia, then we say the Troparion to the Saint; Glory: Troparion to the other Saint; Both now: Theotokion of the Hours. After the Trisagion, Kontakion to the first Saint. At the Third Hour and at the others we say likewise, and we alternate the Kontakia. If a forefeast or afterfeast occurs, we say first the Troparion of the feast, then Glory: Troparion to the Saint; Both now: Theotokion of the Hours. After the Trisagion, Kontakion of the feast invariably at all the Hours. If it be also to the Saint to 6, do thus every day. If there be no Troparion to the Saint, or to two Saints, nor a Kontakion, if there be no forefeast or afterfeast, then we say at the Hours the general Troparion and Kontakion to the Saint according to his hierarchic rank or monastic venerable dignity; after "Pardon, remit": after the Trisagion we say the Kontakion first to the Temple of Christ, then of the day, and to the Temple of the Saint, and-[^11176]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: -to the Saint of the day, if there is one; Glory: "With the Saints give rest"; Both now: Kontakion to the Temple of the Theotokos. If it be not the Temple of the Theotokos, then we say: Both now: "Protection of Christians." If it be a forefeast or afterfeast of Christ, we say first the Kontakion of the feast of Christ, and the rest in order; but the Kontakion of the Temple of Christ we do not say. Thus we say if the Liturgy is not celebrated.[^11177]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes in the Octoechos to 6. If there be an Ode to the Saint which the Typikon indicates, then we say in the Octoechos to 4, and the Ode to the Saint to 4. If there be two Saints, and the Typikon indicates an Ode to each, then the Octoechos is omitted. If there be a forefeast or afterfeast, then also we say as the Typikon indicates. After the Entrance we say Troparia and Kontakia as the Typikon declares. And during a forefeast and afterfeast at the Liturgy the Troparion and Kontakion of the day are not said until the Apodosis, because the Octoechos is not sung. Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, Gospel, and Communion Verse of the day, and as indicated in the Typikon. In like manner we sing on the other days also, except Saturdays and Sundays.[^11178]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: *when we sing "God is the Lord":*[^11179]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнею си́лою херꙋві́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃ественною сла́вою а҆́гглски покланѧ́емый, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ сꙋ́щихъ на землѝ, недо-
items.english_text: On Friday evening at "Lord, I have cried": Stichera in the Menaion to the Saint to 6; Glory: to the Saint, if he has one; if not, Glory: Both now: 1st Theotokion according to the occurring Tone. At the Aposticha in the Octoechos, three Martyria which are written at "Lord, I have cried," omitting the 1st; and refrain: "Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes" [Ps. 122:1 LXX]; and second: "Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us" [Ps. 122:3 LXX]; Glory: to the Saint, if he has one; if not, Glory: Both now: Theotokion in the Octoechos. After "Our Father": Troparion to the Saint; Glory: Both now: Resurrection Theotokion of the occurring Tone; litany, and dismissal. At Compline on Friday after "It is truly meet," after the Trisagion: Troparion to the Temple of Christ and to the Temple of the Theotokos; and to the Temple of a male Saint or female Saint on Friday the Troparion is not said. Then: "Apostles, Martyrs"; Glory: "With the Saints give rest"; Both now: "As first-fruits." If there be a forefeast or afterfeast, we say the Kontakion of the feast. If it be for a Saint with Doxology, we say the Kontakion to the Saint; Glory: Both now: of the feast. Midnight Office we sing according to the custom; only if there be a Master’s [Dominical] Feast, or if the Theotokos is sung with Apodosis, or the Nativity of the Forerunner, or the Beheading, or Peter and Paul, or the Temple of the Saint, and on the Synaxis of the Theotokos, and on the Synaxis of John the Forerunner, we say after the first Trisagion the Troparion, and after the second Trisagion the Kontakion, as was indicated on Monday. At Matins, at "God is the Lord": Troparion to the Saint twice; Glory: Both now: Resurrection Theotokion according to the Tone of the Troparion of the Saint, and not of the occurring Tone, because the Resurrection Theotokion of the Tone is said after the 1st Sessional Hymn at: Both now. But if the Saint has a Polyeleos, then we say at "God is the Lord": after the Troparion of the Saint, the Resurrection Theotokion of the Tone. If on Saturday there be a forefeast or afterfeast, at "God is the Lord": we say the Troparion of the feast twice; Glory: Troparion to the Saint,-[^11180]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: И́ ны́нѣ: пра́зднику. А́ще не бу́детъ тропарѧ̀ Свѧто́му, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь пра́зднику два́жды. Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: то́йже. Та́же глаго́лемъ каѳі́сму ѕ҃і. По каѳі́смахъ є҆ктеніа̀, и҆ сѣда́льны во О҆ктѡ́ихѣ, му́ченичны два̀, а҃-й и҆ в҃-й. Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ воскре́сный и҆́хъ, и҆ чте́ніе; посе́мъ Непоро́чны. По Непоро́чнахъ є҆ктеніа̀, и҆ сѣда́льны въ О҆ктѡ́исѣ му́ченичны, г҃-й и҆ д҃-й, поко́инъ. Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ, и҆ чте́ніе, Ѱало́мъ н҃. И҆ пое́мъ канѡ́ны; въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ всегда̀ предварѧ́етъ въ Мине́и Свѧты́хъ. Пое́мъ же Свѧта́гѡ Мине́и со і҆рмосо́мъ на ѕ҃, та́же Ст҃о́му, є҆гѡ́же є҆́сть хра́мъ, на д҃, и҆ во О҆ктѡ́исѣ му́чениченъ канѡ́нъ на д҃. А́ще ли два̀ Свѧ́та въ Мине́и, пое́мъ є҆ди́номꙋ канѡ́нъ со і҆рмосо́мъ на ѕ҃, а҆ дрꙋго́мꙋ на д҃, и҆ му́чениченъ канѡ́нъ О҆ктѡ́иха на д҃; хра́ма же канѡ́нъ ѡ҆ставлѧ́етсѧ. А́ще ли хра́мъ Хрїсто́въ и҆лѝ Бц҃ы, пое́мъ пре́жде хра́ма канѡ́нъ со і҆рмосо́мъ на ѕ҃, (і҆рмо́съ по два́жды, тропарѝ на д҃,) и҆ Свѧта́гѡ на д҃, и҆ въ О҆ктѡ́исѣ му́чениченъ канѡ́нъ на д҃. А́ще ли Свѧты́й на ѕ҃, пое́мъ хра́ма со і҆рмосо́мъ на д҃, и҆ Свѧта́гѡ на ѕ҃, и҆ во О҆ктѡ́исѣ на д҃.
items.english_text: -Both now: of the feast. If there be no Troparion to the Saint, then we say the Troparion of the feast twice; Glory: Both now: the same. Then we say Kathisma 16. After the Kathismata, litany, and Sessional Hymns in the Octoechos, two Martyria, the 1st and the 2nd; Glory: Both now: their Resurrection Theotokion, and reading; thereafter the Evlogetaria [Amomos / Psalm 118]. After the Evlogetaria, litany, and Sessional Hymns in the Octoechos, Martyria, the 3rd and the 4th, [and] the Sessional Hymn of Repose [Pokoin]; Glory: Both now: Theotokion, and reading; Psalm 50. And we sing the Canons; on Saturday the Saint of the Menaion always takes precedence. We sing the Canon of the Saint of the Menaion with the Heirmos to 6, then to the Saint of whom the Temple is [dedicated] to 4, and in the Octoechos the Martyr Canon to 4. But if there are two Saints in the Menaion, we sing to the one the Canon with the Heirmos to 6, and to the other to 4, and the Martyr Canon of the Octoechos to 4; but the Canon of the Temple is omitted. But if it be the Temple of Christ or of the Theotokos, we sing first the Canon of the Temple with the Heirmos to 6 (the Heirmos twice, troparia to 4), and of the Saint to 4, and in the Octoechos the Martyr Canon to 4. But if the Saint is celebrated to 6, we sing of the Temple with the Heirmos to 4, and of the Saint to 6, and in the Octoechos to 4.[^11181]

items.office: Saturday: All Saints and the Departed[^10760]
items.slavonic_text: Въ ку́ю ли́бо сꙋббѡ́тꙋ славосло́віе прилучи́тсѧ, на Оу́трени канѡ́нъ хра́ма, а҆́ще є҆́сть Хрїсто́въ, и҆лѝ Бц҃ы, со і҆рмосо́мъ на ѕ҃, (і҆рмо́съ по два́жды, тропарѝ на д҃) и҆ Свѧта́гѡ на и҃. По г҃-й пѣ́сни сѣда́ленъ Свѧто́му дневно́му. Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ є҆гѡ̀. По ѕ҃-й пѣ́сни конда́къ Свѧто́му, и҆ і҆́косъ. А́ще ли нѣ́сть Свѧто́му тропарѧ̀ и҆ кондака̀, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь ѻ҆бщїй Свѧто́му, проти́въ преподо́бства є҆гѡ̀, во ѻ҆бщихъ тропарѣ́хъ и҆ кондацѣ́хъ. По ѳ҃-й пѣ́сни свѣти́ленъ пре́жде Свѧто́му, та́же, Сла́ва: въ О҆ктѡ́исѣ, И́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ є҆гѡ̀. А́ще же нѝ: свѣти́ленъ во О҆ктѡ́исѣ: И́же ме́ртвыми: Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Мы̀ ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ хва́лимсѧ. А́ще бу́детъ славосло́віе Свѧто́му въ сꙋббѡ́ту, пое́мъ свѣти́ленъ Свѧто́му два́жды. Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ є҆гѡ̀. items.english_text: On whatever Saturday a Doxology occurs: at Matins, the Canon of the Temple—if it is of Christ or of the Theotokos—with the Heirmos to 6 (the Heirmos twice, troparia to 4), and of the Saint to 8. After Ode 3, Sessional Hymn to the daily Saint; Glory: Both now: its Theotokion. After Ode 6, Kontakion to the Saint, and Ikos. But if there is no Troparion and Kontakion to the Saint, then we say the general Troparion to the Saint according to his hierarchic rank or monastic venerable dignity, in the general troparia and kontakia. After Ode 9, Photagogicon [Exapostilarion] first to the Saint; then Glory: in the Octoechos; Both now: its Theotokion. If not: Photagogicon in the Octoechos: "Thou Who [rulest] over the dead"; Glory: Both now: "In thee we make our boast." If there be a Doxology to the Saint on Saturday, we sing the Photagogicon to the Saint twice; Glory: Both now: its Theotokion. If there are no Stichera to the Saint at the Praises [Lauds], we say: "To Thee glory is due," and "Glory to Thee Who hast shown us the light." And in the Octoechos we do not sing Stichera at the Praises, but we sing them at the Aposticha. But if we sing Stichera to the Saint at the Praises, we do not say that verse: "To Thee glory is due," but after the Stichera we say: "Glory to Thee Who hast shown us the light." Thereafter: "Let us complete our morning prayer"; and at the Aposticha, in the Octoechos, the three Martyria which are written at the Praises. And we say the customary refrains: the 1st: "We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, O Lord" [Ps. 89:14 LXX]; the 2nd: "And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us" [Ps. 89:17 LXX]; and the 4th, of repose [pokoin], we omit. Glory: to the Saint, if he has one; but if not, Glory: Both now: their Theotokion. But the Aposticha in the Octoechos we omit when we sing on Saturday: "God is the Lord." After "It is good to give praise to the Lord" and after the Trisagion: Troparion to the Saint; Glory: Both now: Morning Theotokion, according to the Tone of the Troparion of the Saint. If there be a forefeast or afterfeast, we say the Troparion to the Saint; Glory: Both now: of the feast. If there be two Saints in a forefeast or afterfeast, and they have two Troparia, then we say the Troparion to the Saint; Glory: Troparion to the other Saint; Both now: of the feast. If there be no Troparion to the Saint, then we say one Troparion of the feast. Then the litany, and the First Hour. At the Third Hour we say,-[^11182]

items.english_text: -Glory: Troparion to the Saint; Both now: Theotokion of the Hours. After the Trisagion, Kontakion to the Saint; if there be a forefeast or afterfeast, we say the Troparion of the feast; Glory: to the Saint; Both now: Theotokion of the Hours. After the Trisagion, Kontakion of the feast. If there are two Saints, and they have two Troparia, we say the Troparion of the feast; Glory: to the Saint; Both now: Theotokion of the Hours. After the Trisagion, Kontakion of the feast. At the Sixth Hour, Troparion of the feast; Glory: Troparion to the other Saint, and the Kontakion of the feast at all the Hours without change, except for a great Saint with a Polyeleos; for then we alternate the Kontakion. If there be no Troparion to the Saint, then we say the Troparion and Kontakion of the feast, and thereafter the Dismissal. Then the customary Litiya. At the Liturgy (the Beatitudes in the Octoechos to 6. But if the Saint has an Ode, we say first to the Saint Ode 3, with the Heirmos to 4, and in the Octoechos to 4.) Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, and Gospel, and Communion Verses, first to the Saint, and then of the day. If to the Saint there is no Epistle, then Prokeimenon, and Epistle, Alleluia, and Gospel, and Communion Verse of the day, and for repose. But from the Sunday of the Publican and the Pharisee until the Sunday of All Saints, Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, Gospel, and Communion Verse first of the Saturday, and then to the Saint. If to the Saint there is no Epistle, Gospel, and Communion Verse, then for repose.[^11183]

items.english_text: Where there is a Temple of Christ’s Resurrection, we sing on Saturday at Matins the Resurrection Canon, the Heirmos twice, the troparia to 4, and we sing thus: two Resurrection troparia, and one Cross-Resurrection, and one Theotokion, and to the Saint in the Menaion to 4, and in the Octoechos to 4. items.english_text: -"God is the Lord": we sing Alleluia in Tone 2, thrice. Verse 1: "From night-time my spirit watches early for Thee, O God" [Isa. 26:9 LXX]; and the other verses. Then the Troparion, Tone 2: "Apostles, Prophets, and Martyrs," twice; Glory: "Remember, O Lord, as Thou art good"; Both now: Theotokion: "O holy Mother." After Kathisma 1: "The Lord said unto my Lord" [Ps. 109:1 LXX]: Sessional Hymn in the Octoechos, and reading. And the Evlogetaria [Amomos / Psalm 118] we sing, dividing the Kathisma into two stases with refrains.[^11188]

items.english_text: -repose; and the Priest reads the Diptychs [Pomyannyk] and the Prayer secretly: "O God of spirits and of all flesh"; and the Choir sings: "Lord, have mercy" (thrice). After the Exclamation, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5: "Give rest, O our Savior"; Glory: Both now: Theotokion: "Thou Who didst shine forth from the Virgin"; then Psalm 50: "Have mercy upon me, O God." The Canon first in the Menaion with the Heirmos to 6, and to the Saint of whom the Temple is [dedicated] to 4, and in the Octoechos to 4, Canon 1. But where there is a Temple of the Lord or of the Theotokos: the Canon first of the Temple with the Heirmos to 6, then in the Menaion and in the Octoechos. After Ode 3, Sessional Hymn in the Menaion to the Saint; after Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 8: "With the Saints give rest," and the Ikos. After Ode 9, Photagogicon [Exapostilarion] of the day. At the Praises [Lauds], Martyr Stichera 4, and of repose; Glory: Both now: Theotokion. At the Aposticha, prosomoia Stichera of repose; Glory: Both now: Theotokion. After "It is good to give praise to the Lord": Trisagion; the above-mentioned Troparia; litany, and dismissal. First Hour, and procession into the Narthex, and the complete dismissal. At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes in the Octoechos to 6. But if on Saturday a forefeast or afterfeast occurs with the Octoechos, that of repose is not sung until the Apodosis of the feast.[^11191]

But if at any other time, then to say thus:

По г҃-й пѣ́сни сѣда́ленъ Свѧто́му дневно́му. Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ є҆гѡ̀. По ѕ҃-й пѣ́сни конда́къ Свѧто́му, и҆ і҆́косъ. А́ще ли нѣ́сть Свѧто́му тропарѧ̀ и҆ кондака̀, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь ѻ҆бщїй Свѧто́му, проти́въ преподо́бства є҆гѡ̀, во ѻ҆бщихъ тропарѣ́хъ и҆ кондацѣ́хъ. По ѳ҃-й пѣ́сни свѣти́ленъ пре́жде Свѧто́му, та́же, Сла́ва: въ О҆ктѡ́исѣ, И́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ є҆гѡ̀. А́ще же нѝ: свѣти́ленъ во О҆ктѡ́исѣ: И́же ме́ртвыми: Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Мы̀ ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ хва́лимсѧ. А́ще бу́детъ славосло́віе Свѧто́му въ сꙋббѡ́ту, пое́мъ свѣти́ленъ Свѧто́му два́жды. Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ є҆гѡ̀. А́ще нѣ́сть на Хвали́техъ Свѧто́му стїхи́ръ, глаго́лемъ: Тебѣ̀ сла́ва подоба́етъ: и҆ Сла́ва тебѣ̀ показа́вшемꙋ на́мъ свѣ́тъ: А҆ во О҆ктѡ́исѣ стїхи́ръ на Хвали́техъ не пое́мъ, но пое́мъ и҆́хъ на Стїхо́внѣ. А́ще ли пое́мъ Свѧто́му на Хвали́техъ стїхи̑ры, и҆ мы̀: Тебѣ̀ сла́ва подоба́етъ, тогѡ̀ стїха̀ не глаго́лемъ, но по стїхи́рахъ глаго́лемъ: Сла́ва: тебѣ̀ показа́вшемꙋ на́мъ свѣ́тъ. Посе́мъ: И҆спо́лнимъ оу҆́треннюю моли́тву: И҆ на Стїхо́внѣ, во О҆ктѡ́исѣ, и҆́же сꙋ́ть пи́саны на Хвали́техъ му́ченичны трѝ. Запѣ́вы же глаго́лемъ ѻ҆бы̑чныѧ, а҃-й: И҆спо́лнихомсѧ зау́тра ми́лости твоеѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇и: в҃-й: И҆ бу́ди свѣ́тлость Гдⷭ҇а Бг҃а на́шегѡ на на́съ: и҆ д҃-й поко́инъ ѡ҆ставлѧ́емъ. Сла́ва: Свѧто́му, а҆́ще и҆́мать, а҆́ще ли нѝ, Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ и҆́хъ. Стїхѡ́вныѧ же во О҆ктѡ́исѣ ѡ҆ставлѧ́емъ, є҆гда̀ пое́мъ въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ: Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь. По Бла́го є҆́сть: и҆ по трисвѧто́мъ, тропа́рь Свѧто́му: Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ оу҆́тренній, во Гла́съ тропарѧ̀ Свѧта́гѡ. А́ще бу́детъ предпра́зднство, и҆лѝ попра́зднство глаго́лемъ тропа́рь Свѧто́му Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: пра́зднику. А́ще бу́детъ два̀ Свѧты́хъ въ предпра́зднство, и҆лѝ попра́зднство, а҆ и҆́мъ два̀ тропарѧ̀, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь Свѧто́му, Сла́ва: тропа́рь дрꙋго́му Свѧто́му, И́ ны́нѣ: пра́зднику. А́ще не бу́детъ тропарѧ̀ Свѧто́му, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь пра́здника є҆ди́нъ. Пото́мъ є҆ктеніа̀, и҆ Ча́съ а҃-й. На г҃-мъ Часѣ̀ глаго́лемъ,
items.english_text: That He may establish their souls in the land of the li-[^11194]

По г҃-й пѣ́сни сѣда́ленъ Свѧто́му дневно́му. Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ є҆гѡ̀. По ѕ҃-й пѣ́сни конда́къ Свѧто́му, и҆ і҆́косъ. А́ще ли нѣ́сть Свѧто́му тропарѧ̀ и҆ кондака̀, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь ѻ҆бщїй Свѧто́му, проти́въ преподо́бства є҆гѡ̀, во ѻ҆бщихъ тропарѣ́хъ и҆ кондацѣ́хъ. По ѳ҃-й пѣ́сни свѣти́ленъ пре́жде Свѧто́му, та́же, Сла́ва: въ О҆ктѡ́исѣ, И́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ є҆гѡ̀. А́ще же нѝ: свѣти́ленъ во О҆ктѡ́исѣ: И́же ме́ртвыми: Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Мы̀ ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ хва́лимсѧ. А́ще бу́детъ славосло́віе Свѧто́му въ сꙋббѡ́ту, пое́мъ свѣти́ленъ Свѧто́му два́жды. Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ є҆гѡ̀. А́ще нѣ́сть на Хвали́техъ Свѧто́му стїхи́ръ, глаго́лемъ: Тебѣ̀ сла́ва подоба́етъ: и҆ Сла́ва тебѣ̀ показа́вшемꙋ на́мъ свѣ́тъ: А҆ во О҆ктѡ́исѣ стїхи́ръ на Хвали́техъ не пое́мъ, но пое́мъ и҆́хъ на Стїхо́внѣ. А́ще ли пое́мъ Свѧто́му на Хвали́техъ стїхи̑ры, и҆ мы̀: Тебѣ̀ сла́ва подоба́етъ, тогѡ̀ стїха̀ не глаго́лемъ, но по стїхи́рахъ глаго́лемъ: Сла́ва: тебѣ̀ показа́вшемꙋ на́мъ свѣ́тъ. Посе́мъ: И҆спо́лнимъ оу҆́треннюю моли́тву: И҆ на Стїхо́внѣ, во О҆ктѡ́исѣ, и҆́же сꙋ́ть пи́саны на Хвали́техъ му́ченичны трѝ. Запѣ́вы же глаго́лемъ ѻ҆бы̑чныѧ, а҃-й: И҆спо́лнихомсѧ зау́тра ми́лости твоеѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇и: в҃-й: И҆ бу́ди свѣ́тлость Гдⷭ҇а Бг҃а на́шегѡ на на́съ: и҆ д҃-й поко́инъ ѡ҆ставлѧ́емъ. Сла́ва: Свѧто́му, а҆́ще и҆́мать, а҆́ще ли нѝ, Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ и҆́хъ. Стїхѡ́вныѧ же во О҆ктѡ́исѣ ѡ҆ставлѧ́емъ, є҆гда̀ пое́мъ въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ: Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь. По Бла́го є҆́сть: и҆ по трисвѧто́мъ, тропа́рь Свѧто́му: Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ оу҆́тренній, во Гла́съ тропарѧ̀ Свѧта́гѡ. А́ще бу́детъ предпра́зднство, и҆лѝ попра́зднство глаго́лемъ тропа́рь Свѧто́му Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: пра́зднику. А́ще бу́детъ два̀ Свѧты́хъ въ предпра́зднство, и҆лѝ попра́зднство, а҆ и҆́мъ два̀ тропарѧ̀, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь Свѧто́му, Сла́ва: тропа́рь дрꙋго́му Свѧто́му, И́ ны́нѣ: пра́зднику. А́ще не бу́детъ тропарѧ̀ Свѧто́му, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь пра́здника є҆ди́нъ. Пото́мъ є҆ктеніа̀, и҆ Ча́съ а҃-й. На г҃-мъ Часѣ̀ глаго́лемъ,
items.english_text: Again we pray for the repose of the fallen-asleep, ever-memorable servants of God *(Names)*. (If it be a universal commemoration, the Litany is as was prescribed above on Saturday at Matins. But if a non-universal Pannikhida is sung, we say thus:) Again we pray for the repose of the fallen-asleep servants of God, the blessed and ever-memorable founders of this holy Temple (of this holy Monastery, of our fathers and brethren), our parents and kinsfolk, lying here, inscribed here, and Orthodox Christians everywhere, and the servants of God *(Names)*, of whom we make remembrance, and that every transgression of theirs, voluntary and involuntary, may be pardoned them.

items.slavonic_text: Въ ку́ю ли́бо сꙋббѡ́тꙋ славосло́віе прилучи́тсѧ, на Оу́трени канѡ́нъ хра́ма, а҆́ще є҆́сть Хрїсто́въ, и҆лѝ Бц҃ы, со і҆рмосо́мъ на ѕ҃, (і҆рмо́съ по два́жды, тропарѝ на д҃) и҆ Свѧта́гѡ на и҃. По г҃-й пѣ́сни сѣда́ленъ Свѧто́му дневно́му. Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ є҆гѡ̀. По ѕ҃-й пѣ́сни конда́къ Свѧто́му, и҆ і҆́косъ. А́ще ли нѣ́сть Свѧто́му тропарѧ̀ и҆ кондака̀, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь ѻ҆бщїй Свѧто́му, проти́въ преподо́бства є҆гѡ̀, во ѻ҆бщихъ тропарѣ́хъ и҆ кондацѣ́хъ. По ѳ҃-й пѣ́сни свѣти́ленъ пре́жде Свѧто́му, та́же, Сла́ва: въ О҆ктѡ́исѣ, И́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ є҆гѡ̀. А́ще же нѝ: свѣти́ленъ во О҆ктѡ́исѣ: И́же ме́ртвыми: Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Мы̀ ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ хва́лимсѧ. А́ще бу́детъ славосло́віе Свѧто́му въ сꙋббѡ́ту, пое́мъ свѣти́ленъ Свѧто́му два́жды. Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ є҆гѡ̀. А́ще нѣ́сть на Хвали́техъ Свѧто́му стїхи́ръ, глаго́лемъ: Тебѣ̀ сла́ва подоба́етъ: и҆ Сла́ва тебѣ̀ показа́вшемꙋ на́мъ свѣ́тъ: А҆ во О҆ктѡ́исѣ стїхи́ръ на Хвали́техъ не пое́мъ, но пое́мъ и҆́хъ на Стїхо́внѣ. А́ще ли пое́мъ Свѧто́му на Хвали́техъ стїхи̑ры, и҆ мы̀: Тебѣ̀ сла́ва подоба́етъ, тогѡ̀ стїха̀ не глаго́лемъ, но по стїхи́рахъ глаго́лемъ: Сла́ва: тебѣ̀ показа́вшемꙋ на́мъ свѣ́тъ. Посе́мъ: И҆спо́лнимъ оу҆́треннюю моли́тву: И҆ на Стїхо́внѣ, во О҆ктѡ́исѣ, и҆́же сꙋ́ть пи́саны на Хвали́техъ му́ченичны трѝ. Запѣ́вы же глаго́лемъ ѻ҆бы̑чныѧ, а҃-й: И҆спо́лнихомсѧ зау́тра ми́лости твоеѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇и: в҃-й: И҆ бу́ди свѣ́тлость Гдⷭ҇а Бг҃а на́шегѡ на на́съ: и҆ д҃-й поко́инъ ѡ҆ставлѧ́емъ. Сла́ва: Свѧто́му, а҆́ще и҆́мать, а҆́ще ли нѝ, Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ и҆́хъ. Стїхѡ́вныѧ же во О҆ктѡ́исѣ ѡ҆ставлѧ́емъ, є҆гда̀ пое́мъ въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ: Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь. По Бла́го є҆́сть: и҆ по трисвѧто́мъ, тропа́рь Свѧто́му: Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ оу҆́тренній, во Гла́съ тропарѧ̀ Свѧта́гѡ. А́ще бу́детъ предпра́зднство, и҆лѝ попра́зднство глаго́лемъ тропа́рь Свѧто́му Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: пра́зднику. А́ще бу́детъ два̀ Свѧты́хъ въ предпра́зднство, и҆лѝ попра́зднство, а҆ и҆́мъ два̀ тропарѧ̀, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь Свѧто́му, Сла́ва: тропа́рь дрꙋго́му Свѧто́му, И́ ны́нѣ: пра́зднику. А́ще не бу́детъ тропарѧ̀ Свѧто́му, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь пра́здника є҆ди́нъ. Пото́мъ є҆ктеніа̀, и҆ Ча́съ а҃-й. На г҃-мъ Часѣ̀ глаго́лемъ,
items.english_text: Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia: Glory to Thee, O God (thrice).

А́ще ли нѣ́сть Свѧто́му тропарѧ̀ и҆ кондака̀, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь ѻ҆бщїй Свѧто́му, проти́въ преподо́бства є҆гѡ̀, во ѻ҆бщихъ тропарѣ́хъ и҆ кондацѣ́хъ. По ѳ҃-й пѣ́сни свѣти́ленъ пре́жде Свѧто́му, та́же, Сла́ва: въ О҆ктѡ́исѣ, И́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ є҆гѡ̀. А́ще же нѝ: свѣти́ленъ во О҆ктѡ́исѣ: И́же ме́ртвыми: Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Мы̀ ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ хва́лимсѧ. А́ще бу́детъ славосло́віе Свѧто́му въ сꙋббѡ́ту, пое́мъ свѣти́ленъ Свѧто́му два́жды. Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ є҆гѡ̀. Посе́мъ: И҆спо́лнимъ оу҆́треннюю моли́тву: И҆ на Стїхо́внѣ, во О҆ктѡ́исѣ, и҆́же сꙋ́ть пи́саны на Хвали́техъ му́ченичны трѝ. Сла́ва: Свѧто́му, а҆́ще и҆́мать, а҆́ще ли нѝ, Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ и҆́хъ. Стїхѡ́вныѧ же во О҆ктѡ́исѣ ѡ҆ставлѧ́емъ, є҆гда̀ пое́мъ въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ: Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь. По Бла́го є҆́сть: и҆ по трисвѧто́мъ, тропа́рь Свѧто́му: Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ оу҆́тренній, во Гла́съ тропарѧ̀ Свѧта́гѡ. А́ще бу́детъ предпра́зднство, и҆лѝ попра́зднство глаго́лемъ тропа́рь Свѧто́му Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: пра́зднику. А́ще бу́детъ два̀ Свѧты́хъ въ предпра́зднство, и҆лѝ попра́зднство, а҆ и҆́мъ два̀ тропарѧ̀, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь Свѧто́му, Сла́ва: тропа́рь дрꙋго́му Свѧто́му, И́ ны́нѣ: пра́зднику. А́ще не бу́детъ тропарѧ̀ Свѧто́му, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь пра́здника є҆ди́нъ. Пото́мъ є҆ктеніа̀, и҆ Ча́съ а҃-й. На г҃-мъ Часѣ̀ глаго́лемъ,
items.english_text: **Priest:** O God of spirits and of all flesh, Who hast trampled down death, and overthrown the devil, and given life unto Thy world: do Thou Thyself, O Lord, give rest to the souls of Thy fallen-asleep servants, in a place of light, in a place of green pasture, in a place of refreshment, whence pain, sorrow, and sighing have fled away; and every sin committed by them in word, or deed, or thought, as a good God and Lover of mankind do Thou forgive: for there is no man who shall live and not sin; for Thou alone art without sin, Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and Thy word is truth.

Запѣ́вы же глаго́лемъ ѻ҆бы̑чныѧ, а҃-й: И҆спо́лнихомсѧ зау́тра ми́лости твоеѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇и: в҃-й: И҆ бу́ди свѣ́тлость Гдⷭ҇а Бг҃а на́шегѡ на на́съ: и҆ д҃-й поко́инъ ѡ҆ставлѧ́емъ. Сла́ва: Свѧто́му, а҆́ще и҆́мать, а҆́ще ли нѝ, Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ и҆́хъ. Стїхѡ́вныѧ же во О҆ктѡ́исѣ ѡ҆ставлѧ́емъ, є҆гда̀ пое́мъ въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ: Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь. А́ще бу́детъ предпра́зднство, и҆лѝ попра́зднство глаго́лемъ тропа́рь Свѧто́му Сла́ва: и́ ны́нѣ: пра́зднику. А́ще не бу́детъ тропарѧ̀ Свѧто́му, тогда̀ глаго́лемъ тропа́рь пра́здника є҆ди́нъ. Пото́мъ є҆ктеніа̀, и҆ Ча́съ а҃-й. На г҃-мъ Часѣ̀ глаго́лемъ,
items.english_text: **Choir:** Memory eternal (thrice).[^11216]
